model_requirements.description: Waste Management is an environmental services industry providing residential and commercial waste collection, recycling, landfill operations, hazardous waste handling, and sustainable waste-to-energy solutions.

model.name: Waste Management
model.description: Waste Management is an environmental services industry providing residential and commercial waste collection, recycling, landfill operations, hazardous waste handling, and sustainable waste-to-energy solutions.
model.core_business_processes: Residential Waste Collection and Routing, Commercial Waste Collection and Hauling, Recycling Processing and Material Recovery, Landfill Operations and Cell Management, Hazardous Waste Handling and Disposal, Waste-to-Energy Conversion, Customer Service and Account Management, Fleet Management and Maintenance, Environmental Compliance and Monitoring, Billing and Revenue Management
model.data_domains: Customer, Collection Operations, Recycling, Landfill, Hazardous Waste, Fleet, Billing, Workforce, Environmental Compliance, Asset Management, Contracts, Sustainability
model.common_business_jargons: MSW (Municipal Solid Waste), C&D (Construction and Demolition Waste), MRF (Materials Recovery Facility), WTE (Waste-to-Energy), RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act), CID (Container Identification), TPD (Tons Per Day), LFG (Landfill Gas), LEL (Lower Explosive Limit), TCLP (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure), ROI (Return on Investment), EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization), CNG (Compressed Natural Gas), ASL (Automated Side Loader), FEL (Front End Loader), REL (Rear End Loader), CDL (Commercial Driver License), DOT (Department of Transportation), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), GHG (Greenhouse Gas), CO2e (Carbon Dioxide Equivalent), RNG (Renewable Natural Gas), SRF (Solid Recovered Fuel), PPE (Personal Protective Equipment), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), GPS (Global Positioning System), RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), WO (Work Order), PM (Preventive Maintenance), BOM (Bill of Materials), SLA (Service Level Agreement), PO (Purchase Order), AR (Accounts Receivable), AP (Accounts Payable), GL (General Ledger), COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), KPI (Key Performance Indicator), NPS (Net Promoter Score), CERCLA (Comprehensive Environmental Response Compensation and Liability Act), TSDF (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility), LEA (Local Enforcement Agency), SWIS (Solid Waste Information System), BOL (Bill of Lading), Manifest (Hazardous Waste Tracking Document), Tipping Fee (Charge per ton for waste disposal), Diversion Rate (Percentage of waste diverted from landfill), Compaction Ratio (Volume reduction ratio of waste), Leachate (Liquid that drains from landfill), Cell (Designated area within a landfill for waste placement), Cover (Daily soil or material placed over waste), Liner (Impermeable barrier at landfill base), Cap (Final cover system on closed landfill)
model.operational_systems_of_records: SAP S/4HANA (FI/CO; MM; PM; SD; EHS modules), Salesforce CRM (Customer accounts; service requests; contract management), AMCS Platform (Route optimization; fleet dispatching; container tracking), Geotab Fleet Telematics (GPS tracking; driver behavior; fuel management), Workday HCM (HR; payroll; talent management; workforce planning), Infor EAM (Asset lifecycle; maintenance scheduling; parts inventory), Locus Dispatch (Real-time route management; driver communication), Enviance EHS (Environmental compliance; permit tracking; incident management), Oracle Revenue Management (Billing; invoicing; rate management; collections), Waste Logics (Customer portal; service scheduling; container management)
model.industry_governing_body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Department of Transportation (DOT), Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA), State Environmental Quality Departments, Local Solid Waste Authorities, National Waste and Recycling Association (NWRA), Solid Waste Association of North America (SWANA), ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems, ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, CERCLA (Superfund) Compliance Requirements, Clean Air Act (CAA) Regulations, Clean Water Act (CWA) Regulations, IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) for Public Company Compliance

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all customer identities including residential households, commercial accounts, industrial clients, and municipal contracts. Manages customer profiles, service addresses, account hierarchies, contact information, customer segments (B2C residential, B2B commercial, government), NPS/satisfaction data, and customer lifecycle from prospect to active to inactive. Supports both one-time service requests and recurring service agreements. Integrates with Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics customer portal.
domains.references: Salesforce CRM / GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

products.name: customer_account
products.description: Single source of truth for all customer accounts served by Waste Management, encompassing residential households, commercial businesses, industrial clients, and municipal/government entities. Stores account identity, classification (B2C residential, B2B commercial, government), account status (prospect, active, suspended, inactive, closed), credit standing, account tier, NPS score, customer since date, preferred language, and integration keys to Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics portal. This is the master entity for the customer domain.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account record in the Waste Management data platform. Primary key for the customer domain master entity.

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.hazardous_waste_generator. Business justification: Customer accounts that are EPA-registered hazmat generators require direct link for RCRA compliance tracking, manifest generation authority, biennial reporting, and regulatory status monitoring. Essen

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Commercial waste accounts require dedicated account managers for contract renewals, service optimization, rate negotiations, and billing escalations. Critical for customer retention, upsell opportunit

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Hazardous waste generator accounts enroll in specific safety programs (RCRA, DOT hazmat). Business need: Program eligibility verification, compliance tracking, regulatory reporting. Domain experts exp

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized account_segment STRING field to FK reference to customer_segment table. This is the primary segment classification for customer accounts and should reference the authoritative s

attributes.name: waste_generator_class_waste_stream_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Generator Class Waste Stream Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_waste_stream. Business justification: Customer accounts are classified by EPA waste generator class (LQG/SQG/CESQG) which directly determines eligible waste streams for regulatory compliance, service offerings, manifest requirements, and

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the customer account. For residential accounts this is the householder full name; for commercial and municipal accounts this is the registered business or entity name. Used for billing, contracts, and correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; Salesforce CRM Account Name Field

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable account number assigned to the customer by Waste Management. Used on invoices, service agreements, and customer communications. Sourced from Oracle Revenue Management and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer account. Prospect = pre-service onboarding; Active = services being rendered; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., non-payment, seasonal hold); Inactive = no current services but record retained; Closed = account permanently terminated and archived.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Account Status; Salesforce CRM Account Stage

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Customer value tier assigned by Waste Management based on revenue contribution, contract size, and strategic importance. Drives service priority, dedicated account management assignment, and pricing concessions. Strategic tier typically reserved for large municipal contracts and national commercial accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Rating; Waste Management Commercial Sales Policy

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the customer account indicating the nature of the customer relationship. Drives service offerings, pricing tiers, regulatory requirements, and reporting segmentation. Residential = B2C households; Commercial = B2B businesses; Industrial = large-volume generators; Municipal/Government = public sector contracts.
attributes.references: NWRA Industry Classification; SWANA Member Segmentation Guidelines

attributes.name: autopay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is enrolled in automatic payment processing. When True, invoices are automatically charged to the customer's payment instrument on the due date via Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Autopay; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for invoice and billing correspondence delivery. Populated only when billing address differs from service address. Used by Oracle Revenue Management for invoice generation and AR collections.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; Oracle Revenue Management Billing Address

attributes.name: billing_address_same_as_service
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing Address Same as Service Address Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's billing address is identical to the service address. When True, billing correspondence is sent to the service address. When False, a separate billing address is maintained in the billing system.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Billing Address Configuration

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City for the customer's billing address. Used for invoice delivery and accounts receivable (AR) correspondence when billing address differs from service address.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the customer's billing address. Used for invoice delivery and tax rate determination in Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; USPS ZIP Code Directory

attributes.name: billing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the customer's billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and AR correspondence routing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer account was permanently closed and all services terminated. Null for active accounts. Used for churn analysis, win-back campaigns, and regulatory record retention compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Account Closure; Salesforce CRM Closed Date; RCRA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer account record was first created in the Waste Management data platform. Represents the record audit trail creation event. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable (AR) balance permitted for this customer account before service suspension is triggered. Expressed in USD. Set by the credit management team in Oracle Revenue Management based on payment history and account tier.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Credit Limit; GAAP ASC 310; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit standing of the customer account as assessed by Waste Management's accounts receivable (AR) and collections team. Good = no outstanding issues; Watch = elevated risk monitoring; Hold = service may be suspended pending payment; Collections = account referred to collections; Write_off = balance deemed uncollectable. Sourced from Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Credit Management; GAAP ASC 310 Receivables; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: customer_since_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer account was first activated and services commenced. Represents the start of the customer relationship lifecycle. Used for tenure analysis, loyalty programs, and contract renewal planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Created Date; Oracle Revenue Management Account Activation Date

attributes.name: industry_code
attributes.description: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) or Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code identifying the primary industry of the commercial or industrial customer. Used for waste stream profiling, regulatory compliance determination (e.g., RCRA hazardous waste generator status), and market analytics.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau NAICS; EPA RCRA Generator Classification; DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the customer account record in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), data synchronization with source systems, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has consented to receive marketing and promotional communications from Waste Management, including service upgrade offers, sustainability program invitations, and recycling education materials. Managed per CAN-SPAM and CCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA §1798.120 Opt-Out Rights; GDPR Article 7 Consent

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from the customer, ranging from 0 (extremely unlikely to recommend) to 10 (extremely likely to recommend). Promoters = 9-10; Passives = 7-8; Detractors = 0-6. Used for customer satisfaction analytics and service quality improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: Bain & Company NPS Methodology; Salesforce CRM Survey Integration; SWANA Customer Satisfaction Benchmarks

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this customer account. Used to determine survey recency and schedule follow-up surveys per the customer satisfaction program cadence.
attributes.references: Bain & Company NPS Methodology; Salesforce CRM Survey Date

attributes.name: paperless_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted into electronic (paperless) billing. When True, invoices are delivered via email or the Waste Logics customer portal rather than physical mail. Supports Waste Management's sustainability initiatives.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Oracle Revenue Management Billing Preferences

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms governing when invoices are due for this customer account. Net_15/30/45/60 = days from invoice date; Prepaid = payment required before service; COD = cash on delivery. Sourced from Oracle Revenue Management and SAP S/4HANA SD module.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Payment Terms; SAP S/4HANA SD; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: portal_access_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has active access to the Waste Logics self-service customer portal for online service scheduling, container management, invoice viewing, and service history review.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal Access Management

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Customer's preferred language for communications, invoices, and service notifications. Stored as IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX). Used to route multilingual customer service interactions and generate localized documents.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tags; Salesforce CRM Language Preference; CCPA Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: preferred_payment_method
attributes.description: Customer's preferred method for remitting payment on invoices. ACH = automated clearing house bank transfer; Autopay = recurring automatic charge; Invoice = paper or electronic invoice with manual payment. Stored in Oracle Revenue Management. Actual payment instrument details are NOT stored here per PCI DSS compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Payment Configuration; PCI DSS v4.0; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary point of contact for the customer account. For residential accounts this is the account holder; for commercial accounts this is the designated account manager or facility contact. Used for service communications, billing inquiries, and contract management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the customer account used for billing notifications, service alerts, and marketing communications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics customer portal. Subject to opt-in/opt-out preferences.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the customer account used for service scheduling, driver communication, and customer service interactions. Stored in E.164 international format. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_reference
attributes.description: Integration key linking this customer account to the corresponding Account record in Salesforce CRM. Used for bi-directional synchronization of customer profile, service requests, and contract data between the data platform and Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Salesforce Platform API

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: Customer master number assigned in SAP S/4HANA (SD and FI/CO modules). Used for order-to-cash processing, accounts receivable management, and financial reporting. Links this customer account to SAP billing documents and general ledger (GL) postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; SAP FI/CO Business Partner; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer account was most recently placed in suspended status, typically due to non-payment or service dispute. Null for accounts not currently or previously suspended. Used for AR collections workflow and service reinstatement tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Suspension Workflow; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Collections

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the most recent account suspension. Non_payment = outstanding AR balance; Customer_request = voluntary hold; Regulatory_hold = compliance investigation; Dispute = service or billing dispute; Seasonal = temporary seasonal service pause.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Suspension Reason Codes; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account holds a valid tax exemption certificate, exempting them from applicable sales or service taxes on waste management invoices. Typically applies to government, non-profit, and certain municipal accounts. Validated against exemption certificate records in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; IRS Tax-Exempt Organization Rules; State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: tax_exemption_number
attributes.description: Official tax exemption certificate number issued by the relevant tax authority for accounts with tax_exempt = True. Used to substantiate tax-exempt billing treatment during audits. Null for non-exempt accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Exemption; IRS Publication 557; State Tax Authority Exemption Certificate Requirements; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: waste_generator_class
attributes.description: EPA Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) hazardous waste generator classification for the customer account. LQG = Large Quantity Generator (>1,000 kg/month); SQG = Small Quantity Generator (100-1,000 kg/month); VSQG = Very Small Quantity Generator (<100 kg/month); Non_generator = no regulated hazardous waste. Determines regulatory compliance obligations and service requirements.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; Resource Conservation and Recovery Act; EPA Hazardous Waste Generator Regulations

attributes.name: waste_logics_customer_reference
attributes.description: Integration key linking this customer account to the corresponding customer record in the Waste Logics customer portal. Enables self-service scheduling, container management, and service history access for the customer.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal API; Waste Logics Integration Specification

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual persons associated with a customer account — primary account holders, billing contacts, service contacts, authorized representatives, and emergency contacts. Captures full name, title, role type (billing, service, primary, emergency), phone numbers, email addresses, preferred contact method, communication opt-in/opt-out flags, and portal login linkage. Supports both residential single-contact households and commercial multi-contact accounts. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact object and Waste Logics portal user records.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each contact record in the Waste Management customer domain. Primary key for the contact data product.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account this contact is associated with. Links the contact to the customer master record in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object — AccountId field

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized account_segment STRING field (semantic equivalent to customer_segment) to FK reference. Contacts should derive segment classification from their associated customer account via

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts receive communications and can authorize service changes. Inactive contacts are retained for historical reference. Do_not_contact enforces opt-out compliance. Deceased and unverified statuses support data quality management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contact record was first created in the Waste Management data platform (Silver layer). Represents the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit the contact belongs to within their company (e.g., Facilities, Finance, Operations, Environmental Health & Safety). Supports routing of service and billing inquiries to the correct team.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object — Department field

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact is registered on the National Do Not Call Registry or has explicitly requested no outbound telemarketing calls. True = do not call for marketing purposes. Enforced by the Oracle Revenue Management and Salesforce CRM outbound dialing workflows.
attributes.references: FTC National Do Not Call Registry; TCPA; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has consented to receive marketing and promotional email communications from Waste Management. True = opted in; False = opted out or never consented. Distinct from transactional/service emails which are sent regardless of this flag.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the contact. Used for transmission of formal documents such as service agreements, hazardous waste manifests, and regulatory compliance correspondence where fax remains a legally accepted delivery method.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations; RCRA Manifest Requirements

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given (first) name of the individual contact person. Used for personalized communications, billing correspondence, and service notifications.

attributes.name: is_billing_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated to receive billing-related communications including invoices, payment reminders, Accounts Receivable (AR) notices, and rate change notifications. Supports Oracle Revenue Management billing workflow routing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management — Contact Roles; GAAP/IFRS Billing Standards

attributes.name: is_emergency_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should be notified in emergency situations such as hazardous waste spills, service safety incidents, or after-hours urgent service needs. Emergency contacts are prioritized in incident escalation workflows managed through Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38 Emergency Action Plans; RCRA Emergency Response Requirements; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated as the primary point of contact for the customer account. Each customer account should have exactly one primary contact. Used to determine the default recipient for account-level communications when no specific role routing applies.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role — Primary flag; Waste Logics Contact Management

attributes.name: is_service_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated to receive service-related communications including collection schedule notifications, service disruption alerts, Work Order (WO) confirmations, and container delivery/pickup notices.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform — Contact Routing; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Professional title or position of the contact within their organization (e.g., Facilities Manager, Environmental Compliance Officer, Accounts Payable Specialist). Particularly relevant for commercial and municipal accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object — Title field

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family (last) name of the individual contact person. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for correspondence and account management.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the contact's mailing address for physical correspondence including paper billing statements, regulatory notices, and formal contract documents. May differ from the service address on the customer account.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the contact's mailing address (suite, apartment, floor, unit number, or care-of designation). Supplements mailing_address_line1 for complete address formatting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City component of the contact's mailing address. Used for physical mail delivery and geographic segmentation of contact communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the contact's mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international commercial and industrial accounts and determines applicable privacy regulation framework.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR (EU contacts); CCPA (California contacts)

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the contact's mailing address. Used for mail delivery, geographic market analysis, and routing of state-specific regulatory communications.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation for the contact's mailing address (e.g., TX, CA, FL). Follows USPS state code standards. Used for state-level regulatory compliance routing and tax jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; State Environmental Quality Departments; CCPA (California)

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number for the contact. Supports SMS/text message notifications for service day reminders, route change alerts, and two-factor authentication for portal access. Formatted per E.164 standard.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from this contact, on a scale of 0–10. Promoters score 9–10, Passives 7–8, Detractors 0–6. Used to measure customer satisfaction and loyalty at the contact level for targeted retention and service improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Methodology — Bain & Company; Salesforce CRM Survey Integration

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response was recorded for this contact. Used to determine survey recency and eligibility for follow-up surveys per survey cadence policies.
attributes.references: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Methodology; Salesforce CRM Survey Object

attributes.name: portal_access_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has been granted access to the Waste Logics self-service customer portal. True = portal account exists and is active. Linked to waste_logics_user_id when enabled. Supports self-service for service scheduling, container management, and billing review.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — User Management

attributes.name: portal_last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the contact's most recent login to the Waste Logics customer portal. Used to identify inactive portal users, drive re-engagement campaigns, and support portal access audits. Null if the contact has never logged in.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Session Audit Log; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Contact's stated preference for how Waste Management should reach them. Drives communication channel selection for service notifications, billing statements, and marketing communications. Supports Customer Relationship Management (CRM) personalization and compliance with communication preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time
attributes.description: Contact's preferred time window for receiving outbound calls or communications from Waste Management. Supports compliance with TCPA restrictions and improves customer satisfaction by respecting contact preferences.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the contact's preferred language for communications (e.g., en, es, fr, zh-CN). Drives localization of billing statements, service notifications, and customer portal content.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; Title VI Civil Rights Act (language access)

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the contact. Used for billing notifications, service confirmations, account alerts, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) communications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact Email field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Main telephone number for reaching the contact. Formatted per E.164 international standard. Used for service scheduling confirmations, billing inquiries, and emergency notifications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact Phone field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Functional role this contact plays on the customer account. Determines routing of communications and authorizations: primary (main account holder), billing (receives invoices and AR communications), service (receives service notifications and scheduling), emergency (after-hours escalation), authorized_representative (can act on behalf of account holder).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role; Waste Logics Contact Management

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_reference
attributes.description: External system identifier for this contact record in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the Silver layer and the Salesforce Contact object.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object — Id field

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate email address for the contact. Used as a fallback communication channel when the primary email is undeliverable or for routing specific communication types (e.g., service alerts to a work email, billing to a personal email).

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has provided express written consent to receive SMS/text message communications from Waste Management, including service reminders, route change alerts, and promotional messages. Required for TCPA compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which this contact record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking, conflict resolution during master data management, and audit traceability. Salesforce CRM is the primary source for commercial contacts; Waste Logics for portal-registered residential contacts.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 Data Lineage; SOX IT General Controls; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Honorific or salutation prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Used in formal written communications and billing correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object — Salutation field

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contact record was most recently modified in the Waste Management data platform. Tracks the latest change for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit trail compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management Module; Waste Management Contract Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer segment record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer data product. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change history tracking per Waste Management data governance policy.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Records Management

attributes.name: credit_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit check is required during customer onboarding for this segment. Typically required for commercial and industrial segments; waived for government/municipal accounts and standard residential prepay accounts.
attributes.references: Waste Management Credit Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management Module

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: Corresponding segment identifier code as configured in Salesforce CRM account records. Used for bi-directional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and Salesforce CRM to ensure consistent segment classification across systems.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object Configuration; Waste Management System Integration Standards

attributes.name: deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit is required from customers in this segment at account activation. Deposit requirements are managed in Oracle Revenue Management and SAP S/4HANA FI module.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Deposit Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Waste Management Credit Policy

attributes.name: diversion_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target waste diversion rate percentage (waste diverted from landfill through recycling, composting, or WTE) for customers in this segment. Used for sustainability program goal-setting, MRF throughput planning, and EPA/state environmental compliance reporting. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: EPA Waste Diversion Reporting; State Environmental Quality Department Diversion Mandates; SWANA Diversion Rate Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: dot_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether waste collection services for customers in this segment are subject to DOT hazardous materials transportation regulations (49 CFR). Applies to segments generating regulated hazardous waste requiring special vehicle placarding and CDL driver certification.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; RCRA Transportation Requirements; Geotab Fleet Telematics Compliance Configuration

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this customer segment definition is effective and available for customer assignment. Supports temporal validity tracking for segment taxonomy changes and ensures historical accuracy in customer lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Segment Versioning

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this customer segment definition is no longer active for new customer assignments. Null indicates the segment is open-ended with no planned expiration. Deprecated segments retain this date for historical reference.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Segment Versioning

attributes.name: epa_generator_class
attributes.description: EPA hazardous waste generator classification applicable to customers in this segment under RCRA regulations: VSQG (Very Small Quantity Generator), SQG (Small Quantity Generator), LQG (Large Quantity Generator), or Not Applicable for non-hazardous segments. Drives compliance reporting requirements in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; EPA 40 CFR Part 262 Hazardous Waste Generator Standards; Enviance EHS Compliance Configuration

attributes.name: ghg_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment require Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions reporting as part of their service agreement or regulatory obligation. Applies to large commercial, industrial, and government segments subject to EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98). Managed in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98); Clean Air Act GHG Regulations; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; Enviance EHS Compliance Module

attributes.name: is_default_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is the system default assigned to new customer accounts when no explicit segment classification has been determined during onboarding. Only one segment should carry this flag as True at any given time.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Default Configuration; Waste Logics Onboarding Rules

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer segment record was most recently updated in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; SOX Internal Controls; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the customer segment definition within the classification taxonomy. 'active' segments are available for customer assignment; 'deprecated' segments are retained for historical reference only; 'draft' segments are pending approval before activation.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Segment Management

attributes.name: manifest_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest (EPA Form 8700-22) is required for waste pickups from customers in this segment. Mandatory for LQG and SQG hazardous waste generators under RCRA. Tracked in Enviance EHS and SAP EHS module.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; EPA Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest Requirements (40 CFR Part 262); DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: market_category
attributes.description: High-level market category grouping for the segment: B2C (Business-to-Consumer residential), B2B (Business-to-Business commercial), Government, Industrial, or Non-Profit. Drives sales channel assignment, pricing strategy, and regulatory reporting classification.
attributes.references: Waste Management Sales Channel Strategy; EPA Waste Generator Classification

attributes.name: max_annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Maximum annual revenue threshold in US dollars for customer accounts in this segment. Accounts exceeding this threshold are eligible for promotion to a higher segment. Null indicates no upper revenue cap for the segment.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Segment Eligibility Rules; Waste Management Pricing Policy; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: min_annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue threshold in US dollars that a customer account must meet to qualify for this segment. Used in Salesforce CRM for automated segment assignment and in Oracle Revenue Management for rate eligibility validation. Null indicates no minimum revenue requirement.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Segment Eligibility Rules; Waste Management Pricing Policy; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: min_contract_term_months
attributes.description: Minimum contract duration in months required for customers in this segment. Null or zero indicates no minimum contract term (e.g., residential month-to-month). Enterprise and National Account segments typically require 12–60 month minimum terms.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management; Oracle Revenue Management Contract Terms; Waste Management Contract Policy

attributes.name: nps_benchmark_target
attributes.description: Target Net Promoter Score (NPS) benchmark for customers in this segment, used to set performance expectations for customer satisfaction programs. NPS ranges from -100 to +100. Residential segments typically target 40+; National Account segments target 60+.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Experience KPI Framework; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from invoice date within which payment is due for customers in this segment (e.g., Net 30, Net 60). Configured in Oracle Revenue Management and SAP S/4HANA AR module. Government segments may have Net 45 or Net 60 terms.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Payment Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI/AR Module; GAAP Accounts Receivable Standards

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier eligibility associated with this customer segment, used by Oracle Revenue Management to apply the correct rate schedule. Premium applies to national accounts and enterprise commercial; Government applies to municipal and government contracts with negotiated rates; Economy applies to standard residential.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rate Schedule Configuration; Waste Management Pricing Policy

attributes.name: routing_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank (1 = highest priority) used by AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch to sequence collection routes when capacity constraints require prioritization. Government and medical waste segments typically carry the highest routing priority.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization Configuration; Locus Dispatch Priority Rules

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel through which customers in this segment are acquired and managed. Drives Salesforce CRM lead routing and opportunity assignment rules. Municipal Bid applies to government/municipal contracts won through competitive procurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Routing Rules; Waste Management Sales Channel Strategy

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short, externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the customer segment (e.g., RES_SFH, COM_SMB, GOV_MUN). Used as the business key in Salesforce CRM account records, AMCS routing configurations, and Oracle Revenue Management rate schedules.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; AMCS Platform Route Configuration; Oracle Revenue Management Rate Schedules

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the customer segment, including the types of customers it encompasses, qualifying criteria, and intended use in service delivery and sales targeting.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Domain Data Dictionary

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the customer segment (e.g., 'Residential Single-Family', 'Commercial Small Business', 'Government/Municipal'). Displayed in Salesforce CRM, Waste Logics customer portal, and all operational and executive reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Operational classification of the segment type used for service eligibility rules, route planning in AMCS, and container management in Waste Logics. Residential covers single-family and multi-family; Commercial covers small business through national accounts; Industrial covers large-scale waste generators.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Segment Configuration; Waste Logics Service Eligibility Rules; SWANA Waste Generator Classification

attributes.name: service_eligibility_commercial
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible for commercial waste collection services (dumpster/container service, compactor service, FEL/REL/ASL truck service). Used by AMCS Platform for service configuration.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Service Configuration; Waste Management Service Catalog

attributes.name: service_eligibility_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible for hazardous waste handling and disposal services under RCRA regulations. Typically restricted to Industrial, Commercial, and Government segments with appropriate EPA generator registration.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; EPA Hazardous Waste Generator Standards (40 CFR Part 262); TSDF Regulations

attributes.name: service_eligibility_recycling
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible for recycling collection and Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) processing services. Drives diversion rate reporting and sustainability program enrollment.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Operations; EPA Waste Diversion Reporting; SWANA Recycling Standards

attributes.name: service_eligibility_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible for residential waste collection services (curbside pickup, recycling bins, yard waste). Used by Waste Logics to filter available service offerings during customer onboarding.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Service Eligibility Configuration; Waste Management Service Catalog

attributes.name: service_eligibility_wte
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible for Waste-to-Energy (WTE) conversion services. Eligibility is typically limited to large commercial, industrial, and municipal segments generating sufficient MSW volume to support WTE processing economics.
attributes.references: Waste Management WTE Operations Policy; EPA Clean Air Act WTE Facility Standards

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier assigned to this customer segment, defining the contractual service response and resolution time commitments. Tier-1 represents the highest service priority (e.g., National Accounts, Government contracts); Tier-4 represents standard residential service. Drives operational prioritization in Locus Dispatch and AMCS.
attributes.references: Waste Management SLA Policy; AMCS Platform Dispatch Priority Configuration; Locus Dispatch Priority Rules

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying customer segments in UI dropdowns, reports, and dashboards across Salesforce CRM, Waste Logics portal, and internal analytics tools. Lower numbers appear first.
attributes.references: Waste Management UI/UX Standards; Salesforce CRM Picklist Configuration

attributes.name: sub_segment_type
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the segment type (e.g., Single-Family, Multi-Family under Residential; Small Business, Mid-Market, Enterprise, National Account under Commercial). Used for targeted service offerings and NPS benchmark differentiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Single-Family|Multi-Family|Small Business|Mid-Market|Enterprise|National Account|Municipal|County|State Agency|Federal Agency|Light Industrial|Heavy Industrial|Non-Profit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Sub-Segmentation; Waste Management Sales Taxonomy

attributes.name: sustainability_program_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible to enroll in Waste Management sustainability programs (e.g., zero-waste consulting, RNG offset credits, SRF programs, carbon footprint reporting). Typically available to commercial, industrial, and government segments.
attributes.references: Waste Management Sustainability Program Policy; EPA Sustainable Materials Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number tracking revisions to the customer segment definition. Incremented each time segment attributes (SLA tier, pricing tier, eligibility rules) are modified. Supports audit trail and rollback capabilities.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; SOX Change Management Controls

attributes.name: waste_logics_segment_code
attributes.description: Corresponding segment identifier code as configured in the Waste Logics customer portal and service scheduling system. Enables accurate service eligibility filtering and container management rules for customers accessing the self-service portal.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal Configuration; Waste Management System Integration Standards

attributes.name: parent_segment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on segment (parent_segment_id)

products.name: account_status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of all account lifecycle status transitions — from prospect creation through active service, suspension, reactivation, and final closure. Each record captures the prior status, new status, effective timestamp, reason code (non-payment, service cancellation, relocation, deceased, business closure), the initiating user or system, and any associated case or work order reference. Critical for churn analysis, regulatory compliance, and customer lifecycle management.

attributes.name: account_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account status history record. Serves as the primary key for this immutable audit trail table.

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Salesforce CRM service case or customer service ticket that initiated or is associated with this status transition (e.g., a cancellation request case, a dispute case leading to suspension). Nullable when the transition is system-initiated.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service contract associated with this account at the time of the status transition. Relevant for contract-driven closures, expirations, or renewals that trigger status changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Object

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account whose lifecycle status changed. Links this history record to the master customer account entity in Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Waste Logics Customer Management

attributes.name: final_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the final invoice generated upon account closure or suspension. Links to the Oracle Revenue Management billing system for final billing reconciliation, credit memo processing, and AR write-off procedures.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Invoicing Module; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: primary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (employee or system service account) who initiated or executed this status transition. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements under SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA User Management

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized customer_segment STRING field to FK reference. Account status history should capture segment at time of transition via FK rather than string value for accurate historical segmen

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service address associated with the account at the time of this status transition. Relevant for relocation-driven closures and reactivations at new addresses. Supports geographic churn analysis.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Service Address Management; AMCS Route Management

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Order (WO) associated with this status transition, such as a final service pickup work order generated upon account closure or a reactivation service order. Nullable when no WO is linked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; AMCS Platform Work Order Management

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which supervisory approval was granted for this status transition. Distinct from effective_timestamp (when the change took effect) and created_timestamp (when the record was written). Supports SOX audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 27001 Access Control Audit

attributes.name: ar_balance_at_transition
attributes.description: The outstanding Accounts Receivable (AR) balance on the customer account at the exact moment of this status transition. Critical for non-payment suspension and closure analysis, collections prioritization, and bad debt provisioning under GAAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310 Receivables; Oracle Revenue Management AR Module; SOX Section 404 Financial Controls

attributes.name: churn_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of account churn when the transition represents a closure or deactivation: voluntary (customer-initiated cancellation), involuntary (non-payment or collections-driven), regulatory (compliance-mandated), or seasonal (temporary suspension with planned reactivation). Supports churn analytics and retention strategy development.
attributes.references: NWRA Customer Retention Analytics; Waste Management Internal Churn Reporting Standards

attributes.name: collections_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account was referred to the collections process following a non-payment suspension or closure. Applicable only for financially-driven status transitions. Supports AR aging analysis and bad debt provisioning under GAAP.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Collections Module; GAAP ASC 310 Receivables; SAP S/4HANA FI Collections

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes entered by the initiating user or system regarding this status transition. May include escalation notes, customer communication summaries, or operational context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; Waste Logics Customer Portal Activity Log

attributes.name: container_retrieval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Waste Management-owned containers (bins, dumpsters, roll-off containers) must be retrieved from the service address following this status transition. Triggers container retrieval work order creation in AMCS Platform.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking (CID); Waste Logics Container Management; DOT Equipment Recovery Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this account status history record was first written to the data platform. Represents the audit record creation time, distinct from effective_timestamp (when the business event occurred). Supports data lineage, ETL audit trails, and SOX IT general controls.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the account remained in the prior status before this transition occurred. Supports customer lifecycle duration analysis, churn prediction modeling, and SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: NWRA Customer Lifecycle Analytics; Waste Management Internal KPI Standards

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the new account status became operationally effective. This is the business event timestamp — distinct from the record audit timestamp — and is the authoritative time used for churn analysis, SLA measurement, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; GAAP Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: final_service_date
attributes.description: The date of the last scheduled or completed waste collection service for the account, captured at the time of closure or suspension. Used for final billing reconciliation, container retrieval scheduling, and service completion verification.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Service Scheduling; Oracle Revenue Management Final Billing; DOT Service Completion Records

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account involves hazardous waste services subject to RCRA, DOT, and EPA regulatory requirements. Status transitions for hazardous waste accounts require additional regulatory documentation and notification procedures.
attributes.references: RCRA Section 3002-3004; EPA Hazardous Waste Generator Standards; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: initiating_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated or triggered this status transition event. Supports data lineage, integration audit trails, and root-cause analysis for unexpected status changes.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Lineage Standards; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: manifest_closure_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Waste Manifest Closure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a hazardous waste Manifest (the regulatory tracking document) must be formally closed or reconciled as part of this account status transition. Applicable only for hazardous waste accounts. Supports RCRA compliance and EPA enforcement documentation.
attributes.references: RCRA Section 3002; EPA Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest Regulations (40 CFR Part 262); DOT Hazardous Materials Manifest Requirements

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The account lifecycle status immediately after this transition. Captures the 'to' state in the status change event. Valid values mirror prior_status enumeration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospect|active|suspended|inactive|closed|pending_activation|pending_closure — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Status; Waste Logics Account Lifecycle; NWRA Customer Management Standards

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer of this status transition. Supports multi-channel communication audit trails and regulatory compliance with required notification method standards.
attributes.references: State Consumer Protection Notification Standards; Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM Communication Logs

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification (email, letter, or portal message) was sent to the customer regarding this status transition. Supports compliance with state consumer protection notification requirements and customer communication audit trails.
attributes.references: State Consumer Protection Regulations; NWRA Customer Communication Standards; Waste Logics Customer Portal Notifications

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the customer notification for this status transition was sent. Supports regulatory compliance documentation for required advance notice periods (e.g., service termination notice requirements under state utility regulations).
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission Notification Requirements; NWRA Customer Communication Standards

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The account lifecycle status immediately before this transition occurred. Captures the 'from' state in the status change event. Valid values: prospect (pre-service lead), active (receiving service), suspended (temporarily halted), inactive (service ended but record retained), closed (permanently terminated). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospect|active|suspended|inactive|closed|pending_activation|pending_closure — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Status; Waste Logics Account Lifecycle; NWRA Customer Management Standards

attributes.name: prior_status_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prior status originally became effective. Combined with effective_timestamp, enables precise calculation of duration in prior status for lifecycle analytics and SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: NWRA Customer Lifecycle Analytics; Waste Management Internal Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reactivation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible for reactivation following this status transition. Set to False for deceased customers, regulatory closures, or fraud-related closures. Supports win-back campaign targeting and collections recovery workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Win-Back Campaign Management; Waste Logics Account Reactivation Workflow

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the account status transition occurred. Supports churn analysis, regulatory reporting, and customer lifecycle management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_payment|service_cancellation|relocation|deceased|business_closure|reactivation|contract_expiry|regulatory_action|merger_acquisition|seasonal_suspension — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Collections Module; Salesforce CRM Churn Reason Codes; NWRA Customer Lifecycle Standards

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or detail about the reason for the status transition, supplementing the structured reason_code. May include customer-stated reasons, agent notes, or system-generated explanations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: regulatory_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for any regulatory enforcement action, permit violation notice, or compliance order that directly caused this status transition. Applicable for regulatory-driven account closures or suspensions. Supports RCRA, EPA, and state environmental agency compliance documentation.
attributes.references: RCRA Section 3008 Enforcement; EPA Compliance and Enforcement Policy; CERCLA Liability Documentation; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: The Waste Management service territory or district code associated with the account at the time of this status transition. Supports geographic churn analysis, route optimization impact assessment, and regional regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Territory Management; Locus Dispatch Territory Configuration; EPA Regional Reporting Districts

attributes.name: sla_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition occurred in breach of a contractual Service Level Agreement (SLA), such as a failure to reactivate service within the committed timeframe or a suspension applied without required advance notice. Supports SLA compliance monitoring and contract penalty calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD SLA Management; Salesforce CRM Contract SLA Tracking; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating system of record (e.g., Salesforce CRM Account History ID, Oracle Revenue Management event ID, Waste Logics status log ID). Supports data lineage tracing, reconciliation between source systems and the lakehouse, and duplicate detection.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Lineage Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Integration Standards; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: suspension_reason_category
attributes.description: High-level category for suspension-specific transitions, providing a structured classification above the detailed reason_code. Applicable only when new_status is 'suspended'. Supports regulatory reporting and collections workflow routing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Collections; RCRA Compliance Reporting; EPA Regulatory Enforcement

attributes.name: transition_type
attributes.description: Categorizes how the status transition was initiated: manual (agent or user action), system_automated (triggered by billing engine, collections workflow, or scheduled job), bulk_update (mass data migration or batch operation), or regulatory (mandated by a regulatory authority or compliance requirement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Workflow Engine; Oracle Revenue Management Automation; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: win_back_eligible_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which a closed or inactive account becomes eligible for win-back outreach campaigns. May be set based on cooling-off periods, debt clearance timelines, or business rules. Supports Salesforce CRM marketing campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Management; NWRA Customer Retention Best Practices

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of outstanding AR balance written off as uncollectable at the time of account closure. Applicable only for closure transitions with unrecoverable debt. Supports GAAP bad debt expense recognition and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310 Receivables; SAP S/4HANA FI Bad Debt Management; SOX Section 404 Financial Reporting

products.name: service_enrollment
products.description: Records the active enrollment of a customer account at a specific service address for a defined waste management service (e.g., residential MSW cart pickup, commercial FEL dumpster service, roll-off container rental, recycling curbside). Captures enrollment start and end dates, service frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, on-call), container type and size, service day(s), enrollment status, and the originating contract or service agreement reference. This is the operational link between a customer account and the services they receive — distinct from the contract (owned by the contract domain).

attributes.name: service_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each service enrollment record in the Waste Management lakehouse. Primary key for the service_enrollment data product.

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific physical container asset assigned to this enrollment, identified by the Container Identification (CID) number tracked in AMCS Platform and Infor EAM. Nullable when a specific container has not yet been assigned or for bag-based services.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: collection_stop_id
