attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating service contract or service agreement that governs the terms of this enrollment. Nullable for one-time or on-call service requests not tied to a formal contract.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM Contract Management

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (residential, commercial, industrial, or municipal) enrolled in this service. Links to the customer master product in the Customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (customer service representative, sales agent, or system process) who created or processed this service enrollment. Used for audit trail, performance tracking, and enrollment quality review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Workday HCM; Internal Audit Policy; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Customer service enrollments should link directly to the service catalog offering to ensure customers are enrolled in valid, current service offerings. This provides a single source of truth for servi

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Hazardous waste service enrollments must reference the customer's treatment/storage/disposal permit to verify authorized waste streams, quantity limits, and handling requirements. Waste acceptance dec

attributes.name: recycling_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.recycling_program. Business justification: Commercial recycling service enrollments are tied to specific municipal or regional recycling programs that define accepted materials, collection frequency, and contamination standards. Essential for

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection route to which this service enrollment is assigned for scheduled pickup. Managed in AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch. Drives driver dispatch, vehicle assignment, and stop sequencing.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized customer_segment STRING field to FK reference. Service enrollments should reference the authoritative segment classification via FK rather than storing segment as a string.

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service address where waste collection or related service is performed. A customer may have multiple service addresses, each with independent enrollments.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: service_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service type catalog entry defining the nature of the waste management service enrolled (e.g., residential MSW cart pickup, commercial FEL dumpster, roll-off container rental, curbside recycling). Links to the service type reference product.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: servicing_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Service enrollments (recurring waste collection, recycling programs, roll-off services) are fulfilled by specific operational units (collection districts, recycling facilities). Enables route planning

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Specialized service enrollments (hazardous waste, large commercial accounts, medical waste) may require dedicated vehicles with specific certifications, equipment, or regulatory compliance. Tracks veh

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Recurring hazmat service enrollments specify approved waste profiles defining authorized waste codes, treatment requirements, TSDF destinations, and handling procedures. Essential for service authoriz

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Commercial/industrial service enrollments designate waste-to-energy facilities for material diversion. Route planning, waste stream tracking, and diversion rate reporting require facility assignment a

attributes.name: access_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service address for this enrollment has access restrictions (e.g., gated community, locked enclosure, restricted hours, weight-limited road). True = driver must follow special access procedures documented in special_instructions. Used for route planning and driver briefing.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; DOT Vehicle Weight Regulations

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service enrollment is configured to automatically renew upon reaching the enrollment end date. True = auto-renews per contract terms; False = requires explicit renewal action. Relevant for commercial and municipal contract management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the customer is invoiced for this service enrollment. Monthly is standard for residential; commercial accounts may be billed monthly or quarterly; roll-off and on-call services may be billed per service event.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the service enrollment was formally cancelled. Distinct from enrollment_end_date, which may reflect a scheduled end; cancellation_date records the actual date the cancellation was processed. Used for churn reporting and final billing cutoff.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The stated reason for cancellation or termination of the service enrollment. Populated when enrollment_status transitions to 'cancelled'. Common reasons include customer relocation, competitor switch, non-payment, service dissatisfaction, or contract expiry. Used for churn analysis and customer retention reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Customer Retention Policy

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: The number of containers of the specified type and size assigned to this service enrollment. Commercial accounts may have multiple dumpsters at a single service address. Used for billing (per-container charges) and route capacity planning.

attributes.name: container_size_gallons
attributes.description: The volumetric capacity of the assigned container in US gallons. Standard residential cart sizes include 32, 64, and 96 gallons. Commercial dumpsters range from 96 gallons to several cubic yards (converted). Used for capacity planning, route load calculations, and billing rate determination.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Container Management; SWANA Container Standards

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: The type of waste container assigned to this service enrollment. Cart = residential wheeled bin; dumpster = commercial front-end loader (FEL) or rear-end loader (REL) container; roll_off = open-top roll-off box; compactor = stationary or portable compactor unit; toter = smaller wheeled bin; bag = bag-based service. Aligns with Container Identification (CID) in AMCS Platform.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this service enrollment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the business event of enrollment initiation. Used for audit trail, SLA measurement, and data lineage tracking per SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Internal Data Governance; ISO 8601

attributes.name: diversion_target_pct
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally agreed target diversion rate (percentage of waste diverted from landfill) for this service enrollment. Applicable primarily to recycling and organics enrollments. Used for sustainability reporting and customer-facing environmental impact dashboards.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Diversion Guidelines; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the service enrollment is scheduled to end or was terminated. Null for open-ended recurring service agreements. Populated upon cancellation, contract expiry, or service completion.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the service enrollment, used in customer communications, Waste Logics portal, and Salesforce CRM service records. Format: SE- followed by 8–12 digits.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the service enrollment becomes effective and service delivery begins. Used for billing cycle initiation, route assignment, and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service enrollment. 'active' = service is being delivered; 'pending' = enrollment initiated but not yet started; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., customer request, non-payment); 'cancelled' = terminated before or during service; 'completed' = service period ended normally.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service enrollment involves the handling, collection, or disposal of RCRA-regulated hazardous waste materials. True = hazardous waste service requiring EPA manifest tracking, TSDF routing, and DOT compliance. Triggers additional regulatory workflows in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR); CERCLA; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: last_service_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent service event (pickup, collection, or delivery) was completed for this enrollment. Updated after each confirmed service completion in AMCS Platform or Locus Dispatch. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and missed pickup detection.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: monthly_rate_usd
attributes.description: The contracted or standard monthly charge in US dollars for this service enrollment. Represents the base recurring service fee before fuel surcharges, environmental fees, or taxes. Used for revenue forecasting, billing validation, and contract compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Module; GAAP Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

attributes.name: next_scheduled_service_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next service event is scheduled for this enrollment based on the service frequency and route schedule. Derived from the route schedule but stored here for operational convenience and customer-facing portal display in Waste Logics.

attributes.name: origination_channel

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal; Internal Sales Operations

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory permit (e.g., EPA, state environmental agency, local solid waste authority) is required to perform the service under this enrollment. True = permit must be on file and valid before service commences. Tracked in Enviance EHS permit management module.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; State Environmental Quality Departments; Local Solid Waste Authorities; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: The billing rate code from Oracle Revenue Management that determines the pricing structure applied to this enrollment. Rate codes encode service type, frequency, container size, and customer segment pricing tiers. Used for invoice generation and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: salesforce_enrollment_ref

attributes.name: service_day_of_week

attributes.name: service_frequency

attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: The tier of service provided under this enrollment, defining the Service Level Agreement (SLA) commitments such as response time for missed pickups, customer support priority, and on-call availability. Standard = baseline SLA; Premium = enhanced SLA with guaranteed response windows; Basic = minimal SLA.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; NWRA Service Standards; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: sla_response_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which a missed pickup or service failure must be remediated per the Service Level Agreement (SLA) for this enrollment. Drives customer service escalation workflows and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Policy; Salesforce CRM; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, access, or placement instructions for the service address associated with this enrollment. Examples: gate codes, locked enclosure access, placement at curb vs. alley, fragile materials, or driver safety notes. Displayed to drivers in Locus Dispatch.
attributes.references: Locus Dispatch; AMCS Platform; OSHA Safety Requirements

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which a suspended service enrollment is scheduled to resume or was reactivated. Null when enrollment is not suspended or suspension is indefinite. Used for route reinstatement and billing resumption.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the service enrollment was placed in a suspended state (e.g., seasonal hold, customer-requested pause, non-payment hold). Null when enrollment is not suspended. Used for billing adjustments and route management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this service enrollment record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on any status change, rate adjustment, container change, or schedule modification. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Internal Data Governance; ISO 8601

products.name: service_request

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the service request was cancelled. Populated only when request_status is 'cancelled'. Used for operational analysis and customer experience improvement.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service request was cancelled, either by the customer or by operations. Nullable for non-cancelled requests. Used for cancellation rate analysis and customer churn indicators.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable case number assigned to the service request, used in customer communications and cross-system tracking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Case Number or Waste Logics ticket reference.

attributes.name: channel_source

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service request was marked as fully completed and fulfilled. Used to calculate actual resolution time, SLA adherence, and operational performance metrics.

attributes.name: container_cid
attributes.description: The physical Container Identification (CID) number or RFID tag identifier printed on or embedded in the waste container. Used for field verification and container tracking without requiring a system lookup.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service request record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the system audit creation timestamp, distinct from the business event submitted_timestamp.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-resolution customer satisfaction rating provided by the customer via survey or feedback mechanism. Typically on a 1-5 or 1-10 scale. Contributes to Net Promoter Score (NPS) and service quality analytics.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request has been escalated to a supervisor, manager, or specialized team due to complexity, customer dissatisfaction, regulatory concern, or SLA breach risk. Used for escalation rate KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Escalation; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why the service request was escalated. Populated only when escalation_flag is True. Examples include repeated missed pickups, regulatory compliance concern, or high-value customer complaint.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Escalation Reason; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: estimated_weight_tons
attributes.description: Estimated weight in tons of the waste material associated with the service request, as provided by the customer or estimated by the intake agent. Relevant for bulk pickup, extra pickup, and C&D requests. Used for route load planning and tipping fee estimation.

attributes.name: item_count

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: regulatory_flag

attributes.name: request_status

attributes.name: request_type_code

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Type; Waste Logics Service Request Types; NWRA Service Classification Standards

attributes.name: requested_service_date

attributes.name: scheduled_date

attributes.name: scheduled_timestamp

attributes.name: service_frequency_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request represents a one-time ad hoc service action or a recurring add-on to an existing service schedule. Distinguishes episodic requests from schedule modifications.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Service Scheduling; Salesforce CRM Service Contract

attributes.name: service_request_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the service request as provided by the customer or intake agent. Contains details about the specific issue, location, container, or service need. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Case Description or Waste Logics portal notes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Description; Waste Logics Portal Submission

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service request was not fulfilled within the defined SLA due date. True when the completion timestamp exceeds the sla_due_date or the request remains open past the due date. Used for SLA compliance reporting and KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM SLA Breach Indicator; NWRA Service Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual or policy-defined deadline by which the service request must be fulfilled to meet the applicable Service Level Agreement (SLA). Calculated from submitted_timestamp based on request type and priority tier.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case SLA; SAP S/4HANA SD SLA Configuration; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system from which this service request record was sourced. Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and system-of-record attribution in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics

attributes.name: source_system_case_reference
attributes.description: The native case or ticket identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Case ID or Waste Logics Ticket ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title or subject line summarizing the nature of the service request, as entered by the customer or agent. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Case Subject field.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer submitted the service request. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the request entered the system. Used as the baseline for SLA calculation.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_applicable

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service address where the container is physically placed. A customer may have multiple service addresses, each with independent container assignments.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: srf_production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.srf_production_line. Business justification: Commercial containers for recyclable/combustible waste streams are designated for SRF production lines. Material flow tracking, contamination monitoring, and SRF feedstock quality control require cont

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this container assignment. Used in customer communications, work orders, and field operations. Format: CA- followed by 8-12 digits.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the container assignment. 'active' = container is at the service address and in service; 'pending_delivery' = scheduled for delivery; 'pending_removal' = scheduled for pickup; 'lost' = container cannot be located; 'damaged' = container reported damaged; 'swapped' = replaced by another container. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending_delivery|pending_removal|lost|damaged|swapped|suspended|expired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: cid
attributes.description: Container Identification (CID) number — the industry-standard physical identifier stamped or affixed to the container asset. Used for field identification, route scanning, and container audits. Sourced from AMCS Platform container tracking.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; NWRA Container Identification Standards

attributes.name: collection_day_of_week
attributes.description: Scheduled day(s) of the week on which the container is collected. For multi-day schedules, stores the primary collection day. Drives route assignment in AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch. Sunday collection is not standard in most markets.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch

attributes.name: collection_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which the container is serviced (emptied) under this assignment. Drives route scheduling in AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch. 'on_call' = customer requests pickup as needed (common for roll-offs).
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: condition_at_delivery
attributes.description: Physical condition of the container at the time it was delivered to the service address. Recorded by the driver or dispatcher at delivery. Used for warranty tracking, asset lifecycle management, and customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: condition_at_removal
attributes.description: Physical condition of the container at the time it was removed from the service address. Recorded by the driver or dispatcher at pickup. Supports damage assessment, customer liability determination, and asset refurbishment decisions.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Physical type classification of the container. 'cart' = wheeled residential cart (ASL/REL compatible); 'dumpster' = front-end load (FEL) commercial dumpster; 'roll_off' = open-top roll-off box for C&D or large volume; 'compactor' = stationary or portable compactor unit; 'toter' = smaller wheeled toter bin.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; NWRA Equipment Classification Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container assignment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the business event of assignment initiation. Sourced from AMCS Platform or Waste Logics.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Standards; ISO 8601

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Business-to-consumer or business-to-business segment classification of the customer receiving this container assignment. 'residential' = B2C household; 'commercial' = B2B business account; 'industrial' = large-volume industrial client; 'municipal' = government/municipal contract.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Management Customer Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any damage observed on the container at delivery or during the assignment period. Populated when condition_at_delivery or condition_at_removal indicates damage. Supports insurance claims and customer billing for damage charges.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Waste Management Asset Damage Policy

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the container was physically delivered to the service address and the assignment became active. Sourced from the completed delivery work order in AMCS Platform or Waste Logics.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: enclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container must be placed within a screened enclosure or enclosure structure per local municipal ordinance, HOA requirements, or customer contract terms. True = enclosure required; False = open placement permitted.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authorities; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: epa_waste_code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned waste classification code for the material stream in this container (e.g., D001 for ignitability, F001 for spent solvents). Required for hazardous waste assignments per RCRA regulations. Null for non-hazardous MSW and recycling streams.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261; EPA Hazardous Waste Classification; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: last_serviced_date
attributes.description: Most recent calendar date on which the container was collected/emptied under this assignment. Updated after each successful collection event. Used for service verification, missed pickup detection, and customer service inquiries.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: lock_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container requires a lock mechanism for security or regulatory compliance (e.g., hazardous waste containers, high-theft areas, or customer-requested security). True = lock required; False = no lock required.
attributes.references: RCRA Hazardous Waste Storage Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: material_stream
attributes.description: Waste material stream designated for this container assignment. 'msw' = Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) general refuse; 'recycling' = commingled recyclables for Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) processing; 'organics' = food/organic waste; 'cd_waste' = Construction and Demolition (C&D) debris; 'hazardous' = regulated hazardous waste; 'yard_waste' = landscaping and green waste.
attributes.references: EPA Solid Waste Regulations; RCRA; SWANA Material Classification

attributes.name: missed_pickup_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of missed or skipped scheduled collection events for this container assignment since delivery. Used for SLA compliance monitoring, customer satisfaction tracking, and NPS correlation analysis.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Management SLA Policy; NPS Tracking

attributes.name: monthly_rental_rate
attributes.description: Monthly rental charge billed to the customer for the use of this container under the current assignment. Expressed in US dollars. Used by Oracle Revenue Management for recurring billing generation and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP ASC 842 Lease Accounting; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: overage_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's service agreement permits overage (excess waste placed beside or on top of the container beyond its rated capacity). True = overage collection is permitted and may trigger additional charges; False = overage is not collected.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Waste Management Service Agreement Policy

attributes.name: placement_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the container's physical placement location at the service address. Enables precise geolocation for driver navigation, container audits, and lost container recovery. Sourced from Geotab Fleet Telematics or AMCS Platform.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics; AMCS Platform; WGS84 Coordinate Standard

attributes.name: placement_location
attributes.description: Descriptive text indicating the specific placement location of the container at the service address (e.g., 'curbside', 'back alley', 'loading dock bay 3', 'inside gate'). Used by drivers for accurate container location during collection.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch Driver Communication

attributes.name: placement_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the container's physical placement location at the service address. Enables precise geolocation for driver navigation, container audits, and lost container recovery. Sourced from Geotab Fleet Telematics or AMCS Platform.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics; AMCS Platform; WGS84 Coordinate Standard

attributes.name: regulatory_manifest_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Hazardous Waste Manifest (tracking document) is required for the material stream in this container assignment per RCRA regulations. True = manifest required (hazardous waste); False = standard MSW/recycling, no manifest required.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; EPA Hazardous Waste Manifest Requirements

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the container was physically removed from the service address, ending the active assignment. Null if the assignment is still active. Used for container utilization duration calculations and billing period closure.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag identifier embedded in or affixed to the container. Enables automated container scanning during collection events without manual barcode scanning. Null if container is not RFID-equipped.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Originally planned calendar date for container delivery to the service address. Compared against actual delivery_date to measure delivery SLA compliance and route scheduling accuracy.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: scheduled_removal_date
attributes.description: Originally planned calendar date for container removal from the service address. Compared against actual removal_date to measure removal SLA compliance. Populated when a removal work order is created.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container assignment supports a recurring scheduled service, an on-call demand service, a temporary placement (e.g., event or construction project), or a one-time service request.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Service Scheduling; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: size_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Nominal capacity of the container expressed in cubic yards. Used for commercial dumpsters, roll-offs, and compactors (e.g., 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 20, 30, 40 cubic yards). Null for containers measured in gallons. Supports billing, route planning, and capacity management.
attributes.references: NWRA Container Capacity Standards; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: size_gallons
attributes.description: Nominal capacity of the container expressed in US gallons. Used for residential carts and toters (e.g., 32, 64, 96 gallons). Null for containers measured in cubic yards. Supports container utilization analysis and route weight estimation.
attributes.references: NWRA Container Capacity Standards; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this container assignment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer integration pipeline.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: swap_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this container assignment was created as a replacement for a prior assignment. Null if this is an original assignment (not a swap). Supports container lifecycle analysis and operational efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this container assignment record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, data synchronization, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Standards; ISO 8601

products.name: communication_preference
products.description: Stores each customer contact's communication channel preferences and consent records for regulatory compliance (TCPA, CAN-SPAM). Captures preferred channels (email, SMS, phone, mail, portal), notification types opted in/out (billing alerts, service reminders, outage notifications, promotional offers, NPS surveys), language preference, do-not-contact flags, and consent timestamps with source of consent. Supports omnichannel customer engagement and ensures compliant outreach across all Waste Management customer communications.

attributes.name: communication_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each communication preference record. Primary key for the communication_preference data product in the customer domain.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific contact person within the customer account for whom these preferences apply. Supports multi-contact accounts (e.g., commercial accounts with multiple authorized contacts).

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom this communication preference record applies. Links to the master customer entity in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: billing_alert_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive billing-related alerts such as invoice generation, payment due reminders, and payment confirmation notifications. Supports Oracle Revenue Management billing communication workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The preferred communication channel through which the customer or contact wishes to receive outreach. Supports omnichannel engagement across email, SMS, phone, physical mail, the Waste Logics customer portal, and mobile push notifications.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: consent_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the consent document, contract clause, or recorded call that evidences the consent. For paper forms, this is the document scan ID; for contracts, this is the contract number and clause reference; for recorded calls, this is the call recording ID.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; SOX Compliance; RCRA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recorded consent expires and must be re-obtained. Applicable where regulatory or business policy requires periodic consent renewal. Null indicates consent does not expire under current policy.
attributes.references: TCPA; CCPA; Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: consent_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the customer submitted their consent (e.g., via the Waste Logics customer portal or email signup form). Provides technical evidence of consent origin for regulatory audit purposes. Classified as confidential PII as IP addresses may identify individuals in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: TCPA; CCPA; GDPR Recital 30; FTC Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The legal mechanism by which consent was obtained. 'express_written' is required for TCPA-regulated SMS and autodialed calls. 'double_opt_in' provides the strongest evidence of consent for email marketing. Drives compliance reporting and legal defensibility.
attributes.references: TCPA (47 U.S.C. § 227); CAN-SPAM Act; FCC TCPA Regulations

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The system or touchpoint through which consent was captured. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_portal|salesforce_crm|paper_form|ivr|mobile_app|service_call|email_signup|contract_signature|third_party — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA; Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory consent status for the specified channel and notification type. 'granted' indicates valid consent is on file; 'revoked' indicates consent was withdrawn; 'pending' indicates awaiting confirmation (double opt-in); 'expired' indicates consent has lapsed per retention policy; 'not_required' applies to transactional communications exempt from consent requirements.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA Section 1798.120; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer or contact granted, revoked, or updated consent for this channel and notification type. Critical audit field for TCPA and CAN-SPAM compliance. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA; GDPR Article 7(1)

attributes.name: contact_frequency
attributes.description: The customer or contact's preferred frequency for non-transactional outreach (e.g., promotional offers, NPS surveys, service updates). Transactional and compliance-driven communications (e.g., billing alerts, regulatory notices) are not subject to this frequency cap.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud Frequency Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication preference record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field used for compliance reporting, data lineage, and preference history analysis.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; TCPA Audit Requirements; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Specific suppression flag for telephone-based outreach (voice calls). Distinct from the master do_not_contact flag to allow granular channel-level suppression. Compliance with the National Do Not Call Registry and TCPA requirements.
attributes.references: TCPA; National Do Not Call Registry (FTC); 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Master suppression flag indicating the customer or contact must not be contacted through any channel. Overrides all individual channel and notification preferences. Must be honored across all outbound communication systems including Salesforce CRM, Oracle Revenue Management, and Waste Logics portal.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA Section 1798.120; National Do Not Call Registry

attributes.name: do_not_email
attributes.description: Specific suppression flag for email-based outreach. Distinct from the master do_not_contact flag to allow granular channel-level suppression. Compliance with CAN-SPAM Act unsubscribe requirements.

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Specific suppression flag for physical postal mail outreach. Allows customers to opt out of paper-based communications such as billing statements, promotional mailers, and service notices.
attributes.references: USPS Direct Mail Regulations; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: do_not_sms
attributes.description: Specific suppression flag for SMS/text message outreach. Required for TCPA compliance as SMS requires prior express written consent. Distinct from the master do_not_contact flag.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this communication preference record is effective and should be applied to outbound communications. Supports temporal preference management and scheduled preference changes (e.g., a customer requesting preferences to take effect at the start of next billing cycle).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal; TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this communication preference record is effective. Null indicates the preference is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used for temporary preference overrides (e.g., vacation holds, seasonal suppression) and consent expiry management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal; TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this communication preference record is currently active and in effect. Set to False when a preference is superseded by a newer record or when the contact is deactivated, enabling soft-delete and historical audit without data loss.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The customer or contact's preferred language for all communications, stored as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-CN', 'fr'). Drives language selection in templated outbound communications across email, SMS, IVR, and portal notifications.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tags; ISO 639-1 Language Codes

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The identifier of the user, system, or agent that last modified this preference record. May be a Salesforce CRM user ID, a Waste Logics portal session identifier, or a system process name (e.g., 'BULK_IMPORT', 'IVR_SYSTEM'). Supports audit trail and compliance investigation.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; TCPA Audit Requirements; Salesforce CRM Audit Trail

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: The category of notification for which this preference record captures opt-in or opt-out status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_alert|service_reminder|outage_notification|promotional_offer|nps_survey|collection_schedule|account_update|regulatory_notice|payment_confirmation|route_change — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; Oracle Revenue Management; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: nps_survey_opt_in
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Survey Opt-In Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive Net Promoter Score (NPS) and customer satisfaction surveys. Supports the customer experience measurement program and drives service improvement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Net Promoter Score (NPS) Methodology; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Current opt-in or opt-out status of the customer or contact for the specified channel and notification type combination. 'pending' indicates consent has been requested but not yet confirmed (e.g., double opt-in flow). 'not_set' indicates no preference has been recorded.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: opt_out_channel
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism through which the customer submitted their opt-out request. Supports compliance audit trails and process improvement analysis (e.g., identifying which unsubscribe mechanisms are most used). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email_unsubscribe|sms_stop|ivr|customer_portal|agent_request|written_request|regulatory_order — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the customer or contact for opting out of a communication channel or notification type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: too_frequent|not_relevant|prefer_other_channel|unsubscribe_link|customer_request|complaint|regulatory_request|deceased — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer or contact submitted an opt-out request for this channel or notification type. CAN-SPAM requires opt-out requests to be honored within 10 business days; this timestamp is the compliance clock start.

attributes.name: outage_notification_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive service disruption and outage notifications such as missed collection alerts, route delays, weather-related service suspensions, and facility closures.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; Salesforce CRM Service Cloud

attributes.name: portal_notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has enabled in-portal notifications within the Waste Logics customer portal. When True, notifications are surfaced within the portal dashboard in addition to or instead of external channels.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: preference_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of this preference record: channel (preferred delivery channel), notification (opt-in/out for a notification category), language (preferred language), frequency (preferred contact cadence), or do_not_contact (suppression flag). Enables structured querying of preference records.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_end
attributes.description: The end of the customer's preferred time window for receiving phone or SMS outreach, stored in HH:MM 24-hour format in the customer's local time zone. TCPA restricts calls to 8 AM–9 PM local time; this field captures the customer's narrower preference within that window.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_start
attributes.description: The start of the customer's preferred time window for receiving phone or SMS outreach, stored in HH:MM 24-hour format in the customer's local time zone. Used by outbound dialer and SMS scheduling systems to respect contact time preferences.

attributes.name: promotional_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive promotional communications including new service offers, recycling program promotions, and sustainability initiative campaigns. Subject to CAN-SPAM and TCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: regulatory_notice_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive regulatory and compliance-related notices such as EPA-mandated service change notifications, RCRA hazardous waste handling updates, and local solid waste authority announcements. Note: some regulatory notices may be mandatory regardless of opt-in status.
attributes.references: EPA Regulations; RCRA; Clean Air Act; Clean Water Act; Local Solid Waste Authorities

attributes.name: service_reminder_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive service reminders such as upcoming collection day notifications, container set-out reminders, and scheduled service confirmations. Supports AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch customer notification workflows.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system from which this preference record was captured or last updated. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when preferences are updated across multiple systems of record (Salesforce CRM, Waste Logics portal, Oracle Revenue Management). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|waste_logics|oracle_revenue_mgmt|ivr|mobile_app|paper_form|bulk_import|agent_entry — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal; Oracle Revenue Management; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: suppression_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has been added to a global suppression list, preventing all marketing and non-transactional outreach regardless of individual channel preferences. Populated from CAN-SPAM unsubscribe lists, TCPA litigation holds, or internal suppression decisions.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud Suppression Lists

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason this contact was added to the suppression list. 'bounce' indicates a hard email bounce; 'complaint' indicates a spam complaint; 'litigation_hold' indicates legal proceedings; 'regulatory' indicates a government-mandated suppression order. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unsubscribe|complaint|bounce|litigation_hold|regulatory|deceased|fraud — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; FTC Guidelines; Internal Legal Hold Policy

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The IANA time zone identifier for the customer's or contact's local time zone (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used in conjunction with preferred_contact_time_start and preferred_contact_time_end to schedule compliant outreach.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication preference record was most recently modified. Updated on every change to any preference field. Used for change detection, synchronization with downstream systems, and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; TCPA Audit Requirements; Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal

products.name: nps_response
products.description: Captures Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey responses collected from customers following service interactions, annual relationship surveys, or triggered events (service recovery, onboarding). Records NPS score (0-10), promoter/passive/detractor classification, verbatim feedback text, survey channel (email, SMS, IVR, portal), survey trigger event type, response timestamp, and follow-up action flag. Enables customer satisfaction trending, service quality benchmarking, and closed-loop feedback management.

attributes.name: nps_response_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each NPS survey response record. Serves as the primary key for the nps_response data product in the customer domain silver layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who submitted the NPS survey response. Links to the customer master record encompassing residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent or account manager assigned to handle the closed-loop follow-up for this NPS response. Populated when follow_up_required is True. Enables agent-level follow-up performance tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; Workday HCM

attributes.name: route_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.route_execution. Business justification: NPS surveys are often triggered by specific service events. Linking to the actual route execution that served the customer enables root cause analysis of satisfaction drivers, operational quality metr

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized customer_segment STRING field to FK reference. NPS responses should reference segment classification via FK to enable segment-based NPS analysis without string matching.

attributes.name: service_district_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service district or operational territory associated with the customer's service address at the time of the survey. Enables geographic NPS benchmarking and district-level service quality analysis.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; Waste Logics

attributes.name: service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.hazmat_service_order. Business justification: NPS surveys triggered by hazmat service completion must link to specific orders for service quality tracking, driver performance evaluation, and operational improvement analysis. Enables hazmat-specif

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service interaction or work order that triggered this NPS survey, such as a missed pickup, container delivery, or service recovery event. Nullable for relationship/annual surveys not tied to a single event.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; AMCS Platform; Waste Logics

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent survey campaign or survey definition that generated this response. Links to the survey master record defining the questionnaire version, distribution cohort, and campaign metadata.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NPS response record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, silver layer ingestion tracking, and SOX compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8001 Data Governance; Salesforce CRM Audit Fields

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality classification assigned to this NPS response during ingestion and validation processing. Flags responses as valid, duplicate submissions, suspected automated/bot responses, internal test responses, or incomplete records. Used to filter analytics datasets to production-quality responses only.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Quality Standards; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the customer to complete the NPS survey. Enables channel experience optimization and response quality analysis by device category.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal Analytics; Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object

attributes.name: follow_up_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the closed-loop follow-up action for this NPS response was completed. Used to measure follow-up response time, SLA adherence for detractor recovery, and closed-loop program effectiveness.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; NWRA Customer Experience Standards; NPS Closed-Loop Methodology — Bain & Company

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NPS response requires a closed-loop follow-up action, typically triggered for Detractor responses (score 0-6) or responses containing escalation keywords in verbatim feedback. Drives CRM case creation and customer recovery workflows in Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; NWRA Customer Experience Standards; NPS Closed-Loop Methodology — Bain & Company

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the closed-loop follow-up action for this NPS response. Tracks whether a follow-up has been initiated, is in progress, has been completed, or is not required. Used for closed-loop completion rate reporting and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; NWRA Customer Experience Standards; NPS Closed-Loop Methodology — Bain & Company

attributes.name: is_anonymous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer chose to submit the NPS response anonymously, without linking their identity to the feedback. When True, verbatim feedback and score are retained but customer linkage is suppressed for reporting purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Survey Object

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The raw NPS rating provided by the customer on a 0-to-10 integer scale. Scores 0-6 classify as Detractors, 7-8 as Passives, and 9-10 as Promoters per the standard NPS methodology. This is the principal quantitative outcome of the survey response.
attributes.references: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Methodology — Bain & Company; SWANA Customer Satisfaction Standards; Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided or inferred when a customer opts out of the NPS survey. Populated only when response_status is 'opted_out'. Used to manage survey fatigue, honor communication preferences, and comply with opt-out regulations.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA; Salesforce CRM Subscription Management

attributes.name: relationship_survey_period
attributes.description: The calendar period identifier (e.g., 'Q1-2025', '2024-H2') for annual or periodic relationship NPS surveys. Populated only for relationship survey trigger types; null for transactional post-service surveys. Enables period-over-period relationship NPS trending.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Campaign Object; NWRA Customer Satisfaction Benchmarking

attributes.name: respondent_category
attributes.description: Derived classification of the customer based on their NPS score: Promoter (9-10), Passive (7-8), or Detractor (0-6). Drives closed-loop follow-up workflows, escalation routing, and customer satisfaction KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Methodology — Bain & Company; Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object

attributes.name: response_latency_hours
attributes.description: The elapsed time in hours between the survey sent timestamp and the response submission timestamp. Used to analyze customer engagement speed, optimize survey send timing, and assess the relationship between response latency and NPS score.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Analytics; NWRA Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: response_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this NPS response, used in customer communications, closed-loop follow-up correspondence, and cross-system reconciliation with Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NPS survey response record. 'submitted' indicates a complete response; 'partial' indicates the customer started but did not finish; 'opted_out' indicates the customer declined to participate; 'expired' indicates the survey link lapsed; 'invalid' indicates a response flagged for data quality issues.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the customer submitted the NPS survey response. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for time-series trending, SLA measurement, and response rate analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object; ISO 8601; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: secondary_question_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1-5 or 1-10) provided by the customer in response to a secondary survey question, such as a Customer Effort Score (CES) or Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) question included alongside the primary NPS question. Nullable when no secondary question was presented.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object; NWRA Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: secondary_question_text
attributes.description: The text of the secondary survey question answered by the customer (e.g., 'How easy was it to resolve your issue today?'). Stored to maintain context for the secondary_question_score and to support multi-question survey analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The primary waste management service line associated with the survey trigger event. Values include residential collection, commercial collection, recycling (MRF), landfill operations, hazardous waste handling, or WTE (Waste-to-Energy). Enables service-line-level satisfaction benchmarking.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Waste Logics; NWRA Service Classification Standards; EPA Service Category Definitions

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this NPS response was ingested into the Databricks silver layer. Enables data lineage tracking, source system reconciliation, and identification of integration-specific data quality issues.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system_response_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this NPS response record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Survey Response ID or Waste Logics response key). Used for cross-system reconciliation, deduplication, and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: survey_channel
attributes.description: The delivery channel through which the NPS survey was sent and the response was collected. Values include email, SMS (Short Message Service), IVR (Interactive Voice Response), customer portal (Waste Logics), or in-app. Enables channel-level response rate and satisfaction analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal; NWRA Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: survey_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time after which the survey link or invitation is no longer valid for response submission. Used to classify responses as 'expired' and to enforce survey response window policies.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: survey_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which the survey was presented and the response was collected (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish). Supports multilingual customer base analysis and localization compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; Salesforce CRM Survey Object

attributes.name: survey_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the NPS survey invitation was dispatched to the customer via the selected channel. Used to calculate response latency (time from send to response) and to measure survey expiry windows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: survey_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the survey questionnaire used to collect this response. Enables longitudinal comparability analysis when survey questions or scales are updated, and supports A/B testing of survey designs.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: trigger_event_type
attributes.description: The business event that triggered dispatch of this NPS survey. Classifies whether the survey was sent following a specific service interaction (post_service), as part of an annual relationship survey, during customer onboarding, after a service recovery action, or at contract renewal. Enables segmented satisfaction benchmarking by trigger type.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Object; Waste Logics; NWRA Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NPS response record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8001 Data Governance; Salesforce CRM Audit Fields

attributes.name: verbatim_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text open-ended comment provided by the customer explaining the reason for their NPS score. Used for qualitative analysis, sentiment scoring, service quality benchmarking, and closed-loop feedback management. May contain sensitive customer opinions about service personnel or operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey Response Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation); CCPA

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records all customer touchpoints and engagement events across all channels — inbound calls, outbound calls, chat sessions, email exchanges, portal logins, field representative visits, and automated notifications. Captures interaction type, channel, direction (inbound/outbound), duration, subject/topic, outcome code, agent or system identifier, and linked service request or account. Provides a complete customer interaction history for service quality management, dispute resolution, and CRM analytics. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity records.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer interaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the interaction data product.

attributes.name: contamination_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.contamination_event. Business justification: Customer interactions (calls, emails) about contamination issues, rejected loads, or surcharges reference specific contamination events documented at MRF. Essential for customer education, dispute res

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service contract or agreement associated with this interaction, applicable for commercial, industrial, or municipal accounts where the interaction relates to contract terms, SLA (Service Level Agreement) disputes, or renewal discussions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Object; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this interaction. Links to the customer master record for the residential, commercial, industrial, or municipal account.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent, field representative, or automated system that handled this interaction. Null for fully automated system-generated interactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; Workday HCM

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service address associated with this interaction, applicable when the interaction pertains to a specific pickup location, container, or service site rather than the overall account. Supports multi-site commercial and municipal accounts.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Container Management; Salesforce CRM Service Address

attributes.name: service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.hazmat_service_order. Business justification: Customer interactions (calls, portal messages, emails) frequently reference specific hazmat service orders for scheduling changes, pricing inquiries, manifest questions, or service issues. Enables com

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service request linked to this interaction, if the touchpoint was initiated or resolved in the context of a specific service request (e.g., missed pickup, container swap, billing dispute).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Customer service interactions often reference collection vehicles: customers report license plates for service verification, vehicle numbers for missed pickup inquiries, or vehicle-related incidents.

attributes.name: activity_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this interaction, sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity record number (e.g., ACT-2024-00123456). Used for cross-system traceability and customer-facing reference.

attributes.name: agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer service agent, field representative, or automated system identifier that handled this interaction. For automated interactions, this may contain the system name (e.g., 'IVR_SYSTEM', 'CHATBOT_V2'). Used for agent performance reporting and quality assurance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Owner Name; Workday HCM

attributes.name: agent_team
attributes.description: The contact center team, queue, or department to which the handling agent belongs (e.g., 'Residential_Billing', 'Commercial_Service', 'Environmental_Compliance', 'Field_Operations'). Used for team-level performance analytics and workload distribution reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Queue/Team; Workday HCM Organizational Unit

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel or interface through which the interaction was conducted. Distinct from interaction_type — channel describes the medium (phone, web, in-person) while type describes the nature of the activity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phone|web_chat|email|customer_portal|mobile_app|in_person|ivr|sms — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Channel; Waste Logics Customer Portal; NWRA Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the interaction was formally closed or resolved. Distinct from interaction_timestamp (when it started) and last_modified_timestamp (last record update). Used for resolution time calculation and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Closed Date; NWRA SLA Standards

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual who participated in the interaction, captured at the time of the interaction. Used for follow-up communications and interaction history. PII — classified as restricted.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Email; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; RFC 5321

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who participated in the interaction on the customer side (may be the account holder, an authorized representative, or a site contact). Captured for dispute resolution and interaction history. PII — classified as restricted.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Name; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the individual who participated in the interaction, captured at the time of the interaction. May differ from the account's primary phone if the caller is an authorized representative. PII — classified as restricted.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Phone; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; E.164 ITU-T Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this interaction record was first captured in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from record creation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; SOX Compliance; ISO 8601

attributes.name: crm_activity_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier from Salesforce CRM Activity record (e.g., '00T5f000004XXXXX'). Enables traceability back to the originating CRM record for reconciliation, audit, and cross-system data quality validation.

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: Customer Satisfaction score collected via post-interaction survey, typically on a 1–5 scale. Distinct from NPS (Net Promoter Score) — CSAT measures satisfaction with this specific interaction, while NPS measures overall brand loyalty. Null if no survey was administered.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey; NWRA Customer Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction was initiated by the customer (inbound), initiated by Waste Management (outbound), or an internal system-generated event (internal). Critical for contact center workload analysis and proactive outreach tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Direction; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the interaction in seconds, from initiation to closure. For calls, this is the total talk time including hold. For chats, this is the session duration. Used for contact center efficiency metrics and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Duration; NWRA Contact Center KPI Standards

attributes.name: escalated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the interaction was escalated to a higher support tier, supervisor, or specialized team. Null if no escalation occurred. Used for escalation rate reporting and quality management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Escalation Date; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the interaction was escalated (e.g., 'REGULATORY_COMPLAINT', 'REPEAT_CONTACT', 'SUPERVISOR_REQUEST', 'UNRESOLVED_BILLING_DISPUTE'). Null if no escalation occurred. Used for root cause analysis and agent coaching.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Escalation Reason; EPA Complaint Handling; OSHA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: hold_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds the customer was placed on hold during a phone interaction. Subset of duration_seconds. Used for contact center quality management and customer experience analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CTI Integration; NWRA Contact Center KPI Standards

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interaction record. 'open' indicates initiated but not yet resolved; 'in_progress' indicates actively being handled; 'completed' indicates successfully closed; 'abandoned' indicates customer disconnected before resolution; 'escalated' indicates transferred to a higher tier; 'cancelled' indicates voided interaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Status; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the customer interaction event occurred (i.e., when the call was received, chat was initiated, email was sent, or field visit commenced). This is the principal real-world event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interaction by the nature of the touchpoint. Distinguishes between human-initiated contacts (call, chat, email, field visit) and system-generated events (automated notification, portal login). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: call|chat|email|portal_login|field_visit|automated_notification|sms — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Type; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: is_escalated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction was escalated to a higher support tier or supervisor during its lifecycle. True if escalated; False otherwise. Used as a quick filter for escalation rate KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case IsEscalated; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: is_first_contact_resolution
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's issue was fully resolved during this single interaction without requiring a follow-up contact or callback. True if resolved on first contact; False otherwise. Key KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for contact center performance and NPS (Net Promoter Score) correlation analysis.
attributes.references: NWRA Contact Center KPI Standards; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter or BCP 47 language code representing the language in which the interaction was conducted (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'zh'). Used for multilingual service analytics and workforce language capability planning.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; BCP 47; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this interaction record was most recently updated in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; SOX Compliance; ISO 8601

attributes.name: nps_score
