attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score collected at the end of the interaction on a 0–10 scale (Net Promoter Score). 0–6 = Detractor, 7–8 = Passive, 9–10 = Promoter. Null if no survey was administered. Used for customer experience analytics and service quality management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey; NWRA Customer Satisfaction Standards; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: outcome_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the resolution or result of the interaction (e.g., 'RESOLVED', 'ESCALATED_TIER2', 'CALLBACK_SCHEDULED', 'NO_ACTION_REQUIRED', 'VOICEMAIL_LEFT', 'WORK_ORDER_CREATED'). Sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity Result/Disposition field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resolved|escalated_tier2|callback_scheduled|no_action_required|voicemail_left|work_order_created|transferred — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Result; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: outcome_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the resolution, action taken, or result of the interaction. Complements the structured outcome_code with agent-entered notes or system-generated summaries. Used for dispute resolution and quality assurance review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Description; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: recording_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a call or chat recording is available for this interaction in the contact center recording system. True if a recording exists; False otherwise. Used for quality assurance, dispute resolution, and compliance audit purposes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CTI Integration; NWRA Quality Assurance Standards; CCPA

attributes.name: recording_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier or URL pointing to the call or chat recording stored in the contact center recording system. Null if recording_available is False. Used for quality assurance review and dispute resolution evidence retrieval.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CTI Integration; NWRA Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency associated with a regulatory complaint or compliance-related interaction (e.g., 'EPA', 'OSHA', 'DOT', 'State_DEQ', 'LEA'). Null if regulatory_complaint_flag is False. Used for compliance reporting and incident tracking in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: EPA; OSHA; DOT; RCRA; CERCLA; Enviance EHS; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: regulatory_complaint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involves a regulatory complaint filed with or referenced from a governing body such as the EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), DOT (Department of Transportation), or a State Environmental Quality Department. True if regulatory; False otherwise. Triggers compliance escalation workflows.
attributes.references: EPA Complaint Handling Procedures; RCRA Compliance; Enviance EHS; CERCLA

attributes.name: scheduled_callback_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a callback was scheduled for the customer, applicable when the interaction outcome resulted in a deferred follow-up. Null if no callback was scheduled. Used for workforce scheduling and follow-up compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Follow-Up Date; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line describing the primary topic of the interaction (e.g., 'Missed Pickup Complaint', 'Billing Inquiry - Invoice #12345', 'New Service Setup Request'). Sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity Subject field.

attributes.name: survey_administered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-interaction satisfaction survey (NPS or CSAT) was administered to the customer following this interaction. True if survey was sent/offered; False otherwise. Used to calculate survey response rates and coverage.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey; NWRA Customer Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: topic_category
attributes.description: Standardized business category classifying the primary topic of the interaction. Used for volume trending, root cause analysis, and agent routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|service_request|complaint|inquiry|new_service|cancellation|compliance|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Reason; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: topic_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular detail within the topic_category (e.g., under 'billing': 'rate_dispute', 'payment_arrangement', 'invoice_copy_request'; under 'service_request': 'missed_pickup', 'container_swap', 'bulk_item_pickup'). Supports detailed analytics and agent knowledge base routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Sub-Reason; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: transfer_count
attributes.description: Number of times the interaction was transferred between agents, queues, or departments before final resolution. Zero if handled by the initial agent without transfer. Used for contact center efficiency analysis and customer effort scoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CTI Integration; NWRA Contact Center KPI Standards

attributes.name: wait_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds the customer waited before being connected to an agent or receiving a response. For calls, this is the queue wait time. For chats, this is the time to first agent response. Key metric for SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance and customer satisfaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CTI Integration; NWRA Contact Center KPI Standards

products.name: portal_account
products.description: Manages customer self-service portal accounts on the Waste Logics customer portal. Stores portal username, authentication method (password, SSO, MFA status), portal registration date, last login timestamp, linked customer account(s), portal feature access permissions, notification subscription settings, and portal account status (active, locked, suspended). Enables digital self-service for service scheduling, bill payment, container requests, and service history review. Distinct from the core customer account master.

attributes.name: portal_account_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the customer self-service portal account record in the Waste Logics customer portal. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Internal Data Standard

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the core customer account master record in the customer domain that this portal account is linked to. A single portal account may be associated with one primary customer account; additional linked accounts are managed via the portal account linkage entity.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM — Account Object

attributes.name: account_locked_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the portal account was most recently locked due to excessive failed login attempts or an administrative security action. Null if the account has never been locked. Used for security incident tracking and lockout duration reporting.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; Waste Logics Customer Portal Security Policy

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the portal account. 'active' — fully operational; 'locked' — temporarily blocked due to failed login attempts or security policy; 'suspended' — administratively disabled pending review; 'pending_verification' — registered but email/identity not yet confirmed; 'inactive' — no login activity beyond inactivity threshold; 'closed' — permanently deactivated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|locked|suspended|pending_verification|inactive|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; NIST SP 800-63B

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the portal account based on the customer segment it serves. 'residential' — individual household (B2C); 'commercial' — business customer (B2B); 'municipal' — government or municipal contract customer; 'industrial' — large-scale industrial waste generator. Drives portal feature availability and UI personalization.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM — Account Type Field; NWRA Customer Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: auth_method
attributes.description: Primary authentication mechanism configured for this portal account. 'password' — standard username/password credential; 'sso' — Single Sign-On via enterprise identity provider; 'oauth2' — OAuth 2.0 delegated authorization; 'saml' — Security Assertion Markup Language federation. Determines the login flow presented to the customer.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749; SAML 2.0 OASIS Standard

attributes.name: autopay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has enrolled in automatic payment (AutoPay) through the portal, authorizing recurring charges to a stored payment method on the billing due date. True = AutoPay active; False = manual payment required. Impacts accounts receivable (AR) collection workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management — AutoPay Module; Waste Logics Customer Portal; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: bill_payment_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portal account has been granted access to the online bill payment feature, enabling customers to view invoices and submit payments through the Waste Logics portal. May be restricted for accounts under collections or with disputed balances.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Feature Permissions; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the portal account was permanently closed and deactivated. Null for accounts that are not closed. Triggers data retention and deletion workflows per privacy regulations. Distinct from suspension which is temporary.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA; Waste Logics Customer Portal — Account Lifecycle

attributes.name: container_request_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portal account has been granted access to submit container delivery, swap, or removal requests through the self-service portal. Container ID (CID) management requests are routed to the AMCS Platform for fulfillment.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Feature Permissions; AMCS Platform — Container Tracking (CID)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this portal account record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Serves as the system-of-record audit creation timestamp for data lineage, compliance, and change tracking purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 30; SOX Compliance; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: document_download_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portal account has been granted access to download documents such as invoices, service agreements, waste manifests, and compliance certificates through the self-service portal.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Feature Permissions; RCRA Manifest Requirements; DOT Regulations

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address registered to the portal account. Used for login (when email-based authentication is configured), password reset communications, notification delivery, and billing alerts. Must be unique across all active portal accounts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: email_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registered email address for this portal account has been confirmed via an email verification workflow (e.g., click-through confirmation link). True = verified; False = unverified. Unverified accounts may have restricted portal feature access.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 7 (Consent)

attributes.name: email_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the portal account email address was confirmed via the verification workflow. Null if email has not yet been verified. Provides audit trail for consent and identity verification compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Waste Logics Customer Portal; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: failed_login_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of consecutive failed login attempts since the last successful login or since the counter was last reset. Used to trigger account lockout policies per security standards. Reset to zero upon successful authentication.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; Waste Logics Customer Portal Security Policy; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: inactivity_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of consecutive days without a successful login after which this portal account is flagged as inactive and subject to dormancy policies (e.g., notification, auto-suspension). May be set at the account level to override the system default for specific customer segments.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Inactivity Policy; NIST SP 800-63B

attributes.name: last_login_ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the most recent successful login was performed. Used for security anomaly detection, geographic access monitoring, and fraud investigation. May be considered PII under GDPR and CCPA in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; NIST SP 800-92; Waste Logics Customer Portal Security Policy

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent successful authenticated login to the Waste Logics customer portal for this account. Used for inactivity detection, dormant account management, security monitoring, and customer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; Waste Logics Customer Portal; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: linked_account_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct customer service accounts (e.g., multiple service addresses or business locations) currently linked to this portal account. Supports multi-account management use cases common in commercial and municipal customers managing multiple service sites.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: mfa_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is currently active for this portal account. True = MFA is enforced at login; False = single-factor authentication only. Supports security compliance reporting and risk-based access control policies.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; SOX IT General Controls; Waste Logics Customer Portal Security Policy

attributes.name: mfa_method
attributes.description: The specific second-factor mechanism enrolled for this portal account when MFA is enabled. 'totp' — Time-based One-Time Password (e.g., Google Authenticator); 'sms' — SMS text message code; 'email' — email-delivered OTP; 'authenticator_app' — push notification via authenticator app; 'none' — MFA not configured.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; Waste Logics Customer Portal Security Policy

attributes.name: notification_email_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive email notifications from the portal (e.g., service reminders, billing alerts, collection schedule changes). True = subscribed; False = unsubscribed. Governs outbound email communication consent.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 7; Waste Logics Customer Portal Notification Settings

attributes.name: notification_push_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive mobile push notifications via the Waste Logics customer portal mobile application. True = subscribed; False = unsubscribed. Supports real-time service alerts and collection reminders.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Waste Logics Customer Portal Notification Settings

attributes.name: notification_sms_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive SMS/text message notifications from the portal (e.g., collection day reminders, service disruption alerts). True = subscribed; False = unsubscribed. Governs outbound SMS communication consent.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); GDPR Article 7; Waste Logics Customer Portal Notification Settings

attributes.name: paperless_billing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has enrolled in paperless (electronic) billing through the portal, opting to receive invoices digitally rather than by postal mail. True = paperless billing active; False = paper billing. Supports sustainability reporting on paper reduction and digital adoption KPIs.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management — Billing Preferences; Waste Logics Customer Portal; EPA Sustainability Reporting

attributes.name: password_last_changed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the portal account password was most recently changed or reset. Used to enforce password expiration policies, prompt users to update credentials, and support security compliance audits. Null for SSO-only accounts.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; SOX IT General Controls; Waste Logics Customer Portal Security Policy

attributes.name: portal_account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to the portal account by the Waste Logics customer portal system. Used in customer communications, support tickets, and portal UI display. Distinct from the internal surrogate key.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Account Numbering Standard

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the customer's preferred language for portal UI display and communications (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'en-US', 'es-MX'). Supports multilingual portal experiences for diverse residential and commercial customer bases.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer completed portal account registration in the Waste Logics customer portal. Used for cohort analysis, onboarding funnel reporting, and customer digital adoption tracking.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the portal account registration was completed and confirmed. Provides audit-grade precision for security forensics, compliance logging, and SLA measurement of onboarding workflows.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-92 Log Management; GDPR Article 30; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: service_history_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portal account has been granted access to view historical service records, including past collection events, work orders (WO), and service requests, through the self-service portal.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Feature Permissions; AMCS Platform — Route History

attributes.name: service_scheduling_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portal account has been granted access to the self-service scheduling feature, allowing customers to request, modify, or cancel waste collection service appointments online. Controlled by account type and service agreement terms.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal — Feature Permissions; AMCS Platform — Service Scheduling

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this portal account record originated. 'waste_logics' — Waste Logics customer portal (primary source); 'salesforce' — Salesforce CRM (for accounts provisioned via CRM workflow); 'manual' — manually created by operations staff.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: sso_external_reference
attributes.description: The unique subject identifier (sub claim or NameID) issued by the external SSO identity provider for this portal account. Used to correlate the portal account with the customer's federated identity. Null for non-SSO accounts.
attributes.references: SAML 2.0 OASIS Standard; OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749; NIST SP 800-63C

attributes.name: sso_provider
attributes.description: Identity provider (IdP) used for Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication when auth_method is 'sso' or 'oauth2'. Identifies the federated identity source. 'none' for accounts using native password authentication.
attributes.references: SAML 2.0 OASIS Standard; OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749; NIST SP 800-63C; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the current or most recent suspension of the portal account. Populated when account_status is 'suspended' or 'locked'. 'none' when account is active. Supports customer service investigation and reinstatement workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: security_violation|non_payment|customer_request|admin_review|fraud_investigation|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM — Case Management; Oracle Revenue Management — Collections

attributes.name: suspension_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the portal account was most recently placed in a suspended or locked state. Null if the account has never been suspended. Used for SLA tracking on account reinstatement and security incident response timelines.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; NIST SP 800-92; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: terms_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has accepted the Waste Management portal terms of service and privacy policy during registration or upon a terms update. True = accepted; False = not yet accepted. Accounts with False may have restricted access pending acceptance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA; Waste Logics Customer Portal Terms of Service

attributes.name: terms_accepted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the customer most recently accepted the portal terms of service and privacy policy. Provides legally defensible consent audit trail. Updated each time terms are re-accepted following a policy revision.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; SOX Compliance; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: terms_version_accepted
attributes.description: Version identifier of the portal terms of service and privacy policy that the customer most recently accepted (e.g., 'v2.1', 'v3.0'). Enables compliance teams to identify customers who have not yet accepted the current version following a policy update.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; Waste Logics Customer Portal Terms Versioning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this portal account record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer data product. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 30; SOX Compliance; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: username
attributes.description: The unique login username chosen by or assigned to the customer for authenticating into the Waste Logics self-service portal. May be an email address or a custom alphanumeric handle. Used as the primary login credential identifier.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B Digital Identity Guidelines; Waste Logics Customer Portal

products.name: lead
products.description: Prospective customers who have expressed interest in Waste Management services but have not yet converted to active accounts. Captures lead source (web form, referral, cold outreach, trade show, municipal RFP), prospect type (residential, commercial, industrial, municipal), estimated service volume, assigned sales representative, lead status (new, contacted, qualified, converted, lost), qualification score, and conversion date. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead object. Supports the customer acquisition lifecycle from prospect to active account.

attributes.name: lead_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lead record in the Waste Management customer acquisition pipeline. Primary key for the lead data product.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer account created in Salesforce CRM or Waste Logics upon successful lead conversion. Populated only when lead_status = 'converted'. Enables traceability from lead origin to active customer lifecycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Conversion; Waste Logics Customer Management

attributes.name: lead_assigned_sales_rep_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lead Assigned Sales Rep Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: lead_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management sales representative assigned to own and progress this lead. References the employee record in Workday HCM. Used for workload balancing, performance tracking, and commission attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Workday HCM

attributes.name: recycling_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.recycling_program. Business justification: Sales leads for commercial recycling services are qualified against available recycling programs to verify service availability, accepted materials, and pricing. Required for accurate sales qualificat

attributes.name: budget_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect has confirmed they have an approved budget allocated for waste management services. A key qualification criterion in the sales process; confirmed budget increases conversion probability.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Qualification Framework

attributes.name: collection_frequency_requested
attributes.description: Requested frequency of waste collection service as expressed by the prospect. Used for route planning feasibility and SLA (Service Level Agreement) design during the sales process.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; AMCS Platform Route Optimization

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the prospective commercial, industrial, or municipal organization. Null for residential (B2C) leads where individual name fields apply.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: competitor_incumbent
attributes.description: Name of the current waste service provider (competitor) serving the prospect, if known. Used for competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, and tailoring the sales pitch to differentiate Waste Management's service offering.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Competitive Intelligence Program

attributes.name: container_type_requested
attributes.description: Type of waste container the prospect has requested or that is appropriate for their service needs. Informs equipment provisioning and CID (Container Identification) assignment upon conversion. Values: cart (residential/small commercial), dumpster (FEL/REL front-end or rear-end loader), roll-off (C&D or large volume), compactor (commercial high-density), tote (recycling), none (service-only).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; AMCS Platform Container Management; Waste Logics

attributes.name: contract_end_date_incumbent
attributes.description: Date on which the prospect's current service contract with an incumbent provider expires. Critical for timing outreach and proposal submission to align with the prospect's procurement window.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Playbook

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead was formally converted to an active customer account. Populated when lead_status transitions to 'converted'. Used for sales cycle duration analysis and conversion rate KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Customer Acquisition Metrics

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lead record was first created in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Represents the start of the lead lifecycle and is used for lead age calculation, SLA compliance monitoring, and pipeline velocity reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: crm_lead_reference
attributes.description: External lead identifier sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead object. Used to trace the record back to the originating system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: decision_maker_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sales representative has confirmed contact with the actual decision-maker (budget authority) at the prospect organization. Critical qualification criterion; unconfirmed decision-maker contact reduces forecast reliability.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Qualification Framework

attributes.name: decision_timeline
attributes.description: Prospect's anticipated timeframe for making a purchasing decision. Used for pipeline stage management, sales forecasting, and prioritizing follow-up activities by the assigned sales representative.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Qualification Framework

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that the lead contact has requested no further outreach from Waste Management. Enforces compliance with TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) and CAN-SPAM Act opt-out requirements. When true, all outbound sales and marketing communications must cease.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the lead contact used for sales outreach, marketing communications, and follow-up correspondence. Sourced from Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: estimated_annual_revenue
attributes.description: Projected annual revenue (USD) expected from this lead if converted to an active account. Used for sales pipeline valuation, quota tracking, and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) forecasting. Calculated by sales representative based on service scope and applicable rate schedules.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: estimated_monthly_volume_tons
attributes.description: Estimated monthly waste generation volume in tons (short tons) for the prospective customer. Key input for service sizing, container selection, collection frequency determination, and revenue forecasting. Expressed in TPD (Tons Per Day) equivalent basis for commercial and industrial prospects.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Service Sizing Guidelines; EPA Waste Generation Benchmarks

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First name of the primary contact person associated with the lead. Applies to residential (B2C) leads and the key contact for commercial or municipal prospects.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: Industry classification of the prospective commercial or industrial customer (e.g., healthcare, retail, construction, manufacturing, hospitality, government). Used for targeted sales strategies, regulatory compliance pre-assessment (RCRA, CERCLA), and service customization. Applies to B2B and municipal leads.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; NAICS Industry Classification; EPA RCRA Sector-Specific Regulations

attributes.name: is_hazardous_waste_generator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospective customer generates hazardous waste requiring RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) compliant handling, manifesting, and disposal through a licensed TSDF (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility). Triggers specialized sales routing and compliance review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; EPA RCRA; CERCLA; DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which a Waste Management sales representative made contact with the lead (call, email, meeting, or site visit). Used to identify stale leads requiring re-engagement and to enforce follow-up SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Activity Standards

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the primary contact person associated with the lead. Used in conjunction with first_name to form the full contact identity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the lead was originally generated. Supports marketing attribution analysis and campaign ROI (Return on Investment) measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_form|referral|cold_outreach|trade_show|municipal_rfp|partner|inbound_call|digital_ad — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Marketing Attribution Framework

attributes.name: lead_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the lead within the Waste Management customer acquisition pipeline. Tracks progression from initial capture through qualification to conversion or disqualification. Values: new (just captured), contacted (outreach made), qualified (meets service criteria), converted (became active account), lost (disqualified or chose competitor).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Customer Acquisition Process

attributes.name: lost_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the lead was marked as lost and did not convert to an active account. Used for win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence, and sales process improvement. Populated only when lead_status = 'lost'.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Win/Loss Analysis Program

attributes.name: next_follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next sales follow-up action with the lead. Set by the assigned sales representative to manage pipeline cadence and ensure timely progression through the qualification stages.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Activity Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for sales representative notes capturing qualitative context about the lead, including site visit observations, special service requirements, regulatory considerations (e.g., RCRA generator status), or competitive intelligence gathered during outreach.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the lead contact. Used by sales representatives for initial outreach and qualification calls. Formatted per E.164 international standard.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: prospect_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prospective customer by service segment. Residential (B2C household), commercial (B2B business), industrial (large-scale waste generator), or municipal (government/public sector contract). Drives service offering, pricing tier, and sales routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Customer Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: qualification_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) assigned to the lead based on qualification criteria including service volume, budget authority, decision timeline, and fit with Waste Management service offerings. Higher scores indicate higher conversion probability. Supports sales prioritization and pipeline management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Sales Qualification Framework

attributes.name: rfp_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal Request for Proposal issued by a municipal or government prospect. Applicable primarily to municipal contract leads. Used to track competitive bid processes and link to proposal documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Municipal Sales Process; Local Solid Waste Authorities

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region to which this lead is assigned within Waste Management's organizational territory structure (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West). Used for regional performance reporting and territory management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Territory Management Policy

attributes.name: service_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the prospective service location. Used for route planning feasibility assessment, service zone validation, and eventual account setup upon conversion.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; AMCS Platform Route Optimization; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: service_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the prospective service location (suite, unit, floor, building identifier). Supplements service_address_line1 for precise location identification.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: service_city
attributes.description: City of the prospective service location. Used for geographic market analysis, service territory assignment, and operational capacity planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: service_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the prospective service location (e.g., USA). Supports international operations and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: service_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the prospective service location. Used for service zone validation, route feasibility, and market density analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; USPS Postal Standards

attributes.name: service_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the prospective service location. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, state environmental compliance requirements, and regional sales territory assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; EPA State Environmental Regulations; DOT State Regulations

attributes.name: service_type_requested
attributes.description: Primary waste management service type the prospect is interested in. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste) collection, recycling, C&D (Construction and Demolition) waste, hazardous waste handling, WTE (Waste-to-Energy), landfill disposal, roll-off container, or portable sanitation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msw_collection|recycling|c_and_d|hazardous_waste|wte|landfill|roll_off|portable_toilet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Waste Management Service Catalog; EPA RCRA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the lead record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: account_note
products.description: Free-form and structured notes attached to customer accounts by customer service representatives, field operations staff, sales personnel, and automated systems. Captures note type (service instruction, billing note, safety alert, access instruction, escalation note), note text, visibility level (internal only, field-visible, customer-visible), author, creation timestamp, and expiration date. Critical for communicating special handling instructions (e.g., locked gate codes, aggressive dog warnings, weight-restricted access) across operational teams.

attributes.name: account_note_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each account note record. Primary key for the account_note data product.

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Container Identification (CID) number of the specific waste container (dumpster, cart, roll-off, compactor) to which this note applies. Enables container-level instructions such as overweight warnings, damaged container flags, or special placement requirements.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; Waste Logics Container Management; RFID Standards

attributes.name: collection_stop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.stop. Business justification: Account notes often contain stop-specific operational instructions (access codes, gate combinations, placement details, safety warnings, dog warnings) that drivers and operations teams need when servi

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Account notes document contract-specific exceptions (rate holds, SLA waivers, special handling terms). Operations and billing teams need agreement_id to associate notes with active contracts for servi

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer account to which this note is attached. Links the note to the parent customer account in the Customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: emergency_response_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.emergency_response_incident. Business justification: Account notes document site-specific safety concerns, access restrictions, and incident history related to emergency response events. Critical for driver safety briefings, future service planning, and

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Account notes frequently contain facility-specific instructions (gate access codes, disposal restrictions, delivery procedures for transfer stations/MRFs/landfills). Operations and drivers need facili

attributes.name: hazard_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.hazard_register. Business justification: Account notes document known hazards at customer sites (aggressive dogs, overhead wires, unstable surfaces). Business need: Hazard communication, safety briefing preparation, risk mitigation. Critical

attributes.name: inbound_load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.inbound_load. Business justification: Operational notes about customer accounts reference specific problematic inbound loads for contamination issues, access problems, or material quality concerns. Essential for driver safety alerts and s

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Account notes document safety-critical information related to past incidents at customer sites (prior injuries, hazmat spills, access issues). Business need: Historical incident context, repeat incide

attributes.name: jha_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.jha. Business justification: Account notes reference site-specific JHAs or safety procedures required at customer locations. Business need: Operational safety documentation, crew access to site-specific procedures, compliance ver

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Operations teams document site-specific access restrictions, special handling requirements, and regulatory constraints for customers using specific landfill facilities. Critical for route planning and

attributes.name: primary_account_author_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee (customer service representative, field operations staff, sales personnel, or system user) who created this note. Used for accountability, audit trails, and note ownership tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Record; SAP S/4HANA HR Module; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: related_note_account_note_id
attributes.description: Identifier of a parent or predecessor account note that this note supersedes, amends, or is related to. Enables note versioning and chaining of related instructions (e.g., an updated gate code note referencing the original).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Note Relationships; Waste Logics

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection route to which this note is relevant, when the note contains route-specific instructions (e.g., weight-restricted road on route segment, seasonal access changes). Used by AMCS and Locus Dispatch for route-level note surfacing.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch Real-Time Route Management

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific service address associated with this note, when the note applies to a particular service location rather than the entire account. Null if the note applies account-wide.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; AMCS Platform Container Tracking

attributes.name: tertiary_account_acknowledged_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the field employee (driver or crew member) who most recently acknowledged this note prior to service execution. Used for safety compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Locus Dispatch; AMCS Platform; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Safety-critical and operational notes frequently reference specific collection vehicles: access restrictions for large vehicles, gate clearance issues, vehicle damage incidents, driver safety concerns

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Work Order (WO) associated with this note, if the note was created in the context of a specific service work order. Null if not linked to a WO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: access_code
attributes.description: Gate code, keypad combination, or access credential required to enter the service location. Stored as a structured field separate from note_text to enable targeted display in driver mobile apps and automated gate systems. Classified as confidential due to security sensitivity.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Locus Dispatch; AMCS Platform; Waste Management Security Policy

attributes.name: applies_to_all_services
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note applies to all service types and lines at the associated account or address (True), or is scoped to a specific service line, container, or route as indicated by other fields (False). Drives note display logic in AMCS and Locus Dispatch.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Locus Dispatch; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: author_name
attributes.description: Display name of the employee or system process that authored the note, captured at time of creation for audit and display purposes. Retained even if the employee record is later modified.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SOX Internal Controls; Salesforce CRM Audit Trail

attributes.name: author_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the note author at the time of creation. Supports filtering notes by originating function and enables role-based visibility rules. automated_system indicates notes generated by integration processes (e.g., SAP, AMCS, Enviance).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Role; Workday HCM Job Profile; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: billing_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the invoice, billing dispute, or accounts receivable (AR) transaction in Oracle Revenue Management associated with this note, when note_type is billing_note. Enables traceability between billing annotations and financial transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account note was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Serves as the primary audit creation timestamp and is used for note ordering and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; ISO 8601; Salesforce CRM CreatedDate Field

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this note becomes active and should be applied during service operations. Allows notes to be pre-created for future service events (e.g., a gate code change effective next Monday).
attributes.references: Waste Logics Service Scheduling; AMCS Platform Route Management

attributes.name: escalation_case_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the customer escalation case in Salesforce CRM associated with this note, when note_type is escalation_note. Enables cross-referencing between account notes and formal complaint or escalation case management workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; Waste Management Customer Service SLA Policy; NPS Tracking

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this note is no longer active and should not be displayed to field crews or customer service representatives. Null indicates the note has no expiration and remains active indefinitely. Critical for time-limited instructions such as temporary access codes or seasonal hazard warnings.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; AMCS Platform; Waste Management Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Specific category of safety hazard documented in this note, when note_type is safety_alert. Enables targeted safety briefings and PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) requirements for field crews. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aggressive_animal|biohazard|chemical_exposure|weight_restriction|overhead_obstruction|unstable_ground|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; EPA RCRA; Enviance EHS; NWRA Safety Standards

attributes.name: is_pinned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note is pinned to the top of the account note list, ensuring it is always prominently displayed to customer service representatives and field crews regardless of creation date. True = pinned; False = standard ordering.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: is_safety_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note contains a safety-critical instruction or warning (e.g., aggressive dog, hazardous material on premises, weight-restricted access road, biohazard). Safety-critical notes trigger mandatory acknowledgment workflows in Locus Dispatch and AMCS before service execution.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT 49 CFR; Enviance EHS; NWRA Safety Standards

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the note text content (e.g., en, es, fr). Supports multilingual customer service operations in diverse service territories where notes may be authored in Spanish, English, or other languages.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; CCPA; Waste Management Multilingual Customer Service Policy

attributes.name: last_acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this note was most recently acknowledged by a field crew member or driver via the Locus Dispatch or AMCS mobile application. Relevant for notes where requires_acknowledgment is True.
attributes.references: Locus Dispatch Driver Acknowledgment; AMCS Platform; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account note was most recently updated, including edits to note text, status changes, or visibility modifications. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; ISO 8601; Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate Field

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this note was last reviewed by a supervisor or quality assurance process to confirm its accuracy and continued relevance. Supports note hygiene programs to prevent stale instructions from persisting in operational systems.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Service Quality Standards; NWRA Best Practices

attributes.name: note_category
attributes.description: Broad functional category of the note indicating which business function originated or owns the note. Supports filtering and reporting by department. Values: operational (field ops), customer_service (CSR-generated), compliance (regulatory or EHS-related), sales (sales team annotation), field_operations (driver or field staff note), automated (system-generated note).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Enviance EHS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: note_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the account note, used in customer service correspondence and operational communications (e.g., NOTE-202400012345).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case/Note Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account note. Active notes are visible to applicable audiences; expired notes have passed their expiration date; archived notes have been manually retired; superseded notes have been replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: note_subject
attributes.description: Short summary or title of the account note, providing a quick-scan description of the note content without requiring the full note text to be read. Used in list views and operational dashboards.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Note Subject Field; Waste Logics

attributes.name: note_text
attributes.description: Full free-form or structured text body of the account note. Contains the primary informational content such as special handling instructions, safety warnings, access codes, billing annotations, or escalation details. May contain sensitive operational information.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Note Body Field; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: note_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account note by its operational purpose. Drives routing, visibility, and urgency handling. Values: service_instruction (special handling for collection crews), billing_note (billing or payment-related annotation), safety_alert (hazard or safety warning such as aggressive dog or biohazard), access_instruction (gate codes, locked access, weight-restricted roads), escalation_note (customer complaint or escalated issue), general (unclassified free-form note).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to the note, used to surface critical safety alerts or escalation notes to operational teams. Critical notes (e.g., biohazard warnings, aggressive animal alerts) are highlighted in driver mobile apps and dispatch systems.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Safety Communication Standards; Locus Dispatch; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern
attributes.description: Defines whether this note recurs on a schedule, enabling time-limited instructions to automatically reactivate (e.g., a seasonal road closure note that applies every winter). none = one-time note; other values indicate recurring activation aligned to the effective_date and expiration_date cycle.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Service Scheduling; AMCS Platform Route Management

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory requirement, permit condition, or compliance obligation that this note documents or supports (e.g., RCRA permit number, EPA inspection finding reference, OSHA citation number). Relevant for compliance and EHS-category notes.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; CERCLA; Clean Air Act; Clean Water Act; OSHA 29 CFR; Enviance EHS Permit Tracking

attributes.name: requires_acknowledgment
attributes.description: Indicates whether field staff or drivers must explicitly acknowledge this note before performing service at the associated address. Used for safety alerts, access instructions, and compliance-related notes to ensure crew awareness.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Locus Dispatch Driver Acknowledgment Workflow; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: service_line_type
attributes.description: The type of service line to which this note applies, enabling targeted display to relevant operational crews. Values align with Waste Management's core service lines: residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, hazardous_waste (RCRA-regulated), recycling (MRF-bound), wte (Waste-to-Energy). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|municipal|hazardous_waste|recycling|wte — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Service Line Configuration; RCRA; EPA Subtitle C/D; NWRA

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this note record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Note ID, Waste Logics Note ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Integration Standards; Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this note originated. Supports data lineage tracking and integration reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|waste_logics|amcs|locus_dispatch|sap_s4hana|enviance_ehs|oracle_revenue_mgmt|manual — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Waste Management Enterprise Integration Architecture; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version counter for this note, incremented each time the note text or key attributes are materially updated. Supports note versioning and audit trail requirements, enabling reconstruction of note history.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; Waste Management Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Version Tracking

attributes.name: visibility_level
attributes.description: Controls which audiences can view this note. internal_only: visible only to back-office staff; field_visible: visible to field operations crews and drivers via mobile dispatch systems (Locus Dispatch, AMCS); customer_visible: visible to the customer via the Waste Logics customer portal.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; Locus Dispatch; AMCS Platform; CCPA Data Minimization Principles

attributes.name: waste_stream_type
attributes.description: The specific waste stream category relevant to this note, when the note pertains to a particular material type. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste), C&D (Construction and Demolition), hazardous (RCRA-regulated), organic (food/yard waste), bulky (large item), e_waste (electronic waste). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msw|recycling|c_and_d|hazardous|organic|bulky|e_waste — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; CERCLA; State Environmental Quality Departments; SWANA Waste Stream Classification

products.name: service_suspension
products.description: Records temporary or permanent suspension events on customer service enrollments — including voluntary holds (seasonal, vacation), involuntary suspensions (non-payment, regulatory hold, safety violation), and service interruptions (weather, route disruption). Captures suspension type, start date, expected resume date, actual resume date, suspension reason code, initiating department, and customer notification status. Enables accurate billing adjustments, route planning exclusions, and customer communication during service interruptions.

attributes.name: service_suspension_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each service suspension event record. Primary key for the service_suspension data product.

attributes.name: contamination_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.contamination_event. Business justification: Service suspensions due to repeated contamination violations reference specific contamination events that triggered the suspension. Required for regulatory compliance, customer notification, and reins

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Service suspensions trigger contract billing holds, term extensions, and SLA adjustments. Agreement reference required for automated billing system integration and contract lifecycle event tracking pe

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (residential, commercial, industrial, or municipal) whose service is being suspended. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account record or Waste Logics customer profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: primary_service_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or system user who created or triggered the suspension record. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and internal governance policies.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Workday HCM; Waste Management Internal Governance

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.route. Business justification: Service suspensions must communicate route exclusions to operations teams. Route managers need visibility into which stops are temporarily inactive for route optimization, driver instructions, and cap

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service location address where waste collection or other service is being suspended. Enables route planning exclusions during the suspension period.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: service_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service enrollment (subscription/agreement) that is being suspended. Links this suspension event to the specific recurring service agreement in Waste Logics or SAP SD.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Service Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: actual_resume_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which service was restored and the suspension was lifted. Null if the suspension is still active. Compared against expected_resume_date to measure suspension duration accuracy and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Oracle Revenue Management Billing

attributes.name: auto_resume_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system should automatically reinstate service on the expected_resume_date without requiring manual intervention. When True, AMCS Platform and Oracle Revenue Management are triggered automatically on the resume date.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Oracle Revenue Management; Waste Logics

attributes.name: billing_adjustment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a billing credit or adjustment must be applied to the customer account for the duration of the suspension. True for voluntary holds and operational interruptions; typically False for non-payment suspensions. Triggers workflow in Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: billing_credit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary credit amount (in USD) to be applied to the customer's account for the suspension period. Calculated based on the prorated service rate and suspension duration. Populated by Oracle Revenue Management upon suspension approval.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_hold_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which billing charges resume for the customer account following the suspension. May differ from actual_resume_date due to billing cycle alignment. Used by Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: billing_hold_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which billing charges are paused or adjusted for the customer account. May differ from suspension_start_date if billing cycles do not align with service dates. Used by Oracle Revenue Management for invoice generation.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: container_retrieval_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which containers are retrieved from the service address during the suspension. Null if container_retrieval_required is False. Tracked in AMCS Platform container management.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: container_retrieval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether waste containers (bins, dumpsters, roll-offs) at the service address must be physically retrieved during the suspension period. Relevant for long-term or permanent suspensions. Triggers a container retrieval work order in AMCS or Waste Logics.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; Waste Logics Container Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the suspension record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 8601; Waste Management Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: crm_case_reference
attributes.description: The case or ticket identifier in Salesforce CRM associated with this suspension event. Enables cross-system traceability between the operational suspension record and the customer service case for communication history and resolution tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; Waste Management CRM Integration Standards

attributes.name: customer_notification_status
attributes.description: Tracks whether the customer has been notified of the suspension event. 'not_sent' = notification not yet dispatched; 'sent' = notification dispatched via configured channel; 'acknowledged' = customer confirmed receipt; 'failed' = notification delivery failed. Supports SLA compliance and customer communication obligations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Management Customer SLA Standards; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suspension has been escalated to a higher authority (e.g., collections manager, compliance officer, legal team) due to non-resolution, regulatory severity, or repeat offense. Triggers escalation workflow in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Management Collections Policy; RCRA Compliance

attributes.name: expected_resume_date
attributes.description: The anticipated calendar date on which service is expected to resume. Used for proactive route re-inclusion planning, customer communication scheduling, and billing adjustment calculations. May differ from actual_resume_date.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Oracle Revenue Management Billing

attributes.name: initiating_department
attributes.description: The internal department that initiated or authorized the suspension event. Supports accountability tracking and root-cause analysis of suspension volumes by department.
attributes.references: Waste Management Internal Governance; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suspension is permanent (i.e., service will not resume). True for account closures or permanent service terminations processed as suspensions. When True, expected_resume_date and actual_resume_date are expected to be null.
attributes.references: Waste Management Internal Operations; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, internal comments, or follow-up actions related to the suspension event. Captured by customer service representatives or operations staff.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer of the suspension event (e.g., email, SMS, phone call, customer portal message, physical mail). Sourced from Salesforce CRM communication preferences.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Management Customer Communication Policy

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer notification for this suspension was dispatched. Null if notification has not been sent. Used to measure notification lead time relative to suspension_start_date.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Management Customer SLA Standards

attributes.name: prior_suspension_count
attributes.description: The number of previous suspension events recorded for this customer enrollment prior to the current suspension. Used for customer risk scoring, collections escalation, and identifying repeat non-payment patterns.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Salesforce CRM; Waste Management Collections Policy

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: The regulatory body that mandated or is associated with the suspension event. Applicable only when suspension_type is 'regulatory'. Values: EPA (U.S. Environmental Protection Agency), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), DOT (Department of Transportation), STATE_ENV (State Environmental Quality Department), LOCAL_SWA (Local Solid Waste Authority), OTHER.
attributes.references: EPA; OSHA; DOT; RCRA; CERCLA; Clean Air Act; Clean Water Act

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: The official reference number from a regulatory agency (EPA, OSHA, DOT, State Environmental Quality Department) associated with a regulatory-mandated suspension. Null for non-regulatory suspensions. Required for RCRA, CERCLA, and Clean Water Act compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Regulatory Compliance; OSHA Standards; DOT Regulations; RCRA; CERCLA; Clean Water Act

attributes.name: resume_condition
attributes.description: The condition that must be met before service can be resumed. 'date_based' = resumes on expected_resume_date; 'payment_received' = requires outstanding balance cleared; 'inspection_passed' = requires safety or compliance inspection; 'regulatory_clearance' = requires regulatory agency sign-off; 'manual_review' = requires supervisor approval.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Enviance EHS; OSHA; EPA

attributes.name: route_exclusion_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route exclusion has been confirmed and applied in the AMCS Platform or Locus Dispatch system. Supports operational verification that the address will not receive service during the suspension.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch

attributes.name: route_exclusion_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service address must be excluded from active collection routes during the suspension period. When True, triggers route update in AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch to prevent unnecessary truck dispatches.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch

attributes.name: safety_incident_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this suspension to a safety incident record in Enviance EHS (e.g., OSHA recordable incident, PPE violation, hazardous material spill). Null if suspension is not safety-related. Supports OSHA 300 log and incident management reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA Standards; Enviance EHS; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: sap_hold_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Hold Code
attributes.description: The delivery or billing block code applied in SAP S/4HANA SD or FI module corresponding to this suspension. Used to synchronize the suspension state with SAP order management and accounts receivable processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service being suspended based on customer segment. 'residential' = household waste collection (B2C); 'commercial' = business waste collection (B2B); 'industrial' = large-scale industrial waste; 'municipal' = government/municipal contract services.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Segmentation Standards; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: suspension_duration_days
attributes.description: The planned number of calendar days for the suspension, calculated as the difference between expected_resume_date and suspension_start_date at the time of creation. Used for billing credit calculations and route planning horizon.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Waste Management Internal Operations

attributes.name: suspension_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the suspension event, used in customer communications, billing adjustments, and cross-system references (e.g., Salesforce CRM case number, Oracle Revenue Management hold reference). Format: SUSP-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Waste Management Internal Data Standards; Salesforce CRM Service Object

attributes.name: suspension_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code identifying the specific cause of the suspension (e.g., NON_PAY, SEASONAL_HOLD, VACATION_HOLD, SAFETY_VIOLATION, WEATHER_EVENT, ROUTE_DISRUPTION, REGULATORY_HOLD, CUSTOMER_REQUEST, HAZMAT_INCIDENT). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NON_PAY|SEASONAL_HOLD|VACATION_HOLD|SAFETY_VIOLATION|WEATHER_EVENT|ROUTE_DISRUPTION|REGULATORY_HOLD|CUSTOMER_REQUEST|HAZMAT_INCIDENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Waste Management Internal Operations; RCRA Compliance; OSHA Standards

attributes.name: suspension_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or detail about the specific reason for the suspension, supplementing the structured reason code. Captured by the initiating department representative.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the service suspension becomes effective and collection/service activities are halted for the customer. Used by AMCS route optimization to exclude the address from active routes.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: suspension_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the suspension event. 'pending' = approved but not yet started; 'active' = suspension is currently in effect; 'resumed' = service has been restored; 'cancelled' = suspension was voided before taking effect; 'expired' = suspension end date passed without explicit resume action.
attributes.references: Waste Management Internal Data Standards; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: suspension_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the suspension event. 'voluntary' = customer-initiated hold (seasonal, vacation); 'involuntary' = company-initiated for non-payment or policy violation; 'regulatory' = mandated by EPA, OSHA, DOT, or other governing body; 'operational' = service interruption due to weather, route disruption, or fleet issue.
attributes.references: NWRA Service Standards; EPA Regulatory Compliance; DOT Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the suspension record was last modified. Updated on any status change, date revision, or field update. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 8601; Waste Management Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: waste_stream_type
attributes.description: The type of waste stream associated with the suspended service. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste), recycling, C&D (Construction and Demolition Waste), hazardous, organics, or bulk. Determines which operational teams and regulatory requirements are affected by the suspension.
attributes.references: EPA Solid Waste Regulations; RCRA; NWRA; SWANA

products.name: referral
products.description: Tracks customer referral events where existing Waste Management customers refer new prospects. Captures referring account, referred prospect identity, referral date, referral channel (portal, phone, written), referral program code, referral status (pending, converted, expired, rewarded), reward type (bill credit, gift card), reward amount, and reward fulfillment date. Supports customer loyalty programs, referral incentive management, and acquisition cost attribution for residential and commercial segments.

attributes.name: referral_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each customer referral event record in the Waste Management referral tracking system.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management customer service representative or sales agent who assisted in capturing or processing the referral, particularly for phone and written channel referrals. Null for self-service portal submissions. Used for agent performance attribution.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Employee Record; Salesforce CRM — User Object

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the referral incentive program under which this referral was submitted. Links to the referral program configuration defining reward rules, eligibility, and expiration terms.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management — Loyalty Program Configuration
