attributes.name: referral_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the existing Waste Management customer account that initiated the referral. Links to the customer master record in Salesforce CRM and Waste Logics.

attributes.name: referral_referred_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the prospect or newly converted customer account that was referred. Populated upon conversion from prospect to active customer. Null if the referral has not yet converted.

attributes.name: salesforce_lead_id
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM Lead or Opportunity record ID associated with the referred prospect. Populated when the referral generates a lead in Salesforce. Used for CRM-to-referral reconciliation and sales pipeline attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Lead Object; Waste Management CRM Integration Policy

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized customer_segment STRING field to FK reference. Referrals should reference segment classification via FK to enable segment-based referral program analysis.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost attributed to acquiring the referred customer through this referral event, expressed in USD. Includes the reward amount plus any administrative processing costs allocated to this referral. Used for customer acquisition cost (CAC) analysis and ROI measurement of the referral program.
attributes.references: Waste Management Finance Policy; GAAP Cost Accounting; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the referral was submitted by the existing customer. Supports multi-channel acquisition analytics and channel effectiveness reporting. Values include portal (Waste Logics self-service), phone (customer service center), written (mail or in-person form), mobile_app, and email.
attributes.references: Waste Logics — Customer Portal; Salesforce CRM — Service Cloud

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the referred prospect successfully converted to an active Waste Management customer account. Null if the referral has not yet converted. Used to calculate time-to-conversion and referral program effectiveness metrics.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the referral record was first created in the Waste Management data platform Silver layer. Represents the system ingestion time and serves as the audit trail creation marker per data governance policy.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; SOX Compliance — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: duplicate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this referral has been identified as a duplicate of an existing referral record for the same prospect. True when a duplicate is detected; False otherwise. Duplicate referrals are ineligible for reward fulfillment per program policy.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy; Waste Management Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the referral has been validated against program eligibility rules, including service area coverage, account standing of the referring customer, and prospect uniqueness checks. True when eligibility has been confirmed; False when pending or failed validation.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the referral is no longer eligible for reward fulfillment if the prospect has not converted. Calculated from referral_date based on the program's validity window. Used to trigger status transitions to 'expired'.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the referral record in the Silver layer. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance. Updated on every status transition, reward fulfillment event, or data correction.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Policy; SOX Compliance — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context about the referral event, such as special circumstances, manual override justifications, or customer service agent observations recorded during phone or written channel referral intake.

attributes.name: prospect_city
attributes.description: City component of the referred prospect's service address. Used for service area eligibility validation and geographic reporting of referral acquisition activity.

attributes.name: prospect_email
attributes.description: Email address of the referred prospect provided by the referring customer. Used for outreach communications, lead tracking in Salesforce CRM, and identity matching upon conversion to an active account.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: prospect_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the referred prospect as provided at the time of referral submission. Captured before the prospect converts to a full customer account. Used for outreach and identity matching during the conversion process.

attributes.name: prospect_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the referred prospect as provided at the time of referral submission. Used in conjunction with prospect_first_name for identity resolution and CRM lead matching in Salesforce.

attributes.name: prospect_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the referred prospect as provided at referral submission. Used for outbound sales contact and identity verification during the conversion process.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: prospect_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the referred prospect's service address. Used for service area eligibility checks, route assignment, and geographic segmentation of referral acquisition data.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Standard; Waste Management Service Territory Policy

attributes.name: prospect_service_address
attributes.description: The service address provided by the referring customer for the prospect. Used to validate service area eligibility, assign the prospect to the correct route and district, and support conversion to an active service account.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Waste Management Service Territory Policy

attributes.name: prospect_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the referred prospect's service address. Used for service territory validation, state-level regulatory compliance, and geographic referral performance reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; Waste Management Service Territory Policy

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric code assigned to this referral event, used by the referring customer to share with prospects via the Waste Logics customer portal, phone, or written channels. Serves as the business-facing identifier for tracking and attribution.
attributes.references: Waste Logics — Customer Portal Referral Module

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the referring customer submitted the referral. This is the principal business event date used for program eligibility, expiration window calculation, and acquisition cost attribution reporting.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: referral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the referral event. 'Pending' indicates the prospect has not yet signed up; 'converted' means the prospect became an active customer; 'expired' means the referral window lapsed without conversion; 'rewarded' means the reward has been fulfilled; 'cancelled' means the referral was voided.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: reward_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the reward to be issued to the referring customer upon successful referral conversion, expressed in USD. For bill credits, this is the credit amount applied to the account. For gift cards, this is the face value. Zero if reward_type is 'none'.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy; Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: reward_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the reward amount. Defaults to USD for domestic US operations. Supports multi-currency reward programs for international or cross-border service territories.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reward_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the referral reward was actually issued to the referring customer (e.g., bill credit applied, gift card sent). Null until the reward has been fulfilled. Used to track reward liability, fulfillment SLA compliance, and loyalty program cost accounting.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy; Oracle Revenue Management — Billing Adjustment

attributes.name: reward_fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reward fulfillment for this referral. 'Pending' indicates the reward is approved but not yet issued; 'issued' means the reward has been delivered; 'failed' indicates a processing error; 'voided' means the reward was cancelled after approval.
attributes.references: Waste Management Customer Loyalty Program Policy; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: reward_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number for the issued reward, such as the bill credit transaction ID in Oracle Revenue Management or the gift card authorization number. Used for reconciliation between the referral record and the billing or fulfillment system.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management — Billing Adjustment Reference; Waste Management Internal Reconciliation Policy

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: The type of incentive reward offered to the referring customer upon successful conversion of the referred prospect. Supports bill credit applied to the referring account, physical or digital gift card, or a service discount. 'None' indicates no reward is associated with this referral.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Personnel Hazardous Waste Training Current Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all relevant facility personnel have completed current RCRA hazardous waste management training as required for the generator's category. LQGs must provide formal classroom or on-the-job training; SQGs must ensure familiarity with emergency procedures.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.17(a)(7) (LQG); 40 CFR Part 262.16(b)(9) (SQG); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: primary_waste_stream
attributes.description: The predominant category of waste generated at this site. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste) covers general commercial/residential refuse; C&D (Construction and Demolition Waste) covers building debris; hazardous covers RCRA-regulated hazardous waste; universal waste covers batteries, lamps, and pesticides; mixed indicates multiple co-dominant streams.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Parts 261–262; EPA Waste Classification Guidance

attributes.name: profile_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this waste generator regulatory profile is considered valid and active. Represents the start of the current regulatory classification period, which may be triggered by initial registration, a generator category change, or a site re-notification.

attributes.name: profile_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this waste generator regulatory profile expires or must be renewed. Applicable when state permits or generator registrations have fixed validity periods. Null for open-ended federal EPA registrations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.18; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: rcra_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Notification Date
attributes.description: Date on which the generator submitted the initial RCRA Site Identification (Site ID) notification to the EPA or authorized state agency, establishing the generator's regulatory identity and obligations. Required under 40 CFR Part 262.18.

attributes.name: site_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the regulated waste-generating facility as registered with the EPA and state environmental authority. Used for regulatory correspondence, manifest routing, and compliance inspections.

attributes.name: site_city
attributes.description: City of the regulated waste-generating facility as registered with the EPA and state environmental authority.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Legal or operating name of the waste-generating facility or site as registered with the EPA and state environmental agency. May differ from the customer account name if the customer operates multiple sites.

attributes.name: site_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the regulated waste-generating facility. Used for geographic routing, regulatory jurisdiction mapping, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: site_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the regulated waste-generating facility. Determines which state environmental agency has jurisdiction and which state-specific RCRA regulations apply.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this waste generator profile was originated or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Enviance EHS, SAP S/4HANA EHS module, EPA RCRAInfo, Salesforce CRM, and Waste Logics.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS; SAP S/4HANA EHS; EPA RCRAInfo; Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics

attributes.name: source_system_profile_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier for this waste generator profile record in the originating operational system (e.g., Enviance EHS record ID, SAP EHS business partner number, or RCRAInfo handler ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS; SAP S/4HANA EHS; EPA RCRAInfo

attributes.name: state_permit_number
attributes.description: State-issued environmental permit or registration number for the waste-generating facility, assigned by the applicable State Environmental Quality Department. Required for state-level RCRA-authorized program compliance and may differ from the federal EPA Generator ID.
attributes.references: RCRA State Authorization 40 CFR Part 271; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: state_program_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the RCRA-authorized state program under which this generator is regulated. In RCRA-authorized states, the state program operates in lieu of the federal program; in non-authorized states, the EPA directly administers RCRA.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 271; EPA State Authorization

attributes.name: universal_waste_handler_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this generator is registered as a universal waste handler under 40 CFR Part 273, managing batteries, pesticides, mercury-containing equipment, or lamps under the streamlined universal waste rules rather than full RCRA hazardous waste requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 273; EPA Universal Waste Rule

products.name: sla_assignment
products.description: Associates specific Service Level Agreement (SLA) tiers to customer accounts and service enrollments, defining response time commitments, missed pickup resolution windows, complaint resolution targets, and container delivery lead times. Captures SLA tier name, applicable service types, response time targets (hours), escalation thresholds, penalty clauses for municipal contracts, effective date range, and SLA compliance tracking flag. Bridges customer commitments with operational execution standards across collection, billing, and customer service teams.

attributes.name: sla_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each SLA assignment record linking a customer account or service enrollment to a specific SLA tier.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service agreement or contract enrollment under which this SLA assignment is operative. Enables SLA tracking at the service-agreement level for multi-service accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (residential, commercial, industrial, or municipal) to which this SLA assignment applies. Links to the customer_account master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalize denormalized customer_segment STRING field to FK reference. SLA assignments should reference segment classification via FK to ensure SLA tiers align with authoritative segment definitions.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Waste Management representative who authorized and approved this SLA assignment. Required for municipal and hazardous waste contracts per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA Authorization Management; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA assignment was formally approved by the authorized Waste Management representative. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce CRM Contract Management

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for this SLA assignment, used in customer communications, contract documentation, and operational reporting. Sourced from Salesforce CRM or Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1 Service Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Management

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA assignment. Active indicates the SLA is in force; pending indicates awaiting approval or activation; suspended indicates temporarily paused; expired indicates the effective period has lapsed; terminated indicates the assignment was ended before expiry.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA assignment automatically renews upon reaching the effective end date without requiring a new approval workflow. Relevant for recurring residential and commercial service agreements.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Management; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: billing_dispute_resolution_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which a billing dispute raised by the customer must be investigated and resolved under this SLA tier. Tracked in Oracle Revenue Management and Salesforce CRM for Accounts Receivable (AR) compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP/IFRS; Salesforce CRM; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: complaint_resolution_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which a customer complaint must be resolved and closed under this SLA tier. Applies to customer service interactions logged in Salesforce CRM and tracked for NPS/CSAT impact.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: compliance_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether active SLA compliance monitoring and reporting is enabled for this assignment. When true, operational systems (AMCS, Locus Dispatch, Salesforce CRM) feed compliance metrics against this SLA's targets for KPI dashboards and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; NWRA KPI Reporting; Local Solid Waste Authority Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: container_delivery_lead_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days within which a new or replacement container must be delivered to the customer site after a confirmed service request, as committed under this SLA tier. Tracked in Waste Logics and AMCS Platform.
attributes.references: NWRA Container Management Standards; Waste Logics; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this SLA assignment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO/IEC 20000-1; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: diversion_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Minimum waste diversion rate (percentage of waste diverted from landfill through recycling or recovery) committed under this SLA for applicable recycling or sustainability-focused service agreements. Null if not applicable to this service type.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Diversion Guidelines; State Environmental Quality Departments; ISO 14001

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this SLA assignment expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended assignment with no scheduled end. Used for contract renewal tracking and compliance audits.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this SLA assignment becomes binding and operational. Used to determine whether the SLA applies to a given service event or complaint.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational escalation tier to which unresolved issues are routed when the escalation threshold is breached under this SLA (L1 = frontline supervisor, L2 = operations manager, L3 = regional director, executive = VP/C-suite for municipal contracts).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; Salesforce CRM; SWANA Municipal Contract Standards

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after which an unresolved service request or complaint is automatically escalated to a higher support tier or management under this SLA assignment. Drives automated escalation workflows in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; Salesforce CRM Escalation Rules; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA assignment covers hazardous waste handling services subject to RCRA, DOT, and EPA manifest requirements. When true, stricter response time targets and regulatory compliance tracking apply.
attributes.references: RCRA; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations; DOT 49 CFR; CERCLA

attributes.name: initial_response_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which the first acknowledgment or response to a customer service request or complaint must be delivered under this SLA tier. Distinct from full resolution time.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; Salesforce CRM; NWRA Service Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this SLA assignment record was most recently updated. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO/IEC 20000-1; Databricks Lakehouse CDC Standards

attributes.name: missed_pickup_resolution_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which a missed waste pickup must be resolved and rescheduled under this SLA tier. Core operational commitment tracked against actual resolution times in AMCS Platform and Locus Dispatch.
attributes.references: NWRA Service Standards; SWANA Best Practices; Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts

attributes.name: municipal_contract_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA assignment is associated with a government or municipal contract subject to Local Solid Waste Authority regulations, public reporting requirements, and enhanced penalty clauses.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts; SWANA Municipal Contract Standards; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for the next formal review of this SLA assignment. Calculated from the last review date plus the review cycle. Triggers account manager notifications in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; Salesforce CRM; NWRA Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, negotiated exceptions, or operational instructions associated with this SLA assignment. Used by account managers and operations teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: penalty_amount_per_breach
attributes.description: Fixed monetary penalty amount (in USD) assessed per SLA breach event when penalty clauses are applicable. Used in Oracle Revenue Management for credit memo generation and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS contract liability standards.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; Oracle Revenue Management; Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts

attributes.name: penalty_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative monetary penalty (in USD) that can be assessed against Waste Management under this SLA assignment within a defined period, as stipulated in the contract. Prevents unbounded financial exposure on municipal contracts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; Oracle Revenue Management; Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts

attributes.name: penalty_cap_period
attributes.description: The time period over which the penalty cap amount is measured and reset (monthly, quarterly, or annual). Aligns with contract billing cycles in Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: penalty_clause_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial penalty clauses are contractually applicable when SLA targets are breached under this assignment. Typically true for municipal government contracts governed by Local Solid Waste Authority agreements.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts; SWANA Municipal Contract Standards; GAAP/IFRS Contract Liability

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which SLA compliance performance reports are generated and delivered to the customer or regulatory authority under this assignment. Governs automated report scheduling in Oracle Revenue Management and Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authority Reporting Requirements; NWRA; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled reviews of this SLA assignment to assess performance, renegotiate targets, or update tier classification. Supports proactive contract management and customer retention workflows.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; Salesforce CRM Contract Management; NWRA Best Practices

attributes.name: service_availability_target_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of scheduled service events (pickups, deliveries) that must be completed on time within the measurement period under this SLA tier. For example, 98.50 means 98.5% on-time service completion is required.
attributes.references: NWRA Service Standards; SWANA Best Practices; Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The category of waste management service to which this SLA assignment applies. Determines which operational teams and response time targets are activated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential_collection|commercial_collection|recycling|landfill|hazardous_waste|waste_to_energy|container_delivery|bulk_pickup — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NWRA Service Classification; EPA Waste Management Guidelines; RCRA

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the SLA tier, used in system integrations, route management, and operational dispatching (e.g., STD, PREM, MUN, HAZ, EMG). Sourced from AMCS Platform and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: sla_tier_name
attributes.description: Named classification of the SLA tier assigned to this customer or service enrollment (e.g., Standard, Premium, Municipal, Hazardous, Emergency, Custom). Drives response time targets and escalation thresholds across collection, billing, and customer service operations.
attributes.references: NWRA Service Standards; SWANA Best Practices; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this SLA assignment record originated (e.g., Salesforce CRM for commercial contracts, SAP S/4HANA SD for billing-linked SLAs, Oracle Revenue Management for rate-linked SLAs, Waste Logics for portal-initiated assignments).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce CRM; Oracle Revenue Management; Waste Logics; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: source_system_sla_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this SLA assignment record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Contract ID, SAP SD Agreement Number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and lineage tracing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate this SLA assignment before the effective end date. Contractually binding for municipal and commercial accounts.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authority Contracts; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

products.name: complaint
products.description: Formal customer complaints requiring structured resolution workflows, distinct from general service requests. Captures complaint type (missed pickup, billing dispute, driver behavior, odor/noise, environmental concern, container damage), severity level, regulatory escalation flag (EPA/OSHA reportable), complaint source (phone, portal, social media, regulatory agency, legal), assigned resolution owner, resolution status, root cause code, and resolution timestamp. Supports regulatory response obligations, operational quality improvement, and customer retention management.

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each formal customer complaint record in the Waste Management complaint management system.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; Waste Logics Customer Portal

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific waste container (identified by CID) involved in the complaint, applicable for container damage, missed pickup, or contamination complaints.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Container Management; AMCS Platform CID Tracking

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: Customer complaints often trigger unscheduled compliance inspections by EPA, state environmental agencies, or local health departments. Linking complaints to resulting inspections enables response tra

attributes.name: contamination_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.contamination_event. Business justification: Customer complaints about rejected loads or contamination surcharges directly reference documented contamination events at MRF. Required for billing dispute resolution and customer education on materi

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Complaints frequently cite SLA breaches, service level violations, or billing disputes requiring contract term verification. Resolution workflows need agreement_id to validate customer entitlements, p

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that submitted or is associated with this complaint. Links to the customer_account master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: emergency_response_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.emergency_response_incident. Business justification: Customer complaints about spills, releases, or hazmat incidents must link to formal emergency response records for NRC reporting, regulatory investigation tracking, liability management, and correctiv

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or agent assigned as the primary responsible party for resolving this complaint. Drives accountability tracking, workload balancing, and resolution performance metrics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Owner; Workday HCM Employee Reference

attributes.name: enviance_incident_id
attributes.description: External system identifier for complaints that generated an environmental health and safety incident record in Enviance EHS, applicable for environmental concern and hazardous waste complaints requiring regulatory tracking.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS Incident Management; EPA Incident Reporting; OSHA 300 Log Requirements

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Complaints about odor, noise, dust, or environmental violations are often facility-specific (e.g., landfill odor complaints, MRF noise complaints). Regulatory agencies require facility attribution for

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating customer interaction (call, chat, portal submission) that generated this formal complaint, enabling traceability from first contact.

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Customers file complaints about specific landfill sites (odor, dust, traffic, environmental concerns). Regulatory agencies require complaint tracking by facility for permit compliance and community re

attributes.name: pickup_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.pickup_event. Business justification: Complaints about specific service events (contamination, property damage, missed lift, spillage) need to reference the exact pickup event for proof-of-service verification, RFID scan validation, photo

attributes.name: prior_complaint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous complaint record when repeat_complaint_flag is true, enabling complaint recurrence chain analysis and chronic service failure identification.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Related Case; SWANA Chronic Complaint Analysis

attributes.name: resolution_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Complaints (missed pickups, property damage, billing disputes) are routed to and resolved by specific operational units. Enables unit-level performance metrics, regulatory reporting to municipal autho

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection route associated with the complaint incident, enabling route-level quality analysis, driver accountability, and operational root cause investigation.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Management; Locus Dispatch Route Reference

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service address where the complaint-triggering event occurred, enabling geographic and route-level analysis.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Customer Portal; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Complaints about driver behavior, property damage, noise violations, or service quality are tied to specific vehicles reported by customers (license plate, unit number). Critical for fleet performance

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: Customer complaints about environmental impacts (odor, noise, spills, illegal dumping) can trigger regulatory investigations resulting in violation notices. Tracking complaint-to-violation linkage is

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the remediation or service recovery Work Order (WO) created to resolve the complaint, such as a re-collection dispatch or container replacement order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module Work Order; Infor EAM Work Order

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Community complaints about odor, emissions, noise, or environmental impacts from WTE facilities require facility linkage for regulatory agency response, permit compliance tracking, and community relat

attributes.name: assigned_team
attributes.description: Functional team responsible for complaint resolution. Environmental compliance team handles EPA/OSHA-reportable complaints; legal team handles complaints with litigation potential.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Queue; Enviance EHS Workflow Assignment

attributes.name: billing_dispute_amount_usd
attributes.description: Dollar amount in dispute for billing-related complaints. Populated only when complaint_type is billing_dispute. Used for accounts receivable (AR) adjustment tracking and revenue impact analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the complaint was formally closed after customer confirmation or timeout period. Distinct from resolved_timestamp as closure may follow resolution after a customer satisfaction confirmation window.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Closed Date; SWANA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: complaint_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the complaint in detail as reported by the customer or regulatory agency. Captures the full context of the issue including specific circumstances, locations, and impacts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Description; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: complaint_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable complaint reference number communicated to the customer and used in regulatory correspondence. Format: CMP-YYYY-NNNNNNN.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Number; NWRA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: complaint_source
attributes.description: Channel or origination point through which the complaint was received. Regulatory agency source indicates complaints filed directly by EPA, OSHA, DOT, or state environmental bodies requiring mandatory response timelines.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Origin; EPA Complaint Intake Procedures; RCRA §7002

attributes.name: complaint_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the complaint from initial receipt through resolution and closure. Drives SLA tracking and operational dashboards.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Status; SWANA Customer Service Guidelines

attributes.name: complaint_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the complaint subject matter. Missed pickup covers scheduled collection failures; billing dispute covers invoice or charge disagreements; driver behavior covers conduct or safety concerns; odor/noise covers nuisance impacts; environmental concern covers spills, leachate, or regulatory issues; container damage covers physical damage to customer containers.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Type; EPA Complaint Classification; RCRA Complaint Handling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when the complaint record was first created in the data platform. May differ from received_timestamp if there was a data entry lag.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Records Management

attributes.name: credit_amount_usd
attributes.description: Dollar value of the billing or service credit issued to the customer as resolution for the complaint. Populated only when credit_issued_flag is true. Feeds into revenue management and EBITDA impact reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: credit_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a billing credit or service credit was issued to the customer as part of the complaint resolution. Supports accounts receivable (AR) adjustment tracking and revenue impact reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Credit Memo; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Adjustment

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-resolution customer satisfaction score on a 1-5 scale collected via follow-up survey. Feeds into NPS (Net Promoter Score) and customer retention analytics. Null if survey not completed.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Survey; NWRA NPS Measurement Standards

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint was escalated internally beyond the initial assigned team (e.g., from customer service to operations management or legal). Distinct from regulatory_escalation_flag which tracks external regulatory body involvement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Escalation Rules; NWRA Escalation Management Standards

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why the complaint was escalated, capturing the business justification for escalation such as SLA breach, repeat complaint, high-value customer, or regulatory risk.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Escalation Reason; Enviance EHS Escalation Workflow

attributes.name: first_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer received the first substantive response to their complaint. Used to calculate first response time against SLA targets and regulatory response obligations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM First Response Time; NWRA Customer Service KPI Standards

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the underlying service failure or incident that prompted the complaint actually occurred. May differ from received_timestamp if the customer reported the issue after the fact.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Service Event Tracking; Enviance EHS Incident Date

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice or billing document number referenced in a billing dispute complaint. Enables direct linkage to the Oracle Revenue Management billing record for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Invoice Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Billing Document

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording the most recent update to the complaint record, supporting change tracking and data lineage for regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Records Management

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint record is subject to a legal hold, preventing deletion or modification of associated records. Set when litigation is threatened or initiated.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; CERCLA Litigation Hold Requirements; IFRS/GAAP Legal Contingency Disclosure

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the complaint was formally received and logged in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp used as the SLA clock start for all response time calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Created Date; NWRA SLA Standards; EPA Response Time Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Identifies the specific regulatory body involved when regulatory_escalation_flag is true. Determines applicable response timelines, reporting formats, and compliance obligations. LEA (Local Enforcement Agency) complaints are captured under local_enforcement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPA|OSHA|DOT|state_env_agency|local_enforcement|CERCLA|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement Response Policy; OSHA Complaint Handling Procedures; DOT Hazmat Regulations; RCRA; CERCLA

attributes.name: regulatory_escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint requires mandatory reporting or response to a regulatory body (EPA, OSHA, DOT, state environmental agency). When true, triggers regulatory response workflow with statutory deadlines.
attributes.references: EPA Complaint Response Requirements; RCRA §7002; CERCLA Reporting Obligations; Clean Air Act §304; Clean Water Act §505

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: External case or docket number assigned by the regulatory agency (EPA, OSHA, DOT) for tracking the complaint in their system. Required for regulatory correspondence and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Case Management System; OSHA Complaint Tracking; RCRA Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: repeat_complaint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint is a recurrence of a previously filed complaint for the same customer and same issue type within a rolling 90-day window. Repeat complaints trigger enhanced resolution workflows and root cause analysis requirements.
attributes.references: NWRA Customer Retention Standards; Salesforce CRM Duplicate Case Detection

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective action taken to resolve the complaint, such as re-collection dispatched, billing credit issued, driver counseling completed, or environmental remediation performed.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Resolution; Enviance EHS Corrective Action; ISO 14001 §10.2

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome classification of the complaint resolution. Resolved_accepted means customer confirmed satisfaction; resolved_rejected means customer disputed the resolution; referred_to_regulatory means the complaint was escalated to an external regulatory body for adjudication.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Resolution Code; NWRA Customer Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the complaint was marked as resolved, meaning the root cause was addressed and corrective action completed. Used to calculate total resolution time against SLA targets.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Closed Date; NWRA Resolution Time KPI; EPA Complaint Closure Requirements

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the underlying operational or systemic cause of the complaint (e.g., driver_error, route_planning_failure, equipment_malfunction, billing_system_error, weather_delay, container_overfill). Used for operational quality improvement and recurring issue analysis. The business actively manages these facility allocation agreements as operational contracts with specific tonnage commitments, pricing, allocation percentages, and priority routing rules that vary by customer-facility combination.

attributes.name: facility_allocation_agreement_id

attributes.name: customer_account_id

attributes.name: wte_facility_id

attributes.name: agreement_status

attributes.name: auto_renewal

attributes.name: contracted_annual_tonnage

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facility allocation agreement becomes active and waste routing begins under the contracted terms.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facility allocation agreement terminates. May be null for evergreen agreements or those with automatic renewal clauses.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the facility allocation agreement record was last updated.

attributes.name: minimum_monthly_tonnage

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Routing priority rank for this facility when the customer has multiple facility allocation agreements. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for waste routing decisions.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Contracted price per ton the customer pays for waste disposal at this WTE facility. May vary by customer tier, volume commitments, and contract negotiation.

attributes.name: waste_stream_allocation_percent

attributes.name: waste_type_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of waste stream types permitted or prohibited under this agreement based on facility capabilities and permit restrictions (e.g., 'MSW only, no hazardous', 'Commercial waste, no medical').

products.name: survey
products.description: Master reference table for survey. Referenced by survey_id.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Primary key for survey

attributes.name: actual_response_count
attributes.description: Current count of completed survey responses received. Updated as responses are submitted.

attributes.name: anonymous_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether respondent identity is captured (false) or kept anonymous (true). Anonymous surveys may improve response rates for sensitive topics.

attributes.name: consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consent must be obtained from respondents before they can participate in the survey, typically required for surveys collecting personal data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days that survey response data will be retained before archival or deletion, in accordance with data governance and privacy policies.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which the survey is distributed to respondents: email, SMS text message, customer web portal, mobile app, interactive voice response (IVR), paper mail, or in-person interview.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey closes and no longer accepts new responses. Null for surveys with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey becomes active and available for respondents to complete.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_minutes
attributes.description: Expected time in minutes for a respondent to complete the survey, used to set respondent expectations and improve response rates.

attributes.name: external_survey_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to this survey by the external survey platform or vendor system. Used for integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: incentive_description
attributes.description: Description of the incentive offered to survey respondents (e.g., '$10 account credit', 'Entry into monthly prize draw', '10% discount on next service'). Null if no incentive is offered.

attributes.name: incentive_offered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether respondents are offered an incentive (e.g., discount, gift card, prize entry) for completing the survey.

attributes.name: invitation_sent_count
attributes.description: Total number of survey invitations distributed to potential respondents.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that most recently modified the survey record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: max_reminder_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of reminder messages that will be sent to a non-respondent before ceasing outreach. Null if reminders are not enabled.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or operational notes about the survey.

attributes.name: privacy_notice_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether respondents are presented with a privacy notice explaining how their survey data will be used, stored, and protected.

attributes.name: question_count
attributes.description: Total number of questions included in the survey instrument.

attributes.name: reminder_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated reminder messages are sent to non-respondents to encourage survey completion.

attributes.name: reminder_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between automated reminder messages sent to non-respondents. Null if reminders are not enabled.

attributes.name: response_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of survey invitations that resulted in completed responses, calculated as (actual_response_count / invitation_sent_count) * 100.

attributes.name: response_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all questions in the survey require a response (true) or if some questions are optional (false).

attributes.name: survey_category
attributes.description: Categorization of the survey by its timing and trigger: transactional (post-service), relationship (periodic customer health check), event-triggered (after specific incident), periodic (scheduled intervals), or ad-hoc (one-time special purpose).

attributes.name: survey_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the survey in operational systems and reports (e.g., 'CSAT-Q1-2024', 'NPS-ANN').

attributes.name: survey_language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the survey is presented, using ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish, FRA for French).

attributes.name: survey_name

attributes.name: survey_owner

attributes.name: survey_platform
attributes.description: Name of the technology platform or tool used to administer the survey (e.g., 'Qualtrics', 'SurveyMonkey', 'Medallia', 'Salesforce Feedback Management', 'Custom Portal').

attributes.name: survey_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed business purpose and objectives of the survey, explaining what insights or decisions it is intended to support.

attributes.name: survey_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the survey: draft (being designed), active (accepting responses), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (closed to responses), archived (historical record), or cancelled (discontinued).

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Classification of the survey by its primary purpose: customer satisfaction (CSAT), net promoter score (NPS), service quality assessment, driver performance feedback, facility feedback, or complaint resolution follow-up.

attributes.name: survey_url
attributes.description: Web address (URL) where respondents can access and complete the survey online.

attributes.name: survey_version
attributes.description: Version number of the survey instrument, incremented when questions or structure are modified (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Enables tracking of survey changes over time.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: The intended respondent population for this survey: residential customers, commercial accounts, industrial clients, municipal contracts, all customer segments, or internal staff.

attributes.name: target_response_count
attributes.description: Desired number of completed survey responses needed to achieve statistical significance or business objectives.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the survey record.

attributes.name: revised_survey_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on survey (revised_survey_id)

attributes.name: program_name

attributes.description: Type of incentive or reward provided to the customer who makes the referral (the referrer).

attributes.name: parent_referral_program_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on referral_program (parent_referral_program_id)

domains.name: collection
domains.description: Core operational domain managing all waste collection, hauling, and transfer operations including residential/commercial pickup routes, transfer station consolidation, driver assignments, container placements, weight tickets, and outbound haul dispatch to disposal facilities.
domains.references: SWANA Collection Best Practices / DOT Hours of Service / AMCS Platform

products.name: route
products.description: Master record for a defined waste collection route, representing a named geographic sequence of stops assigned to a specific truck type (ASL, FEL, REL) and service line (MSW, C&D, bulk). Captures route code, district, zone, day-of-week schedule, estimated duration, total stops, total mileage, truck type requirement, service frequency, capacity constraints, and active status. Sourced from AMCS Platform route master. This is the canonical route definition — the template from which daily route executions are generated. One route may produce multiple executions per week depending on service frequency.

products.name: collection_stop
products.description: Master record for an individual service stop on a route, representing a physical service location (residential address or commercial site) with a defined sequence position. Captures stop sequence number, planned arrival window, estimated service duration, service address, customer account reference, container count, service type (curbside, alley, drive-in), access notes, CID/RFID tag identifiers for containers at this stop, special instructions (gate codes, back-up required), and stop status. Sourced from AMCS Platform and Waste Logics. SSOT for the stop-level service assignment and sequencing within a route.

products.name: pickup_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing the actual execution of a single waste pickup at a stop during a route execution, including container-level proof of service via RFID. Records timestamp of arrival, timestamp of service completion, driver ID, truck ID, container(s) serviced (by CID/RFID), RFID scan result (successful read, no read, damaged tag), lift confirmation from PTO sensor, waste stream type (MSW, recycling, C&D, bulk), estimated weight or lift count, GPS coordinates at time of service, compaction ratio recorded, and service outcome (completed, skipped, contaminated). Sourced from Locus Dispatch, Geotab telemetry, and AMCS Platform RFID readers. Core operational event of the collection domain — SSOT for both service execution and container-level proof-of-service.
