attributes.description: Unique identifier for this container placement record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

products.name: driver_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the assignment of a CDL-licensed driver to a specific route execution on a given service date. Records driver ID, route execution reference, truck ID, assignment type (primary, relief, trainee), shift start time, shift end time, pre-trip inspection status, DOT hours-of-service compliance flag, and assignment status (scheduled, active, completed, absent). Sourced from Locus Dispatch and Workday HCM. Enables driver performance tracking, DOT compliance, and route coverage management.

attributes.name: driver_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the driver assignment record. Primary key for this transactional entity capturing the assignment of a CDL-licensed driver to a specific route execution.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operations depot (facility) from which the driver and truck are dispatched for this route execution. Links to the facility master record.

attributes.name: hazwoper_training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.hazwoper_training. Business justification: Drivers assigned to hazmat collection routes must have current HAZWOPER certification per OSHA 1910.120. Links assignment to training verification for regulatory compliance and safety qualification.

attributes.name: observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_observation. Business justification: Safety observations are made on specific driver assignments during their shift. Observers need to link observations to the assignment context (route type, vehicle, shift conditions) for meaningful beh

attributes.name: primary_driver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the helper (second crew member) assigned to assist the driver on this route execution. Links to the workforce employee master record. Null if no helper assigned.

attributes.name: primary_driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Commercial Driver License (CDL) licensed driver assigned to execute the route. Links to the driver master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: route_execution_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific route execution instance that the driver is assigned to perform. Links to the route execution transactional record.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection vehicle (truck) assigned to the driver for this route execution. Links to the fleet asset master record.

attributes.name: absence_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for driver absence if assignment status is absent. Sick for illness, vacation for planned time off, personal for personal leave, injury for work-related injury, no_show for unexcused absence, other for miscellaneous reasons. Null if driver reported for duty.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the driver completed their shift and returned to the depot. Captured from Geotab Fleet Telematics GPS tracking or driver mobile app check-out. Used for performance analysis and variance reporting against scheduled end time.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the driver began their shift and commenced route execution. Captured from Geotab Fleet Telematics GPS tracking or driver mobile app check-in. Used for performance analysis and variance reporting against scheduled start time.

attributes.name: assignment_created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the dispatcher or system user who created this driver assignment record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: assignment_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this driver assignment record was first created in the Locus Dispatch system. Used for audit trail and assignment lead time analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the dispatcher or system user who last modified this driver assignment record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: assignment_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this driver assignment record was last modified in the Locus Dispatch system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and special instructions for the driver assignment. May include route-specific guidance, customer alerts, safety warnings, or equipment requirements.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the driver assignment, formatted as DA- followed by 10 digits. Used for operational tracking and communication.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification of the driver assignment indicating urgency and importance. Critical for time-sensitive routes or service level agreement (SLA) commitments, high for premium customers, normal for standard service, low for flexible/deferred routes.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the driver assignment. Scheduled indicates future planned assignment, active indicates driver is currently executing the route, completed indicates route execution finished, absent indicates driver did not report, cancelled indicates assignment was voided before execution.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the driver assignment indicating the role and responsibility level. Primary indicates regular assigned driver, relief indicates substitute coverage, trainee indicates driver under training supervision, backup indicates standby assignment, temporary indicates short-term fill-in.

attributes.name: cdl_class_required
attributes.description: The minimum Commercial Driver License (CDL) class required to operate the assigned truck and execute the route. Class A for combination vehicles over 26,001 lbs, Class B for single vehicles over 26,001 lbs, Class C for vehicles designed to transport 16+ passengers or hazardous materials.
attributes.references: DOT Commercial Driver License Standards 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: cdl_endorsements_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CDL endorsements required for the assignment. Common endorsements include H (Hazardous Materials), N (Tank Vehicle), P (Passenger), S (School Bus), T (Double/Triple Trailers). Empty if no special endorsements required.
attributes.references: DOT Commercial Driver License Standards 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: dispatch_sequence
attributes.description: The sequential order in which this driver assignment was dispatched from the depot on the service date. Used for operational tracking and first-out/last-in analysis.

attributes.name: dot_hos_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hours-of-Service (HOS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the driver assignment complies with DOT hours-of-service regulations at the time of assignment. True indicates the driver has sufficient available hours and rest periods to legally execute the route, false indicates a compliance violation or risk.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: estimated_route_duration_hours
attributes.description: The estimated total duration in hours required to complete the assigned route execution, including driving time, service stops, and breaks. Used for scheduling and DOT hours-of-service compliance planning.

attributes.name: helper_assigned_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a helper (second crew member) is assigned to assist the driver on this route execution. True indicates a two-person crew, false indicates solo driver operation. Common for residential rear-loader routes and heavy commercial pickups.

attributes.name: hos_available_drive_hours
attributes.description: The number of driving hours available to the driver under DOT hours-of-service regulations at the time of assignment. Calculated from the drivers electronic logging device (ELD) data and used to ensure compliance with the 11-hour driving limit.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: hos_available_duty_hours
attributes.description: The number of on-duty hours available to the driver under DOT hours-of-service regulations at the time of assignment. Calculated from the drivers electronic logging device (ELD) data and used to ensure compliance with the 14-hour on-duty limit.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: pre_trip_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of the mandatory pre-trip vehicle inspection conducted by the driver before route execution. Passed indicates inspection completed with no defects, failed indicates defects found requiring maintenance, pending indicates inspection not yet completed, not_required indicates inspection waived for specific assignment type, waived indicates management override.
attributes.references: DOT Vehicle Inspection Requirements 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: pre_trip_inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the pre-trip vehicle inspection was completed and recorded by the driver. Used for DOT compliance documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: DOT Vehicle Inspection Requirements 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route type that the driver is assigned to execute. Residential for curbside household collection, commercial for business waste pickup, roll_off for large container haul, recycling for materials recovery collection, hazardous for special waste handling.

attributes.name: service_area_code
attributes.description: Geographic service area code where the route is executed. Formatted as 2-3 letter region code followed by 3-digit zone number (e.g., NE-001, SW-042). Used for territory management and performance reporting.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the driver is assigned to execute the route. This is the business event date for the assignment and the primary date dimension for operational reporting.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: The scheduled timestamp when the driver is expected to complete their shift and return to the depot. Used for workforce scheduling and DOT hours-of-service compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: The scheduled timestamp when the driver is expected to begin their shift and commence route execution. Used for workforce scheduling and Department of Transportation (DOT) hours-of-service compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this driver assignment record. Locus_dispatch for automated dispatch assignments, workday_hcm for workforce management initiated assignments, manual_entry for dispatcher-created assignments.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique record identifier from the source operational system (Locus Dispatch or Workday HCM). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation with source systems.

products.name: truck_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the assignment of a specific collection vehicle (ASL, FEL, REL, roll-off, CNG/RNG unit) to a route execution on a given service date. Records vehicle ID, route execution reference, truck type, fuel type (diesel, CNG, RNG), odometer at assignment, pre-trip inspection pass/fail, assigned capacity (cubic yards), and assignment status. Sourced from AMCS Platform and Geotab Fleet Telematics. Distinct from driver_assignment — a truck and driver are assigned independently and may change mid-route.
products.reference: AMCS Vehicle Assignment / Geotab Asset Assignment

attributes.name: truck_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the truck assignment record. Primary key for this transactional entity capturing the assignment of a collection vehicle to a route execution on a specific service date.

attributes.name: fuel_purchase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.fuel_purchase. Business justification: Truck assignments determine which vehicle consumed fuel on which date. Fleet managers reconcile fuel purchases against assignments to detect unauthorized usage, validate fuel efficiency by vehicle, an

attributes.name: primary_truck_dispatch_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or yard from which the truck was dispatched for this route execution. Typically a collection operations center, transfer station, or regional depot.

attributes.name: route_execution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific route execution instance that this truck is assigned to perform. Links to the route_execution transactional record.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection vehicle (truck) assigned to this route execution. Links to the fleet vehicle master record.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the truck completed the route execution and returned to the facility or disposal site. Captured from Geotab GPS tracking or driver mobile app check-out.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the truck departed the facility or yard to begin route execution. Captured from Geotab GPS tracking or driver mobile app check-in.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for this truck assignment, typically formatted as a combination of date, route, and sequence number for operational tracking and dispatch communication.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification for this truck assignment. Emergency assignments for service failures or complaints; special event for large-scale temporary collections; routine for standard scheduled service.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the truck assignment. Tracks progression from initial scheduling through dispatch, execution, and completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the truck was assigned to the route execution. Represents the business event time when dispatch confirmed the vehicle-to-route pairing.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the truck assignment was cancelled before or during execution. Captures operational context for weather delays, vehicle failures, route cancellations, or customer service suspensions.

attributes.name: capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Rated capacity of the assigned truck in cubic yards. Represents the maximum volume of waste the vehicle can carry per load, used for route optimization and load planning.

attributes.name: capacity_tons
attributes.description: Rated weight capacity of the assigned truck in tons. Represents the maximum weight the vehicle can legally and safely carry, constrained by DOT regulations and vehicle GVWR.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this truck assignment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation, distinct from the business assignment timestamp.

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental incident occurred during this truck assignment. True if a spill, leak, unauthorized discharge, or EPA-reportable event was logged during route execution.
attributes.references: EPA CERCLA and RCRA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel or energy source for the assigned vehicle. CNG (Compressed Natural Gas), RNG (Renewable Natural Gas), diesel, electric, or hybrid powertrain. Critical for sustainability reporting and GHG emissions tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Fuel Standards

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time GPS tracking was active for this truck assignment. True if Geotab telematics was operational and transmitting location data during route execution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this truck assignment record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking updates to assignment status, times, or other attributes throughout the assignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments related to this truck assignment. Captures dispatcher instructions, driver feedback, route conditions, or any contextual information relevant to the assignment execution.

attributes.name: odometer_end
attributes.description: Odometer reading in miles at the time the truck completed the route execution and returned. Used to calculate route mileage and update vehicle lifecycle metrics.

attributes.name: odometer_start
attributes.description: Odometer reading in miles at the time the truck was assigned and departed for route execution. Used for mileage tracking, fuel efficiency analysis, and preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: post_trip_inspection_status
attributes.description: Result of the post-trip vehicle inspection performed after route completion. Identifies any defects or maintenance needs discovered during route execution.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations 396.11

attributes.name: post_trip_inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the post-trip inspection was completed. Used for maintenance work order generation and fleet safety tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations 396.11

attributes.name: pre_trip_inspection_status
attributes.description: Result of the mandatory DOT pre-trip vehicle inspection performed before route execution. Pass indicates vehicle is safe for operation; fail or conditional requires maintenance intervention before dispatch.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations 396.13

attributes.name: pre_trip_inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pre-trip inspection was completed. Required for DOT compliance documentation and OSHA safety audit trails.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations 396.13

attributes.name: reassignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the truck was reassigned during route execution. Captures operational context for vehicle breakdowns, driver changes, route adjustments, or emergency redeployment.

attributes.name: route_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the truck deviated from the planned route during execution. True if GPS tracking detected significant off-route travel, triggering operational review or customer service follow-up.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety incident occurred during this truck assignment. True if an accident, injury, near-miss, or OSHA-reportable event was logged during route execution.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the truck is scheduled to begin the route execution. Used for dispatch planning and driver coordination.

attributes.name: truck_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collection vehicle by body configuration and loading mechanism. ASL (Automated Side Loader), FEL (Front End Loader), REL (Rear End Loader), roll-off for container hauling, compactor for transfer operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASL|FEL|REL|roll_off|compactor|hook_lift|grapple|flatbed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: service_schedule
products.description: Master record defining the recurring service schedule for a customer stop — the days of week, frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, on-call), effective date range, and service windows. Captures customer account reference, stop reference, service frequency code, scheduled days of week, start date, end date, holiday handling rule, and schedule status. Sourced from Waste Logics and AMCS Platform. SSOT for when a customer is supposed to receive service — distinct from route_stop_sequence which defines the order within a route.
products.reference: Waste Logics Service Schedule / AMCS Service Frequency

attributes.name: service_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: collection_stop_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection stop associated with this schedule. Links to the stop master record.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Service schedules track which employee created them for audit trail, training assessment, and accountability in customer service setup—complements modified_by_user for change tracking.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owns this service schedule. Links to the customer account master record.

attributes.name: frequency_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.frequency_plan. Business justification: Schedules reference standardized frequency plans (weekly, bi-weekly, on-demand) for consistent service delivery. Critical for route optimization, capacity planning, customer contract fulfillment, and

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Service schedules define recurring delivery of specific offerings to customers. Essential for subscription management, automated billing, contract fulfillment tracking, and service level agreement enf

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service address where collection occurs. Links to the service address master record.

attributes.name: sla_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA governing this service schedule. Defines performance commitments, response times, and service guarantees.

attributes.name: access_requirements
attributes.description: Special access conditions required to service this stop. Used for driver preparation and route planning.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule automatically renews at the end of its term. True if the schedule continues indefinitely unless cancelled.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the customer is billed for this scheduled service. May differ from service frequency.

attributes.name: container_quantity
attributes.description: Number of containers serviced at this stop per scheduled pickup. Used for capacity planning and billing calculations.

attributes.name: container_size
attributes.description: Capacity of the container in cubic yards or gallons, depending on container type. Used for capacity planning and billing.

attributes.name: container_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the container size. Standardizes capacity reporting across different container types.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of waste container used for this scheduled service. Determines collection equipment and handling procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cart|bin|dumpster|compactor|roll_off|bag|toter — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this service schedule expires or is terminated. Nullable for open-ended schedules. Marks the end of the schedule validity period.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this service schedule becomes active and service delivery begins. Marks the beginning of the schedule validity period.

attributes.name: external_schedule_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier from the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: friday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Fridays. True if Friday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: holiday_handling_rule
attributes.description: Defines how service is adjusted when a scheduled day falls on a recognized holiday. Determines whether service is skipped, rescheduled, or delivered as normal.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service schedule record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: monday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Mondays. True if Monday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for service delivery. High and critical priorities receive preferential routing and must-complete status.

attributes.name: route_assignment_method
attributes.description: Method used to assign this schedule to collection routes. Fixed schedules are always on the same route; dynamic schedules are optimized daily.

attributes.name: saturday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Saturdays. True if Saturday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the service schedule. Human-readable code used in operations and customer communications.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service schedule. Determines whether the schedule is operational and service should be delivered.

attributes.name: service_window_end_time
attributes.description: Latest time of day when service can be performed at this stop. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Used for route optimization and customer expectations.

attributes.name: service_window_start_time
attributes.description: Earliest time of day when service can be performed at this stop. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Used for route optimization and customer expectations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system that originated this service schedule record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, access instructions, safety requirements, or customer-specific handling procedures. Displayed to drivers and dispatchers.

attributes.name: sunday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Sundays. True if Sunday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the schedule is suspended. Populated only when schedule_status is suspended. Used for customer service and reactivation workflows.

attributes.name: thursday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Thursdays. True if Thursday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: tuesday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Tuesdays. True if Tuesday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: waste_stream
attributes.description: Classification of the waste material being collected. Determines disposal routing, processing requirements, and regulatory compliance obligations. MSW = Municipal Solid Waste, C&D = Construction and Demolition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msw|recycling|organics|yard_waste|construction_demolition|hazardous|special — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wednesday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Wednesdays. True if Wednesday is a scheduled service day.

products.name: route_optimization_run
products.description: Transactional record capturing each execution of the route optimization algorithm in AMCS Platform, including the optimization scenario (daily re-optimization, seasonal rebalancing, new customer onboarding), input parameters (number of stops, truck count, time windows, vehicle capacities), optimization objectives (minimize miles, minimize time, maximize compaction), output metrics (total route miles, total route hours, stops per truck), and whether the optimized plan was accepted or rejected. Sourced from AMCS Platform. Enables optimization performance tracking and scenario comparison.

attributes.name: route_optimization_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each execution of the route optimization algorithm. Primary key.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service area for which this optimization was executed.

attributes.name: carbon_initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_initiative. Business justification: Route optimization directly supports carbon reduction initiatives through mileage reduction and fuel efficiency. Linking optimization runs to initiatives enables ROI measurement, carbon credit validat

attributes.name: primary_route_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (operations manager or dispatcher) who made the acceptance decision. Nullable if decision is still pending.

attributes.name: acceptance_decision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the optimized route plan was accepted for deployment (accepted), rejected by operations (rejected), awaiting management review (pending_review), or partially implemented (partially_accepted).

attributes.name: acceptance_decision_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the acceptance decision was made. Nullable if decision is still pending.

attributes.name: algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version number of the route optimization algorithm used for this run, formatted as major.minor.patch (e.g., 3.2.1).

attributes.name: baseline_total_miles
attributes.description: Total route miles from the previous or baseline plan, used for comparison to measure optimization improvement. Nullable if no baseline exists.

attributes.name: configuration_profile_code
attributes.description: Reference to the optimization configuration profile (parameter set) used for this run, defining weights, constraints, and objectives.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this optimization run record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The target date for which the optimized routes were planned. This is the date the routes are intended to be executed in the field.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error or exception message if the optimization run failed or encountered issues. Nullable if run completed successfully.

attributes.name: execution_mode
attributes.description: Indicates how the optimization run was initiated: manual (user-triggered), scheduled (automated on schedule), automatic (event-driven), or api_triggered (external system integration).

attributes.name: input_driver_count
attributes.description: Total number of drivers available and included as input to the optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: input_stop_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer stops (service locations) included as input to the optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: input_truck_count
attributes.description: Total number of collection vehicles (trucks) available and included as input to the optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this optimization run record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: miles_improvement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage reduction in total route miles compared to the baseline plan. Positive values indicate improvement (fewer miles). Nullable if no baseline exists.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by operations staff regarding this optimization run, such as special considerations, manual adjustments, or business context.

attributes.name: optimization_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds for the optimization algorithm to complete execution.

attributes.name: optimization_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the optimization algorithm execution completed or terminated.

attributes.name: optimization_quality_score
attributes.description: Algorithm-generated quality score (0-100) indicating how well the optimized solution meets the defined objectives and constraints. Higher scores indicate better optimization results.

attributes.name: optimization_run_number
attributes.description: Business-friendly identifier for the optimization run, typically formatted as OPT-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS for traceability.

attributes.name: optimization_scenario_type
attributes.description: The business scenario or trigger that initiated this optimization run, such as daily re-optimization, seasonal rebalancing, new customer onboarding, emergency reroute, capacity expansion, or service area change.

attributes.name: optimization_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the optimization algorithm execution began.

attributes.name: optimization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the optimization run: queued (awaiting execution), running (in progress), completed (successfully finished), failed (encountered errors), cancelled (manually stopped), or partially_accepted (some routes accepted, others rejected).

attributes.name: output_average_hours_per_route
attributes.description: Average estimated time in hours per route in the optimized plan.

attributes.name: output_average_miles_per_route
attributes.description: Average distance in miles per route in the optimized plan.

attributes.name: output_average_stops_per_route
attributes.description: Average number of customer stops per route in the optimized plan.

attributes.name: output_route_count
attributes.description: Total number of optimized routes generated by the algorithm as output.

attributes.name: output_total_route_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated time in hours across all optimized routes, including drive time, service time, and breaks.

attributes.name: output_total_route_miles
attributes.description: Total distance in miles across all optimized routes generated by the algorithm.

attributes.name: output_unassigned_stop_count
attributes.description: Number of customer stops that could not be assigned to any route due to constraints (capacity, time windows, or other limitations).

attributes.name: primary_optimization_objective
attributes.description: The primary business objective the optimization algorithm was configured to achieve: minimize total route miles, minimize total route time, maximize compaction efficiency, balance workload across drivers, minimize operational cost, or maximize service quality.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by operations when the optimized plan was rejected or partially accepted. Nullable if plan was fully accepted or decision is pending.

attributes.name: secondary_optimization_objective
attributes.description: The secondary business objective applied as a tie-breaker or secondary goal when the primary objective is met. Nullable if only one objective was used.

attributes.name: time_window_enforcement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer-specific time window constraints were enforced during optimization (True) or relaxed (False).

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vehicle capacity constraints (weight and volume limits) were enforced during optimization (True) or relaxed (False).

products.name: district
products.description: Master reference entity defining the geographic collection districts and zones used to organize route planning and operational management. Captures district code, district name, zone code, municipality or jurisdiction, geographic boundary description, service type supported (residential, commercial, C&D), assigned operations manager, and active status. Sourced from AMCS Platform geographic configuration. Enables geographic reporting, district-level performance management, and regulatory jurisdiction alignment.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Primary key for district

attributes.name: district_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the operations manager assigned to this district. References employee master data.

attributes.name: district_operations_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the depot or yard facility that services this district. References facility master data.

attributes.name: reduction_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.reduction_target. Business justification: Collection districts are operational units for carbon reduction target setting. District-level targets (e.g., 20% emission reduction by 2030) require linking to corporate sustainability targets for ca

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the primary transfer station where collected waste from this district is consolidated before outbound haul. References facility master data.

attributes.name: area_square_miles

attributes.name: service_area_code

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: tare_weight_lbs

attributes.name: ticket_number

attributes.name: ticket_status

attributes.name: weigh_out_timestamp

products.name: container_rfid_scan
products.description: Transactional record capturing each RFID tag scan event for a container during collection operations — recording proof of service at the container level. Captures CID (Container Identification number), RFID tag ID, scan timestamp, GPS coordinates at scan, truck ID, route execution reference, stop reference, scan result (successful read, no read, damaged tag), and lift confirmation flag from PTO sensor. Sourced from AMCS Platform RFID readers and Geotab PTO data. Enables container-level proof-of-service, SLA compliance, and container utilization tracking.

attributes.name: container_rfid_scan_id

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the container master record that was scanned during collection operations.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the driver who was operating the collection vehicle at the time of the RFID scan event.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: The unique hexadecimal identifier encoded in the RFID tag chip. This is the raw tag serial number read by the RFID scanner hardware.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the collection vehicle that performed the RFID scan and container service.

attributes.name: billing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether this scan event qualifies for billing based on service completion, lift confirmation, and contract terms. True indicates billable service.

attributes.name: cid
attributes.description: The unique Container Identification Number physically marked on the container and encoded in the RFID tag. Industry-standard identifier for tracking individual containers across collection operations.

attributes.name: container_size_gallons
attributes.description: The volumetric capacity of the scanned container measured in gallons. Captured to support service billing verification and capacity planning.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: The physical type of container that was scanned. Captured at scan time to support container type verification and service validation.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score from 0.00 to 1.00 representing the overall quality and completeness of this scan record based on signal strength, GPS accuracy, and data completeness. Higher scores indicate higher quality data.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: A code indicating any service exception or issue encountered during the scan event. Used for operational troubleshooting and customer communication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|contamination|blocked_access|overweight|damaged_container|missed_scan|weather_delay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exception_notes

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: The estimated accuracy of the GPS coordinates in meters. Lower values indicate higher precision of the location data captured during the scan event.

attributes.name: gps_latitude

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate captured at the moment of the RFID scan, providing precise location verification of the service event.

attributes.name: lift_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator confirming whether the container was physically lifted and emptied based on PTO (Power Take-Off) sensor data correlated with the RFID scan event. True indicates confirmed service completion.

attributes.name: proof_of_service_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator confirming this scan event serves as valid proof of service delivery for customer SLA and dispute resolution purposes. True indicates verified service completion.

attributes.name: pto_activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the vehicle PTO system was activated to lift and empty the container. Used to correlate RFID scan with physical service completion.

attributes.name: reader_device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the RFID reader hardware device that captured this scan. Used for device performance tracking and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: reader_firmware_version

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this RFID scan record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks data refresh cycles and correction events.

attributes.name: scan_date
attributes.description: The calendar date of the RFID scan event, derived from scan_timestamp for simplified date-based reporting and partitioning.

attributes.name: scan_result_status
attributes.description: The outcome status of the RFID scan attempt indicating whether the tag was successfully read or if any issues occurred during the scan operation.

attributes.name: scan_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated and transmitted this RFID scan record. Identifies the data lineage and integration source.

attributes.name: scan_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the RFID tag was scanned by the collection vehicle reader. Represents the proof-of-service event time for this container.

attributes.name: scheduled_service_time
attributes.description: The planned timestamp for servicing this container based on the route schedule. Used to calculate service timeliness and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The category of waste collection service being performed at the time of the scan. Distinguishes between residential, commercial, and other service classifications.

attributes.name: service_variance_minutes
attributes.description: The difference in minutes between the scheduled service time and actual scan timestamp. Positive values indicate late service, negative values indicate early service.

attributes.name: signal_strength
attributes.description: The radio frequency signal strength measured in decibels-milliwatts (dBm) at the time of the scan. Indicates the quality of the RFID tag read and can help diagnose tag or reader issues.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether this scan event occurred within the contracted service window defined in the customer SLA. True indicates on-time service delivery.

attributes.name: source_system_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this scan record was created in the originating operational system (AMCS or Geotab). Used to measure data latency and support data reconciliation.

attributes.name: truck_number
attributes.description: The human-readable fleet identification number of the collection vehicle that performed the scan. Used for operational reporting and driver communication.

attributes.name: waste_stream_type
attributes.description: The category of waste material collected from this container. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste), recycling, organics, or other specialized waste streams.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this load ticket record. Completed tickets are eligible for billing; voided tickets are excluded from revenue reporting.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total tipping fee charged for this load (net weight multiplied by tipping fee rate). Primary revenue component for transfer station operations.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_rate
attributes.description: Per-ton disposal fee rate applied to this load based on waste stream type, customer contract, and jurisdiction. Expressed in currency per ton.

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total billable amount for this load including tipping fees, environmental fees, and any additional charges. Used for invoice generation.

attributes.name: waste_characterization_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the waste stream type and material composition: visual inspection, manifest declaration, physical sampling, customer declaration, or default profile.

attributes.name: waste_origin_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Municipality, county, or jurisdiction where the waste was collected. Required for regulatory reporting and flow control compliance.
attributes.references: State Solid Waste Flow Control Regulations

attributes.name: weigh_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loaded vehicle was weighed at the inbound scale. Primary transaction timestamp for this load ticket.

attributes.name: weigh_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the empty vehicle was weighed at the outbound scale after unloading. Used to calculate tare weight and cycle time.

products.name: scale_transaction
products.description: Detailed scale house weighing transaction record capturing each individual scale event at the transfer station. Records scale ID, transaction timestamp, vehicle plate/CID, gross weight, tare weight, net weight (tons), scale operator, weighmaster certification reference, scale calibration record reference, transaction type (inbound, outbound, tare-only), and associated load ticket ID. Supports regulatory weighmaster compliance and audit trail for tipping fee disputes. Sourced from AMCS Platform scale integration.

attributes.name: scale_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the scale transaction record. Primary key for the scale transaction entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer account associated with this scale transaction. Used for billing and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: diversion_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.diversion_record. Business justification: Scale transactions at MRFs and transfer stations document material sorting outcomes. Diversion rate calculation and material flow analysis require transaction-to-pathway linkage for sustainability rep

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver operating the vehicle during the scale transaction.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the scale house operator who recorded the transaction. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer station or disposal facility where the scale transaction occurred.

attributes.name: load_ticket_id
attributes.description: Associated load ticket identifier linking this scale transaction to the broader load documentation. Used for cross-referencing with dispatch and billing records.

attributes.name: route_execution_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the route execution associated with this scale transaction, if the load originated from a collection route.

attributes.name: scale_equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the scale equipment used for this transaction. Links to the specific scale house weighing system.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle being weighed. Links to the fleet vehicle master record.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: Date when the scale transaction was included in customer billing. Used for revenue recognition and accounts receivable tracking.

attributes.name: cid
attributes.description: Container Identification number for the container being weighed, if applicable. Used for tracking specific container loads.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes recorded by the scale operator regarding special circumstances, observations, or instructions related to the transaction.

attributes.name: contamination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the load was flagged for contamination. True indicates contamination detected, False indicates clean load.

attributes.name: contamination_type
attributes.description: Description of the type of contamination detected in the load, if applicable. Examples include hazardous materials, prohibited items, or cross-contamination of waste streams.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scale transaction record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the tipping fee amount. Typically USD for US operations, CAD for Canadian operations, MXN for Mexican operations.

attributes.name: disposal_authorization_number
attributes.description: Authorization or permit number allowing disposal of the waste at this facility. Required for certain waste types and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gross_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of the vehicle and load combined, measured in pounds. Captured during the first weighing event.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number associated with this scale transaction for billing purposes. Links the transaction to the customer billing record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scale transaction record was last updated in the data platform. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Classification of the load source. Indicates whether the load originated from collection routes, transfer operations, commercial customers, residential service, rolloff containers, or special waste handling.

attributes.name: manifest_number
attributes.description: Hazardous waste manifest tracking document number, if applicable. Required for RCRA-regulated hazardous waste shipments.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific material type within the waste stream. Provides granular classification for disposal and recycling operations.

attributes.name: net_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Net weight of the load only, calculated as gross weight minus tare weight, measured in pounds.

attributes.name: net_weight_tons
attributes.description: Net weight of the load converted to tons. Primary unit for billing, reporting, and regulatory compliance. Calculated as net_weight_lbs divided by 2000.

attributes.name: rejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the load was rejected and not accepted for disposal. True indicates rejected load, False indicates accepted load.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the load was rejected, if applicable. Includes reasons such as contamination, unauthorized waste type, or facility capacity constraints.

attributes.name: scale_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent scale calibration prior to this transaction. Used to verify measurement validity and compliance with calibration frequency requirements.

attributes.name: scale_calibration_record_number
attributes.description: Reference to the most recent scale calibration record at the time of transaction. Ensures measurement accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that generated this scale transaction record. Typically AMCS Platform scale integration module.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this record in the source system. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation with operational systems.

attributes.name: tare_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Weight of the empty vehicle without load, measured in pounds. Used to calculate net payload weight.

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique scale ticket number assigned to this weighing transaction. Used for customer communication, dispute resolution, and audit trail.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total tipping fee charged for this transaction, calculated as net weight in tons multiplied by the tipping fee rate.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_rate
attributes.description: Rate charged per ton for waste disposal at the facility. Used to calculate the tipping fee amount for billing.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Business date of the scale transaction. Used for daily reporting, billing cycles, and operational analytics.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scale transaction. Tracks whether the transaction is completed, pending validation, voided, under dispute, corrected, or rejected.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scale transaction was recorded. Primary business event timestamp for the weighing event.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of scale transaction. Inbound indicates waste arriving at facility, outbound indicates waste leaving facility, tare-only captures vehicle weight without load, reweigh indicates a correction transaction.

attributes.name: validation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale transaction has been validated and approved for billing. True indicates validated, False indicates pending validation or rejected.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Notes recorded during the validation process. Captures reasons for rejection, corrections made, or special circumstances requiring review.

attributes.name: vehicle_plate_number
attributes.description: License plate number of the vehicle being weighed. Used for manual verification and cross-reference.

attributes.name: waste_stream_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of waste material being weighed. Examples include MSW (Municipal Solid Waste), C&D (Construction and Demolition), recyclables, organics, hazardous waste.

attributes.name: weighmaster_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification number of the licensed weighmaster who validated the transaction. Required for regulatory compliance in jurisdictions with weighmaster certification requirements.

products.name: tipping_fee_rate
products.description: Reference table defining tipping fee rate schedules applied at each transfer station. Captures rate ID, transfer station reference, waste stream type (MSW, C&D, special waste, hazardous), customer segment (residential, commercial, municipal, self-haul), rate per ton, minimum charge, effective date, expiration date, rate basis (per ton, per load, per yard), regulatory rate cap reference, and approval status. Used by SAP SD and Oracle Revenue Management for tipping fee invoice generation. Distinct from billing domain rate schedules — this is the operational rate reference owned by transfer operations.
products.reference: Tipping Fee Schedule / SAP SD Condition Record

attributes.name: tipping_fee_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tipping fee rate record. Primary key.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Tipping fee rates are subject to permit conditions and regulatory rate caps established by permitting authorities. Permits define maximum allowable rates and rate adjustment procedures.

attributes.name: primary_tipping_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this tipping fee rate. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_tipping_fee_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new rate that replaces this rate when status is superseded. Nullable for active rates. Maintains rate version history.

attributes.name: tertiary_tipping_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this tipping fee rate record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer station where this tipping fee rate applies. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the rate. Tracks regulatory or management approval process before rate activation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tipping fee rate was approved. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: contamination_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Additional fee per ton charged for contaminated loads that do not meet material stream specifications. Nullable if no contamination penalty applies.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Control Standard, EPA Waste Classification

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the service agreement or contract that defines this rate. Nullable for standard published rates not tied to specific contracts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tipping fee rate record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this rate record.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer classification this rate applies to. Determines pricing tier and service level agreements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this tipping fee rate becomes active and applicable for billing. Start of the rate validity period.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Validity, Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: environmental_fee
attributes.description: Additional environmental surcharge per ton applied on top of base tipping fee. Used for environmental compliance and remediation programs.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Department, EPA Compliance

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this tipping fee rate ceases to be active. Nullable for open-ended rates. End of the rate validity period.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Validity, Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fuel surcharge can be applied to this rate. True if fuel surcharge is allowed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tipping fee rate record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: Minimum tipping fee charged regardless of tonnage. Applied when calculated tonnage-based fee falls below this threshold. Expressed in local currency.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing, Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to base rate for special circumstances. Positive for surcharges, negative for discounts. Nullable if no adjustment applies.

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: Unit of measure for rate calculation. Determines how the tipping fee is computed and applied to weight tickets.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the tipping fee rate schedule. Used for rate lookup and billing system integration.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rate Management, Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the tipping fee rate schedule. Human-readable identifier used in billing and reporting.

attributes.name: rate_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, terms, conditions, or special instructions related to this tipping fee rate. Free-text field for operational guidance.

attributes.name: rate_per_ton
attributes.description: Tipping fee charged per ton of waste disposed. Primary pricing metric for tonnage-based billing. Expressed in local currency.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing, Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tipping fee rate. Controls whether the rate can be applied to new transactions.

attributes.name: rate_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for this rate. Used for rate card segmentation and pricing strategy analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or local enforcement agency that governs this rate. Used for compliance tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: Local Enforcement Agency (LEA), State Environmental Quality Department

attributes.name: regulatory_rate_cap
attributes.description: Maximum tipping fee allowed by local regulatory authority. Nullable if no cap applies. Ensures compliance with local solid waste authority rate limits.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authority Regulations, State Environmental Quality Department

attributes.name: seasonal_rate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a seasonal rate with time-limited applicability. True for seasonal rates, False for year-round rates.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated this tipping fee rate. SAP_SD = SAP Sales and Distribution, ORACLE_RM = Oracle Revenue Management.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this rate record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is exempt from sales tax. True for tax-exempt customers such as government entities, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption Guidelines, State Tax Regulations

attributes.name: volume_discount_rate_per_ton
attributes.description: Discounted rate per ton applied when volume threshold is exceeded. Nullable if no volume discount applies.

attributes.name: volume_discount_threshold_tons
attributes.description: Minimum tonnage required to qualify for volume-based discount pricing. Nullable if no volume discount applies.

attributes.name: waste_stream_type
attributes.description: Type of waste material this rate applies to. MSW = Municipal Solid Waste, C&D = Construction and Demolition Waste. Determines applicable disposal regulations and handling requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Classification Standards, RCRA Waste Categories

products.name: outbound_haul
products.description: Outbound haul assignment and manifest record dispatching consolidated waste loads from the transfer station to a destination facility (landfill, MRF, WTE, TSDF). Captures haul ID, transfer station origin, destination facility type and ID, assigned transfer trailer/vehicle, driver assignment, scheduled and actual departure datetimes, estimated arrival, waste stream type, estimated tonnage, BOL number, manifest number (if hazardous), waste classification codes (EPA/RCRA), seal numbers, carrier DOT number, chain-of-custody signatures, haul contractor reference, and haul status (scheduled, in-transit, delivered, rejected). Core operational record bridging transfer to landfill/recycling/energy domains. Supports DOT compliance on all outbound loads and RCRA manifest requirements for special/hazardous waste streams.

attributes.name: outbound_haul_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the outbound haul assignment record. Primary key for tracking consolidated waste loads dispatched from transfer stations to destination facilities.

attributes.name: destination_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination facility receiving the outbound haul load (landfill, MRF, WTE, or TSDF).

attributes.name: disposal_landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Outbound hauls from transfer stations to landfills need direct landfill site FK (destination_facility_id is generic facility reference) for landfill-specific logistics, capacity coordination, and wast

attributes.name: disposal_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.disposal_purchase_order. Business justification: Outbound hauls execute against disposal purchase orders. Operations tracks haul performance (tonnage, timing, costs) against PO terms for contract compliance and vendor performance management. Procure

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver assigned to execute the outbound haul transport.

attributes.name: hauler_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the third-party hauling contractor if the haul is subcontracted. Null if performed by internal fleet.

attributes.name: hauling_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.hauling_agreement. Business justification: Outbound hauls execute third-party hauling agreements for transfer station-to-disposal transport. Hauling cost reconciliation, carrier performance tracking, and agreement compliance verification requi

attributes.name: hazmat_manifest_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.manifest. Business justification: Outbound hauls from transfer stations to TSDF facilities require manifests for hazardous waste. Role-prefixed to distinguish from internal tracking; removes denormalized manifest_number text field.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Outbound hauls involve highway transport of large loads with distinct safety risks (load securement, traffic accidents, rollover). Incident linkage is essential for carrier safety management, DOT comp

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Outbound hauls must comply with transportation permits and manifest requirements for waste movement between facilities. Permits authorize specific waste types and destination facilities for haul opera

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Outbound hauls from transfer stations to disposal facilities need supervisor coordination for scheduling, manifesting, carrier management, and load rejection handling.

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer station origin facility where consolidated waste is loaded for outbound transport.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer trailer or vehicle assigned to transport the outbound haul load.

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Outbound hauls from transfer stations to WTE facilities are core waste-to-energy supply chain operations. Enables WTE feedstock logistics tracking, haul cost allocation to energy operations, and suppl

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle arrived at the destination facility. Used for delivery confirmation and facility gate operations.

attributes.name: actual_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle departed the transfer station. Used for on-time performance tracking and DOT compliance.

attributes.name: actual_tonnage
attributes.description: Actual weight of the waste load in tons as measured at the destination facility scale. Used for billing and disposal fee calculation.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading document number for the outbound haul shipment. Required for DOT compliance and chain-of-custody tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Bill of Lading Requirements (49 CFR Part 373)

attributes.name: carrier_dot_number
attributes.description: Department of Transportation carrier identification number for the hauling company or contractor. Required for interstate commerce compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Carrier Registration Requirements (49 CFR Part 390)

attributes.name: contamination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the load was identified as contaminated with prohibited materials or improperly sorted waste streams.

attributes.name: contamination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contamination found in the load (e.g., hazardous materials in MSW, non-recyclables in recycling stream, prohibited items).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outbound haul record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: destination_facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination facility type. MRF = Materials Recovery Facility, WTE = Waste-to-Energy, TSDF = Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility.

attributes.name: dispatch_notes
attributes.description: Operational notes from dispatch personnel regarding special handling instructions, route conditions, or coordination requirements.

attributes.name: driver_notes
attributes.description: Notes entered by the driver regarding delivery conditions, facility operations, delays, or issues encountered during the haul.

attributes.name: environmental_fee_amount
attributes.description: Environmental surcharge or regulatory fee assessed on the waste load for environmental compliance programs and remediation funds.

attributes.name: epa_waste_code
attributes.description: EPA hazardous waste classification code(s) for the load. Required for RCRA-regulated waste streams. Multiple codes may be comma-separated.
attributes.references: EPA Hazardous Waste Codes (40 CFR Part 261)

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time for the vehicle to arrive at the destination facility based on route planning and traffic conditions.

attributes.name: estimated_fuel_consumption_gallons
attributes.description: Estimated fuel consumption in gallons for the outbound haul based on vehicle type, load weight, and route distance.

attributes.name: estimated_tonnage
attributes.description: Estimated weight of the consolidated waste load in tons based on transfer station scale readings or volume calculations.

attributes.name: generator_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste generator signature was captured on the manifest or BOL for chain-of-custody compliance.

attributes.name: haul_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the outbound haul assignment. Used for operational tracking and communication with drivers, facilities, and regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: haul_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outbound haul assignment in the dispatch and delivery workflow.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outbound haul record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: load_rejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination facility rejected the load due to contamination, improper classification, or facility capacity constraints.

attributes.name: rcra_classification
attributes.description: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act classification for the waste load. Determines regulatory handling and disposal requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA Waste Classification Standards (40 CFR Part 261)

attributes.name: receiver_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination facility receiver signature was captured on the manifest or BOL for chain-of-custody completion.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the destination facility rejected the load. Includes contamination type, classification errors, or operational issues.

attributes.name: route_distance_miles
attributes.description: Total distance in miles from transfer station origin to destination facility. Used for fuel cost allocation and route optimization.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety incident occurred during the outbound haul (accident, spill, injury, near-miss). Triggers incident reporting workflow.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time for the vehicle to depart the transfer station with the consolidated load.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Tamper-evident seal identifier applied to the trailer or container. Used for security and chain-of-custody verification, especially for hazardous waste.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this outbound haul record (e.g., AMCS Platform, Locus Dispatch, SAP S/4HANA).

attributes.name: tipping_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total tipping fee amount charged for the haul based on actual tonnage and facility rate. Primary disposal cost component.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_rate
attributes.description: Per-ton disposal fee rate charged by the destination facility for accepting the waste load. Used for cost allocation and billing.

attributes.name: transporter_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transporter (driver) signature was captured on the manifest or BOL for chain-of-custody compliance.

attributes.name: waste_stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the waste material stream being transported. MSW = Municipal Solid Waste, C&D = Construction and Demolition Waste.

products.name: haul_manifest
products.description: Shipping and tracking manifest accompanying each outbound haul from the transfer station. Captures manifest number, BOL reference, outbound haul ID, origin transfer station, destination facility, waste description, waste classification codes (EPA/RCRA), total net weight (tons), number of containers/trailers, seal numbers, driver signature, carrier DOT number, departure timestamp, and chain-of-custody signatures. Required for DOT compliance on all outbound loads and RCRA manifest requirements for special/hazardous waste streams.
products.reference: Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest / BOL / DOT Shipping Paper

attributes.name: haul_manifest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the haul manifest record. Primary key.

attributes.name: destination_facility_id
attributes.description: Disposal or processing facility to which this haul is destined. May be landfill, WTE facility, or other disposal site.

attributes.name: disposal_landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Haul manifests for waste transported to landfills require landfill site reference for regulatory compliance, manifest-based waste tracking, and chain-of-custody documentation. Core regulatory and oper

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.disposal_purchase_order. EPA RCRA regulations require linking manifests to disposal contracts for hazardous waste. Compliance

attributes.name: driver_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.hauling_agreement. Business justification: Haul manifests document waste transport under hauling agreements, including BOL terms and carrier obligations. Regulatory compliance, carrier liability verification, and hauling agreement audit trails

attributes.name: origin_transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Transfer station facility from which this haul originated. Starting point of the outbound shipment.

attributes.name: outbound_haul_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound haul execution record that this manifest documents.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Transport vehicle (truck or tractor) used to haul this shipment.

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_waste_stream. attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the haul arrived at the destination facility. Used for transit time tracking and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: bol_reference_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading reference number accompanying this haul manifest. Links manifest to shipping documentation.

attributes.name: carrier_dot_number

attributes.name: departure_timestamp

attributes.name: destination_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the destination facility representative who signed the manifest upon receipt, confirming delivery and acceptance.
