attributes.name: epa_waste_code
attributes.description: EPA hazardous waste code(s) applicable to this shipment. Multiple codes may be comma-separated. Required for RCRA manifest compliance.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the haul is expected to arrive at the destination facility.

attributes.name: gross_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the loaded vehicle including waste payload and vehicle tare weight, measured in tons.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this haul contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and RCRA manifest compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this manifest record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: manifest_issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manifest document was officially issued and became active for this haul.

attributes.name: manifest_number

attributes.name: manifest_status

attributes.name: origin_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the transfer station representative who signed the manifest at origin, certifying the shipment details.

attributes.name: origin_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the origin facility representative signed the manifest.

attributes.name: rcra_manifest_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Manifest Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this haul requires a formal RCRA hazardous waste manifest under federal regulations.

attributes.name: rejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this haul was rejected at the destination facility due to contamination, incorrect classification, or other non-compliance issues.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the haul was rejected at the destination facility. Populated only when rejection_flag is true.

attributes.name: seal_numbers
attributes.description: Security seal identification numbers applied to containers or trailer doors. Multiple seals may be comma-separated. Required for chain-of-custody integrity.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this manifest record originated (e.g., AMCS Platform, SAP EHS).

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional instructions for handling, transporting, or unloading this haul. May include safety precautions, equipment requirements, or facility-specific procedures.

attributes.name: tare_weight_tons
attributes.description: Empty weight of the transport vehicle and containers without waste payload, measured in tons.

attributes.name: total_net_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total net weight of waste material in this haul measured in tons. Calculated as gross weight minus tare weight.

products.name: facility_capacity
products.description: Daily and period-level capacity and throughput tracking record for each transfer station. Captures capacity record ID, transfer station, record date/period, permitted daily capacity (TPD), actual inbound tonnage by waste stream, actual outbound tonnage by destination type, floor storage tonnage at end of day, capacity utilization percentage, number of inbound loads, number of outbound hauls, peak hour/day throughput, diversion rate (percentage diverted from landfill), average daily tonnage, capacity status (normal, near-capacity, over-capacity), regulatory capacity exceedance flags, and reporting submission reference. Enables proactive capacity management, regulatory compliance reporting, state solid waste reporting, and internal KPI tracking.
products.reference: TPD Throughput Record / Facility Capacity Log

attributes.name: facility_capacity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the facility capacity tracking record. Primary key for daily and period-level capacity and throughput tracking at transfer stations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who validated and approved the capacity record for regulatory reporting. Supports audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Daily capacity utilization must stay within permitted limits. Capacity records demonstrate permit compliance and support regulatory reporting of throughput against permitted daily tonnage limits.

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer station for which capacity is being tracked. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: actual_inbound_tonnage
attributes.description: Total tonnage of waste received at the transfer station during the record date or period. Represents all incoming waste streams before sorting or processing.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices, State SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: actual_outbound_tonnage
attributes.description: Total tonnage of waste dispatched from the transfer station to disposal or processing facilities during the record date or period.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices, State SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: average_daily_tonnage
attributes.description: Average daily tonnage processed during the record period. For daily records, equals actual_inbound_tonnage. For period records, represents the mean daily throughput.

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the transfer station capacity. Normal indicates utilization within acceptable range, near_capacity indicates approaching permit limits, over_capacity indicates permit exceedance, under_capacity indicates significantly below normal throughput.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of permitted daily capacity utilized, calculated as (actual_inbound_tonnage / permitted_daily_capacity_tpd) * 100. Key performance indicator for capacity management.
attributes.references: Internal KPI Framework, SWANA Capacity Management Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions implemented in response to capacity exceedance or operational issues. Documents compliance response for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: RCRA Corrective Action Requirements, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity record was first created in the system. Part of the standard audit trail for all transactional records.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0.00 to 1.00) indicating the completeness and accuracy of the capacity record. Based on presence of required fields, validation checks, and data source reliability.

attributes.name: diversion_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of waste diverted from landfill disposal through recycling, composting, or waste-to-energy. Calculated as ((outbound_mrf_tonnage + outbound_wte_tonnage + outbound_organics_tonnage) / actual_inbound_tonnage) * 100. Key sustainability metric.
attributes.references: EPA Diversion Rate Calculation, State Sustainability Reporting

attributes.name: exceedance_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the permitted capacity was exceeded, if applicable. Includes operational circumstances, emergency conditions, or unplanned events that led to the exceedance.

attributes.name: exceedance_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage by which the actual inbound tonnage exceeded the permitted daily capacity. Null if no exceedance occurred. Used for regulatory violation reporting and corrective action planning.
attributes.references: RCRA Permit Compliance, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: floor_storage_tonnage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Floor Storage Tonnage End of Day
attributes.description: Tonnage of waste remaining on the transfer station floor at the end of the record date. Represents inventory not yet dispatched for disposal or processing.
attributes.references: SWANA Transfer Station Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: inbound_cd_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of construction and demolition (C&D) waste received during the record date or period. C&D includes debris from building, renovation, and demolition activities.
attributes.references: EPA C&D Waste Definition, State Solid Waste Regulations

attributes.name: inbound_load_count
attributes.description: Total count of inbound collection vehicles or loads received at the transfer station during the record date or period. Used for operational throughput analysis.

attributes.name: inbound_msw_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of municipal solid waste (MSW) received during the record date or period. MSW includes residential and commercial non-hazardous waste.
attributes.references: EPA Municipal Solid Waste Definition, RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: inbound_organics_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of organic waste (food waste, yard waste, compostables) received during the record date or period. Tracked separately for diversion rate calculation.
attributes.references: EPA Organics Management, State Composting Regulations

attributes.name: inbound_recyclable_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of recyclable materials received during the record date or period. Includes materials destined for Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) processing.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Standards, State Diversion Rate Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity record was last updated. Part of the standard audit trail for all transactional records.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: operational_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting operational conditions, equipment issues, weather impacts, or other factors affecting capacity and throughput during the record date or period.

attributes.name: outbound_haul_count
attributes.description: Total count of outbound haul trucks dispatched from the transfer station to disposal or processing facilities during the record date or period.

attributes.name: outbound_landfill_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of waste hauled to landfill disposal facilities during the record date or period. Used for diversion rate calculation.
attributes.references: EPA Landfill Reporting, RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: outbound_mrf_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of recyclable materials sent to Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) for processing during the record date or period. Contributes to diversion rate.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Standards, State Diversion Rate Reporting

attributes.name: outbound_wte_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of waste sent to waste-to-energy (WTE) facilities for energy recovery during the record date or period. Contributes to diversion rate.
attributes.references: EPA Waste-to-Energy Standards, Clean Air Act

attributes.name: peak_hour_throughput_tons
attributes.description: Maximum tonnage processed during any single hour of the record date. Used to identify operational bottlenecks and peak demand periods.
attributes.references: SWANA Transfer Station Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: peak_hour_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the peak hour throughput occurred during the record date. Supports operational planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: permit_exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the actual inbound tonnage exceeded the permitted daily capacity. True indicates a regulatory compliance issue requiring immediate attention and reporting.
attributes.references: RCRA Permit Compliance, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: permitted_daily_capacity_tpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permitted Daily Capacity Tons Per Day (TPD)
attributes.description: The maximum daily throughput capacity in tons per day (TPD) as authorized by the facility's operating permit. This is the regulatory limit that cannot be exceeded without permit violation.
attributes.references: RCRA Permit Requirements, State Solid Waste Authority Regulations

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: The specific date for which this capacity record applies. Used for daily capacity tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: record_period
attributes.description: The reporting period for aggregated capacity tracking (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03). Supports both monthly and quarterly period-level reporting.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the capacity record in the reporting workflow. Draft indicates preliminary data, validated indicates quality checks passed, submitted indicates included in regulatory reporting, archived indicates historical record.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory report submission that includes this capacity data. Links capacity records to state SWIS reporting, EPA reporting, or local enforcement agency submissions.
attributes.references: State SWIS Reporting, EPA Waste Reporting, LEA Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: report_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory report containing this capacity data was submitted to the governing authority. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: State SWIS Reporting, EPA Waste Reporting

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which the capacity data originated (e.g., AMCS Platform, Waste Logics, manual entry). Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity record was validated and approved for regulatory reporting. Part of the audit trail for compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: transfer_trailer
products.description: Master record for transfer trailers and long-haul vehicles assigned to or operating from transfer stations. Captures trailer ID, trailer type (walking floor, end-dump, live-bottom, compactor trailer), VIN, license plate, DOT registration number, tare weight, payload capacity (tons), volume capacity (cubic yards), assigned transfer station, current status (available, loaded, in-transit, maintenance), last inspection date, next DOT inspection due date, and ownership type (owned, leased, contracted). Distinct from fleet domain vehicles — these are transfer-specific haul assets.

attributes.name: transfer_trailer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transfer trailer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: assigned_transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer station to which this trailer is currently assigned or based.

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: Trailers undergo compliance inspections for DOT standards, safety requirements, and environmental controls. Inspections verify equipment compliance with transportation and environmental regulations.

attributes.name: disposal_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the disposal facility (landfill or waste-to-energy plant) where this trailer typically delivers loads.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fixed_asset. Business justification: Transfer trailers are capital assets requiring depreciation, insurance valuation, impairment testing, and financial reporting. Link to fixed_asset master enables asset lifecycle management, book value

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Transfer trailers are mobile assets requiring DOT inspections, brake repairs, tire replacements, and unscheduled maintenance. Linking the current or most recent work order to transfer_trailer enables

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.pm_schedule. Business justification: Transfer trailers require scheduled PM (annual DOT inspections, quarterly brake checks, tire rotations per mileage intervals). Linking transfer_trailer to its PM schedule enables compliance-driven mai

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID tag attached to the trailer for automated tracking and gate access.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost paid to acquire the trailer, including purchase price or initial lease payment.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the trailer was acquired by the company through purchase, lease, or contract.

attributes.name: axle_count
attributes.description: Number of axles on the trailer, relevant for weight distribution and DOT compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transfer trailer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_location_latitude
attributes.description: Most recent GPS latitude coordinate of the trailer's location.

attributes.name: current_location_longitude
attributes.description: Most recent GPS longitude coordinate of the trailer's location.

attributes.name: dot_registration_number
attributes.description: DOT registration number required for interstate commercial hauling operations.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trailer is equipped with active GPS tracking for real-time location monitoring.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date the trailer was placed into active operational service.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current insurance policy for the trailer expires.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the insurance coverage on this trailer.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety or compliance inspection performed on the trailer.

attributes.name: last_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent inspection indicating whether the trailer passed, failed, or received conditional approval.

attributes.name: last_location_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent GPS location update received from the trailer.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance service performed on the trailer.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transfer trailer record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: license_plate
attributes.description: State-issued license plate number for the transfer trailer.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the transfer trailer.

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model designation for the trailer.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Year the trailer was manufactured, used for depreciation and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: next_dot_inspection_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Department of Transportation (DOT) Inspection Due Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required DOT annual inspection to maintain compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service based on time or usage intervals.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or maintenance history comments.

attributes.name: odometer_miles
attributes.description: Current odometer reading in miles, used for maintenance scheduling and utilization tracking.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trailer is owned by the company, leased from a third party, or contracted through a hauling agreement.

attributes.name: payload_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum allowable payload weight in tons that the trailer can legally and safely carry.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current state registration for the trailer expires.

attributes.name: registration_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the trailer is registered for operation.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the trailer was retired from active service and removed from the operational fleet.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Reason the trailer was retired from service (e.g., end of useful life, accident damage, sold, lease termination).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this transfer trailer record originated (e.g., AMCS Platform, Infor EAM).

attributes.name: tare_weight_tons
attributes.description: Empty weight of the transfer trailer in tons, used to calculate net payload from gross weight.

attributes.name: tire_size
attributes.description: Standard tire size specification for the trailer, used for maintenance and replacement planning.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or asset tag for the transfer trailer, used for operational tracking and dispatch.

attributes.name: trailer_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the transfer trailer indicating availability and location state.

attributes.name: trailer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer trailer by its unloading mechanism and design (e.g., walking floor, end-dump, live-bottom, compactor trailer).

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned by the manufacturer, used for registration and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)

attributes.name: volume_capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Maximum volume capacity of the trailer in cubic yards, relevant for low-density waste streams.

products.name: scale_equipment
products.description: Master record for weighing scale equipment installed at transfer station scale houses. Captures scale ID, transfer station, scale type (truck scale, axle scale, floor scale), manufacturer, model, serial number, capacity (tons), installation date, last calibration date, next calibration due date, calibration certificate number, weighmaster certification status, NTEP certification number, operational status, and maintenance history reference. Required for regulatory compliance with state weights and measures authorities.
products.reference: NTEP Certified Scale / Weighmaster Equipment Record

attributes.name: scale_equipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the weighing scale equipment record. Primary key for the scale equipment master data.

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: Scale equipment undergoes compliance inspections for calibration, certification, and accuracy standards. Regulatory inspections verify scales meet weights and measures requirements for commercial tran

attributes.name: lockout_tagout_procedure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.lockout_tagout_procedure. Business justification: Scale equipment requires LOTO procedures for maintenance and calibration. This is a regulatory requirement under OSHA 1910.147 for servicing equipment with electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy

attributes.name: loto_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.loto_execution. Business justification: When scale equipment undergoes maintenance, the actual LOTO execution must be tracked for compliance verification, audit trail, and incident investigation if equipment-related injuries occur during or

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Scale equipment requires calibration, repair, and compliance-driven maintenance work orders. Linking the most recent or active work order to scale_equipment enables real-time operational status tracki

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.pm_schedule. Business justification: Scales require scheduled preventive maintenance (calibration every 90 days, annual certification inspections) per state weights-and-measures regulations. Linking scale_equipment to its PM schedule ena

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer station facility where this scale equipment is installed and operated.

attributes.name: accuracy_class
attributes.description: NIST accuracy classification for the scale equipment. Class I (precision laboratory), Class II (precision commercial), Class III (commercial/vehicle scales - most common for waste operations), Class IIII (wheel-load weighers). Determines acceptable tolerance and verification requirements.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total capital cost of acquiring and installing the scale equipment, including hardware, foundation, installation labor, and initial calibration. Used for asset valuation and depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP Fixed Asset Accounting, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: calibration_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization or agency that performed the most recent calibration. Typically a state weights and measures department or certified third-party calibration service provider.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44, State Weights and Measures Regulations

attributes.name: calibration_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the most recent calibration certificate issued by the authorized calibration service provider or weights and measures authority. Required for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: camera_system_installed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale is equipped with camera systems for license plate recognition, load verification, or security monitoring. True if cameras are installed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the scale equipment measured in tons. Represents the upper limit for safe and accurate weighing operations. Critical for operational planning and load management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scale equipment record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: division_size_lbs
attributes.description: The smallest unit of weight that the scale can display and measure, expressed in pounds. Also known as scale increment or readability. Determines the precision of weight measurements.

attributes.name: environmental_protection_rating
attributes.description: IP (Ingress Protection) rating or equivalent environmental protection classification for the scale electronics and load cells. Indicates resistance to dust, moisture, and harsh conditions typical in waste operations.

attributes.name: foundation_type
attributes.description: Type of foundation construction for the scale installation. Concrete pit is below-grade installation, above ground is surface-mounted, shallow pit is partially recessed, modular is prefabricated foundation system. Affects maintenance access and drainage requirements.

attributes.name: inbound_outbound_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale is designated for inbound collection vehicles, outbound transfer haul vehicles, or bidirectional use for both traffic flows. Critical for operational flow management and weight ticket routing.

attributes.name: indicator_model
attributes.description: Model designation of the digital weight indicator (display and processing unit) connected to the scale. The indicator converts load cell signals to weight readings and interfaces with ticketing systems.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44, NTEP Certificate of Conformance

attributes.name: indicator_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the weight indicator unit. Required for NTEP certification tracking and service documentation.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44, NTEP Certificate of Conformance

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the scale equipment was installed and commissioned at the transfer station. Used for tracking equipment age, warranty periods, and depreciation schedules.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent calibration performed on the scale equipment. Calibration ensures measurement accuracy and is required for regulatory compliance with state weights and measures authorities.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44, State Weights and Measures Regulations

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent operational inspection or preventive maintenance check performed on the scale equipment. Distinct from regulatory calibration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scale equipment record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: load_cell_count
attributes.description: Number of load cells (weight sensors) installed in the scale system. Typical configurations range from 4 to 12 load cells depending on platform size and capacity. Critical for maintenance planning and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: maintenance_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the active preventive maintenance or service contract covering this scale equipment. Links to vendor service agreements and scheduled maintenance activities.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the scale equipment. Critical for warranty claims, parts sourcing, and technical support.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model designation for the scale equipment. Used for identifying compatible parts, specifications, and service procedures.

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required calibration of the scale equipment. Used for preventive maintenance planning and regulatory compliance tracking. Typically annual or semi-annual based on jurisdiction requirements.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44, State Weights and Measures Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional information, special handling requirements, known issues, or operational considerations specific to this scale equipment.

attributes.name: ntep_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Type Evaluation Program (NTEP) Certificate Number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by the National Conference on Weights and Measures (NCWM) National Type Evaluation Program, certifying that the scale design meets NIST Handbook 44 requirements. Required for commercial weighing applications in most U.S. jurisdictions.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the scale equipment. Active indicates in-service and available for weighing operations, inactive for temporarily offline, maintenance for scheduled service, out_of_service for equipment failures, decommissioned for permanently retired units.

attributes.name: platform_length_feet
attributes.description: Length of the scale weighing platform measured in feet. Determines the maximum vehicle length that can be accommodated for single-draft weighing. Typical truck scales range from 40 to 100 feet.

attributes.name: platform_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of the scale weighing platform measured in feet. Standard truck scale widths are typically 10 to 12 feet to accommodate commercial vehicle axle spacing.

attributes.name: printer_integration_type
attributes.description: Method by which weight ticket printers are connected to the scale system. Direct serial for RS-232 connection, network for TCP/IP, USB for local connection, none if no printer is integrated.

attributes.name: remote_display_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale is equipped with remote weight displays visible to drivers. True if remote displays are installed and operational, false otherwise. Enhances transparency and reduces disputes.

attributes.name: rfid_reader_installed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Reader Installed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale is equipped with RFID readers for automated vehicle or container identification. True if RFID capability is installed, false otherwise. Enables touchless weighing workflows.

attributes.name: scale_house_location
attributes.description: Physical location description of the scale house or weighing station within the transfer station facility. Used for operational routing and driver instructions.

attributes.name: scale_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the scale equipment, used for operational reference and reporting. Externally visible scale designation.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44 - Specifications, Tolerances, and Other Technical Requirements for Weighing and Measuring Devices

attributes.name: scale_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scale equipment based on its design and intended use. Truck scales are for full vehicle weighing, axle scales for individual axle measurement, floor scales for smaller loads, platform scales for container weighing, portable scales for temporary installations, and rail scales for rail car weighing.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific scale unit. Required for warranty registration, service tracking, and regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: software_system_integration
attributes.description: Name of the enterprise software system that the scale is integrated with for automated weight ticket generation and data capture. Typically ERP, billing, or waste management platform.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this scale equipment record originated. Typically asset management system, ERP, or facility management platform.

attributes.name: unattended_operation_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale is configured for unattended self-service operation by drivers. True if kiosk or automated systems allow operation without scale house attendant, false for attended-only operation.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer's warranty coverage expires for the scale equipment. Used for maintenance planning and cost forecasting.

attributes.name: weighmaster_certification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scale location has current weighmaster certification as required by state regulations. Certified means valid certification is in place, expired means renewal is needed, not_required for jurisdictions without this requirement, pending for applications in process.
attributes.references: State Weights and Measures Regulations, Business and Professions Code

products.name: hauler_account
products.description: Master record for external haulers, contractors, and self-haul customers authorized to deliver waste to Waste Management transfer stations. Captures hauler account ID, company name, account type (contracted hauler, municipal hauler, self-haul, broker), DOT carrier number, EPA generator ID (if applicable), insurance certificate reference, approved waste streams, credit terms, tipping fee rate tier, account status, primary contact, and originating jurisdiction. Distinct from the customer domain — this is the operational hauler/vendor relationship specific to transfer station intake. Integrates with AMCS for vehicle pre-authorization.

attributes.name: hauler_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hauler account record. Primary key for external haulers, contractors, and self-haul customers authorized to deliver waste to transfer stations.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: epa_generator_id
attributes.description: EPA-issued identification number for hazardous waste generators, required for haulers delivering hazardous waste streams under RCRA regulations.

attributes.name: regulated_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulated_facility. Business justification: Hauler accounts may represent regulated facilities when the hauler operates their own transfer stations or disposal facilities. Links third-party haulers to regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Hauler accounts represent third-party haulers who are vendors in the vendor master. Procurement manages vendor relationships, tracks certifications and insurance, and processes invoices. AP reconciles

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number assigned to the hauler for billing and operational reference. Used in manifests and weight tickets.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the hauler account. Active: authorized to deliver. Inactive: not currently delivering. Suspended: temporarily blocked. Pending approval: awaiting authorization. Terminated: permanently closed. Delinquent: payment issues.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hauler relationship. Contracted hauler: long-term service agreement. Municipal hauler: government entity. Self-haul: individual or business delivering own waste. Broker: intermediary. Third-party contractor: subcontracted hauler. Private hauler: independent commercial hauler.

attributes.name: approved_waste_streams
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste stream types the hauler is authorized to deliver (e.g., MSW, C&D, recyclables, organics, hazardous). Determines acceptance at transfer station gates.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hauler contract automatically renews upon expiration without requiring explicit re-negotiation.

attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the hauler business location.

attributes.name: business_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, unit, or building information.

attributes.name: business_city

Enables routing optimization and disposal cost management for outbound haul planning.

attributes.name: destination_facility_id

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.name: regulated_facility_id

attributes.name: relationship_manager_employee_id

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: wte_facility_id

attributes.name: accepted_waste_streams
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste stream types accepted at this destination facility (e.g., MSW, C&D, recyclables, organics, hazardous). MSW = Municipal Solid Waste, C&D = Construction and Demolition Waste.

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the disposal services contract or Service Level Agreement (SLA) governing the relationship with this destination facility.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the destination facility is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this destination facility record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for tipping fees and financial transactions at this facility.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this destination facility record became inactive or was closed. Null for currently active facilities.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this destination facility record became active and available for receiving waste hauls.

attributes.name: environmental_fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Additional environmental surcharge per ton assessed by the destination facility for regulatory compliance and environmental programs.

attributes.name: estimated_travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average travel time in minutes from the primary transfer station to this destination facility under normal traffic conditions.

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the destination facility indicating availability for receiving waste hauls.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination facility. MRF = Materials Recovery Facility, WTE = Waste-to-Energy, TSDF = Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility.

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination facility applies a fuel surcharge to tipping fees. True if surcharge applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the destination facility entrance or scale house for routing and navigation.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the destination facility entrance or scale house for routing and navigation.

attributes.name: haul_distance_miles
attributes.description: Estimated road distance in miles from the primary transfer station to this destination facility, used for route optimization and cost planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this destination facility record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, access requirements, or restrictions for this destination facility.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the destination facility on weekdays (Monday-Friday), formatted as start-end time range.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the destination facility on weekends (Saturday-Sunday), formatted as start-end time range.

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date

attributes.name: permit_number

attributes.name: permitted_capacity_tpd
attributes.description: Maximum daily tonnage the facility is permitted to receive by regulatory authorities. TPD = Tons Per Day.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the destination facility address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: preferred_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this destination facility is designated as a preferred routing target for cost or operational efficiency. True if preferred, False otherwise.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or Local Enforcement Agency (LEA) with oversight of this destination facility.

attributes.name: requires_manifest_flag

attributes.name: scale_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination facility has certified scales for weighing incoming loads. True if scales are available, False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the destination facility is located.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Standard disposal charge per ton of waste received at the destination facility. Business-sensitive pricing information.

products.name: operating_permit
products.description: Regulatory operating permit records specific to each transfer station facility. Captures permit ID, transfer station reference, permit type (solid waste facility permit, air quality permit, stormwater permit, conditional use permit), issuing regulatory agency (EPA, state environmental agency, LEA), permit number, issue date, expiration date, permitted waste types, permitted daily tonnage limit (TPD), permit conditions and restrictions, renewal status, and compliance monitoring requirements. Distinct from the compliance domain — this is the operational permit reference owned by transfer station management.
products.reference: Solid Waste Facility Permit / EPA Operating Permit

attributes.name: operating_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the operating permit record. Primary key for the operating permit entity.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.franchise_agreement. Business justification: Operating permits implement permit conditions mandated by franchise agreements with municipalities. Franchise compliance verification, permit-to-contract reconciliation, and municipal audit support re

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Transfer station operating permits are compliance permits and should reference the central compliance.permit table. This consolidates permit management across all facility types. Removes redundant per

attributes.name: superseded_permit_operating_permit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous operating permit that this permit replaces or supersedes, if applicable. Used for tracking permit lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, EPA Permit History Standards

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer station facility to which this operating permit applies.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Status of any appeals or challenges to permit conditions or denial. Tracks legal or administrative proceedings related to the permit.
attributes.references: EPA Administrative Procedures, State Environmental Agency Appeal Process

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this permit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the permit becomes legally binding and enforceable. May differ from issue date if there is a grace period.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Management Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit requires ongoing environmental monitoring such as air quality, water quality, or noise level monitoring.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Monitoring Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the permit expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Critical for compliance tracking and renewal planning.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Renewal Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: financial_assurance_amount
attributes.description: Required amount of financial assurance in US dollars to be maintained as a condition of the permit. Covers potential closure, remediation, and post-closure costs.
attributes.references: RCRA Financial Assurance Requirements, EPA Closure Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: financial_assurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit requires financial assurance instruments such as bonds, letters of credit, or insurance to cover closure and post-closure costs.
attributes.references: RCRA Financial Assurance Requirements, EPA Closure Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for environmental liability insurance or financial assurance instrument associated with this permit.
attributes.references: RCRA Financial Assurance Requirements, EPA Insurance Standards

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the permit was officially issued by the regulatory authority. Marks the beginning of permit validity.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Issuance Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: issuing_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority that issued the permit. May include EPA, state environmental agencies, or Local Enforcement Agency (LEA).
attributes.references: EPA Regulatory Framework, State Environmental Quality Departments, LEA Standards

attributes.name: issuing_agency_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or abbreviation for the issuing regulatory agency for system integration and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: EPA Agency Codes, State Environmental Agency Standards

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection conducted by the issuing agency.
attributes.references: EPA Inspection Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: last_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent regulatory inspection. Indicates whether the facility was found to be in compliance with permit conditions.
attributes.references: EPA Inspection Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: last_modification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent modification or amendment to the permit terms or conditions.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Modification Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this permit record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: modification_count
attributes.description: Total number of modifications or amendments made to the permit since original issuance. Used for tracking permit change history.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Modification Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of environmental monitoring and compliance reporting as specified in the permit conditions.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Monitoring Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection by the issuing agency. Used for compliance planning and preparation.
attributes.references: EPA Inspection Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements, LEA Inspection Schedules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the permit. May include internal operational guidance or historical context.

attributes.name: operating_hours_restriction
attributes.description: Specific operating hours or time-of-day restrictions imposed by the permit. May limit facility operations to certain days or hours to minimize community impact.
attributes.references: State Environmental Agency Permit Conditions, LEA Local Ordinances

attributes.name: permit_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed text description of specific conditions, restrictions, and operational requirements imposed by the regulatory authority as part of the permit. May include operating hours, noise limits, traffic restrictions, or environmental monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Conditions Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements, LEA Local Ordinances

attributes.name: permit_document_storage_path
attributes.description: File system path or document management system reference to the official permit document and supporting materials.
attributes.references: Internal Document Management Standards, EPA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: permitted_annual_tonnage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum annual tonnage of waste authorized for processing or transfer at the facility under this permit. Used for long-term capacity planning and annual compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Capacity Standards, State Environmental Agency Permit Conditions

attributes.name: permitted_daily_tonnage_limit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permitted Daily Tonnage Limit (Tons Per Day / TPD)
attributes.description: Maximum daily tonnage of waste authorized for processing or transfer at the facility under this permit, measured in Tons Per Day (TPD). Critical operational constraint for capacity planning and compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Capacity Standards, State Environmental Agency Permit Conditions, SWANA Operational Standards

attributes.name: permitted_waste_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of waste types authorized for handling under this permit. May include Municipal Solid Waste (MSW), Construction and Demolition (C&D), recyclables, or other specific waste streams.
attributes.references: RCRA Waste Classification, EPA Waste Type Standards, State Solid Waste Regulations

attributes.name: public_notice_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit requires public notice or community notification for certain operational changes or permit modifications.
attributes.references: EPA Public Participation Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements, LEA Community Notification Standards

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the permit renewal application must be submitted to the regulatory authority to avoid lapse in coverage.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Renewal Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the permit renewal process. Tracks whether renewal is required and the stage of the renewal application.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Renewal Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for submitting compliance reports to the regulatory authority as specified in the permit.
attributes.references: EPA Reporting Requirements, State Environmental Agency Standards

attributes.name: responsible_party_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the responsible party or permit holder for regulatory correspondence and compliance notifications.
attributes.references: EPA Communication Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: responsible_party_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the responsible party or permit holder for regulatory correspondence and emergency notifications.
attributes.references: EPA Communication Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization legally responsible for compliance with this permit. Typically the facility operator or permit holder.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Holder Standards, State Environmental Agency Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this permit record originated. Typically Enviance EHS or similar environmental compliance management system.

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of permit violations recorded against this permit since issuance. Used for compliance tracking and risk assessment.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement Standards, State Environmental Agency Violation Tracking

products.name: shift_log
products.description: Operational shift log maintained by transfer station supervisors for each work shift. Captures log ID, transfer station, shift date, shift type (day, evening, night), shift supervisor ID, shift start/end times, total loads received, total tonnage processed, tipping floor utilization percentage, equipment deployed (loaders, compactors), equipment issues noted, safety incidents reported, contamination incidents, staffing headcount, weather conditions, operational anomalies, floor clearance timestamps, operational holds or stoppages, regulatory inspector visits, and shift handover notes. Provides the operational narrative record supporting incident investigation, compliance audits, performance reviews, and tipping floor activity tracking.
products.reference: Shift Operations Log / Supervisor Daily Report

attributes.name: shift_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transfer station shift log record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_shift_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor responsible for overseeing operations during this shift.

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer station facility where this shift occurred.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when shift operations concluded, may differ from scheduled end due to operational conditions.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when shift operations commenced, may differ from scheduled start due to operational conditions.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shift log was formally approved by management or compliance personnel.

attributes.name: contamination_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of contamination incidents identified during the shift where prohibited materials were detected in waste streams.

attributes.name: contamination_incident_summary
attributes.description: Description of contamination incidents including material types, sources, and corrective actions taken to address the contamination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift log record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: equipment_deployed
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of equipment units deployed during the shift, including loaders, compactors, and other machinery with asset identifiers.

attributes.name: equipment_issues_noted
attributes.description: Narrative description of any equipment malfunctions, breakdowns, or performance issues observed during the shift requiring maintenance attention.

attributes.name: floor_clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tipping floor was cleared of all waste material and ready for the next shift or end-of-day closure.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift log record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: log_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the shift log, typically formatted as station code, date, and shift sequence.

attributes.name: operational_anomaly_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of operational anomalies, unusual events, or deviations from standard operating procedures encountered during the shift.

attributes.name: operational_anomaly_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any operational anomalies or deviations from normal procedures occurred during the shift.

attributes.name: operational_hold_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes that operations were on hold or stopped during the shift.

attributes.name: operational_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether operations were placed on hold or stopped during the shift due to safety, equipment, or regulatory reasons.

attributes.name: operational_hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why operations were placed on hold, including safety concerns, equipment failure, regulatory inspection, or other causes.

attributes.name: outbound_haul_count
attributes.description: Number of outbound haul trips dispatched from the transfer station to disposal facilities during the shift.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspection_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the regulatory inspection including areas reviewed, findings, citations issued, and follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspector_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency or local enforcement authority whose inspector visited the facility during the shift.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspector_visit_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a regulatory inspector from EPA, state environmental agency, or local enforcement authority visited the facility during the shift.

attributes.name: safety_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of safety incidents reported during the shift, including injuries, near-misses, and hazardous conditions.

attributes.name: safety_incident_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of safety incidents that occurred during the shift, including nature, location, and immediate response actions taken.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shift occurred.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end timestamp for the shift.

attributes.name: shift_handover_notes
attributes.description: Narrative notes provided by the shift supervisor to the incoming shift, documenting ongoing issues, pending tasks, and operational status for continuity.

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start timestamp for the shift.

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift log record indicating whether it is in draft, active, completed, under review, or approved state.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period: day shift, evening shift, night shift, weekend shift, or holiday shift.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this shift log record originated, such as AMCS Platform or Locus Dispatch.

attributes.name: staffing_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of personnel assigned and present during the shift, including operators, spotters, and support staff.

attributes.name: tipping_floor_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of tipping floor capacity utilized during the shift, calculated as occupied area divided by total available area.

attributes.name: total_loads_received
attributes.description: Total count of waste loads received at the transfer station during this shift from collection vehicles and other sources.

attributes.name: total_tonnage_processed
attributes.description: Total weight in tons of waste material processed through the transfer station during this shift, measured via scale tickets.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather conditions during the shift that may have impacted operations, safety, or throughput. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|snow|fog|wind|extreme_heat|extreme_cold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: haul_rate
products.description: Reference rate schedule for outbound haul transportation costs from transfer stations to destination facilities. Captures haul rate ID, origin transfer station, destination facility reference, haul contractor reference, waste stream type, rate basis (per ton, per load, per mile), rate amount, fuel surcharge formula, effective date, expiration date, contract reference, rate tier (spot, contracted, municipal), and approval status. Used for outbound disposal cost accounting and haul contractor invoice validation in SAP MM/FI.
products.reference: Haul Rate Schedule / Disposal Transportation Rate

attributes.name: haul_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the haul rate record. Primary key.

attributes.name: destination_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination disposal or processing facility where waste is delivered. May be a landfill, waste-to-energy plant, materials recovery facility, or treatment storage and disposal facility.

attributes.name: hauler_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party hauling contractor or internal fleet division responsible for outbound transportation. Used for invoice validation and cost allocation.

attributes.name: origin_transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer station from which waste is hauled. Identifies the consolidation facility where waste is loaded for outbound transportation.

attributes.name: primary_haul_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this haul rate. Provides audit trail for rate authorization.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_haul_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer haul rate record that replaces this rate. Used to maintain rate history and version control. Null for current active rates.

attributes.name: tertiary_haul_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this haul rate record. Part of audit trail for rate changes.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for rate changes. Tracks management authorization before rate becomes active.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the haul rate was approved. Part of audit trail for rate management.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master service agreement or purchase order governing this haul rate. Links rate to contractual terms and conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this haul rate record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rate amount. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Standard route distance in miles between origin transfer station and destination facility. Used for per-mile rate calculations and route planning.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this haul rate becomes active and applicable for transportation cost calculations and invoicing. Start of rate validity period.

attributes.name: environmental_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional environmental compliance fee per unit added to base haul rate. May be mandated by state or local regulations for waste transportation.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_time_minutes
attributes.description: Expected travel time in minutes for haul route under normal traffic conditions. Used for scheduling and per-hour rate calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this haul rate ceases to be valid. Null for open-ended rates. End of rate validity period.

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_formula
attributes.description: Mathematical formula or reference to fuel surcharge calculation method applied to base rate. May reference DOT fuel price index or fixed percentage. Used to adjust transportation costs based on fuel price volatility.
attributes.references: DOT Fuel Price Index, Contract Terms

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_percentage
attributes.description: Fixed percentage fuel surcharge applied to base rate if using percentage-based surcharge method. Null if formula-based surcharge is used.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this haul rate record was last updated. Part of audit trail for tracking rate changes.

attributes.name: maximum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transportation charge cap per haul. May be imposed by municipal contracts or regulatory rate caps.

attributes.name: minimum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transportation charge per haul regardless of calculated rate. Ensures cost recovery for small loads or short hauls.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory permit or authorization number required for this haul route. Applicable for hazardous waste manifests or special transportation permits.

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether special hauling permits are required for this route. True for hazardous waste, overweight loads, or restricted routes.

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_percentage
attributes.description: Annual or periodic percentage adjustment applied to base rate for inflation or cost escalation per contract terms. Null if no automatic adjustment applies.

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: Base transportation rate amount per unit as defined by rate basis. Expressed in currency per ton, per load, per mile, or other unit. Excludes fuel surcharges and additional fees.

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: Unit of measure on which the haul rate is calculated. Determines how transportation costs are computed for invoicing and cost accounting.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the haul rate used in contracts and invoicing. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each rate schedule.

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the haul rate schedule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rate_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional rate information, special conditions, or business context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the haul rate. Controls whether rate is available for use in cost calculations and invoicing.

attributes.name: rate_tier
attributes.description: Classification of rate type based on contract structure. Spot = one-time market rate, Contracted = long-term agreement rate, Municipal = government contract rate, Emergency = premium rate for urgent hauls, Seasonal = time-period specific rate.

attributes.name: regulatory_rate_cap
attributes.description: Maximum rate amount imposed by regulatory authority or municipal contract. Null if no regulatory cap applies.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this haul rate record originated. Typically SAP MM for rate management or Oracle Revenue Management for billing rates.

products.name: hauler_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization contract between a hauler account and a transfer station facility. It captures the station-specific permissions, rates, waste stream restrictions, and operational requirements that govern a hauler's ability to deliver waste to a specific transfer station. Each record links one hauler account to one transfer station with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship, including authorization lifecycle dates, station-specific tipping rates, allowed waste streams, RFID requirements, and delivery history metrics.. Existence Justification: In waste management transfer station operations, haulers must be explicitly authorized to deliver waste to specific transfer stations, with each hauler-station relationship governed by station-specific permissions, rates, waste stream restrictions, and operational requirements. A single hauler account can be authorized to deliver to multiple transfer stations (e.g., a regional contractor authorized at 5 different WM facilities), and each transfer station accepts waste from hundreds of different hauler accounts (contracted haulers, municipal haulers, self-haul customers, brokers). The authorization relationship is actively managed by station operators and compliance staff, with lifecycle states (pending, active, suspended, revoked), station-specific tipping rates, allowed waste streams, RFID requirements, and delivery history tracking.

attributes.name: hauler_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this hauler-station authorization record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: hauler_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the hauler account authorized to deliver waste to the transfer station

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the transfer station facility where the hauler is authorized to deliver

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the hauler was authorized to deliver waste to this specific transfer station. Marks the start of the authorization relationship.

attributes.name: authorization_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this station-specific authorization expires and requires renewal. Null indicates no expiration (evergreen authorization subject to ongoing compliance).

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this station-specific authorization. Pending: application submitted. Active: authorized to deliver. Suspended: temporarily blocked. Revoked: permanently terminated. Expired: authorization period ended.

attributes.name: authorized_transfer_stations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transfer station facility IDs where this hauler is authorized to deliver waste. Used for gate access control and vehicle pre-authorization. [Moved from hauler_account: This denormalized STRING field in hauler_account contains a comma-separated list of transfer station IDs. It should be replaced by the proper hauler_authorization association table, which provides full relationship lifecycle management, station-specific attributes, and historical tracking. The denormalized field cannot capture authorization dates, statuses, station-specific rates, or suspension reasons.]

attributes.name: last_delivery_date

attributes.name: pre_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hauler must pre-register each vehicle delivery in AMCS before arriving at THIS specific transfer station. Station-specific operational requirement.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if this station-specific authorization status is revoked (e.g., repeated violations at this station, contract termination for this station, regulatory prohibition).

attributes.name: rfid_transponder_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hauler's vehicles must have RFID transponders for automated gate entry at THIS specific transfer station. Station-specific requirement that may differ from hauler's global RFID settings.

attributes.description: Rate tier classification determining the per-ton tipping fee charged to this hauler at THIS specific transfer station. May differ from the hauler's global rate tier based on station-specific contracts or volume commitments.

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste stream types this hauler is authorized to deliver to THIS specific transfer station. May be more restrictive than the hauler's global approved_waste_streams based on station capabilities and hauler-station agreement.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if this station-specific authorization status is suspended (e.g., contamination violations at this station, unpaid invoices for this station, station-specific safety incident).

attributes.name: ytd_tonnage_delivered
attributes.description: Total tons of waste delivered by this hauler to this specific transfer station in the current calendar year. Used for volume-based rate tier adjustments and contract compliance monitoring.

products.name: hauler_site_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization contract between hauler accounts and landfill sites. It captures the operational authorization for a specific hauler to deliver waste to a specific site, including approved waste streams, negotiated tipping rates, volume commitments, and contract terms that exist only in the context of this hauler-site relationship. Each record represents a distinct disposal agreement governing one hauler's access to one site.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, hauler accounts are authorized to deliver waste to multiple landfill sites based on negotiated contracts, and each landfill site accepts waste from multiple authorized haulers. The authorization relationship is actively managed with site-specific terms: approved waste streams may vary by site based on permits, tipping fee rates are negotiated per hauler-site combination based on volume commitments, and authorization status is tracked per site (a hauler may be active at Site A but suspended at Site B). This is an operational business entity called 'Hauler Site Authorization' or 'Disposal Agreement' that humans create, update, and manage.

products.name: route_driver_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification and assignment relationship between collection routes and drivers. It captures which drivers are qualified to operate specific routes, including primary/backup designation, qualification verification, and effective date ranges. Each record links one route to one employee (driver) with attributes that exist only in the context of this qualification relationship. This is the operational matrix used by dispatch to assign drivers to routes based on CDL requirements, truck type qualifications, and coverage needs.. Existence Justification: In waste collection operations, routes require multiple qualified drivers for coverage (primary, backup, vacation relief, seasonal support), and drivers are qualified to operate multiple routes based on CDL class, truck type experience, and geographic familiarity. Dispatch actively manages this qualification matrix to ensure daily route coverage, track driver-route experience, verify qualifications, and manage rotation schedules. This is an operational business entity called 'Route Driver Qualification' that dispatch teams create, update, and query daily.
