products.name: disposal_routing
products.description: This association product represents the operational routing agreement between transfer stations and landfill sites. It captures the business rules, capacity allocations, and logistics parameters that govern where waste from each transfer station is disposed. Each record links one transfer station to one landfill site with routing preferences, contracted capacity, haul logistics, and waste stream rules that exist only in the context of this disposal relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, transfer stations actively manage disposal routing to multiple landfill sites for capacity balancing, waste stream specialization (MSW vs C&D), redundancy planning, and cost optimization. Simultaneously, landfill sites receive waste from multiple transfer stations across their service territory. The business manages these routing relationships as operational agreements with contracted capacity allocations, haul logistics parameters, waste stream routing rules, and effective/expiration dates that belong to neither the transfer station nor the landfill site alone.

products.name: district_program_participation

It captures district-level program launch, enrollment tracking, diversion performance measurement, and participation status. Each record links one collection district to one circular economy program with attributes that exist only in the context of this district-program relationship, enabling geographic program performance reporting and ESG compliance tracking.. The business actively manages district-level program participation, tracking launch dates, customer enrollment, participation rates, and diversion performance for each district-program combination to support ESG reporting and program optimization.

products.name: hazmat_service_schedule
products.description: This association product represents the scheduled service relationship between collection routes and hazardous waste generators. It captures the operational scheduling, container assignments, and service frequency for each route-generator pairing. Each record links one route to one hazardous waste generator with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific service arrangement.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, collection routes serve multiple hazardous waste generators, and individual generators are often served by multiple routes depending on waste stream type, service frequency, and regulatory requirements. For example, a single hazmat generator may have flammable liquids collected weekly on Route 101 and corrosive materials collected monthly on Route 205. The business actively manages these service schedules as operational entities with specific attributes like container assignments, pickup timing, and waste stream specifications.

products.name: facility_staffing_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational staffing assignment between transfer stations and employees. It captures the assignment of employees to specific transfer station facilities with role-specific responsibilities, shift patterns, and facility-specific certifications. Each record links one transfer station to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, enabling cross-training tracking, coverage management, and compliance verification.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management operations, transfer stations require multiple employees across different roles (weighmasters, tipping floor operators, supervisors, equipment operators) and shifts to maintain continuous operations. Simultaneously, employees are cross-trained and assigned to multiple transfer station facilities to provide coverage during absences, peak periods, and staff rotations. The business actively manages these assignments with facility-specific roles, shift patterns, and certifications that vary by facility type (MSW vs C&D vs hazmat-permitted).

attributes.name: vehicle_id

attributes.name: annual_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the vehicle must complete its annual DOT safety inspection to maintain compliance. Failure to inspect by this date results in out-of-service status.

attributes.name: cab_card_storage_location
attributes.description: Physical or digital location where the IRP cab card (registration document) is stored. Cab cards must be carried in the vehicle at all times for roadside inspection readiness.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vehicle registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dot_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) to commercial motor carriers. Required for interstate commerce and displayed on vehicle.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle registration becomes valid and the vehicle is legally authorized to operate on public roads.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle registration expires and must be renewed to maintain legal operation. Critical for compliance tracking and renewal scheduling.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel type for the vehicle as recorded on the registration. CNG = Compressed Natural Gas, RNG = Renewable Natural Gas. Impacts IFTA reporting and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: gross_vehicle_weight
attributes.description: Maximum allowable weight of the vehicle including cargo, as registered with the state DMV. Measured in pounds. Determines registration class and fee structure.

attributes.name: ifta_decal_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Fuel Tax Agreement (IFTA) Decal Number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IFTA decal affixed to the vehicle. IFTA simplifies fuel tax reporting for commercial vehicles operating across multiple jurisdictions.

attributes.name: ifta_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Fuel Tax Agreement (IFTA) Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date when the IFTA decal expires and must be renewed. Typically aligns with calendar year end.

attributes.name: irp_apportioned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle is registered under the International Registration Plan (IRP), which allows commercial vehicles to travel across multiple jurisdictions with a single registration and apportioned fees.

attributes.name: irp_base_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code representing the base jurisdiction for IRP apportionment. This is where the carrier maintains its principal place of business.

attributes.name: irp_fleet_number
attributes.description: Unique fleet identifier assigned under the IRP program. Used for tracking and reporting across multiple jurisdictions.

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the vehicle registration was issued (e.g., TX, CA, IL).

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle last completed a DOT annual safety inspection. Used to calculate next inspection due date.

attributes.name: lien_holder_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution or entity holding a lien on the vehicle, if applicable. Recorded on the title and registration documents.

attributes.name: mc_number
attributes.description: Operating authority number issued by FMCSA for carriers transporting regulated commodities in interstate commerce. Not all vehicles require an MC number.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or remarks related to the vehicle registration (e.g., temporary permits, exemptions, pending renewals).

attributes.name: registered_owner_address
attributes.description: Mailing address of the registered owner as recorded on the vehicle registration document. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: registered_owner_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity or individual listed as the registered owner on the vehicle registration. Typically the company name for fleet vehicles.

attributes.name: registration_class
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle registration as defined by state DMV regulations. Determines fee structure and operational restrictions.

attributes.name: registration_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the vehicle registration document. Used for electronic record-keeping and roadside inspection readiness.

attributes.name: registration_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee paid for the vehicle registration, including base registration, IRP apportionment fees, and any applicable surcharges. Denominated in USD.

attributes.name: registration_fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the registration fee. Typically USD for U.S. operations.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The official license plate or registration number issued by the state Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). This is the externally-known identifier displayed on the vehicle.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vehicle registration. Active registrations are compliant for road operation; expired or suspended registrations require immediate attention to maintain DOT compliance.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the registration was last renewed. Used to track renewal history and calculate next renewal cycle.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle title document issued by the state. Links registration to proof of ownership.

attributes.name: ucr_registration_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the UCR registration is valid. UCR must be renewed annually.

attributes.name: ucr_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Unified Carrier Registration for this vehicle. UCR is a federally-mandated registration system for commercial motor carriers operating in interstate commerce.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vehicle registration record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle type as recorded on the registration (e.g., ASL = Automated Side Loader, FEL = Front End Loader, REL = Rear End Loader, roll-off truck, transfer vehicle).

attributes.name: vehicle_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle as recorded on the registration document.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character alphanumeric Vehicle Identification Number assigned by the manufacturer. Unique global identifier for the vehicle, recorded on registration documents.

products.name: driver
products.description: Master record for all CDL (Commercial Driver License) holders and non-CDL operators assigned to fleet vehicles. Captures driver employee ID (FK to workforce domain), CDL number, class (A/B/C), state of issuance, expiration date, endorsements (Hazmat, Tanker, Doubles/Triples), medical examiner certificate details, DOT physical due date, MVR status, HazMat clearance, drug/alcohol program enrollment, current qualification status, last qualification review date, next review due date, and operational status. SSOT for driver identity and qualification records within the fleet domain.
products.reference: FMCSA Driver Qualification File — 49 CFR Part 391

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the driver record. Primary key for the driver entity within the fleet domain.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_area. Business justification: Drivers are assigned to service territories for route planning, CDL compliance by jurisdiction, labor deployment, and territory-based performance management. Critical for workforce planning and regula

attributes.name: cdl_training_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_certification. Business justification: CDL licenses, hazmat endorsements, and DOT medical certifications are regulatory training certifications. Driver qualification files require linking to certification records for FMCSA compliance audit

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record in the workforce domain. Links driver to their HR profile in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: home_district_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary operational district where the driver is based. Used for route assignment and workforce planning.

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: Classification of the Commercial Driver License indicating the types of vehicles the driver is authorized to operate. Class A for combination vehicles, Class B for heavy straight vehicles, Class C for smaller vehicles requiring placards or designed to transport 16+ passengers.

attributes.name: cdl_endorsements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CDL endorsements held by the driver (e.g., H for Hazmat, N for Tanker, T for Doubles/Triples, P for Passenger). Determines specialized vehicle and cargo authorization.

attributes.name: cdl_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the Commercial Driver License expires and must be renewed. Critical for DOT compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: cdl_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the current Commercial Driver License was issued by the state authority.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Driver Qualification File Requirements

attributes.name: cdl_number
attributes.description: Unique Commercial Driver License number issued by the state licensing authority. Required for all drivers operating commercial motor vehicles.

attributes.name: cdl_state
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commercial Driver License (CDL) State of Issuance
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the Commercial Driver License was issued (e.g., CA, TX, NY).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the driver record was first created in the fleet management system.

attributes.name: dot_physical_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Physical Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date when the DOT medical examiner certificate expires. Drivers must maintain current medical certification to operate commercial vehicles.

attributes.name: dot_physical_issue_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Physical Issue Date
attributes.description: Date when the current DOT medical examiner certificate was issued.

attributes.name: drug_alcohol_program_enrollment_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug and Alcohol Program Enrollment Date
attributes.description: Date when the driver was enrolled in the DOT drug and alcohol testing program.

attributes.name: drug_alcohol_program_enrollment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug and Alcohol Program Enrollment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver is enrolled in the DOT-mandated drug and alcohol testing program. Required for all CDL drivers.

attributes.name: hazmat_clearance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the driver's TSA security threat assessment clearance required for Hazmat endorsement. Must be renewed every five years.

attributes.name: hazmat_endorsement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds a valid Hazmat endorsement on their CDL, required for transporting hazardous waste materials subject to RCRA regulations.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA 49 CFR 383.93, RCRA Hazmat Transportation Requirements

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver was hired by Waste Management. Used for seniority, tenure analysis, and route assignment priority.

attributes.name: last_alcohol_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the driver's most recent alcohol test (pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, or return-to-duty).

attributes.name: last_alcohol_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the driver's most recent alcohol test. Positive results (BAC >= 0.04) or refusals trigger disqualification.

attributes.name: last_drug_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the driver's most recent drug test (pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, or return-to-duty).

attributes.name: last_drug_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the driver's most recent drug test. Positive results or refusals trigger disqualification and return-to-duty protocols.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the driver record was last updated. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_qualification_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver's qualification file was last reviewed for completeness and compliance with DOT requirements.

attributes.name: medical_examiner_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the driver's DOT medical examiner certificate. Required to demonstrate physical fitness to operate commercial motor vehicles.

attributes.name: medical_examiner_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified medical examiner who issued the DOT physical certificate.

attributes.name: mvr_last_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Last Review Date
attributes.description: Date when the driver's Motor Vehicle Record was last reviewed by the fleet safety department. DOT requires annual MVR reviews.

attributes.name: mvr_next_review_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Next Review Due Date
attributes.description: Date when the next Motor Vehicle Record review is due. Used for compliance tracking and proactive safety management.

attributes.name: mvr_status
attributes.description: Current status of the driver's Motor Vehicle Record based on the most recent review. Indicates driving history and violation status for risk assessment and DOT compliance.

attributes.name: next_qualification_review_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next driver qualification file review is due. Used for proactive compliance management.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the driver within the fleet. Indicates availability for route assignments and vehicle operations.

attributes.name: primary_route_type
attributes.description: Primary type of collection route the driver is assigned to. Determines vehicle type and operational requirements.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the driver based on DOT requirements, medical certification, license validity, and company safety standards. Determines whether the driver is authorized to operate fleet vehicles.

attributes.name: safety_score
attributes.description: Composite safety score based on driving behavior, incident history, and compliance metrics captured from Geotab Fleet Telematics. Scale 0-100, higher is better.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver's employment was terminated. Null for active drivers.

attributes.name: total_miles_driven
attributes.description: Cumulative total miles driven by the driver across all fleet vehicles since hire date. Used for experience assessment and performance analysis.

products.name: vehicle_assignment
products.description: Transactional record of driver-to-vehicle assignments for each operational shift or day. Captures assigned driver, assigned vehicle unit, assignment date, shift start time, shift end time, route or run assignment reference, pre-trip inspection completion flag, post-trip inspection completion flag, odometer at assignment start, odometer at assignment end, engine hours at start, engine hours at end, and assignment status. Supports HOS (Hours of Service) tracking, vehicle utilization reporting, and driver accountability.
products.reference: Driver-Vehicle Assignment Log — FMCSA HOS / Geotab

attributes.name: vehicle_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle assignment record. Primary key for the vehicle assignment entity.

attributes.name: delivery_wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Daily vehicle assignments include deliveries to WTE facilities. Dispatch and operations need to track which vehicle/driver delivered waste to which energy facility on each shift for load reconciliatio

attributes.name: dispatcher_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Dispatchers assign vehicles to routes and drivers daily, critical for operational accountability, shift planning, HOS compliance verification, and route optimization decisions.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver assigned to operate the vehicle during this shift. References the driver master record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; DOT Driver Qualification Files

attributes.name: pre_post_trip_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.pre_post_trip_inspection. Business justification: Vehicle assignments require pre-trip inspections per FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396.11. The vehicle_assignment table currently has pre_trip_inspection_completed BOOLEAN and pre_trip_inspection_timestamp, but n

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection route or run assigned to this driver-vehicle combination for the shift. May be null for non-route assignments such as maintenance runs or standby.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Locus Dispatch

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle unit assigned for this operational shift. References the fleet vehicle master record.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the driver completed the shift and returned the vehicle, as recorded by telematics or dispatch system. May differ from scheduled shift end time.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the driver began the shift and took control of the vehicle, as recorded by telematics or dispatch system. May differ from scheduled shift start time.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this vehicle assignment is effective. Represents the operational day of the assignment.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vehicle assignment. Tracks progression from scheduled through active operation to completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment purpose. Indicates whether the vehicle is assigned for route collection, transfer haul, roll-off service, maintenance run, standby duty, or emergency response.

attributes.name: cdl_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the drivers Commercial Driver License (CDL) was verified as valid and appropriate for the vehicle class at the time of assignment. Required for DOT compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Commercial Driver License Standards 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vehicle assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any vehicle defects or maintenance issues identified during the assignment. Used to generate work orders for corrective maintenance.

attributes.name: defects_reported
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any vehicle defects or maintenance issues were reported during the pre-trip or post-trip inspection for this assignment.
attributes.references: DOT Vehicle Inspection Requirements 49 CFR 396.11; Infor EAM

attributes.name: dispatch_location
attributes.description: The facility or yard location from which the vehicle was dispatched for this assignment. Typically the operating base or depot.

attributes.name: engine_hours_end
attributes.description: The cumulative engine operating hours at the end of the assignment. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and asset lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics; Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance

attributes.name: engine_hours_start
attributes.description: The cumulative engine operating hours at the beginning of the assignment. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and asset lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics; Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance

attributes.name: fuel_level_end_percent
attributes.description: The fuel tank level as a percentage at the end of the assignment. Used for fuel consumption tracking and refueling planning.

attributes.name: fuel_level_start_percent
attributes.description: The fuel tank level as a percentage at the beginning of the assignment. Used for fuel consumption tracking and refueling planning.

attributes.name: hos_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the driver was in compliance with Hours of Service (HOS) regulations at the time of assignment. Ensures driver has adequate rest and is within allowable driving hours.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vehicle assignment record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the vehicle assignment. May include special instructions, operational observations, or other relevant information.

attributes.name: odometer_end
attributes.description: The vehicle odometer reading in miles at the end of the assignment. Used to calculate distance traveled during the shift for utilization and maintenance tracking.

attributes.name: odometer_start
attributes.description: The vehicle odometer reading in miles at the beginning of the assignment. Used to calculate distance traveled during the shift for utilization and maintenance tracking.

attributes.name: post_trip_inspection_completed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the driver completed the mandatory post-trip vehicle inspection after completing the shift. Required for DOT compliance and vehicle maintenance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Vehicle Inspection Requirements 49 CFR 396.11; FMCSA

attributes.name: post_trip_inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the post-trip inspection was completed and recorded. Used for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: pre_trip_inspection_completed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the driver completed the mandatory pre-trip vehicle inspection before beginning the shift. Required for DOT compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Vehicle Inspection Requirements 49 CFR 396.11; FMCSA

attributes.name: return_location
attributes.description: The facility or yard location to which the vehicle was returned at the end of the assignment. May differ from dispatch location for transfer operations.

attributes.name: safety_incident_occurred
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any safety incident, accident, or near-miss event occurred during this vehicle assignment. Triggers incident investigation and reporting workflow.
attributes.references: OSHA Recordkeeping Requirements 29 CFR 1904; DOT Accident Reporting

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the driver is scheduled to complete the shift and return the vehicle. Used for Hours of Service (HOS) tracking and shift duration calculation.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the driver is scheduled to begin the shift and take control of the vehicle. Used for Hours of Service (HOS) tracking and shift duration calculation.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

products.name: telematics_event
products.description: High-frequency GPS and telematics event records sourced from Geotab Fleet Telematics for each vehicle. Captures event timestamp, vehicle unit, GPS latitude, GPS longitude, vehicle speed, posted speed limit, heading, ignition status, engine RPM, engine load percentage, coolant temperature, battery voltage, odometer reading at event, fuel level, idle duration flag, harsh braking event flag, harsh acceleration event flag, seatbelt status, PTO (Power Take-Off) status, and geofence zone identifier. Foundational for route compliance, driver behavior scoring, and fuel consumption analysis.
products.reference: Geotab Fleet Telematics Event Log — GPS/OBD-II

attributes.name: telematics_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each telematics event record captured from the vehicle tracking system.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver assigned to the vehicle at the time of the event.

attributes.name: geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geographic boundary zone the vehicle was within at the time of the event.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the planned collection route the vehicle was assigned to at the time of the event.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fleet vehicle that generated this telematics event.

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Telematics systems use geofencing to track vehicle arrival, dwell time, and departure at WTE facilities. Operations need this link for facility queue management, driver behavior monitoring at tipping

attributes.name: altitude_feet
attributes.description: Elevation of the vehicle above sea level measured in feet at the time of the event.

attributes.name: battery_voltage
attributes.description: Vehicle battery voltage measured in volts at the time of the event.

attributes.name: coolant_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Engine coolant temperature measured in degrees Fahrenheit at the time of the event.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the telematics platform or system that captured and transmitted this event record.

attributes.name: device_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the telematics tracking device installed in the vehicle.

attributes.name: engine_load_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of maximum engine load being utilized at the time of the event.

attributes.name: engine_rpm
attributes.description: Engine speed measured in revolutions per minute at the time of the event.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the telematics event was captured by the vehicle tracking device.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the telematics event indicating the trigger or reason for the event record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gps_ping|ignition_on|ignition_off|harsh_event|idle_alert|geofence_entry|geofence_exit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_gallons
attributes.description: Cumulative fuel consumed by the vehicle measured in gallons since the last reset or event.

attributes.name: fuel_level_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of fuel remaining in the vehicle tank at the time of the event.

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated accuracy of the GPS coordinates measured in meters indicating the precision of the location data.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the vehicle at the time of the event in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the vehicle at the time of the event in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: harsh_acceleration_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a harsh acceleration event occurred based on acceleration thresholds.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Driver Safety Standards

attributes.name: harsh_braking_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a harsh braking event occurred based on deceleration thresholds.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Driver Safety Standards

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Compass direction the vehicle is traveling measured in degrees from 0 to 359 where 0 is north.

attributes.name: idle_duration_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the vehicle was idling for an extended period at the time of the event.

attributes.name: idle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of time the vehicle engine was running while stationary measured in minutes.

attributes.name: ignition_status
attributes.description: Current state of the vehicle ignition indicating whether the engine is running or off.

attributes.name: odometer_miles
attributes.description: Total cumulative distance traveled by the vehicle in miles as recorded at the time of the event.

attributes.name: posted_speed_limit_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Posted Speed Limit Miles Per Hour (MPH)
attributes.description: Legal speed limit at the vehicles location at the time of the event in miles per hour.

attributes.name: pto_status
attributes.description: Current state of the power take-off mechanism indicating whether it is engaged for auxiliary equipment operation.

attributes.name: satellite_count
attributes.description: Number of GPS satellites used to determine the vehicles location at the time of the event.

attributes.name: seatbelt_status
attributes.description: Current state of the driver seatbelt indicating whether it is fastened or unfastened.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Standards

attributes.name: speeding_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the vehicle was exceeding the posted speed limit at the time of the event.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Standards

attributes.name: vehicle_speed_mph
attributes.description: Instantaneous speed of the vehicle at the time of the event measured in miles per hour.

products.name: fuel_transaction
products.description: Individual fuel dispensing transaction records for all fleet vehicles covering diesel, CNG (Compressed Natural Gas), and RNG (Renewable Natural Gas) fueling events. Captures transaction date and time, vehicle unit, driver, fuel type, quantity dispensed (gallons or GGE), unit cost, total cost, fuel card number, fueling station identifier (company yard or public station), odometer at fueling, engine hours at fueling, DEF quantity dispensed, and transaction source (fleet card, yard pump, CNG station). Integrates with SAP MM for cost allocation and supports IFTA fuel tax reporting.
products.reference: Fleet Fuel Card Transaction — IFTA / SAP MM / Geotab

attributes.name: fuel_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: air_emission_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.air_emission_event. Business justification: Fuel dispensing events can trigger vapor recovery system failures, spills, or overfill events reportable under air quality permits. Environmental compliance officers link fuel transactions to emission

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver who performed the fueling transaction. Links to driver master record.

attributes.name: fuel_purchase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.fuel_purchase. Business justification: Individual vehicle fuel transactions must reconcile against bulk fuel purchases for inventory management, cost allocation, and variance analysis. Essential for fuel accounting and detecting shrinkage/

attributes.name: fueling_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fueling location. May be internal yard pump ID or external commercial station identifier from fuel card network.

attributes.name: fueling_wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Many WTE facilities have on-site fueling stations for fleet vehicles. Fuel transactions need to link to the WTE facility where fueling occurred for cost allocation, facility-specific fuel inventory ma

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection route the vehicle was assigned to at the time of fueling. Links fuel consumption to operational route performance.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work shift during which the fueling occurred. Supports labor cost allocation and shift-based fuel consumption analysis.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fleet vehicle that was fueled in this transaction. Links to the vehicle master record.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization or approval code from the fuel card processor or yard pump system. Used for transaction reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center to which this fuel transaction cost is allocated. Supports financial reporting and budget tracking by operational unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel transaction record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the transaction cost (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: def_quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Volume of DEF (Diesel Exhaust Fluid) dispensed in gallons during this transaction. Required for diesel vehicles with SCR emissions systems to meet EPA standards.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Emissions Standard

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative engine operating hours at time of fueling. Critical for maintenance scheduling and fuel efficiency analysis for heavy equipment.

attributes.name: fuel_card_number
attributes.description: Fleet fuel card number used for the transaction. Masked or tokenized for security. Used to reconcile with fuel card provider statements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Security Standard

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: Grade or specification of the fuel dispensed. ULSD = Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel; B5/B20 = biodiesel blend percentages. Ensures compliance with vehicle manufacturer specifications.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel dispensed in this transaction. CNG = Compressed Natural Gas, RNG = Renewable Natural Gas.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General ledger account code for fuel expense posting in SAP FI. Varies by fuel type and vehicle class.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fueling location. Captured from vehicle telematics or fuel card network. Used to validate station location and detect anomalies.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fueling location. Captured from vehicle telematics or fuel card network. Used to validate station location and detect anomalies.

attributes.name: ifta_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter state/province code where fuel was purchased. Required for IFTA quarterly fuel tax reporting for interstate commercial vehicles.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice or receipt number for this fuel transaction. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: is_emergency_fuel
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this was an unplanned emergency fueling event (e.g., vehicle ran low on route). Used to identify route planning issues and driver behavior patterns.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel transaction record was last modified. Tracks updates for reconciliation, corrections, or status changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the fuel transaction. May include driver remarks, exception explanations, or reconciliation notes.

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Vehicle odometer reading in miles at the time of fueling. Used to calculate fuel economy (MPG or MPGe) and validate vehicle utilization.

attributes.name: pre_tax_amount
attributes.description: Transaction cost before fuel taxes. Calculated as total_cost minus tax_amount. Used for cost analysis and vendor invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: pump_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific fuel pump or dispenser used at the fueling station. Supports pump-level performance tracking and maintenance.

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Volume or energy-equivalent quantity of fuel dispensed. For liquid fuels measured in gallons; for CNG/RNG measured in GGE (Gasoline Gallon Equivalent).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated this transaction record (e.g., Geotab, WEX FleetCard, internal yard pump system). Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Original transaction identifier from the source system. Maintains traceability to upstream system for reconciliation and issue resolution.

attributes.name: station_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fueling station. Company yard = internal fleet facility; public station = commercial retail; CNG station = specialized compressed natural gas facility.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total fuel tax included in the transaction cost. Includes federal, state, and local fuel excise taxes. Used for IFTA reporting and tax reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the fuel transaction (quantity × unit cost). Used for cost allocation and budget tracking.

attributes.name: transaction_source
attributes.description: System or method that captured this fuel transaction. Fleet card = commercial fuel card network; yard pump = internal automated pump; telematics = vehicle onboard system; manual entry = driver-reported.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the fuel transaction. Approved = validated and posted; pending = awaiting review; disputed = flagged for investigation; reconciled = matched to invoice.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel dispensing transaction occurred. Captured from fuel card system or yard pump controller.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of fuel at the time of transaction (price per gallon, GGE, or kWh).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity dispensed. GGE = Gasoline Gallon Equivalent used for CNG/RNG; kWh for electric charging.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the fuel vendor or station operator (e.g., Shell, BP, internal fleet services). Used for vendor performance analysis and contract compliance.

products.name: fleet_dot_inspection
products.description: Records of DOT roadside inspections and annual vehicle inspections (CVSA — Commercial Vehicle Safety Alliance) for fleet units. Captures inspection date, inspection type (Level I–VI CVSA, Annual DOT, State Patrol), inspection location, inspector name and badge number, inspection result (pass, out-of-service, warning), number of violations cited, violation codes (FMCSA OOS criteria), corrective action required flag, corrective action completion date, and inspection report number. Critical for FMCSA compliance tracking and CSA (Compliance Safety Accountability) score management.
products.reference: FMCSA CVSA Inspection Report — 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: reviewing_employee_id

attributes.name: driver_oos_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the driver specifically was placed out of service.

attributes.description: Category or context of the inspection event (roadside stop, scheduled annual inspection, state patrol enforcement, terminal audit, compliance review, or random selection).

attributes.name: inspection_notes

attributes.name: inspection_state

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp

attributes.name: oos_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of violations that met FMCSA out-of-service criteria.

attributes.name: out_of_service_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vehicle or driver was placed out of service as a result of the inspection. True if OOS order was issued.

attributes.name: severity_weight
attributes.description: Severity weight assigned to the violations for CSA scoring purposes (1-10 scale, with 10 being most severe).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: vehicle_oos_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vehicle specifically was placed out of service.

attributes.name: violation_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of FMCSA violation codes cited during the inspection (e.g., 393.75B, 396.3A1).

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of violations cited during the inspection.

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the violations found during the inspection, including inspector notes.

products.name: pre_post_trip_inspection
products.description: Driver-completed pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspection records as required by FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396.11. Captures inspection date, inspection type (pre-trip or post-trip), driver, vehicle unit, trailer unit (if applicable), odometer reading, each inspection item result (brakes, lights, tires, mirrors, horn, wipers, coupling devices, emergency equipment, body/frame), defect reported flag, defect description, defect severity, driver signature timestamp, and mechanic acknowledgment timestamp. Feeds directly into maintenance work order generation for reported defects.
products.reference: DVIR — Driver Vehicle Inspection Report — 49 CFR 396.11

attributes.name: trailer_id

attributes.name: vehicle_id

attributes.name: coupling_devices_status

attributes.description: The date and time when the driver electronically signed or certified the inspection report.

attributes.name: emergency_equipment_status

attributes.name: exhaust_system_status

attributes.name: fuel_system_status
attributes.description: Inspection result for the fuel system including tank, lines, and connections for leaks or damage. Applies to diesel, CNG, and RNG fuel systems.

attributes.name: horn_status
attributes.description: Inspection result for the vehicle horn functionality.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the inspection was performed.

attributes.name: inspection_location

attributes.name: tires_status

attributes.name: trailer_unit_number

attributes.name: wipers_status

products.name: hos_log
products.description: Hours of Service (HOS) log records for CDL drivers as mandated by FMCSA ELD (Electronic Logging Device) rules under 49 CFR Part 395. Captures log date, driver, vehicle unit, duty status (off duty, sleeper berth, driving, on-duty not driving), duty status start timestamp, duty status end timestamp, duration in status, cumulative driving hours in 8-day window, cumulative on-duty hours in 8-day window, 30-minute break compliance flag, ELD device identifier, co-driver identifier, shipping document reference, and HOS violation flag with violation type code. Supports FMCSA compliance and driver safety management.
products.reference: ELD Hours of Service Log — FMCSA 49 CFR Part 395

products.name: driver_initiative_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between drivers and carbon reduction initiatives. It captures driver enrollment in eco-driving programs, idle reduction training, and other sustainability initiatives. Each record links one driver to one carbon initiative with training completion status, certification details, and performance metrics that exist only in the context of this participation.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, drivers participate in multiple concurrent carbon reduction initiatives (idle reduction, eco-driving training, speed management, route efficiency programs), and each initiative enrolls hundreds of drivers across the fleet. The business actively manages these participations as operational records with training completion, certification status, performance metrics, and incentive tracking. This is not a derived correlation but an operational enrollment process managed by sustainability and fleet safety teams.

attributes.description: Driver's baseline eco-driving behavior score measured before participation in this initiative. Used to calculate improvement and initiative effectiveness. Scale typically 0-100.

attributes.description: Driver's current eco-driving behavior score while participating in this initiative. Updated periodically based on telematics data. Scale typically 0-100.

attributes.description: Date when the driver achieved certification for this eco-driving or sustainability initiative. Null if not yet certified.

attributes.name: certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver's certification for this initiative expires and requires renewal. Null if certification does not expire or driver is not certified.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current certification status of the driver for this specific initiative: not_certified (no certification obtained), in_progress (working toward certification), certified (holds valid certification), expired (certification lapsed), revoked (certification removed).

attributes.description: Estimated metric tons of CO2 equivalent emissions reduced by this specific driver's participation in this initiative. Aggregated across all drivers to measure total initiative impact.

attributes.description: Percentage reduction in vehicle idle time achieved by this driver through participation in idle reduction initiatives. Calculated from telematics data comparing baseline to current period.

attributes.description: Total monetary incentive or bonus earned by this driver for achieving performance targets in this carbon initiative. Used for driver engagement and program ROI tracking.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility or operational site where this fueling station is located.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the fueling station location.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, building, or unit number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the fueling station is located.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for fueling station communications and operational coordination.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fueling station operations or management.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration or termination date of the fueling station contract or service agreement.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the contract or agreement governing the use of this fueling station.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the fueling station contract or service agreement.

attributes.name: cost_per_gallon_cng
attributes.description: Current negotiated or market cost per gallon equivalent for CNG fuel at this station.

attributes.name: cost_per_gallon_diesel
attributes.description: Current negotiated or market cost per gallon for diesel fuel at this station, used for fleet cost analysis.

attributes.name: cost_per_kwh_electric
attributes.description: Current cost per kilowatt-hour for electric vehicle charging at this station.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the fueling station location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fueling station record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_throughput_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum daily fuel dispensing capacity in gallons, used for fleet scheduling and station utilization analysis.

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date when the fueling station was permanently taken out of service, if applicable.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental certifications or compliance standards met by the fueling station (e.g., EPA Tier 3, CARB, LEED).

attributes.name: fuel_types_available
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fuel types available at this station (e.g., diesel, CNG, RNG, gasoline, electric). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: diesel|cng|rng|gasoline|electric|biodiesel|lng|hydrogen — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hazmat_permit_number
attributes.description: Permit number for handling and storing hazardous materials at the fueling station, required for compliance.

attributes.name: is_24_hour_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fueling station provides round-the-clock access for fleet vehicles.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fueling station record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fueling station for GPS routing and telematics integration.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fueling station for GPS routing and telematics integration.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required safety or regulatory inspection of the fueling station.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, or station-specific information.

attributes.name: number_of_cng_dispensers
attributes.description: Count of CNG-specific dispensers at the station, critical for CNG fleet capacity planning.

attributes.name: number_of_electric_chargers
attributes.description: Count of electric vehicle charging stations available for electric fleet vehicles.

attributes.name: number_of_pumps
attributes.description: Total count of fueling pumps or dispensers available at the station.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the fueling station (e.g., 24/7, Mon-Fri 6am-10pm), used for fleet scheduling.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fueling station indicating its availability for fleet operations.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the fueling station address.

attributes.name: primary_fuel_type
attributes.description: The predominant fuel type dispensed at this station, used for fleet routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Business region or district code for organizational reporting and fleet management hierarchy.

attributes.name: safety_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety inspection for the fueling station, required for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the fueling station location.

attributes.name: station_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the fueling station, used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: station_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fueling station for identification and display purposes.

attributes.name: station_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fueling station based on ownership and access model.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Total fuel storage capacity at the station measured in gallons, used for inventory and supply chain planning.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or operator managing the fueling station, if applicable.

attributes.name: parent_fueling_station_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fueling_station (parent_fueling_station_id)

products.name: geofence_zone
products.description: Master reference table for geofence_zone. Referenced by geofence_zone_id.

attributes.name: geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Primary key for geofence_zone

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility associated with this geofence zone (e.g., landfill, transfer station, depot).

attributes.name: service_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service area that this geofence zone belongs to or supports.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address or location descriptor for the geofence zone (organizational contact data).

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, building, or unit number for the geofence zone (organizational contact data).

attributes.name: alert_on_entry
attributes.description: Indicates whether an alert should be triggered when a vehicle enters this geofence zone.

attributes.name: alert_on_exit
attributes.description: Indicates whether an alert should be triggered when a vehicle exits this geofence zone.

attributes.name: allowed_vehicle_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of vehicle types permitted to operate within this geofence zone (e.g., ASL, FEL, REL, roll-off, CNG, RNG).

attributes.name: area_square_meters
attributes.description: Total area covered by the geofence zone in square meters, calculated from the defined geometry.

attributes.name: boundary_coordinates
attributes.description: Serialized representation of the geofence boundary coordinates (e.g., WKT, GeoJSON string) defining the polygon or custom shape.

attributes.name: center_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geofence zone center point in decimal degrees (WGS84).

attributes.name: center_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geofence zone center point in decimal degrees (WGS84).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the geofence zone is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the geofence zone is located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this geofence zone record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this geofence zone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dot_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether operations within this geofence zone are subject to DOT/FMCSA compliance monitoring and reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this geofence zone is deactivated or retired. Null for zones with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this geofence zone becomes active and begins being monitored by telematics systems.

attributes.name: external_zone_code
attributes.description: Identifier for this geofence zone in the external telematics or fleet management system (e.g., Geotab zone ID).

attributes.name: geometry_type
attributes.description: The geometric shape type used to define the geofence zone boundaries (e.g., circle, polygon, rectangle, custom).

attributes.name: hazmat_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this geofence zone is designated for hazardous waste handling and requires special compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: idle_time_threshold_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum allowed idle time in minutes for vehicles within this geofence zone before triggering an alert or compliance violation.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this geofence zone record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this geofence zone record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or operational instructions related to this geofence zone.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the geofence zone location (organizational contact data).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for monitoring and alerting when vehicles enter or exit this geofence zone.

attributes.name: radius_meters
attributes.description: Radius of the geofence zone in meters, applicable when geometry_type is circle. Null for non-circular zones.

attributes.name: requires_cdl
attributes.description: Indicates whether drivers operating within this geofence zone must hold a valid Commercial Driver License (CDL).

attributes.name: restricted_hours
attributes.description: Time ranges during which access to or operations within the geofence zone are restricted (e.g., '22:00-06:00' for noise ordinances).

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.description: Maximum allowed speed in miles per hour for vehicles operating within this geofence zone. Used for compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the geofence zone is located.

attributes.name: telematics_provider
attributes.description: Name of the telematics system provider that monitors this geofence zone (e.g., Geotab Fleet Telematics).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the geofence zone (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago) used for timestamp interpretation.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or identifier for the geofence zone used in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the geofence zone, including its purpose, boundaries, and operational context.

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the geofence zone (e.g., 'Downtown Collection District', 'Landfill Perimeter', 'Customer Service Area 5').

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the geofence zone indicating whether it is actively monitored and enforced.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the geofence zone based on its operational purpose (e.g., service area, facility perimeter, restricted zone, customer site, depot, transfer station).

attributes.name: parent_geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on geofence_zone (parent_geofence_zone_id)

domains.name: maintenance
domains.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance for fleet and facility assets. Manages work orders (WO), maintenance schedules (PM cycles), repair history, parts inventory (BOM), technician assignments, downtime tracking, and maintenance costs. Ensures equipment reliability, regulatory compliance (DOT inspections), and asset lifecycle optimization. Integrates with Infor EAM for CMMS functionality and SAP PM for work order execution.
domains.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management / OSHA Equipment Safety Standards / Infor EAM

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core transactional entity representing a maintenance work order (WO) for fleet vehicles or facility assets. Captures WO type (preventive/corrective/emergency), priority, status lifecycle (open, in-progress, on-hold, closed), originating system (SAP PM or Infor EAM), estimated vs. actual labor hours, estimated vs. actual cost, downtime start/end, failure description, root cause, corrective action taken, safety clearance flags (LOTO), DOT inspection linkage, and regulatory compliance indicators. SSOT for all maintenance execution records.
products.reference: SAP PM Work Order / Infor EAM Work Order

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the maintenance work order record in the Databricks Silver layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Entity; SAP PM Order Object
