attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Work orders generating hazardous waste (parts cleaning, fluid changes, contaminated materials) must reference approved waste profiles for proper characterization, manifest preparation, and disposal co

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Total actual cost incurred for the work order upon completion, including actual labor, parts consumed, and external contractor charges in USD. Posted to the SAP FI/CO cost center. Used for EBITDA reporting, maintenance budget variance, and asset lifecycle cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Actual Cost Settlement; Infor EAM Actual Cost; GAAP ASC 360; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the maintenance work was completed and the asset was returned to service. Used to calculate actual labor duration, downtime, and mean time to repair (MTTR) metrics.
attributes.references: SAP PM Actual Finish (IEDD/IETD); Infor EAM Actual End; ISO 55001

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of labor hours expended by technicians to complete the work order. Captured from time confirmations in SAP PM or Infor EAM. Used for labor cost calculation, productivity analysis, and maintenance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Actual Work (ISMNW); Infor EAM Actual Hours; GAAP Labor Cost Capitalization

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the technician began executing the work order. Used to calculate schedule adherence, labor hours, and downtime duration. Compared against scheduled_start_date for KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Actual Start (ISDD/ISTD); Infor EAM Actual Start; ISO 55001 Performance Monitoring

attributes.name: asset_meter_reading
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Meter Reading at Work Order
attributes.description: Odometer (miles) or engine hours reading of the asset at the time the work order was executed. Used to track PM intervals (e.g., oil change every 5,000 miles), calculate mean time between failures (MTBF), and validate DOT inspection compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PM Counter Reading (ZAEHL); Infor EAM Meter Reading; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.3

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the work order was formally closed in the originating system, confirming all costs have been settled and the asset has been returned to service. Used for cycle time analysis, cost settlement confirmation, and regulatory record completion.
attributes.references: SAP PM Order Close (TECO); Infor EAM WO Close Date; SOX Section 404; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.21

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Free-text description of the repair, adjustment, or corrective action performed by the technician to resolve the failure. Captured at work order completion. Required for DOT inspection records and OSHA incident documentation.
attributes.references: SAP PM Activity Text (LTXT); Infor EAM Corrective Action; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the work order was first created in the originating system (SAP PM or Infor EAM). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category. Used for aging analysis, SLA measurement, and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP PM ERDAT/ERUHR; Infor EAM Creation Date; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: dot_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work order is associated with or fulfills a DOT vehicle inspection requirement under 49 CFR Part 396. When True, the work order record serves as part of the DOT inspection documentation and must be retained per regulatory retention schedules.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11 (Driver Vehicle Inspection Reports); DOT 49 CFR Part 396.21 (Periodic Inspection)

attributes.name: dot_inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of DOT inspection associated with this work order, if applicable. Annual = federally mandated annual vehicle inspection; Pre_Trip = driver pre-trip inspection defect repair; Post_Trip = post-trip defect repair; Roadside = repair following roadside enforcement inspection; None = not a DOT inspection work order.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.17 (Periodic Inspection Standards)

attributes.name: downtime_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset was returned to operational service following maintenance completion. Used with downtime_start_timestamp to calculate total asset downtime duration for fleet availability reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Downtime End; SAP PM Breakdown End; ISO 55001 Availability Metrics

attributes.name: downtime_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset was taken out of service due to the maintenance event. May precede actual_start_timestamp if the asset was grounded before a technician was assigned. Critical for fleet availability and route impact analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Downtime Start; SAP PM Breakdown Start; NWRA Fleet Availability KPI

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost of the work order at time of creation, including planned labor, parts, and external services in USD. Used for budget planning, purchase order approval thresholds, and maintenance cost forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Planned Cost (KOSTO); Infor EAM Estimated Cost; GAAP ASC 360; SOX Cost Controls

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Planned number of labor hours required to complete the work order, as estimated at time of creation. Used for workforce scheduling, capacity planning, and cost estimation. Compared against actual_labor_hours for variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP PM Planned Work (ARBEI); Infor EAM Estimated Hours; SWANA Maintenance Cost Benchmarks

attributes.name: external_service_cost
attributes.description: Cost of external contractor or vendor services engaged to complete or support the work order in USD. Linked to purchase orders (PO) in SAP MM. Relevant for outsourced repairs, specialized inspections, and warranty work.
attributes.references: SAP MM External Service (ML81N); Infor EAM Contractor Cost; GAAP Service Expense Recognition

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the type of failure or defect (e.g., brake failure, hydraulic leak, engine fault). Sourced from the SAP PM or Infor EAM failure catalog. Enables structured failure mode analysis and fleet reliability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Cause Code (URSAC); Infor EAM Failure Code; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Coding Standards

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the observed failure, defect, or maintenance need that triggered the work order. Captured by the requestor or technician. Used for root cause analysis, failure mode trending, and regulatory incident documentation.
attributes.references: SAP PM Malfunction Description (QMTXT); Infor EAM Problem Description; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147

attributes.name: loto_cleared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required LOTO energy isolation procedure has been completed and verified prior to work commencement. Must be True before work begins on LOTO-required work orders. Supports OSHA compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147; SAP EHS Permit-to-Work; Infor EAM Safety Clearance

attributes.name: loto_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) energy isolation procedures are required before executing this work order. Mandatory safety clearance flag per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 for work on equipment with hazardous energy sources (hydraulics, electrical, pneumatic).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (Control of Hazardous Energy); SAP EHS Safety Permit; Infor EAM Safety Plan

attributes.name: meter_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the asset_meter_reading field. Miles or kilometers for vehicle odometers; hours for engine hour meters; cycles for equipment with cycle-based PM intervals.
attributes.references: SAP PM Counter Unit (ZAEHL); Infor EAM Meter UOM; DOT 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: originating_system
attributes.description: Source system that created and owns this work order record. Determines the authoritative system of record for reconciliation. SAP_PM indicates SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance module; INFOR_EAM indicates Infor Enterprise Asset Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Infor EAM CMMS

attributes.name: parts_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost of spare parts and materials consumed during work order execution in USD. Sourced from SAP MM goods issue or Infor EAM parts transactions. Enables parts vs. labor cost split analysis for maintenance optimization.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Cost (MATNR/DMBTR); Infor EAM Parts Cost; GAAP Inventory Expensing

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number from SAP MM associated with external services or parts procurement for this work order. Links maintenance execution to the procurement process for AP matching and spend management.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order (EBELN); Infor EAM PO Reference; GAAP AP Matching

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the work order, driving scheduling urgency and resource allocation. Critical = immediate safety or regulatory risk (e.g., brake failure, DOT out-of-service condition); High = significant operational impact; Medium = moderate impact; Low = minor issue; Routine = standard PM cycle.
attributes.references: SAP PM Priority (PRIOK); Infor EAM Priority; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 (Safety Priority)

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work order is required to satisfy a regulatory compliance obligation beyond DOT (e.g., EPA equipment inspection, OSHA mandated maintenance, RCRA hazardous waste equipment certification, Clean Air Act emission control maintenance). Triggers enhanced documentation and retention requirements.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; Clean Air Act Section 112

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the maintenance need was identified and the work order was formally requested. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP canonical category. Distinct from created_timestamp (system entry time) — captures the real-world trigger date for SLA and compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP PM Basic Start Date (GSTRP); Infor EAM Required Date; ISO 55001

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Technician-documented root cause of the failure or maintenance need, captured upon work order completion. Supports reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis, repeat failure prevention, and regulatory reporting for DOT and OSHA incidents.
attributes.references: SAP PM Root Cause (URSAC); Infor EAM Root Cause; ISO 55001 Failure Analysis; RCRA Corrective Action

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the maintenance work is expected to be completed. Used for fleet availability commitments, route planning coordination, and maintenance window management.
attributes.references: SAP PM Scheduled Finish (GLTRP); Infor EAM Scheduled End; SWANA Fleet Management Guidelines

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the maintenance work is scheduled to begin. Used for workforce scheduling, parts pre-staging, and fleet availability planning. May differ from actual_start_date if work is rescheduled.
attributes.references: SAP PM Scheduled Start (GSTRP); Infor EAM Scheduled Start; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_wo_reference
attributes.description: Native primary key or internal identifier of this work order in the originating system (SAP PM order number or Infor EAM internal WO ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: SAP PM AUFNR Field; Infor EAM WO_ID

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to the work order record in the originating system. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PM AEDAT; Infor EAM Last Modified Date; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the repair or parts replacement on this work order is eligible for or has been submitted as a warranty claim to the OEM or parts supplier. When True, actual_cost may be partially or fully recovered. Supports warranty recovery tracking and vendor management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP PM Warranty Claim; GAAP Warranty Accounting

attributes.name: wo_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable work order number assigned by the originating system (SAP PM or Infor EAM). Used for cross-system reference, technician communication, and regulatory documentation such as DOT inspection records.
attributes.references: SAP PM PM01 Order Number; Infor EAM WO Number; DOT 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: wo_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the work order. Open = created but not started; In_Progress = technician actively working; On_Hold = paused pending approval or resources; Pending_Parts = awaiting parts from inventory; Completed = work finished, pending closure review; Closed = fully closed and costed; Cancelled = voided without execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_progress|on_hold|pending_parts|completed|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PM System Status (STAT); Infor EAM WO Status; ISO 55001 Asset Management

products.name: pm_schedule
products.description: Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule master defining recurring maintenance cycles for fleet and facility assets. Stores PM plan type (time-based, meter-based, condition-based), frequency interval (days, miles, engine hours), last performed date/meter reading, next due date/meter reading, estimated duration, assigned crew or technician role, associated task list, DOT inspection cycle flags, and active/inactive status. Sourced from Infor EAM PM module and SAP PM maintenance plans.
products.reference: Infor EAM PM Plan / SAP PM Maintenance Plan

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PM schedule record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Populated by the ingestion pipeline. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data model conventions.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this PM schedule becomes active and begins generating work orders. Allows future-dated PM plans to be configured in advance (e.g., when a new asset is commissioned or a regulatory requirement takes effect).
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans; ISO 55001

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of labor hours required to complete the PM task. Used for technician scheduling, crew capacity planning, and asset downtime forecasting. Sourced from the task list standard times in Infor EAM or SAP PM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Task Lists; SAP PM Task List (IA01); SWANA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: estimated_labor_cost
attributes.description: Estimated labor cost to complete one cycle of this PM task, in US dollars. Calculated from estimated_duration_hours multiplied by the applicable technician labor rate. Used for maintenance budget planning and COGS allocation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Labor Rates; SAP PM Cost Planning; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: estimated_parts_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of parts and materials required to complete one cycle of this PM task, in US dollars. Sourced from the Bill of Materials (BOM) associated with the task list. Used for maintenance budget planning and cost forecasting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM BOM; SAP PM Bill of Materials; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this PM schedule is no longer active and will not generate new work orders. Applicable for temporary PM plans, asset disposal schedules, or time-limited regulatory inspection programs. Null for open-ended schedules.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans; ISO 55001

attributes.name: frequency_interval
attributes.description: Numeric value representing how often the PM task recurs, interpreted in conjunction with frequency_unit. For example, a value of 90 with frequency_unit of 'days' means every 90 days. For meter-based plans, this is the meter increment (e.g., 5000 miles).
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Strategy Cycles

attributes.name: frequency_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the frequency_interval. Defines whether the PM cycle is driven by elapsed time (days, weeks, months) or asset utilization meters (miles, engine_hours, operating_hours). Critical for calculating next due date or meter reading.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Strategy; DOT FMCSA Inspection Intervals

attributes.name: functional_location_code
attributes.description: SAP PM or Infor EAM functional location code identifying the physical installation point or system hierarchy node where the asset is installed (e.g., fleet depot bay, landfill pump station). Supports hierarchical maintenance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Functional Location (IL01); Infor EAM Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: is_dot_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM schedule represents a federally mandated Department of Transportation (DOT) vehicle inspection cycle (e.g., annual inspection per 49 CFR Part 396.17). When true, completion records are subject to DOT recordkeeping requirements and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396; NWRA Fleet Safety Standards

attributes.name: is_epa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM schedule is mandated by EPA environmental regulations (e.g., landfill gas (LFG) collection system inspections, leachate system checks, or CNG fueling station inspections). When true, records are subject to EPA reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart WWW; Clean Air Act; RCRA; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: is_osha_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM schedule is mandated by OSHA regulations (e.g., crane inspections per 29 CFR 1910.179, powered industrial truck inspections per 29 CFR 1910.178). When true, records must be retained per OSHA recordkeeping requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; OSHA 29 CFR 1926; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: last_performed_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the most recent PM task was completed for this schedule. Used as the baseline for calculating the next due date for time-based plans. Populated from work order completion records in Infor EAM or SAP PM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Completion; SAP PM Order Confirmation

attributes.name: last_performed_meter_reading
attributes.description: Odometer (miles) or engine hour meter reading recorded at the time the most recent PM was completed. Used as the baseline for calculating the next due meter reading for meter-based plans. Sourced from Geotab Fleet Telematics or Infor EAM meter readings.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Meter Readings; Geotab Fleet Telematics; DOT FMCSA

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the next_due_date that a work order should be automatically generated to allow for parts procurement, technician scheduling, and asset availability planning. Ensures PM tasks are not missed due to resource constraints.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Scheduling Parameters; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated calendar date by which the next PM task must be completed. For time-based plans, derived from last_performed_date plus frequency_interval. Drives work order generation and maintenance scheduling. Critical for DOT compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Scheduling; DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: next_due_meter_reading
attributes.description: Calculated odometer or engine hour meter value at which the next PM task must be performed. For meter-based plans, derived from last_performed_meter_reading plus frequency_interval. Null for time-based plans.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Scheduling; Geotab Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for maintenance planners to record special instructions, regulatory references, seasonal considerations, or asset-specific requirements associated with this PM schedule. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the PM schedule plan (e.g., 'Annual DOT Brake Inspection – Class 8 Trucks', 'Monthly Compactor Hydraulic Service'). Used for display and reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the PM plan as assigned in Infor EAM or SAP PM. Used for cross-system reference and audit trail. Format: PM- followed by 4-20 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans (IP01/IP02)

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this PM schedule, used for work order queue management and resource allocation when multiple PM tasks compete for the same technician or asset downtime window. Critical priority is reserved for safety-critical and regulatory-mandated inspections.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Priority Codes; SAP PM Priority; NWRA Fleet Safety Standards

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent revision to this PM schedule was approved and applied. Used in conjunction with revision_number for change history tracking and regulatory audit documentation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Change Management; SAP PM Maintenance Plans; ISO 55001; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter incremented each time the PM schedule definition is modified (e.g., frequency change, task list update, regulatory requirement change). Supports change management and audit trail for compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Change Management; SAP PM Maintenance Plans; ISO 55001; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PM schedule record. Active schedules generate work orders on due dates. Suspended schedules are temporarily paused (e.g., asset out of service). Archived schedules are retained for historical reference.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans; ISO 55001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this PM schedule record was sourced: Infor EAM PM module, SAP PM maintenance plans, or manually entered. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_plan_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this PM plan record in the originating source system (Infor EAM plan number or SAP PM maintenance plan number). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Maintenance Plans (IP01); Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: technician_role
attributes.description: Skill or trade classification required to perform this PM task. Used for workforce planning and technician qualification matching. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanic|electrician|hydraulic_tech|tire_tech|inspector|welder|general_tech — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Classifications; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT CDL Requirements

attributes.name: tolerance_days
attributes.description: Allowable number of days before or after the next_due_date within which the PM task can be completed without being flagged as overdue. Provides scheduling flexibility while maintaining compliance. Negative values indicate early completion tolerance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Scheduling Tolerance; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: tolerance_meter_units
attributes.description: Allowable meter reading variance (miles or engine hours) above or below the next_due_meter_reading within which the PM task can be completed without being flagged as overdue. Applicable only to meter-based PM plans. Null for time-based plans.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Module; SAP PM Scheduling Tolerance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PM schedule record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Updated by the ingestion pipeline on each delta load. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data model conventions.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance; ISO 8601

attributes.name: work_order_type
attributes.description: Type of work order that will be generated when this PM schedule triggers. Aligns with SAP PM order types and Infor EAM work order categories. PM is standard preventive maintenance, inspection is a check-only task, lubrication is a fluid service, calibration is for measurement equipment, and overhaul is a major rebuild.

products.name: wo_task

Enables granular tracking of multi-step maintenance procedures and technician productivity.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id

attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Schedule; SAP PM Maintenance Plan; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.3

attributes.name: primary_wo_employee_id

attributes.name: primary_work_order_id

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp

attributes.references: Infor EAM Actual Finish; SAP PM Actual Finish Date/Time; NWRA Fleet Uptime Standards

attributes.name: actual_labor_cost
attributes.description: Actual labor cost incurred for this task based on actual hours worked and the technician's labor rate. Feeds into work order total cost and asset maintenance cost reporting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Actual Labor Cost; SAP PM Actual Labor Costs; GAAP ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: Actual labor hours recorded by the technician upon task completion. Compared against estimated hours for variance analysis, technician productivity measurement, and future labor estimate refinement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Actual Labor; SAP PM Actual Work; NWRA Technician Productivity KPIs

attributes.name: actual_parts_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost of parts and materials consumed during task execution, recorded upon parts issuance from inventory. Used for work order cost variance analysis and asset lifecycle cost tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Actual Material Cost; SAP PM Actual Costs; GAAP ASC 360 Asset Maintenance

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the technician actually began executing this task. Captured via CMMS mobile app or time-clock entry. Used for schedule adherence analysis and downtime duration calculation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Actual Start; SAP PM Actual Start Date/Time; DOT 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this task record was first created in the CMMS system, either by the work order planner or automatically generated from a PM schedule. Supports audit trail requirements and SOX financial controls for maintenance cost records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Infor EAM Record Audit; SAP PM System Timestamp; ISO 14001 Records Management

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any defect, fault, or abnormal condition discovered during task execution. Populated by the technician and used to initiate corrective work orders, parts procurement, and safety incident reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Defect Notes; DOT DVIR Defect Remarks; OSHA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: defect_found_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a defect, fault, or out-of-tolerance condition was identified during execution of this task. Triggers corrective action workflow and defect documentation in Infor EAM and Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Defect Reporting; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.217

attributes.name: dot_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this task constitutes or contributes to a federally mandated Department of Transportation (DOT) vehicle inspection under 49 CFR Part 396. Triggers regulatory documentation requirements and inspection record retention obligations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.21; FMCSA Inspection Requirements

attributes.name: downtime_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes the asset was taken out of service specifically for this task. Contributes to overall work order downtime and feeds fleet availability and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) calculations. Distinct from labor hours as it includes wait time for parts or approvals.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Downtime Tracking; NWRA Fleet Availability Benchmarks; SAP PM Downtime

attributes.name: estimated_labor_cost
attributes.description: Planned labor cost for this task calculated from estimated labor hours multiplied by the technician's standard labor rate. Used for work order cost budgeting and maintenance financial planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Planned Labor Cost; SAP PM Planned Labor Costs; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Planned labor hours required to complete this task, derived from the standard task template or planner estimate. Used for work order scheduling, technician capacity planning, and maintenance cost budgeting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Planned Labor; SAP PM Planned Work; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Benchmarks

attributes.name: estimated_parts_cost
attributes.description: Planned cost of parts and materials required for this task, derived from the Bill of Materials (BOM) and current inventory pricing. Used for work order cost estimation and maintenance budget planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Planned Material Cost; SAP PM Planned Costs; GAAP ASC 360 Asset Maintenance

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of an inspection task, indicating whether the inspected component passed, failed, or passed with conditions. Required for DOT inspection records and regulatory compliance reporting. Null for non-inspection task types.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11; FMCSA Driver Vehicle Inspection Report (DVIR); Enviance EHS Inspection Records

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this task record was most recently modified, including status changes, labor hour updates, or technician note additions. Supports data lineage tracking and change audit requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Infor EAM Record Audit; SAP PM Change Document; ISO 14001 Records Management

attributes.name: loto_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) energy isolation procedures are required before performing this task, per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147. Enforces hazardous energy control compliance for tasks involving electrical, hydraulic, or pneumatic systems.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 Control of Hazardous Energy; Enviance EHS LOTO Procedures

attributes.name: meter_reading_at_task
attributes.description: Odometer (miles) or engine hours reading recorded at the time this task was performed. Critical for mileage-based and hour-based PM interval tracking, DOT inspection records, and asset lifecycle management in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Meter Reading; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.3; SAP PM Measurement Document

attributes.name: meter_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the meter reading recorded at task execution (e.g., miles for vehicle odometer, hours for engine hour meter). Required to correctly interpret meter_reading_at_task for PM interval calculations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Unit of Measure; SAP PM Measurement Unit; DOT 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: parts_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this task requires one or more parts or materials from inventory to be completed. Drives parts reservation workflow in Infor EAM and SAP MM materials management integration.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Requirement; SAP PM Component Assignment

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) items for this task (e.g., 'safety_glasses,gloves,steel_toe_boots,hearing_protection'). Sourced from the EHS system and enforced per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132 standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132 PPE Requirements; Enviance EHS PPE Matrix; ISO 45001

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this task, which may differ from the parent work order priority if specific steps are more time-critical (e.g., a safety-critical brake inspection step within a broader PM work order). Drives technician scheduling and dispatch sequencing.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Priority Code; SAP PM Priority; NWRA Fleet Safety Standards

attributes.name: required_certification
attributes.description: Specific regulatory or industry certification required to perform this task (e.g., CDL for vehicle brake inspection, ASE for engine diagnostics, DOT_INSPECTOR for federal vehicle inspection). Enforces compliance with DOT 49 CFR Part 396 and OSHA standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CDL|ASE|DOT_INSPECTOR|HAZMAT|OSHA_30|FORKLIFT|NONE|EPA_608|RCRA_HAZWASTE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; ASE Certification Standards

attributes.name: required_skill_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the minimum skill or trade qualification required to perform this task (e.g., 'MECH-DIESEL', 'ELEC-HV', 'HVAC-CERT'). Used for technician assignment validation and workforce capability gap analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Skill Requirement; Workday HCM Skill Profile; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: safety_instructions
attributes.description: Mandatory safety procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO) requirements, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) specifications, and hazard warnings that must be followed before and during task execution. Sourced from EHS system and linked to OSHA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (LOTO); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132 (PPE); Enviance EHS Safety Procedure Library

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the technician is scheduled to begin this task. Used for maintenance scheduling, shift planning, and asset downtime window management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Scheduled Start; SAP PM Scheduled Start Date/Time

attributes.name: skip_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a task was skipped or bypassed in the work order execution. Required when task_status is 'skipped' to maintain audit trail integrity and support PM compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_applicable|deferred|parts_unavailable|asset_unavailable|safety_hold|supervisor_override|weather|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Skip Reason; SAP PM Operation Skip; NWRA PM Compliance Standards

attributes.name: standard_task_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this task to a standardized maintenance task template in the CMMS library (e.g., 'HYD-INSP-001' for hydraulic inspection). Enables consistent task definition, labor estimation benchmarking, and cross-fleet maintenance analytics.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Standard Task; SAP PM Standard Text Key; SWANA Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: task_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the maintenance task to be performed, including the specific action, component, and expected outcome (e.g., 'Inspect and replace hydraulic hose on compactor lift arm'). Sourced from standard task library or entered by planner.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Task Description; SAP PM Operation Short Text

attributes.name: task_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier for the task, typically formatted as the parent WO number suffixed with a task sequence (e.g., WO-2024-00123-T01). Used in technician communications, printed work packets, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Task Code; SAP PM Operation Number

attributes.name: task_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this task within the parent work order, defining the execution sequence of multi-step maintenance procedures (e.g., 10, 20, 30 in SAP PM operation numbering convention). Enables dependency management and step-by-step workflow tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Operation Sequence; SAP PM Operation Activity Number

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the maintenance task within the work order execution workflow. Drives technician dashboard visibility, WO completion logic, and downtime reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|complete|skipped|on_hold|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Task Status; SAP PM Operation Status; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance task by the nature of the work performed. Used for labor planning, parts forecasting, and maintenance cost categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inspection|repair|replacement|lubrication|calibration|cleaning|adjustment|testing|documentation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Activity Type; SAP PM Activity Type; ISO 14001 Maintenance Classification

attributes.name: technician_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the assigned technician to record observations, findings, deviations from standard procedure, or recommendations during task execution. Captured via Infor EAM mobile app and retained for maintenance history and knowledge management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Technician Remarks; SAP PM Long Text; NWRA Maintenance Documentation Standards

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supervisor or quality inspector verified and approved the completed task. Establishes the regulatory sign-off timestamp for DOT inspection records and OSHA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.21; OSHA Recordkeeping Requirements; Infor EAM Approval Timestamp

products.name: parts_usage
products.description: Transactional record of parts and materials consumed against a work order. Captures part number, part description, quantity requested, quantity issued, unit of measure, unit cost, total cost, issuing warehouse/storeroom, reservation number, actual issue date, and return quantity. Links to BOM and parts catalog for traceability. Supports COGS allocation, parts consumption analysis, and reorder triggering. Sourced from Infor EAM parts issuance and SAP MM goods issue.
products.reference: Infor EAM Parts Issue / SAP MM Goods Issue

attributes.name: parts_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parts usage transaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional line entity.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP MM Goods Issue

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Parts consumption for boiler repairs must be tracked at the unit level for maintenance cost allocation, spare parts inventory optimization, and identifying high-wear components requiring design improv

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance technician or mechanic who requested or received the parts issuance. Supports labor-parts correlation and technician productivity analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Labor; Workday HCM Worker

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle or facility asset for which the parts were consumed. Enables asset-level parts cost tracking and lifecycle analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: generated_waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Hazardous parts replacement transactions must reference waste profiles for disposal tracking, manifest preparation, and cost allocation. Critical for tracking waste generation at the transaction level

attributes.name: ghg_emission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ghg_emission. Business justification: Specific parts (refrigerants, hydraulic fluids, solvents) have direct GHG impact when installed or disposed. EPA Section 608 requires tracking refrigerant quantities by work order. Hazmat parts flagge

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: Parts consumed during customer-billable repairs (container parts, compactor components) must map to specific invoice line items. Enables parts cost pass-through billing and reconciliation between main

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Parts used in landfill equipment maintenance must be tracked by site for environmental compliance reporting, cost allocation to specific landfill operations, and regulatory audits. Landfill sites have

attributes.name: parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parts catalog master record identifying the specific part or material consumed. Links to Bill of Materials (BOM) for traceability and reorder analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Catalog; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Purchase Order number associated with the procurement of this part if it was a direct purchase rather than issued from storeroom stock. Links parts usage to procurement spend for total cost of ownership analysis.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: service_offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Parts consumed during service-related maintenance (container parts, compactor components) are tracked against service offerings for cost recovery, warranty claims, and profitability analysis. Real WM

attributes.name: storeroom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issuing warehouse or storeroom from which the part was physically dispensed. Supports inventory location tracking and storeroom replenishment analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Storeroom Management; SAP MM Storage Location

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Generator parts usage tracking enables unit-level cost analysis, critical spares planning, and warranty parts tracking for OEM reimbursement claims on defective components.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Parts usage tracks component consumption by vehicle for cost allocation and inventory planning. Fleet financial analysts need vehicle→parts usage linkage for TCO analysis and parts demand forecasting.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order against which parts were issued. Links parts consumption to the specific maintenance event (corrective or preventive). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order; SAP PM Work Order

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the asset category for which parts were consumed. Distinguishes fleet vehicles (trucks, loaders) from facility assets (compactors, conveyors) and containers for parts spend segmentation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Classification; NWRA Fleet Standards

attributes.name: bom_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) component line from which this parts usage was derived. Enables traceability from actual consumption back to the planned maintenance BOM for variance analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM BOM; SAP PM Bill of Materials

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center to which the parts cost is allocated. Enables departmental cost tracking, budget variance analysis, and financial reporting by organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Cost Allocation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts usage record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion reconciliation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SAP MM Change Log; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international or cross-border maintenance activities.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: dot_inspection_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Inspection Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parts usage was associated with a DOT-required vehicle inspection or compliance repair. Supports regulatory reporting for DOT out-of-service violations and fleet compliance audits.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations 49 CFR Part 396; FMCSA Vehicle Inspection Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code used to post the parts cost in SAP FI. Determines whether the expense is capitalized (asset improvement) or expensed (maintenance COGS) per accounting policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger; GAAP/IFRS IAS 16 Asset Accounting

attributes.name: goods_issue_number
attributes.description: SAP MM goods issue document number generated at the time of physical parts issuance from inventory. Provides cross-system traceability between Infor EAM work order and SAP MM inventory movement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Issue; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: hazmat_part_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the part or material is classified as hazardous (e.g., certain lubricants, solvents, refrigerants). Triggers special handling, storage, and disposal requirements per EPA and OSHA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Hazardous Waste Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the parts were physically issued from the storeroom to the work order. Used for inventory aging, consumption trend analysis, and maintenance scheduling alignment. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT date dimension.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP MM Goods Issue Date

attributes.name: issue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the parts issuance transaction. Tracks progression from initial request through reservation, physical issuance, and potential return. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT lifecycle state.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance Workflow; SAP MM Goods Issue Status

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the parts were physically issued from the storeroom. Enables time-of-day analysis for storeroom operations and supports audit trail requirements. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP MM Goods Issue Timestamp

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this parts usage record within the parent work order. Enables multi-part work orders to be reconstructed in original sequence. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP PM Work Order Components

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or parts manufacturer. Used for vendor performance analysis, warranty tracking, and preferred supplier compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Catalog; SAP MM Manufacturer Part Number

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number as assigned by the manufacturer. Enables cross-referencing between internal catalog numbers and OEM catalogs for procurement and warranty claims.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Catalog; SAP MM Manufacturer Part Number

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this parts usage record in the source system. Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SAP MM Change Log; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for technician or storeroom clerk notes regarding the parts issuance (e.g., substitution reason, special handling instructions, warranty claim details). Supports operational context and audit documentation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance Notes; SAP MM Goods Issue Text

attributes.name: part_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the part type used for spend analysis and inventory segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical|electrical|hydraulic|pneumatic|body|consumable|lubricant|tire|safety|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Classification; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: part_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the part or material consumed (e.g., 'Air Filter - Heavy Duty Diesel', 'Hydraulic Pump Seal Kit'). Supports reporting and technician communication.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Catalog; SAP MM Material Description

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or internal catalog part number uniquely identifying the part or material. Used for procurement, cross-referencing with vendor catalogs, and BOM traceability.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Catalog; SAP MM Material Number

attributes.name: quantity_issued
attributes.description: Actual number of units physically dispensed from the storeroom to the work order. May differ from quantity requested due to partial availability or over-issuance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP MM Goods Issue Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Number of units of the part originally requested by the technician or planner for the work order. Compared against quantity issued to identify fulfillment gaps and partial issuances.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Request; SAP MM Reservation Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: Number of units returned to the storeroom after work order completion because they were not consumed. Used to calculate net consumption and adjust inventory balances.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Return; SAP MM Goods Return

attributes.name: reorder_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parts issuance triggered an automatic reorder request because inventory fell below the minimum reorder point. Supports proactive inventory replenishment and prevents stockout-driven maintenance delays.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Management; SAP MM MRP Reorder Point Planning

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date on which the parts were originally requested or reserved for the work order. Compared against issue date to measure storeroom fulfillment lead time and parts availability performance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Reservation; SAP MM Reservation Date

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known reservation or pick ticket number generated when parts are reserved against a work order prior to physical issuance. Enables pre-staging and kitting of parts for planned maintenance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Reservation; SAP MM Reservation

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date on which unused parts were returned to the storeroom after work order completion. Null if no parts were returned. Used to calculate net consumption and storeroom restocking timelines.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Return; SAP MM Goods Return

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this parts usage record originated. Infor EAM for CMMS-driven issuances, SAP MM for goods issue transactions, or manual for paper-based entries. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Native transaction identifier from the originating source system (Infor EAM parts issuance ID or SAP MM material document number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP MM Material Document

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of parts issued calculated as quantity issued minus quantity returned multiplied by unit cost. Represents the net parts spend charged to the work order for COGS allocation and maintenance budget tracking. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT monetary category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Object Controlling; GAAP COGS

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the parts movement: issue (parts dispensed to work order), return (unused parts returned to storeroom), transfer (moved between storerooms), or adjustment (inventory correction). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT discriminator.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Issuance; SAP MM Movement Type

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or moving average cost per unit of the part at the time of issuance, sourced from SAP MM material valuation. Used for COGS allocation and maintenance cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Accounting; GAAP Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the part quantity (e.g., EA=Each, QT=Quart, GL=Gallon, LB=Pound, KG=Kilogram, FT=Feet, L=Liter). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for inventory valuation consistency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|QT|GL|LB|KG|FT|M|L|BOX|SET|KIT|PR — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parts usage is associated with a warranty claim against the OEM or supplier. Enables warranty cost recovery tracking and vendor chargeback processing.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP PM Warranty Claim

attributes.name: work_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parent work order type indicating whether parts were consumed for planned preventive maintenance (PM), unplanned corrective repair, scheduled inspection, major overhaul, or emergency breakdown response.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Classification; SAP PM Order Type

products.name: repair_history
products.description: Historical record of completed maintenance and repair events for each asset, providing a longitudinal view of asset health and reliability. Captures asset identifier, WO reference, repair type, failure mode, failure code, component repaired, repair description, labor hours, parts cost, total repair cost, technician, completion date, and mileage/hours at repair. Enables MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), and lifecycle cost analysis. Distinct from the active work_order as it represents the closed/archived maintenance record.
products.reference: Infor EAM Repair History / SAP PM Notification History

attributes.name: repair_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each closed/archived repair or maintenance event record in the repair history. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Work Order Management

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Boiler repair history must be tracked at the unit level for reliability analysis, MTBF calculations, warranty claim documentation, and regulatory compliance reporting to state boiler inspectors.

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_source. Business justification: Repair history on emission sources (LFG wells, flares, compressors) is required for EPA annual compliance reports and state air permit renewals. Regulators audit repair frequency, downtime duration, a

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary technician or mechanic who performed and closed the repair. Used for workforce productivity analysis and skill-based routing of future work orders.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Workforce Management; Infor EAM Labor Module

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance facility, shop, or service location where the repair was performed (e.g., fleet maintenance yard, landfill workshop, transfer station). Enables geographic and facility-level maintenance cost and performance analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Location Master; SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: failure_mode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.failure_mode. Business justification: Repair history records should link to standardized failure mode catalog for consistent failure tracking and trend analysis. Currently has failure_mode (STRING) and failure_code (STRING) which duplicat

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle, facility equipment, or infrastructure asset on which the repair or maintenance event was performed. Enables longitudinal asset health and lifecycle cost analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Repair history for landfill equipment must be maintained by site for regulatory inspections, environmental compliance audits, and demonstrating proper maintenance of pollution control equipment. Requi

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule or maintenance plan that triggered this work order, if applicable. Populated for planned/preventive repairs; null for corrective or emergency repairs. Enables PM compliance rate analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Schedule; SAP PM Maintenance Plan

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Generator repair history is essential for performance trending, warranty management, major overhaul planning, and demonstrating equipment reliability to utility offtake partners and insurance underwri

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Repair history tracks vehicle-specific failure patterns, warranty claims, and cost trends. Fleet managers analyze repair history by vehicle for replacement decisions and reliability analysis. Asset_id

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating Work Order (WO) that was executed and subsequently closed to produce this repair history record. Links the archived record back to the active WO lifecycle.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Module; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known asset tag or equipment number (e.g., fleet unit number, facility equipment tag) as assigned in Infor EAM or SAP PM. Enables direct lookup without requiring a join to the asset master.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Master; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the Work Order (WO) was formally closed and archived in the CMMS, creating this repair history record. May differ from completion_timestamp if administrative review or cost settlement occurs after physical completion.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Lifecycle; SAP PM Order Settlement; SOX Financial Close Controls

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the repair or maintenance event was completed and the asset was returned to service. Used to calculate actual repair duration and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR). Distinct from the WO close date which may occur later during administrative closure.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Completion; SAP PM Order Confirmation; ISO 14224

attributes.name: component_repaired
attributes.description: Name or description of the specific component, sub-assembly, or system on the asset that was repaired or replaced (e.g., rear axle, hydraulic pump, compactor blade, engine air filter, brake caliper). Supports Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis and component-level MTBF tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM BOM Module; SAP PM Bill of Materials (BOM); VMRS Component Code Standard

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) cost center code to which the repair costs are allocated. Enables financial reporting of maintenance expenditure by business unit, region, or operational division for EBITDA and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Cost Allocation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this repair history record was first created in the source system (Infor EAM or SAP PM). Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Infor EAM Audit Trail

attributes.name: dot_inspection_number
attributes.description: Official DOT inspection report number assigned by the inspecting authority for DOT-mandated inspections. Required for regulatory compliance documentation and FMCSA audit response. Populated only when is_dot_inspection is True.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.21; FMCSA Inspection Records

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the asset was out of service (unavailable for operations) due to this repair event, from the time it was taken out of service to the time it was returned to active duty. Key input for fleet availability rate and operational impact assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Availability Metrics; Infor EAM Downtime Tracking; SWANA Fleet Benchmarking

attributes.name: engine_hours_at_repair
attributes.description: Engine hour meter reading recorded at the time of repair for hour-metered assets (compactors, generators, heavy equipment, Waste-to-Energy (WTE) plant equipment). Used for hour-based PM interval tracking and MTBF analysis where mileage is not applicable.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Meter Reading; SAP PM Measurement Document; ISO 14224

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code used to post the repair costs in the financial system. Distinguishes between capital expenditure (CapEx) and operating expenditure (OpEx) maintenance costs for GAAP/IFRS financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO General Ledger; GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_dot_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether this repair event was associated with or triggered by a Department of Transportation (DOT) mandated vehicle inspection (e.g., annual inspection per 49 CFR Part 396.17, roadside inspection, or out-of-service order). Critical for DOT compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.17 Annual Inspection; FMCSA Compliance; DOT Out-of-Service Criteria

attributes.name: is_warranty_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether the repair costs are recoverable under an OEM or vendor warranty. When True, triggers the warranty recovery process and cost reclassification from maintenance expense to warranty receivable.
attributes.references: SAP MM Warranty Management; Infor EAM Warranty Module; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Total labor cost in US dollars for this repair event, calculated from technician hours and applicable labor rates. Component of total repair cost and lifecycle cost analysis. Confidential as it reflects internal labor rate structures.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Accounting; Infor EAM Cost Module; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: labor_hours
attributes.description: Total actual labor hours expended by all technicians on this repair event, as recorded in the CMMS time entry. Used for Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) calculation, technician productivity analysis, and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Labor Module; SAP PM Confirmation; ISO 14224

attributes.name: odometer_at_repair
attributes.description: Odometer reading in miles recorded at the time of repair for wheeled fleet assets (trucks, ASL, FEL, REL vehicles). Used to calculate mileage-based Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), establish PM trigger intervals, and support DOT inspection compliance records.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396; Geotab Fleet Telematics; Infor EAM Meter Reading

attributes.name: parts_cost
attributes.description: Total cost in US dollars of all parts and materials consumed during this repair event, sourced from the Bill of Materials (BOM) and parts inventory. Component of total repair cost and lifecycle cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP MM Materials Management; Infor EAM Parts Inventory; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the work order at the time of execution, indicating urgency and impact on fleet availability or regulatory compliance (e.g., critical for DOT out-of-service violations, routine for scheduled Preventive Maintenance (PM)).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Priority; SAP PM Priority; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.9

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP Purchase Order (PO) number associated with external parts procurement or subcontractor services for this repair. Links the maintenance record to the Accounts Payable (AP) process for cost reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order (PO); SAP AP Accounts Payable; GAAP Accrual Accounting

attributes.name: repair_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the work performed, findings, corrective actions taken, and any relevant observations by the technician. Provides the detailed maintenance record for audit, warranty claims, and future diagnostic reference.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Notes; SAP PM Long Text; DOT Inspection Records

attributes.name: repair_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the repair history record. Completed indicates work was finished and verified; closed indicates the WO was formally archived; cancelled indicates the WO was voided; deferred indicates work was postponed and re-scheduled.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Lifecycle; SAP PM Order Status Management

attributes.name: repair_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance event: corrective (reactive repair after failure), preventive (scheduled Preventive Maintenance (PM) cycle), predictive (condition-based), emergency (unplanned critical failure), or inspection (DOT/regulatory inspection). Drives MTBF and MTTR segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance Data; DOT 49 CFR Part 396; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date the failure, defect, or maintenance need was first reported or identified, either by a driver vehicle inspection report (DVIR), operator, or automated telematics alert. Establishes the start of the repair lifecycle for Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) calculation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.11 Driver Vehicle Inspection Report (DVIR); Geotab Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Technician or engineer analysis of the underlying root cause of the failure or maintenance need (e.g., deferred maintenance, operator misuse, manufacturing defect, environmental exposure). Supports root cause analysis (RCA) and continuous improvement programs.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance Data; OSHA Incident Investigation Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date the maintenance or repair event was scheduled to be performed, as planned in the Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule or work order dispatch. Used to measure schedule adherence and PM compliance rate.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP PM Maintenance Plan

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this repair history record was sourced (Infor EAM for asset-centric maintenance, SAP PM for work order execution, or Manual for paper-based records). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the technician physically began work on the asset. Used as the primary business event timestamp for Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) calculation and technician utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Labor Time Entry; SAP PM Confirmation; ISO 14224

attributes.name: subcontractor_cost
attributes.description: Cost in US dollars paid to external vendors or subcontractors for work performed on this repair event (e.g., specialized engine rebuilds, body shop work, OEM warranty repairs). Tracked separately from internal labor cost for make-vs-buy analysis.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order (PO); Infor EAM Subcontractor Module; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: supervisor_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the maintenance supervisor or fleet manager who reviewed and approved the completed repair before work order closure. Required for DOT annual inspection certification and internal quality control.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396.17 Inspection Certification; Infor EAM Work Order Approval Workflow

attributes.name: technician_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary technician who performed the repair, as recorded at the time of work order closure. Retained in the historical record for audit and accountability purposes even if the technician record changes. Classified confidential as it is employee data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Records; DOT 49 CFR Part 396.21 Inspection Certification

attributes.name: total_repair_cost
attributes.description: Total cost in US dollars for the complete repair event, encompassing labor, parts, subcontractor, and any other direct costs. Primary financial metric for asset lifecycle cost analysis, EBITDA impact assessment, and repair vs. replace decision support.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Settlement; Infor EAM Cost Module; GAAP Cost Accounting; IFRS 16

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this repair history record in the source system. Supports incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Infor EAM Audit Trail

attributes.name: vmrs_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vehicle Maintenance Reporting Standards (VMRS) System Code
attributes.description: Three-digit Vehicle Maintenance Reporting Standards (VMRS) system code identifying the major vehicle system affected by the repair (e.g., 011 = Air Brakes, 013 = Cooling System, 032 = Engine). Industry-standard classification for fleet maintenance benchmarking and DOT compliance reporting.
attributes.references: American Trucking Associations (ATA) VMRS Code Standard; DOT 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: warranty_claim_number
attributes.description: OEM or vendor-assigned warranty claim reference number for repairs covered under warranty. Populated only when is_warranty_claim is True. Used to track warranty recovery status and receivable amounts.
attributes.references: SAP MM Warranty Management; Infor EAM Warranty Module

attributes.name: wo_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known Work Order (WO) number assigned by the CMMS (Infor EAM or SAP PM) at the time the work order was created. Serves as the primary business identifier for cross-system traceability and audit.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Module; SAP PM Module; DOT Inspection Records

products.name: downtime_event
products.description: Captures discrete asset downtime events resulting from maintenance activities or unplanned failures. Records asset identifier, downtime start timestamp, downtime end timestamp, total downtime duration (hours), downtime category (planned PM, unplanned breakdown, awaiting parts, awaiting technician, DOT hold), impact on operations (route cancellation, service disruption), associated work order, and cost of downtime. Critical for fleet availability KPI tracking and operational impact assessment.

attributes.name: downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each discrete asset downtime event record in the maintenance domain.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance Data Standard

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Boiler failures cause operational downtime events that must be tracked at the unit level for availability factor calculations, lost generation reporting, and power purchase agreement performance metri

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.cell. Business justification: Equipment downtime in specific landfill cells affects airspace consumption rates, daily cover operations, and cell-specific operational planning. Operations track which cell was impacted to adjust dai

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance facility, depot, or garage where the asset is being serviced during the downtime event.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Facility Master; SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: failure_mode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.failure_mode. Business justification: Downtime events are caused by specific failure modes. Currently has failure_mode (STRING) and failure_cause (STRING) which should reference the standardized failure_mode catalog for consistent root ca

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle or facility asset that experienced the downtime event. Links to the asset master record in the asset management domain.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Master; SAP PM Equipment Master (IE01)

attributes.name: ghg_emission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ghg_emission. Business justification: Emission control equipment downtime (flare outages, LFG system failures) triggers quantifiable fugitive methane emissions that must be calculated and reported to EPA under GHGRP. Each downtime event g

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Equipment downtime events caused by or resulting in safety incidents. Real business need: incident investigation includes equipment failure analysis; downtime cost attribution to incidents for workers

attributes.name: near_miss_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.near_miss. Business justification: Downtime events may be preceded by near-miss incidents (equipment malfunction almost causing injury). Real business process: leading indicator tracking for predictive safety management. Waste Manageme

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule that triggered this planned downtime event. Populated only for planned_pm downtime category. Links to the PM schedule master in the maintenance domain.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP PM Maintenance Plan (IP01)

attributes.name: primary_downtime_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance technician or mechanic assigned to resolve the downtime event. Links to the workforce/employee record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Record; Infor EAM Labor Management
