attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Turbine major inspections, generator rewinds, and rotor balancing are typically subcontracted vendor work requiring unit-level tracking for cost control and performance guarantee verification.

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.maintenance_type. Business justification: Subcontracted maintenance work should be classified by standardized maintenance type for consistent cost tracking and vendor performance analysis. Currently has work_type (STRING) which should referen

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Subcontracted work tracks external vendor services by vehicle (body repairs, specialized equipment). Fleet procurement managers need vehicle→subcontract linkage for vendor performance analysis and cos

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external vendor or specialty repair shop performing the subcontracted maintenance work. Used for vendor performance management and spend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master; Infor EAM — Supplier Record

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent maintenance work order (WO) that triggered this subcontracted service engagement. Links subcontract activity back to the originating WO in the CMMS.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order; SAP PM Module — PM Order

attributes.name: actual_invoiced_cost
attributes.description: The actual amount invoiced by the vendor upon completion of the subcontracted maintenance work. Compared against quoted cost to identify cost overruns and support three-way match in SAP AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Vendor Invoice; Oracle Revenue Management — AP; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the subcontract work authorization. Controls whether work may proceed and whether invoices may be processed. Values: pending, approved, rejected, cancelled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Approval Workflow; SOX Compliance — Procurement Controls

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the asset category on which subcontracted work is performed. Distinguishes fleet vehicles (ASL, FEL, REL trucks) from facility equipment, containers, or infrastructure assets.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Category; SAP PM — Equipment Category; DOT Fleet Regulations

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center code to which the subcontracted maintenance expense is charged. Enables departmental cost allocation, EBITDA reporting, and maintenance budget tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Center; GAAP/IFRS Cost Allocation; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: cost_variance
attributes.description: Difference between actual invoiced cost and quoted cost (actual_invoiced_cost minus quoted_cost). Positive value indicates cost overrun; negative indicates savings. Supports vendor performance management and budget control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Variance; GAAP/IFRS Cost Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subcontract work record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports SOX compliance audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Record Creation Timestamp; Infor EAM — Created Date; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this subcontract work record (quoted cost, invoiced cost). Typically USD for domestic operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: dot_inspection_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Inspection Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subcontracted work is related to a DOT vehicle inspection, safety defect correction, or regulatory compliance repair. True flags the record for DOT compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations (FMCSR); 49 CFR Part 396 — Vehicle Inspection and Maintenance

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was out of service due to the subcontracted maintenance work. Used for fleet availability KPI reporting, route impact analysis, and maintenance cost-of-downtime calculations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Downtime Tracking; Geotab Fleet Telematics — Asset Availability; NWRA Fleet Performance KPIs

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of equipment failure or defect that necessitated the subcontracted repair. Supports failure mode analysis and reliability engineering.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Failure Code; SAP PM — Damage Code; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code for posting the subcontracted maintenance expense in SAP FI/CO. Ensures correct financial classification of external maintenance spend.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — General Ledger; GAAP/IFRS Chart of Accounts; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on the vendor's invoice for the subcontracted maintenance work. Used for AP payment terms calculation, aging analysis, and financial period accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Vendor Invoice Date; GAAP/IFRS Accounts Payable; SOX Controls

attributes.name: make_vs_buy_category
attributes.description: Classification of the business reason for subcontracting this maintenance work rather than performing it in-house. Supports make-vs-buy analysis and strategic workforce planning. Values: specialty_skill, capacity_overflow, emergency, cost_efficiency, oem_required.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — External Service Reason; SAP PM — Subcontracting Reason; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: parts_supplied_by
attributes.description: Indicates whether parts and materials for the subcontracted repair were supplied by the external vendor, by Waste Management from internal inventory, or shared between both parties. Affects cost allocation and BOM tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Provision; Infor EAM — Parts Responsibility; BOM Management

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: The externally communicated purchase order (PO) number issued to the vendor for this subcontracted work. Used for invoice matching, three-way match, and AP reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order; GAAP/IFRS Procurement Controls

attributes.name: promised_completion_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor committed to completing the subcontracted work at time of engagement. Compared against actual completion date to measure vendor on-time delivery performance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Required By Date; SAP PM — Required End Date; SLA Management

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the completed subcontracted work passed internal quality inspection and was formally accepted. False triggers rework requests or dispute initiation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Service Entry Acceptance; SAP PM — Technical Completion; ISO 45001 Quality Controls

attributes.name: quoted_cost
attributes.description: The vendor's quoted price for the subcontracted maintenance work prior to work commencement. Used as the baseline for budget approval, make-vs-buy analysis, and variance tracking against actual invoiced cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Value; GAAP/IFRS Cost Accounting; SOX Procurement Controls

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subcontracted work is required to meet a specific regulatory compliance obligation (EPA, OSHA, RCRA, DOT). True requires associated compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT FMCSR; RCRA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: scope_of_work
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the maintenance work scope assigned to the external vendor. Includes specific repair tasks, components to be serviced, and expected deliverables. Sourced from Infor EAM service order description.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Service Order Description; SAP PM — Long Text

attributes.name: service_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external vendor completed and delivered the subcontracted maintenance work. Used to calculate turnaround time, asset downtime duration, and vendor on-time performance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Actual Finish Date; SAP PM — Actual Finish Date; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: service_location_type
attributes.description: Indicates where the subcontracted maintenance work was physically performed. Distinguishes on-site repairs at Waste Management facilities from work performed at the vendor's shop, dealer, or via mobile service unit.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Service Location; SAP PM — Work Center Location; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external vendor commenced the subcontracted maintenance work at the site or shop. Used for scheduling, downtime tracking, and SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Actual Start Date; SAP PM — Actual Start Date; DOT Fleet Compliance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this subcontract work record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Infor EAM and SAP PM in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse — Data Lineage; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this subcontract work record in the originating operational system (Infor EAM service order ID or SAP PM service entry sheet number). Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Service Order ID; SAP PM — Service Entry Sheet; Enterprise Data Governance

attributes.name: subcontract_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for the subcontract work record. Used in vendor communications, PO references, and invoice matching. Format: SC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — External Service Order Number; SAP PM — Service Entry Sheet

attributes.name: technician_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the internal maintenance technician or supervisor regarding the subcontracted work, including observations at handoff, acceptance inspection findings, or follow-up actions required.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Notes; SAP PM — Long Text

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the subcontract work record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Change Document; Infor EAM — Last Modified Date; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: vendor_completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes provided by the external vendor upon completion of the subcontracted work, describing work performed, parts replaced, and any recommendations. Captured in Infor EAM service entry.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Service Entry Notes; SAP PM — Completion Confirmation Text

attributes.name: vendor_performance_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1.0 to 5.0 scale) assigned to the vendor for this subcontract work engagement, evaluating quality, timeliness, and cost adherence. Feeds vendor performance management and future sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Evaluation; Infor EAM — Supplier Rating; NWRA Vendor Management

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: The vendor's own internal reference or job number for this subcontracted work engagement. Used for invoice reconciliation and vendor communication tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Reference; Infor EAM — External Reference

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a warranty claim has been filed against the vendor for this subcontracted repair work. True if a warranty claim is active or has been submitted.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Warranty Claim; SAP PM — Warranty Claim; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's repair warranty expires. Enables proactive warranty claim management before expiration and supports asset maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Warranty Expiry; SAP PM — Warranty End Date

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Description of the warranty terms provided by the vendor on the completed subcontracted repair work, including duration, coverage scope, and conditions. Supports warranty claim tracking and vendor accountability.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Warranty Record; SAP PM — Warranty Management; NWRA Fleet Standards

attributes.name: work_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subcontracted maintenance work execution. Tracks progression from open engagement through completion, invoicing, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_progress|completed|invoiced|closed|disputed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Service Order Status; SAP PM — Order Status

products.name: warranty_claim
products.description: Warranty claims submitted to OEM manufacturers or parts suppliers for defective components or premature failures covered under warranty agreements. Captures claim number, asset reference, failed component, failure date, failure description, warranty coverage type (OEM vehicle, parts, extended), claim submission date, claim amount, OEM/supplier response, approved reimbursement amount, reimbursement received date, and claim status (submitted, approved, denied, paid). Enables warranty cost recovery tracking and supplier quality management.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the warranty claim record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.adjustment. Business justification: Approved warranty claims on customer equipment result in billing adjustments (credits) when original repair was invoiced. Enables automated customer credit processing when OEM reimburses warranty work

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Warranty claims reference the original equipment purchase contract or service agreement under which warranty coverage was provided. Real business process: warranty cost recovery tracking, contract-bas

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance technician or warranty administrator who submitted the claim to the OEM or supplier. Links to the workforce/employee master in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Master; SAP PM Personnel

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle or facility asset on which the failed component was installed. Links to the asset master in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; DOT Vehicle Inspection Standards

attributes.name: parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the failed component or part in the parts master catalog (Bill of Materials). Links to the parts inventory managed in Infor EAM and SAP MM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Inventory; SAP MM Material Master; Bill of Materials (BOM)

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Warranty claims on emissions/environmental equipment must track permit compliance (failed emissions controls, permit-required monitoring equipment). Link enables demonstrating equipment failures didn'

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Warranty claims track manufacturer warranty recovery by vehicle. Fleet financial managers need vehicle→warranty linkage for cost recovery tracking and OEM performance analysis. Asset_number is denorma

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OEM manufacturer or parts supplier against whom the warranty claim is filed. Links to the vendor/supplier master in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master; Infor EAM Supplier Management

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order that identified the defective component or premature failure triggering this warranty claim. Links to maintenance.work_order.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Management; SAP PM Work Order

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal appeal was submitted to the OEM or supplier for a denied or partially approved claim. Populated only when appeal_flag is True.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Administration

attributes.name: appeal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a denied or partially approved warranty claim has been formally appealed to the OEM or supplier. Enables tracking of appeal activity and outcomes for supplier quality management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Administration

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the formal appeal submitted to the OEM or supplier. Tracks whether the original denial was upheld, fully overturned, or partially overturned following appeal review.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Administration

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount approved by the OEM or supplier for reimbursement. May differ from the claimed amount due to partial approvals, labor rate caps, or disputed items.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting; SAP FI Cost Recovery; Infor EAM Warranty Cost Tracking

attributes.name: asset_meter_at_failure
attributes.description: The odometer or hour-meter reading of the asset at the time of component failure. Used to validate warranty coverage based on mileage or operating hour limits (e.g., 100,000-mile powertrain warranty).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Meter Readings; DOT Vehicle Records; OEM Warranty Terms

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable claim reference number assigned at submission to the OEM manufacturer or parts supplier. Used for all correspondence and tracking with the counterparty. Sourced from Infor EAM warranty module.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP PM Notification

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the warranty claim. Tracks progression from initial submission through OEM/supplier review, approval or denial, and final payment or closure.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP PM Notification Status

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount submitted to the OEM or supplier for reimbursement, including labor costs, parts costs, and any associated repair expenses. Represents the total recovery sought.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting; SAP FI Cost Recovery; Infor EAM Warranty Cost Tracking

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which the warranty claim recovery will be credited upon reimbursement. Enables financial tracking of warranty cost recovery by business unit or operational area.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warranty agreement under which the claim is filed. Distinguishes OEM vehicle warranty, OEM parts warranty, extended warranty contracts, supplier parts warranty, or service contracts. Drives claim routing and recovery expectations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warranty claim record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this claim (claimed, approved, reimbursed). Typically USD for domestic operations. Required for multi-currency financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP Financial Reporting; IFRS

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for claim denial or partial denial by the OEM or supplier (e.g., out-of-warranty, improper installation, normal wear). Supports supplier quality analysis and denial pattern tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: out_of_warranty|improper_installation|normal_wear|missing_documentation|coverage_exclusion|duplicate_claim|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Terms; NWRA Fleet Standards

attributes.name: dot_inspection_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component failure was identified during or is related to a DOT (Department of Transportation) vehicle inspection. Supports regulatory compliance tracking and DOT out-of-service event correlation.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations (FMCSR); 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: failed_component_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the specific component or assembly that failed (e.g., 'hydraulic pump', 'CNG fuel injector', 'compactor blade'). Complements the part number for claim documentation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Component Catalog; SAP MM Material Description

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized failure mode code from the maintenance failure code catalog (e.g., VMRS codes for fleet components). Enables structured failure analysis and supplier quality reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure Codes; VMRS (Vehicle Maintenance Reporting Standards); ATA Codes

attributes.name: failure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the component failure or defect was first observed or reported. Used to validate that the failure occurred within the warranty coverage period.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure Tracking; DOT Vehicle Inspection Records

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the component failure or defect, including observed symptoms, conditions at time of failure, and any diagnostic findings. Supports OEM claim evaluation and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure Analysis; SAP PM Notification Long Text

attributes.name: labor_cost_claimed
attributes.description: The portion of the claimed amount attributable to technician labor hours expended on diagnosing and repairing the failed component. Supports detailed cost recovery analysis by cost category.
attributes.references: SAP PM Labor Cost Tracking; Infor EAM Work Order Costing; GAAP

attributes.name: meter_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the asset meter reading at failure (e.g., miles for vehicle odometer, hours for equipment hour meter). Required to correctly interpret the meter reading for warranty eligibility validation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Meter Configuration; DOT Vehicle Records

attributes.name: oem_claim_reference
attributes.description: The claim reference or RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) number assigned by the OEM manufacturer or parts supplier upon receipt of the claim. Used for external tracking and correspondence.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Administration

attributes.name: oem_response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OEM manufacturer or parts supplier provided their formal response (approval, denial, or request for additional information) to the submitted claim.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Administration

attributes.name: oem_response_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or rationale provided by the OEM or supplier in their claim response, including reasons for denial, partial approval justification, or conditions for reimbursement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Administration

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or internal part number of the failed component. Denormalized for claim correspondence and supplier communication without requiring a join to the parts master.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Inventory; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: part_returned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the failed component was physically returned to the OEM or supplier. Populated only when return_required_flag is True. Used to confirm return compliance and trigger reimbursement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Policy

attributes.name: parts_cost_claimed
attributes.description: The portion of the claimed amount attributable to replacement parts and materials used in the repair of the failed component. Supports detailed cost recovery analysis by cost category.
attributes.references: SAP MM Parts Cost; Infor EAM Parts Usage; GAAP

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP purchase order number associated with the original procurement of the failed component. Used to validate warranty eligibility based on purchase date and supplier contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order; Infor EAM Procurement Integration

attributes.name: reimbursed_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount received from the OEM or supplier as reimbursement. May differ from the approved amount if partial payments were made. Used for accounts receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting; SAP FI AR Module; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: reimbursement_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reimbursement payment was received from the OEM or supplier. Used for cash flow tracking, accounts receivable aging, and warranty recovery performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI AR Module; Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP

attributes.name: return_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OEM or supplier requires the failed component to be physically returned as a condition of claim approval. Drives parts return logistics and core charge management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Policy

attributes.name: source_claim_reference
attributes.description: The native claim identifier from the originating source system (Infor EAM or SAP PM). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer data product and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP PM Notification; Enterprise Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system from which this warranty claim record was sourced. Supports data lineage and reconciliation between Infor EAM, SAP PM, and any manually entered claims.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the warranty claim was formally submitted to the OEM manufacturer or parts supplier. Used to measure claim submission timeliness and track aging.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP PM Notification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warranty claim record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to claim status, amounts, or OEM response details.

attributes.name: warranty_agreement_number
attributes.description: The warranty contract or agreement number under which coverage is claimed. References the specific OEM vehicle warranty, extended warranty contract, or supplier parts warranty agreement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Contracts; SAP MM Outline Agreement

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicable warranty coverage expires. Used to validate claim eligibility and confirm the failure occurred within the coverage window.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; OEM Warranty Terms

products.name: fluid_sample
products.description: Oil and fluid analysis sample records supporting predictive maintenance programs for fleet engines, transmissions, and hydraulic systems. Captures sample ID, asset reference, component sampled (engine oil, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, coolant, DEF), sample date, mileage/hours at sample, laboratory reference, analysis results (viscosity, contamination levels, wear metals ppm, water content), condition assessment (normal, caution, critical), recommended action, and follow-up work order reference. Enables condition-based maintenance decisions.

attributes.name: fluid_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each oil and fluid analysis sample record in the predictive maintenance program. Primary key for the fluid_sample data product.

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Boiler water chemistry samples must be tracked at the unit level for condition monitoring, corrosion prevention, and maintaining boiler efficiency per ASME guidelines and insurance requirements.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle or facility asset from which the fluid sample was collected. Links to the asset master record in Infor EAM for asset lifecycle context.

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Fluid samples from equipment operating at landfill sites should be tracked by site for equipment health monitoring and site-specific maintenance program effectiveness analysis. Enables site-level pred

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Fluid sampling programs are often permit-required (groundwater monitoring, stormwater sampling, underground storage tank testing). Samples must reference the driving permit for compliance demonstratio

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance schedule that triggered this fluid sample collection. Links to the PM cycle definition for condition-based maintenance program tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: primary_fluid_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order associated with the fluid sample collection event. Links to the work_order product for operational context and cost tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: tclp_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.tclp_test. Business justification: Oil analysis samples may require TCLP testing to determine if used fluids are hazardous waste, affecting disposal method and cost. Critical for waste characterization decisions, regulatory compliance,

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Turbine lubricating oil analysis requires unit-level tracking for predictive maintenance, bearing wear monitoring, and determining optimal oil change intervals to prevent catastrophic failures.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Fluid samples track oil analysis results by vehicle for predictive maintenance. Fleet maintenance planners need vehicle→fluid sample linkage for engine health monitoring and PM optimization. Asset_num

attributes.name: aluminum_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of aluminum wear particles in the fluid sample, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Elevated aluminum indicates wear in pistons, bearings, or pump housings.
attributes.references: ASTM D5185 Wear Metals Analysis; ISO 11500

attributes.name: component_sampled
attributes.description: The specific fluid system or component from which the sample was drawn. Identifies the type of fluid analyzed (e.g., engine oil, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, coolant, Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engine_oil|transmission_fluid|hydraulic_fluid|coolant|def|differential_fluid|gear_oil — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: condition_assessment
attributes.description: Overall fluid and component condition rating assigned by the laboratory based on analysis results. Drives maintenance urgency: 'normal' = no action required, 'caution' = monitor closely or schedule service, 'critical' = immediate maintenance action required.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Predictive Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: copper_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of copper wear particles in the fluid sample, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Elevated copper indicates wear in bearings, bushings, thrust washers, or cooler cores.
attributes.references: ASTM D5185 Wear Metals Analysis; ISO 11500

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fluid sample record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement for sample processing workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Total engine operating hours recorded at the time of fluid sample collection. Used for equipment that tracks maintenance intervals by hours rather than mileage (e.g., off-road equipment, generators, compactors).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: fluid_brand
attributes.description: Brand or trade name of the fluid currently in service at the time of sampling (e.g., Shell Rotella, Mobil Delvac, Chevron Delo). Used to correlate fluid performance across brands and validate approved fluid usage.
attributes.references: OEM Fluid Approval Lists; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: fluid_grade
attributes.description: SAE viscosity grade or specification of the fluid in service at the time of sampling (e.g., 15W-40, 5W-30, Dexron VI). Used to validate correct fluid specification and interpret viscosity analysis results.
attributes.references: SAE J300 Engine Oil Viscosity Classification; OEM Fluid Specifications

attributes.name: fluid_hours_in_service
attributes.description: Number of operating hours the sampled fluid has been in service since the last fluid change. Key metric for assessing fluid degradation relative to OEM-recommended change intervals.
attributes.references: OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: fluid_miles_in_service
attributes.description: Number of miles the sampled fluid has been in service since the last fluid change. Used alongside fluid_hours_in_service to assess oil life for on-road fleet vehicles.
attributes.references: OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines; DOT Vehicle Inspection Standards

attributes.name: fuel_dilution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of fuel contamination detected in the engine oil sample. Fuel dilution reduces oil viscosity and lubricating film strength, indicating injector leaks, ring blow-by, or short-trip operation patterns.
attributes.references: ASTM D3524 Fuel Dilution Standard; OEM Engine Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: iron_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of iron wear particles in the fluid sample, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Elevated iron levels indicate wear in cylinder liners, crankshafts, camshafts, or gears depending on the component sampled.
attributes.references: ASTM D5185 Wear Metals Analysis; ISO 11500

attributes.name: lab_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the laboratory analyst interpreting the fluid analysis results. May include trend observations, anomaly explanations, and specific component wear hypotheses.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 17025 Laboratory Competence Standard

attributes.name: lab_name
attributes.description: Name of the external fluid analysis laboratory that processed the sample (e.g., Polaris Laboratories, Analysts Inc., Blackstone Laboratories). Used for vendor performance tracking and result traceability.

attributes.name: lab_received_date
attributes.description: Date the fluid sample was received and logged by the external analysis laboratory. Used to calculate turnaround time and monitor laboratory service level performance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 17025 Laboratory Competence Standard

attributes.name: lab_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the external fluid analysis laboratory to this sample submission. Used to cross-reference laboratory reports, chain-of-custody documentation, and result retrieval.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 4406 Fluid Cleanliness Standards

attributes.name: lead_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of lead wear particles in the fluid sample, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Elevated lead indicates bearing overlay wear, particularly in connecting rod and main bearings.
attributes.references: ASTM D5185 Wear Metals Analysis; ISO 11500

attributes.name: odometer_miles
attributes.description: Vehicle odometer reading in miles at the time the fluid sample was collected. Used to track fluid change intervals, correlate wear metal trends with mileage, and schedule condition-based maintenance.
attributes.references: DOT Vehicle Inspection Standards; OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: particle_count_iso
attributes.description: ISO 4406 cleanliness code representing the particle count per milliliter at 4, 6, and 14 micron thresholds (e.g., '18/16/13'). Used to assess hydraulic fluid cleanliness and filter effectiveness.
attributes.references: ISO 4406 Hydraulic Fluid Cleanliness Standard; ASTM D7647

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Maintenance action recommended by the laboratory based on fluid analysis findings (e.g., 'Change oil at next service', 'Resample in 5,000 miles', 'Immediate engine inspection required'). Drives work order creation and PM schedule adjustments.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Predictive Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: resample_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which a follow-up fluid sample should be collected, as recommended by the laboratory or maintenance planner. Populated when resample_required is True.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Predictive Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: resample_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory or maintenance team has determined that a follow-up fluid sample is required to confirm findings, monitor a developing condition, or validate corrective action effectiveness.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Predictive Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: results_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fluid analysis results were received from the laboratory and made available for maintenance decision-making. Used to measure laboratory turnaround time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 17025 Laboratory Competence Standard

attributes.name: sample_collection_method
attributes.description: Method used to extract the fluid sample from the component. Affects result interpretation as live-zone sampling provides more representative contamination data than drain-plug sampling.
attributes.references: ASTM D7718 Fluid Sampling Procedures; ISO 4021

attributes.name: sample_collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the fluid sample was collected from the asset. Provides higher granularity than sample_date for operational sequencing and integration with telematics data from Geotab.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Geotab Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: sample_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the fluid sample was physically collected from the asset. Used as the principal business event date for trending, scheduling, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OEM Predictive Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier assigned to the fluid sample at time of collection. Used for cross-referencing with laboratory reports, work orders, and Infor EAM sample records. Typically formatted as a lab-assigned or field-assigned alphanumeric code.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fluid sample record, tracking progression from collection through laboratory analysis to closure. Drives workflow actions and follow-up maintenance decisions.

attributes.name: silicon_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of silicon in the fluid sample, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Elevated silicon indicates dirt/dust ingestion through air filtration failures or gasket sealant contamination, accelerating abrasive wear.
attributes.references: ASTM D5185 Wear Metals Analysis; OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: soot_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of soot (combustion byproduct) measured in the engine oil sample. Elevated soot levels indicate incomplete combustion, EGR system issues, or extended oil drain intervals in diesel fleet engines.
attributes.references: ASTM D7844 Soot in Used Engine Oil; OEM Diesel Engine Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which the fluid sample record was ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer (e.g., Infor EAM, SAP PM, manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: technician_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the maintenance technician to record observations at the time of sample collection, such as visible fluid discoloration, unusual odor, or known recent repairs that may affect results.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Equipment Maintenance

attributes.name: total_acid_number
attributes.description: Total Acid Number (TAN) of the sampled fluid in mg KOH/g. Measures fluid oxidation and acidic degradation byproducts. Rising TAN indicates fluid life depletion and increased corrosion risk to engine components.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 Acid Number Standard; OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: total_base_number
attributes.description: Total Base Number (TBN) of the sampled fluid in mg KOH/g. Measures remaining alkaline reserve in engine oil that neutralizes combustion acids. Declining TBN indicates oil life depletion and need for oil change.
attributes.references: ASTM D2896 Base Number Standard; OEM Fluid Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the fluid sample record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with source systems, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: viscosity_cst_100
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the sampled fluid measured at 100 degrees Celsius, expressed in centistokes (cSt). Used to assess viscosity index and high-temperature fluid performance for engine and transmission fluids.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 Kinematic Viscosity Standard; ISO 3104

attributes.name: viscosity_cst_40
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the sampled fluid measured at 40 degrees Celsius, expressed in centistokes (cSt). Deviation from OEM specification indicates fluid degradation, contamination, or incorrect fluid grade.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 Kinematic Viscosity Standard; ISO 3104

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.description: Water contamination level in the sampled fluid, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Elevated water content indicates coolant leaks, condensation ingress, or seal failures that can cause corrosion and accelerated wear.
attributes.references: ASTM D6304 Water in Petroleum Products; ISO 12937

products.name: facility_maintenance_request
products.description: Maintenance requests submitted for fixed facilities including transfer stations, MRF buildings, landfill infrastructure, WTE plants, and administrative offices. Captures request number, facility reference, requestor name/department, request date, problem description, location within facility, urgency level, requested completion date, assigned work order reference, and resolution status. Distinct from fleet work orders — this captures the demand-side intake for facility maintenance needs before WO creation.

attributes.name: facility_maintenance_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the facility maintenance request record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: emergency_response_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.emergency_response_incident. Business justification: Maintenance requests triggered by hazmat spills or releases must link to emergency response incidents for root cause analysis, corrective action tracking, and regulatory reporting. Required for incide

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed facility (transfer station, MRF building, landfill infrastructure, WTE plant, or administrative office) for which maintenance is requested. Links to the facility master record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Facility Master; SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: failure_mode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.failure_mode. Business justification: Facility maintenance requests should reference standardized failure modes for consistent problem classification and prioritization. Currently has failure_code (STRING) which should be replaced with FK

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fixed asset or equipment item within the facility that requires maintenance (e.g., conveyor belt, compactor, HVAC unit, leachate pump). Null if the request is for a structural/civil element rather than a tracked asset.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Master; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: jha_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.jha. Business justification: Facility maintenance work requires Job Hazard Analysis before execution per OSHA requirements. Real business process: pre-work safety planning for confined space entry, elevated work, hazmat handling.

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Maintenance requests for landfill site infrastructure (scale houses, site roads, fencing, environmental monitoring equipment) should link to specific landfill sites for site-specific maintenance track

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost center to which the maintenance costs for this request will be charged. Determines financial accountability and enables cost allocation reporting by facility, department, or business unit.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Cost Allocation; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: parent_request_facility_maintenance_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent facility maintenance request when this request is a follow-up, sub-task, or related recurrence of a prior request. Enables request lineage tracking and recurring issue analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Hierarchy; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Some facility maintenance requests are driven by permit conditions or compliance requirements. This link enables tracking of permit-mandated maintenance and ensures compliance obligations are met thro

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance schedule that triggered this request, if applicable. Null for corrective or emergency requests. Links demand-side intake to the PM plan for schedule compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Schedule; SAP PM Maintenance Plan

attributes.name: primary_facility_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who submitted the maintenance request. Used for accountability, communication, and follow-up notifications. Sourced from Workday HCM employee master.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Master; SAP PM Notification Originator

attributes.name: service_offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Facility maintenance at customer sites (compactor repair, container pad maintenance, scale calibration) is tied to service offerings for billing, cost allocation, and SLA compliance. Real WM operation

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.transfer_station. Business justification: Facility maintenance requests at transfer stations (tipping floor repairs, scale house HVAC, compactor issues) must reference which transfer station for work order routing, facility-specific maintenan

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order created to fulfill this maintenance request. Populated after WO creation; null while request is in pre-approval or pending state. Links the demand-side intake to the execution-side WO.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order; SAP PM Work Order

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the maintenance work was actually completed and the request was resolved. Used for SLA compliance measurement, on-time performance reporting, and backlog aging analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Completion; SAP PM Actual Finish Date; ISO 55001

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the maintenance request was formally approved for work order creation. Used for approval cycle time analysis and audit trail.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Approval Workflow; SOX Compliance; ISO 55001

attributes.name: approved_completion_date
attributes.description: Date confirmed by the maintenance supervisor or planner as the target completion date after reviewing resource availability and priority. May differ from the requestor's requested completion date. Drives SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Scheduling; SAP PM Scheduling; ISO 55001

attributes.name: confined_space_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance work requires entry into a permit-required confined space (e.g., leachate collection vault, underground utility vault, tank). Triggers confined space entry permit workflow per OSHA standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 Permit-Required Confined Spaces; ISO 45001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility maintenance request record was first created in the system of record (Infor EAM). Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SOX Compliance; ISO 55001

attributes.name: downtime_expected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance work is expected to require taking the affected asset or facility area out of service (downtime). Used for operational planning, production scheduling, and capacity impact assessment.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Downtime Planning; ISO 55001 Asset Management; SWANA Operational Standards

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance issue has potential environmental impact such as leachate containment breach, LFG leak, chemical spill, or stormwater system failure. When true, triggers Enviance EHS notification and EPA/state regulatory reporting workflow.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act; EPA Clean Air Act; RCRA; Enviance EHS; CERCLA

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Preliminary cost estimate for completing the requested maintenance work, including labor and parts. Used for budget approval routing, capital vs. expense classification, and maintenance budget forecasting. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Cost Estimation; SAP CO Internal Order; GAAP/IFRS Asset Capitalization Rules

attributes.name: estimated_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of hours the affected asset or facility area will be out of service to complete the maintenance work. Used for operational impact planning and throughput loss estimation. Populated when downtime_expected_flag is true.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Downtime Estimation; ISO 55001; SWANA Operational KPIs

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fixed facility for which maintenance is requested. Drives applicable regulatory requirements, maintenance standards, and routing rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transfer_station|mrf|landfill|wte_plant|admin_office|maintenance_shop|fueling_station — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Solid Waste Facility Classification; RCRA; SWANA Facility Standards

attributes.name: location_within_facility
attributes.description: Specific area, zone, building section, floor, room, or equipment bay within the facility where the maintenance issue is located (e.g., 'Tipping Floor Bay 2', 'Compactor Room', 'Cell 4 Leachate Pump Station'). Enables precise technician dispatch.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Sub-Location; SAP PM Functional Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: loto_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) energy isolation procedures are required to safely perform the maintenance work. When true, LOTO permit must be issued before WO execution. Critical for OSHA compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 Control of Hazardous Energy (LOTO); ISO 45001

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the requestor describing the maintenance issue, observed symptoms, and any relevant context (e.g., 'Conveyor belt on tipping floor making grinding noise and slipping under load since Monday morning'). Primary input for WO creation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Description; SAP PM Notification Long Text

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance request represents a recurring issue that has been reported previously for the same asset or location. When true, triggers root cause analysis workflow and may escalate priority. Supports reliability improvement programs.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure History; ISO 55001 Asset Management; SWANA Reliability Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance request is related to a regulatory compliance requirement such as a permit condition, DOT inspection finding, EPA consent order, or OSHA citation. When true, resolution is tracked against regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Conditions; DOT 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR; RCRA; Enviance EHS Compliance Module

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when a maintenance request is rejected or returned to the requestor. Populated only when request_status is 'rejected'. Supports process improvement and requestor feedback.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Workflow; SAP PM Notification Rejection

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the maintenance request was formally submitted. Used as the principal business event date for SLA calculation, aging analysis, and backlog reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Date; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable request identifier assigned at intake (e.g., FMR-2024-000123). Used for cross-system reference, verbal communication, and audit trails. Sourced from Infor EAM service request numbering sequence.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request; SAP PM Notification Number

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the maintenance request from initial submission through resolution. Drives workflow routing and SLA tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|in_progress|on_hold|completed|cancelled|rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Status; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the maintenance request was submitted, including timezone offset. Used for exact SLA elapsed-time calculations and audit trail.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request; SAP PM Notification Creation Time

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance request by nature of need. Corrective addresses existing failures; preventive is scheduled upkeep; emergency requires immediate response; safety and environmental types trigger regulatory notification workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corrective|preventive|emergency|inspection|safety|environmental|capital_improvement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Request Type; ISO 55001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; EPA Facility Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: requested_completion_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requestor needs the maintenance work to be completed, based on operational or regulatory requirements. Used as input to WO scheduling and SLA target-setting. May differ from the approved scheduled completion date.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Required Date; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: requestor_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit of the employee who submitted the request (e.g., Landfill Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Environmental Compliance). Used for cost allocation and reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Unit; SAP CO Cost Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: requestor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who submitted the maintenance request, captured at time of submission for historical reference even if the employee record changes. Stored as a denormalized snapshot.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; GDPR Article 4 (internal employee data)

attributes.name: requestor_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the requestor for follow-up communication regarding the maintenance request status or clarification of problem details.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Contact; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text summary of how the maintenance issue was resolved, including corrective actions taken, root cause identified, and any follow-up recommendations. Populated upon request closure. Supports knowledge management and recurring issue analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request Resolution; SAP PM Notification Completion Text; ISO 55001

attributes.name: safety_hazard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reported maintenance issue presents an immediate or potential safety hazard to personnel or the public. When true, triggers expedited review and OSHA notification workflow per safety management protocols.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; OSHA 29 CFR 1926; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: source_request_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this maintenance request in the originating source system (e.g., Infor EAM service request ID, SAP PM notification number). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Service Request; SAP PM Notification; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this maintenance request originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Enviance EHS; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this facility maintenance request record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SOX Compliance; ISO 55001

attributes.name: urgency_level
attributes.description: Requestor-assigned urgency classification indicating the business impact and speed of response required. Critical indicates immediate safety or operational risk; high indicates same-day response needed; medium and low allow scheduled response. Drives SLA target assignment.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Priority Classification; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 55001

products.name: meter_reading
products.description: Periodic meter and usage readings for fleet vehicles and facility equipment used to trigger meter-based PM schedules and track asset utilization. Captures asset reference, meter type (odometer miles, engine hours, hydraulic hours, cycle count, tonnage processed), reading value, reading date, reading source (manual entry, Geotab telematics, automated sensor), reader employee reference, and variance from expected reading flag. Feeds PM schedule due-date calculations and asset utilization reporting.
products.reference: Infor EAM Meter Reading / Geotab Odometer

attributes.name: meter_reading_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each meter reading record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the meter_reading data product.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Boiler operating hour meters and steam flow meters must be tracked at the unit level for PM scheduling, performance monitoring, and calculating unit-level availability factors.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or depot where the meter reading was recorded or where the asset is based. Relevant for facility equipment meters (e.g., MRF balers, WTE turbines, landfill gas engines) and for fleet vehicles domiciled at a specific yard.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle or facility equipment asset for which this meter reading was recorded. Links to the asset master in Infor EAM and SAP PM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Meter readings may be permit-required (operating hours for air permits, throughput for waste permits, usage for water discharge permits). Readings must track permit compliance, support regulatory repo

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule that this meter reading is associated with or triggers. Used to calculate next-due dates for meter-based PM cycles.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: primary_meter_reader_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who recorded or submitted this meter reading. Applicable for manual entry readings; null for automated telematics or sensor sources.

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Generator operating hours and MWh production meters require unit-level tracking for maintenance triggers, performance trending, and reconciling utility settlement data with internal generation records

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Meter readings track odometer and engine hours by vehicle for PM triggering and utilization analysis. Fleet operations managers need vehicle→meter reading linkage for maintenance scheduling and asset

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Order (WO) during which this meter reading was captured, if applicable. Links meter readings taken at task execution time to the corresponding maintenance work order for cost and lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the asset being metered. Distinguishes fleet vehicles (collection trucks, transfer vehicles) from facility equipment (compactors, balers, WTE turbines, landfill gas engines) for utilization reporting and PM strategy segmentation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; NWRA Fleet Standards

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the meter reading was confirmed and approved by the responsible supervisor or maintenance planner. Supports audit trail requirements for DOT and regulatory compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meter reading record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: dot_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this meter reading is associated with or required for a Department of Transportation (DOT) vehicle inspection event. DOT-linked readings are subject to additional retention and audit requirements under FMCSA regulations.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396; SAP S/4HANA EHS Module

attributes.name: expected_reading_value
attributes.description: The anticipated meter reading value based on historical usage rate and elapsed time since the last reading. Used as the baseline for variance calculation and anomaly detection in PM scheduling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: geotab_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Geotab telematics device installed on the vehicle that transmitted this meter reading. Populated only when reading_source is 'geotab_telematics'. Enables traceability back to the specific telematics hardware unit.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics; DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: geotab_trip_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Geotab trip or engine activity session during which this telematics-sourced meter reading was captured. Supports correlation with GPS route data and driver behavior events.

attributes.name: incremental_usage
attributes.description: Usage accumulated since the previous meter reading (current reading value minus previous reading value). Stored as a business field to support PM trigger evaluation and utilization rate calculations without requiring a self-join at query time.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: meter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meter or usage counter being read. Determines the unit of measure and PM trigger logic. Common types include odometer (miles), engine hours, hydraulic hours, cycle count (lifts/compactions), and tonnage processed (TPD). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: odometer|engine_hours|hydraulic_hours|cycle_count|tonnage_processed|fuel_consumed|pressurized_cycles|electrical_hours — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; NWRA Fleet Standards

attributes.name: pm_due_at_value
attributes.description: The meter value at which the next Preventive Maintenance (PM) task is scheduled to be triggered for this asset and meter type. Calculated from the PM schedule interval and the last PM completion meter reading.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: pm_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this meter reading has triggered or is projected to trigger a Preventive Maintenance (PM) work order based on the asset's configured PM schedule thresholds. True when the reading value meets or exceeds the next PM due meter point.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; DOT Inspection Requirements

attributes.name: previous_reading_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent prior confirmed meter reading for the same asset and meter type. Used to compute elapsed time and usage rate between readings for PM scheduling and utilization analytics.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: previous_reading_value
attributes.description: The most recent prior confirmed meter reading value for the same asset and meter type. Used to calculate incremental usage since last reading and to detect rollover or anomalous variance conditions.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: reading_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the meter reading was taken. Used for day-level PM due-date calculations, utilization reporting, and DOT inspection scheduling. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; DOT Inspection Requirements; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: reading_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the technician or driver at the time of reading. May include observations about meter condition, suspected inaccuracies, or contextual information relevant to variance investigation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: reading_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this meter reading record, sourced from Infor EAM or SAP PM. Used for cross-system traceability and audit reference.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: reading_source
attributes.description: Indicates the originating source or method by which this meter reading was captured. Manual entries are submitted by technicians or drivers; Geotab telematics readings are automatically transmitted via GPS/OBD integration; automated sensor readings come from onboard equipment sensors.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: reading_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the meter reading record. Pending readings await validation; confirmed readings are accepted for PM calculations; rejected readings failed variance checks; superseded readings have been replaced by a corrected entry.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the meter reading was physically taken or recorded by the source system. This is the principal business event timestamp, distinct from record audit timestamps. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Geotab Fleet Telematics; ISO 14001

attributes.name: reading_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure corresponding to the meter type and reading value (e.g., miles for odometer, hours for engine/hydraulic meters, cycles for compaction counters, tons for tonnage processed). Aligns with Infor EAM unit of measure configuration.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 14001

attributes.name: reading_value
attributes.description: The actual numeric value recorded on the meter or usage counter at the time of reading (e.g., 125,432.5 miles on odometer, 4,820.25 engine hours). This is the principal quantitative measurement for this event log record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Geotab Fleet Telematics; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why a meter reading was rejected during validation. Populated when reading_status is 'rejected'. Common reasons include meter rollover not flagged, value below previous reading, or variance exceeding tolerance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: remaining_until_pm
attributes.description: Calculated remaining usage (in the meter's unit of measure) before the next PM task is due (PM due-at value minus current reading value). Supports proactive maintenance scheduling and fleet availability planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: rollover_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter counter rolled over (reset to zero) between the previous and current reading, as can occur with odometers reaching maximum counter capacity. When true, incremental usage is adjusted for rollover in PM calculations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; DOT Vehicle Inspection

attributes.name: source_reading_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this meter reading record in the originating source system (Infor EAM, SAP PM, or Geotab). Enables idempotent upserts and cross-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Geotab Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this meter reading originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking across Infor EAM, SAP PM, Geotab telematics, and AMCS platform integrations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Geotab Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meter reading record was last modified in the Silver Layer data product. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: variance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reading value deviates from the expected value beyond the configured tolerance threshold. True when the absolute variance exceeds the asset's defined variance tolerance, triggering a review workflow in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: variance_from_expected
attributes.description: Numeric difference between the actual reading value and the expected reading value (actual minus expected). Positive values indicate higher-than-expected usage; negative values indicate lower-than-expected usage. Used to flag anomalous readings for review.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage deviation of the actual reading from the expected reading value, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Supports threshold-based alerting and trend analysis for asset utilization anomalies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Maintenance budgets must allocate funds for permit-required activities (compliance inspections, permit-mandated equipment upgrades, monitoring programs). Budget line items track permit obligations, en
