attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.maintenance_type. Business justification: Maintenance budgets are allocated by standardized maintenance type categories. Currently has maintenance_type (STRING) which should reference the maintenance_type master table for consistent classific

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Maintenance budgets are established at the WTE facility level for annual planning, cost center management, and tracking facility-level maintenance spend against revenue from tipping fees and energy sa

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual maintenance expenditure posted to date against this budget record, sourced from SAP FI/CO actual cost postings and Infor EAM work order actuals. Updated periodically via ERP integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; Infor EAM; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the maintenance budget (or most recent revision) was formally approved by the authorized approver. Establishes the effective date of spend authorization.

attributes.name: budget_source

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the maintenance budget record, tracking progression from initial draft through approval, active spend, revision, and closure. Drives workflow approvals and spend authorization.

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: encumbered_amount

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA FI module to which maintenance budget amounts are posted. Ensures financial traceability and alignment with the chart of accounts for GAAP/IFRS reporting.

attributes.name: labor_budget_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated for internal technician labor costs, including regular time and overtime. Supports workforce planning and labor cost governance within the maintenance function.

attributes.name: maintenance_category
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance type covered by this budget: fleet Preventive Maintenance (PM), fleet corrective/repair, facility PM, facility corrective, or subcontracted work. Core dimension for maintenance spend governance and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or commentary associated with this maintenance budget record (e.g., planned fleet expansion, anticipated regulatory changes, known large repair projects). Supports budget narrative documentation.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initial approved maintenance budget amount for the period, as established during the annual or quarterly planning cycle. Serves as the baseline for variance analysis and budget governance.

attributes.name: parts_budget_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated for spare parts, consumables, and materials (Bill of Materials — BOM items) required for maintenance activities. Supports parts inventory planning and procurement governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PM Module; Infor EAM Parts Inventory; BOM Management

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget period ends. Defines the boundary for spend authorization and variance calculation for the budget record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget period begins. Used to align maintenance spend tracking with the fiscal calendar and to calculate time-phased budget consumption.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: Actual maintenance spend for the equivalent period in the prior fiscal year. Used as a baseline reference for budget planning, year-over-year variance analysis, and trend reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Operational region code to which this maintenance budget is assigned (e.g., NE, SE, MW, SW, W). Enables regional maintenance spend benchmarking and geographic budget governance across Waste Management's distributed operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Infor EAM

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget allocation is specifically designated to fund regulatory compliance maintenance activities (e.g., DOT vehicle inspections, EPA environmental equipment maintenance, OSHA safety system upkeep). True = compliance-mandated spend.
attributes.references: DOT Inspection Requirements; EPA Regulations; OSHA Standards; RCRA Compliance

attributes.name: remaining_budget_amount
attributes.description: Available budget balance calculated as revised (or original if no revision) budget minus actual spend minus encumbered amounts. Represents the uncommitted, unspent budget available for new work authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Infor EAM; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: The most recently approved revised budget amount, reflecting mid-period budget adjustments, supplemental approvals, or reforecasting. Null if no revision has been made. Used as the current authorized spend ceiling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter tracking the number of budget revisions applied to this record. Zero (0) indicates the original approved budget with no revisions. Supports audit trail and change history analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Compliance; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for the most recent budget revision, documenting the business justification (e.g., unplanned fleet breakdown, regulatory compliance requirement, emergency repair). Required when revision_number > 0.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: source_budget_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this budget record in the originating source system (e.g., SAP CO internal order number, Infor EAM budget reference). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Infor EAM; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system from which this budget record was sourced: SAP S/4HANA CO/PM module, Infor EAM, or manually entered. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Infor EAM; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: spend_to_budget_pct
attributes.description: Ratio of actual spend to date divided by the current authorized budget, expressed as a percentage. Provides a real-time utilization indicator for budget monitoring dashboards and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Infor EAM; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: subcontract_budget_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated specifically for subcontracted maintenance work (third-party vendors, specialized repair shops). Enables make-vs-buy analysis and subcontract spend governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Infor EAM Subcontract Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this maintenance budget record was most recently modified (e.g., budget revision, actual spend refresh, status change). Supports incremental data loading and change data capture in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Compliance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary difference between the current authorized budget (revised or original) and actual spend to date. Positive value indicates underspend; negative value indicates overspend. Used for financial governance and management reporting.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance expressed as a percentage of the current authorized budget amount. Calculated as (variance_amount / current_budget_amount) * 100. Enables normalized comparison of budget performance across asset classes, facilities, and cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between a part in the parts catalog and a vendor who can supply that part. It captures vendor-specific pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and supplier preference status. Each record links one part to one vendor with commercial terms that exist only in the context of this specific supply relationship. This is the operational source list that procurement uses to determine which vendors to buy from for each part.. Existence Justification: In waste management fleet operations, parts are strategically sourced from multiple vendors to ensure supply continuity, competitive pricing, and risk mitigation. A hydraulic pump may be available from the OEM, two aftermarket suppliers, and an emergency local distributor—each with different pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities. Conversely, each vendor supplies hundreds or thousands of different parts across engine, hydraulic, electrical, and body systems. Procurement actively manages these supply agreements as operational records, negotiating vendor-specific terms and tracking performance metrics per vendor-part combination.

attributes.name: supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each supply agreement record

attributes.name: parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the part in the master parts catalog that this supply agreement covers

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor who can supply the part under this agreement

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this supply agreement. Active agreements are available for purchasing, Inactive are blocked, Pending are under negotiation, Expired require renewal.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master purchasing agreement or contract that governs the commercial terms for this vendor-part supply relationship. Links to contract management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply agreement becomes active and the pricing/terms are valid from.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply agreement expires and pricing/terms are no longer valid. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: last_purchase_cost
attributes.description: Most recent actual purchase price per unit paid to a supplier. Used for cost trend analysis, standard cost updates, and procurement benchmarking. Expressed in USD. [Moved from parts_catalog: This attribute captures the most recent purchase price, but it doesn't indicate which vendor that price came from. In a multi-vendor sourcing model, procurement needs to track the current price from EACH vendor, not just the last price paid. This should move to supply_agreement as unit_price, allowing procurement to compare vendor pricing.]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order History; Infor EAM Parts Cost History; GAAP Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when this part was purchased from this specific vendor. Used to track active supply relationships and identify stale source list entries.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected receipt for this vendor-part combination. Varies by vendor based on their inventory position, manufacturing capacity, and shipping distance.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered from this vendor for this part, based on vendor-specific packaging, economic order size, or contract terms.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred/primary supplier for this part. Used by procurement to prioritize vendor selection when multiple sources are available. Only one vendor per part should be marked preferred.

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: The part number used by the preferred supplier in their catalog. Required for accurate purchase order line items and supplier communication. Corresponds to the Info Record in SAP MM. [Moved from parts_catalog: This attribute stores the part number used by the preferred supplier, but each vendor may use a different part number for the same part in their catalog. This is vendor-specific data that belongs in the supply_agreement association, not in the parts_catalog master record.]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record; Infor EAM Supplier Part Reference

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Negotiated price per unit of measure that this vendor charges for this specific part. Varies by vendor-part combination based on contract terms, volume commitments, and supplier relationships.

products.name: incident_response_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of maintenance technicians to hazardous material emergency response incidents. It captures the operational record of each technician's participation in an emergency response, including their specific role, time on scene, protective equipment used, and exposure documentation. Each record links one technician assignment to one emergency response incident with attributes that exist only in the context of this emergency response participation.. Existence Justification: Emergency response incidents require multiple technicians with specialized roles (incident commander, hazmat specialist, equipment operator, decontamination crew), and maintenance technicians respond to multiple emergency incidents over time. The business actively manages each technician's participation in each incident as a distinct operational record with role assignment, time tracking, PPE documentation, and exposure level recording for OSHA compliance and workers compensation purposes.

attributes.name: response_role

domains.name: recycling
domains.description: Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) operations including inbound material receiving, sorting processes, contamination tracking, commodity recovery (paper, plastics, metals, glass), bale production, quality control, outbound commodity sales, and market pricing for recovered materials. Tracks diversion rates, processing throughput (TPD), equipment performance, and commodity grades. Supports EPA recycling reporting and circular economy goals. Integrates with AMCS for recycling route management and SAP MM for commodity inventory.
domains.references: EPA Sustainable Materials Management / SWANA MRF Standards / ISO 14001

products.name: mrf_facility
products.description: Master record for each Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) operated by Waste Management. Captures facility identity, physical address, permitted capacity (TPD), facility type (single-stream, dual-stream, mixed-waste MRF), operational status, EPA permit number, state permit number, licensed processing capacity, tipping floor area (sq ft), baling line count, sort line count, ownership type, and commissioning date. SSOT for MRF facility identity across the recycling domain.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_lifecycle_stage. Required f

attributes.name: accepts_cd_waste
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Accepts Construction and Demolition (C&D) Waste Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MRF facility is permitted and equipped to process Construction and Demolition (C&D) waste streams including concrete, wood, drywall, and metals. C&D processing requires specialized equipment and separate permit conditions.

attributes.name: accepts_commercial
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MRF facility is permitted and equipped to accept commercial and industrial recyclable materials. Drives commercial hauling route assignments in AMCS and contract eligibility in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Management; State Environmental Quality Department Permit Conditions

attributes.name: accepts_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MRF facility is permitted and equipped to accept residential curbside recyclable materials. Drives routing logic in AMCS and service enrollment eligibility in Waste Logics.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Management; Waste Logics Service Scheduling; State Environmental Quality Department Permit Conditions

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the MRF facility. Used for regulatory filings, logistics routing, emergency response coordination, and vendor/hauler directions. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry System (FRS); DOT Facility Location Requirements; OSHA Emergency Response Planning

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the MRF facility (suite, building, gate number, or additional location detail). Supplements address_line1 for precise facility identification in logistics and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry System (FRS); DOT Facility Location Requirements

attributes.name: baling_line_count
attributes.description: Number of baling lines (balers) at the MRF facility used to compress and bind recovered commodities (paper, plastics, metals) into marketable bales. Determines bale production capacity and influences commodity sales throughput.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; NWRA Commodity Baling Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the MRF facility is located. Used for geographic reporting, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and service area mapping.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry System (FRS); State Environmental Quality Department Jurisdiction

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MRF facility was officially commissioned and began commercial operations. Used for asset age calculations, depreciation schedules, permit anniversary tracking, and capital planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Asset Accounting; GAAP Fixed Asset Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO cost center code assigned to this MRF facility for financial cost allocation, P&L reporting, and budget management. Links facility operational costs to the general ledger (GL) for EBITDA and COGS reporting.

attributes.name: county

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Record Management Requirements; Databricks Lakehouse Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MRF facility was permanently decommissioned and ceased operations. Null for active facilities. Used for asset retirement accounting, permit closure filings, and historical reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Asset Retirement; EPA Facility Closure Requirements

attributes.name: design_capacity_tpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Processing Capacity Tons Per Day (TPD)
attributes.description: Engineering-designed maximum daily throughput capacity in tons per day (TPD) as specified in the facility's original design documentation. May differ from permitted capacity due to regulatory limits or operational constraints. Used for capital planning and equipment sizing.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Design Standards; EPA Solid Waste Facility Design Guidelines

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the MRF facility, used in operational systems (AMCS, SAP MM), regulatory submissions, and inter-system integration. Format: MRF-[STATE]-[SEQUENCE].
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Facility Registry; SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Code Convention; SWIS Facility Identification

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Official human-readable name of the MRF facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in customer-facing communications, contracts, and reporting (e.g., 'Houston North MRF').
attributes.references: Enviance EHS Permit Tracking; EPA Facility Registry System (FRS)

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MRF by processing methodology. Single-stream accepts all recyclables commingled; dual-stream separates fiber from containers; mixed-waste MRF processes unsorted MSW; source-separated handles pre-sorted materials; drop-off serves public drop-off programs.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; SWANA MRF Classification Standards; National Waste and Recycling Association (NWRA) Facility Taxonomy

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO 14001 Environmental Management System Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MRF facility holds a current ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. ISO 14001 certification demonstrates systematic environmental management and is required for certain municipal contracts and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems; Enviance EHS Certification Tracking; Waste Management Sustainability Reporting

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MRF facility holds a current ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. Relevant for OSHA compliance, worker safety programs, and contract qualification requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health and Safety; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Enviance EHS Certification Tracking

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Facility Record Last Updated Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the MRF facility master record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Data Governance Standards; ISO 14001 Record Management Requirements

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the MRF facility in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GPS-based routing in AMCS, geospatial analytics, emergency response mapping, and regulatory geographic submissions.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Geotab Fleet Telematics GPS Standards; EPA Facility Registry System (FRS) Geographic Coordinates

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the MRF facility in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GPS-based routing in AMCS, geospatial analytics, emergency response mapping, and regulatory geographic submissions.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Geotab Fleet Telematics GPS Standards; EPA Facility Registry System (FRS) Geographic Coordinates

attributes.name: max_contamination_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Maximum Allowable Contamination Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable contamination rate percentage for outbound commodity bales as specified in commodity offtake contracts and quality standards. Exceeding this threshold may result in load rejection, price penalties, or contract violations. Used in quality control and commodity sales management.
attributes.references: NWRA Commodity Quality Standards; EPA Recycling Market Development Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA MM Quality Management

attributes.name: operating_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days of the week the MRF facility operates (e.g., 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT'). Used for route scheduling in AMCS, customer service availability, and workforce planning in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization; Workday HCM Workforce Planning; Waste Logics Service Scheduling

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Facility Operating Hours End Time
attributes.description: Standard daily end time for MRF facility operations in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used for inbound vehicle scheduling, tipping fee window management in Oracle Revenue Management, and AMCS route dispatch timing.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Dispatch Scheduling; Oracle Revenue Management Tipping Fee Windows; OSHA Hours of Operation Standards

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Facility Operating Hours Start Time
attributes.description: Standard daily start time for MRF facility operations in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used for inbound vehicle scheduling, tipping fee window management in Oracle Revenue Management, and AMCS route dispatch timing.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Dispatch Scheduling; Oracle Revenue Management Tipping Fee Windows; OSHA Hours of Operation Standards

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the MRF facility. Active indicates full operations; temporarily_closed covers planned or unplanned shutdowns; decommissioned indicates permanent closure; permitted_not_operating indicates permit held but no active processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|under_construction|temporarily_closed|decommissioned|permitted_not_operating — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Enviance EHS Operational Status Tracking; EPA Facility Registry System (FRS); RCRA Facility Status Codes

attributes.name: optical_sorter_count
attributes.description: Number of optical sorting units (near-infrared or AI-vision sorters) installed at the facility for automated material identification and separation. Indicates automation level, influences contamination rates, and is tracked in Infor EAM for maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA Advanced MRF Technology Standards; EPA Recycling Infrastructure Guidelines

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates the ownership or operational arrangement for the facility. Company-owned assets are on Waste Management's balance sheet; leased facilities carry lease obligations; joint ventures involve shared ownership; contracted facilities are operated under service agreements with municipalities or third parties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Asset Accounting; IFRS 16 Lease Accounting; GAAP Fixed Asset Standards

attributes.name: permitted_capacity_tpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permitted Processing Capacity Tons Per Day (TPD)
attributes.description: Maximum permitted daily processing throughput in tons per day (TPD) as authorized by the facility's state environmental permit. This is the regulatory ceiling for inbound material acceptance and is used for compliance monitoring, capacity planning, and diversion rate reporting.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Department Permit Conditions; EPA Solid Waste Regulations; RCRA Subtitle D; SWANA Facility Capacity Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary operational phone number for the MRF facility. Used for inbound hauler coordination, customer service escalations, emergency contact, and regulatory agency communications.
attributes.references: OSHA Emergency Contact Requirements; DOT Facility Contact Standards

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM plant code corresponding to this MRF facility. Used for inventory management of recovered commodities, purchase orders (PO) for consumables, and materials management integration between the MRF and SAP MM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Configuration; SAP MM Inventory Management; AMCS-SAP Integration Standards

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the MRF facility address. Used for geographic analysis, regulatory jurisdiction mapping, and logistics routing.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Code Standard; EPA Facility Registry System (FRS)

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal Waste Management operational region code to which this MRF facility is assigned (e.g., 'SOUTH', 'NORTHEAST', 'WEST'). Used for regional performance reporting, P&L allocation in SAP FI/CO, and organizational hierarchy management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Profit Center Hierarchy; Waste Management Internal Organizational Structure

attributes.name: sort_line_count
attributes.description: Number of active sorting lines (conveyor-based manual or automated sort systems) at the MRF facility. Directly determines sorting throughput capacity and staffing requirements. Used in capacity planning and equipment maintenance scheduling in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; NWRA Facility Capacity Benchmarks

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the MRF facility is located. Determines applicable state environmental regulations, permit requirements, and reporting jurisdictions.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; State Environmental Quality Department Jurisdiction; EPA Facility Registry System (FRS)

attributes.name: storage_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum on-site storage capacity in tons for processed and baled commodities awaiting outbound shipment. Used for inventory management in SAP MM, commodity sales scheduling, and market timing decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; State Environmental Quality Department Storage Permit Conditions

attributes.name: target_diversion_rate_pct
attributes.description: Facility-level target percentage of inbound material weight that is successfully recovered and diverted from landfill disposal. Expressed as a percentage (0-100). Used as a KPI benchmark for operational performance, EPA recycling reporting, and sustainability goal tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Metrics; SWANA Diversion Rate Calculation Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Waste Management Sustainability Goals

attributes.name: tipping_floor_area_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Tipping Floor Area Square Feet
attributes.description: Total area of the tipping floor in square feet where inbound recyclable materials are unloaded from collection vehicles. Determines maximum simultaneous unloading capacity and influences throughput planning and safety compliance under OSHA.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry Safety Standards; SWANA MRF Design Guidelines; Infor EAM Facility Specifications

attributes.name: total_floor_area_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: MRF Total Floor Area Square Feet
attributes.description: Total enclosed floor area of the MRF facility building in square feet, including tipping floor, sort lines, baling area, storage, and office space. Used for property tax assessments, lease calculations, and facility planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Asset Accounting; IFRS 16 Lease Accounting; Infor EAM Facility Specifications

products.name: inbound_load
products.description: Transactional record of each inbound material load received at a MRF. Captures load receipt timestamp, originating route or transfer station, hauling vehicle ID, gross weight (tons), tare weight, net weight, material stream type (single-stream residential, commercial, C&D, drop-off), contamination flag, initial visual contamination estimate (%), tipping fee applied, scale ticket number, driver ID, and receiving dock assignment. Integrates with AMCS for route-to-MRF load reconciliation and SAP MM for material receipt posting.

attributes.name: inbound_load_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each inbound material load received at the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF). Serves as the primary key for all load-level transactions and reconciliations.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; SAP MM Material Document

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (residential, commercial, or municipal) associated with this inbound load. Used for tipping fee billing reconciliation in Oracle Revenue Management and Salesforce CRM account linkage.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; Salesforce CRM; SAP SD

attributes.name: diversion_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.diversion_record. Business justification: Each inbound load contributes tonnage to facility-level diversion metrics tracked for ESG reporting and regulatory compliance. Business need: Diversion rate calculation, ESG metric aggregation, tracea

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CDL-licensed driver who delivered the inbound load. Used for driver performance tracking, DOT compliance, and load accountability.
attributes.references: DOT Commercial Driver License (CDL) Requirements; Workday HCM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF scale house operator who processed this inbound load weigh-in. Used for operator accountability, training compliance tracking, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Recordkeeping; SOX Compliance; Workday HCM

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) that received this inbound load. Supports multi-facility operations and facility-level throughput reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: generator_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generator Epa Id Registration Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: MRFs receiving contaminated loads from generators must track EPA ID registrations for regulatory compliance and enforcement. When hazardous contamination exceeds thresholds, generator EPA ID is requir

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Incidents during load tipping (driver injuries, contamination exposure, vehicle accidents) require linkage to the specific inbound load for root cause analysis, customer notification, and contaminatio

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: FK to recycling.mrf_facility.mrf_facility_id — Every inbound load must reference which MRF received it. Required for facility throughput reporting and contamination rate tracking by facility.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Buy-back programs and commercial recyclable purchases require linking inbound loads to originating POs for three-way matching (receipt, PO, invoice), cost reconciliation, and purchased material tracea

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection route that generated this inbound load. Links the MRF receipt back to the originating residential or commercial collection route for AMCS route-to-MRF load reconciliation and diversion rate reporting.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Management; EPA Recycling Reporting

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer station that consolidated and dispatched this load to the MRF, if applicable. Null for direct-haul loads from collection routes. Supports transfer station throughput and chain-of-custody tracking.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet vehicle that delivered the inbound load to the MRF. Used for fleet performance tracking, load-per-vehicle analytics, and Geotab telematics reconciliation.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Geotab Fleet Telematics; DOT Vehicle Records

attributes.name: waste_acceptance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Inbound loads must comply with facility waste acceptance permits specifying allowed material types, contamination limits, and capacity thresholds. Critical for scale house permit verification and regu

attributes.name: amcs_load_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the AMCS Platform linking this MRF inbound load record to the originating route dispatch and collection event. Enables route-to-MRF load reconciliation and confirms that collected materials were delivered to the correct facility.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route and Load Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with this inbound load, used for third-party hauler loads and transfer station deliveries. Provides chain-of-custody documentation and supports SAP MM goods receipt matching.
attributes.references: DOT Freight Regulations; SAP MM Goods Receipt; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: contamination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inbound load was visually identified as contaminated at the time of receipt. True = contamination detected; False = load appears clean. Triggers contamination workflow including surcharge assessment, customer notification, and Enviance EHS incident logging if contamination exceeds threshold.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: contamination_pct
attributes.description: Initial visual estimate of contamination level as a percentage of total load volume, assessed by the MRF receiving operator at the tipping floor. Expressed as 0.00 to 100.00. Used for contamination trending, customer education programs, and EPA recycling quality reporting. Formal contamination rate may be updated after sort audit.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: contamination_surcharge
attributes.description: Additional fee assessed on this load due to contamination exceeding the contractual threshold, expressed in US dollars. Applied per customer contract terms when contamination percentage exceeds the agreed acceptable contamination rate. Posted to Oracle Revenue Management for billing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP SD; IFRS/GAAP; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: contamination_type
attributes.description: Primary category of contamination identified in the load (e.g., food waste, hazardous materials, non-recyclable plastics, bagged recyclables, electronics, textiles, medical waste). Used for contamination root cause analysis and targeted customer outreach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_waste|hazardous|non_recyclable_plastic|bagged_recyclables|electronics|textiles|medical_waste|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the inbound load record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: estimated_diversion_tons
attributes.description: Estimated tonnage of this load that is expected to be diverted from landfill through recycling or recovery, based on material stream type and historical contamination-adjusted yield rates. Expressed in short tons. Used for real-time diversion rate tracking and EPA recycling program reporting. Distinct from actual recovered commodity weight which is captured at bale production.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA Diversion Rate Methodology; ISO 14001

attributes.name: gross_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight of the loaded vehicle as measured at the MRF inbound scale, expressed in short tons. Gross weight is the first weigh-in measurement before tare deduction. Critical for Tons Per Day (TPD) throughput reporting and tipping fee calculation.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; NIST Handbook 44 Weights and Measures; EPA Recycling Reporting

attributes.name: is_audited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inbound load has been selected for and completed a formal sort audit or waste characterization study. True = audit completed. Sort audits are used to validate contamination estimates, measure commodity composition, and support EPA recycling program reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA Sort Audit Methodology; ISO 14001

attributes.name: load_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for scale operator or supervisor notes regarding this inbound load. May include observations about load quality, unusual materials, driver communications, or special handling instructions. Supports operational exception management.

attributes.name: load_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the load arrived at the MRF. 'direct_haul' = collection vehicle delivering directly from route; 'transfer_station' = consolidated load from a transfer station; 'drop_off_center' = aggregated materials from a public drop-off facility; 'special_event' = community recycling event; 'third_party_hauler' = independent hauler delivering under contract.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: load_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the inbound load record. 'received' = weighed and logged at scale; 'accepted' = cleared for processing; 'rejected' = refused entry (contamination, wrong material, etc.); 'pending_review' = flagged for supervisor review; 'posted' = SAP MM material receipt posted; 'voided' = record cancelled.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; SAP MM Goods Receipt Workflow

attributes.name: manifest_number
attributes.description: Hazardous waste tracking manifest number, if applicable. Required under RCRA for loads containing any hazardous waste fraction. Null for standard recyclable loads. Links to Enviance EHS manifest tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; EPA Hazardous Waste Manifest System; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: material_stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inbound material stream. 'single_stream_residential' = commingled recyclables from residential curbside collection; 'commercial_mixed' = mixed recyclables from commercial accounts; 'cnd' = Construction and Demolition (C&D) debris; 'drop_off' = materials from public drop-off programs; 'organics' = food/yard waste streams; 'special_collection' = event or special program collections. Drives sorting line configuration and commodity yield expectations.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: net_weight_tons
attributes.description: Net weight of the inbound material load, calculated as gross weight minus tare weight, expressed in short tons. This is the primary tonnage figure used for TPD throughput reporting, tipping fee billing, diversion rate calculations, and SAP MM material receipt posting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; SAP MM Goods Receipt; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: processing_shift
attributes.description: Work shift during which this inbound load was received and processed at the MRF. Used for shift-level throughput reporting, labor allocation, and operational performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Workday HCM Shift Management

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the hauling vehicle arrived at the MRF scale house and the load receipt process was initiated. This is the principal business event timestamp for the inbound load transaction. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: receiving_dock
attributes.description: Identifier of the MRF tipping floor dock or bay assigned to receive this load. Used for floor traffic management, sorting line assignment, and operational throughput balancing across dock positions.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why a load was rejected at the MRF gate. Populated only when load_status = 'rejected'. Common reasons include excessive contamination, prohibited materials, missing documentation, or capacity constraints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excessive_contamination|prohibited_materials|missing_documentation|capacity_exceeded|wrong_material_type|hazardous_detected|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting; RCRA

attributes.name: sap_material_doc_number
attributes.description: SAP MM material document number generated upon goods receipt posting for this inbound load. Confirms the load has been formally received into SAP inventory management. Null until load_status = 'posted'. Enables reconciliation between MRF scale records and SAP MM inventory.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; IFRS/GAAP Inventory Recognition

attributes.name: scale_ticket_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible scale house ticket number assigned at the weigh station upon load receipt. Used as the primary operational reference for load reconciliation between the MRF, hauling contractor, and SAP MM material receipt posting. Printed on the physical scale ticket given to the driver.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; SAP MM Goods Receipt; AMCS Load Management

attributes.name: service_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic service area or municipality from which this load originated. Used for municipal contract compliance reporting, diversion rate calculations by jurisdiction, and EPA recycling program reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting; Local Solid Waste Authorities; SWANA

attributes.name: sort_line_assignment
attributes.description: Identifier of the MRF sorting line or processing line to which this load was directed after tipping floor receipt. Used for equipment utilization tracking, throughput balancing, and sort line performance analytics.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Management

attributes.name: supervisor_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this load record has been flagged for or has undergone supervisor review. True = supervisor review required or completed. Triggered by contamination above threshold, weight anomalies, rejected loads, or missing documentation.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: supervisor_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the supervisor completed review of this flagged load record. Null if supervisor_review_flag is False or review is pending. Used for SLA compliance on review turnaround and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: tare_weight_tons
attributes.description: Weight of the empty hauling vehicle as measured at the MRF outbound scale after unloading, expressed in short tons. Used with gross weight to calculate net material weight. May be sourced from vehicle tare records if a second weigh is not performed.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; NIST Handbook 44 Weights and Measures

attributes.name: tipping_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total tipping fee charged for this inbound load in US dollars, calculated as net weight multiplied by the tipping fee rate. Represents the gross revenue amount for this load transaction. Posted to Oracle Revenue Management and SAP FI/CO for billing and GL recognition.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP FI/CO; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: tipping_fee_rate
attributes.description: The contractual tipping fee rate applied to this load, expressed in US dollars per short ton. Tipping fees are the charge assessed per ton for waste or recyclable material disposal/processing at the MRF. Rate may vary by material stream type, customer contract, or municipal agreement.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP SD Pricing; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the inbound load record was most recently modified. Tracks post-receipt corrections such as weight adjustments, contamination re-assessments, or status changes.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Type of collection or hauling vehicle that delivered the load. ASL = Automated Side Loader; FEL = Front End Loader; REL = Rear End Loader; roll_off = roll-off container truck; transfer_trailer = semi-trailer from transfer station; rear_load = rear-loading compactor. Affects expected compaction ratio and material quality.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; DOT Vehicle Classification; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the MRF at the time of load receipt. Used for operational analytics correlating weather with contamination rates, load volumes, and processing throughput. Supports capacity planning and seasonal trend analysis.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting

products.name: sort_line
products.description: Master record for each sort line (conveyor-based sorting system) and its installed equipment within a MRF facility. Captures sort line identity, facility reference, line type (pre-sort, OCC, fiber, container, residue), design throughput (TPH), station count, automation level, and operational status. Includes equipment inventory: individual equipment assets (balers, optical sorters, conveyors, eddy current separators, magnetic separators, shredders, glass breakers) with manufacturer, model, serial number, installation date, design capacity, maintenance schedule references, and Infor EAM asset references. Supports equipment performance tracking, throughput capacity planning, and maintenance coordination.

attributes.name: sort_line_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sort line record within the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF). Serves as the primary key for this master resource entity.

attributes.name: air_quality_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Sort lines operate under equipment-specific air quality permits governing particulate emissions, VOC controls, and operational parameters. Enables tracking of permit-mandated throughput limits, emissi

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) where this sort line is physically installed and operated.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; EPA Solid Waste Facility Reporting

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Infor EAM system asset identifier for this sort line, used to link to maintenance schedules, work orders, and asset lifecycle records in the EAM system.

attributes.name: jha_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.jha. Business justification: JHAs are written for specific sort line configurations due to varying equipment types, automation levels, and material streams. Each sort line requires dedicated JHAs for sorting operations, enabling

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_lifecycle_stage. Business justification: Sort line lifecycle stage (operational, under maintenance, decommissioned) drives production scheduling, capacity utilization reporting, and maintenance planning. Required for daily throughput plannin

attributes.name: line_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Sort lines require shift supervisors for real-time operational control, safety compliance, quality assurance, and throughput management. Supervisor assignment is essential for OSHA compliance, contami

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule in Infor EAM that governs routine maintenance intervals, inspection tasks, and lubrication schedules for this sort line.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (Lockout/Tagout)

attributes.name: amcs_line_reference
attributes.description: Identifier used to reference this sort line within the AMCS Platform for recycling route management and material flow tracking integration. Enables cross-system reconciliation between MRF operations and collection route data.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization and Container Tracking

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation on the sort line. Manual lines rely entirely on human sorters; semi-automated lines combine optical sorters or mechanical separators with manual quality control; fully automated lines use robotics and optical sorting with minimal human intervention.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; NWRA Best Practices for MRF Automation

attributes.name: baler_count
attributes.description: Number of baling machines installed on or directly serving this sort line. Balers compress recovered commodities into bales for outbound commodity sales. Affects throughput capacity and commodity output rates.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sort line was formally accepted into production operation following installation testing and validation. Marks the start of the operational lifecycle and warranty period.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: conveyor_length_m
attributes.description: Total length of the primary sort conveyor belt in meters. Used for maintenance planning (belt replacement scheduling), throughput modeling, and facility layout documentation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: conveyor_speed_mpm
attributes.description: Rated operating speed of the sort line conveyor belt in meters per minute (MPM). Directly affects sort quality and throughput rate; used in process optimization and OSHA ergonomic compliance for sorter workload assessment.
attributes.references: OSHA Ergonomics Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sort line master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Records Management

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sort line was permanently taken out of service. Null for active lines. Used for asset lifecycle reporting, capital planning, and EPA facility capacity reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; EPA Solid Waste Facility Reporting

attributes.name: design_recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Engineered target material recovery rate expressed as a percentage of inbound material weight that is successfully recovered as saleable commodity. Used as the baseline for diversion rate reporting and performance benchmarking against EPA recycling goals.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: design_throughput_tpd
attributes.description: Engineered design capacity of the sort line expressed in tons per day (TPD), calculated based on standard operating shift hours. Used for daily production planning, EPA recycling reporting, and diversion rate calculations.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: design_throughput_tph
attributes.description: Engineered design capacity of the sort line expressed in tons per hour (TPH). Represents the maximum rated processing rate under optimal conditions as specified by the equipment manufacturer or system integrator. Used for capacity planning and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: dust_suppression_system
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dust suppression or dust collection system is installed on this sort line. Required for air quality compliance under the Clean Air Act and OSHA particulate matter exposure limits, particularly on glass and shredder lines.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA) Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1000 Air Contaminants; EPA Air Quality Standards

attributes.name: eddy_current_separator_count
attributes.description: Number of eddy current separator units installed on this sort line. Eddy current separators use magnetic induction to eject non-ferrous metals (aluminum, copper) from the material stream. Critical for aluminum recovery rates.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: equipment_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual equipment assets installed on this sort line (e.g., balers, optical sorters, conveyors, eddy current separators, magnetic separators, shredders, glass breakers). Used for maintenance planning and asset inventory management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP PM Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated fire suppression system (e.g., sprinkler, spark detection and suppression) is installed on this sort line. MRF sort lines processing paper and plastics carry elevated fire risk; fire suppression is required by NFPA 13 and local fire codes.
attributes.references: NFPA 13 Standard for Installation of Sprinkler Systems; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.159; Local Fire Code

attributes.name: floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area occupied by the sort line and its associated equipment in square meters. Used for facility layout planning, fire safety compliance, and OSHA egress requirement calculations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.37 Means of Egress; Local Building Code Compliance

attributes.name: glass_breaker_count
attributes.description: Number of glass breaking/crushing units installed on this sort line. Glass breakers reduce glass to cullet for downstream processing or disposal. Relevant for container sort lines processing single-stream material.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sort line was physically installed and commissioned at the facility. Used to calculate asset age, depreciation schedules, and to trigger lifecycle replacement planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; GAAP/IFRS Asset Depreciation Standards

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or capital refurbishment of the sort line. Used to assess remaining useful life, schedule next overhaul, and support capital expenditure planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; GAAP/IFRS Asset Lifecycle Standards

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the sort line within the facility (e.g., MRF-SL-01, OCC-LINE-A). Used in operational communications, work orders, and reporting.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the sort line (e.g., 'OCC Pre-Sort Line 1', 'Fiber Sorting Line B'). Used in operational dashboards, maintenance scheduling, and facility floor plans.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the sort line. Active indicates normal production operation; maintenance indicates the line is taken offline for scheduled or unscheduled maintenance; commissioning indicates new installation under testing; decommissioned indicates permanently retired.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sort line by the material stream it processes. Pre-sort lines handle initial separation; OCC (Old Corrugated Cardboard) lines process cardboard; fiber lines handle paper; container lines process plastics, metals, and glass; residue lines handle non-recoverable material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_sort|occ|fiber|container|residue|glass|mixed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; NWRA Best Practices

attributes.name: magnetic_separator_count
attributes.description: Number of magnetic separator (overhead magnet or drum magnet) units installed on this sort line for ferrous metal recovery. Ferrous metal recovery rate is directly dependent on magnetic separator performance.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) who designed and built the sort line system (e.g., Machinex, Van Dyk, CP Group, Bollegraaf). Used for warranty management, spare parts sourcing, and technical support.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP MM Materials Management

attributes.name: material_stream
attributes.description: The type of incoming material stream this sort line is designed to process. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste) single-stream accepts commingled residential recyclables; dual-stream separates fiber from containers at collection; OCC handles Old Corrugated Cardboard; C&D (Construction and Demolition) handles construction debris. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msw|single_stream|dual_stream|occ|commercial|c_and_d|organics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; RCRA Subtitle D; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: max_contamination_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable contamination rate (percentage of non-target material in the output stream) for this sort line before commodity quality is rejected by buyers. Exceeding this threshold triggers quality control interventions and may affect commodity sale prices.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Quality Guidelines; China National Sword Policy

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model designation for the sort line system. Used for spare parts identification, technical documentation retrieval, and warranty claims.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SAP MM Materials Management

attributes.name: noise_level_db
attributes.description: Rated operational noise level of the sort line in decibels (dB). Used for OSHA hearing conservation program compliance, PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) requirements determination, and facility noise permit compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.95 Occupational Noise Exposure; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: operating_shift_count
attributes.description: Number of production shifts per day this sort line is designed to operate (typically 1, 2, or 3 shifts). Used for daily throughput capacity calculations, workforce scheduling, and operational cost modeling.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry Standards

attributes.name: optical_sorter_count
attributes.description: Number of optical sorting units installed on this sort line. Optical sorters use near-infrared (NIR) or visible spectrum technology to identify and eject specific material types. Drives automation level classification and throughput capacity.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: power_consumption_kw
attributes.description: Rated electrical power consumption of the sort line in kilowatts (KW) at full operating capacity. Used for energy cost modeling, utility budgeting, and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reporting under EPA and ISO 14001 requirements.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Clean Air Act

attributes.name: residue_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of inbound material that is expected to be classified as residue (non-recoverable waste sent to landfill disposal). Lower residue rates indicate higher diversion performance. Used in EPA diversion rate reporting and sustainability KPI tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; SWANA Diversion Rate Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology is installed on this sort line for automated container or material tracking. Supports integration with AMCS Platform for container management and material flow tracking.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Container Tracking; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: sap_functional_location
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM) functional location code assigned to this sort line. Used to link maintenance work orders, preventive maintenance plans, and cost center allocations in SAP PM and FI/CO modules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Plant Maintenance; SAP FI/CO Financial Controlling

attributes.name: screen_count
attributes.description: Number of disc screen or trommel screen units installed on this sort line for size-based material separation. Screens separate 2D materials (paper, film) from 3D materials (containers, cans) and are a primary separation mechanism in MRF operations.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number uniquely identifying this sort line system. Required for warranty registration, insurance documentation, and regulatory equipment records.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; DOT Equipment Registration

attributes.name: shift_duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard duration of each operating shift in hours for this sort line. Combined with operating_shift_count and design_throughput_tph to derive design_throughput_tpd. Used in workforce planning and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry Standards

attributes.name: shredder_count
attributes.description: Number of shredding units installed on this sort line for size reduction of incoming material. Shredders improve downstream sorting efficiency and are common on OCC and residue lines.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: station_count
attributes.description: Total number of manual sort stations installed along the sort line. Determines labor requirements for staffing the line at full capacity and is used in workforce planning and ergonomic compliance assessments.
attributes.references: OSHA Ergonomics Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this sort line master record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with source systems, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Records Management

products.name: commodity
products.description: Reference master for all recovered commodity types and their quality grade specifications processed and sold from MRF operations. Captures commodity identity (code, name, category), ISRI grade codes, grade-level quality specifications (max contamination %, moisture threshold, bale density requirements, prohibited materials), market classification (positive-value vs residue), unit of measure, and recyclability tier. Grade specifications define acceptance/rejection criteria and drive sales pricing premiums or discounts. SSOT for commodity identity and quality standards across recycling and billing domains.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each recovered commodity master record in the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF). Primary key for the commodity reference table. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; AMCS Platform Commodity Catalog

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material. Business justification: Recyclable commodities are materials in ERP/procurement systems for integrated inventory management, financial posting, and material master governance. Links commodity catalog to procurement material

attributes.name: accepted_materials
attributes.description: Narrative description of materials explicitly accepted within this commodity stream (e.g., 'Corrugated containers, kraft paper bags' for OCC). Complements the prohibited materials list to fully define the commodity specification for MRF operations and customer education.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: amcs_commodity_code
attributes.description: Commodity identifier as configured in the AMCS Platform for route management and MRF dispatching. Used to link commodity master records to AMCS recycling route assignments, container tracking, and inbound material receiving workflows.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Optimization and MRF Operations Module

attributes.name: baling_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity must be baled prior to outbound shipment to end-market buyers. Drives MRF baler scheduling, bale production tracking, and outbound logistics planning. False for loose commodities such as glass cullet or scrap metal.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform MRF Operations Module; NWRA Baling Standards

attributes.name: base_price_per_ton
attributes.description: Current or standard base price per ton (USD) for this commodity as used in MRF commodity sales. For positive-value commodities, this is the revenue received per ton sold. For negative-value commodities, this is the cost paid per ton disposed. Sensitive commercial pricing data. Integrated with Oracle Revenue Management and SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: High-level material category grouping for the commodity. Drives MRF sorting line configuration, equipment routing, and EPA diversion rate reporting by material stream. Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paper|plastics|metals|glass|organics|electronics|textiles|residue|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SWANA Material Classification Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the commodity type (e.g., OCC, HDPE, ALU, ONP). Used as the business-facing identifier in SAP MM material master, AMCS commodity catalog, and commodity sales contracts. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; AMCS Platform

attributes.name: commodity_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the recovered commodity (e.g., 'Old Corrugated Containers', 'High-Density Polyethylene Natural', 'Aluminum Used Beverage Cans'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE and is used in customer-facing reports, commodity sales invoices, and EPA recycling disclosures.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: commodity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commodity master record. Active commodities are processed and sold from MRF operations. Inactive or discontinued commodities are retained for historical reporting. Pending_approval records are under review for addition to the MRF commodity catalog. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; AMCS Platform Commodity Catalog

attributes.name: contamination_fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Fee charged per ton (USD) when a commodity load exceeds the maximum contamination percentage threshold. Applied as a deduction from the commodity sale price or as a separate charge to the originating customer account. Configured in Oracle Revenue Management billing rules.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA SD; NWRA Contamination Fee Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity master record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and SOX-compliant record management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: diversion_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tonnage of this commodity counts toward the diversion rate calculation (percentage of waste diverted from landfill). True for recyclable and compostable commodities; false for residue streams that are landfilled. Drives EPA and state-level diversion rate reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; State Environmental Quality Departments; SWANA Diversion Rate Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this commodity master record and its associated grade specifications became effective for MRF operations and commodity sales. Used to manage commodity specification version history and ensure correct specifications are applied to historical transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: end_market_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is sold to domestic end-market buyers, exported to international markets, or both. Drives logistics planning, export documentation requirements (BOL, customs), and market pricing strategy. Export commodities may require additional DOT and customs compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Export Regulations; NWRA Market Reporting; SAP SD Export Management

attributes.name: epa_material_category_code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned material category code used in mandatory recycling and diversion rate reporting submissions. Aligns commodity records with EPA's Advancing Sustainable Materials Management (SMM) reporting framework and state environmental quality department reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Advancing Sustainable Materials Management (SMM); Clean Air Act; Clean Water Act; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commodity master record or its grade specifications expire and must be reviewed or replaced. Null for open-ended commodity definitions. Supports commodity specification lifecycle management and ensures outdated specifications are not applied to active operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular

attributes.name: ghg_emission_factor
attributes.description: Greenhouse gas (GHG) emission factor in metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) per ton of commodity recycled versus landfilled. Used to calculate GHG emission reductions from recycling activities for sustainability reporting, EPA GHG inventory submissions, and circular economy goal tracking.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98); EPA WARM Model; ISO 14001; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which commodity sales revenue or disposal costs are posted. Ensures accurate financial reporting and P&L attribution by commodity type. Required for SAP FI/CO integration and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO General Ledger; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: grade_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the ISRI grade specification including allowable materials, prohibited items, and quality characteristics. Used by MRF quality control staff to assess bale acceptance and by sales teams to communicate product quality to end-market buyers.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is classified as a hazardous material under RCRA or DOT regulations.
