attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required based on inspection findings. True when bale must be reworked, reprocessed, or when process improvements are needed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the inspection record was first created in the database. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: grade_assigned
attributes.description: Quality grade assigned to the bale based on inspection results. Determines commodity pricing tier and buyer eligibility. Premium is highest quality, Grade A-C are standard tiers, off-spec requires rework, reject is unsaleable.

attributes.name: inspection_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Time spent performing the inspection in minutes. Used for labor cost tracking and process efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the inspection was performed. Production line for in-process QC, staging area for pre-shipment, loading dock for final verification, buyer facility for receiving inspection, third party lab for independent verification.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes captured by the inspector. May include observations about material quality, equipment issues, or process anomalies.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the inspection event. Format: INS-YYYYMMDD-NNNN where YYYYMMDD is inspection date and NNNN is sequence number.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail result of the inspection. Pass indicates bale meets quality standards, fail requires corrective action, conditional pass allows shipment with buyer notification, pending retest requires additional verification.

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bale inspection was performed. Principal business event timestamp for this quality control transaction.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Category of inspection performed. Production QC (Quality Control) occurs during bale production, pre-shipment before delivery, buyer-requested per customer requirement, random audit for ongoing quality assurance, compliance verification for regulatory requirements, or post-complaint following buyer dispute.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the inspection record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Type of recovered material in the inspected bale. Aligns with commodity categories tracked for recycling diversion rates and commodity sales. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mixed_paper|cardboard|pet_plastic|hdpe_plastic|aluminum|steel|glass|mixed_plastics — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: moisture_content_percentage
attributes.description: Measured moisture content in the bale as a percentage of total weight. Affects commodity value and grade classification. Expressed as percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: photo_documentation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic evidence was captured during inspection. True when photos are available for quality documentation or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: reinspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bale must be reinspected after corrective action. True when initial inspection failed or when buyer requires verification.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the bale failed inspection. Populated only when inspection_result is fail. Supports root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of samples taken from the bale for inspection. Larger sample sizes provide more accurate contamination and moisture measurements.

attributes.name: shipment_hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why shipment was not approved. Populated when approved_for_shipment is false. Used for logistics coordination and customer communication.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record where the inspection data originated. AMCS for integrated MRF operations, SAP QM (Quality Management) for enterprise quality module, manual entry for paper-based inspections, mobile app for field inspections, third party lab for external certifications.

products.name: commodity_inventory
products.description: Operational inventory snapshot of recovered commodity bales held in MRF storage at any point in time. Captures facility reference, commodity reference, commodity grade, total bales on hand, total weight on hand (tons), storage location summary, oldest bale production date, average bale age (days), allocated quantity (committed to pending sales orders), available quantity, and last physical count date. Integrates with SAP MM material inventory for commodity stock management and financial valuation.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Stock / MRF Commodity Inventory

attributes.name: commodity_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity inventory snapshot record.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recovered commodity type (paper, plastics, metals, glass).

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility where the commodity inventory is held.

attributes.name: allocated_bales
attributes.description: Number of bales committed to pending sales orders or customer allocations.

attributes.name: allocated_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight in tons of commodity inventory allocated to pending sales orders.

attributes.name: available_bales
attributes.description: Number of bales available for sale, calculated as total bales on hand minus allocated bales.

attributes.name: available_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight in tons of commodity inventory available for sale, calculated as total weight minus allocated weight.

attributes.name: average_bale_age_days
attributes.description: Average age in days of all bales in inventory, calculated from production date to snapshot date.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Representative batch or lot number for traceability of the commodity inventory, particularly for quality tracking.

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade classification of the recovered commodity bales based on contamination levels and material purity standards.
attributes.references: Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries (ISRI) Specifications

attributes.name: contamination_rate_percent
attributes.description: Average contamination rate percentage across all bales in inventory, indicating non-recyclable material content.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory snapshot record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the commodity inventory indicating availability for sale or operational restrictions.

attributes.name: inventory_turnover_days
attributes.description: Average number of days commodity inventory remains in storage before being sold, calculated over a rolling period.

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total financial valuation of the commodity inventory on hand based on current market pricing or standard cost.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Material Valuation, GAAP Inventory Accounting Standards

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed for this commodity at this facility.

attributes.name: last_quality_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality inspection or certification performed on this commodity inventory.

attributes.name: market_price_per_ton
attributes.description: Current market price per ton for this commodity grade, used for inventory valuation and sales pricing.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material master number for the commodity, used for integration with SAP MM inventory and financial systems.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity in tons for this commodity type at this facility.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the commodity inventory, including special handling instructions or quality observations.

attributes.name: oldest_bale_production_date
attributes.description: Production date of the oldest bale currently in inventory, used to track inventory aging and FIFO management.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the MRF facility for integration with SAP MM and FI/CO modules.

attributes.name: price_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the current market price per ton used for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: quality_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of quality certification or inspection for the commodity inventory against ISRI or customer specifications.

attributes.name: reorder_point_tons
attributes.description: Minimum inventory threshold in tons that triggers production planning or sales acceleration actions.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: Business date for which this inventory snapshot was captured, representing the inventory position as of end of day.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this inventory snapshot was captured from the source system.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total MRF storage capacity utilized by this commodity inventory.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Primary storage location or zone within the MRF where the commodity bales are stored.

attributes.name: total_bales_on_hand
attributes.description: Total count of commodity bales currently in MRF storage at the snapshot date.

attributes.name: total_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight of commodity inventory on hand measured in tons.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure used for commodity inventory tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure Master

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory snapshot record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for inventory valuation amount.

products.name: commodity_buyer
products.description: Master record for commodity buyers and end-market purchasers of recovered materials sold from MRF operations. Captures buyer company name, buyer type (domestic mill, export broker, reprocessor, direct end-user), primary contact name, contact phone, contact email, billing address, shipping address, preferred commodities list, buyer credit status, payment terms, preferred delivery method (FOB MRF, delivered), active/inactive status, and SAP vendor/customer account reference. SSOT for commodity buyer identity within the recycling domain.

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity buyer record. Primary key for the commodity buyer entity within the recycling domain.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buyer is currently active and eligible for commodity sales. True means active and available for transactions, False means inactive and excluded from sales processes.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the buyer's billing address including street number and street name. Used for invoicing and accounts receivable processing.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the buyer's billing address for suite, floor, or building information. Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for the buyer's billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the buyer's billing address.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the buyer's billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for the buyer's billing address. Uses standard postal abbreviations.

attributes.name: buyer_established_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this commodity buyer was first established. Used for buyer tenure analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the commodity buyer organization that purchases recovered materials from MRF operations.

attributes.name: buyer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commodity buyer based on their role in the recovered materials supply chain. Domestic mills process materials domestically, export brokers facilitate international sales, reprocessors transform materials into new feedstock, direct end-users consume materials in manufacturing, aggregators consolidate materials from multiple sources, and traders buy and resell commodities.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the buyer contact. Used for purchase orders, invoices, shipping notifications, and quality documentation.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the buyer contact. Used for order coordination, quality issues, and logistics communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity buyer record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance allowed for this buyer in USD. Used for credit risk management and sales order approval workflows.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit approval status of the buyer. Approved buyers can receive shipments on credit terms, suspended buyers require prepayment or letter of credit, declined buyers are not eligible for sales.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent commodity sale transaction with this buyer. Used to identify dormant buyer relationships and trigger reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_tons
attributes.description: Minimum shipment size in tons that the buyer will accept per order. Used for load planning and sales order validation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity buyer record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional buyer-specific information such as special handling requirements, preferred contact times, facility access instructions, or historical relationship context.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the number of days and conditions for payment (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, COD, Letter of Credit). Aligns with SAP FI payment terms master data.

attributes.name: preferred_commodities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of recovered material commodity types the buyer prefers to purchase (e.g., OCC, mixed paper, PET, HDPE, aluminum, ferrous metals, glass). Supports sales planning and material allocation decisions.

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_method
attributes.description: Buyer's preferred logistics arrangement. FOB MRF (Free On Board at Materials Recovery Facility) means buyer arranges transport, delivered means seller delivers to buyer facility, buyer pickup means buyer collects from MRF, third-party carrier means mutually agreed logistics provider.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the buyer organization responsible for commodity procurement and contract management.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_lifecycle_stage. Business justification: Equipment lifecycle stage (commissioned, operational, under-repair, decommissioned) determines maintenance strategy, utilization tracking eligibility, and disposal planning. Required for operational s

attributes.name: lockout_tagout_procedure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.lockout_tagout_procedure. Business justification: OSHA 1910.147 requires asset-specific LOTO procedures for each energy-isolating device. Each MRF equipment asset must reference its controlling LOTO procedure for maintenance work authorization, compl

attributes.name: loto_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.loto_execution. Business justification: Each LOTO execution event must reference the specific equipment being serviced for compliance audit trails, zero-energy verification tracking, and incident investigation when unauthorized energization

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility where this equipment is installed and operates. Links equipment to its physical location for operational planning and reporting.

attributes.name: oem_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Equipment OEM vendors supply parts and service. Links equipment to vendor master for warranty management, OEM parts sourcing, and service contract administration - eliminates denormalized manufacturer

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.pm_schedule. Business justification: MRF equipment (balers, optical sorters, conveyors) requires scheduled preventive maintenance to maintain throughput capacity and quality standards. PM schedules drive maintenance planning for recyclin

attributes.name: spare_parts_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material. Business justification: Equipment spare parts are materials in procurement/inventory systems. Links equipment to standard spare parts material master for maintenance planning, inventory management, and equipment lifecycle co

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or capital cost of the equipment in USD. Used for asset valuation, depreciation calculations, and return on investment analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business criticality classification of the equipment based on impact to MRF operations if the equipment fails. Used for maintenance prioritization and spare parts inventory planning.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to depreciate the equipment asset over its useful life. Determines how asset value is expensed over time.

attributes.name: design_throughput_capacity_tph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Throughput Capacity Tons Per Hour (TPH)
attributes.description: Manufacturer-rated processing capacity of the equipment measured in tons per hour. Used for capacity planning, bottleneck analysis, and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equipment requires specific environmental permits or air quality permits for operation. Used for EPA and state environmental compliance tracking.

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the MRF equipment asset for operational identification and reporting.

attributes.name: equipment_tag
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset tag or equipment number assigned to this MRF processing equipment. Used for physical identification, maintenance tracking, and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MRF processing equipment by functional category. Determines the equipment's role in the material recovery and sorting process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: baler|optical_sorter|conveyor|eddy_current_separator|magnetic_separator|shredder|glass_breaker|trommel_screen|air_classifier|compactor — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: floor_space_sqft
attributes.description: Physical footprint of the equipment in square feet. Used for facility layout planning and space utilization analysis.

attributes.name: infor_eam_asset_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Infor Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Asset ID
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier to the corresponding asset record in the Infor EAM system. Enables integration for maintenance work orders, parts inventory, and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment was installed and commissioned at the MRF facility. Used for age tracking, depreciation calculations, and lifecycle planning.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equipment record is currently active in the system. Used for filtering active assets in operational reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety or operational inspection performed on this equipment. Used for regulatory compliance and safety audit tracking.

attributes.name: last_pm_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent preventive maintenance service was completed on this equipment. Used for maintenance compliance tracking and scheduling.

attributes.name: lockout_tagout_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equipment requires lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance or service per OSHA regulations. Critical for worker safety compliance.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures_hours
attributes.description: Average operational time between equipment failures measured in hours. Key reliability metric used for maintenance planning and equipment performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair_hours
attributes.description: Average time required to repair the equipment when a failure occurs, measured in hours. Used for downtime planning and maintenance resource allocation.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model number or designation for this equipment type. Used for parts compatibility, technical specifications, and maintenance procedures.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required safety or operational inspection. Used for compliance planning and inspection scheduling.

attributes.name: next_pm_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service on this equipment. Used for maintenance planning and downtime scheduling.

attributes.name: noise_level_db
attributes.description: Operational noise level produced by the equipment measured in decibels. Used for OSHA hearing protection compliance and facility noise management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special handling instructions, or operational notes about the equipment.

attributes.name: operating_hours_meter
attributes.description: Cumulative operating hours recorded for this equipment since installation or last meter reset. Used for usage-based maintenance scheduling and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the MRF equipment. Indicates whether the equipment is available for production, undergoing maintenance, or offline.

attributes.name: power_rating_kw
attributes.description: Electrical power consumption rating of the equipment in kilowatts. Used for energy cost analysis, electrical capacity planning, and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: safety_certification
attributes.description: Safety certifications or compliance standards met by the equipment (e.g., UL, CE, OSHA). Used for regulatory compliance and workplace safety verification.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for this specific equipment unit. Used for warranty claims, service history, and asset tracking.

attributes.name: sort_line_assignment
attributes.description: Designation of the specific sorting line or processing line within the MRF where this equipment is positioned. Used for throughput tracking and line balancing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment record was last modified in the system. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected operational lifespan of the equipment in years for depreciation and lifecycle planning purposes.

attributes.name: voltage_requirement
attributes.description: Electrical voltage specification required for equipment operation (e.g., 480V 3-phase). Used for electrical infrastructure planning and safety compliance.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer's warranty coverage for this equipment expires. Used for maintenance cost planning and warranty claim eligibility.

attributes.name: weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of the equipment in pounds. Used for structural load calculations, rigging planning, and relocation logistics.

products.name: material_composition
products.description: Transactional record of material composition analysis performed on inbound loads or sort session samples at a MRF. Captures analysis date, inbound load or sort session reference, sample weight (lbs), fiber percentage (OCC, mixed paper, newspaper), plastics percentage (PET, HDPE, mixed), metals percentage (aluminum, steel), glass percentage (clear, colored), organics percentage, other recyclables percentage, contamination percentage, analysis method (manual sort audit, NIR scan), and analyst ID. Supports contamination trending, diversion rate accuracy, and EPA reporting.
products.reference: MRF Sort Audit / Material Composition Analysis

attributes.name: material_composition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each material composition analysis record at the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF). Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: customer_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection route from which the sampled inbound load originated. Enables contamination trending by geographic route or service area, supporting targeted customer education programs and route-level diversion rate analysis.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Management; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: diversion_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.diversion_record. Business justification: Material composition analysis determines what percentage of input stream is diverted vs. landfilled, feeding diversion records. Business need: Diversion rate validation, contamination impact quantific

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility where the material composition analysis was performed. Links to the facility master record.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Facility Reporting; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: inbound_load_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound material load (truck delivery or collection route drop-off) that was sampled for this composition analysis. Nullable when analysis is performed on a sort session sample rather than a specific inbound load.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Inbound Load Tracking; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: mrf_equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Infor EAM asset record for the NIR (Near-Infrared) optical sorter or scanner used when analysis_method is nir_scan. Null for manual sort audit analyses. Supports equipment performance tracking and calibration compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: primary_material_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM workforce record of the technician or analyst who performed the material composition analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Workforce Records; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: sort_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF sort line where the sample was collected or processed. Links to the recycling.sort_line product for sort line configuration and throughput context. Supports sort line performance benchmarking and contamination trending by line.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Sort Line Tracking; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: sort_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF sort line session from which the sample was drawn for composition analysis. Nullable when analysis is tied directly to an inbound load rather than a sort session.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Sort Session Tracking; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Material composition analyses detecting hazardous constituents (batteries, electronics, chemicals) trigger waste profiling requirements for proper characterization and disposal. Real business process:

attributes.name: aluminum_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of aluminum (primarily UBC — Used Beverage Cans) in the analyzed sample. Aluminum is the highest-value metal commodity recovered at MRFs. Tracked for commodity recovery, diversion rate, and SAP MM inventory valuation.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; LME Aluminum Commodity Standards

attributes.name: analysis_method
attributes.description: The technique used to perform the material composition analysis. Manual sort audit involves physical hand-sorting of a sample; NIR (Near-Infrared) scan uses optical sensor technology; grab sample is a single-point collection; composite sample aggregates multiple grab samples across a shift or load.
attributes.references: ASTM D5231 Standard Test Method for Determination of the Composition of Unprocessed Municipal Solid Waste; EPA Recycling Measurement Guidance

attributes.name: analysis_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this composition analysis record, formatted as MC-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-referencing with EPA recycling reports, audit documentation, and SAP MM commodity inventory records.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SAP MM Material Document Numbering

attributes.name: analysis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material composition analysis record. Draft indicates data entry in progress; pending_review awaits QC supervisor sign-off; approved indicates validated and accepted for reporting; rejected indicates failed QC review; voided indicates cancelled or superseded record.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SWANA MRF Quality Control Standards

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world date and time when the material composition analysis was physically performed at the MRF. Distinct from record creation audit timestamp. Used for contamination trending and EPA recycling reporting period alignment.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: clear_glass_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of clear (flint) glass in the analyzed sample. Clear glass commands the highest glass commodity price and is tracked separately from colored glass for accurate market valuation and EPA reporting.
attributes.references: Glass Packaging Institute Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: colored_glass_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of colored glass (amber, green) in the analyzed sample. Colored glass has lower commodity value than clear glass and is tracked separately for accurate diversion rate and market pricing analysis.
attributes.references: Glass Packaging Institute Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: contamination_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of non-recyclable contaminants (hazardous materials, food-soiled items, non-accepted materials, residue) in the analyzed sample. Critical KPI for MRF operations, commodity quality, and EPA recycling program compliance. High contamination triggers customer outreach and education programs.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SWANA MRF Contamination Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this material composition analysis record was first created in the system. Populated automatically at record insertion. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer lakehouse processing.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: diversion_rate_contribution_pct
attributes.description: The estimated recyclable material percentage from this analysis that contributes to the facility diversion rate calculation (total recyclables recovered / total material received). Equals 100% minus contamination% minus residue%. Used for EPA recycling program reporting and circular economy goal tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SWANA Diversion Rate Calculation Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: hazardous_material_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any hazardous or household hazardous waste materials identified in the sample. Populated only when hazardous_material_found is True. Supports RCRA incident reporting, Enviance EHS documentation, and DOT compliance.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: hazardous_material_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether any hazardous or household hazardous waste (HHW) materials were identified in the sample during analysis. True triggers mandatory incident reporting per RCRA and Enviance EHS protocols. Critical for worker safety (OSHA) and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C Hazardous Waste Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication; Enviance EHS Incident Reporting

attributes.name: hdpe_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene, Resin Code #2) plastics in the analyzed sample. HDPE includes milk jugs and detergent bottles. Tracked separately as a distinct commodity grade with its own market pricing.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ASTM Resin Identification Codes

attributes.name: material_stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material stream being analyzed. Single stream combines all recyclables; dual stream separates fiber from containers; source separated isolates specific commodities; MSW (Municipal Solid Waste) is mixed waste; C&D (Construction and Demolition) waste is construction debris.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: mixed_paper_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of mixed paper (office paper, magazines, junk mail, paperboard) in the analyzed sample. Mixed paper is a lower-grade fiber commodity. Tracked for diversion rate reporting and commodity market pricing.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: mixed_plastics_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of mixed plastics (Resin Codes #3-#7, excluding PET and HDPE) in the analyzed sample. Mixed plastics have lower commodity value and may be directed to waste-to-energy or residue streams depending on market conditions.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ASTM Resin Identification Codes

attributes.name: newspaper_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of Old Newspaper (ONP) in the analyzed sample. ONP is a distinct fiber grade with its own commodity market pricing. Tracked separately from mixed paper for accurate commodity recovery reporting.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: occ_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of Old Corrugated Cardboard (OCC) in the analyzed sample. OCC is a high-value fiber commodity recovered at MRFs. Used for commodity recovery tracking, diversion rate calculation, and SAP MM inventory valuation.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SAP MM Commodity Classification

attributes.name: organics_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of organic material (food waste, yard waste, compostable material) in the analyzed sample. High organics content in recyclable streams indicates collection program contamination and reduces commodity quality. Tracked for contamination trending and EPA reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; RCRA Subtitle D; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: other_recyclables_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of other recoverable materials not classified in primary commodity categories (e.g., cartons, electronics, textiles, rigid plastics). Tracked to identify emerging commodity recovery opportunities and support diversion rate accuracy.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: pct_sum_check
attributes.description: Sum of all material category percentages (fiber + plastics + metals + glass + organics + other recyclables + contamination + residue). Should equal 100.00% for a valid analysis. Used for data quality validation and QC review. Values deviating from 100.00 flag data entry errors.
attributes.references: ASTM D5231 Standard Test Method; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: pet_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate, Resin Code #1) plastics in the analyzed sample. PET includes beverage bottles and food containers. High-value plastic commodity tracked for recovery rate and EPA recycling reporting.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ASTM Resin Identification Codes

attributes.name: qc_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the QC reviewer during the review process. Documents reasons for rejection, data corrections made, or observations about sample representativeness. Supports audit trail and continuous improvement.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SWANA MRF Quality Control Standards

attributes.name: qc_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QC supervisor completed review of this composition analysis record. Null until QC review is performed. Supports audit trail for EPA reporting and ISO 14001 compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The EPA or regulatory reporting period to which this composition analysis is attributed, formatted as YYYY-QN (quarterly) or YYYY-MM (monthly). Used to aggregate composition data for EPA recycling program reports, state environmental quality department submissions, and SWANA benchmarking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; State Environmental Quality Department Reporting Requirements; SWANA Benchmarking Program

attributes.name: residue_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of material directed to residue (landfill disposal) after MRF processing. Distinct from contamination percentage — residue includes unrecoverable fines, broken glass, and process losses. Used to calculate net diversion rate and landfill disposal costs.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: sample_source_type
attributes.description: Identifies the point in the MRF processing stream from which the sample was collected. Inbound load samples represent pre-processing material; sort line feed samples are taken mid-process; post-sort residue samples assess recovery efficiency; bale samples validate outbound commodity quality.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: sample_weight_lbs
attributes.description: The gross weight in pounds of the material sample drawn for composition analysis. Minimum representative sample weight per ASTM D5231 is typically 200 lbs for MSW streams. Used to validate statistical representativeness of the analysis.
attributes.references: ASTM D5231 Standard Test Method; EPA Recycling Measurement Guidance; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: steel_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of ferrous steel (tin cans, steel containers) in the analyzed sample. Steel is recovered via magnetic separation. Tracked for commodity recovery reporting and SAP MM inventory.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: total_fiber_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate percentage by weight of all fiber materials (OCC + mixed paper + newspaper) in the analyzed sample. Derived field stored for operational convenience and EPA reporting. Supports fiber commodity recovery trending and sort line performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular

attributes.name: total_glass_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate percentage by weight of all glass materials (clear + colored) in the analyzed sample. Stored for operational reporting and EPA recycling program compliance. Supports glass recovery trending.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; Glass Packaging Institute Standards

attributes.name: total_metals_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate percentage by weight of all metal materials (aluminum + steel) in the analyzed sample. Stored for operational reporting and EPA recycling program compliance. Supports metals recovery trending and commodity revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular

attributes.name: total_plastics_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate percentage by weight of all plastic materials (PET + HDPE + mixed plastics) in the analyzed sample. Stored for operational reporting and EPA recycling program compliance. Supports plastics recovery trending.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this material composition analysis record was last modified. Updated on every write operation. Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

products.name: recycling_buyer_contract
products.description: Master record for commodity offtake agreements and sales contracts between Waste Management MRF operations and commodity buyers. Captures contract number, commodity buyer reference, commodity reference, contract type (spot, short-term, long-term offtake), contract start date, contract end date, committed volume (tons/month), price mechanism (fixed, index-linked, floor-and-ceiling), price index reference, minimum quality grade required, penalty clauses for contamination, contract status (draft, active, expired, terminated), and SAP SD contract reference. Distinct from the contract domain — this is the MRF-specific commodity sales agreement.

attributes.name: recycling_buyer_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the MRF commodity offtake agreement or sales contract record in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity buyer (counterparty) master record — the organization purchasing recovered materials from the MRF under this contract.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recovered commodity master record (e.g., OCC, HDPE, aluminum, glass) that is the subject of this offtake agreement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Buyer contracts for commodity sales are specialized service agreements governed by the master contract framework. Operations teams track contract lifecycle, amendments, renewals, terminations, and com

attributes.name: contract_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Waste Management employee (typically MRF Commodity Manager or Regional Sales Manager) responsible for managing and maintaining this buyer contract.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Master; Waste Management Contract Ownership Policy

attributes.name: export_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Export contracts for recyclable commodities require EPA export permits and international waste shipment permits (Basel Convention compliance). Enables verification of export authorization and tracking

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility originating this commodity sales contract. Identifies which processing facility is the selling party.
attributes.references: Waste Management Facility Master; EPA SWIS Facility Registry

attributes.name: salesforce_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Contract ID
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM contract record identifier linked to this commodity offtake agreement. Used for cross-system traceability between the MRF data product and the CRM contract management module.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management; Waste Management CRM Integration Standards

attributes.name: sourcing_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_contract. Business justification: Commodity sales contracts may reference procurement contracts in closed-loop/take-back agreements (e.g., supplier takes back packaging as recyclable commodity). Enables integrated contract management

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract automatically renews at expiration unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal within the renewal_notice_days period.

attributes.name: bale_weight_spec_lbs
attributes.description: The contractually specified target bale weight in pounds for commodity shipments under this agreement. Deviations from this specification may trigger price adjustments or load rejections.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; Waste Management MRF Baling Standards

attributes.name: base_price_per_ton
attributes.description: The contractually agreed base price per short ton for the commodity in US dollars. For fixed-price contracts, this is the locked price. For index-linked contracts, this may represent the base or floor price. Used in revenue recognition and commodity sales reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP SD Pricing Condition; Waste Management MRF Revenue Policy

attributes.name: ceiling_price_per_ton
attributes.description: The maximum price per short ton the buyer will pay, applicable when price_mechanism is 'floor_and_ceiling'. Caps the MRF's upside in exchange for floor price protection. Null for non-floor-and-ceiling contracts.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Commercial Policy; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: committed_volume_tons_monthly
attributes.description: The contractually committed volume of recovered commodity in short tons per month that Waste Management agrees to supply to the buyer. Used for production planning, route optimization, and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Operations Standard; NWRA Commodity Sales Guidelines

attributes.name: contamination_penalty_basis
attributes.description: The method by which contamination penalties are assessed: per_ton (rate applied to excess contamination weight), flat_fee (fixed charge per non-conforming load), price_deduction_pct (percentage reduction from invoice price), or load_rejection (load refused and returned at seller's cost).
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Commercial Policy; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular

attributes.name: contamination_penalty_rate
attributes.description: The contractual penalty rate in US dollars per short ton applied to shipments that exceed the maximum allowable contamination percentage. Used to calculate contamination surcharge deductions from commodity revenue.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Commercial Policy; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: contract_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional contract terms, special conditions, buyer-specific requirements, or operational notes not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commodity offtake agreement. Draft: under negotiation; Active: binding and in force; Suspended: temporarily paused; Expired: reached end date without renewal; Terminated: cancelled before end date.
attributes.references: Waste Management Contract Lifecycle Policy; SAP SD Contract Status

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commodity sales agreement by duration and commitment structure. Spot contracts are single-transaction; short-term are typically under 12 months; long-term offtake agreements are multi-year committed volume arrangements; evergreen contracts auto-renew; trial contracts are provisional.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Commercial Policy; NWRA Commodity Sales Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this buyer contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Waste Management Data Governance Policy; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: The agreed delivery terms defining when title and risk of loss transfer from Waste Management to the buyer. FOB Origin: buyer takes title at MRF loading dock; FOB Destination: title transfers at buyer's facility; Ex Works: buyer arranges all transport.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Shipping Conditions; DOT Freight Regulations

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The contractually agreed method for resolving disputes between Waste Management and the commodity buyer regarding contract terms, quality, or payment.
attributes.references: Waste Management Legal Contract Policy; NWRA Dispute Resolution Guidelines

attributes.name: diversion_rate_credit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes provisions for diversion rate credits or incentives tied to the MRF's overall diversion rate performance. Supports EPA recycling reporting and circular economy goal tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; Waste Management Sustainability Policy; ISO 14001

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the commodity offtake agreement expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended evergreen contracts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP SD Contract Validity

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract grants the buyer exclusive rights to purchase a specific commodity from this MRF facility, preventing Waste Management from selling that commodity to competing buyers during the contract term.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Commercial Policy; Antitrust Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was formally signed and executed by both parties. May differ from the effective start date for contracts with retroactive or future effective dates.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; Waste Management Legal Contract Policy

attributes.name: floor_price_per_ton
attributes.description: The minimum guaranteed price per short ton below which the buyer will not pay, applicable when price_mechanism is 'floor_and_ceiling'. Protects the MRF from extreme market downturns. Null for non-floor-and-ceiling contracts.
attributes.references: Waste Management MRF Commercial Policy; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract contains a force majeure clause that suspends obligations in the event of extraordinary circumstances (natural disasters, regulatory shutdowns, pandemics). Relevant for EPA/OSHA emergency compliance scenarios.
attributes.references: Waste Management Legal Contract Policy; CERCLA Emergency Provisions

attributes.name: governing_law_state
