attributes.description: Total weight in short tons of all inbound material received at the MRF during the reporting period, including both recyclable and residue streams. Used as the denominator for diversion rate calculation.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Reporting Guidelines; RCRA Subtitle D; SWANA Recycling Metrics Standards

attributes.name: total_tons_recycled
attributes.description: Total weight in short tons of all recovered materials processed and diverted from landfill during the reporting period across all commodity streams at the MRF. This is the primary quantitative outcome metric of the recycling report.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Reporting Guidelines; RCRA Subtitle D; SWANA Recycling Metrics Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EPA recycling report record was last modified in the Waste Management lakehouse. Updated on every status change, data correction, or agency response update. Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Waste Management Data Governance Standards

products.name: mrf_tsdf_disposal_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual disposal agreement between a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) and a Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility (TSDF). It captures the business relationship where MRFs contract with TSDFs to dispose of contaminated residue, rejected bales, and hazmat-contaminated materials that cannot be recycled. Each record links one MRF to one TSDF with contract terms, approved waste codes, pricing, volume commitments, and shipment tracking that exist only in the context of this specific disposal relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, MRF facilities maintain disposal contracts with multiple TSDF facilities to handle different waste streams (contaminated residue, rejected bales, hazmat-contaminated materials), and each TSDF serves multiple MRF facilities across the service region. The business actively manages these disposal agreements as contractual relationships with specific terms, pricing, approved waste codes, volume commitments, and shipment tracking that vary by MRF-TSDF pairing.

attributes.name: mrf_tsdf_disposal_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each MRF-TSDF disposal agreement record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mrf Tsdf Disposal Agreement - Mrf Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Materials Recovery Facility that is party to this disposal agreement

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mrf Tsdf Disposal Agreement - Tsdf Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the TSDF facility that is party to this disposal agreement

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this disposal agreement indicating whether shipments are authorized. Active agreements allow shipments; Suspended/Expired/Terminated agreements require resolution before shipments can resume.

attributes.name: annual_volume_commitment_tons
attributes.description: Minimum annual tonnage of waste that the MRF commits to ship to this TSDF under this agreement. Volume commitments typically secure favorable pricing and capacity guarantees.

attributes.name: approved_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) that this specific MRF is authorized to ship to this specific TSDF under this agreement. Subset of the TSDF's overall permitted_waste_codes, tailored to the MRF's waste streams.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this disposal agreement became effective and the MRF was authorized to begin shipping waste to this TSDF under the agreed terms.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this disposal agreement expires or is scheduled for renewal. MRF must renegotiate or establish alternative disposal arrangements before this date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disposal agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disposal agreement record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent waste shipment from this MRF to this TSDF under this agreement. Used to monitor active vs. dormant disposal relationships and contract utilization.

attributes.name: pricing_per_ton
attributes.description: Contracted disposal fee in dollars per ton that the MRF pays to the TSDF for accepting and processing waste under this agreement. Pricing varies by MRF-TSDF relationship based on volume commitments, waste types, and distance.

attributes.name: primary_waste_stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary waste stream that this MRF ships to this TSDF (e.g., contaminated residue, rejected bales, hazmat-contaminated materials, process water treatment sludge). MRFs may have multiple agreements with different TSDFs for different waste streams.

attributes.name: total_shipments_ytd
attributes.description: Count of waste shipments from this MRF to this TSDF in the current calendar year. Used to track contract activity and compare against volume commitments.

products.name: buyer_tsdf_return_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual agreement between commodity buyers and TSDF facilities for handling contaminated recyclable material returns. It captures the business rules, cost responsibilities, and operational protocols that govern how rejected or contaminated bales from commodity buyers are disposed of through specific TSDF facilities. Each record links one commodity buyer to one TSDF facility with attributes that define the terms of their contamination disposition relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management recycling operations, commodity buyers who purchase recovered materials from MRFs establish formal agreements with multiple TSDF facilities to handle contaminated or rejected bales that fail quality standards. Each buyer maintains relationships with multiple TSDFs to cover different contamination scenarios, geographic regions, and waste code requirements. Conversely, TSDF facilities serve multiple commodity buyers under separate contractual terms. The business actively manages these buyer-TSDF agreements as operational contracts with specific contamination thresholds, cost responsibilities, and notification protocols.

attributes.name: buyer_tsdf_return_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this buyer-TSDF return agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buyer Tsdf Return Agreement - Commodity Buyer Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commodity buyer who has established this contamination return agreement

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buyer Tsdf Return Agreement - Tsdf Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the TSDF facility authorized to receive contaminated returns under this agreement

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this buyer-TSDF return agreement. ACTIVE agreements are in force, SUSPENDED agreements are temporarily inactive, EXPIRED agreements have passed their expiration date, TERMINATED agreements have been formally ended.

attributes.name: contamination_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable contamination percentage in recovered material bales before rejection and TSDF disposition is triggered under this agreement. Varies by buyer quality standards and commodity type.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this buyer-TSDF return agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposal_cost_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines which party bears the financial responsibility for TSDF disposal costs for contaminated returns. Values: BUYER (buyer pays all costs), WM (Waste Management absorbs costs), SHARED (split per agreement terms), NEGOTIATED (case-by-case determination).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this buyer-TSDF return agreement became effective and operational. Used for determining which agreement terms apply to contamination events.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this buyer-TSDF return agreement expires or requires renewal. Null indicates an evergreen agreement with no fixed expiration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this buyer-TSDF return agreement record was last updated.

attributes.name: max_annual_volume_tons
attributes.description: Maximum tonnage of contaminated material that can be sent to this TSDF facility under this agreement within a calendar year. Used for capacity planning and agreement compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional terms, special conditions, or operational notes specific to this buyer-TSDF return agreement.

attributes.name: notification_protocol
attributes.description: Describes the required communication and notification procedures when contaminated material is identified and routed to the TSDF under this agreement. May include contact sequences, documentation requirements, and timeline expectations.

attributes.name: preferred_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes that this buyer-TSDF agreement is specifically designed to handle. Subset of the TSDF facility's permitted waste codes, tailored to the buyer's typical contamination profile.

attributes.name: return_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity buyer must provide explicit written authorization before contaminated material can be sent to this TSDF facility. Affects operational workflow and liability.

products.name: facility_initiative_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between MRF facilities and carbon reduction initiatives. It captures facility-specific implementation details, timelines, investment allocation, and CO2e reduction contributions for each initiative at each facility. Each record links one MRF facility to one carbon initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific facility-initiative participation.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, carbon reduction initiatives are implemented across multiple MRF facilities in phased rollouts, and each facility participates in multiple concurrent sustainability programs (e.g., LED retrofits, solar installations, equipment efficiency upgrades). The business actively manages facility-specific implementation timelines, investment allocations, CO2e reduction contributions, and project status for each facility-initiative combination to support ESG reporting, ROI tracking, and initiative portfolio management.

attributes.name: facility_initiative_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each facility-initiative participation record

attributes.name: carbon_initiative_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Initiative Participation - Carbon Initiative Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carbon reduction initiative being implemented at the facility

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Initiative Participation - Mrf Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MRF facility participating in the carbon initiative

attributes.name: actual_reduction_tons
attributes.description: Actual measured annual CO2e reduction in metric tons achieved at this facility after initiative implementation. Null until post-implementation measurement is completed.

attributes.name: baseline_emissions_tons
attributes.description: Facility-specific baseline annual emissions in metric tons CO2e measured prior to initiative implementation, used to calculate actual reduction achieved at this facility.

attributes.name: facility_contribution_co2e_tons
attributes.description: Projected or actual annual CO2e reduction in metric tons attributable to this specific facility's participation in this initiative. Facility-level contribution that rolls up to the initiative's total target_co2e_reduction_tons.

attributes.name: facility_investment_amount
attributes.description: Capital investment allocated to this specific facility for implementing this carbon initiative. Facility-level investment that rolls up to the initiative's total capital_investment_amount.

attributes.name: facility_project_manager
attributes.description: Name of the facility-level project manager or site lead responsible for implementing this initiative at this specific MRF facility.

attributes.name: facility_role_in_initiative
attributes.description: Role or phase designation for this facility within the initiative. Values include: pilot (testing/proof-of-concept site), full_implementation (standard rollout), phase_1/phase_2 (staged deployment), control_group (baseline comparison facility).

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current implementation status of this carbon initiative at this specific facility. Values: planned (scheduled but not started), in_progress (actively implementing), completed (fully implemented and operational), on_hold (temporarily paused), cancelled (discontinued at this facility).

attributes.name: implementation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing facility-specific implementation details, challenges, lessons learned, or deviations from standard initiative approach.

attributes.name: participation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific MRF facility completed implementation of this carbon initiative or ceased participation. Null if participation is ongoing.

attributes.name: participation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific MRF facility began participating in or implementing this carbon initiative. May differ from the initiative's overall planned_start_date due to phased rollout across facilities.

products.name: program_target_contribution
products.description: This association product represents the contribution relationship between recycling programs and corporate sustainability reduction targets. It captures how each recycling program contributes to achieving specific sustainability commitments, tracking baseline performance, actual contribution values, alignment timelines, and reporting status. Each record links one recycling program to one reduction target with attributes that quantify and track the program's role in achieving the target.. Existence Justification: In waste management sustainability operations, corporate reduction targets (e.g., 30% diversion rate increase, 50% Scope 1 emissions reduction) are achieved through the coordinated contribution of multiple recycling programs, and each recycling program simultaneously contributes to multiple sustainability targets. The sustainability team actively manages these contribution relationships, tracking each program's baseline performance, actual contribution value, contribution percentage, and reporting status for each target it supports. This is an operational management relationship, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: program_target_contribution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the program-target contribution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: recycling_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program Target Contribution - Recycling Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the recycling program that contributes to the sustainability target

attributes.name: reduction_target_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program Target Contribution - Reduction Target Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability reduction target being supported by the program

attributes.name: actual_contribution_value
attributes.description: The actual measured contribution value that this program has delivered toward the target, expressed in the target's unit of measure. Updated periodically based on operational data from the recycling program.

attributes.name: alignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this recycling program stopped or is scheduled to stop contributing toward this sustainability target. Null for ongoing contributions. Used when programs are retired or removed from target scope.

attributes.name: alignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this recycling program began contributing toward this specific sustainability target. May differ from program start date if target was established later or program was added to target scope after launch.

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: The baseline measurement for this specific program in the context of this target, measured in the target's unit of measure. Represents the program's starting point performance in the baseline year for this target.

attributes.name: contribution_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the calculation methodology used to determine this program's contribution to the target. May reference specific formulas, data sources, or allocation methods used for this program-target combination.

attributes.name: contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the overall target achievement that this specific recycling program is expected to contribute. Used for proportional allocation of target responsibility across multiple programs.

attributes.name: last_measurement_date
attributes.description: The date when the actual contribution value was last calculated and updated. Used to track data freshness for sustainability reporting and to schedule next measurement cycle.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting assumptions, exclusions, adjustments, or other relevant context for this program's contribution to this target. Used for audit trail and sustainability report footnotes.

attributes.name: reporting_status
attributes.description: Current status of this program's contribution reporting for this target. Active indicates ongoing tracking and reporting. Pending indicates contribution not yet started. Suspended indicates temporary exclusion. Completed indicates target achieved or program contribution ended. Excluded indicates program removed from target scope.

products.name: commodity_acceptance
products.description: This association product represents the operational acceptance criteria between recovered commodities and service offerings. It captures which commodities are accepted under which service offerings, along with offering-specific quality thresholds, pricing mechanisms, and grade restrictions. Each record links one commodity to one offering with attributes that define the acceptance terms for that specific commodity-offering combination.. Existence Justification: In waste management recycling operations, a single service offering (e.g., Commercial Recycling Program) accepts multiple commodity types (paper, plastic, metal, glass), and each commodity can be accepted under multiple service offerings (residential curbside, commercial front-load, industrial programs). The business actively manages commodity acceptance specifications per offering, including offering-specific contamination thresholds, accepted grade lists, pricing mechanisms, and volume requirements that vary by service tier and customer segment.

attributes.name: commodity_acceptance_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each commodity-offering acceptance specification

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the recovered commodity master

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the service offering master

attributes.name: acceptance_status
attributes.description: Current status of this commodity acceptance under this service offering. Active = currently accepted, Suspended = temporarily not accepted (e.g., due to market conditions or contamination issues), Discontinued = permanently removed from offering.

attributes.name: accepted_grade_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or JSON list of ISRI grade codes accepted for this commodity under this specific service offering. Allows service offerings to restrict which grades are acceptable (e.g., residential service may only accept Grade A OCC, while commercial accepts Grades A and B).

attributes.name: contamination_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable contamination percentage for this commodity under this service offering. May differ from the commodity master default to reflect service-level quality requirements (e.g., premium recycling programs have stricter thresholds than standard programs).

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity acceptance specification record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this commodity acceptance specification became or will become active for this service offering. Supports versioning of acceptance criteria over time.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this commodity acceptance specification expires or was superseded. Null for currently active specifications. Supports historical tracking of acceptance criteria changes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified this commodity acceptance specification record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity acceptance specification record was last updated.

attributes.name: minimum_volume_lbs
attributes.description: Minimum volume in pounds of this commodity required per pickup or billing period for this service offering. Null if no minimum applies. Used for commercial/industrial programs with volume commitments.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Method by which the commodity sale price or revenue share is determined for this commodity-offering combination. Values: spot (current market spot price), indexed (tied to published index), fixed (contracted fixed price), revenue_share (percentage of commodity revenue credited to customer), cost_plus (cost recovery plus margin).

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why this commodity is not accepted or was suspended under this service offering (e.g., MARKET_COLLAPSE, CONTAMINATION_ISSUE, EQUIPMENT_LIMITATION). Null for active acceptances.

attributes.name: revenue_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of commodity sale revenue credited back to the customer under this service offering. Applicable when pricing_basis is revenue_share. Null for other pricing methods.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this commodity acceptance specification record.

products.name: commodity_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between a recovered commodity type and a vendor who supplies or purchases that commodity. It captures vendor-specific pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, quality grade requirements, and contract terms that exist only in the context of this specific commodity-vendor pairing. Each record links one commodity to one vendor with commercial terms negotiated for that specific material stream.. Existence Justification: In waste management recycling operations, commodities (recovered materials like OCC, mixed paper, plastics) can be sourced from multiple vendors through buy-back programs, commercial purchases, and third-party processors, while vendors supply multiple commodity types with varying pricing and quality terms. The business actively manages commodity supply agreements as contractual relationships with vendor-specific pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and quality grade requirements that vary by the commodity-vendor pairing.

attributes.name: commodity_supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each commodity-vendor supply agreement record

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the recovered commodity master, identifying which material type this supply agreement covers

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor master, identifying which supplier or buyer this agreement is with

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this supply agreement: active (currently in effect), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (negotiated but not yet effective), expired (term ended), terminated (cancelled before term end)

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: External contract or agreement reference number governing the commercial terms for this commodity-vendor relationship. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this supply agreement record was created

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply agreement becomes effective and pricing/terms apply

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply agreement expires or is scheduled for renegotiation

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from order placement to delivery or pickup for this commodity from this vendor. Lead time varies by vendor based on logistics, processing capacity, and geographic location. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity (in commodity unit of measure) required per order for this commodity from this vendor. MOQ varies by vendor based on transportation economics and processing batch sizes. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms specific to this commodity-vendor agreement, may override vendor master default payment terms for this material type

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred supplier for this commodity based on price, quality, reliability, or strategic relationship

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Specific quality grade or specification required by this vendor for this commodity. May differ from the commodity master ISRI grade if vendor has stricter or custom requirements. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Negotiated price per unit of measure for this commodity from this specific vendor. Price varies by vendor based on market conditions, volume commitments, and quality requirements. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this supply agreement record was last modified

products.name: commodity_regulatory_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance mapping between recovered commodities and applicable regulatory requirements. It captures which specific regulations apply to each commodity type, along with commodity-specific compliance thresholds, testing protocols, and documentation standards that vary by commodity-regulation combination. Each record links one commodity to one regulatory requirement with attributes that define how that specific regulation applies to that specific commodity.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, a single recovered commodity (e.g., lithium batteries, contaminated cardboard, e-waste) is subject to multiple regulatory requirements from different agencies (EPA RCRA rules, DOT transport regulations, state solid waste codes, OSHA handling standards). Conversely, a single regulatory requirement (e.g., RCRA hazardous waste manifest requirements) applies to multiple commodity types (batteries, e-waste, contaminated materials, certain plastics). The business actively manages these mappings because compliance thresholds, testing protocols, and documentation standards vary by commodity-regulation combination—the same EPA regulation may require TCLP testing quarterly for batteries but monthly for contaminated plastics.

attributes.name: commodity_regulatory_applicability_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each commodity-regulation applicability mapping record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the recovered commodity master record

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commodity Regulatory Applicability - Regulatory Requirement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory requirement record

attributes.name: commodity_regulatory_applicability_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this applicability mapping record. Active mappings drive compliance workflows; inactive mappings are historical.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing commodity-specific compliance considerations, interpretations, or special handling instructions for this regulation (e.g., 'Applies only to batteries containing lithium', 'Requires pre-notification to state DEP').

attributes.name: compliance_threshold
attributes.description: Commodity-specific compliance threshold or trigger value that determines when this regulatory requirement applies (e.g., 'contamination >5%', 'bale weight >1000 lbs', 'hazardous material present'). Thresholds vary by commodity type even for the same regulation.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity-regulation applicability mapping was created in the system.

attributes.name: documentation_standard
attributes.description: Specific documentation or record-keeping standard required for this commodity under this regulation (e.g., 'EPA Form 8700-22 for hazardous waste', 'Bill of Lading with ISRI grade certification', 'Chain of Custody documentation'). Documentation requirements vary by commodity type.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory requirement became applicable to this specific commodity. May differ from the regulation's general effective date if commodity-specific applicability was determined later or phased in.

attributes.name: exemption_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number or citation for any exemption granted for this commodity under this regulation (e.g., EPA exemption letter number, state variance approval number).

attributes.name: exemption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether an exemption from this regulatory requirement has been requested or granted for this commodity. Tracks exemption lifecycle.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory requirement ceases to apply to this commodity, if applicable (e.g., due to commodity reclassification, regulation sunset, or exemption granted).

attributes.name: last_compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance review or audit confirming this commodity's adherence to this regulatory requirement. Used to track compliance verification currency.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this applicability mapping record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this applicability mapping record.

attributes.name: next_compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit of this commodity against this regulatory requirement. Drives compliance calendar and audit scheduling.

attributes.name: requirement_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory requirement is mandatory, conditional (applies only under certain circumstances), recommended, or not applicable for this specific commodity. Drives compliance workflow routing.

attributes.name: responsible_compliance_officer
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the compliance officer responsible for managing this commodity's compliance with this specific regulation. Enables accountability and contact routing.

attributes.name: testing_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of compliance testing or sampling for this commodity under this regulation (e.g., TCLP testing frequency for hazardous commodities, contamination testing for recyclables). Frequency varies by commodity-regulation combination.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this applicability mapping record.

products.name: equipment_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between MRF processing equipment and employees authorized to operate it. It captures safety compliance, training completion, proficiency assessment, and authorization status for each employee-equipment pairing. Each record links one piece of MRF equipment to one certified employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this operational authorization relationship. Critical for shift scheduling, OSHA compliance, and safety management.. Existence Justification: In MRF operations, equipment certification represents a true many-to-many operational relationship. Each piece of specialized processing equipment (optical sorters, balers, eddy current separators) requires multiple certified operators across shifts to maintain 24/7 operations, and each MRF employee is typically certified on multiple equipment types to provide operational flexibility. The business actively manages these certifications with proficiency levels, expiration tracking, and authorization status as part of safety compliance and shift scheduling processes.

attributes.name: equipment_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this equipment certification record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: certifying_instructor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the instructor or supervisor who certified this employee on this equipment. Used for audit trail and training program management.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee who holds certification to operate the equipment

attributes.name: mrf_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MRF processing equipment asset that requires operator certification

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current authorization status for this employee-equipment certification. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data. Determines whether employee can be scheduled to operate this equipment.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee was certified to operate this specific equipment. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this equipment certification expires and requires renewal. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data. Critical for compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: incident_count
attributes.description: Number of safety incidents recorded for this employee operating this specific equipment. Used for safety performance tracking and recertification decisions.

attributes.name: last_proficiency_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent proficiency assessment for this employee on this equipment. Used to track ongoing competency verification.

attributes.name: next_proficiency_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next proficiency assessment. Used for compliance scheduling and training program management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding restrictions, special conditions, or observations related to this certification (e.g., 'Authorized for day shift only', 'Requires supervision for first 40 hours').

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: Assessed proficiency level of the employee operating this specific equipment. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data. Used for shift assignment and complex operation authorization.

attributes.name: total_operating_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative hours this employee has operated this specific equipment. Used for experience tracking and proficiency advancement decisions.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee completed required training for this equipment. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data. Used for OSHA recordkeeping.

products.name: facility_permit
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory permit assignment relationship between MRF facilities and environmental permits. It captures the specific permit-facility binding with effective dates, compliance status, and inspection history that exist only in the context of this regulatory relationship. Each record links one MRF facility to one permit with attributes tracking the lifecycle and compliance state of that specific permit at that specific facility.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, MRF facilities simultaneously hold multiple environmental permits (air quality, water discharge, stormwater, waste handling, RCRA hazardous waste) issued by different regulatory agencies, each with distinct effective dates, expiration dates, compliance requirements, and inspection schedules. Conversely, regional or multi-facility permits can cover multiple MRF facilities under a single permit number, particularly for air quality or stormwater permits. The business actively manages each facility-permit combination as a distinct compliance entity with its own lifecycle, tracking permit-specific compliance status, inspection history, renewal deadlines, and facility-specific conditions.

attributes.name: facility_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this facility-permit assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MRF facility that holds this permit

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the environmental permit held by the facility

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which this permit was formally assigned or associated with this facility in Waste Management's compliance tracking system. Used for audit trail and historical tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_officer_assigned
attributes.description: Name of the Waste Management compliance officer specifically assigned to manage this permit at this facility. May differ from the general permit compliance officer if facility-level assignments exist.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this facility with respect to this specific permit. Tracks whether the facility is meeting all conditions, limits, and reporting requirements imposed by this permit.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this permit became effective and binding for this specific facility. May differ from the permit's original issue date if the permit was transferred or amended for this facility.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this permit expires for this specific facility. Critical for renewal tracking and compliance planning. May differ from the master permit expiration if facility-specific amendments exist.

attributes.name: facility_specific_conditions
attributes.description: Additional conditions, limitations, or requirements specific to this facility's use of this permit. Supplements the general permit conditions with facility-specific operational constraints.

attributes.name: last_compliance_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent compliance report for this permit at this facility was submitted to the regulatory agency. Used to track reporting frequency adherence.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection conducted for this specific permit at this specific facility. Used to track inspection frequency and schedule future inspections.

attributes.name: next_compliance_report_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next compliance report for this permit at this facility must be submitted to the regulatory agency. Critical for avoiding reporting violations.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Anticipated or scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection of this permit at this facility. Used for compliance planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: permit_role
attributes.description: The functional role or purpose this permit serves at this specific facility. A facility may hold multiple permits serving different regulatory purposes (e.g., one for air emissions, one for water discharge, one for waste handling).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this permit was terminated, revoked, or otherwise ceased to be applicable to this facility. Null if the permit is still active.

domains.name: landfill
domains.description: Landfill site operations including cell management, waste placement, compaction ratios, daily cover application, leachate collection and treatment, landfill gas (LFG) monitoring (LEL readings), liner integrity, environmental monitoring (groundwater, air quality), airspace consumption tracking, capacity planning, and closure/cap plans. Manages tipping fees, tonnage received (TPD), and regulatory compliance for RCRA Subtitle D facilities. Supports EPA SWIS reporting and CERCLA/Superfund obligations. Integrates with Enviance EHS.
domains.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D / SWANA Landfill Operations Standards / Clean Air Act

products.name: site
products.description: Master record for each landfill facility. Captures site identity, physical location (GPS coordinates, address, county, state), permitted acreage, total design capacity (cubic yards and tons), current operational status (active/closed/post-closure), RCRA Subtitle D permit number, EPA facility ID, state SWIS registration number, liner system type, leachate management system type, LFG collection system presence, host community agreement reference, regulatory jurisdiction, and site classification (MSW, C&D, monofill). Top-level anchor for all landfill operational, environmental, and compliance data.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the landfill site. Primary key for all landfill operational, environmental, and compliance data anchored to this facility.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Large landfill sites operate as separate billing entities for host community agreements and inter-company transfers. Site generates internal invoices for corporate waste or bills host community for im

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_source. Business justification: Landfill sites are major stationary GHG emission sources requiring EPA GHGRP reporting under Subpart HH. Each site must be registered as an emission source for carbon accounting, regulatory compliance

attributes.name: regulated_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulated_facility. Business justification: Landfill sites are regulated facilities. Compliance domain maintains canonical regulated facility registry with EPA IDs, RCRA status, Title V designation, and compliance risk levels that landfill oper

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Landfill sites must implement site-specific safety programs for OSHA compliance (hazard communication, emergency response, confined space). Regulatory requirement and operational necessity for trackin

attributes.name: site_enviance_facility_id
attributes.description: Facility identifier as configured in the Enviance EHS system, which is the system of record for environmental compliance, permit tracking, and incident management at this facility. Used for cross-system data integration and compliance record linkage.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS System Integration; Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: site_epa_facility_id
attributes.description: EPA-assigned facility identifier used for federal environmental reporting, RCRA compliance tracking, and CERCLA/Superfund obligations. Format: two-letter state code followed by 10-digit numeric identifier.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA RCRA Information System (RCRAInfo); CERCLA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: tracked_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.tracked_site. Business justification: Landfill sites are sustainability-tracked facilities for ESG reporting boundary definition, GHG inventory scope determination, and regulatory compliance (EPA GHGRP, state programs). Essential for CDP,

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the landfill facility. Used for regulatory correspondence, emergency response coordination, and logistics routing.
attributes.references: DOT Facility Location Requirements; EPA Facility Registration

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the landfill facility (suite, building, gate number, or additional location descriptor).

attributes.name: airspace_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent engineering airspace survey used to calculate remaining airspace. Ensures remaining_airspace_cy reflects current conditions and supports audit trail for capacity reporting.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); SWANA Engineering Survey Standards

attributes.name: cap_system_type
attributes.description: Type of final cover (cap) system installed or planned for the landfill. The cap is the final cover system placed over closed portions of the landfill to minimize infiltration and control LFG emissions. 'final_cap' indicates permanent closure cap installed; 'interim_cap' indicates temporary cover on inactive areas; 'none' indicates active filling area; 'planned' indicates cap design approved but not yet constructed.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart F); EPA Final Cover Design Guidance

attributes.name: cercla_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Environmental Response Compensation and Liability Act (CERCLA) Status
attributes.description: Current CERCLA/Superfund status of the facility. Indicates whether the site is listed on the National Priorities List (NPL) or subject to CERCLA remedial action obligations. Drives legal liability accruals and environmental compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_listed|npl_listed|remedial_investigation|remedial_action|completed|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CERCLA (Superfund) Compliance Requirements; EPA NPL Database; IFRS/GAAP Environmental Liability

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Municipality or city in which the landfill facility is located. Used for jurisdictional determination, local enforcement agency (LEA) assignment, and host community agreement management.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authorities; LEA Jurisdiction Assignment

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Regulatory and operational classification of the landfill facility. MSW (Municipal Solid Waste) accepts household and commercial waste; C&D (Construction and Demolition) accepts construction debris; monofill accepts a single waste type; industrial accepts non-hazardous industrial waste; hazardous is a RCRA Subtitle C facility. Drives applicable regulatory framework and permitted waste streams.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); RCRA Subtitle C; EPA Waste Classification Guidelines

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landfill facility ceased accepting waste and initiated the formal closure process. Null for active facilities. Triggers post-closure care obligations under RCRA Subtitle D including 30-year monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart G); EPA Post-Closure Care Requirements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the facility location (e.g., USA). Supports multi-country enterprise reporting and regulatory framework determination.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County in which the landfill facility is located. Critical for determining applicable local solid waste authority jurisdiction, host community agreement obligations, and county-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authorities; SWANA Regional Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the landfill site master record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Record Management

attributes.name: ghg_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is subject to mandatory greenhouse gas (GHG) reporting under EPA 40 CFR Part 98 (Subpart HH for MSW landfills). Facilities exceeding the 25,000 metric ton CO2e threshold must report annually. Drives GHG data collection workflows in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98 Subpart HH); Clean Air Act (CAA); ISO 14001

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is subject to groundwater monitoring requirements under RCRA Subtitle D or state permit conditions. Drives scheduling of monitoring well sampling events and Enviance EHS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart E); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: host_community_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the host community agreement (HCA) between the facility operator and the local municipality. HCAs govern tipping fee sharing, traffic mitigation, odor controls, and community benefit obligations. Links to contract management records in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authorities; SWANA Host Community Agreement Guidelines

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the landfill facility centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for geospatial analysis, route optimization, emergency response, and environmental monitoring zone mapping.
attributes.references: GPS/WGS84 Standard; EPA Facility Geolocation Requirements

attributes.name: lea_name
attributes.description: Name of the Local Enforcement Agency (LEA) responsible for routine inspection and enforcement at the facility. In California and other states, LEAs are county-level agencies delegated enforcement authority by the state. Required for compliance contact management and inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments; CalRecycle LEA Program; SWANA LEA Standards

attributes.name: leachate_management_type
attributes.description: Type of leachate collection and management system installed at the facility. Leachate is the liquid that drains through the waste mass and must be managed to prevent groundwater contamination. Drives operational costs, permit conditions, and Clean Water Act (CWA) compliance obligations.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); Clean Water Act (CWA) NPDES Permit Requirements

attributes.name: lfg_collection_system
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active landfill gas (LFG) collection and control system is installed at the facility. LFG systems capture methane for waste-to-energy (WTE) or renewable natural gas (RNG) conversion, and are required under EPA New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) for qualifying facilities. Drives Clean Air Act compliance and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA) NSPS Subpart WWW/XXX; EPA LFG Energy Program; ISO 14001

attributes.name: lfg_utilization_type
attributes.description: Method by which captured landfill gas (LFG) is utilized or destroyed. 'flare_only' indicates gas is combusted without energy recovery; 'electricity_generation' indicates WTE power generation; 'RNG' indicates renewable natural gas pipeline injection; 'direct_use' indicates direct thermal use; 'none' indicates no LFG system. Drives GHG emissions reporting and sustainability metrics.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA) NSPS; EPA LFG Energy Program; GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: liner_system_type
attributes.description: Type of engineered liner system installed at the base of the landfill to prevent leachate migration into groundwater. Determines applicable regulatory standards, leachate collection design, and groundwater monitoring requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_composite|double_composite|clay|geomembrane|no_liner|other — promote to reference product if additional liner subtypes are needed]
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart D); EPA Liner System Design Guidance

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the landfill facility centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for geospatial analysis, route optimization, emergency response, and environmental monitoring zone mapping.
attributes.references: GPS/WGS84 Standard; EPA Facility Geolocation Requirements

attributes.name: monitoring_well_count
attributes.description: Total number of groundwater monitoring wells installed at the facility perimeter and downgradient locations as required by the facility permit. Used for compliance scheduling, sampling cost estimation, and permit condition verification.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart E); State Groundwater Monitoring Permit Conditions

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landfill facility first began accepting waste. Used for site age calculations, post-closure care timeline planning, and historical capacity consumption analysis.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the landfill site. 'active' indicates waste is actively being received; 'closed' indicates waste acceptance has ceased; 'post_closure' indicates the site is in the regulatory post-closure care period; 'permitted' indicates permit obtained but operations not yet commenced; 'construction' indicates liner/cell construction in progress; 'suspended' indicates operations temporarily halted.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current RCRA Subtitle D or state solid waste operating permit expires. Triggers permit renewal workflow in Enviance EHS. Facilities operating beyond this date without renewal are in violation of RCRA and state regulations.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: permit_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current operating permit was issued by the regulatory authority. Used to calculate permit duration, track renewal cycles, and support compliance audit documentation.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: permitted_acreage
attributes.description: Total land area in acres authorized under the current operating permit for waste disposal activities. Drives capacity planning, cell development scheduling, and permit boundary compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Solid Waste Permit

attributes.name: permitted_daily_receipt_tons
attributes.description: Maximum tonnage per day (TPD) the facility is permitted to receive under its current operating permit. Operational throughput must not exceed this limit without permit modification. Used for daily tonnage monitoring and permit compliance alerts in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Solid Waste Operating Permit

attributes.name: post_closure_end_date
attributes.description: Projected or actual date on which the mandatory post-closure care period ends (minimum 30 years after closure under RCRA Subtitle D). Used for long-range financial liability estimation and closure cost accrual under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart G); IFRS/GAAP Asset Retirement Obligation (ARO) Accounting; SOX

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP code for the landfill facility address. Used for geographic analysis, regulatory jurisdiction mapping, and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: rcra_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Subtitle D Permit Number
attributes.description: State-issued RCRA Subtitle D operating permit number authorizing the facility to receive and dispose of municipal solid waste (MSW) or other permitted waste streams. Required for regulatory compliance and annual permit renewal tracking.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the primary state or local regulatory agency with permitting and enforcement authority over the facility (e.g., 'California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery', 'Texas Commission on Environmental Quality'). Determines applicable state-specific regulatory requirements beyond federal RCRA Subtitle D baseline.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments; RCRA Authorized State Programs

attributes.name: remaining_airspace_cy
attributes.description: Current remaining permitted airspace in cubic yards, calculated from the most recent engineering survey. Critical KPI for capacity planning, site life estimation, and financial asset valuation under IFRS/GAAP. Updated following each annual or semi-annual airspace survey.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); IFRS/GAAP Asset Valuation; SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP S/4HANA plant code assigned to this landfill facility. Used for financial cost center assignment, materials management (MM), plant maintenance (PM), and EHS module integration. Enables cross-domain financial and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Configuration; Internal ERP Integration Standards

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the landfill site across enterprise systems including SAP S/4HANA, Enviance EHS, and Infor EAM. Used as the cross-system business key.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard; SAP S/4HANA Plant Code Convention

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official operating name of the landfill facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in all internal and external communications.
attributes.references: EPA SWIS Facility Registration; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: standard_tipping_fee
attributes.description: Standard gate rate charged per short ton for waste disposal at the facility (tipping fee). This is the base rate before contractual discounts or surcharges. Confidential commercial pricing data used in Oracle Revenue Management rate configuration and financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rate Configuration; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation where the landfill facility is located. Determines applicable state environmental quality department regulations, state permit requirements, and state-specific RCRA program authority.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments; RCRA Authorized State Programs

attributes.name: swis_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) Registration Number
attributes.description: State Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) registration number assigned by the state environmental agency. Used for EPA SWIS reporting submissions and state-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA SWIS Reporting Requirements; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the landfill facility location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Required for accurate timestamp interpretation of operational events, regulatory reporting deadlines, and scheduling across multi-site enterprise operations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: total_design_capacity_cy
attributes.description: Total permitted airspace capacity of the landfill in cubic yards as approved in the facility design engineering report. Represents the maximum volume of waste and cover material the site is engineered and permitted to contain. Used for long-range capacity planning and permit compliance.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Annual Reporting

attributes.name: total_design_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Total permitted disposal capacity of the landfill in short tons as approved in the facility design engineering report. Complements cubic yard capacity for tonnage-based regulatory reporting and financial capacity valuation.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Annual Reporting; IFRS/GAAP Asset Valuation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the landfill site master record. Used for change detection, data synchronization across integrated systems, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Record Management

attributes.name: waste_streams_accepted
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of waste stream types the facility is permitted to accept (e.g., 'MSW, C&D, industrial non-hazardous, special waste'). Drives waste acceptance screening, manifest verification, and permit compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSW|C&D|industrial_non_hazardous|special_waste|ash|sludge|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Solid Waste Permit Waste Acceptance Criteria

products.name: cell
products.description: Master record for each discrete waste placement cell within a landfill site. Tracks cell identifier (CID), cell phase (active, filled, closed), design volume (cubic yards), permitted waste types (MSW, C&D, special waste), liner system specifications (single, double, composite), leachate collection system tie-in, cell opening date, projected fill date, actual closure date, base elevation, top elevation, and cell geometry coordinates. Supports airspace consumption tracking and cell sequencing for capacity planning. Sourced from AMCS Platform and Enviance EHS.

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the landfill cell. Primary key for the cell master record.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices for Landfill Operations

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_source. Business justification: Individual cells are discrete emission sources with different waste ages, gas generation rates, and collection system coverage. Tracked separately for accurate GHG inventory, carbon credit baseline ca

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Cells are sub-components of facility structures for asset hierarchy, cost center allocation, capital project tracking, and consolidated environmental reporting. New attribute establishes proper facili

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent landfill site where this cell is located. Links to the landfill facility master record.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Facility Identification

attributes.name: actual_fill_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the cell reached design capacity and was closed to further waste placement.

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Horizontal footprint area of the cell in acres, measured at the base liner surface.

attributes.name: average_daily_tonnage
attributes.description: Average tons per day (TPD) received in this cell during active operations, used for capacity planning and operational forecasting.

attributes.name: base_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Elevation of the cell base (liner surface) in feet above mean sea level, used for airspace calculations and grading plans.

attributes.name: cell_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the cell used in operational and planning documents.

attributes.name: cell_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cell, typically alphanumeric code used in operational communications and regulatory reporting (e.g., CELL-A1, PHASE2-C3).

attributes.name: cell_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the cell in its lifecycle: planned (designed but not built), under_construction (being prepared), active (receiving waste), filled (at capacity but not closed), closed (operations ceased, interim cover applied), capped (final cover system installed).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Closure Requirements

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when formal closure activities (final grading, interim cover installation) were completed and the cell transitioned from active to closed status.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Closure Requirements (40 CFR 258.60)

attributes.name: compaction_ratio_target
attributes.description: Target volume reduction ratio for waste compaction operations in this cell, typically expressed as ratio of loose volume to compacted volume (e.g., 4.0 means 4:1 reduction).
attributes.references: Operational Best Practices for Waste Compaction

attributes.name: construction_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when cell construction was completed and the cell was certified ready for waste placement.

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physical construction of the cell (excavation, liner installation) commenced.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cell record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Current elevation of the active waste surface in feet above mean sea level, updated from periodic topographic surveys.

attributes.name: daily_cover_material_type
attributes.description: Type of material used for daily cover application to control odors, vectors, and litter: soil (traditional 6-inch soil cover), alternative_daily_cover (ADC such as compost, shredded green waste), tarps (reusable geomembrane tarps), foam (spray-applied foam), auto_daily_cover (automated tarp systems).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Daily Cover Requirements (40 CFR 258.21)

attributes.name: design_capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Total permitted airspace volume for waste placement in cubic yards, as specified in the engineering design and regulatory permit.
attributes.references: Landfill Design Plans and Permit Documents

attributes.name: design_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Total permitted waste tonnage capacity, calculated from design volume and assumed compaction density.
attributes.references: Landfill Design Plans and Permit Documents

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for environmental monitoring activities (groundwater sampling, gas monitoring, leachate testing) as specified in the permit.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Monitoring Requirements (40 CFR 258.50-258.55)

attributes.name: final_cap_installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the final cover system (cap) was installed over the closed cell, marking the beginning of post-closure care period.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Closure Requirements (40 CFR 258.60)

attributes.name: gas_collection_start_date
attributes.description: Date when active gas collection operations commenced in this cell, required for EPA NSPS/EG compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS/EG Landfill Gas Collection Requirements (40 CFR Part 60 Subpart XXX)

attributes.name: gas_collection_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active landfill gas collection system (vertical wells and/or horizontal collectors) has been installed in this cell.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS/EG Landfill Gas Collection Requirements (40 CFR Part 60 Subpart XXX)

attributes.name: geometry_coordinates
attributes.description: Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the cell boundary polygon coordinates for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_wells
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of groundwater monitoring well identifiers assigned to this cell for environmental compliance monitoring per RCRA Subtitle D requirements.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Groundwater Monitoring (40 CFR 258.40)

attributes.name: liner_system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engineered liner system installed at the base of the cell to prevent leachate migration: single_composite (one geomembrane + clay layer), double_composite (two geomembrane layers with leak detection), single_geomembrane, clay_only (compacted clay liner), enhanced_composite (advanced multi-layer system).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Liner Design Standards (40 CFR 258.40)

attributes.name: liner_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Total thickness of the liner system in inches, including all geomembrane and clay layers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or historical context relevant to this cell.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the cell was opened for active waste placement operations.

attributes.name: permitted_waste_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste types authorized for disposal in this cell per regulatory permit (e.g., MSW, C&D, special waste, industrial non-hazardous). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSW|C&D|special_waste|industrial_non_hazardous|asbestos|contaminated_soil|sludge|ash — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Permit Conditions

attributes.name: phase_number
attributes.description: Development phase identifier indicating the sequential construction phase of the landfill expansion plan.

attributes.name: post_closure_care_end_date
attributes.description: Projected or actual date when the 30-year post-closure care period (monitoring, maintenance, gas management) will end or ended.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Post-Closure Care (40 CFR 258.61)

attributes.name: projected_fill_date
attributes.description: Forecasted date when the cell is expected to reach design capacity based on current waste placement rates and airspace consumption trends.

attributes.name: remaining_capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Current available airspace for waste placement in cubic yards, updated based on survey measurements and waste placement records.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name of the licensed professional engineer responsible for design certification and ongoing compliance oversight for this cell.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Standard disposal charge per ton of waste placed in this cell, used for revenue tracking and cost allocation. May vary by waste type and customer contract.

attributes.name: top_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Permitted final elevation of the cell top surface in feet above mean sea level, defining the maximum fill height.

attributes.name: total_tonnage_received
attributes.description: Cumulative tonnage of waste placed in this cell since opening, tracked for capacity management and regulatory reporting.

products.name: leachate_collection
