attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Concentration in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide concentration measured in parts per million. H2S is a toxic and corrosive gas that poses health and safety risks and can damage gas collection equipment.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1000, EPA Clean Air Act

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the monitoring point in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and mapping of landfill gas distribution.

attributes.name: lel_percentage
attributes.description: Lower Explosive Limit reading expressed as a percentage. LEL measures the concentration of combustible gas relative to the minimum concentration required for ignition. Regulatory action is triggered when LEL exceeds 25%.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146, EPA NSPS Subpart WWW

attributes.name: lfg_flow_rate_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Landfill Gas (LFG) Flow Rate in Standard Cubic Feet per Minute (SCFM)
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of landfill gas measured in standard cubic feet per minute at the monitoring point. Used to calculate total gas extraction and energy recovery potential.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, Waste-to-Energy Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the monitoring point in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and mapping of landfill gas distribution.

attributes.name: methane_concentration_pct
attributes.description: Methane concentration measured as a percentage by volume at the monitoring point. Critical for assessing landfill gas composition and explosion risk.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, Clean Air Act

attributes.name: monitoring_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the landfill gas monitoring event, used for daily and periodic compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA SWIS Reporting, RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency of monitoring at this point as required by regulatory permits or operational procedures.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, RCRA Subtitle D Permit Conditions

attributes.name: monitoring_method
attributes.description: Standardized method or protocol used to conduct the landfill gas monitoring, ensuring consistency and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Method 21, EPA Method 25, NSPS Subpart WWW

attributes.name: monitoring_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the monitoring point indicating its purpose and location within the landfill gas collection and monitoring system.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the landfill gas monitoring reading was recorded in the field. This is the actual event time of the measurement, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act, RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: nitrogen_concentration_pct
attributes.description: Nitrogen concentration measured as a percentage by volume. Elevated nitrogen levels may indicate air intrusion or dilution of landfill gas.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for technician observations, field conditions, equipment issues, or other contextual information relevant to the monitoring event.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS, Internal Standard Operating Procedures

attributes.name: oxygen_concentration_pct
attributes.description: Oxygen concentration measured as a percentage by volume. Low oxygen levels indicate anaerobic conditions; elevated levels may indicate air intrusion into the landfill gas collection system.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this monitoring record was first created in the source system or data platform.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this monitoring record was last updated in the source system or data platform.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is set to True when this monitoring record must be included in mandatory regulatory reports to EPA, state agencies, or local enforcement authorities.
attributes.references: EPA SWIS Reporting, RCRA Subtitle D, NSPS Subpart WWW

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the monitoring record was ingested, typically Enviance EHS or a field data collection application.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS, Internal Data Integration Standard

attributes.name: static_pressure_inches_wc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Static Pressure in Inches of Water Column (WC)
attributes.description: Static pressure measured in inches of water column at the monitoring point. Indicates the vacuum or pressure within the landfill gas collection system.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Temperature of the landfill gas at the monitoring point measured in degrees Fahrenheit. Elevated temperatures may indicate subsurface fires or active decomposition.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of monitoring. Weather can influence landfill gas migration and surface emission readings.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices, EPA Surface Emission Monitoring

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wind Speed in Miles Per Hour (MPH)
attributes.description: Wind speed at the time of monitoring measured in miles per hour. Wind conditions can influence surface emission dispersion and detection.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices, EPA Surface Emission Monitoring

products.name: lfg_extraction_well
products.description: Master record for each LFG extraction well installed within the landfill. Tracks well ID, cell reference, installation date, well depth (feet), well casing material, screen interval, wellhead equipment type, current operational status (active, idle, abandoned), connected header pipe segment, and design extraction rate (SCFM). Supports LFG collection system management, RNG (Renewable Natural Gas) production planning, and EPA compliance. Sourced from Enviance EHS and Infor EAM.

attributes.name: lfg_extraction_well_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lfg_extraction_well

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_source. Business justification: Individual extraction wells are discrete emission sources for GHG inventory. Each well's gas composition and flow rate feeds carbon accounting, RNG production tracking, and carbon credit quantificatio

attributes.name: header_pipe_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the LFG collection header pipe segment that this well is connected to. Supports gas flow network modeling and system optimization.

attributes.name: landfill_cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific landfill cell where this extraction well is located. Supports cell-level gas collection tracking and capacity planning.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Cell Management

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent landfill site where this LFG extraction well is installed. Links to the landfill facility master record.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: LFG extraction wells require regular maintenance (wellhead repairs, valve replacements, header connections). Tracking which work order serviced which well is essential for EPA regulatory compliance, d

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: LFG extraction systems require air permits (Title V, NSPS). Wells should reference the permit authorizing gas collection, flaring, or energy recovery to ensure design extraction rates and vacuum level

attributes.name: abandonment_date
attributes.description: Date when the well was permanently closed and abandoned. Wells are abandoned when no longer needed due to cell closure, system reconfiguration, or end of gas generation. Null for active wells.

attributes.name: abandonment_method
attributes.description: Method used to permanently close the well. Grouted wells are filled with cement grout; capped wells have sealed wellheads; removed wells are fully extracted; other methods per site-specific procedures. Null for active wells.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset tag or barcode identifier assigned by the asset management system. Links to Infor EAM for maintenance scheduling, parts inventory, and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: casing_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the well casing. High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) is most common for corrosion resistance; PVC, steel, and fiberglass are alternatives based on site conditions and design specifications.

attributes.name: construction_contractor
attributes.description: Name of the contractor or vendor that installed the extraction well. Used for warranty claims, quality tracking, and vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: construction_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost of well installation including materials, labor, and equipment in US dollars. Used for capital expenditure tracking, asset valuation, and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this well record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: design_extraction_rate_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Extraction Rate (Standard Cubic Feet per Minute)
attributes.description: Designed gas extraction capacity of the well measured in standard cubic feet per minute (SCFM) at standard temperature and pressure. Used for system capacity planning and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: design_vacuum_inches_h2o
attributes.description: Target vacuum pressure at the wellhead measured in inches of water column. Optimal vacuum range is typically 2-6 inches H2O to maximize gas extraction while minimizing air intrusion.
attributes.references: SWANA LFG System Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: elevation_feet
attributes.description: Ground surface elevation at the well location measured in feet above mean sea level. Used for hydraulic gradient calculations and leachate management.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the LFG extraction well was installed and commissioned. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, warranty management, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent field inspection of the well. EPA NSPS Subpart WWW requires quarterly monitoring of wellhead parameters (flow, vacuum, temperature, methane concentration).
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this well record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the well location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, field navigation, and spatial analysis of gas collection network.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the well location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, field navigation, and spatial analysis of gas collection network.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next regulatory or preventive maintenance inspection. Supports compliance calendar management and field crew scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or historical context about the well. May include construction anomalies, performance issues, or site-specific considerations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the LFG extraction well. Active wells are currently extracting gas; idle wells are installed but not in service; maintenance wells are temporarily offline; abandoned wells are permanently closed; planned wells are approved but not yet installed.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Operational Standards

attributes.name: rng_production_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether gas from this well is routed to the RNG production facility. True if well contributes to RNG production; false if gas is flared or used for waste-to-energy only. Supports RNG revenue allocation and environmental credit tracking.

attributes.name: screen_interval_bottom_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the bottom of the perforated screen section. Defines the lower boundary of the gas collection zone.

attributes.name: screen_interval_top_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the top of the perforated screen section. Defines the upper boundary of the gas collection zone.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction warranty expires. Typically 1-2 years from installation date. Used for warranty claim management and defect tracking.

attributes.name: well_depth_feet
attributes.description: Total depth of the extraction well measured in feet from ground surface to bottom of well screen. Critical for gas collection efficiency and design capacity calculations.

attributes.name: well_diameter_inches
attributes.description: Internal diameter of the well casing measured in inches. Affects gas flow capacity and extraction efficiency.

attributes.name: well_identifier
attributes.description: Business identifier or tag number for the LFG extraction well. Used for field operations, maintenance work orders, and regulatory reporting. May follow site-specific naming conventions (e.g., SITE-CELL-WELL-###).
attributes.references: SWANA Landfill Gas Management Best Practices

attributes.name: well_type
attributes.description: Classification of the extraction well design. Vertical wells are drilled vertically into waste mass; horizontal wells are installed horizontally in trenches; trench wells are perforated pipes in gravel-filled trenches.
attributes.references: SWANA LFG Collection System Design Standards

attributes.name: wellhead_equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of wellhead control and monitoring equipment. Standard wellheads have manual valves; adjustable wellheads allow field tuning; automated wellheads have remote control capability; monitoring-only wellheads are for observation wells.

products.name: groundwater_monitoring_well
products.description: Master record for each groundwater monitoring well at a landfill site. Captures well ID, site reference, well designation (upgradient, downgradient, compliance), installation date, total depth (feet), screened interval, aquifer zone monitored, GPS coordinates, sampling frequency (quarterly, semi-annual, annual), regulatory permit reference, and current operational status. Anchors all groundwater sampling events and is required for RCRA Subtitle D detection monitoring programs. Sourced from Enviance EHS.
products.reference: RCRA Subtitle D Groundwater Monitoring Well

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_well_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the groundwater monitoring well record. Primary key for the entity.

attributes.name: jha_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.jha. Business justification: Groundwater well sampling involves confined space considerations, chemical exposure, and slip/fall hazards. Each well location may have site-specific hazards requiring tailored JHA for sampling proced

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the landfill site where this monitoring well is located. Links to the landfill facility master record.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Groundwater monitoring wells require maintenance (pump repairs, casing repairs, well development). Operations track which work orders service which wells for regulatory compliance and sampling program

attributes.name: monitoring_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.monitoring_station. Business justification: Groundwater monitoring wells at landfills are monitoring stations tracked in compliance domain. Linking to canonical monitoring station record enables enterprise-wide environmental monitoring coordina

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the environmental contractor or laboratory responsible for sampling and analysis at this well. Links to vendor master record.

attributes.name: analyte_list_code
attributes.description: Code or reference to the list of chemical analytes (parameters) tested during sampling events at this well. Typically Appendix I, Appendix II, or site-specific list per RCRA.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D 40 CFR 258 Appendix I and II

attributes.name: aquifer_zone
attributes.description: Name or designation of the aquifer zone or hydrogeologic unit being monitored by this well (e.g., Upper Alluvial, Bedrock, Perched Water Table).

attributes.name: casing_diameter_inches
attributes.description: Inside diameter of the well casing in inches. Determines sampling equipment compatibility and well capacity.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: casing_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the well casing. PVC is most common for environmental monitoring; stainless steel used for volatile organic compound (VOC) sampling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this monitoring well record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the monitoring well was permanently decommissioned and sealed per regulatory requirements. Null for active wells.

attributes.name: decommission_reason
attributes.description: Business or regulatory reason for decommissioning the well (e.g., landfill closure, well damage, redundant monitoring point, permit modification).

attributes.name: elevation_feet_msl
attributes.description: Elevation of the well top-of-casing or ground surface reference point in feet above mean sea level. Critical for calculating hydraulic gradients and groundwater flow direction.

attributes.name: epa_swis_well_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) Well ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by EPA SWIS for this monitoring well. Used in federal reporting and data exchange with EPA.

attributes.name: filter_pack_material
attributes.description: Material placed around the well screen to prevent fine sediment from entering the well while allowing groundwater flow. Typically clean silica sand.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the monitoring well was installed and became operational. Critical for establishing monitoring history and regulatory compliance timelines.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this monitoring well record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_sampling_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent groundwater sampling event at this well. Used to track compliance with sampling frequency requirements.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the monitoring well location in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the monitoring well location in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: monitoring_program_type
attributes.description: Type of RCRA Subtitle D monitoring program this well supports. Detection monitoring is baseline; assessment monitoring follows detection of contamination.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_sampling_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next groundwater sampling event. Calculated based on sampling frequency and last sampling date. Used for field scheduling.

attributes.name: permit_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the environmental permit or regulatory order that mandates monitoring at this well. Links well to specific compliance obligations.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Department Permit System

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sampling results from this well must be included in regulatory reports to EPA or state agencies. True for compliance wells; false for supplemental monitoring points.

attributes.name: sampling_frequency
attributes.description: Regulatory or operational frequency at which groundwater samples are collected from this well. Quarterly is typical for RCRA detection monitoring.

attributes.name: screen_interval_bottom_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the bottom of the screened interval. Defines the monitored zone lower boundary.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: screen_interval_top_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the top of the screened interval where groundwater enters the well. Defines the monitored zone upper boundary.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: seal_material
attributes.description: Material used to seal the annular space between the borehole wall and well casing. Prevents surface water infiltration and cross-contamination between aquifer zones.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: state_well_permit_number
attributes.description: State-issued permit or registration number for the monitoring well. Required in many jurisdictions for all groundwater monitoring wells.
attributes.references: State Water Resources Control Board Standards

attributes.name: static_water_level_feet
attributes.description: Most recent measured depth to groundwater from the top of casing, in feet. Used to calculate groundwater elevation and flow direction. Updated after each sampling event.
attributes.references: ASTM D4750 Standard Test Method for Water Level Measurement

attributes.name: total_depth_feet
attributes.description: Total depth of the monitoring well from ground surface to bottom, measured in feet. Determines the aquifer zone being monitored.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: well_construction_method
attributes.description: Drilling and installation method used to construct the monitoring well. Hollow stem auger is most common for shallow environmental wells.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: well_designation
attributes.description: Business identifier for the monitoring well, typically assigned per site naming convention (e.g., MW-01, GW-UG-03). Used in regulatory reports and field operations.

attributes.name: well_development_date
attributes.description: Date when well development (removal of drilling fluids and fines) was completed and the well was ready for sampling. Typically occurs shortly after installation.
attributes.references: ASTM D5521 Standard Guide for Well Development

attributes.name: well_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, field observations, maintenance history, or special sampling instructions for this well.

attributes.name: well_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the monitoring well in its lifecycle. Active wells are sampled per schedule; inactive wells are not currently monitored.

attributes.name: well_type
attributes.description: Classification of the well based on its position relative to the landfill and regulatory purpose. Upgradient wells establish baseline conditions; downgradient wells detect contamination migration.

products.name: groundwater_sample
products.description: Transactional record of each groundwater sampling event conducted at a monitoring well. Captures sample date, well reference, sampling technician, field parameters (pH, temperature, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, turbidity), laboratory sample IDs, chain-of-custody number, analytical parameters tested (VOCs, metals, indicator parameters per EPA Method 8260/6010), detected concentrations, applicable groundwater protection standard (GWPS) limits, exceedance flags, and required regulatory notification status. Supports RCRA Subtitle D detection and assessment monitoring compliance. Sourced from Enviance EHS.
products.reference: RCRA Subtitle D Groundwater Sampling Event

attributes.name: groundwater_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the groundwater sampling event record.

attributes.name: compliance_environmental_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_environmental_monitoring. Business justification: Groundwater samples collected at landfills are compliance environmental monitoring events. Linking to compliance domain's canonical monitoring record enables regulatory reporting (SWIS, CERCLA), excee

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technician or employee who collected the groundwater sample.

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_well_id
attributes.description: Reference to the monitoring well where the sample was collected.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Field sampling incidents (slips, chemical exposure, equipment failure) must link to specific sampling events for investigation of field conditions, sampling method, and PPE adequacy. Critical for envi

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the landfill site where the monitoring well is located.

attributes.name: analysis_complete_date
attributes.description: Date when laboratory analysis of the sample was completed.

attributes.name: analysis_start_date
attributes.description: Date when laboratory analysis of the sample began.

attributes.name: analytical_parameters_tested
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical parameters and contaminants tested in this sample (e.g., VOCs, metals, indicator parameters).
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D 40 CFR 258 Appendix I and II

attributes.name: cercla_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Environmental Response Compensation and Liability Act (CERCLA) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detected concentrations trigger CERCLA (Superfund) reporting obligations.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique chain of custody document number tracking sample handling from collection through analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this groundwater sample record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: exceedance_detected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any detected concentrations exceeded applicable Groundwater Protection Standard (GWPS) limits or regulatory thresholds.

attributes.name: exceedance_parameters
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific parameters that exceeded applicable Groundwater Protection Standard (GWPS) limits.

attributes.name: field_conductivity_umhos
attributes.description: Specific conductivity measured in the field at the time of sample collection, in micromhos per centimeter.

attributes.name: field_dissolved_oxygen_mg_l
attributes.description: Dissolved oxygen concentration measured in the field at the time of sample collection, in milligrams per liter.

attributes.name: field_notes
attributes.description: Additional field observations, notes, or comments recorded by the sampling technician during sample collection.
attributes.references: EPA Sampling and Analysis Plan (SAP) Guidelines

attributes.name: field_oxidation_reduction_potential_mv
attributes.description: Oxidation-reduction potential (ORP) measured in the field at the time of sample collection, in millivolts.

attributes.name: field_ph
attributes.description: pH measurement taken in the field at the time of sample collection.

attributes.name: field_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Water temperature measured in the field at the time of sample collection, in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: field_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Turbidity measured in the field at the time of sample collection, in Nephelometric Turbidity Units.

attributes.name: gwps_limit_exceeded
attributes.description: Description of the specific Groundwater Protection Standard limit that was exceeded, including the parameter name and limit value.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified analytical laboratory that performed the sample analysis.
attributes.references: EPA National Environmental Laboratory Accreditation Program (NELAP)

attributes.name: laboratory_sample_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the analytical laboratory for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this groundwater sample record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: metals_analysis_method
attributes.description: EPA analytical method used for metals analysis (typically ICP or ICP-MS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPA_6010|EPA_6010B|EPA_6010C|EPA_6010D|EPA_6020|EPA_6020A|EPA_6020B|not_tested — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: monitoring_program_type
attributes.description: Type of groundwater monitoring program under which this sample was collected (detection, assessment, corrective action, or post-closure).

attributes.name: purge_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Volume of water purged from the monitoring well prior to sample collection, measured in gallons.

attributes.name: qa_qc_flag
attributes.description: Quality assurance and quality control status of the sample results.

attributes.name: qa_qc_notes
attributes.description: Notes regarding quality assurance or quality control issues, qualifications, or observations related to the sample.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory authorities were notified of exceedance or other reportable conditions.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory notification to EPA, state, or Local Enforcement Agency (LEA) is required based on sample results.

attributes.name: sample_appearance
attributes.description: Visual description of the sample appearance (e.g., clear, cloudy, discolored, odor present).
attributes.references: EPA Sampling and Analysis Plan (SAP) Guidelines

attributes.name: sample_date
attributes.description: Date when the groundwater sample was collected from the monitoring well.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Unique field sample identification number assigned by the sampling technician or laboratory.

attributes.name: sample_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the sample was received by the analytical laboratory.

attributes.name: sample_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the groundwater sample was collected, including time zone.
attributes.references: EPA Sampling and Analysis Plan (SAP) Guidelines

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sample purpose (routine monitoring, confirmation, assessment, background, quality control duplicate, or blank).

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: Method used to collect the groundwater sample from the monitoring well.

attributes.name: swis_reporting_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) Reporting Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample result must be included in EPA Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) reporting.

attributes.name: voc_analysis_method
attributes.description: EPA analytical method used for volatile organic compound analysis.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions at the time of sample collection (e.g., clear, rainy, snowy).
attributes.references: EPA Sampling and Analysis Plan (SAP) Guidelines

products.name: liner_integrity_event
products.description: Transactional record of liner integrity inspection and testing events for landfill cells. Captures inspection date, cell reference, inspection method (electrical leak location survey, visual inspection, pressure test), inspector credentials, liner layer inspected (primary, secondary, composite), defects identified (count, location coordinates, size), repair actions taken, post-repair verification result, and regulatory notification requirement flag. Critical for demonstrating liner system performance under RCRA Subtitle D and state permit conditions. Sourced from Enviance EHS.

attributes.name: liner_integrity_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the liner integrity inspection or testing event. Primary key for this transactional record.

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific landfill cell where the liner integrity inspection was performed. Links to the cell master record.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Liner inspections and repairs involve confined space entry, heat stress, and chemical exposure hazards. Incidents during integrity events must be traceable to specific inspection/repair activities for

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Liner integrity inspections require certified QA/QC personnel. When performed by internal staff (vs. third-party contractors), linking to employee enables certification tracking, quality assurance, an

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Liner integrity is a permit condition (Subtitle D liner requirements). Inspection events should reference the permit mandating liner performance standards, inspection frequency, and repair protocols t

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the landfill site where the liner integrity event occurred. Links to the site master record.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the inspection event, including labor, equipment, and contractor fees. Excludes repair costs which are tracked separately.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this liner integrity event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: defect_location_coordinates
attributes.description: Geographic or grid coordinates identifying the location of defects within the cell. May be GPS coordinates, station/offset measurements, or grid references per site survey system.

attributes.name: defect_size_description
attributes.description: Description of the size and extent of identified defects, typically including dimensions (length, width, area) and severity classification.

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of defect identified in the liner system. Common types include punctures, tears, seam separations, wrinkles, stress cracks, holes, abrasion, and chemical degradation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: puncture|tear|seam_separation|wrinkle|stress_crack|hole|abrasion|chemical_degradation — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: defects_identified_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects, anomalies, or integrity issues identified during the inspection. Zero indicates no defects found.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the liner integrity event, typically assigned by the EHS system or inspection tracking system. Used for external reference and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: inspection_area_square_feet
attributes.description: Total area of liner surface inspected during this event, measured in square feet. Used to calculate inspection coverage and defect density metrics.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the liner integrity inspection or testing was performed. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: inspection_duration_hours

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: The method or technique used to assess liner integrity. Common methods include electrical leak location surveys, visual inspections, pressure tests, vacuum tests, spark tests, and ultrasonic testing.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, comments, or context related to the inspection event. May include inspector observations, site conditions, or other relevant details.

attributes.name: inspection_report_reference

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the liner integrity inspection event. Tracks the inspection from scheduling through completion and review.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this liner integrity event record was last updated in the system. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: permit_compliance_status

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_notified

attributes.name: repair_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether repair actions are required based on the inspection findings. True indicates repair is necessary; False indicates no repair needed.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D Corrective Action Requirements

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions during the inspection. Weather can affect inspection quality and visibility, particularly for visual inspections.

Drives long-range capital planning, permit renewal timing, and executive site-life reporting.

attributes.name: intermediate_cover_factor_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of airspace consumed by intermediate cover systems. Applied to areas inactive for extended periods.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity plan record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lateral_expansion_planned

attributes.name: permit_renewal_target_date
attributes.description: Target date for obtaining required permit renewals or modifications to support this capacity plan. Null if no permit action is required.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity plan. Tracks approval workflow and active status.

attributes.name: plan_type

attributes.name: plan_version

attributes.name: planning_horizon_years
attributes.description: Number of years covered by this capacity plan (e.g., 1, 5, 10, 20).

attributes.name: projected_site_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated number of years until the landfill reaches permitted capacity and requires closure, based on current waste acceptance rates and compaction assumptions.

attributes.name: total_permitted_capacity_tons

attributes.name: vertical_expansion_capacity_cy
attributes.description: Additional airspace capacity (cubic yards) to be gained through vertical expansion, if planned. Null if no vertical expansion is planned.
attributes.references: Internal Planning Standards, Permit Modification Records

attributes.name: vertical_expansion_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether vertical expansion (height increase) is included in this capacity plan. True if vertical expansion is planned and permitted.

products.name: site_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the operational authorization between a service offering and a landfill site. It captures the business rules governing which waste streams from which service offerings are permitted to be disposed at which landfill sites, including capacity allocations, routing priorities, and site-specific cost structures. Each record links one offering to one site with attributes that exist only in the context of this disposal authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, service offerings are designed to serve multiple geographic markets and must be configured with multiple authorized disposal sites for capacity balancing, geographic coverage, and waste type specialization. Conversely, each landfill site accepts waste from multiple service offerings based on permit restrictions, capacity allocations, and commercial agreements. The business actively manages these authorizations as a disposal network configuration, tracking site-specific routing priorities, tonnage caps, transportation costs, and approved waste types for each offering-site pairing.

products.name: cell_equipment_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Equipment Assignment between landfill cells and fixed assets (equipment). It captures the operational deployment of equipment to specific cells for waste placement, compaction, and cell management activities. Each record links one cell to one piece of equipment with assignment period, role designation, and utilization tracking that exist only in the context of this relationship. Supports cost allocation, capacity planning, and equipment utilization analysis.. Existence Justification: In landfill operations, multiple pieces of equipment (compactors, dozers, water trucks) operate concurrently in a single cell during active waste placement, and each piece of equipment rotates across multiple cells throughout its operational lifecycle. The business actively manages these assignments with specific start/end dates, designates primary vs. backup equipment for capacity planning, and tracks cell-specific utilization hours for cost allocation and equipment performance analysis.

products.name: cell_permit_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory authorization relationship between landfill cells and environmental permits. It captures which permits authorize which cells for waste placement operations, including authorization scope, effective periods, waste type restrictions, and capacity limits specific to each cell-permit combination. Each record links one cell to one permit with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory authorization.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, landfill cells require multiple types of regulatory permits throughout their lifecycle (construction permits, operational permits, expansion permits, closure permits), and each permit can authorize multiple cells within a facility or across facilities. The business actively manages these authorization relationships, tracking which permits cover which cells with specific effective dates, waste type restrictions, capacity allocations, and cell-specific regulatory conditions that belong to neither the cell nor the permit alone.

attributes.description: Current status of this cell-permit authorization. Tracks whether the authorization is currently in force (Active), temporarily suspended by regulatory action (Suspended), has expired (Expired), has been revoked (Revoked), or is awaiting renewal approval (Pending Renewal). Distinct from both cell_status and permit_status as it represents the status of this specific authorization relationship.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Classification of what phase or activity this permit authorizes for the cell. Distinguishes between construction permits (authorizing cell construction), operation permits (authorizing waste placement), expansion permits (authorizing cell expansion), closure permits (authorizing final closure activities), and post-closure permits (authorizing post-closure monitoring and maintenance).

domains.name: hazmat
domains.description: Hazardous waste handling, treatment, storage, and disposal operations under RCRA Subtitle C. Manages hazardous waste manifests (cradle-to-grave tracking), TSDF facility operations, waste characterization (TCLP testing), container tracking, EPA ID numbers, waste codes, chain-of-custody, transportation compliance (DOT HMR), BOL documents, emergency response (HAZWOPER), and regulatory reporting. Ensures safe handling of industrial, medical, and special wastes. Integrates with Enviance EHS and SAP EHS modules.
domains.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle C / OSHA HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120 / CERCLA / DOT 49 CFR

products.name: hazardous_waste_generator
products.description: Master record for each EPA-registered hazardous waste generator (large quantity, small quantity, or very small quantity). Captures EPA ID number, generator category (LQG/SQG/VSQG), site address, RCRA permit status, emergency contact, contingency plan reference, accumulation time limits, and regulatory notification history. Serves as the authoritative identity record for all waste-generating sites managed under RCRA Subtitle C.

Corporate sustainability teams track emissions, waste metrics, and compliance by generator location. Standard ESG report

attributes.name: biennial_report_required_flag

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name

attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262.34, OSHA HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120, DOT HMR 49 CFR 172.604

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone

attributes.name: enforcement_action_count

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Used to determine ignitability characteristic (D001: flash point <60°C).

attributes.name: is_corrosive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the characteristic of corrosivity per EPA D002 criteria (aqueous with pH ≤2 or ≥12.5, or liquid that corrodes steel at rate >6.35mm per year at 55°C).

attributes.name: is_ignitable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the characteristic of ignitability per EPA D001 criteria (liquid with flash point <60°C, non-liquid capable of spontaneous combustion, ignitable compressed gas, or oxidizer).

attributes.name: is_reactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the characteristic of reactivity per EPA D003 criteria (unstable, reacts violently with water, generates toxic gases, contains cyanide or sulfide, or capable of detonation).

attributes.name: is_toxic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the toxicity characteristic per TCLP testing, with contaminant concentrations exceeding regulatory thresholds (D004-D043).

attributes.name: land_disposal_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste is subject to Land Disposal Restrictions requiring treatment to meet specific standards before landfill disposal.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this waste profile. Profiles should be reviewed annually or when waste characteristics change.

attributes.name: ldr_treatment_standards
attributes.description: Specific treatment standards that must be met before land disposal, including concentration limits for hazardous constituents or required treatment technologies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waste profile record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this waste profile.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating degree of danger: I (great danger), II (medium danger), III (minor danger). Used for transportation classification.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Measured pH level of the waste material. Critical for determining corrosivity characteristic (D002: pH ≤2 or ≥12.5).

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical form of the waste material at ambient temperature and pressure.

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Personal protective equipment required when handling this waste (e.g., 'Level B, respirator, chemical-resistant gloves, face shield').

attributes.name: process_generating_waste
attributes.description: Description of the industrial or commercial process that generates this waste stream (e.g., 'Metal degreasing operation', 'Paint booth cleaning').

attributes.name: profile_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste profile becomes effective and waste shipments under this profile may be accepted.

attributes.name: profile_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste profile expires and must be renewed or re-approved. Typically profiles are valid for 1-3 years depending on facility requirements.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the waste stream or material being profiled (e.g., 'Industrial Solvent Waste', 'Lead-Contaminated Soil').

attributes.name: profile_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the waste profile, used for external reference and tracking. Typically formatted as WP- followed by numeric sequence.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: DOT-approved proper shipping name for the hazardous material as it must appear on shipping papers and manifests (e.g., 'Waste Flammable Liquid, N.O.S.').

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special handling, storage, or safety requirements for this waste stream (e.g., 'Keep refrigerated', 'Incompatible with oxidizers', 'Requires secondary containment').

attributes.name: tclp_results_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: TCLP (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure) Results Summary
attributes.description: Summary of TCLP test results listing detected contaminants and their concentrations in mg/L. Used to determine D-code assignments for toxic characteristics.

attributes.name: tclp_test_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: TCLP (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure) Test Date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure laboratory test was performed to determine if waste exhibits toxicity characteristic.

attributes.name: treatment_method_required
attributes.description: Approved treatment or disposal method for this waste stream (e.g., 'Incineration', 'Stabilization', 'Landfill Disposal', 'Fuel Blending').

attributes.name: un_na_number
attributes.description: Four-digit United Nations or North America identification number assigned to the hazardous material for transportation purposes (e.g., UN1203, NA1993).

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the waste material including source process, composition, contaminants, and any special handling considerations.

products.name: manifest

Supports e-Manifest (EPA RCRAInfo) integration.

attributes.name: manifest_id

attributes.name: discrepancy_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the TSDF identified any discrepancies between the manifest and the actual shipment received (quantity, type, condition).

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class or division number (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 6.1 for toxic substances, 8 for corrosives) per 49 CFR Part 173.

attributes.name: dot_id_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN or NA identification number assigned to the hazardous material for transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline).

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating degree of danger: I=Great Danger, II=Medium Danger, III=Minor Danger.

attributes.name: dot_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: DOT-required proper shipping name from the Hazardous Materials Table (49 CFR 172.101) describing the waste for transportation purposes.

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Hazardous Waste Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) identifying the specific waste characteristics or sources. Example: D001,F005,D008.

attributes.name: generator_city
attributes.description: City where the generator facility is located.

attributes.name: generator_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative at the generator facility responsible for the manifest.

attributes.name: generator_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the generator facility contact person.

attributes.name: generator_emergency_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency response phone number for incidents involving this waste shipment (e.g., CHEMTREC, facility emergency line).

attributes.name: generator_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the hazardous waste generator facility originating the waste shipment.

attributes.name: generator_signature_date
attributes.description: Date the generator authorized representative signed the manifest certifying the waste information is accurate.

attributes.name: generator_site_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the generator facility where the hazardous waste was produced.

attributes.name: generator_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the generator facility location.

attributes.name: generator_zip_code
attributes.description: US postal ZIP code for the generator facility (5-digit or ZIP+4 format).

attributes.name: import_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this manifest documents an international import of hazardous waste into the United States.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart H; EPA Form 8700-22 Box 16

attributes.name: import_port_of_entry
attributes.description: US port of entry location for international hazardous waste imports.

attributes.name: manifest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manifest document. Tracks progression from draft through final disposition at TSDF. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_transit|received_by_tsdf|completed|corrected|rejected|voided — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: manifest_type
attributes.description: Format type of the manifest submission: paper (traditional hard copy), electronic (e-Manifest via RCRAInfo), or hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for total waste quantity. EPA codes: K=Kilograms, P=Pounds, T=Tons (2000 lbs), G=Gallons, L=Liters, M=Metric Tons, N=Cubic Meters, Y=Cubic Yards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: K|P|T|G|L|M|N|Y — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Form 8700-22 Box 12; 40 CFR Part 262 Appendix

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Receipt Date at Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF)
attributes.description: Date the TSDF facility received and accepted the hazardous waste shipment. Used to calculate transit time and verify timely delivery.

attributes.name: rejection_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the TSDF rejected all or part of the waste shipment.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the TSDF rejected the waste shipment (e.g., waste not matching manifest, facility permit restrictions, safety concerns).

attributes.name: residue_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the containers being shipped contain only residue (less than 3% by weight remaining after emptying).

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Date the hazardous waste shipment left the generator facility. Critical for regulatory compliance timelines and chain-of-custody tracking.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional handling, storage, or safety instructions for transporters and TSDF personnel. May include temperature requirements, incompatibility warnings, or PPE requirements.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste on this manifest across all waste streams and containers.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: EPA-issued 12-character unique tracking number for the Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest (9 digits + 3 letter suffix). Required for cradle-to-grave tracking under RCRA Subtitle C.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart B; EPA Form 8700-22

attributes.name: transporter_1_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the first transporter company handling the waste shipment.

attributes.name: transporter_2_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the second transporter company if applicable.

attributes.name: transporter_signature_date
attributes.description: Date the transporter signed the manifest acknowledging receipt of the waste shipment from the generator.

attributes.name: tsdf_city
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) City
attributes.description: City where the TSDF facility is located.

attributes.name: tsdf_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Name
attributes.description: Legal name of the designated TSDF facility receiving the hazardous waste.

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Date
attributes.description: Date the TSDF authorized representative signed the manifest certifying receipt of the waste shipment.

attributes.name: tsdf_site_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Site Address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the TSDF facility receiving the waste.

attributes.name: tsdf_state
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) State Code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the TSDF facility location.

attributes.name: tsdf_zip_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) ZIP Code
attributes.description: US postal ZIP code for the TSDF facility.

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hazardous waste contents, composition, and physical state. Required to supplement EPA waste codes.

products.name: manifest_line
products.description: Individual waste stream line item on a hazardous waste manifest. Captures line number, waste description, EPA waste codes, DOT hazard class, UN/NA number, container type (drum, tote, tank), container count, unit of measure, total quantity (lbs/gallons), physical state, and special handling notes. Each manifest may carry multiple waste streams requiring separate line entries per DOT HMR and RCRA requirements.
products.reference: Manifest Line Item / DOT HMR Shipping Description

attributes.name: manifest_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manifest line item. Primary key for the manifest line entity.

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: Manifest line has un_na_number (string) but no FK to dot_hazmat_classification reference table. Adding FK provides standardized DOT classification lookup. Keep dot_proper_shipping_name, dot_hazard_cla

attributes.name: manifest_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent hazardous waste manifest document. Links this line item to the overall manifest header.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Manifest line has epa_waste_codes (string, comma-separated) but no FK to waste_code reference table. Adding FK for primary waste code provides standardized waste code lookup. Keep epa_waste_codes stri

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved waste profile document. Waste profiles contain detailed characterization data including TCLP test results, flash point, pH, and other analytical data.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers of this waste stream on the manifest line. Each container must be of the same type and size.

attributes.name: container_size
attributes.description: Capacity or size of each individual container in the unit of measure specified. For drums, typically 55 gallons; for totes, typically 275-330 gallons.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of container used to package the hazardous waste. Common types include 55-gallon drums, intermediate bulk containers (totes), portable tanks, compressed gas cylinders, bags, and boxes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest line record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: discrepancy_comments
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of any discrepancy between the manifest description and the waste received. Required when discrepancy_indication is not none.

attributes.name: discrepancy_indication
attributes.description: Type of discrepancy identified by the receiving facility, if any. Discrepancies must be reported to EPA and the generator within 15 days.

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard classification for transportation purposes. Identifies the primary hazard category (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 6.1 Toxic, Class 8 Corrosive, Class 9 Miscellaneous).

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating the degree of danger. Group I represents high danger, Group II medium danger, and Group III low danger.

attributes.name: dot_proper_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: Official DOT proper shipping name from the Hazardous Materials Table. Must be used on shipping papers and placards.

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes assigned to this waste stream. Includes F-list (process wastes), K-list (industry-specific), P-list and U-list (discarded commercial chemicals), and D-list (characteristic wastes) codes.

attributes.name: flash_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Flash point temperature in degrees Fahrenheit. Wastes with flash point below 140°F are characteristic hazardous wastes (D001) and DOT Class 3 flammable liquids.

attributes.name: generator_comments
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes from the waste generator regarding this waste stream. May include process information, generation date, or other relevant details.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the manifest document. Determines the ordering of waste streams on the manifest form.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current status of this manifest line item in the cradle-to-grave tracking workflow. Tracks progression from draft through final disposition.

attributes.name: management_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the intended treatment, storage, or disposal method for this waste stream at the designated TSDF facility.

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste is designated as a marine pollutant under DOT regulations. Requires special marking and documentation for water transportation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest line record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: pcb_concentration_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of PCBs in parts per million if the waste contains PCBs. Wastes with PCB concentrations of 50 ppm or greater are subject to TSCA PCB regulations.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement of the waste. Wastes with pH ≤2 or ≥12.5 are characteristic corrosive hazardous wastes (D002).

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical state or form of the hazardous waste. Determines handling, storage, and treatment requirements.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the waste was received at the designated TSDF facility. Establishes the start of the facility's custody period.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received by the designated facility in the specified unit of measure. May differ from total_quantity if discrepancies exist.

attributes.name: reportable_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream meets or exceeds the CERCLA reportable quantity threshold. If true, the letters RQ must appear on the manifest and shipping papers.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional handling, storage, or transportation instructions for this waste stream. May include temperature controls, incompatibility warnings, PPE requirements, or emergency response procedures.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of waste for this line item in the specified unit of measure. Calculated as container count multiplied by container size, or measured directly.

attributes.name: un_na_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN or NA identification number assigned to the hazardous material for transportation. UN numbers are internationally recognized; NA numbers are North America-specific.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the waste quantity. Common units include gallons, liters, pounds, kilograms, tons, and cubic yards.

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the hazardous waste stream. Includes physical characteristics, chemical composition, and source process information as required by DOT HMR and RCRA.

attributes.name: waste_minimization_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the waste minimization efforts applied to this waste stream. Required for biennial reporting under RCRA.

products.name: hazmat_container

Captures container type, capacity, material of construction, UN performance rating, current waste profile assignment, fill level, tare weight, gross weight, accumulation start date, storage location (satellite, 90-day, permitted storage), container condition, and chain-of-custody status. Integrates with AMCS container tracking and SAP EHS.

attributes.name: storage_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical facility or site where the container is currently stored. Links to facility EPA ID number and permit information.

attributes.name: tsdf_epa_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID number of the permitted TSDF facility designated to receive and dispose of this container. Must be listed on the hazardous waste manifest.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264/265; TSDF Permit Requirements

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the waste profile that characterizes the hazardous waste currently stored in this container. Links to waste codes, TCLP results, and handling requirements.

attributes.name: accumulation_deadline_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the container must be shipped off-site to avoid RCRA violations. Calculated based on generator status and accumulation start date.

attributes.name: accumulation_start_date

attributes.name: capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum rated capacity of the container in U.S. gallons. Used to calculate fill levels, determine accumulation limits, and plan transportation logistics.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_status
attributes.description: Current custody status in the cradle-to-grave tracking chain. Indicates which party currently has physical possession and legal responsibility for the container.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical integrity and condition of the container. Critical for safety, regulatory compliance, and determining if container requires overpacking or replacement.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 265.171; Container Condition Requirements; DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173.24

attributes.name: container_status
attributes.description: Current state of the container in its lifecycle from deployment through final disposal. Drives regulatory compliance timelines (e.g., 90-day accumulation limits) and operational workflows.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical container form factor used to store and transport the hazardous waste. Determines handling procedures and equipment requirements.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 178; UN Packaging Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste in this container was finally treated and disposed of at the TSDF. Completes the cradle-to-grave tracking lifecycle.
attributes.references: RCRA Manifest Requirements; EPA e-Manifest System

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Planned or actual method of treatment and disposal for the waste in this container. Determined by waste characteristics, EPA waste codes, and TSDF capabilities.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264/265; Treatment and Disposal Standards

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class or division number (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 8 for corrosives) that classifies the primary hazard of the material for transportation purposes.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; Hazard Class Definitions

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group (I, II, or III) indicating the degree of danger: I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Determines packaging requirements.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; Packing Group Criteria

attributes.name: dot_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: DOT-required proper shipping name for the hazardous material in this container as listed in 49 CFR 172.101 Hazardous Materials Table. Required for transportation documentation.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172.101; Hazardous Materials Table

attributes.name: dot_un_number

attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number assigned to the hazardous material for international transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Required on shipping papers and labels.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172.101; UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes assigned to the waste in this container (e.g., D001, F003). Determines regulatory requirements and disposal methods.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261 Subpart D; EPA Hazardous Waste Code Lists

attributes.name: fill_level_percent

attributes.name: gross_weight_lbs

attributes.name: identification_number

attributes.references: RCRA Container Labeling Requirements; DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172

attributes.name: label_affixed_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazardous waste label was affixed to the container. RCRA requires containers to be labeled upon start of accumulation with waste identity and accumulation start date.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent container inspection for leaks, corrosion, and structural integrity. RCRA requires weekly inspections of containers in accumulation areas.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this container record. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: material_of_construction
