attributes.description: Reference to the original TCLP test ID if this is a retest. Null if this is the initial test. Maintains audit trail for retested samples.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: TCLP test has assigned_waste_codes (string, comma-separated) but no FK to waste_code reference table. Adding FK for primary assigned waste code provides standardized waste code lookup. Keep assigned_w

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: TCLP results are submitted in biennial reports, LDR notifications, and waste characterization reports. Links analytical data to regulatory submissions for compliance verification and audit support.

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the waste profile under which this sample was collected and tested. Waste profiles define the expected characteristics and handling requirements for specific waste streams.

attributes.name: analyte_group
attributes.description: Category of contaminants analyzed in the TCLP test. Common groups include RCRA 8 metals, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), semi-volatile organic compounds (SVOCs), and pesticides.

attributes.name: arsenic_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of arsenic in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 5.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: assigned_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes assigned based on TCLP results. D-codes (D004-D043) indicate toxicity characteristic. Empty if waste passes all thresholds.

attributes.name: barium_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of barium in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 100.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: benzene_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of benzene in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 0.5 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: cadmium_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of cadmium in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 1.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: certifying_chemist_license
attributes.description: Professional license or certification number of the chemist who certified the test results. Validates professional qualifications.

attributes.name: certifying_chemist_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified chemist or laboratory director who reviewed and certified the analytical results. Responsible for data quality and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number for the chain-of-custody documentation that accompanied the sample from collection through laboratory analysis. Ensures sample integrity and traceability.

attributes.name: chromium_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of total chromium in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 5.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TCLP test record was first created in the Enviance EHS system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: detection_limit_mg_l
attributes.description: Lowest concentration of analyte that the analytical method can reliably detect. Used to interpret non-detect results and ensure regulatory thresholds can be measured.

attributes.name: extraction_fluid
attributes.description: Type of extraction fluid used in the TCLP procedure. Fluid #1 (pH 4.93 ± 0.05) or Fluid #2 (pH 2.88 ± 0.05) based on waste alkalinity.

attributes.name: laboratory_certification_number
attributes.description: State or EPA certification number for the analytical laboratory. Validates that the laboratory is authorized to perform RCRA characterization testing.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified analytical laboratory that performed the TCLP test. Must be EPA-certified or state-certified for hazardous waste characterization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TCLP test record was last updated. Tracks changes to test status, results, or quality control flags.

attributes.name: lead_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of lead in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 5.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: mercury_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of mercury in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 0.2 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: overall_pass_fail
attributes.description: Overall determination of whether the waste exhibits the toxicity characteristic. Pass indicates non-hazardous; fail indicates hazardous waste requiring D-code assignment.

attributes.name: qa_qc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test met all quality assurance and quality control criteria. Qualified results may have data quality limitations but are still reportable.

attributes.name: qa_qc_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any quality control issues, deviations from standard method, matrix interferences, or data qualifiers applied to the results.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test results require regulatory agency review and approval before waste can be accepted for disposal or treatment.

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date when the final laboratory analytical report was issued. Used for regulatory reporting timelines and waste profile approval workflows.

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Unique report number assigned by the laboratory to the analytical report. Used for document tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is a retest of a previous sample due to quality control failure, sample integrity issues, or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste sample was physically collected from the waste stream or container for laboratory testing. Critical for chain-of-custody and sample integrity validation.

attributes.name: sample_collection_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the waste sample was collected, including time zone. Used for hold time calculations and chain-of-custody verification.

attributes.name: sample_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory received the sample for analysis. Used to verify sample hold times and chain-of-custody transfer.

attributes.name: selenium_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of selenium in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 1.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: silver_result_mg_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of silver in the TCLP leachate expressed in milligrams per liter. Regulatory threshold is 5.0 mg/L per 40 CFR 261.24.

attributes.name: test_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all analytical testing and quality control procedures were completed and results finalized.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: EPA-approved analytical method used for the TCLP test. Standard method is SW-846 Method 1311 (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure).

attributes.name: test_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the TCLP extraction procedure was initiated in the laboratory. Used to verify compliance with sample hold time requirements.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current status of the TCLP test in the laboratory workflow. Tracks progression from sample receipt through final report issuance.

attributes.name: waste_matrix_type
attributes.description: Physical form of the waste sample tested. Determines the specific TCLP extraction procedure to be followed.

products.name: treatment_record
products.description: Record of hazardous waste treatment operations performed at a TSDF or permitted on-site treatment unit. Captures treatment date, treatment unit ID, treatment technology code (incineration, neutralization, stabilization, fuel blending, solvent recovery), input waste stream and quantity, treatment parameters (temperature, pH, residence time), output residual characterization, emission control data, operator certification, and regulatory unit code per RCRA land disposal restrictions (LDR). Sourced from SAP EHS treatment logs.

attributes.description: Internal identifier for the specific treatment unit or equipment used for the operation (e.g., incinerator, neutralization tank, stabilization mixer, fuel blending unit, solvent recovery still). Each unit has unique operating parameters and permit conditions.

attributes.description: The Department of Transportation (DOT) Bill of Lading number associated with the shipment of hazardous waste to the treatment facility. Links treatment record to transportation compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this treatment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disposal_method_code
attributes.description: EPA code indicating the intended final disposal or management method for the treated residual. Values: LANDF=Landfill, INJCT=Underground Injection, SURFI=Surface Impoundment, WSTPL=Waste Pile, RCYCL=Recycling, ENRGY=Energy Recovery, OTHRD=Other Disposal. attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this treatment operation was performed as part of an emergency response action under CERCLA (Superfund) or RCRA Corrective Action. True=Emergency response treatment, False=Routine permitted treatment.
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 104; 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart D Contingency Plan

attributes.name: emission_control_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the air pollution control equipment used during thermal treatment operations (e.g., scrubbers, baghouses, electrostatic precipitators). Required for Clean Air Act (CAA) compliance and RCRA air emission standards.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart AA/BB/CC Air Emission Standards

attributes.name: input_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the input waste quantity. Values: KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, GAL=Gallons, L=Liters, TON=US Tons, MT=Metric Tonnes. Must align with manifest and facility reporting units.

attributes.name: input_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) assigned to the input waste stream. Determines applicable treatment standards and Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR).
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: input_waste_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of hazardous waste fed into the treatment unit for this operation, measured in the unit specified by input_quantity_unit. Critical for mass balance calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.73 Operating Record; 40 CFR Part 268.7 LDR Recordkeeping

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this treatment record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: ldr_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treated waste meets EPA Land Disposal Restrictions treatment standards and is eligible for land disposal. Values: COMPLIANT=Meets LDR standards, NON_COMPLIANT=Requires additional treatment, EXEMPT=Waste category exempt from LDR, PENDING_ANALYSIS=Awaiting analytical results.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional observations, deviations from standard procedures, equipment malfunctions, or other relevant information about the treatment operation. Supports operational troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: operator_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification number of the trained and certified operator who performed or supervised the treatment operation. RCRA requires personnel training and certification for hazardous waste treatment operations.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.16 Personnel Training; HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: output_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the output residual quantity. Values: KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, GAL=Gallons, L=Liters, TON=US Tons, MT=Metric Tonnes.

attributes.name: output_residual_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of treated residual material or byproduct remaining after treatment, measured in the unit specified by output_quantity_unit. Used for mass balance verification and subsequent disposal or recycling decisions.

attributes.name: output_waste_characterization
attributes.description: Description of the physical and chemical characteristics of the treated residual, including any remaining hazardous waste codes. Determines whether the residual meets Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR) treatment standards or requires further treatment.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 268.7 Waste Analysis and Recordkeeping; 40 CFR Part 261.3

attributes.name: pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Operating pressure in pounds per square inch (PSI) during treatment. Relevant for pressurized treatment technologies such as wet air oxidation or supercritical water oxidation.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality assurance review for this treatment record. Values: APPROVED=Record verified and approved by QA, REJECTED=Record failed QA review, PENDING_REVIEW=Awaiting QA review, NOT_REQUIRED=QA review not required for this operation.

attributes.name: regulatory_unit_code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned code identifying the specific treatment unit under the facility's RCRA Part B permit. Each unit has unique permit conditions, operating parameters, and waste acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: RCRA Part B Permit; 40 CFR Part 264.13

attributes.name: residence_time_minutes
attributes.description: The duration in minutes that the waste remained in the treatment unit. Critical for ensuring adequate contact time for chemical reactions, thermal destruction, or physical separation processes per permit specifications.
attributes.references: RCRA Part B Permit Operating Conditions; 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart O

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this treatment record originated. Values: SAP_EHS=SAP Environment Health and Safety module, ENVIANCE=Enviance EHS platform, MANUAL_ENTRY=Manually entered by operator, SCADA=Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system, LIMS=Laboratory Information Management System.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: stack_emission_test_result
attributes.description: Result of stack emission testing performed during or after the treatment operation to verify compliance with air quality standards. Values: PASS=Emissions within permitted limits, FAIL=Emissions exceed limits, NOT_TESTED=No test performed for this operation.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 60 Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources; Clean Air Act

attributes.name: tclp_test_performed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Test Performed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) test was performed on the treated residual to verify that hazardous characteristics have been successfully treated. True=TCLP performed, False=TCLP not performed.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261.24 Toxicity Characteristic; EPA Method 1311

attributes.name: tclp_test_result
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Test Result
attributes.description: Result of the TCLP test if performed. Values: PASS=Treated waste no longer exhibits toxicity characteristic, FAIL=Waste still exhibits toxicity characteristic, NOT_APPLICABLE=TCLP not required for this waste, PENDING=Test results not yet available.

attributes.name: treatment_batch_number
attributes.description: Internal batch identifier for grouping multiple treatment records that were processed together or as part of a continuous treatment campaign. Enables batch-level quality control and traceability.

attributes.name: treatment_cost_usd

attributes.description: The total cost in US dollars incurred for this treatment operation, including labor, energy, consumables, and equipment depreciation. Used for cost accounting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP Cost Accounting Standards; SAP CO Module

attributes.name: treatment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the hazardous waste treatment operation was performed. Critical for regulatory reporting timelines and Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR) compliance tracking.

attributes.name: treatment_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: The calculated treatment efficiency expressed as a percentage, representing the degree of contaminant removal or destruction achieved. For incinerators, this is the Destruction and Removal Efficiency (DRE) which must meet or exceed 99.99% for most hazardous wastes.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.343 Performance Standards for Incinerators

attributes.name: treatment_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the treatment process was completed. Used to calculate total treatment duration and verify process completion per permit requirements.

attributes.name: treatment_ph_level
attributes.description: The pH level maintained during chemical treatment processes such as neutralization or chemical oxidation. Must be within permitted operating ranges to ensure effective treatment and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.17 General Requirements for Ignitable, Reactive, or Incompatible Wastes

attributes.name: treatment_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the treatment process began. Used to calculate residence time and verify compliance with treatment technology specifications.

attributes.name: treatment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the treatment operation. Values: COMPLETED=Treatment successfully finished, IN_PROGRESS=Treatment underway, FAILED=Treatment did not meet specifications, ABORTED=Treatment stopped before completion, PENDING_VERIFICATION=Awaiting analytical confirmation of treatment effectiveness.

attributes.name: treatment_technology_code
attributes.description: EPA-defined code representing the treatment technology applied. Values: INCIN=Incineration, NEUTR=Neutralization, STBLZ=Stabilization, FBLEN=Fuel Blending, SOLVR=Solvent Recovery, CARBN=Carbon Adsorption, WETOX=Wet Air Oxidation, CHOXD=Chemical Oxidation, CMBST=Combustion, DEACT=Deactivation, MACRO=Macroencapsulation, RORGS=Recovery of Organics, RMETL=Recovery of Metals, WTRRX=Water Reaction. attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 268.42 Treatment Standards; EPA RCRA Waste Codes

attributes.name: treatment_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Operating temperature of the treatment process in degrees Celsius. Critical parameter for thermal treatment technologies (incineration, combustion) to ensure destruction and removal efficiency (DRE) requirements are met.

products.name: disposal_record

Closes the cradle-to-grave tracking loop required by RCRA Subtitle C.

attributes.description: EPA-standardized code identifying the disposal method used (e.g., D80 for landfill, D81 for underground injection, D82 for incineration ash disposal). Defines the ultimate fate of the hazardous waste.

attributes.name: disposal_method_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the disposal method employed at the TSDF, including specific technology, process, or unit operation used for final waste disposition.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; TSDF Operating Procedures

attributes.name: disposal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the disposal record in the TSDF workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through disposal to final certification and manifest closure.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; TSDF Workflow Management Standards

attributes.name: emergency_response_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether emergency response procedures were activated during receipt or disposal of this waste. Triggers incident reporting and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120; RCRA Contingency Plan Requirements

attributes.name: ldr_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the TSDF certified LDR compliance for the disposed waste. Documents when treatment standards were verified prior to land disposal.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 268; EPA LDR Certification Requirements

attributes.name: ldr_compliance_certified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the TSDF has certified that the waste meets Land Disposal Restriction treatment standards prior to disposal. Required for restricted hazardous wastes under RCRA.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 268; EPA Land Disposal Restrictions

attributes.name: ldr_treatment_method
attributes.description: Description of the treatment method applied to meet LDR standards before disposal (e.g., stabilization, neutralization, thermal treatment). Required for restricted waste codes.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 268; EPA LDR Treatment Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or observations related to the disposal event. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this disposal record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this disposal record was last modified. Tracks changes and updates throughout the disposal workflow and certification process.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory reports related to this disposal were submitted to EPA or state environmental agencies. Documents compliance with reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.75; State Environmental Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether required regulatory reports (e.g., biennial report, exception report) have been submitted for this disposal event. Tracks compliance reporting obligations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.75; EPA Biennial Report Requirements

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejection of the waste shipment by the TSDF, if applicable. Documents why waste was not accepted for disposal (e.g., failed waste profile, prohibited material, damaged containers).
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.13; TSDF Waste Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created or manages this disposal record (e.g., Enviance EHS, SAP EHS, TSDF proprietary system). Supports data lineage and integration tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; System Integration Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special handling, processing, or disposal instructions required for this waste stream. Documents unique requirements for safe and compliant disposal operations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; OSHA HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized TSDF representative who signed and certified the disposal record. Provides accountability for disposal confirmation.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Manifest Signature Requirements

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the TSDF representative signed the disposal record, confirming receipt and disposal of the hazardous waste shipment.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Manifest Completion Timeline

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_title
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Title
attributes.description: Job title of the TSDF representative who signed the disposal record (e.g., Facility Manager, Environmental Compliance Officer). Establishes authority of signatory.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; TSDF Operating Procedures

attributes.name: waste_code_primary
attributes.description: Primary EPA hazardous waste code (D, F, K, P, or U list) identifying the principal hazardous characteristic or listing of the disposed waste. Determines regulatory requirements and disposal restrictions.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261; EPA Hazardous Waste Code System

attributes.name: waste_codes_additional
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional EPA hazardous waste codes applicable to the disposed waste. Captures multiple hazardous characteristics or listings for mixed waste streams.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261; EPA Hazardous Waste Code System

attributes.name: waste_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste disposed, measured in pounds. Represents the actual weight accepted and disposed by the TSDF facility.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Waste Quantity Reporting Standards

attributes.name: waste_quantity_tons
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste disposed, measured in tons. Calculated or measured weight for regulatory reporting and capacity tracking purposes.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Waste Quantity Reporting Standards

attributes.name: waste_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Volume of liquid or semi-liquid hazardous waste disposed, measured in gallons. Used for liquid waste streams and deep well injection disposal methods.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Volume Measurement Standards

products.name: epa_id_registration
products.description: EPA Identification Number registration record for each regulated site (generators, transporters, TSDFs). Captures EPA ID number, site name, site address, regulated activity types (generator, transporter, TSDF), RCRA notification form submission date, notification type (initial, subsequent, withdrawal), handler status, large/small/very small quantity generator classification, and state agency notification status. Serves as the regulatory identity anchor for all RCRA compliance activities. Sourced from EPA RCRAInfo and Enviance EHS.
products.reference: EPA ID Number / RCRA Site ID (RCRAInfo)

attributes.name: epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) ID Registration ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EPA identification number registration record.

attributes.name: authorized_state_program
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorized State RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) Program
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state has an EPA-authorized RCRA program and administers the program in lieu of the federal EPA.

attributes.name: epa_id_number
attributes.description: The 12-character EPA identification number assigned to the regulated site (format: 2-letter state code + 9 digits). This is the regulatory identity anchor for all RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) compliance activities.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle C; 40 CFR Part 262

attributes.name: facility_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the facility contact person for regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: facility_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person for regulatory correspondence and compliance matters at the registered facility.

attributes.name: facility_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the facility contact person.

attributes.name: generator_classification
attributes.description: Generator size classification: LQG (Large Quantity Generator, >1000 kg/month), SQG (Small Quantity Generator, 100-1000 kg/month), VSQG (Very Small Quantity Generator, <100 kg/month), CESQG (Conditionally Exempt Small Quantity Generator, legacy term), or not_applicable for non-generators.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 262.13; 40 CFR Part 262.14; 40 CFR Part 262.15

attributes.name: handler_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the EPA ID registration: active (currently operating), inactive (not currently handling hazardous waste), pending (application submitted), withdrawn (voluntarily terminated), or suspended (regulatory action).

attributes.name: handler_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) Handler Type
attributes.description: Primary regulated activity type for this EPA ID: generator (produces hazardous waste), transporter (hauls hazardous waste), TSDF (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility), or mixed (multiple activities).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle C; 40 CFR Part 262

attributes.name: is_generator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPA ID is registered as a hazardous waste generator.

attributes.name: is_transporter
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPA ID is registered as a hazardous waste transporter.

attributes.name: is_tsdf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is TSDF (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility)
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPA ID is registered as a Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility for hazardous waste.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the regulated site in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: location_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the geographic coordinates of the site: GPS (field measurement), address_geocoding (automated), survey (professional land survey), or map_interpolation (manual map reading).

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the regulated site in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: NAICS (North American Industry Classification System) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code representing the primary business activity of the facility.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau NAICS; EPA Form 8700-12

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this EPA ID registration, including special conditions, regulatory variances, or operational context.

attributes.name: notification_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA ID registration became effective and the site was authorized to conduct regulated activities.

attributes.name: notification_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) Notification Submission Date
attributes.description: Date when the RCRA notification form (EPA Form 8700-12) was submitted to the EPA or authorized state agency.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) Notification Type
attributes.description: Type of RCRA notification form submission: initial (first-time registration), subsequent (periodic update), amendment (correction to existing registration), or withdrawal (deregistration).

attributes.name: owner_operator_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity that owns or operates the regulated facility.

attributes.name: owner_operator_type
attributes.description: Type of entity that owns or operates the facility: private (commercial), public (publicly traded), federal (U.S. government), state (state government), or municipal (local government).

attributes.name: rcrainfo_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the last successful data synchronization with the EPA RCRAInfo system.

attributes.name: rcrainfo_sync_status
attributes.description: Status of data synchronization with the EPA RCRAInfo national database: synced (up to date), pending (sync in progress), failed (sync error), or not_synced (not yet synchronized).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EPA ID registration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EPA ID registration record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA ID registration expires and must be renewed (if applicable based on state requirements).

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code representing the primary business activity of the facility (legacy classification system).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor SIC; EPA Form 8700-12

attributes.name: site_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the regulated site.

attributes.name: site_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, building, floor) for the regulated site.

attributes.name: site_city
attributes.description: City where the regulated site is located.

attributes.name: site_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the regulated site location.

attributes.description: The legal or trade name of the regulated facility or site registered with the EPA.

attributes.description: ZIP code or ZIP+4 code for the regulated site address.

attributes.name: site_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the regulated site is located.

attributes.description: System of record where this EPA ID registration was originally captured: Enviance EHS, SAP EHS module, EPA RCRAInfo, or manual entry.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the state environmental quality department or local enforcement agency has been notified of this EPA ID registration.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which an amended version of the biennial report was submitted. Nullable if no amendment has been filed.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the biennial report was amended after initial submission. Nullable if the report has not been amended. Common reasons include data corrections, additional waste codes discovered, or regulatory agency feedback.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the authorized representative signed and certified the biennial report, attesting to its accuracy under penalty of law.

attributes.name: certification_title
attributes.description: Job title of the authorized facility representative who certified the biennial report (e.g., Environmental Manager, Facility Director, Compliance Officer).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or context related to the biennial report submission. May include explanations of unusual waste volumes, operational changes, or regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this biennial report record was most recently updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: number_of_waste_codes_reported
attributes.description: The count of distinct EPA hazardous waste codes (e.g., D001, F001, K001) reported in this biennial report. Each waste stream is classified by one or more waste codes.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility shipped any hazardous waste off-site to TSDFs during the reporting year. True = off-site shipments occurred, False = all waste managed on-site.

attributes.name: onsite_treatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility performed any on-site treatment, storage, or disposal of hazardous waste during the reporting year. True = on-site management occurred, False = all waste shipped off-site.

attributes.name: primary_treatment_method
attributes.description: The predominant treatment, storage, or disposal method used for hazardous waste during the reporting year. Examples: incineration, stabilization, landfill, fuel blending, recycling, neutralization.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code
attributes.description: The EPA hazardous waste code representing the largest volume of waste generated during the reporting year. Format: one letter (D=characteristic, F=non-specific source, K=specific source, P/U=acute/toxic) followed by three digits.

attributes.name: primary_waste_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the primary waste stream corresponding to the primary waste code. Describes the waste source, composition, and hazardous characteristics.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The even-numbered calendar year for which this biennial report is submitted (e.g., 2022, 2024). Reports are required every two years per RCRA regulations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this biennial report data was sourced. Typically Enviance EHS regulatory reporting module or SAP EHS module.

attributes.name: state_agency_code
attributes.description: Two-letter abbreviation of the state environmental agency to which this biennial report was submitted. Corresponds to the state where the facility is located.

attributes.name: total_waste_generated_lbs
attributes.description: The total quantity of RCRA hazardous waste generated during the reporting year, measured in pounds. Aggregated across all waste codes managed by the facility.

attributes.name: total_waste_managed_onsite_lbs
attributes.description: The total quantity of hazardous waste treated, stored, or disposed of on-site at the generator facility during the reporting year, measured in pounds.

attributes.name: total_waste_shipped_offsite_lbs
attributes.description: The total quantity of hazardous waste shipped off-site to Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facilities (TSDFs) during the reporting year, measured in pounds.

Integrates with Enviance EHS incident module and DOT incident reporting.
products.reference: HAZMAT Incident / NRC Release Report / DOT Incident Report

Links incident to mandated remediation activities, closure verification, and regulatory oversight of c

Required for tracking enforcement actions resulting from incidents and linking incident response to r

attributes.name: incident_datetime

attributes.name: incident_number

attributes.name: incident_status

attributes.references: EPA Emergency Response Classification, OSHA Incident Types

attributes.name: injuries_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether any personnel injuries or exposures occurred as a result of the incident.

attributes.name: injury_count

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.references: CERCLA 40 CFR 302.6, Clean Water Act 40 CFR 110.6

attributes.name: nrc_report_number

attributes.name: regulatory_report_due_date

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submission_date

attributes.references: EPA Compliance Tracking, State Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: release_pathway

attributes.name: waste_code

products.name: land_disposal_restriction
products.description: Land Disposal Restriction (LDR) notification and certification record per 40 CFR Part 268. Captures waste code, treatment standard type (concentration-based or technology-based), applicable treatment standard values, underlying hazardous constituents (UHCs), LDR notification date, generator certification statement, and whether waste meets treatment standards prior to land disposal. Required to accompany every hazardous waste shipment destined for land disposal. Sourced from SAP EHS and Enviance EHS.

attributes.name: land_disposal_restriction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the land disposal restriction record. Primary key for the LDR notification and certification entity.

attributes.name: generator_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generator Epa Id Registration Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: LDR notification tracks generator EPA ID as a string.
