attributes.name: manifest_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hazardous waste manifest that this LDR notification accompanies. Every LDR must be associated with a manifest shipment.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: LDR notifications (40 CFR 268.7) are regulatory submissions. Links LDR compliance documentation to submission tracking for deadline management, confirmation, and audit trails.

attributes.name: treatment_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.treatment_record. Business justification: LDR certifications document that treatment standards were met before land disposal. One LDR certification references one treatment batch that achieved compliance. This links the LDR certification to t

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the waste profile that characterizes the waste stream subject to this LDR. Links to waste characterization and TCLP testing results.

attributes.name: analytical_method
attributes.description: EPA-approved analytical method used to determine constituent concentrations for LDR compliance (e.g., SW-846 methods, TCLP).

attributes.name: analytical_results
attributes.description: Summary of analytical test results showing constituent concentrations compared to treatment standards, formatted as constituent:value:unit triplets.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the generator certified that the waste meets LDR treatment standards or provided required notification of non-compliance.

attributes.name: certification_statement
attributes.description: Full text of the generator certification statement required by 40 CFR 268.7, certifying that waste meets treatment standards or identifying prohibited waste codes.

attributes.name: certifying_official_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative who signed the LDR certification on behalf of the generator.

attributes.name: certifying_official_signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the authorized representative signed the LDR certification document.

attributes.name: certifying_official_title
attributes.description: Job title of the authorized representative who signed the LDR certification (e.g., Environmental Manager, Plant Manager, Authorized Agent).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or special instructions related to the LDR notification, treatment requirements, or compliance considerations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LDR record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: dilution_prohibition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste is subject to dilution prohibition under 40 CFR 268.3. True if dilution as substitute for treatment is prohibited.

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Hazardous Waste Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U codes) applicable to this waste stream and subject to LDR treatment standards.

attributes.name: laboratory_certification_number
attributes.description: State or federal certification number of the laboratory that performed LDR compliance testing.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified laboratory that performed analytical testing to verify LDR compliance.

attributes.name: ldr_notification_type
attributes.description: Type of LDR notification: one-time (single shipment), annual (covers multiple shipments of same waste), or waste-specific (unique waste stream).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LDR record was last modified. Audit trail for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: no_migration_petition_number
attributes.description: Reference number for approved no-migration petition under 40 CFR 268.6, if applicable, allowing land disposal without meeting treatment standards.

attributes.name: prohibited_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste codes that are prohibited from land disposal without meeting treatment standards. Used when waste does not meet standards.

attributes.name: sample_analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory completed analysis of the waste sample for LDR compliance verification.

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste sample was collected for LDR compliance testing.

attributes.name: storage_prohibition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste is subject to storage prohibition under 40 CFR 268.50. True if storage of restricted waste is prohibited except for accumulation purposes.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Specific waste subcategory within the EPA waste code that may have different treatment standards (e.g., high mercury, low mercury, radioactive).

attributes.name: treatment_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste was treated to meet LDR standards, if applicable. Required when waste_meets_treatment_standards_flag is True.

attributes.name: treatment_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility where the waste was treated to meet LDR standards, if treatment occurred prior to shipment.

attributes.name: treatment_standard_code
attributes.description: The specific treatment standard code from 40 CFR Part 268 Subpart D that applies to this waste (e.g., DEACT, RLEAD, STABL, MACRO, CMBST).

attributes.name: treatment_standard_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the treatment standard requirements, including specific concentration limits or technology specifications that must be met.

attributes.name: treatment_standard_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Land Disposal Restriction (LDR) Treatment Standard Type
attributes.description: Type of treatment standard applicable to this waste: concentration-based (specific constituent levels) or technology-based (specific treatment technology required).

attributes.name: tsdf_acknowledgment_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Acknowledgment Date
attributes.description: Date when the receiving TSDF acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the LDR notification and certification.

attributes.name: uhc_treatment_standards
attributes.description: Specific concentration limits or treatment requirements for each underlying hazardous constituent listed, formatted as constituent:limit pairs.

attributes.name: underlying_hazardous_constituents
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of underlying hazardous constituents present in the waste that are subject to treatment standards, even if not the primary waste code.

attributes.name: variance_or_exemption_number
attributes.description: Reference number for any EPA-granted variance, exemption, or extension from LDR treatment standards applicable to this waste shipment.

attributes.name: waste_category
attributes.description: EPA waste category classification: wastewater (contains less than 1% total organic carbon and less than 1% total suspended solids) or nonwastewater. Determines applicable treatment standards.

attributes.name: waste_meets_treatment_standards_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste has been treated to meet applicable LDR treatment standards prior to land disposal. True if waste meets standards, False if waste requires further treatment.

products.name: waste_code
products.description: Reference table of EPA and state hazardous waste codes used to classify hazardous waste streams. Captures waste code (D001–D043, F-listed, K-listed, P-listed, U-listed), waste code description, hazard basis (ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity, toxicity, listed), regulatory citation (40 CFR Part 261 subpart), applicable treatment standards, state-specific code flag, and active status. Used across waste profiles, manifests, and regulatory reports for standardized waste classification.
products.reference: EPA Hazardous Waste Code (40 CFR Part 261)

attributes.name: waste_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the waste code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code is currently active and should be used for new waste classifications. True for codes in current regulatory use. False for obsolete, superseded, or delisted codes that are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: acute_hazardous_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code designates an acutely hazardous waste under RCRA. True for P-listed wastes and certain F-listed wastes that are subject to more stringent quantity thresholds (1 kg vs 100 kg for generator status determination) and management requirements.

attributes.name: container_type_restriction
attributes.description: Specific container or packaging requirements for this waste code during storage and transportation. May specify DOT-approved containers, compatibility requirements, or prohibited container materials. Critical for safe handling and DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations compliance.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Parts 172-173 - DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delisting_petition_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generators may petition EPA to delist this waste code for specific waste streams that do not exhibit hazardous characteristics. True for listed wastes (F, K, P, U codes) where site-specific delisting is possible. False for characteristic wastes (D codes) which cannot be delisted.

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class for transportation of this waste under Hazardous Materials Regulations. Classes include: Class 1 (Explosives), Class 2 (Gases), Class 3 (Flammable Liquids), Class 4 (Flammable Solids), Class 5 (Oxidizers), Class 6 (Toxic/Infectious), Class 7 (Radioactive), Class 8 (Corrosives), Class 9 (Miscellaneous). Used for manifest preparation and vehicle placarding.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this waste code became effective under federal or state regulations. Used to determine applicability to historical waste streams and to track regulatory changes over time. Critical for legacy waste management and compliance audits.

attributes.name: generator_accumulation_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days a generator may accumulate this waste on-site before shipping to a TSDF. Typically 90 days for large quantity generators, 180 days for small quantity generators, or 270 days with approved extension. Shorter limits (e.g., 1 day) may apply to acutely hazardous wastes.

attributes.name: hazard_basis
attributes.description: Primary hazard characteristic that qualifies this waste as hazardous under RCRA. Ignitability (D001) covers flammable liquids and oxidizers. Corrosivity (D002) covers acids and bases. Reactivity (D003) covers unstable or explosive materials. Toxicity (D004-D043) covers materials that leach toxic constituents. Listed wastes are hazardous by definition regardless of characteristics. Multiple indicates waste exhibits more than one characteristic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste code record was last updated. Tracks regulatory changes, data corrections, and reference updates. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, clarifications, or internal guidance for using this waste code. May include common misclassifications to avoid, industry-specific interpretations, or cross-references to related codes. Free-text field for subject matter expert annotations.

attributes.name: prohibited_method_code
attributes.description: Management method codes that are prohibited for this waste code under Land Disposal Restrictions. Typically references disposal methods that are banned without prior treatment (e.g., landfill disposal, deep well injection). Comma-separated list if multiple methods are prohibited.

attributes.name: recycling_potential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code has known recycling or reclamation pathways that may qualify for reduced regulatory requirements under RCRA recycling exemptions. True if legitimate recycling options exist (e.g., solvent recovery, metal reclamation, fuel blending).

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific section of 40 CFR Part 261 or state regulation that defines this waste code. Provides legal reference for compliance documentation and audit trails. Format typically follows CFR structure (e.g., 40 CFR 261.31 for F-listed wastes).

attributes.name: reportable_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: CERCLA reportable quantity in pounds. If a spill or release of this waste equals or exceeds this quantity, it must be reported to the National Response Center immediately. Values typically range from 1 lb (most hazardous) to 5,000 lbs. Null if no RQ is assigned.

attributes.name: small_quantity_exclusion_kg
attributes.description: Quantity threshold in kilograms below which a generator may qualify for reduced regulatory requirements. Typically 100 kg per month for hazardous waste or 1 kg per month for acutely hazardous waste. Used to determine generator category (VSQG, SQG, LQG).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for state-specific waste codes. Null for federal EPA codes. Used to identify which state jurisdiction defines and enforces this code. Critical for multi-state operations to ensure compliance with local regulations.

attributes.name: state_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code is a state-specific designation beyond federal EPA requirements. True when the code is defined by state environmental regulations and may not be recognized in other states. False for federal EPA codes that apply nationwide.

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Date when this waste code was or will be removed from regulatory lists. Null for active codes. Populated when EPA or state agencies delist a waste code or when state-specific codes are superseded. Historical record retention required for audit trails.
attributes.references: Federal Register or State Regulatory Updates

attributes.name: tclp_constituent
attributes.description: Specific toxic constituent measured in TCLP testing for toxicity characteristic wastes. Examples include arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, selenium, silver, benzene, trichloroethylene. Only populated for D-code toxicity characteristic wastes (D004-D043).

attributes.name: tclp_regulatory_level_mg_l
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Regulatory Level (mg/L)
attributes.description: Maximum concentration in milligrams per liter of TCLP extract that triggers hazardous waste classification for toxicity characteristic wastes. Waste exceeding this level must be managed as hazardous. Only applicable to D-code toxicity characteristic wastes.

attributes.name: toxicity_characteristic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code is based on Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) test results. True for D004-D043 codes where waste is hazardous if TCLP extract exceeds regulatory levels for specific contaminants. Requires periodic testing to confirm classification.

attributes.name: treatment_standard_code
attributes.description: Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR) treatment standard code that applies to this waste before land disposal. References 40 CFR Part 268 treatment standards. Specifies required treatment technology or concentration limits (e.g., DEACT for deactivation, IMERC for incineration, specific mg/L or mg/kg limits for TCLP constituents).

attributes.name: treatment_subcategory
attributes.description: Subcategory designation for wastes with multiple treatment standards based on waste form or concentration. Used when a single waste code has different treatment requirements for wastewater versus non-wastewater forms, or for different concentration ranges.

attributes.name: universal_treatment_standard
attributes.description: Universal Treatment Standard concentration limits for underlying hazardous constituents. Specifies maximum allowable concentrations (in mg/L for TCLP or mg/kg total) for each constituent before the waste can be land disposed. Multiple constituents may be listed with their respective limits.

attributes.name: waste_code
attributes.description: EPA or state hazardous waste code identifier. Format follows EPA classification: D-codes (D001-D043 for characteristic wastes), F-codes (F001-F039 for non-specific source wastes), K-codes (K001-K181 for specific source wastes), P-codes (P001-P205 for acutely hazardous commercial chemical products), U-codes (U001-U411 for toxic commercial chemical products). This is the business identifier used across manifests, profiles, and regulatory reports.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 - Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: waste_code_type
attributes.description: Classification category of the waste code. D-listed are characteristic wastes (ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity, toxicity). F-listed are wastes from non-specific sources. K-listed are wastes from specific sources. P-listed are acutely hazardous discarded commercial chemical products. U-listed are toxic discarded commercial chemical products. State-specific codes are additional classifications imposed by state environmental agencies.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 Subparts C and D

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the waste stream or material covered by this code. Includes physical characteristics, chemical composition, source process, and typical examples. Used by generators and TSDFs to match waste streams to appropriate codes.

attributes.name: waste_minimization_code
attributes.description: Code indicating applicable waste minimization or source reduction strategies for this waste stream. References EPA waste minimization guidance and best management practices. Used in biennial reports and pollution prevention planning.

products.name: dot_hazmat_classification
products.description: Reference table of DOT Hazardous Materials classifications per 49 CFR Parts 171–180 (HMR). Captures hazard class/division (1–9), UN/NA number, proper shipping name, packing group (I/II/III), label requirements, placard requirements, special provisions, packaging authorizations, quantity limits for passenger/cargo aircraft, and marine pollutant flag. Used to populate manifest shipping descriptions and ensure DOT HMR compliance for all hazardous waste transport.
products.reference: DOT HMR Hazardous Materials Table (49 CFR 172.101)

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Classification ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DOT hazardous materials classification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cargo_aircraft_quantity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum net quantity per package permitted on cargo-only aircraft. May be expressed as weight (kg), volume (L), or 'Forbidden' if not permitted.

attributes.name: classification_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this classification entry became effective in the Hazardous Materials Regulations. Used to track regulatory changes over time.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory status of this classification entry. Active = currently in force, Superseded = replaced by newer entry, Withdrawn = no longer valid.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this classification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: erg_guide_number
attributes.description: Three-digit guide number from the DOT Emergency Response Guidebook that provides first responders with initial action guidance for incidents involving this material.

attributes.name: excepted_quantity_code
attributes.description: Code (E0-E5) indicating the maximum quantity per inner packaging permitted under excepted quantity provisions, which allow minimal regulatory requirements for very small quantities.

attributes.name: exceptions
attributes.description: Reference to regulatory sections (e.g., 173.###) that provide exceptions or reduced requirements for limited quantities, small quantities, or specific transport modes.

attributes.name: forbidden_cargo_aircraft
attributes.description: Indicates whether transport of this material on cargo-only aircraft is prohibited under any circumstances.

attributes.name: forbidden_passenger_aircraft
attributes.description: Indicates whether transport of this material on passenger-carrying aircraft is prohibited under any circumstances.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Primary hazard class or division (1-9) assigned to the material based on its predominant hazard. Examples: 1.1 (explosives), 2.1 (flammable gas), 3 (flammable liquid), 4.1 (flammable solid), 5.1 (oxidizer), 6.1 (toxic), 7 (radioactive), 8 (corrosive), 9 (miscellaneous).

attributes.name: hazard_division
attributes.description: Subdivision within a hazard class that further categorizes the material by specific hazard characteristics (e.g., 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 6.1). May be null for classes without divisions.

attributes.name: inhalation_hazard_zone
attributes.description: For materials that are poisonous by inhalation, the hazard zone (A, B, C, or D) indicating the degree of inhalation toxicity. Zone A is the most toxic.

attributes.name: label_code
attributes.description: Code(s) identifying the required hazard warning label(s) that must be affixed to packages. Multiple labels may be required for materials with subsidiary hazards. Examples: 3 (flammable liquid), 6.1 (poison), 8 (corrosive).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this classification record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is eligible for limited quantity exceptions, which allow reduced packaging, marking, and labeling requirements when transported in small quantities.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_max_net
attributes.description: Maximum net quantity per inner receptacle or article permitted under limited quantity provisions. Expressed as weight or volume.

attributes.name: marine_pollutant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is designated as a marine pollutant under DOT and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code regulations. Requires special marking and handling for water transport.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to this classification entry. May include references to specific regulatory amendments or interpretations.

attributes.name: packaging_authorizations
attributes.description: Codes referencing the authorized packaging sections (e.g., 173.###) that specify which container types and specifications are approved for this material.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Degree of danger presented by the material during transport. I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Used to determine packaging requirements and quantity limits.

attributes.name: passenger_aircraft_quantity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum net quantity per package permitted on passenger-carrying aircraft. May be expressed as weight (kg), volume (L), or 'Forbidden' if not permitted.

attributes.name: placard_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific placard design required for the transport vehicle. Examples: FLAMMABLE, CORROSIVE, POISON, OXIDIZER, DANGEROUS.

attributes.name: placard_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether placards must be displayed on the transport vehicle for this material when transported in specified quantities.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: The official DOT-approved name used to describe the hazardous material on shipping papers, manifests, and labels. Must match the Hazardous Materials Table entry exactly.

attributes.name: reportable_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: The threshold quantity (in pounds) at or above which a spill or release of this material must be reported to the National Response Center under CERCLA. Null if no RQ applies.

attributes.name: severe_marine_pollutant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as a severe marine pollutant (PP designation) requiring enhanced environmental protection measures during marine transport.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special provision codes (e.g., B1, IB2, T4, TP1) that impose additional requirements or grant exceptions for packaging, handling, or transport of this material.

attributes.name: subsidiary_hazard_class
attributes.description: Secondary hazard class(es) for materials that present more than one type of hazard. Multiple subsidiary classes may be listed, separated by commas.

attributes.name: superseded_by_un_na_number
attributes.description: If this classification has been superseded, the UN/NA number of the replacement classification entry. Null if status is active.

attributes.name: technical_name_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technical or chemical name of the hazardous constituent(s) must be entered in parentheses after the proper shipping name on shipping papers.

attributes.name: un_na_number
attributes.description: Four-digit identification number assigned by the United Nations or North America to hazardous materials for international and domestic transport. Format: UN#### or NA####.

attributes.name: vessel_stowage_location
attributes.description: Code indicating where the material must be stowed on a vessel (e.g., A = on deck only, B = under deck, C = on or under deck). Applies to marine transport.

attributes.name: vessel_stowage_other
attributes.description: Additional stowage requirements or restrictions for marine transport, such as segregation from other materials, ventilation requirements, or temperature controls.

products.name: storage_unit
products.description: Master record for permitted hazardous waste storage units at generator sites or TSDFs. Captures unit ID, unit type (satellite accumulation area, 90-day accumulation area, permitted storage tank, container storage building, drip pad, containment building), physical location, maximum permitted capacity (gallons/lbs), secondary containment type, inspection frequency requirement, permit or exemption basis, current inventory quantity, and unit status (active, closed, under inspection). Supports RCRA storage time limit tracking.

attributes.name: storage_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste storage unit. Primary key for the storage unit master record.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TSDF facility or generator site where this storage unit is located. Links to the facility master record for site-level attributes.

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_generator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hazardous waste generator that operates this storage unit. Applicable when the unit is at a generator site rather than a TSDF.

attributes.name: lockout_tagout_procedure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.lockout_tagout_procedure. Business justification: Hazmat storage units with mechanical/electrical systems (ventilation, pumps, alarms, temperature control) require LOTO procedures for maintenance and repair. OSHA 1910.147 compliance mandate linking h

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Storage units operate under facility permit with specific conditions (40 CFR 264/265 Subpart I). Permit defines storage capacity, waste codes, and time limits. Required for permit compliance verificat

attributes.name: building_location
attributes.description: Physical building or structure identifier where the storage unit is located within the facility campus.

attributes.name: closure_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification number issued by regulatory authority confirming that the storage unit closure was completed in accordance with RCRA requirements.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage unit was permanently closed and decommissioned. Applicable for units that have completed RCRA closure procedures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage unit record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: current_inventory_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of hazardous waste stored in the unit at the time of last inventory update. Measured in the unit of measure specified for this storage unit.

attributes.name: emergency_response_zone
attributes.description: Emergency response zone designation for this storage unit within the facility emergency action plan. Used for HAZWOPER response coordination.

attributes.name: exemption_basis
attributes.description: Regulatory basis under which this storage unit operates without a full RCRA permit. Identifies the specific exemption category that applies.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed to protect the storage unit. Required for certain hazardous waste storage configurations.
attributes.references: NFPA Fire Protection Standards, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the storage unit location in decimal degrees format for spatial tracking and emergency response.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the storage unit location in decimal degrees format for spatial tracking and emergency response.

attributes.name: incompatible_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA waste codes that must not be stored in this unit due to incompatibility concerns. Used to prevent dangerous chemical reactions.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Required frequency for routine inspections of the storage unit measured in days. Satellite accumulation areas require weekly inspections; 90-day areas require daily inspections per RCRA.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage unit was installed and commissioned for use. Used for tracking unit age and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: inventory_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used for tracking inventory quantity in this storage unit. Must align with the capacity measurement unit.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent routine inspection performed on this storage unit. Used to track compliance with inspection frequency requirements.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage capacity of the unit measured in gallons. Applicable for liquid waste storage tanks and container storage areas. Regulatory limit that must not be exceeded.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_pounds
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage capacity of the unit measured in pounds. Applicable for solid waste storage areas and satellite accumulation points. Regulatory limit that must not be exceeded.

attributes.name: maximum_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for safe storage of waste in this unit. Applicable when temperature control is required.

attributes.name: minimum_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for safe storage of waste in this unit. Applicable when temperature control is required.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage unit record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes to unit configuration or status.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date when the next routine inspection is required based on inspection frequency. Used for compliance scheduling and alerts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or historical information about the storage unit.

attributes.name: permitted_waste_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) Permitted Waste Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes that are authorized for storage in this unit. Restricts the types of waste that may be placed in the unit.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Description of personal protective equipment required for personnel working in or inspecting this storage unit. Based on hazard assessment of stored wastes.

attributes.name: room_area_designation
attributes.description: Specific room number, area code, or zone designation within the building for precise location identification.

attributes.name: secondary_containment_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Volume capacity of the secondary containment system in gallons. Must meet or exceed 110% of the largest container or 10% of total stored volume per RCRA requirements.

attributes.name: secondary_containment_type
attributes.description: Type of secondary containment system installed to prevent environmental release in case of primary container failure. Required for most hazardous waste storage units under RCRA.

attributes.name: storage_time_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days that hazardous waste may be stored in this unit before shipment is required. Varies by unit type: satellite accumulation has no time limit until 55 gallons accumulated; 90-day areas have 90-day limit.

attributes.name: temperature_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage unit requires active temperature control to maintain waste stability and prevent hazardous conditions. True for temperature-sensitive wastes.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation for the storage unit, used by facility personnel for identification and communication.

attributes.name: unit_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage unit, used in facility documentation, permits, and operational tracking. Externally visible unit designation.

attributes.name: unit_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage unit in its lifecycle. Active units are available for waste storage; inactive units are temporarily out of service; closed units have completed closure procedures.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage unit based on RCRA regulatory categories. Determines applicable storage time limits, capacity restrictions, and operational requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: satellite_accumulation_area|90_day_accumulation_area|permitted_storage_tank|container_storage_building|drip_pad|containment_building|less_than_90_day_area — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ventilation_system_type
attributes.description: Type of ventilation system installed to control vapor accumulation and maintain air quality in the storage area. Required for volatile hazardous waste storage.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106, EPA Air Quality Standards

products.name: storage_unit_inspection
products.description: Periodic inspection record for hazardous waste storage units and container storage areas as required by RCRA regulations (weekly for LQGs, daily for permitted storage). Captures inspection date, inspector name and certification, unit inspected, checklist items (container condition, labeling, secondary containment integrity, aisle space, emergency equipment), deficiencies noted, corrective actions required, and sign-off status. Sourced from Enviance EHS inspection module.

attributes.name: storage_unit_inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste storage unit inspection record.

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: Storage unit inspections (40 CFR 264.15, 264.174) ARE compliance inspections. Links hazmat-specific inspection details to general inspection tracking for findings management, corrective actions, and r

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the inspector who conducted the inspection.

attributes.name: storage_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hazardous waste storage unit or container storage area being inspected.

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Facility ID
attributes.description: Reference to the TSDF facility where the storage unit is located.

attributes.name: aisle_space_adequate
attributes.description: Indicates whether aisle space allows unobstructed movement of personnel and emergency equipment for inspection and emergency response, typically requiring minimum 2-foot clearance.

attributes.name: aisle_space_notes
attributes.description: Details regarding aisle space adequacy, including measurements and any obstructions that impede access or emergency response.

attributes.name: container_closure_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all containers are properly closed except when adding or removing waste, as required to prevent emissions and spills.

attributes.name: container_closure_notes
attributes.description: Observations regarding container closure practices, including any open containers, damaged lids, or improper sealing.

attributes.name: container_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed observations regarding the physical condition of containers, including any signs of damage, corrosion, leakage, or deterioration.

attributes.name: container_condition_pass
attributes.description: Indicates whether containers were found to be in good condition without signs of leakage, corrosion, bulging, or structural deterioration.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date when all required corrective actions were completed and verified.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions required to remediate identified deficiencies and achieve compliance.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which corrective actions must be completed to maintain regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective actions are required to address deficiencies identified during the inspection.

attributes.name: corrective_action_verified_by
attributes.description: Name of the individual who verified completion of corrective actions and confirmed compliance restoration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deficiencies_identified_count
attributes.description: Total number of deficiencies or non-compliance items identified during the inspection.

attributes.name: deficiency_summary
attributes.description: Consolidated summary of all deficiencies noted during the inspection, including specific checklist items that failed and their severity.

attributes.name: emergency_equipment_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether required emergency equipment (spill kits, fire extinguishers, eyewash stations, safety showers, PPE) is present, accessible, and in working order.

attributes.name: emergency_equipment_notes
attributes.description: Observations regarding the availability, condition, and accessibility of emergency response equipment, including any missing or non-functional items.

attributes.name: facility_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility manager who reviewed and signed off on the inspection findings.

attributes.name: incompatible_waste_notes
attributes.description: Details regarding waste segregation practices, including any instances of incompatible materials stored in proximity or inadequate separation measures.

attributes.name: incompatible_waste_separation_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether incompatible wastes are properly separated to prevent reactions, as required by RCRA for reactive, ignitable, and incompatible materials.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: General observations, comments, and additional context captured during the inspection that do not fit into specific checklist categories.

attributes.name: inspection_signed_off
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection has been formally signed off by the inspector and facility manager, confirming review and acceptance of findings.

attributes.name: inspector_certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the inspector's certification expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or license number for the inspector demonstrating qualification to perform hazardous waste inspections.

attributes.name: inspector_certification_type
attributes.description: Type of certification held by the inspector, such as HAZWOPER 40-hour, RCRA Inspector, or facility-specific training credentials.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who performed the inspection.

attributes.name: labeling_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all containers are properly labeled with waste description, hazard class, accumulation start date, and EPA waste codes as required by RCRA.

attributes.name: labeling_deficiency_notes
attributes.description: Description of any labeling deficiencies found, such as missing labels, illegible text, incorrect waste codes, or missing accumulation start dates.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: overall_inspection_result
attributes.description: Summary result of the inspection indicating whether the storage unit meets all regulatory requirements or requires corrective action.

attributes.name: secondary_containment_integrity_pass
attributes.description: Indicates whether secondary containment systems (berms, dikes, spill pallets) are intact, free of cracks, and capable of containing 110% of the largest container volume.

attributes.name: secondary_containment_notes
attributes.description: Observations regarding the condition and adequacy of secondary containment, including any cracks, liquid accumulation, or capacity concerns.

attributes.name: sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection was formally signed off and approved.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of inspection, relevant for outdoor storage areas where precipitation or temperature may affect container integrity.

products.name: transporter_registration
products.description: Master record for EPA-registered hazardous waste transporters authorized to transport waste on behalf of Waste Management. Captures transporter EPA ID, company name, DOT operating authority number, state transporter permits, insurance certificate details, vehicle types authorized, waste types authorized, HAZMAT employee training compliance status, and approval status for use on manifests. Distinct from the fleet domain's vehicle records — this is the regulatory transporter entity identity.
products.reference: EPA Hazardous Waste Transporter Registration / DOT Operating Authority

attributes.name: transporter_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste transporter registration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: epa_id_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: Hazardous waste transporters must be EPA-registered. The epa_id_number string duplicates epa_id_registration data. Adding FK normalizes this relationship and provides a third inbound link to epa_id_re

attributes.name: hauling_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.hauling_agreement. Business justification: Registered hazmat transporters operate under hauling agreements defining routes, rates, insurance requirements, DOT compliance. Transporter assignment validates active agreement, insurance coverage, a

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Registered transporters are vendors for transportation services. Waste Management operations require linking transporter registrations to vendor master data for contract management, payment processing

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the transporter was approved for use by Waste Management for hazardous waste transportation services.

attributes.name: approved_for_manifest_use
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transporter is currently approved for use on hazardous waste manifests. False indicates transporter cannot be selected for new shipments.

attributes.name: authorized_dot_hazard_classes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorized Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazard Classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of DOT hazard classes (1-9) that the transporter is authorized to transport based on DOT operating authority and vehicle placarding.

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle types the transporter is authorized and equipped to operate for hazardous waste transport (e.g., tanker truck, box truck, flatbed, roll-off, vacuum truck).
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 177 - DOT Carriage by Public Highway

attributes.name: authorized_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) that the transporter is authorized and equipped to handle based on permits, equipment, and training.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 - Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company providing cargo insurance coverage for hazardous waste in transit.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total cargo insurance coverage amount in USD for hazardous waste shipments in transit.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current cargo insurance policy expires. Transporter must maintain continuous coverage to remain approved.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the cargo insurance coverage protecting hazardous waste shipments in transit.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the transporter company headquarters or principal place of business is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the transporter company headquarters. Typically USA for domestic transporters.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transporter registration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dot_operating_authority_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Operating Authority Number
attributes.description: DOT motor carrier operating authority number (MC, FF, or MX number) required for interstate hazardous materials transportation. Format: MC-XXXXXX or FF-XXXXXX.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 107 - DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the 24/7 emergency response contact at the transporter company for incident response and HAZWOPER coordination.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 emergency phone number for incident response and spill coordination. Must be monitored at all times during transport operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the transporter registration expires and must be renewed. Null for indefinite registrations subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: hazmat_employee_training_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Employee Training Compliance Status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the transporters HAZMAT employee training program per DOT HMR requirements. All drivers and handlers must receive training every 3 years.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart H - Training Requirements

attributes.name: hazmat_training_last_verified_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Training Last Verified Date
attributes.description: Date when Waste Management last verified that the transporter maintains compliant HAZMAT employee training records and certifications.

products.name: transporter_service_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization contract between a hazardous waste transporter and a service area. It captures the regulatory and operational authorization for a specific transporter to operate within a specific geographic service territory. Each record links one transporter_registration to one service_area with authorization status, effective dates, service level agreements, and rate schedules that exist only in the context of this transporter-area relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, a single hazardous waste transporter can be authorized to operate across multiple geographic service areas (different municipalities, counties, or franchise territories), and each service area requires authorization from multiple transporters to ensure operational redundancy, competitive pricing, and service continuity. The business actively manages these authorizations as regulatory compliance artifacts, tracking authorization status, effective dates, service level agreements, and area-specific rate schedules for each transporter-area combination.
