attributes.references: EPA Renewable Energy Standards, FERC Energy Classification

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_officer
attributes.description: Name of the designated environmental compliance officer responsible for regulatory adherence and permit compliance at the facility.
attributes.references: EPA Responsible Official Requirements, OSHA Safety Management

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the WTE facility. Used in operational systems, regulatory filings, and inter-system communication.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the Waste-to-Energy facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in public communications.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Primary technology classification for waste-to-energy conversion process. Mass-burn combusts unsorted MSW; RDF uses preprocessed fuel; gasification/pyrolysis are thermal conversion; anaerobic digestion produces biogas; LFG-to-energy captures landfill methane.
attributes.references: EPA WTE Technology Classification, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: ghg_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is subject to EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP) due to emissions exceeding 25,000 metric tons CO2e annually.

attributes.name: grid_interconnection_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Voltage level in kilovolts at which the facility connects to the electrical grid. Determines transmission infrastructure requirements and interconnection agreements.
attributes.references: IEEE Grid Interconnection Standards, FERC Interconnection Procedures

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility has achieved ISO 14001 certification for environmental management systems. Demonstrates commitment to systematic environmental performance improvement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_permit_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent environmental permit renewal or modification. Used to track permit compliance cycles and upcoming renewal deadlines.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Renewal Requirements, State Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the WTE facility in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, proximity analysis, and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the WTE facility in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, proximity analysis, and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: nameplate_electrical_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Maximum electrical power generation capacity in megawatts under optimal operating conditions. Used for grid interconnection agreements and renewable energy credit calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE Power Generation Standards, FERC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: next_permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when current environmental permits expire and require renewal. Critical for compliance planning and operational continuity.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Renewal Requirements, State Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WTE facility. Operational indicates active energy generation; standby is ready but not producing; maintenance is temporary shutdown; decommissioned is permanently closed.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, EPA Facility Status Codes

attributes.name: permitted_capacity_tpd
attributes.description: Maximum daily waste processing capacity in tons per day as authorized by environmental permits. Regulatory limit for waste intake volume.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Permit Conditions, State Solid Waste Permits

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the WTE facility location. Used for geographic analysis and service territory mapping.

attributes.name: power_purchase_agreement_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility operates under an active power purchase agreement with a utility or off-taker for electricity sales.

attributes.name: rec_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility qualifies for renewable energy credits under state or federal renewable portfolio standards. True if eligible for REC generation.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Energy Tracking Systems, State RPS Programs

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority governing the WTE facility. Federal for EPA-direct oversight; state for delegated programs; local for municipal authority; tribal for sovereign nation lands.
attributes.references: EPA Regulatory Jurisdiction Framework, RCRA State Authorization

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the WTE facility is located. Determines state-level environmental regulations and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 (US State Codes), EPA State Jurisdiction Codes

attributes.name: steam_output_capacity_klb_per_hr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Steam Output Capacity Thousand Pounds Per Hour (klb/hr)
attributes.description: Maximum steam production capacity in thousand pounds per hour for facilities producing process steam or district heating. Relevant for combined heat and power (CHP) operations.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: turbine_generator_count
attributes.description: Number of steam turbine generators installed for electricity production. Relevant for power generation capacity and reliability analysis.

attributes.name: waste_feedstock_types
attributes.description: Types of waste materials accepted as fuel for energy conversion. Common types include MSW, C&D, SRF, biosolids, medical waste, industrial waste. Comma-separated list.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Classification Standards, RCRA Subtitle D

products.name: boiler_unit
products.description: Master record for each combustion boiler unit within a WTE facility. Tracks boiler unit number, manufacturer, model, design capacity (TPD MSW), steam generation rate (klb/hr), operating pressure (psi), operating temperature (°F), grate type (reciprocating, roller, vibrating), installation date, last major overhaul date, current operational status, and associated facility. Supports boiler performance trending and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the combustion boiler unit within the WTE facility. Primary key for the boiler unit master record.

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_source. Business justification: Each boiler unit is a discrete emission source for GHG inventory and air quality compliance. EPA requires unit-level emission tracking for Part 75 and GHGRP reporting. Links combustion equipment to su

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WTE facility where this boiler unit is installed. Links to the facility master record.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fixed_asset. Business justification: Boilers are major capital assets requiring depreciation tracking, insurance valuation, warranty management, and maintenance scheduling in EAM systems. Financial reporting and capital project cost allo

attributes.name: acquisition_cost_usd
attributes.description: Original purchase and installation cost of the boiler unit in US dollars. Used for capitalization, depreciation calculations, and ROI analysis. Confidential financial data.

attributes.name: annual_operating_hours
attributes.description: Total operating hours per year for the boiler unit. Used for capacity factor calculations, maintenance scheduling, and regulatory reporting. Typical WTE facilities operate 8000+ hours annually.

attributes.name: ash_handling_system
attributes.description: Type of ash removal and handling system. Wet systems use water sluicing, dry systems use conveyors, pneumatic uses air transport, mechanical uses augers or drag chains. Impacts residue management and disposal.
attributes.references: EPA Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA)

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Internal asset management tag or barcode identifier for the boiler unit. Used for fixed asset tracking, depreciation, and physical inventory audits.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current availability status for dispatch and operations. Available means ready for full operation, unavailable means offline, limited means operating at reduced capacity, testing means undergoing performance or compliance testing.

attributes.name: boiler_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Thermal efficiency of the boiler unit expressed as a percentage. Calculated as energy output (steam) divided by energy input (waste fuel). Monitored for performance optimization and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: boiler_type
attributes.description: Classification of the boiler combustion technology. Mass burn processes unsorted MSW, RDF uses preprocessed fuel, modular is smaller capacity, fluidized bed uses sand bed, stoker uses mechanical grates.

attributes.name: combustion_control_system
attributes.description: Type or model of the automated combustion control system (e.g., DCS, PLC) used to optimize air-fuel ratio, temperature, and emissions. Critical for EPA compliance and efficiency.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the boiler unit was officially placed into commercial operation after successful testing and acceptance. Marks the start of warranty and operational life.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this boiler unit record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: cumulative_operating_hours
attributes.description: Total lifetime operating hours since commissioning. Critical for predictive maintenance, remaining useful life estimation, and major overhaul planning.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to depreciate the boiler unit asset. Straight line spreads cost evenly, declining balance accelerates early depreciation, units of production bases on usage.

attributes.name: design_capacity_tpd
attributes.description: Rated design capacity of the boiler unit measured in tons per day (TPD) of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) that can be processed. Key metric for facility throughput planning.
attributes.references: EPA Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA)

attributes.name: emissions_control_technology
attributes.description: Description of the air pollution control equipment installed (e.g., electrostatic precipitator, baghouse, scrubber, selective catalytic reduction). Required for CAA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: grate_type
attributes.description: Type of mechanical grate system used for waste combustion. Reciprocating grates move back and forth, roller grates use rotating cylinders, vibrating grates shake waste, traveling grates move continuously.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: greenhouse_gas_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the boiler unit is subject to EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP) requirements. Facilities emitting 25,000+ metric tons CO2e annually must report.

attributes.name: heat_rate_btu_per_kwh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heat Rate British Thermal Units Per Kilowatt-Hour (BTU/kWh)
attributes.description: Heat rate of the boiler-turbine system measured in BTU per kilowatt-hour. Lower values indicate higher efficiency. Key metric for energy conversion performance and benchmarking.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the boiler unit was originally installed and commissioned at the facility. Used for age-based maintenance planning and depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the boiler and machinery insurance coverage. Covers equipment breakdown, business interruption, and liability. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or insurance inspection of the boiler unit. ASME and state boiler inspections are typically required annually or biennially.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or refurbishment of the boiler unit. Major overhauls typically include refractory replacement, tube bundle replacement, and grate system rebuild.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this boiler unit record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and supports change auditing for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the boiler unit (e.g., Babcock & Wilcox, Covanta, Martin GmbH).
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: maximum_continuous_rating_mw
attributes.description: Maximum continuous electrical output capacity in megawatts (MW) when the boiler operates at full design capacity. Used for grid interconnection and revenue calculations.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation for the boiler unit. Used for parts procurement and technical documentation reference.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required regulatory or insurance inspection. Missing inspection deadlines can result in operating permit violations and forced shutdowns.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: next_scheduled_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next major overhaul based on manufacturer recommendations, operating hours, and regulatory inspection requirements.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or historical information about the boiler unit. Used for knowledge transfer and operational context.

attributes.name: operating_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Pressure Pounds Per Square Inch (psi)
attributes.description: Normal operating steam pressure of the boiler measured in pounds per square inch (psi). Critical safety and performance parameter monitored continuously.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: operating_temperature_f
attributes.description: Normal operating steam temperature of the boiler measured in degrees Fahrenheit. Monitored for efficiency and safety compliance.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the boiler unit. Operational means actively processing waste, standby is ready but not running, maintenance is planned downtime, outage is unplanned downtime, decommissioned is permanently retired, startup is initial commissioning phase.

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current air quality operating permit. Facilities must renew permits before expiration to maintain legal operation.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: EPA or state-issued air quality operating permit number for the boiler unit. Required for CAA Title V compliance and emissions monitoring reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V

attributes.name: renewable_energy_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the boiler unit qualifies for Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) under state or federal renewable portfolio standards. Eligibility depends on fuel source classification and technology type.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for the boiler unit. Unique identifier for warranty, service history, and regulatory tracking.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: steam_generation_rate_klb_per_hr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Steam Generation Rate Thousand Pounds Per Hour (klb/hr)
attributes.description: Rated steam generation capacity of the boiler measured in thousand pounds per hour (klb/hr). Critical for energy output calculations and turbine sizing.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: unit_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the boiler unit, typically assigned by the facility (e.g., 'Boiler-1', 'Unit-A'). Used for operational communication and work orders.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the boiler unit in years for depreciation and capital planning purposes. Typical WTE boilers have 25-30 year useful lives with major overhauls.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty coverage expires. After expiration, all maintenance and repair costs are borne by the facility owner.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

products.name: turbine_generator
products.description: Master record for each steam turbine-generator set at a WTE or LFG-to-energy facility. Captures turbine manufacturer, model, rated capacity (MW), generator voltage (kV), power factor, installation date, last major inspection date, operational status, interconnection agreement reference, and utility offtake meter point ID. Enables turbine performance benchmarking and capacity reporting.

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the turbine-generator set. Primary key for this master resource entity.

attributes.name: air_quality_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Turbine generators require air quality permits for emissions and grid interconnection permits. Links generator to air permit for emissions monitoring, permit compliance verification, and regulatory in

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Turbine generators are driven by steam from specific boiler units. This is a fundamental operational relationship in WTE facilities - each turbine receives steam from a specific boiler. The FK establi

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fixed_asset. Business justification: Turbine generators are high-value capital equipment requiring fixed asset tracking for depreciation calculations, insurance coverage, asset retirement planning, and capital expenditure reporting. Esse

attributes.name: primary_turbine_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WTE (Waste-to-Energy) or LFG-to-energy facility where this turbine-generator set is installed.

attributes.name: annual_operating_hours_target
attributes.description: Target number of operating hours per year for this turbine-generator set, used for capacity planning and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset identification tag assigned to this turbine-generator set for tracking and maintenance purposes.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the turbine-generator set successfully completed commissioning tests and was placed into commercial operation.

attributes.name: cooling_system_type
attributes.description: Type of cooling system used for the generator windings and bearings (air-cooled, water-cooled, hydrogen-cooled, or hybrid).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turbine-generator record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_operating_hours
attributes.description: Total accumulated operating hours since commissioning, used to track equipment lifecycle and schedule maintenance intervals.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the turbine-generator set was permanently taken out of service and decommissioned. Null if still in service.

attributes.name: emissions_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this turbine-generator is subject to continuous emissions monitoring system (CEMS) requirements under EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: Electrical frequency of the generator output in hertz (Hz). Standard values are 60 Hz in North America and 50 Hz in most other regions.

attributes.name: fuel_source_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel source driving this turbine-generator: MSW (Municipal Solid Waste) combustion, LFG (Landfill Gas), biogas, SRF (Solid Recovered Fuel), RNG (Renewable Natural Gas), or mixed sources.

attributes.name: generator_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Rated output voltage of the generator in kilovolts (kV), typically the voltage at which power is delivered to the step-up transformer or grid interconnection point.

attributes.name: grid_interconnection_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Voltage level at which this turbine-generator interconnects to the utility grid after step-up transformation, measured in kilovolts (kV).
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnecting Distributed Resources with Electric Power Systems

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the turbine-generator set was originally installed and commissioned at the facility.

attributes.name: interconnection_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the utility interconnection agreement governing the connection of this generator to the electrical grid.

attributes.name: last_major_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major inspection or overhaul of the turbine-generator set, typically involving disassembly and detailed component examination.
attributes.references: ASME PTC 6 Steam Turbines Performance Test Codes

attributes.name: maintenance_contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the long-term service agreement (LTSA) or maintenance contract covering this turbine-generator set.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the turbine-generator set (e.g., General Electric, Siemens, Mitsubishi).

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model designation for this turbine-generator set, used for parts procurement and technical specifications.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next major inspection or overhaul based on manufacturer recommendations and operational hours.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special configurations, or historical information about this turbine-generator set.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the turbine-generator set indicating whether it is actively generating power, on standby, undergoing maintenance, or decommissioned.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Rated power factor of the generator, representing the ratio of real power to apparent power. Typically expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.85 or 0.90).
attributes.references: IEEE 115 Guide for Test Procedures for Synchronous Machines

attributes.name: rated_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Nameplate electrical generation capacity of the turbine-generator set measured in megawatts (MW). This is the maximum continuous power output under design conditions.
attributes.references: IEEE 115 Guide for Test Procedures for Synchronous Machines

attributes.name: rec_tracking_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: REC (Renewable Energy Credit) Tracking System ID
attributes.description: Identifier for this generator in the regional REC tracking system (e.g., M-RETS, WREGIS, PJM-GATS) used to issue and track renewable energy credits.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether electricity generated by this turbine-generator set qualifies for Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) under applicable state or federal renewable energy programs.

attributes.name: scada_system_tag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) System Tag
attributes.description: Tag identifier used in the facility's SCADA system to monitor and control this turbine-generator set in real-time.
attributes.references: IEC 61850 Communication Networks and Systems for Power Utility Automation

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific turbine-generator unit.

attributes.name: steam_inlet_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Steam Inlet Pressure (PSI - Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Design steam inlet pressure at the turbine inlet in pounds per square inch (PSI). Applicable to steam turbines in WTE facilities.
attributes.references: ASME PTC 6 Steam Turbines Performance Test Codes

attributes.name: steam_inlet_temperature_f
attributes.description: Design steam inlet temperature at the turbine inlet in degrees Fahrenheit. Applicable to steam turbines in WTE facilities.
attributes.references: ASME PTC 6 Steam Turbines Performance Test Codes

attributes.name: turbine_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Design thermal efficiency of the turbine expressed as a percentage, representing the ratio of electrical output to thermal input energy.
attributes.references: ASME PTC 6 Steam Turbines Performance Test Codes

attributes.name: turbine_type
attributes.description: Classification of the turbine technology used in this generator set. Steam turbines are common in WTE facilities; gas turbines and biogas turbines are used in LFG-to-energy projects.
attributes.references: ASME PTC 6 Steam Turbines Performance Test Codes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this turbine-generator record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: utility_offtake_meter_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the revenue-grade meter that measures electrical energy delivered from this turbine-generator to the utility grid or internal distribution system.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer's warranty coverage for this turbine-generator set expires.

products.name: lfg_collection_system
products.description: Master record for each Landfill Gas (LFG) collection and control system (GCCS) at a landfill site. Stores system ID, associated landfill site, total extraction well count, blower/flare station count, design flow capacity (scfm), current operational status, NSPS Subpart WWW permit reference, installation date, and whether the system feeds a beneficial use project (LFG-to-RNG, LFG-to-electricity). SSOT for LFG infrastructure identity.
products.reference: GCCS — Gas Collection and Control System

attributes.name: lfg_collection_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the landfill gas collection and control system (GCCS). Primary key for the LFG collection system master record.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: LFG collection systems often operate under gas rights agreements with landfill owners or third-party energy developers. These contracts govern gas extraction rights, revenue sharing, and beneficial us

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_source. Business justification: LFG collection systems are both fugitive emission sources (uncaptured methane) and emission reduction assets (captured methane avoids atmospheric release). Required for EPA Subpart HH reporting and ca

attributes.name: energy_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated waste-to-energy or LFG-to-energy project that utilizes gas from this collection system. Null if gas is flared only.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fixed_asset. Business justification: LFG collection systems are major capital installations (wells, headers, blowers) requiring asset tracking for depreciation, capital cost allocation, and lifecycle management. Financial reporting and c

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the landfill site where this LFG collection system is installed. Links to the facility master record.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: LFG collection systems operate under NSPS Subpart WWW permits (explicitly referenced in attributes). Links system to permit for NSPS compliance tracking, permit condition monitoring, and regulatory re

attributes.name: annual_operating_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated annual operating and maintenance cost in USD for the LFG collection system, including electricity, labor, and parts.

attributes.name: beneficial_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collected LFG is used for beneficial purposes such as electricity generation, renewable natural gas production, or direct thermal use (True) or is flared for destruction only (False).

attributes.name: beneficial_use_type
attributes.description: Classification of how collected LFG is utilized: conversion to electricity (LFG-to-electricity), processing to renewable natural gas (LFG-to-RNG), direct thermal use, medium-BTU gas production, or flare-only destruction.

attributes.name: blower_station_count
attributes.description: Number of blower stations that create negative pressure to extract landfill gas from the collection wells.

attributes.name: capital_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure in USD for the design, procurement, and installation of the LFG collection system.

attributes.name: collection_area_acres
attributes.description: Total landfill area in acres covered by this LFG collection system. Used for system coverage and efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: collection_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of generated landfill gas that is captured by the collection system. Typical range is 75-95% for well-designed active systems.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the LFG collection system was officially commissioned and began operational gas extraction.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the LFG collection system with EPA NSPS Subpart WWW and state/local air quality regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LFG collection system record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the LFG collection system was permanently decommissioned and removed from service. Null for active systems.

attributes.name: design_engineer
attributes.description: Name of the engineering firm or professional engineer responsible for the system design and specifications.

attributes.name: design_flow_capacity_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Flow Capacity (Standard Cubic Feet per Minute)
attributes.description: Maximum design flow capacity of the LFG collection system measured in standard cubic feet per minute (scfm). Represents the engineered extraction capacity.

attributes.name: estimated_methane_generation_rate_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Methane Generation Rate (Standard Cubic Feet per Minute)
attributes.description: Estimated methane generation rate from the waste mass in the collection area, measured in standard cubic feet per minute. Based on EPA LandGEM or similar modeling.

attributes.name: flare_station_count
attributes.description: Number of flare stations used to combust collected LFG when beneficial use is not available or during maintenance periods.

attributes.name: header_pipe_diameter_inches
attributes.description: Primary diameter of the header piping system in inches. Larger diameters support higher flow capacity.

attributes.name: header_pipe_length_feet
attributes.description: Total length of header piping in feet that conveys collected gas from extraction wells to the blower or flare station.

attributes.name: horizontal_well_count
attributes.description: Number of horizontal extraction wells in the collection system. Horizontal wells are typically installed during active filling operations.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the LFG collection system was originally installed and commissioned at the landfill site.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or operational inspection of the LFG collection system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LFG collection system record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency_days
attributes.description: Required frequency in days for routine monitoring of the LFG collection system per regulatory requirements. Typically quarterly (90 days) or monthly (30 days).
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart WWW Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection of the LFG collection system based on regulatory monitoring frequency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or historical information about the LFG collection system.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the LFG collection system in its lifecycle. Determines whether the system is actively collecting gas.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Collection and Control System (GCCS) Code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the LFG collection system. Used in operational reporting and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: system_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or primary contractor that designed and installed the LFG collection system.

attributes.name: system_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the landfill gas collection system for operational identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gas collection system based on extraction method: active extraction (blower-driven), passive venting (natural pressure), or hybrid (combination).
attributes.references: SWANA Landfill Gas Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: total_extraction_well_count
attributes.description: Total number of vertical and horizontal extraction wells installed in the LFG collection system. Used for system capacity and coverage analysis.

attributes.name: vertical_well_count
attributes.description: Number of vertical extraction wells in the collection system. Vertical wells are typically installed in closed or capped landfill areas.

attributes.name: waste_in_place_tons
attributes.description: Estimated total tons of municipal solid waste in place within the collection system coverage area. Used for gas generation potential modeling.

products.name: rng_processing_unit
products.description: Master record for each Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) processing and upgrading unit that converts raw LFG to pipeline-quality RNG. attributes.name: stack_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific emissions stack or unit within the facility from which the reading was taken. May correspond to boiler, turbine, or combustion unit identifier.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Stack Identification Requirements

attributes.name: averaging_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the emissions measurement was averaged. Regulatory limits may apply to different averaging periods (e.g., 1-hour, 24-hour, annual).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent calibration or quality assurance test performed on the monitoring equipment prior to this reading. EPA regulations require regular calibration and QA testing of CEMS equipment.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 75 Appendix B - Quality Assurance and Quality Control Procedures

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, notes, or explanations related to this emissions reading. May include information about operational conditions, equipment issues, weather impacts, or other factors affecting emissions.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emissions reading is within permitted limits. Non-compliant or exceedance readings trigger regulatory reporting and corrective action requirements under the Clean Air Act (CAA).
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Compliance and Enforcement

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measured concentration. Common units include parts per million (ppm), milligrams per dry standard cubic meter (mg/dscm), nanograms per dry standard cubic meter (ng/dscm), micrograms per dry standard cubic meter (ug/dscm), or pounds per million British thermal units (lb/MMBtu).
attributes.references: EPA CEMS Reporting Requirements - 40 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: control_device_status
attributes.description: Operational status of air pollution control equipment (e.g., scrubbers, baghouses, electrostatic precipitators, selective catalytic reduction systems) at the time of measurement. Control device malfunctions or bypass events may result in elevated emissions and compliance violations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: corrected_concentration
attributes.description: Pollutant concentration corrected to 7% oxygen (O2) reference basis as required by EPA regulations for combustion sources. This normalization allows for consistent comparison across different operating conditions.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this emissions reading record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source of the emissions data. CEMS provides continuous monitoring; stack tests provide periodic verification; predictive models or engineering estimates may be used when direct measurement is not feasible; data substitution follows EPA protocols when CEMS data is unavailable.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 75 - Continuous Emission Monitoring

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reading represents a deviation from permit requirements, operating parameters, or monitoring requirements. Deviations must be reported to regulatory authorities and may trigger enforcement actions.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Deviation Reporting

attributes.name: flow_rate
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of stack gas at the time of measurement, typically measured in dry standard cubic feet per hour (dscfh) or dry standard cubic meters per hour (dscmh). Used to calculate mass emission rates.
attributes.references: EPA Method 2 - Determination of Stack Gas Velocity and Volumetric Flow Rate

attributes.name: flow_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for stack gas flow rate. Common units include dry standard cubic feet per hour (dscfh), dry standard cubic meters per hour (dscmh), actual cubic feet per minute (acfm), or actual cubic meters per hour (acmh).
attributes.references: EPA Method 2 - Determination of Stack Gas Velocity and Volumetric Flow Rate

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel being combusted at the time of measurement. Fuel composition affects emissions profiles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSW|RDF|SRF|LFG|Natural_Gas|Biogas|Coal|Biomass|Mixed — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart Eb - Standards of Performance for Large Municipal Waste Combustors

attributes.name: mass_emission_rate
attributes.description: Calculated mass emission rate of the pollutant, derived from concentration and flow rate. Typically expressed in pounds per hour (lb/hr) or kilograms per hour (kg/hr). Used for permit compliance and annual emission inventory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: mass_emission_rate_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mass Emission Rate Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for mass emission rate. Common units include pounds per hour (lb/hr), kilograms per hour (kg/hr), tons per year (ton/yr), or grams per second (g/sec).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: measured_concentration
attributes.description: Raw measured concentration of the pollutant as captured by the Continuous Emissions Monitoring System (CEMS) or stack test equipment. Units vary by pollutant (ppm, mg/dscm, ng/dscm).
attributes.references: EPA Method 19 - Determination of Sulfur Dioxide Removal Efficiency and Particulate Matter, Sulfur Dioxide, and Nitrogen Oxides Emission Rates

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: EPA-approved method used to capture this emissions reading. CEMS (Continuous Emissions Monitoring System) provides real-time data; EPA reference methods (e.g., Method 5 for particulates, Method 23 for dioxins/furans, Method 29 for metals) are used for periodic stack tests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CEMS|Method_5|Method_23|Method_29|Method_26A|Method_3A|Method_7E|Manual_Stack_Test — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Appendix A - Test Methods

attributes.name: moisture_content
attributes.description: Moisture content of the stack gas expressed as a percentage by volume. Used to convert between wet and dry basis measurements.
attributes.references: EPA Method 4 - Determination of Moisture Content in Stack Gases

attributes.name: operating_load
attributes.description: Operating load of the combustion unit at the time of measurement, expressed as a percentage of maximum rated capacity. Emissions characteristics vary with load, and some permit limits are load-dependent.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: oxygen_percent
attributes.description: Measured oxygen (O2) percentage in the stack gas at the time of reading. Used to calculate corrected concentration values.
attributes.references: EPA Method 3A - Determination of Oxygen and Carbon Dioxide Concentrations in Emissions from Stationary Sources

attributes.name: permit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration or emission rate for this pollutant as specified in the facility's air quality permit issued by the state or EPA. Used to determine compliance status.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Operating Permit Requirements

attributes.name: permit_limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the permit limit. Must be compatible with concentration_unit for compliance comparison. May also include tons per year (tpy) for annual emission limits.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Operating Permit Requirements

attributes.name: pollutant_type
attributes.description: Type of air pollutant measured in this emissions reading. Common pollutants include nitrogen oxides (NOx), sulfur dioxide (SO2), carbon monoxide (CO), hydrogen chloride (HCl), dioxins and furans, mercury (Hg), particulate matter (PM), volatile organic compounds (VOC), lead (Pb), and cadmium (Cd). attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Pollutant List

attributes.name: qa_qc_status
attributes.description: Quality assurance and quality control status of the emissions reading. Indicates whether the data has passed validation checks, failed QA procedures, or was affected by instrument issues. Data substitution may occur per EPA protocols when CEMS data is unavailable.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 75 Appendix B - Quality Assurance and Quality Control Procedures

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the emissions measurement was captured. For CEMS data, this is the end of the averaging period (typically hourly). For stack tests, this is the midpoint of the test run.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 75 - Continuous Emission Monitoring

attributes.name: reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emissions reading must be reported to regulatory agencies (EPA, state environmental quality departments). Exceedances, deviations, and certain periodic reports trigger mandatory reporting under Clean Air Act (CAA) requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: stack_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature of the stack gas at the measurement point, typically in degrees Fahrenheit (°F) or Celsius (°C). Used for flow rate calculations and combustion efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: stack_temperature_unit

attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA Moderated Transaction System (EMTS) Transaction ID
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the EPA EMTS system when the RIN generation event is registered. EMTS is the official EPA system for tracking RIN generation, transfer, and retirement.

attributes.name: epa_company_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Company Registration Number
attributes.description: EPA-issued registration number for the company generating RINs under the Renewable Fuel Standard program. Required for all RIN generation and trading activities.

attributes.name: epa_facility_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Facility Registration Number
attributes.description: EPA-issued registration number for the specific facility producing renewable fuel. Each RNG production facility must be registered with EPA to generate valid RINs.

attributes.name: equivalence_value
attributes.description: EPA-assigned equivalence value for the fuel pathway, used to adjust RIN generation based on the fuels energy content relative to ethanol. Compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) have pathway-specific EVs.

attributes.name: feedstock_type
attributes.description: Type of organic waste feedstock used to produce the biogas that was upgraded to RNG. Common types include MSW landfill gas, separated municipal solid waste biogas, and food waste digestate.
attributes.value_regex: MSW Landfill Gas|Biogas from Separated MSW|Biogas from Wastewater Treatment|Agricultural Waste|Food Waste

attributes.name: generation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RNG was injected into the natural gas pipeline and the RINs were generated. This is the principal business event timestamp for RFS2 compliance.

attributes.name: generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the RNG injection and RIN generation event occurred, used for detailed operational tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: ghg_reduction_percent
attributes.description: Lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions reduction percentage compared to baseline petroleum fuel, as determined by the EPA-approved fuel pathway. Cellulosic biofuels (D3) typically achieve 60%+ reduction.

attributes.name: lcfs_credit_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) Credit Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RNG is eligible for California Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) credits or similar state-level low-carbon fuel programs. RNG from landfills typically qualifies for LCFS credits.

attributes.name: market_value_per_rin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Market Value Per Renewable Identification Number (RIN)
attributes.description: Market trading price per RIN at the time of generation, expressed in US dollars. D3 cellulosic RINs typically command premium prices due to scarcity and higher compliance value.

attributes.name: methane_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of methane (CH4) in the upgraded RNG at the time of pipeline injection. Pipeline-quality RNG typically contains 95-99% methane. Used for energy content calculation and quality verification.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this RIN generation record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RIN generation record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this RIN generation event. Used for operational context and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: pathway_code
attributes.description: EPA-approved fuel pathway code identifying the specific production process and feedstock combination used to produce the RNG. Each pathway has a unique lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions profile.

attributes.name: pipeline_injection_point
attributes.description: Specific location or meter station where the RNG was injected into the natural gas pipeline system. Critical for custody transfer and RIN generation documentation.

attributes.name: pipeline_operator
attributes.description: Name of the natural gas pipeline company or operator that received the RNG injection. Required for RFS2 chain of custody documentation.

attributes.name: qa_qc_passed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Passed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RIN generation event passed all internal quality assurance and quality control checks, including gas quality testing, metering verification, and documentation completeness.

attributes.name: raw_lfg_volume_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Raw Landfill Gas (LFG) Volume in Standard Cubic Feet Per Minute (SCFM)
attributes.description: Volume of raw landfill gas collected and fed into the RNG upgrading system, measured in standard cubic feet per minute. Used for mass balance and efficiency calculations.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RNG generation event is eligible for Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) in addition to RINs. Some jurisdictions allow dual crediting for renewable gas projects.

attributes.name: rin_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of RINs generated from this RNG injection event. Each gallon equivalent of renewable fuel generates one RIN under RFS2.

attributes.name: rin_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RIN. Generated = newly created; Assigned = attached to fuel batch; Separated = detached for trading; Retired = used for compliance; Invalidated = voided due to error or fraud.

attributes.name: rin_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the RIN was generated. RINs are vintage-dated and can only be used for compliance in the year generated or the following year.

attributes.name: rng_volume_gge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Volume in Gasoline Gallon Equivalents (GGE)
attributes.description: Volume of renewable natural gas expressed in gasoline gallon equivalents (GGE), used for RIN quantity calculation under RFS2. One GGE equals approximately 0.1147 MMBtu.

attributes.name: rng_volume_mmbtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Volume in Million British Thermal Units (MMBtu)
attributes.description: Volume of renewable natural gas injected into the pipeline, measured in million British Thermal Units (MMBtu). This is the energy content basis for RIN generation.

attributes.name: total_rin_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Renewable Identification Number (RIN) Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total estimated market value of the RINs generated in this event, calculated as RIN quantity multiplied by market value per RIN. Used for revenue recognition and financial reporting.

attributes.name: upgrading_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Efficiency of the biogas upgrading system in converting raw landfill gas to pipeline-quality RNG, expressed as a percentage of methane recovery. Typical systems achieve 95-98% efficiency.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the RIN generation event was verified by a third-party auditor or internal quality assurance process, confirming compliance with EPA RFS2 requirements.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification or internal quality assurance review for this RIN generation event. Verified RINs are eligible for trading and compliance use.

attributes.name: verifier_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent third-party auditor or verification body that reviewed and validated the RIN generation event for RFS2 compliance.

SSOT for energy revenue contract terms.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_contract. attributes.name: agreement_name

attributes.name: agreement_number

attributes.name: agreement_status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the offtake agreement: Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) for electricity, steam sales for industrial heat, Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) sales, Renewable Energy Credit (REC) sales, capacity agreement, or hybrid multi-product agreement.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled expiration date of the offtake agreement. Null for evergreen or indefinite-term agreements.

attributes.name: contract_start_date

attributes.name: contract_term_years

attributes.name: contracted_volume_unit

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: curtailment_provisions
attributes.description: Description of conditions under which the offtaker may curtail or reduce energy deliveries, including notice requirements and compensation terms.

attributes.name: delivery_obligation_type
attributes.description: Nature of the delivery commitment: firm (guaranteed delivery), as-available (best-effort), interruptible (subject to curtailment), or must-take (buyer obligated to accept all output).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Primary method for resolving disputes arising under this agreement: litigation in courts, binding arbitration, mediation, or good-faith negotiation.

attributes.name: energy_type
attributes.description: Primary energy product sold under this agreement: electricity (MWh), steam (klb or MMBtu), Renewable Natural Gas (RNG in MMBtu), Renewable Energy Credits (RECs), capacity rights, or bundled multi-product.

attributes.name: environmental_attributes_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes transfer of environmental attributes such as carbon offsets, emission reduction credits, or sustainability certifications (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Summary of force majeure provisions that excuse non-performance due to events beyond the parties' control (natural disasters, regulatory changes, grid failures).

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this agreement (e.g., State of New York, Province of Ontario).

attributes.name: interconnection_point
attributes.description: Physical or logical point where energy is delivered to the offtaker, such as substation name, grid node, or pipeline interconnect identifier.

attributes.name: maximum_delivery_limit_percent
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of contracted annual volume that the buyer is obligated to accept, above which the seller may sell excess energy to third parties.

attributes.name: minimum_delivery_commitment_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of contracted annual volume that the seller is obligated to deliver, below which penalties or liquidated damages may apply.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special provisions, or contextual information about the offtake agreement not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the offtaker must remit payment for energy delivered.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller is required to provide a performance bond, letter of credit, or other financial guarantee to secure delivery obligations (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: rec_ownership_clause
attributes.description: Specifies which party retains ownership of Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) generated by the facility: seller retains, buyer receives, shared arrangement, or negotiated per delivery.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement requires approval from a public utility commission, energy regulatory authority, or other governing body (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of regulatory approval process for this agreement, if applicable.

attributes.name: renewable_attribute_transfer
attributes.description: Indicates whether renewable energy attributes (RECs, carbon credits, green tags) are transferred to the buyer (True) or retained by the seller (False).

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Specifies whether and how the agreement may be renewed upon expiration: automatic renewal, mutual consent required, buyer option, seller option, or no renewal provision.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which energy deliveries are invoiced and settled: monthly, quarterly, annual, or per individual delivery.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Summary of conditions under which either party may terminate the agreement early, including notice periods, termination fees, and triggering events.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offtake agreement record was last modified in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

products.name: delivery
products.description: Transactional record of energy deliveries made to offtake counterparties under PPAs or steam sales agreements. Captures delivery period, facility ID, agreement ID, energy type, metered quantity delivered (MWh, klb, MMBtu), scheduled quantity, curtailment volume, delivery point, settlement meter read, and delivery status. Drives utility invoice reconciliation and revenue recognition under Oracle Revenue Management.

attributes.name: delivery_id

attributes.name: invoice_id

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id

attributes.name: offtake_counterparty_id

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Each energy delivery comes from a specific turbine-generator unit. This link enables tracking of actual deliveries by asset, which is critical for settlement, performance analysis, and capacity factor

attributes.name: adjustment_amount

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or reference number provided by the offtake counterparty or grid operator acknowledging receipt of the delivered energy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this delivery record.

attributes.name: curtailment_quantity
attributes.description: Volume of energy curtailed or not delivered due to grid operator instruction, equipment failure, or contractual limitation.

attributes.name: curtailment_reason
attributes.description: Reason for any curtailment of scheduled delivery (e.g., grid operator instruction, equipment outage, contractual limit, low demand).

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the delivery transaction, used in invoicing and settlement reconciliation.

attributes.name: delivery_status

attributes.name: emissions_offset_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of greenhouse gas emissions offsets (in metric tons CO2e) associated with this renewable energy delivery, used for sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: energy_type

attributes.name: meter_read_timestamp

attributes.name: metered_quantity

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue amount for this delivery after all adjustments, used for financial reporting and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: period_end

attributes.name: period_start

attributes.name: point

attributes.name: price_per_unit

attributes.name: quality_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered energy met all quality specifications and certifications required by the PPA or sales agreement (e.g., renewable attributes, emissions standards).

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: Number of Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) generated and transferred with this energy delivery, typically one REC per MWh of renewable electricity.

attributes.name: settlement_meter_number

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery record was last modified, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
