attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The base price per unit of energy under this schedule, expressed in the currency and unit specified. For fixed schedules this is the contract rate; for indexed schedules this may be the floor or reference rate.

attributes.name: capacity_payment_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule includes a separate capacity payment component in addition to energy payments. Relevant for electricity PPAs with capacity markets. True if capacity payments are included, false otherwise.
attributes.references: ISO Capacity Market Rules; PPA Standard Terms

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of commercial arrangement this rate schedule supports. PPA is Power Purchase Agreement for electricity, offtake is long-term gas sales agreement, spot is short-term market sales, utility tariff is regulated rate, and bilateral is negotiated contract.
attributes.references: Energy Contract Standards; ISDA Energy Definitions

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: Name of the buyer or off-taker organization that this rate schedule applies to. The entity purchasing energy under this pricing arrangement.

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the energy buyer. Utility is investor-owned or public utility, industrial is large manufacturing customer, commercial is business customer, aggregator is energy broker/marketer, ISO market is wholesale market participation, and municipal is government entity.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate schedule record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this rate schedule. Typically USD for U.S. operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate schedule becomes active and applicable to energy sales transactions. Start of the rate schedule validity period.

attributes.name: energy_type
attributes.description: Type of energy product covered by this rate schedule. Electricity refers to WTE electrical generation, steam to thermal energy sales, RNG to renewable natural gas from landfill gas processing, LFG to raw landfill gas, and thermal to combined heat products.

attributes.name: environmental_attribute_treatment
attributes.description: Specifies how environmental attributes such as RECs, carbon credits, LCFS credits, and RINs are allocated between buyer and seller under this rate schedule. Bundled means attributes transfer with energy, unbundled means sold separately, seller/buyer retains indicates which party keeps the attributes, and shared indicates negotiated split.
attributes.references: EPA REC Guidance; LCFS Regulations; RFS RIN Standards

attributes.name: escalation_mechanism
attributes.description: Method by which the rate schedule adjusts over time. CPI ties to Consumer Price Index, fixed percent applies a contractual annual increase, market indexed follows commodity or power market indices, negotiated annual requires bilateral agreement each period, and none indicates a flat rate for the contract term.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Design Standards; Contract Management Best Practices

attributes.name: escalation_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual escalation percentage applied to the base rate when escalation mechanism is fixed percent. Null for non-fixed escalation types.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate schedule ceases to be valid. Null for open-ended or evergreen rate schedules. End of the rate schedule validity period.

attributes.name: index_reference
attributes.description: Specific market index or benchmark used for indexed pricing. Examples include ISO-NE Day-Ahead LMP Hub, Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price, or specific node/zone pricing points. Null for non-indexed schedules.
attributes.references: ISO Market Data Standards; EIA Natural Gas Pricing

attributes.name: market_iso
attributes.description: The Independent System Operator or Regional Transmission Organization market applicable to this rate schedule for electricity products. ISO-NE is ISO New England, PJM is PJM Interconnection, MISO is Midcontinent ISO, CAISO is California ISO, ERCOT is Electric Reliability Council of Texas, SPP is Southwest Power Pool, NYISO is New York ISO. None applies to non-electricity products or bilateral contracts outside ISO markets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iso_ne|pjm|miso|caiso|ercot|spp|nyiso|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000 RTO Standards; ISO Market Participation Rules

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum energy quantity allowed per period under this rate schedule, expressed in the unit specified by rate_unit. Null if no maximum applies.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum energy quantity commitment per period required under this rate schedule, expressed in the unit specified by rate_unit. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications regarding this rate schedule. Used for business context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Fundamental pricing mechanism for the rate schedule. Fixed indicates a set dollar per unit rate, LMP-indexed ties to locational marginal pricing in wholesale electricity markets, Henry Hub-indexed follows natural gas commodity pricing for RNG, cost-plus adds margin to production costs, negotiated reflects bilateral contract terms, and tariff follows regulatory-approved rates.
attributes.references: FERC Energy Pricing Standards; ISO Market Design Principles

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base rate. USD per MWh for electricity, USD per thousand pounds for steam, USD per million BTU or therm or dekatherm for gas products.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 80000 Quantities and Units; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: rec_bundled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Renewable Energy Credits are bundled with the energy sale under this rate schedule or sold separately. True if RECs are bundled with energy, false if unbundled or not applicable.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Energy Certificate Tracking Systems; State RPS Programs

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory body or jurisdiction that oversees this rate schedule, if applicable. Examples include state public utility commissions, FERC for wholesale markets, or none for unregulated bilateral contracts.
attributes.references: FERC Jurisdictional Standards; State PUC Authority

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the rate schedule used in contracts and billing systems. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each pricing schedule.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rate Schedule Standards

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the energy rate schedule for business reference and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate schedule. Draft indicates under development, active means currently in use, suspended means temporarily inactive, expired means past expiration date, and superseded means replaced by a newer schedule.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which energy deliveries and payments are settled under this rate schedule. Hourly for real-time markets, daily for day-ahead, monthly for typical utility billing, quarterly or annual for long-term contracts.
attributes.references: ISO Settlement Procedures; Contract Payment Terms

attributes.name: tariff_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory tariff, docket number, or public utility commission filing that governs this rate schedule. Applicable for utility-regulated energy sales.
attributes.references: FERC Tariff Filing Requirements; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: time_of_use_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate schedule includes time-of-use pricing with different rates for peak, off-peak, and shoulder periods. True if TOU pricing applies, false otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate schedule record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

products.name: planned_outage
products.description: Transactional record of planned maintenance outages for WTE boilers, turbine-generators, and LFG-to-energy units. Captures outage ID, asset ID (boiler, turbine, or RNG unit), facility ID, outage type (annual overhaul, scheduled inspection, regulatory test), planned start date, planned end date, actual start date, actual end date, estimated lost generation (MWh), outage reason code, responsible work order reference, and outage status. Supports generation availability planning and utility notification compliance.

attributes.name: planned_outage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planned maintenance outage record. Primary key for the planned outage entity.

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Planned maintenance outages are often scheduled for specific boiler units. While planned_outage already links to fixed_asset (generic), adding a direct link to boiler_unit enables boiler-specific outa

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal supervisor or maintenance manager responsible for overseeing the planned outage execution and ensuring work completion.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste-to-Energy (WTE) or Landfill Gas-to-Energy (LFG) facility where the outage is planned.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific asset (boiler, turbine-generator, or Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) unit) undergoing the planned outage.

attributes.name: outage_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Major outages involve significant parts/services procurement; direct PO link enables outage cost tracking, vendor performance correlation with downtime duration, capital project budget reconciliation,

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: Planned outages may require advance notification to air quality agencies and inclusion in annual deviation reports. Links outage to submission for regulatory notification tracking, deviation reporting

attributes.name: turbine_generator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.turbine_generator. Business justification: Planned maintenance outages are often scheduled for specific turbine-generator units. This link enables turbine-specific outage tracking, coordination with offtake agreements, and generation availabil

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external contractor or vendor responsible for performing the planned outage maintenance work, if applicable. References vendor master data.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order (WO) in the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system (e.g., Infor EAM) that governs the execution of the planned outage activities.

attributes.name: actual_cost_usd
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred for the planned outage in United States Dollars (USD), captured after outage completion. Used for variance analysis and future cost estimation improvement.

attributes.name: actual_duration_hours
attributes.description: Actual duration of the outage in hours, calculated from actual start and end dates. Used to measure schedule adherence and improve future planning accuracy.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the planned outage work was completed and the asset was returned to service. Used to calculate actual outage duration and variance from plan.

attributes.name: actual_lost_generation_mwh
attributes.description: Actual energy generation lost during the outage period in megawatt-hours (MWh), calculated from actual outage duration and asset capacity.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the planned outage work commenced. May differ from planned start date due to operational or weather conditions.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the planned outage was cancelled, if applicable (e.g., asset failure requiring emergency repair, regulatory exemption granted, scope change).

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Summary notes documenting the outcome of the planned outage after completion, including work performed, issues encountered, deviations from plan, and recommendations for future outages.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the planned outage record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this planned outage is on the critical path for facility operations, meaning any delay would directly impact the facility's ability to meet generation commitments or regulatory deadlines. True if critical path, False otherwise.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental impact assessment was conducted for the planned outage to evaluate potential emissions, waste generation, or environmental risks during maintenance activities. True if assessment performed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the planned outage in United States Dollars (USD), including labor, materials, contractor fees, and lost revenue from generation downtime. Used for budget planning and cost-benefit analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_lost_generation_mwh
attributes.description: Estimated energy generation lost during the planned outage period in megawatt-hours (MWh). Used for revenue impact analysis and utility settlement planning.

attributes.name: outage_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique identifier or reference number for the planned outage, used for tracking and communication with utility operators and internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: outage_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the planned outage (e.g., boiler tube inspection, turbine blade replacement, emissions testing, regulatory compliance). Aligns with NERC GADS cause codes where applicable.

attributes.name: outage_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the reason for the planned outage, including specific maintenance activities, inspections, or regulatory requirements driving the outage.

attributes.name: outage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planned outage: planned (initial state), scheduled (confirmed with utility), in progress (work underway), completed (work finished and asset returned to service), cancelled, or postponed.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planned outage based on its purpose: annual overhaul (major maintenance), scheduled inspection, regulatory test (compliance-driven), preventive maintenance (PM), component replacement, or performance optimization.
attributes.value_regex: annual overhaul|scheduled inspection|regulatory test|preventive maintenance|component replacement|performance optimization
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, NERC Generating Availability Data System (GADS)

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Environmental or operating permit number associated with the planned outage, if the outage is required to maintain permit compliance (e.g., air quality permit, operating permit).
attributes.references: EPA Regulations, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: planned_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration of the planned outage in hours, calculated from planned start and end dates. Used for resource planning and generation availability forecasting.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the planned outage is expected to be completed and the asset returned to operational service.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the planned outage is expected to begin. Used for generation availability planning and utility notification.

attributes.name: postponement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the planned outage was postponed or rescheduled, if applicable (e.g., weather conditions, parts unavailability, utility request, operational priority change).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned outage is driven by regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., Clean Air Act (CAA) emissions testing, boiler inspection mandated by state environmental agency). True if compliance-driven, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA), EPA Regulations, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: safety_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal safety plan is required for the planned outage due to hazardous work conditions (e.g., confined space entry, hot work, high voltage). True if safety plan required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: scope_of_work
attributes.description: Detailed description of the maintenance activities, inspections, tests, and component replacements to be performed during the planned outage. Defines the work scope for planning and execution.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the planned outage record was last modified. Used for audit trail and tracking changes to outage schedule or status.

attributes.name: utility_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the utility operator or ISO formally approved the planned outage schedule.

attributes.name: utility_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of utility or ISO approval for the planned outage: pending (awaiting response), approved (outage confirmed), conditional (approved with restrictions), or denied (outage must be rescheduled).

attributes.name: utility_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the utility operator or Independent System Operator (ISO) was formally notified of the planned outage, as required by interconnection agreements and grid reliability standards.

products.name: reagent_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of APC reagent consumption at WTE facilities, tracking usage of lime, urea, activated carbon, and other pollution control chemicals. Captures consumption date, facility ID, APC unit ID, reagent type, quantity consumed (tons or gallons), reagent lot number, supplier reference, unit cost ($/ton), and associated boiler operating hours. Supports emissions compliance cost tracking and reagent inventory management.

attributes.name: reagent_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reagent consumption transaction record.

attributes.name: air_pollution_control_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific Air Pollution Control unit that consumed the reagent.

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the boiler unit associated with this reagent consumption event.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility operator or technician who recorded or supervised the reagent consumption.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste-to-Energy (WTE) facility where the reagent was consumed.

attributes.name: reagent_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Reagent purchases are high-volume recurring procurement; direct PO link enables consumption-to-invoice three-way match, unit cost variance analysis, supplier performance tracking by consumption effici

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational shift during which the reagent was consumed.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier who provided the reagent.

attributes.name: boiler_operating_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the associated boiler unit operated during the consumption period, used to normalize reagent usage rates.

attributes.name: co_emissions_lbs
attributes.description: The pounds of carbon monoxide emitted during the consumption period.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act CEMS Reporting

attributes.name: consumption_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reagent was consumed in the APC system.

attributes.name: consumption_method
attributes.description: The method by which the reagent was introduced into the APC system (e.g., automatic injection, manual feed, batch addition).

attributes.name: consumption_rate_per_ton_msw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumption Rate per Ton Municipal Solid Waste (MSW)
attributes.description: The reagent consumption rate normalized per ton of MSW processed, a key performance indicator for APC efficiency.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Performance Standards

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the reagent consumption was recorded, supporting real-time monitoring and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reagent consumption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the quality or reliability of the consumption data (e.g., verified, estimated, provisional, suspect).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or method from which the consumption data was captured (e.g., SCADA, manual entry, inventory system, CEMS).

attributes.name: emissions_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reagent consumption achieved the required emissions compliance targets during the period (True = compliant, False = non-compliant).
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Permit

attributes.name: hcl_emissions_lbs
attributes.description: The pounds of hydrochloric acid emitted during the consumption period, tracked to assess reagent effectiveness in acid gas removal.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act CEMS Reporting

attributes.name: inventory_transaction_number
attributes.description: The identifier of the inventory transaction in the ERP system that recorded the reagent withdrawal from stock.

attributes.name: mercury_emissions_lbs
attributes.description: The pounds of mercury emitted during the consumption period, tracked to assess activated carbon effectiveness in heavy metal capture.
attributes.references: EPA Mercury and Air Toxics Standards (MATS)

attributes.name: msw_feedstock_tons
attributes.description: The tons of Municipal Solid Waste processed during the consumption period, used to calculate reagent consumption per ton of waste.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the reagent consumption event, including any operational anomalies or special circumstances.

attributes.name: nox_emissions_lbs
attributes.description: The pounds of nitrogen oxides emitted during the consumption period, tracked to assess reagent effectiveness in NOx reduction.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act CEMS Reporting

attributes.name: particulate_matter_lbs
attributes.description: The pounds of particulate matter emitted during the consumption period.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act CEMS Reporting

attributes.name: quantity_consumed
attributes.description: The quantity of reagent consumed during the specified period.

attributes.name: reagent_lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number of the reagent consumed, enabling traceability to supplier shipment and quality specifications.

attributes.name: reagent_name
attributes.description: The commercial or chemical name of the reagent consumed.

attributes.name: reagent_type
attributes.description: The type of Air Pollution Control reagent consumed (e.g., lime for acid gas removal, urea for NOx reduction, activated carbon for mercury and dioxin capture).
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act APC Technology Standards

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current status of the consumption record (e.g., active, voided, corrected, archived).

attributes.name: so2_emissions_lbs
attributes.description: The pounds of sulfur dioxide emitted during the consumption period, tracked to assess reagent effectiveness in acid gas removal.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act CEMS Reporting

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The physical storage location or warehouse code from which the reagent was withdrawn.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: total_cost_usd
attributes.description: The total cost of the reagent consumed in this transaction, calculated as quantity consumed multiplied by unit cost, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: unit_cost_usd
attributes.description: The cost per unit of measure for the reagent consumed, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity consumed (e.g., tons, gallons, pounds).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reagent consumption record was last modified.

products.name: rec_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of REC sales, retirements, and transfers executed by Waste Management for WTE and LFG-to-electricity generation. Captures transaction ID, REC issuance reference, transaction type (sale, retirement, transfer, banking), counterparty, transaction date, quantity (MWh), price ($/REC), registry transaction ID, state RPS compliance period, and settlement status. SSOT for REC monetization and state renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance tracking.

attributes.name: rec_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the REC transaction record. Primary key for the rec_transaction data product.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: REC transactions execute under master trading agreements (for recurring trades) or spot sale contracts. These contracts govern pricing terms, settlement procedures, and dispute resolution. Direct refe

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Waste-to-Energy (WTE) or Landfill Gas-to-Energy (LFG) facility that generated the underlying renewable energy for these RECs.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: REC sales to compliance buyers generate formal invoices for financial settlement. Business process: environmental attribute monetization requires invoicing with payment terms, AR tracking, and ASC 606

attributes.name: rec_issuance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the REC issuance batch from which these RECs originated. Links to the original generation and certification event.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_credit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.renewable_energy_credit. Business justification: REC transactions (sales, retirements) in energy domain update status of renewable_energy_credit records in sustainability. Links trading activity to ESG accounting for Scope 2 market-based emissions a

attributes.name: broker_fee_usd
attributes.description: The fee paid to a broker or intermediary for facilitating the REC transaction, in United States Dollars. Zero if transaction was direct without broker involvement.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master REC purchase agreement, power purchase agreement (PPA), or sales contract under which this transaction was executed. Used for contract compliance tracking and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: counterparty_account_number
attributes.description: The registry account number or identifier of the counterparty receiving or purchasing the RECs. Used for registry transfer verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this REC transaction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: eligibility_state
attributes.description: The U.S. state(s) for which these RECs are eligible for Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance, using two-letter state abbreviations (e.g., CA, NY, MA). Multiple states may be comma-separated if RECs qualify in multiple jurisdictions.

attributes.name: emissions_avoided_co2e_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emissions Avoided Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Tons
attributes.description: The estimated greenhouse gas emissions avoided (in metric tons of CO2 equivalent) by the renewable energy generation represented by these RECs, compared to conventional fossil fuel generation. Used for sustainability reporting and carbon accounting.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The renewable fuel source that generated the electricity for these RECs. MSW = Municipal Solid Waste (Waste-to-Energy combustion); LFG = Landfill Gas; biogas = anaerobic digestion gas; biomass = organic material combustion; solar = photovoltaic or thermal; wind = wind turbine; hydro = hydroelectric; geothermal = geothermal steam. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSW|LFG|biogas|biomass|solar|wind|hydro|geothermal|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: generation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the generation period for the renewable energy that created these RECs. Defines the end of the time window during which the underlying MWh were produced.

attributes.name: generation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the generation period for the renewable energy that created these RECs. Defines the beginning of the time window during which the underlying MWh were produced.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to this REC transaction. May include information about transaction amendments, dispute resolution, or unique circumstances.

attributes.name: rec_quantity_mwh
attributes.description: The quantity of RECs transacted, measured in megawatt-hours (MWh). One REC typically represents one MWh of renewable electricity generation. This is the primary unit of measure for REC transactions.

attributes.name: registry_name
attributes.description: The name of the renewable energy tracking registry system in which this REC transaction was recorded. M-RETS = Midwest Renewable Energy Tracking System; NAR = North American Renewables Registry; NEPOOL-GIS = New England Power Pool Generation Information System; WREGIS = Western Renewable Energy Generation Information System; PJM-GATS = PJM Generation Attribute Tracking System; ERCOT = Electric Reliability Council of Texas; NC-RETS = North Carolina Renewable Energy Tracking System; MIRECS = Michigan Renewable Energy Certification System. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: M-RETS|NAR|NEPOOL-GIS|WREGIS|PJM-GATS|ERCOT|NC-RETS|MIRECS|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: registry_transaction_number
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the REC tracking registry system (e.g., M-RETS, NAR, NEPOOL GIS, WREGIS) that recorded this transaction. Used for external audit and verification.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RECs were permanently retired in the tracking registry. Null if RECs have not been retired. Retirement is irreversible and removes RECs from tradable inventory.

attributes.name: retirement_purpose
attributes.description: The stated purpose or beneficiary for which the RECs were retired (e.g., state RPS compliance, voluntary green power program, corporate sustainability commitment, carbon offset program). Null if not retired.

attributes.name: retirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RECs in this transaction. Active = available for trading; Retired = permanently retired for compliance or voluntary purposes; Transferred = moved to another account; Expired = past eligibility window; Cancelled = invalidated due to error or fraud.

attributes.name: rps_compliance_period
attributes.description: The state RPS compliance period (typically a calendar year or program year) for which these RECs may be applied. Format varies by state program (e.g., 2024, 2023-2024, Q4-2023).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the REC transaction was settled and payment/delivery completed. May differ from transaction date for forward contracts or delayed settlements.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the financial and registry settlement for this transaction. Pending = awaiting completion; Settled = payment and registry transfer complete; Failed = settlement did not complete; Disputed = under review or contested; Reversed = transaction was reversed or unwound.

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: The specific renewable energy generation technology used (e.g., mass burn WTE, modular WTE, LFG-to-electricity, LFG-to-RNG, anaerobic digestion). Provides additional detail beyond fuel_type for technology-specific RPS tiers or market segmentation.

attributes.name: total_transaction_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Transaction Value United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the REC transaction in United States Dollars, calculated as rec_quantity_mwh multiplied by unit_price_usd. Represents gross revenue for sales or gross cost for purchases before any fees or adjustments.

attributes.name: trading_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether these RECs have trading restrictions imposed by state regulations, contract terms, or registry rules. True = restrictions apply; False = freely tradable.

attributes.name: trading_restriction_reason
attributes.description: Description of the trading restriction if trading_restriction_flag is true. Examples include state geographic eligibility limits, vintage year restrictions, technology tier requirements, or contractual hold periods.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the REC transaction was executed and legally binding. This is the business event date used for revenue recognition and compliance period assignment.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number assigned by Waste Management for tracking and reconciliation purposes. Used in financial reporting and customer communications.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the REC transaction activity. Sale = monetization to third party; Retirement = voluntary or compliance retirement; Transfer = internal movement between accounts; Banking = holding for future compliance period; Forward_sale = pre-sold future vintage; Spot_sale = immediate delivery sale.

attributes.name: unit_price_usd
attributes.description: The price per REC (per MWh) in United States Dollars. For sales, this is the selling price; for purchases, this is the acquisition cost. Zero for retirements and internal transfers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this REC transaction record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which third-party verification or audit of this REC transaction was completed. Null if verification was not performed or is still pending.
attributes.references: ISO 14064 Greenhouse Gas Accounting and Verification

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification or audit of the REC transaction for compliance or quality assurance purposes. Verified = passed independent review; Pending_verification = under review; Failed_verification = did not pass audit; Not_required = verification not mandated for this transaction type.
attributes.references: ISO 14064 Greenhouse Gas Accounting and Verification

attributes.name: verifier_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent third-party organization that verified or audited this REC transaction, if applicable. Null if verification was not performed or not required.

Supports California LCFS and Oregon CFP compliance and credit revenue.

products.name: stack

attributes.name: stack_id

attributes.name: boiler_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.boiler_unit. Business justification: Stacks are associated with specific boiler units - each boiler exhausts through a dedicated stack (or multiple boilers may share a common stack). This link enables tracking of which boiler's emissions

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Waste-to-Energy (WTE) facility where this stack is located. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: air_pollution_control_device_type
attributes.description: Primary type of air pollution control equipment installed upstream of this stack to reduce emissions before discharge to atmosphere.

attributes.name: cems_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the CEMS was last certified or recertified by regulatory authorities, demonstrating compliance with accuracy and quality assurance requirements.

attributes.name: cems_next_recertification_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required CEMS recertification to maintain regulatory compliance and measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: continuous_emissions_monitoring_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Continuous Emissions Monitoring System is installed on this stack for real-time pollutant measurement and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stack record was first created in the system, following format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the emission stack was permanently taken out of service and decommissioned. Marks the end of regulatory reporting obligations for this asset.

attributes.name: design_flow_rate_cubic_meters_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Flow Rate Cubic Meters Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum designed volumetric flow rate of exhaust gases through the stack, measured in cubic meters per hour at standard conditions. Used for capacity planning and permit limits.

attributes.name: emission_limit_co_pounds_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit Co Pounds Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission rate for carbon monoxide from this stack, measured in pounds per hour. Indicator of combustion efficiency and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: emission_limit_dioxin_furan_nanograms_per_cubic_meter
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit Dioxin Furan Nanograms Per Cubic Meter
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission concentration for dioxins and furans from this stack, measured in nanograms per dry standard cubic meter. Stringent limit for toxic organic compounds.

attributes.name: emission_limit_hcl_pounds_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit Hcl Pounds Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission rate for hydrogen chloride from this stack, measured in pounds per hour. Acid gas control requirement for waste combustion.

attributes.name: emission_limit_mercury_pounds_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit Mercury Pounds Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission rate for mercury from this stack, measured in pounds per hour. Hazardous air pollutant limit under Clean Air Act.

attributes.name: emission_limit_nox_pounds_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit Nox Pounds Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission rate for nitrogen oxides from this stack, measured in pounds per hour. Regulatory limit enforced under Clean Air Act.

attributes.name: emission_limit_particulate_matter_pounds_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit Particulate Matter Pounds Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission rate for particulate matter from this stack, measured in pounds per hour. Critical for air quality compliance.

attributes.name: emission_limit_so2_pounds_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emission Limit So2 Pounds Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum permitted emission rate for sulfur dioxide from this stack, measured in pounds per hour. Regulatory limit enforced under Clean Air Act.

attributes.name: exit_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Average temperature of exhaust gases at the stack exit point, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical for buoyancy calculations in dispersion modeling.

attributes.name: exit_velocity_meters_per_second
attributes.description: Average velocity of exhaust gases exiting the stack, measured in meters per second. Key parameter for dispersion modeling and regulatory compliance calculations.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency for conducting structural and safety inspections of the emission stack, measured in months between inspections.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the emission stack was originally installed and commissioned at the facility. Determines applicability of New Source Performance Standards.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent structural or safety inspection of the emission stack was completed.

attributes.name: last_modification_date
attributes.description: Date when the stack or associated air pollution control equipment underwent significant modification that may trigger new regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: last_stack_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent comprehensive stack emission test was conducted by certified third-party testing firm.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the stack location in decimal degrees. Used for air dispersion modeling and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the stack location in decimal degrees. Used for air dispersion modeling and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured or constructed the emission stack and associated structural components.

attributes.name: material_construction
attributes.description: Primary construction material of the emission stack, determining durability, corrosion resistance, and maintenance requirements.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or design specification number for the emission stack, used for maintenance and parts procurement.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required structural or safety inspection of the emission stack.

attributes.name: next_stack_test_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required comprehensive stack emission test to maintain regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, special conditions, or historical information about the emission stack that may be relevant for operations or compliance.

attributes.name: opacity_limit_percent
attributes.description: Maximum permitted visible opacity of stack emissions, measured as a percentage. Visual indicator of particulate emissions and combustion quality.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the emission stack in its lifecycle. Determines whether the stack is actively emitting, temporarily offline, or permanently retired.

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current air permit expires, requiring renewal or modification to continue operations legally.

attributes.name: permit_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the current air permit was issued by the regulatory authority, establishing the effective start of permit conditions.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory air permit number issued by the environmental authority governing emissions from this stack. Links to permit compliance requirements and emission limits.

attributes.name: stack_diameter_meters
attributes.description: Internal diameter of the emission stack at the discharge point, measured in meters. Used for calculating exit velocity and dispersion characteristics.

attributes.name: stack_height_meters
attributes.description: Physical height of the emission stack measured in meters from ground level to the top of the discharge point. Critical parameter for dispersion modeling and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: stack_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation for the emission stack, used for operational identification and communication.

attributes.name: stack_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the emission stack, typically assigned by facility operations or regulatory authorities. Used in operational documentation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: stack_testing_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency for conducting comprehensive stack emission testing, measured in months between tests. Regulatory compliance requirement.

attributes.name: stack_type
attributes.description: Classification of the emission stack based on its primary function within the WTE facility operations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stack record was last modified in the system, following format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: linked_stack_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on stack (linked_stack_id)

attributes.name: beneficial_reuse_eligible

attributes.name: cadmium_concentration_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Concentration of cadmium detected in the ash sample leachate, measured in milligrams per liter.

attributes.name: carbon_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of unburned carbon remaining in the ash sample, indicating combustion efficiency.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number documenting the chronological documentation of sample handling from collection through analysis to ensure sample integrity.

attributes.name: chloride_content_mg_per_kg
attributes.description: Concentration of chloride ions in the ash sample, measured in milligrams per kilogram, relevant for corrosion assessment and beneficial reuse applications.

attributes.name: chromium_concentration_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Concentration of chromium detected in the ash sample leachate, measured in milligrams per liter.

attributes.name: collected_by

attributes.name: collection_point
attributes.description: Specific equipment location or system component where the ash sample was collected (e.g., Boiler 2 Bottom Hopper, ESP Unit 3, Baghouse Outlet).

attributes.name: collection_timestamp

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the ash sample test results meet all applicable environmental regulatory requirements and permit conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Planned or actual method for final disposition of the ash material represented by this sample.

attributes.name: heavy_metals_detected
attributes.description: Indicator of whether heavy metals (lead, cadmium, mercury, chromium, arsenic, etc.) were detected above regulatory thresholds in the ash sample.

attributes.name: laboratory_code
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory facility responsible for analyzing this ash sample.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ash sample record was most recently updated in the data system.

attributes.name: lead_concentration_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Concentration of lead detected in the ash sample leachate, measured in milligrams per liter.

attributes.name: mercury_concentration_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Concentration of mercury detected in the ash sample leachate, measured in milligrams per liter.

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of moisture content in the ash sample at time of collection, measured as weight percent.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the ash sample failed to meet regulatory compliance standards, if applicable.

attributes.name: ph_level
attributes.description: Measure of acidity or alkalinity of the ash sample on a scale of 0-14, where 7 is neutral.

attributes.name: quality_control_passed
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the laboratory analysis passed internal quality control checks including blanks, duplicates, and spike recoveries.

attributes.name: received_at_lab_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ash sample was received and logged into the laboratory information system.

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the archived ash sample may be disposed of per regulatory retention requirements.

attributes.name: sample_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, special handling instructions, or contextual information about the ash sample.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or barcode for the ash sample used for tracking and laboratory reference.

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current state of the ash sample in its lifecycle from collection through final disposition.

attributes.name: sample_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the ash sample collected, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: sulfate_content_mg_per_kg
attributes.description: Concentration of sulfate compounds in the ash sample, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Standard analytical method or protocol used for testing the ash sample (e.g., EPA Method 1311 TCLP, ASTM D3987).

attributes.name: toxicity_characteristic
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the ash sample exhibits hazardous waste characteristics based on Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) testing per RCRA regulations.

attributes.name: resample_ash_sample_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ash_sample (resample_ash_sample_id)

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Service agreements and contracts with customers including municipal solid waste contracts, commercial service agreements, hauling contracts, disposal agreements, and franchise agreements. Manages contract terms, service levels (SLA), pricing structures, rate escalation clauses, renewal dates, performance obligations, contract amendments, and lifecycle events (origination, renewal, amendment, termination). Links customers to service commitments and billing terms. Integrates with Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.
domains.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition / Contract Law / NWRA Contract Standards

products.name: contract
products.description: Master record for all service agreements and contracts between Waste Management and its customers. Covers MSW municipal contracts, commercial service agreements, hauling contracts, disposal agreements, and franchise agreements. Stores contract number, type, status, effective/expiration dates, auto-renewal flags, governing jurisdiction, and Salesforce CRM opportunity reference. Single source of truth for contract identity and lifecycle stage (origination, active, amended, renewed, terminated). Integrates with Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Links contracts to primary regulatory drivers, essenti

attributes.name: safety_program_id

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of formal amendments executed against this contract since origination. Used to track contract change history and version control.

attributes.name: annual_escalation_percentage

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews at expiration unless either party provides notice. True for auto-renewing contracts, False for fixed-term agreements requiring explicit renewal.

attributes.name: base_service_rate
attributes.description: Primary recurring charge amount for the contracted service. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in contract terms. Excludes variable charges, surcharges, and taxes.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated under this contract. Monthly for recurring monthly billing, Quarterly for quarterly invoicing, Annual for yearly billing, Per Service for event-based billing.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the contract. Used in customer communications, invoicing, and legal documentation.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract. Draft for contracts under negotiation, Pending for signed but not yet effective, Active for in-force agreements, Suspended for temporarily paused contracts, Amended for contracts with modifications, Terminated for ended agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: early_termination_penalty
attributes.description: Financial penalty amount charged if the customer terminates the contract before the expiration date. May be a fixed amount or calculated as a percentage of remaining contract value.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms become binding and service obligations commence. Used for billing start date and service level agreement (SLA) enforcement.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_requirement
attributes.description: Description of environmental regulations and compliance obligations specified in the contract. May reference Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA), Clean Air Act (CAA), or state-specific environmental requirements.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract term ends and obligations cease unless renewed. Nullable for evergreen or indefinite-term contracts.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Description of the circumstances (natural disasters, pandemics, war, government action) that excuse non-performance of contract obligations without penalty.

attributes.name: governing_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the contract interpretation and dispute resolution. Typically a state or province code (e.g., TX, CA, ON) or country code for international contracts.

attributes.name: indemnification_clause
attributes.description: Description of the indemnification obligations where one party agrees to protect the other from specified liabilities, claims, or damages arising from contract performance.

attributes.name: insurance_requirement
attributes.description: Description of the insurance coverage types and minimum limits required under the contract. Typically includes general liability, auto liability, workers compensation, and environmental impairment liability.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contract amendment execution. Nullable if no amendments have been executed.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate charged on overdue balances per month or per annum as specified in contract terms. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 1.50 for 1.5% monthly).

attributes.name: maximum_tonnage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum volume of waste in tons that the facility or service provider will accept under the contract. Common in landfill disposal agreements. Nullable for unlimited contracts.

attributes.name: minimum_tonnage_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum volume of waste in tons that the customer commits to deliver under the contract term. Common in disposal and hauling agreements. Nullable for contracts without volume commitments.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the Waste Management employee responsible for managing this contract relationship. Typically a sales representative, account manager, or municipal services manager.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date that payment is due. Common values are 15, 30, or 60 days. Used for accounts receivable (AR) aging and collections management.

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the performance bond required under the contract. Nullable if no bond is required.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract requires the service provider to post a performance bond to guarantee service delivery. Common in municipal and franchise agreements.

attributes.name: rate_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Description of the pricing adjustment mechanism over the contract term. May reference Consumer Price Index (CPI), fixed percentage increases, or fuel surcharge formulas.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration that either party must provide notice to prevent auto-renewal or initiate renewal discussions. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days.

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM opportunity identifier that originated this contract. Links contract to the sales pipeline and opportunity record for revenue attribution and sales performance tracking.

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) module contract document number. Used for integration with SAP billing, order management, and financial accounting.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Description of the performance obligations and service commitments defined in the contract. May include pickup frequency, response times, container delivery standards, and quality metrics.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date when all parties executed the contract. Used for legal enforceability and contract lifecycle tracking. May differ from effective date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record that originated this contract data. Salesforce for CRM-originated contracts, SAP for ERP-originated contracts, AMCS for operations platform contracts, Manual for legacy or paper contracts.

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the contract term expressed in months. Common values are 12, 24, 36, or 60 months. Used for calculating expiration dates and renewal cycles.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Description of the conditions and procedures under which either party may terminate the contract prior to expiration. Includes notice requirements, cause provisions, and early termination penalties.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for contract termination. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days depending on contract type and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: value_total
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue value of the contract over its full term. Calculated from base rates, estimated volumes, and contract duration. Used for revenue forecasting and sales performance metrics.

products.name: agreement_type
products.description: Reference classification of contract and agreement types used across Waste Management's commercial and municipal operations. Includes types such as MSW Municipal Franchise, Commercial Hauling, Roll-Off Disposal, Residential Service, Hazardous Waste Disposal, and Intermodal Transfer. Drives contract workflow routing, SLA assignment, and billing rule selection.

attributes.name: agreement_type_id

attributes.description: Indicates whether customer approval or acceptance is required before escalated rates take effect. True for some municipal contracts with board approval requirements; false for automatic escalations.

attributes.name: dispute_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after notification during which customer may dispute the escalation calculation or request review. Null if no dispute period is contractually defined.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this escalation clause becomes active and begins governing rate adjustments.

attributes.name: escalation_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable rate increase percentage in any single escalation period, protecting customers from excessive increases during high inflation periods (e.g., 5.00 represents 5% cap).
attributes.references: Contract Negotiation Standards; Municipal Contract Requirements

attributes.name: escalation_clause_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the escalation clause. Active = currently in effect; suspended = temporarily not applied; expired = past expiration date; superseded = replaced by amendment; pending_approval = awaiting customer or internal approval.

attributes.name: escalation_floor_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum rate increase percentage guaranteed in any escalation period, ensuring revenue growth even during deflationary periods (e.g., 1.00 represents 1% floor). Null if no floor applies.

attributes.name: escalation_type
attributes.description: Type of rate escalation mechanism applied. CPI (Consumer Price Index) escalation adjusts rates based on inflation indices; PPI (Producer Price Index) escalation ties to producer cost changes; fuel index escalation adjusts for fuel cost fluctuations; fixed percentage applies a predetermined annual increase; disposal cost passthrough allows direct pass-through of landfill tipping fee increases; labor cost index ties to wage inflation; hybrid combines multiple escalation methods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cpi|ppi|fuel_index|fixed_percentage|disposal_cost_passthrough|labor_cost_index|hybrid — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Waste Management Contract Standards; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Description of any charges or fees explicitly excluded from this escalation clause (e.g., regulatory fees, environmental surcharges, one-time charges). Free-text field capturing negotiated exclusions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this escalation clause expires or is superseded. Null for clauses that remain active through contract term.

attributes.name: fixed_escalation_percentage
attributes.description: The predetermined annual percentage increase applied to rates for fixed percentage escalation clauses (e.g., 3.00 represents 3% annual increase). Null for index-based escalations.

attributes.name: index_reference
attributes.description: Specific economic index or benchmark used for escalation calculation (e.g., CPI-U All Urban Consumers, PPI Waste Management Services, DOE Diesel Fuel Index, Regional CPI). Null for fixed percentage escalations.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; U.S. Department of Energy

attributes.name: last_escalation_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent rate escalation was applied under this clause. Null if no escalation has occurred yet.

attributes.name: last_escalation_percentage
attributes.description: The actual percentage increase applied during the most recent escalation event (e.g., 2.75 represents 2.75% increase). Used for historical tracking and forecasting.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this escalation clause record.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this escalation clause record was last modified.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next escalation review and rate adjustment calculation. Critical for proactive customer rate notifications and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Contract Management Standards; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special provisions, negotiation history, or operational notes related to this escalation clause.

attributes.name: notification_days_advance
attributes.description: Number of days prior to rate change effective date that customer must be notified, as stipulated in contract terms (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days). Required for compliance with municipal contract notification requirements.
attributes.references: Municipal Contract Requirements; Customer Communication Standards

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: How often the escalation clause is reviewed and rates are adjusted (annual = once per year, semi-annual = twice per year, quarterly = four times per year, biennial = every two years, monthly = every month).

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation (index reports, cost data, calculations) must be provided to customer with escalation notification. True for municipal contracts requiring transparency; false for standard commercial agreements.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this escalation clause record in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: sla_term
products.description: Service Level Agreement terms defined within a contract, specifying performance obligations such as on-time collection rate, missed pickup response time, container delivery lead time, complaint resolution SLA, and contamination notification requirements. Stores SLA metric name, target threshold, measurement frequency, penalty provisions for non-compliance, and reporting requirements. Supports SLA monitoring and customer performance reporting. Aligns with Salesforce CRM SLA tracking.

attributes.name: sla_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SLA term record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: SLA terms often specify facility-specific performance metrics (turnaround time at MRFs, acceptance windows at landfills). Required for facility performance monitoring, SLA compliance tracking, and pen

attributes.name: reduction_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.reduction_target. Business justification: SLA terms in waste contracts often include sustainability performance metrics (e.g., 'achieve 75% diversion rate') that map to formal reduction targets. Enables automated SLA compliance monitoring, pe

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id

Business justification: SLA terms (response times for hazmat incidents, missed pickup resolution) are often mandated by regulatory requirements (RCRA, state codes). Links contractual service levels to regulatory drivers, ess

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: SLA terms vary by customer segment (residential 48hr vs commercial 24hr vs municipal 4hr response). Segment linkage enables segment-specific SLA template application, performance benchmarking, and aut

attributes.name: sla_definition_id

attributes.name: amendment_date

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating how many times this SLA term has been amended since the original contract. Zero for original terms.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent amendment to this SLA term (e.g., service scope change, performance improvement initiative, regulatory requirement, customer request).

attributes.name: baseline_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period used to establish the baseline performance value.

attributes.name: baseline_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period used to establish the baseline performance value.

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: The historical or initial performance level used as a reference point for measuring improvement or setting targets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA term record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or platform from which performance data for this SLA metric is extracted (e.g., AMCS Platform, Locus Dispatch, Salesforce CRM, Geotab Fleet Telematics).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this SLA term expires or is no longer in effect. Null for open-ended terms.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this SLA term becomes active and performance measurement begins.

attributes.name: escalation_procedure
attributes.description: Description of the escalation process when performance falls below the escalation threshold (e.g., notify regional manager, schedule customer meeting, initiate corrective action plan).

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_value
attributes.description: The performance level that triggers escalation procedures or management notification (typically worse than the target threshold).

attributes.name: exclusion_conditions
attributes.description: Circumstances under which the SLA obligation does not apply (e.g., force majeure events, customer-caused delays, extreme weather, equipment failure beyond control, regulatory shutdowns).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA term record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How often the SLA metric is measured and evaluated (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually, per incident, continuous). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|per_incident|continuous — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Detailed description of how the SLA metric is calculated, including data sources, calculation formulas, and any adjustments or exclusions applied.

attributes.name: measurement_period_days
attributes.description: The rolling or fixed period in days over which the SLA metric is calculated (e.g., 30 for monthly rolling average, 90 for quarterly).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional context, clarifications, or special instructions related to this SLA term that do not fit in other structured fields.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the penalty or service credit applied per occurrence or period of non-compliance. Null if penalty is non-monetary.

attributes.name: penalty_calculation_method
attributes.description: Description of how the penalty is calculated (e.g., flat fee per incident, percentage of monthly service fee, tiered based on severity, prorated by days of non-compliance).

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: penalty_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial penalties or service credits apply for non-compliance with this SLA term (True if penalties exist, False otherwise).

attributes.name: penalty_type
attributes.description: The type of penalty or remedy applied when the SLA is not met (service credit, financial penalty, rate reduction, contract termination right, none).
attributes.references: Contract Law Standards, Salesforce CRM Contract Terms

attributes.name: reporting_format
attributes.description: The format in which SLA performance must be reported (e.g., PDF dashboard, Excel spreadsheet, online portal, email summary, API feed).

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: How often SLA performance reports must be delivered to the customer (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually, on request, none). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|on_request|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reporting_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal reporting of this SLA metric to the customer is required (True if reporting is mandatory, False otherwise).

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: The party responsible for meeting this SLA obligation (Waste Management, customer, third party, shared responsibility).

attributes.name: sla_category
attributes.description: The category of SLA term grouping related performance obligations (collection performance, response time, service quality, safety compliance, environmental compliance, customer satisfaction).
attributes.references: SWANA Service Standards, Internal SLA Framework

attributes.name: sla_metric_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the SLA metric to enable consistent tracking and reporting across contracts.

attributes.name: sla_metric_name
attributes.description: The name of the performance metric being measured (e.g., On-Time Collection Rate, Missed Pickup Response Time, Container Delivery Lead Time, Complaint Resolution Time, Contamination Notification Time).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM SLA Tracking, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: sla_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SLA term (active, suspended, expired, superseded, draft, cancelled).

attributes.name: target_threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric target value that must be met or exceeded to satisfy the SLA obligation (e.g., 98.5 for 98.5% on-time rate, 4 for 4-hour response time).

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: The comparison operator defining how actual performance is evaluated against the target (greater than or equal, less than or equal, equal, greater than, less than).

attributes.name: threshold_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the target threshold (percentage, hours, days, minutes, count, tons, cubic yards). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: percentage|hours|days|minutes|count|tons|cubic_yards — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: amendment
products.description: Records all formal modifications to an existing contract including scope changes, rate adjustments, service additions or removals, term extensions, and SLA revisions. Each amendment captures amendment number, effective date, amendment type, description of changes, approval status, approving authority, and reference to the original agreement. Maintains a complete audit trail of contract evolution from origination through termination. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and SAP SD change orders.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent contract being amended. Links to the original service agreement or contract.

attributes.name: document_id

attributes.name: superseded_by_amendment_id

attributes.name: amendment_description

attributes.name: amendment_number

attributes.name: amendment_status
