products.name: renewal
products.description: Tracks contract renewal events and renewal pipeline management. Captures renewal type (auto-renewal, negotiated renewal, evergreen), renewal notice date, renewal offer date, customer response date, new term start/end dates, rate changes applied at renewal, and renewal outcome (accepted, declined, renegotiated, lapsed). Supports proactive renewal management workflows and revenue retention tracking. Integrates with Salesforce CRM opportunity pipeline.

attributes.name: renewal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract renewal event. Primary key.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract amendment record if renewal triggered formal amendment. Links to contract amendment tracking in Salesforce CRM. Null if no amendment was required.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent contract being renewed. Links to the contract master record in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer associated with this renewal. Links to customer master data in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager responsible for managing this renewal. Links to employee master data in Workday Human Capital Management (HCM).

attributes.name: renewal_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or executive who approved the renewal terms. Links to employee master data in Workday HCM. Null if no approval was required.

attributes.name: amendment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether renewal resulted in formal contract amendment documentation due to material changes in terms, pricing, or service scope. True if amendment executed; False if renewal proceeded under existing contract framework.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when renewal terms were approved by authorized manager or executive. Null if no approval was required or approval is still pending.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether renewal terms required management approval due to rate concessions, service modifications, or contract value thresholds. True if approval workflow triggered; False if within standard authority limits.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract is eligible for automatic renewal based on original contract terms. True if auto-renewal clause exists and conditions are met; False if manual renewal process required.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Predictive score (0.00 to 1.00) indicating likelihood of customer not renewing, calculated at renewal notice date. Higher scores indicate greater risk of churn. Derived from customer payment history, service complaints, competitive activity, and engagement metrics.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of competing waste management company that customer was considering during renewal, if disclosed. Used for competitive analysis and market intelligence.

attributes.name: competitor_threat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer indicated they were considering or received offers from competing waste management providers during renewal process. True if competitive threat identified; False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the renewal record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: customer_response_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer provided their decision on the renewal offer (accepted, declined, or requested renegotiation).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewed contract term begins. Typically aligns with the expiration date of the previous term.

attributes.name: escalation_basis
attributes.description: Method used to calculate rate increase at renewal. CPI: Consumer Price Index adjustment. Fixed Percentage: predetermined annual increase. Market Rate: adjustment to current market pricing. Negotiated: custom rate agreed during renewal discussion. None: no escalation applied.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewed contract term ends. Defines the end of the new commitment period.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the renewal record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account manager to document renewal discussions, customer feedback, negotiation details, special considerations, or other contextual information relevant to the renewal process.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewal notice was sent to the customer, typically 60-90 days before contract expiration per Service Level Agreement (SLA) terms.

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: Date when formal renewal terms and pricing were presented to the customer. May differ from notice date if negotiation occurred.

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when customer submitted formal opt-out notice for auto-renewal. Must be received within notice period specified in contract (typically 30-90 days before expiration). Null if no opt-out received.

attributes.name: opt_out_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer provided written notice to opt out of auto-renewal within the required notice period. True if opt-out notice received; False otherwise. Relevant only for contracts with auto-renewal clauses.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Business result of the renewal process. Retained: customer renewed at similar service level. Lost: customer declined renewal and terminated service. Expanded: customer renewed with increased service scope or value. Downsized: customer renewed with reduced service scope or value.

attributes.name: previous_annual_value
attributes.description: Total annual revenue from the contract term prior to renewal, expressed in USD. Used as baseline for rate change calculation.

attributes.name: previous_term_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the contract term that preceded this renewal. Typically one day before renewal_effective_date.

attributes.name: previous_term_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the contract term that preceded this renewal. Used for historical tracking and term comparison.

attributes.name: rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in annual contract value from previous term to renewed term. Positive values indicate rate increase (escalation), negative values indicate discount or concession. Calculated as ((renewed_annual_value - previous_annual_value) / previous_annual_value) * 100.

attributes.name: rate_escalation_clause_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a contractual rate escalation clause (e.g., Consumer Price Index (CPI) adjustment, fixed percentage increase) was applied at renewal. True if escalation clause triggered; False if rates remained flat or were manually adjusted.

attributes.name: renewal_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the renewal event. Format: RNW-YYYYMMDD followed by sequence. Used in customer communications and internal tracking.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the renewal. Pending: renewal window opened but no action taken. Offered: renewal terms presented to customer. Accepted: customer agreed to renew. Declined: customer rejected renewal. Renegotiated: terms modified during renewal. Lapsed: renewal window closed without action. Cancelled: renewal process terminated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|offered|accepted|declined|renegotiated|lapsed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the renewal mechanism. Auto-renewal executes automatically per contract terms; negotiated renewal requires active renegotiation; evergreen continues indefinitely until terminated; manual renewal requires explicit customer action.

attributes.name: renewed_annual_value
attributes.description: Total annual revenue from the renewed contract term, expressed in USD. Reflects any rate escalation or service changes applied at renewal.

attributes.name: retention_strategy
attributes.description: Proactive retention approach applied during renewal process. Standard: normal renewal process. Discount Offered: pricing concession to retain customer. Service Upgrade: enhanced service at no additional cost. Executive Engagement: senior leadership involvement. None: no special retention effort required.

attributes.name: service_change_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any service level or scope changes applied at renewal. Examples: increased pickup frequency from weekly to twice-weekly, added recycling service, reduced container count from 5 to 3 units.

attributes.name: service_level_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Service Level Agreement (SLA) terms or service scope changed at renewal. True if service frequency, container count, or performance commitments were modified; False if service levels remained unchanged.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system where this renewal record originated. Salesforce CRM: renewal opportunity pipeline. SAP SD: sales and distribution module. Manual Entry: direct data entry by user.

attributes.name: term_length_months
attributes.description: Duration of the renewed contract term expressed in months. Common values: 12, 24, 36, 60 months.

products.name: termination

Captures termination reason code, notice date, effective termination date, early termination penalty amount, equipment retrieval requirements, final billing instructions, and customer churn classification. Supports revenue loss analysis and customer win-back programs. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.

attributes.name: termination_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract termination event. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_container_id

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer whose contract is being terminated. Used for churn analysis and win-back program targeting.

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract termination was formally approved by authorized personnel. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: churn_classification

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of competitor that customer switched to, if known. Used for competitive intelligence and market share analysis. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: contract_value_lost
attributes.description: Estimated annual recurring revenue lost due to contract termination in USD. Calculated from contract billing rate and service frequency. Used for revenue loss analysis and churn impact reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the termination record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process timing analysis.

attributes.name: early_termination_flag

attributes.name: early_termination_penalty_amount

attributes.name: effective_termination_date

attributes.name: equipment_retrieval_date

attributes.name: equipment_retrieval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether company-owned equipment (containers, compactors, bins) must be retrieved from customer site. True: retrieval required. False: no equipment to retrieve or customer-owned equipment.

attributes.name: equipment_retrieval_status

attributes.name: exit_feedback_summary
attributes.description: Summary of customer feedback from exit interview. Captures key concerns, service issues, and improvement suggestions. Used for service quality improvement and retention strategy development.
attributes.references: Customer Service Standards, Voice of Customer Program

attributes.name: exit_interview_completed_flag

products.name: lifecycle_event
products.description: Chronological audit log capturing all significant state transitions and business events in a contract's lifecycle. Event types include: origination, activation, first-service-date, amendment (scope changes, rate adjustments, service additions/removals, term extensions), renewal (auto-renewal execution, negotiated renewal, evergreen continuation), termination (voluntary cancellation, non-renewal expiration, breach-based, regulatory-driven), suspension, and reinstatement. Each event stores event type, event timestamp, prior state, new state, triggering user/system, event-specific detail attributes (amendment description, renewal outcome, termination reason code, penalty amounts), and approval reference. Provides complete chronological contract history for compliance, dispute resolution, revenue retention analysis, and customer service inquiries. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.

products.name: service_area
products.description: This association product represents the franchise coverage relationship between contract and service_area. It captures the geographic scope of service agreements, tracking which contracts authorize service delivery in which territories. Each record links one contract to one service_area with franchise-specific terms, exclusivity provisions, and service commitments that exist only in the context of this geographic coverage relationship. The franchise coverage relationship is an operational business entity that contract administrators actively manage, with territory-specific terms including franchise fees, exclusivity provisions, and service commitments that vary by geography even within the same master contract.

products.name: billing_rate_schedule

attributes.description: Unit of measure for per-unit rate components (e.g., ton for tonnage-based, pickup for per-pickup, day for daily rental). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ton|yard|pickup|day|month|gallon|mile|container|each — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: billing_tipping_fee_schedule
products.description: Reference schedule of tipping fees charged per ton (or per load) for waste disposal at landfill, transfer station, or WTE facility. Captures facility ID, waste stream type (MSW, C&D, special waste, hazardous), fee per ton (TPD-based pricing), minimum load fee, effective date range, customer tier (municipal, commercial, self-haul), and regulatory surcharge components. Supports both external customer billing and internal transfer pricing between operational units.

attributes.name: billing_tipping_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tipping fee schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: class_id

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contract or service agreement to which this tipping fee schedule is linked, if applicable.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility (landfill, transfer station, or WTE facility) where the tipping fee applies.

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.mrf_facility. Business justification: Tipping fee schedules are facility-specific, varying by MRF operational costs, market conditions, and capacity. Each facility maintains its own fee schedule. Core pricing configuration for MRF tipping

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.transfer_station. Business justification: Tipping fee schedules are facility-specific; direct link enables rate lookup, contract enforcement, and automated billing for inbound loads at each transfer station.

attributes.name: waste_stream_id

Disposal facilities require this link for regulatory compliance, cost recovery calculations, and accurate inv

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the tipping fee schedule, ensuring proper authorization before activation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Oracle Revenue Management Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this tipping fee schedule.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tipping fee schedule was approved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tipping fee schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the tipping fee amounts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: customer_tier
attributes.description: Customer segment or tier to which this tipping fee schedule applies, enabling tiered pricing strategies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this tipping fee schedule expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended schedule.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rate Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this tipping fee schedule becomes active and applicable for billing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rate Effective Dating

attributes.name: environmental_surcharge
attributes.description: Additional regulatory or environmental surcharge per ton, covering compliance costs such as landfill gas monitoring, leachate treatment, or closure reserves.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Base tipping fee charged per ton of waste disposed. Primary pricing component for tonnage-based billing.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606, Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: host_community_fee
attributes.description: Fee per ton paid to the host municipality or community as part of landfill operating agreements.

attributes.name: internal_transfer_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is used for internal transfer pricing between operational units (True) or external customer billing (False).

attributes.name: local_tax_rate
attributes.description: Local jurisdiction tax rate applied to tipping fees, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: minimum_load_fee
attributes.description: Minimum charge applied per load regardless of tonnage, ensuring cost recovery for small loads.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tipping fee schedule record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the tipping fee schedule, including special terms, exceptions, or business context.

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Pricing methodology applied by this schedule (flat rate per ton, tiered pricing based on volume thresholds, time-of-day pricing).

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the tipping fee schedule, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the tipping fee schedule for business user identification.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tipping fee schedule. Controls whether the schedule is available for billing transactions.

attributes.name: state_tax_rate
attributes.description: State-level tax rate applied to tipping fees, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0650 for 6.5%).
attributes.references: State Department of Revenue Tax Codes

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the tipping fee calculation (ton, cubic yard, or per load).
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44, Weights and Measures Standards

products.name: cycle
products.description: Configuration entity defining the recurring billing schedule for customer accounts. Captures cycle code, frequency (monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, per-haul for roll-off), billing run date, invoice generation date, payment terms (net 30, net 15, net 45), grace period days, late fee trigger rules, and applicable customer segments. Each billing account is assigned to one billing cycle that governs when invoices are generated and when payments are due. Drives the automated billing run schedule in Oracle Revenue Management and determines AR aging calculations.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing cycle configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: cycle_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user or administrator who created this billing cycle configuration. Audit trail for accountability and change tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user or administrator who last modified this billing cycle configuration. Audit trail for change accountability.

attributes.name: dunning_sequence_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dunning sequence configuration that defines the escalation schedule and actions for overdue accounts in this billing cycle (e.g., reminder at 5 days, notice at 15 days, suspension at 30 days).
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: advance_billing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices are generated in advance of the service period (prepaid model) or after service delivery (arrears model). True for advance billing (invoice before service), False for arrears billing (invoice after service).

attributes.name: ar_aging_bucket_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of day thresholds for AR aging bucket calculations (e.g., 30,60,90,120 for standard 30-day buckets). Used to categorize outstanding receivables by age for collections prioritization and financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting Standards, SAP FI/CO AR Aging

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this billing cycle automatically renew at the end of each period without requiring manual intervention. True for ongoing subscription services, False for term-limited contracts requiring explicit renewal.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: Revenue model applied in this billing cycle. Subscription for fixed recurring fees (monthly container rental), transactional for per-event charges (per-haul roll-off), usage-based for metered consumption (tonnage-based tipping fees), hybrid for combination of fixed and variable charges.

attributes.name: billing_period_day
attributes.description: Day of the month when the billing period closes and invoices are generated (1-31). For monthly cycles, this is the cutoff day. For bi-monthly or quarterly, this represents the anchor day.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: consolidation_level
attributes.description: Defines how invoices are consolidated for multi-site or hierarchical accounts. Account-level generates one invoice per account, site-level generates separate invoices per service location, parent-account rolls up all child accounts, consolidated combines all services into single invoice.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle record was first created in the system. Audit trail for configuration management and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this billing cycle. Typically USD for US operations, CAD for Canadian operations. Supports multi-currency billing for international accounts.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer segment this billing cycle serves. Residential for household waste collection, commercial for business accounts, industrial for manufacturing facilities, municipal for government contracts, roll-off for temporary container services, special-waste for hazardous or regulated waste handling.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the billing cycle (e.g., MC01 for Monthly Cycle 01, BC15 for Bi-Monthly Cycle 15). Used as business identifier in Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: cycle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the billing cycle purpose, scope, and applicable customer segments.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the billing cycle for business user identification (e.g., Monthly Residential East, Quarterly Commercial West).
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the billing cycle. Active for cycles currently in use, inactive for cycles not yet activated, suspended for temporarily disabled cycles, archived for historical cycles no longer in use but retained for audit purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: discount_eligibility_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this billing cycle are eligible for early payment discounts, volume discounts, or promotional pricing. True enables discount application rules, False excludes cycle from discount programs.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: dunning_process_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections reminder) process is enabled for overdue accounts in this billing cycle. True triggers escalating reminder notices and collection actions, False requires manual collections management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be received to qualify for early payment discount. Typically 10 days for 2/10 net-30 terms.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered for payment within specified early payment window (e.g., 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Common for commercial accounts to incentivize faster payment and improve cash flow.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing cycle configuration expires and can no longer be assigned to new accounts. Null for open-ended cycles. Used for phasing out legacy billing structures.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing cycle configuration becomes effective and can be assigned to customer accounts. Supports future-dated cycle changes for rate updates or term modifications.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Recurrence pattern for invoice generation. Monthly for standard residential/commercial, bi-monthly for certain municipal contracts, quarterly for large commercial accounts, annual for prepaid contracts, per-haul for roll-off containers, on-demand for special services.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: gl_ar_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Accounts Receivable (AR) Account Code
attributes.description: Default GL account code for posting accounts receivable from invoices in this billing cycle. Maps to SAP FI/CO chart of accounts for balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Chart of Accounts, GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: gl_revenue_account_code
attributes.description: Default GL account code for posting revenue from invoices in this billing cycle. Maps to SAP FI/CO chart of accounts for financial reporting and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Chart of Accounts, GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after payment due date before late fees are assessed or collection actions begin. Typically 5-10 days to accommodate payment processing delays.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Primary method for delivering invoices to customers in this billing cycle. Email for electronic delivery, postal-mail for paper invoices, portal for customer self-service access, EDI for electronic data interchange with large commercial accounts, both for dual delivery.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: invoice_generation_date
attributes.description: The date when invoices for this billing cycle are generated and made available to customers. Typically 1-3 days after billing period closes.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle record was last updated. Tracks configuration changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: late_fee_flat_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged as late fee regardless of balance, used as alternative or supplement to percentage-based late fees. Common for residential accounts ($5-$25 flat fee).

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of outstanding balance charged as late fee when payment is overdue beyond grace period. Typically 1.5% to 3% per month, subject to state usury laws.

attributes.name: late_fee_trigger_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether late fees are automatically triggered for overdue invoices in this billing cycle. True enables automatic late fee assessment, False requires manual review.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: payment_due_date_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days after invoice generation date when payment is due. Typically 15, 30, or 45 days representing net-15, net-30, or net-45 payment terms.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms applied to invoices in this billing cycle. Net-30 is most common for commercial accounts, net-15 for residential, net-45 or net-60 for large municipal contracts, due-on-receipt for certain transactional services, prepaid for annual contracts.

attributes.name: proration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether charges are prorated for partial billing periods when accounts are activated or terminated mid-cycle. True enables daily proration calculations, False bills full period regardless of start/end dates.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method for recognizing revenue from invoices in this billing cycle per GAAP/IFRS standards. Point-in-time for transactional services (per-haul), over-time for subscription services (monthly collection), milestone-based for project-based contracts.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Primary service type billed under this cycle. Collection for regular pickup services, disposal for landfill tipping fees, recycling for material recovery facility processing, hauling for transportation services, rental for container/equipment rental, processing for waste-to-energy or treatment services.

attributes.name: statement_generation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether monthly account statements are generated in addition to individual invoices. True for accounts requiring consolidated statements showing all activity, False for invoice-only delivery.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Data Model

attributes.name: tax_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method for calculating sales tax or VAT on invoices in this billing cycle. Standard applies jurisdiction-based tax rates, exempt for tax-exempt customers (municipalities, non-profits), reverse-charge for certain B2B transactions, mixed for accounts with both taxable and exempt services.
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: write_off_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be written off as bad debt without requiring executive approval. Balances below this threshold can be written off by collections team, amounts above require CFO or controller authorization per SOX controls.

products.name: run
products.description: Operational record of a batch billing execution that generates invoices for a defined set of customer accounts within a billing cycle. Captures run date, billing cycle reference, run type (scheduled, manual, correction), total accounts processed, total invoices generated, total billed amount, run status (pending, in-progress, completed, failed), and operator ID. Provides audit trail for SOX compliance and billing operations management.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing run batch execution. Primary key.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing cycle for which this run was executed. Links to the billing cycle master data defining the period and frequency.

attributes.name: run_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who approved this billing run for invoice release. Null if approval not required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: run_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user or automated process that initiated the billing run. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: accounts_on_hold
attributes.description: Count of customer accounts excluded from billing due to hold status (e.g., payment dispute, account under review, service suspension).

attributes.name: accounts_with_errors
attributes.description: Count of customer accounts that encountered errors during billing run processing. Requires manual review and correction.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing run requires managerial approval before invoice release. True for correction and manual runs; false for scheduled runs.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run was approved for invoice release. Null if approval not required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: ar_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of the accounts receivable posting for this billing run. Pending indicates awaiting posting; posted indicates successfully recorded in AR; failed indicates posting error; reversed indicates posting was reversed due to correction.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the billing period covered by this run. Defines the inclusive end boundary for usage and service charges.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the billing period covered by this run. Defines the inclusive start boundary for usage and service charges.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing run record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from run start to run end. Used for performance analysis and capacity planning.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run execution completed or failed. Null if run is still in progress or pending.

attributes.name: error_log_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of errors encountered during billing run execution. Detailed error records are stored in separate error log tables.

attributes.name: gl_batch_number
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO batch identifier for the general ledger posting of this billing run revenue. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue from this billing run was posted to the general ledger in SAP FI/CO. Used for financial period close and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: invoice_release_date
attributes.description: Date when invoices from this billing run were released to customers. May differ from run completion date if approval or review was required.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing run record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by billing operators regarding special circumstances, manual interventions, or issues requiring follow-up.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business-friendly identifier for the billing run, typically formatted as cycle-sequence (e.g., 2024-01-001). Used for operational tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing run. Pending indicates queued for execution; in-progress indicates active processing; completed indicates successful finish; failed indicates error termination; cancelled indicates operator abort; suspended indicates paused awaiting intervention.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing run execution mode. Scheduled runs are automated per billing cycle calendar; manual runs are operator-initiated; correction runs address prior errors; supplemental runs handle mid-cycle adjustments; final runs close the cycle; interim runs are preliminary.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Cloud User Guide

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system that executed the billing run (e.g., Oracle Revenue Management, SAP SD). Used for multi-system environments and data lineage.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run execution began. Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: total_accounts_processed
attributes.description: Count of distinct customer accounts included in this billing run. Used for reconciliation and completeness validation.

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all billing adjustments (credits, discounts, dispute resolutions) applied in this run, in USD. Negative values represent credits to customers.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all invoice amounts generated by this billing run, in USD. Represents gross revenue recognized for the billing period before payments and adjustments.

attributes.name: total_invoices_generated
attributes.description: Count of invoices created by this billing run. May differ from accounts processed if some accounts have zero balance or are on hold.

attributes.name: total_service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all recurring service charges (container rentals, subscription fees) included in this run, in USD. Excludes usage-based charges and taxes.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all tax charges included in the invoices generated by this run, in USD. Includes sales tax, environmental fees, and regulatory surcharges.

attributes.name: total_usage_charge_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all usage-based charges (tonnage, pickups, tipping fees) included in this run, in USD. Excludes recurring service charges and taxes.

attributes.name: zero_balance_accounts
attributes.description: Count of customer accounts processed that resulted in zero invoice amount due to no usage or offsetting credits.

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Credit or debit adjustment applied to a customer account or invoice to correct billing errors, honor service credits, apply promotional discounts, settle disputes, or write off uncollectible balances. Captures adjustment type (credit memo, debit memo, service credit, write-off, bad debt, rate correction, small balance write-off), adjustment reason code, original invoice reference, adjustment amount, approval status, approver ID, GL impact (revenue reversal or bad debt expense), recovery status for write-off types, and approval workflow audit trail. Supports GAAP revenue recognition adjustments, SOX-controlled approval workflows, and bad debt management per ASC 326 (CECL).

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing adjustment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: adjustment_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who initiated the adjustment. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: adjustment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the adjustment. Required for adjustments exceeding automated approval thresholds. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: ar_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.ar_account. Business justification: Adjustments (credits, debits, write-offs) directly impact AR account balances. While adjustment.invoice_id and adjustment.billing_account_id exist, a direct FK to ar_account is essential for AR sub-le

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account receiving the adjustment. Links to the billing account impacted by this adjustment.

attributes.name: contamination_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.contamination_event. Business justification: Contamination events trigger billing adjustments (surcharges when contamination exceeds contract thresholds, or credits for processing issues). Real-world process requires linking adjustments to conta

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Billing adjustments stem from contract disputes, SLA breaches, or rate corrections. Audit trail requires linking adjustment back to governing agreement for regulatory compliance, revenue recognition c

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing dispute case that triggered this adjustment. Links adjustments to customer dispute resolution workflows.

attributes.name: ghg_emission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ghg_emission. Business justification: Credit memos for service failures require corresponding emission allocation adjustments for accurate carbon accounting. Links billing adjustments to emission records, ensuring regulatory reporting acc

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Safety incidents frequently trigger billing adjustments for service interruptions, equipment damage, liability claims, or route delays. Waste Management operations require tracking which adjustments s

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice being adjusted. Links to the invoice that this adjustment modifies or corrects.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Service-related adjustments (missed pickup credits, contamination charges, SLA breach credits) must reference the offering to categorize revenue impact, track service quality costs, and analyze adjust

attributes.name: reversed_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original adjustment being reversed by this adjustment. Maintains bidirectional linkage for audit trail and correction tracking.

attributes.name: service_exception_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.service_exception. Business justification: Billing adjustments for missed pickups, contamination, access issues, or service failures require linking to the documented service exception with root cause and resolution notes.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_request. Business justification: Credits and adjustments frequently originate from service requests (missed pickups, service failures, complaint resolutions). Tracking this relationship enables root cause analysis of revenue leakage,

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: Billing adjustments frequently result from violation notices: credits for service interruptions due to compliance shutdowns, charge corrections for non-permitted waste acceptance, or penalty-related b

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the adjustment. Used for customer communication, dispute tracking, and audit trails.

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the adjustment in the approval and posting workflow. Determines whether the adjustment has impacted financial statements and customer balances. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|rejected|posted|reversed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adjustment indicating the nature of the correction or modification. Determines accounting treatment and approval workflow requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_memo|debit_memo|service_credit|write_off|bad_debt|rate_correction|small_balance_write_off|promotional_discount|dispute_settlement|billing_error_correction — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the adjustment. Positive values represent debits (charges to customer), negative values represent credits (refunds or reductions). Expressed in the account's billing currency.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the approval workflow for this adjustment. Tracks whether required management authorization has been obtained per SOX-controlled approval thresholds.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the adjustment was approved by authorized personnel. Critical for SOX compliance and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: bad_debt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment represents a bad debt write-off or uncollectible balance. Used for bad debt reserve calculations per ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) standard.

attributes.name: corrected_charge_amount
attributes.description: Corrected invoice line item amount after adjustment. Used for billing error analysis and process improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the adjustment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the adjustment amount. Supports multi-currency billing operations.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer was notified of the adjustment. Tracks communication timeliness and customer service performance.

attributes.name: customer_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been notified of this adjustment. Supports customer communication tracking and service quality management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the adjustment becomes effective for revenue recognition and customer billing purposes. May differ from posting date for backdated corrections.

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the source system or third-party system. Supports cross-system reconciliation and audit trail linkage.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the adjustment is posted. Determines whether the adjustment impacts revenue reversal, bad debt expense, or other GL accounts per GAAP requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the adjustment record was last modified. Tracks changes throughout the approval and posting workflow.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text notes providing additional context, justification, or instructions related to the adjustment. Used for audit documentation and customer service reference.

attributes.name: original_charge_amount
attributes.description: Original invoice line item amount before adjustment. Provides context for variance analysis and billing accuracy metrics.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the adjustment was posted to the general ledger and customer account balance. Marks the point at which the adjustment impacts financial statements.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific business reason for the adjustment. Used for root cause analysis, trend reporting, and process improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the adjustment was necessary. Provides business context for audit, compliance, and customer service purposes.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered from a previously written-off balance. Tracks bad debt recoveries for financial reporting and collections performance metrics.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously written-off amount was recovered. Used for bad debt recovery reporting and collections analytics.

attributes.name: recovery_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a written-off balance is eligible for future recovery attempts. Used by collections teams to prioritize recovery efforts.

attributes.name: revenue_impact_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which this adjustment impacts recognized revenue in the current accounting period. Used for revenue recognition reporting per ASC 606 and IFRS 15.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment reverses a previous adjustment. Used to track adjustment corrections and maintain audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: service_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period to which this adjustment applies. Supports revenue recognition and period-specific billing corrections.

products.name: dispute

Integrates with Salesforce CRM case management.

attributes.name: dispute_employee_id

attributes.name: dispute_escalated_to_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor to whom the dispute was escalated for review and decision.

attributes.name: pickup_event_id

attributes.name: route_id

attributes.name: vehicle_id

attributes.name: weight_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.weight_ticket. Business justification: Tonnage and tipping fee disputes require direct access to the weight ticket with certified gross/tare/net weights, scale calibration date, and weighmaster certification for validation.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by the disputed invoice.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp

attributes.name: customer_contact_phone

products.name: payment_plan
products.description: Structured installment arrangement established for customers unable to pay their full outstanding AR balance, including individual scheduled installment records. Header captures plan start/end dates, total balance enrolled, number of installments, installment amount, frequency, down payment, plan status (active, completed, defaulted, cancelled), and collection agent ID. Each installment detail captures sequence number, scheduled due date, scheduled amount, actual payment date, actual amount paid, installment status (scheduled, paid, missed, waived), and days past due. Supports residential hardship programs, commercial account workout agreements, and enables collections teams to track compliance and trigger dunning on missed installments.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment plan arrangement. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account enrolled in this payment plan.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Payment plans are negotiated as part of contract terms. Collections and credit teams need to trace payment arrangements back to originating agreement for covenant compliance, early termination penalty

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment method (credit card, bank account, etc.) on file for auto-pay or manual installment payments.

attributes.name: primary_payment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections team member or agent responsible for managing this payment plan and following up on missed payments.

attributes.name: quaternary_payment_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this payment plan record.

attributes.name: tertiary_payment_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (customer service representative, collections agent, or system process) who created this payment plan record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the payment plan was approved by management. Null if no approval was required.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment plan required management approval before activation. Typically true for large balances, extended terms, or settlement plans.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this plan. When true, installments are automatically charged to the customers payment method on file on each due date.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Auto Pay Configuration

attributes.name: bankruptcy_case_number
attributes.description: Court-assigned bankruptcy case number if this payment plan is part of a bankruptcy arrangement. Null for non-bankruptcy plans.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_chapter
attributes.description: Type of bankruptcy filing if this payment plan is part of a bankruptcy arrangement. Chapter 7 is liquidation; Chapter 11 is business reorganization; Chapter 13 is individual debt adjustment. Null for non-bankruptcy plans.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: default_threshold_count
attributes.description: Number of missed installments allowed before the plan is automatically moved to defaulted status. Typically 2 for standard plans, may be higher for hardship programs.

attributes.name: down_payment_amount
attributes.description: Initial payment required at plan setup before installment schedule begins. May be zero for certain hardship programs.

attributes.name: down_payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date the down payment was received and processed. Null if no down payment was required or if down payment is still outstanding.

attributes.name: enrolled_balance_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the original balance that was enrolled into this payment plan. May be less than original balance if customer made partial payment or if certain charges were excluded from the plan.

attributes.name: final_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the last installment payment. Represents the planned completion date of the payment plan.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Final Payment Due Date

attributes.name: first_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the first installment payment. Subsequent installments are calculated based on this date and the installment frequency.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - First Payment Due Date

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after installment due date before payment is considered missed. Standard grace period is typically 10 days.

attributes.name: installment_amount
attributes.description: Standard amount due for each installment payment. Calculated as (enrolled_balance_amount - down_payment_amount) / total_installment_count. Final installment may differ to account for rounding.

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which installment payments are scheduled. Monthly is most common; weekly and biweekly are used for residential hardship programs; quarterly may be used for large commercial accounts.

attributes.name: interest_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Total interest charges accrued on this payment plan to date. Zero for interest-free plans.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the enrolled balance, if any. Most residential hardship plans have zero interest; commercial workout agreements may include interest. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard late fee charged for each missed installment payment. May be waived for hardship programs.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Late Fee Configuration

attributes.name: missed_installment_count
attributes.description: Number of scheduled installments that were not paid by their due date. Used to determine default status and trigger collections escalation.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Missed Payment Count

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment plan record was last modified. Updated whenever plan status, payment amounts, or other attributes change.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special terms, customer circumstances, negotiation details, or other relevant information about this payment plan.

attributes.name: original_balance_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding accounts receivable (AR) balance at the time the payment plan was established. Represents the full amount owed before any plan payments were made.

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date the payment plan was completed, defaulted, or cancelled. Null for active or suspended plans. For completed plans, this is the date the final payment was received; for defaulted or cancelled plans, this is the date the plan was terminated.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Arrangement End Date

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the payment plan, formatted as PP-NNNNNNNN.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Arrangement Number

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date when the payment plan became active and the installment schedule began. Typically the date the plan was approved and down payment (if required) was received.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Arrangement Start Date

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment plan. Draft indicates plan is being set up but not yet active; active means plan is in effect and installments are being processed; completed indicates all installments paid successfully; defaulted means customer missed installments per default criteria; cancelled indicates plan was terminated before completion; suspended means plan is temporarily on hold pending resolution of dispute or other issue.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Arrangement Status

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment plan based on the business program and customer segment. Residential hardship programs support customers facing temporary financial difficulty; commercial workout agreements are negotiated arrangements for business accounts; standard installment plans are routine payment schedules; seasonal deferral plans accommodate seasonal business fluctuations; bankruptcy arrangements comply with court-ordered payment terms; settlement plans represent negotiated reduced-balance agreements.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Arrangement Type

attributes.name: remaining_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance remaining on the payment plan after all payments received to date. Calculated as enrolled_balance_amount minus sum of all installment payments received.

attributes.name: settlement_discount_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of discount applied to the original balance as part of a settlement agreement. Zero for standard payment plans.

attributes.name: settlement_discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the original balance as part of a settlement agreement. Zero for standard payment plans. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20% discount).

attributes.name: total_installment_count
attributes.description: Total number of scheduled installment payments in this plan. Typically ranges from 3 to 24 installments depending on plan type and balance amount.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Number of Installments

attributes.name: total_late_fees_assessed
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all late fees assessed on this payment plan due to missed installments.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Late Fee Total

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all payments received against this payment plan, including down payment and all installment payments to date.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Total Payments Received

products.name: payment_plan_installment
products.description: Individual scheduled installment within a payment plan, representing a specific payment obligation on a defined due date. Captures installment sequence number, scheduled due date, scheduled amount, actual payment date, actual amount paid, installment status (scheduled, paid, missed, waived), and days past due. Enables collections teams to track payment plan compliance and trigger dunning actions on missed installments.

attributes.name: payment_plan_installment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment plan installment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: applied_to_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific invoice that this installment payment was applied against in the accounts receivable (AR) system. Used for revenue recognition and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payment plan agreement under which this installment is scheduled.

attributes.name: actual_amount_paid
attributes.description: The actual amount paid by the customer for this installment in USD. May differ from scheduled amount due to partial payments or overpayments. Null if not yet paid.

attributes.name: actual_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer actually made the payment for this installment. Null if not yet paid.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this installment record was first created in the system, typically when the payment plan was established. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance - Audit Trail; Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this installment (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency billing for international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days this installment is overdue, calculated as current date minus scheduled due date. Zero or negative if not yet due or paid on time. Used for aging analysis and dunning triggers.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Accounts Receivable (AR) Aging

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for this missed installment (e.g., 0=no action, 1=reminder, 2=warning, 3=final notice, 4=collections). Used to track collections intensity.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Collections and Dunning

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the scheduled due date before this installment is considered missed and dunning actions begin. Typically set at payment plan level but can be overridden per installment.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Plan Terms

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this installment within the payment plan (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Determines the order of scheduled payments.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Plan Installment Sequencing

attributes.name: installment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this installment: scheduled (not yet due or paid), paid (fully paid), partial (partially paid), missed (past due and unpaid), waived (forgiven by collections), cancelled (plan terminated).
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Installment Status Management

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent dunning communication sent to the customer regarding this installment. Used to schedule next dunning action.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Collections and Dunning

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this installment record, such as status changes or payment application. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance - Audit Trail; Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late fee assessed on this installment due to missed or late payment, in USD. Null if no late fee applies or installment paid on time.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Late Fee Calculation; State Regulatory Limits

attributes.name: late_fee_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the late fee for this installment was waived as a customer service gesture or due to billing error. True if waived, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Fee Waiver Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this installment, such as payment disputes, customer requests, or collections agent observations.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the customer submitted this installment payment (e.g., online portal, mobile app, phone). Null if not yet paid.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Channel Analytics

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used by the customer to pay this installment (e.g., credit card, ACH, check). Null if not yet paid. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ach|check|cash|wire_transfer|auto_pay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or transaction identifier from the payment processor or bank for this installment payment. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: scheduled_amount
attributes.description: The contractually agreed amount due for this installment in USD. Represents the planned payment obligation.

attributes.name: scheduled_due_date
attributes.description: The date on which this installment payment is contractually due from the customer.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or system user who approved the waiver of this installment. Required for SOX audit trail when waivers are granted.

attributes.name: waiver_date

attributes.references: SOX Compliance - Audit Trail; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this installment was waived or forgiven by collections or management. Null if not waived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial_hardship|service_failure|billing_error|customer_retention|bankruptcy|deceased|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Collections Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
