attributes.description: Accounting date for general ledger posting. Determines the accounting period for revenue recognition. May differ from usage_date based on revenue recognition rules.

attributes.name: invoice_line_number
attributes.description: Line number on the invoice where this rated usage appears. Null if not yet invoiced. Enables traceability from invoice back to rated usage.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rated usage record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: other_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Additional surcharges not categorized as fuel or environmental. May include administrative fees, special handling charges, or regulatory compliance fees.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rated usage was manually overridden by a billing analyst. True if rates or amounts were manually adjusted, false for standard rating engine output.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code for manual override if override_flag is true. Null for non-overridden records. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manual override was performed. Null for non-overridden records.

attributes.name: rated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rating engine processed and priced this usage event. Represents the rating execution time, not the usage occurrence time.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rating Process Log

attributes.name: rating_batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the rating engine batch run that processed this usage event. Supports reprocessing and audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Batch Processing Log

attributes.name: rating_error_code
attributes.description: Error code if rating failed or encountered issues. Null for successfully rated records. Used for troubleshooting and reprocessing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Error Code Catalog

attributes.name: rating_error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message describing why rating failed or what issue was encountered. Null for successfully rated records.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Error Handling Standard

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current status of the rating process for this usage event. Indicates whether rating completed successfully or requires intervention.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_rule
attributes.description: Revenue recognition method applied to this rated usage. Determines timing of revenue recognition per GAAP/IFRS standards.

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: Type of waste management service for which usage was rated. Categorizes the billable service line.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Total charge amount before taxes. Sum of base_charge_amount plus all applicable surcharges and fees.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the rated usage. Includes sales tax, use tax, and any other applicable taxes based on service location and tax jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: Final billable amount for this rated usage event. Sum of subtotal_amount and tax_amount. This is the amount that will appear on the customer invoice.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the usage quantity is expressed. Aligns with rate schedule unit definitions.

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: Price per unit applied from the rate schedule. The rate component value used in the charge calculation.

attributes.name: usage_date
attributes.description: Date when the actual usage event occurred (pickup date, disposal date, rental day). Business event date for revenue recognition and reporting.

attributes.name: usage_quantity
attributes.description: Measured quantity of usage that was rated. Value depends on usage type: number of pickups, tons of waste, days of container rental, etc.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Usage Measurement Standard

attributes.name: usage_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the usage event being rated. Distinguishes between different billable usage categories (pickups, weight-based, time-based, fees).

products.name: tax_rule
products.description: Reference configuration defining tax applicability rules for waste management services by jurisdiction. Captures tax authority (state, county, municipality), tax type (sales tax, excise tax, solid waste tax, environmental surcharge tax), applicable service types, tax rate, effective date range, exemption categories, and tax account GL mapping. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance for Waste Management's nationwide operations.

attributes.name: tax_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax rule configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_tax_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this tax rule configuration for production use.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_tax_rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the tax rule that replaces this rule when it expires or is updated, maintaining audit trail of rule changes.

attributes.name: applicable_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste management service types to which this tax rule applies (e.g., residential collection, commercial hauling, landfill disposal, recycling, hazardous waste). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential_collection|commercial_collection|landfill_disposal|recycling|hazardous_waste|transfer_station|waste_to_energy|rolloff_service — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the tax rule configuration: pending review, approved for use, or rejected.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tax rule was approved (format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax: percentage of base amount, flat fee, tiered rate structure, per-unit charge, or compound (tax on tax).

attributes.name: compounding_sequence
attributes.description: Order in which this tax is applied when multiple taxes compound on each other. Lower numbers are applied first.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax rule record was first created in the system (format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for tax amounts (typically USD for U.S. operations).

attributes.name: customer_type_applicability
attributes.description: Customer segments to which this tax rule applies (all, residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, government).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this tax rule expires or is superseded by a new rule. Null indicates an open-ended rule (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this tax rule becomes active and begins applying to transactions (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

attributes.name: exemption_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of exemption categories that exclude customers or transactions from this tax (e.g., nonprofit, government, recycling-only, tax-exempt certificate holders).

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid tax exemption certificate must be on file to apply the exemption (True/False).

attributes.name: flat_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged per transaction or unit when tax is assessed as a flat fee rather than a percentage rate.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in SAP FI/CO where tax revenue or liability is posted for financial reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code for internal allocation and management reporting of tax-related revenue or expenses.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_county
attributes.description: County name where the tax rule applies, if applicable to county-level taxation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_municipality
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the tax rule applies, if applicable to municipal-level taxation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code defining the geographic boundary for tax applicability, used for address-based tax determination.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the tax rule applies (ISO 3166-2:US format).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax rule record was last updated (format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: maximum_tax_amount
attributes.description: Maximum tax amount cap per transaction or billing period, limiting tax liability for high-value transactions.

attributes.name: minimum_tax_amount
attributes.description: Minimum tax amount to be charged regardless of calculated tax, ensuring a floor for tax collection.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special instructions, or business rationale for the tax rule configuration.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the statute, ordinance, or regulation authorizing this tax (e.g., California Revenue and Taxation Code Section 6051, City Ordinance 2023-045).

attributes.name: remittance_due_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) or days after period end when tax remittance payment is due to the authority.

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which collected taxes must be remitted to the tax authority: monthly, quarterly, annually, or on-demand.

attributes.name: reporting_code
attributes.description: Code used for regulatory tax reporting and filing with state or local authorities (e.g., sales tax jurisdiction code, waste tax category code).

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_rule
attributes.description: Accounting rule for when tax revenue is recognized: immediate upon billing, deferred to service delivery, prorated over service period, or milestone-based.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the tax rule, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the tax rule including applicability conditions, exemptions, and business context.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the tax rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax rule: draft, pending approval, active, suspended, expired, or superseded.

attributes.name: tax_authority_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the tax authority (e.g., state FIPS code, county code, municipality tax ID).

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the governmental entity or tax authority imposing the tax (e.g., State of California, Cook County, City of Houston).

attributes.name: tax_authority_type
attributes.description: Level of government or jurisdiction imposing the tax (state, county, municipality, special district, federal, tribal).

attributes.name: tax_base
attributes.description: The base amount or unit upon which the tax is calculated: gross invoice amount, net amount after discounts, tonnage disposed, number of pickups, container count, or service days.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0825 for 8.25% tax rate). Supports up to six decimal places for precision.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Tax rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 8.25 for 8.25% tax). Used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Category of tax being applied: sales tax, excise tax, solid waste tax, environmental surcharge, tipping fee tax, or franchise fee.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Tax Classification

attributes.name: waste_stream_applicability
attributes.description: Types of waste streams subject to this tax rule (e.g., MSW, C&D, hazardous, recyclable materials). Municipal Solid Waste (MSW), Construction and Demolition (C&D) waste classification.
attributes.references: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Waste Classification

products.name: write_off
products.description: Record of an AR balance written off as uncollectible bad debt. Captures write-off date, write-off amount, original invoice references, write-off reason (bankruptcy, customer dispute settled, small balance, statute of limitations), approval authority, GL bad debt expense account, and recovery status (written off, partially recovered, fully recovered). Supports SOX-controlled bad debt management and GAAP bad debt expense recognition.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable write-off record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ar_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AR account from which the balance is being written off. Links to the receivables ledger account.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Write-off approval thresholds and GL treatment vary by contract type and customer segment. Finance needs contract context for bad debt reserve calculations, customer lifetime value assessment, and win

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this write-off. Links to the customer account that holds the uncollectible balance.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Customer Account Master

attributes.name: final_collection_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.collection_action. Business justification: Write-offs occur after collection efforts are exhausted. Write_off table has collection_attempts_count and last_collection_action_date but no FK to the actual collection_action records. Adding final_c

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice that is being written off. May be null if write-off applies to multiple invoices or an account-level balance.

attributes.name: primary_write_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved the write-off. Required for SOX segregation of duties compliance. Links to the user/employee who has write-off approval authority.

attributes.name: tertiary_write_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this write-off record. Used for change accountability and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: accounting_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI/CO document number generated when the write-off was posted to the general ledger. Used for GL reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period in which the write-off is recorded. Format: YYYY-MM. Used for period-end close and financial reporting.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total amount written off as uncollectible bad debt. Represents the AR balance that is being removed from the books.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: The organizational level of the approver. Values: supervisor (up to $1K), manager (up to $10K), director (up to $50K), vp (up to $250K), cfo (over $250K). Ensures write-offs are approved at appropriate authority level per dollar thresholds.
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy - Approval Authority Matrix

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the write-off request. Values: pending (awaiting approval), approved (write-off authorized), rejected (write-off denied). SOX control point.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the write-off was approved. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to supporting documentation for the write-off decision. May include collection notes, legal documents, or bankruptcy filings.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for the original revenue and subsequent write-off. Used for segment reporting and performance analysis.

attributes.name: collection_attempts_count
attributes.description: Total number of collection attempts made before the write-off decision. Demonstrates due diligence for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Collections Policy - Due Diligence Requirements

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with the write-off for management accounting purposes. Used for operational performance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this write-off record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the write-off amount. Typically USD for domestic operations.

attributes.name: days_past_due_at_write_off
attributes.description: Number of days the invoice was past due at the time of write-off. Used for aging analysis and collection effectiveness metrics.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the write-off is recorded. Used for annual financial reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: gl_ar_contra_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Accounts Receivable (AR) Contra Account
attributes.description: The GL contra account code used to reduce the AR balance. Paired with bad debt expense account for double-entry accounting.

attributes.name: gl_bad_debt_expense_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Bad Debt Expense Account
attributes.description: The GL account code to which the bad debt expense is posted. Used for financial statement reporting and GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this write-off record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, context, or special circumstances related to the write-off. Used for operational and audit documentation.

attributes.name: original_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The original total amount of the invoice(s) before any payments or adjustments. Provides context for the write-off magnitude.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_before_write_off
attributes.description: The AR balance outstanding immediately before the write-off was applied. Used for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from write_off_date due to period-end processing.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the write-off. Values: bankruptcy (customer filed bankruptcy), customer_dispute_settled (dispute resolved with write-off), small_balance (balance below collection threshold), statute_of_limitations (collection period expired), business_closure (customer business closed), uncollectible (deemed uncollectible after collection efforts).
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy - Bad Debt Classification

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances leading to the write-off. Provides additional context beyond the reason code.
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy - Bad Debt Documentation

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Total amount recovered after the write-off was recorded. Used to track bad debt recovery and adjust bad debt expense. Null if no recovery has occurred.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Date when recovery payment was received. Null if no recovery has occurred. Used for bad debt recovery reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy - Bad Debt Recovery

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the write-off was reversed. Null if not reversed. Used when write-off was recorded in error or customer subsequently pays.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this write-off has been reversed. True if reversed, False if active. Used for financial statement accuracy.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the write-off was reversed. Required when reversal_indicator is True. Used for audit documentation.

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The service line associated with the original revenue. Values: residential_collection, commercial_collection, recycling, landfill, hazardous_waste, waste_to_energy. Used for bad debt analysis by service type.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this write-off is subject to SOX internal control testing. True for material write-offs requiring enhanced documentation.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AR balance was officially written off as uncollectible bad debt. Used for financial reporting and GAAP revenue recognition.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the write-off transaction. Format: WO-NNNNNNNN. Used for audit trails and external references.
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy - Bad Debt Management

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current status of the write-off record. Values: written_off (initial write-off recorded), partially_recovered (some amount recovered post-write-off), fully_recovered (entire amount recovered), reversed (write-off reversed due to error or policy change).
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy - Bad Debt Recovery Tracking

attributes.name: write_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the write-off transaction was recorded in the system. Used for audit trails and SOX compliance.

products.name: prepayment
products.description: Customer prepayment or deposit held on account before services are rendered, common for new commercial accounts, roll-off container rentals, and municipal contract mobilizations. Captures prepayment amount, receipt date, payment method, prepayment type (deposit, advance payment, retainer), applied amount, remaining balance, expiry date, and refund status. Managed in Oracle AR as an unapplied cash balance until offset against future invoices.

attributes.name: prepayment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prepayment or deposit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service contract or agreement that required or governs this prepayment, particularly for municipal mobilization fees or commercial service agreements.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that made the prepayment. Links to the customer account master record.

attributes.name: prepayment_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or manager who approved the prepayment for posting, required for SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) segregation of duties controls.

attributes.name: prepayment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or system user who recorded the prepayment receipt in the system.

attributes.name: prepayment_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the prepayment record, supporting SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period identifier (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-01) when the prepayment was recognized in the financial statements.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Original total amount of the prepayment received from the customer before any applications or adjustments.

attributes.name: application_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority order for automatic application of this prepayment against invoices when multiple prepayments exist for the same customer account. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of the prepayment that has been applied against invoices or service charges to date.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the prepayment was approved for posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: auto_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prepayment should be automatically applied to new invoices (true) or requires manual application by AR staff (false).

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the company bank account where the prepayment funds were deposited.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the prepayment record was first created in the database.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the prepayment transaction (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: Date when the prepayment funds were deposited into the company bank account, which may differ from receipt date for checks or delayed transfers.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the prepayment is no longer valid for application and may be subject to refund or forfeiture per contract terms. Null for prepayments with no expiration.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier from the source system for cross-system reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: forfeiture_date
attributes.description: Date when the prepayment was forfeited and recognized as revenue per contract terms (e.g., non-refundable deposit after service cancellation). Null if not forfeited.

attributes.name: forfeiture_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or contract clause justifying the forfeiture of the prepayment (e.g., customer cancellation, breach of contract, expiration). Null if not forfeited.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Chart of accounts code for the unapplied cash or customer deposit liability account where the prepayment is recorded.

attributes.name: gl_date
attributes.description: Accounting date when the prepayment was posted to the general ledger, determining the fiscal period for financial reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the prepayment record was last updated, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special instructions, or business notes related to the prepayment (e.g., customer request details, special handling requirements).

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Financial instrument used to remit the prepayment: check, wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), credit card, cash, or money order.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the payment instrument (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace number, credit card authorization code) for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: prepayment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the prepayment transaction, typically system-generated or manually assigned for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: prepayment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the prepayment: active (available for application), partially applied (some balance used), fully applied (entire amount consumed), refunded (returned to customer), expired (past validity period), or forfeited (retained per contract terms).

attributes.name: prepayment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prepayment purpose: deposit (refundable security), advance payment (applied to future invoices), retainer (ongoing service commitment), mobilization fee (municipal contract startup), security deposit (credit risk mitigation), or container deposit (roll-off equipment).

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the prepayment was received from the customer. This is the business event date for the cash receipt.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the prepayment was received, including time zone information for multi-region operations.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to the customer from this prepayment. Null if no refund has been issued.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date when the prepayment or remaining balance was refunded to the customer. Null if no refund has been processed.

attributes.name: refund_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prepayment is eligible for refund to the customer (true) or is non-refundable per contract terms (false).

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method used to return funds to the customer: check, wire transfer, ACH, credit card reversal, or account credit. Null if no refund has been processed.

attributes.name: refund_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference identifier for the refund transaction (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace) for reconciliation purposes. Null if no refund has been processed.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Current unapplied balance available for future invoice applications. Calculated as prepayment_amount minus applied_amount minus any refunds or adjustments.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Expected or actual start date of services for which this prepayment was collected, relevant for advance payments and mobilization fees.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating system that created the prepayment record (e.g., ORACLE_AR, SALESFORCE, WASTE_LOGICS) for data lineage and integration tracking.

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Billing-specific account entity representing the financial relationship between Waste Management and a customer for invoicing and payment purposes. Distinct from the customer master (owned by customer domain) — this entity captures billing address, billing contact, preferred payment method, autopay enrollment, paperless billing flag, billing currency, tax exemption status, tax exemption certificate number, credit rating, and Oracle Revenue Management account number. A single customer may have multiple billing accounts (e.g., separate accounts per service location or business unit).

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_area. Business justification: Billing accounts are domiciled in service areas for franchise compliance, tax jurisdiction determination, service territory management, and regulatory reporting. Essential for municipal contract compl

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer master account in the customer domain. A single customer may have multiple billing accounts for different service locations or business units.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.billing_cycle

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service location associated with this billing account for service delivery and route assignment.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the billing account, often matching the customer legal name or a business unit designation.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Human-readable billing account number displayed on invoices and customer communications. Externally visible identifier.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account indicating its operational state and billing eligibility.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account based on customer segment and service model.

attributes.name: autopay_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in automatic payment processing on invoice due date.

attributes.name: autopay_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer enrolled in automatic payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for billing correspondence and invoice delivery.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, or unit number for billing correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for billing contact to receive invoices and payment notifications.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary billing contact person responsible for invoice receipt and payment coordination.

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for billing contact for payment inquiries and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the billing address.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or division code for organizational hierarchy and reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing account was closed and billing operations ceased.

attributes.name: close_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for account closure (e.g., customer request, non-payment, service termination).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code for internal financial reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for the account before service suspension or payment requirement.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal or external credit assessment classification used for credit limit determination and collections risk management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all billing transactions on this account.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current escalation level in the collections process, indicating severity of delinquency and collection actions taken.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in SAP FI/CO for revenue recognition and accounts receivable posting.

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when a dunning notice or collection communication was sent to the customer.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

products.name: billing_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between a billing account and a circular economy program. It captures customer participation in sustainability initiatives including enrollment terms, performance tracking, and financial incentives. Each record links one billing account to one circular economy program with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management operations, billing accounts (customers) can enroll in multiple circular economy programs simultaneously (e.g., a commercial customer participates in both organics composting and electronics take-back programs), and each program has multiple enrolled customers. The business actively manages these enrollments as operational entities, tracking enrollment dates, participation tiers, customer-specific performance targets, actual diversion volumes, and financial incentives for each customer-program combination. This is not a derived analytical relationship but an operational business process where enrollment records are created, monitored, and updated as part of program management and customer sustainability reporting.

products.name: frequency_plan
products.description: Defines all service frequency configurations available for waste collection services. Captures pickup frequency (daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, on-call, event-based), number of pickups per period, applicable days of week, holiday adjustment rules, and minimum service commitment periods. Used by collection routing, billing rate calculation, and contract terms. This is the SSOT for service frequency definitions referenced across billing and collection domains.
products.reference: Service Frequency Definition / AMCS Route Frequency

attributes.name: frequency_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service frequency plan configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this frequency plan was approved for operational use by authorized management. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the manager or administrator who approved this frequency plan for operational use. Required for plans in active status.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracts using this frequency plan automatically renew at the end of the commitment period. True if auto-renewal is enabled, False if explicit renewal is required.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Defines how often customers are billed for this frequency plan: per individual pickup, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually. Used by billing systems to generate invoices.

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of days advance notice required for customers to cancel or modify service under this frequency plan. Used for contract enforcement and scheduling adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this frequency plan is no longer available for new service contracts. Existing contracts may continue beyond this date. Null indicates no planned end date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this frequency plan becomes available for use in new service contracts and billing configurations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: extra_pickup_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can request additional pickups beyond the standard frequency under this plan. True if extra pickups are permitted (typically with additional charges), False otherwise.

attributes.name: frequency_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the frequency plan: active (available for new contracts), inactive (not available but existing contracts continue), deprecated (being phased out), pending approval (awaiting management approval), or suspended (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: frequency_type
attributes.description: The base frequency pattern for service pickups: daily, weekly, bi-weekly (every two weeks), monthly, on-call (customer-initiated), or event-based (scheduled events).

attributes.name: friday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Fridays. True if Friday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

attributes.name: holiday_adjustment_rule
attributes.description: Defines how service is adjusted when a scheduled pickup falls on a recognized holiday: no service provided, shifted to next business day, shifted to prior business day, service on same day regardless, or customer chooses adjustment method.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this frequency plan record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: maximum_commitment_period
attributes.description: The maximum number of months a customer can commit to this frequency plan in a single contract term. Null indicates no maximum limit.

attributes.name: maximum_skips_per_year
attributes.description: The maximum number of scheduled pickups a customer can skip in a 12-month period under this frequency plan. Null indicates no limit or skip_allowed_flag is False.

attributes.name: minimum_commitment_period
attributes.description: The minimum number of months a customer must commit to this frequency plan when entering a service contract. Used for contract term enforcement and early termination calculations.

attributes.name: monday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Mondays. True if Monday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or operational considerations related to this frequency plan. Used for internal documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: period_unit
attributes.description: The time unit that defines the frequency period: day, week, month, quarter, or year. Used in conjunction with pickups_per_period to calculate service frequency.

attributes.name: pickups_per_period
attributes.description: The number of pickups scheduled within the defined frequency period. For weekly service this is typically 1, for bi-weekly this is 1 per two-week period, for daily this is 5-7 depending on operating days.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the frequency plan used in billing, contracts, and operational systems. Externally visible unique code.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the frequency plan including service scope, pickup schedule details, and any special conditions or restrictions.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the frequency plan (e.g., 'Weekly Residential Pickup', 'Bi-Weekly Commercial Service', 'Daily MSW Collection').

attributes.name: proration_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether billing can be prorated for partial periods when service starts or ends mid-cycle. True if proration is allowed, False if full-period billing applies.

attributes.name: saturday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Saturdays. True if Saturday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service type this frequency plan applies to: residential curbside, commercial dumpster, industrial hauling, municipal contracts, roll-off container rental, or recycling programs.

attributes.name: service_window_end_time
attributes.description: The latest time of day (HH:MM format, 24-hour) that service pickups must be completed for this frequency plan. Used for route scheduling and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: service_window_start_time
attributes.description: The earliest time of day (HH:MM format, 24-hour) that service pickups can begin for this frequency plan. Used for route scheduling and customer communication.

attributes.name: skip_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can request to skip scheduled pickups under this frequency plan (e.g., for vacation holds). True if skips are permitted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: sunday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Sundays. True if Sunday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

attributes.name: thursday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Thursdays. True if Thursday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

attributes.name: tuesday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Tuesdays. True if Tuesday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this frequency plan configuration. Incremented with each modification to support change history and rollback capabilities.

attributes.name: wednesday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this frequency plan includes service pickups on Wednesdays. True if Wednesday is an eligible service day, False otherwise.

products.name: service_rate_schedule
products.description: Master rate schedule defining the complete pricing structure for each service offering by customer segment, geography, and effective period. Captures base rates, fuel surcharges (indexed to DOE diesel price), environmental recovery fees, regulatory compliance fees, contamination surcharges, overweight fees, tipping fee pass-throughs, and applicable taxes. Each surcharge/fee component includes calculation method (flat fee, percentage, index-linked) and effective date range. Supports time-bound rate versioning for annual adjustments. This is the SSOT for service pricing referenced by billing, contract, and sales domains.
products.reference: Rate Schedule / Oracle Revenue Management / SAP SD Pricing Condition

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.description: Method used to calculate environmental recovery fee component. Fixed amount or percentage of base rate.

attributes.name: environmental_recovery_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to recover costs of environmental compliance, monitoring, and sustainability programs. May be fixed or calculated as percentage of base rate.

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of base rate applied as fuel surcharge when method is percentage. Null for other methods.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: overweight_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged per unit (ton or pound) when container or load weight exceeds the standard weight limit included in base rate.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_status

attributes.name: rate_version

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_fee

attributes.name: tipping_fee_method

attributes.name: tipping_fee_passthrough
attributes.description: Landfill or disposal facility tipping fee per ton passed through to customer. Reflects actual disposal costs at destination facility.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for weight-based pricing components including standard weight limit and overweight fees.

Each bundle has its own lifecycle independent of component offerings. Referenced by contract and billing domains for bundle-level pricing and fulfillment.

products.name: offering_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between service offerings and regulatory requirements in waste management operations. It captures the Service Compliance Matrix — tracking which regulatory requirements apply to which service offerings, the compliance status of each pairing, audit history, and responsible parties. Each record links one offering to one regulatory requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific compliance obligation.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, a single service offering must comply with multiple regulatory requirements simultaneously (e.g., hazardous waste collection complies with DOT 49 CFR transport rules, EPA RCRA handling requirements, OSHA 1910.120 worker safety standards, and state-specific regulations). Conversely, a single regulatory requirement applies to multiple service offerings (e.g., DOT hazmat transport rules apply to all hazmat collection services, medical waste services, and industrial waste services). The compliance team actively manages the Service Compliance Matrix as an operational artifact, tracking compliance status, conducting audits, maintaining documentation, and assigning responsible parties for each offering-requirement pairing.

products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between offering and employee. It captures the operational assignment of employees to specific service offerings they are qualified and authorized to deliver. Each record links one offering to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, including proficiency levels, assignment dates, and allocation percentages for workforce planning and compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management operations, employees are cross-trained and assigned to deliver multiple service offerings (e.g., a CDL driver may handle residential curbside, commercial FEL, and roll-off services), and each service offering requires multiple employees with different roles and proficiency levels (e.g., medical waste service requires dedicated technicians, drivers, and supervisors). The business actively manages these assignments with proficiency tracking, certification requirements, allocation percentages, and assignment dates for workforce planning, compliance, and route optimization.

It captures the regulatory and operational requirement for each service offering to comply with specific safety programs, tracking certification status, audit schedules, and training completion. Each record links one offering to one safety_program with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, service offerings must comply with multiple safety programs based on the nature of the service (e.g., hazardous waste collection requires OSHA Hazmat, DOT, EPA RCRA, and state-specific programs), and each safety program applies to multiple service offerings across residential, commercial, and specialty services. The business actively manages this compliance relationship through certification tracking, audit scheduling, training completion monitoring, and status reporting—operations managers monitor program compliance across their service portfolio while safety managers track offering coverage across programs.

products.name: disposal_network
products.description: This association product represents the operational disposal network configuration between service areas and landfill sites. It captures the multi-site disposal strategy for each service area, including primary and backup site designations, routing priorities, haul distance logistics, and tonnage allocation planning. Each record links one service area to one landfill site with attributes that govern route optimization, capacity planning, and disposal cost management. This is actively managed by operations teams to balance site capacity utilization, minimize haul costs, and ensure disposal continuity.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, service areas require multi-site disposal strategies for operational resilience and capacity management. A service area routes waste to multiple landfill sites (primary for daily operations, secondary for overflow, backup for contingencies, seasonal for peak periods), and each landfill site receives waste from multiple service areas based on geographic proximity and capacity availability. Operations teams actively manage these disposal network configurations, adjusting site designations, priority rankings, and tonnage allocations based on site capacity, haul economics, and franchise agreement requirements.

Suspended configurations are temporarily inactive but may be reactivated. Planned configurations are approved but not yet effective. Retired configurations are historical records.

products.name: area_regulatory_compliance

It captures the jurisdiction-specific regulatory obligations that apply to each geographic service territory. Each record links one service area to one regulatory requirement with enforcement details, inspection schedules, and compliance tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this territorial compliance relationship. Used by regulatory affairs to manage area-specific compliance obligations and by operations to ensure service delivery meets all applicable regulatory standards.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, each service area is subject to multiple regulatory requirements from different jurisdictional levels (federal EPA rules, state environmental codes, county solid waste plans, municipal ordinances). Conversely, each regulatory requirement applies to multiple service areas across different geographic territories. The business actively manages this territorial compliance register, tracking jurisdiction-specific enforcement authorities, inspection schedules, reporting deadlines, and compliance status for each area-requirement combination.

attributes.name: epa_id_number
attributes.description: Unique EPA identification number assigned to the facility for tracking purposes under federal environmental programs. Required for RCRA hazardous waste facilities and other federally regulated sites.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit expires and the facility must cease permitted activities unless a renewal or extension is granted. Nullable for permits with indefinite terms subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: financial_assurance_amount

attributes.name: inspection_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the regulatory agency conducts inspections of the permitted facility. Determines the cadence of regulatory oversight and compliance verification.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory agency officially issued the permit. May differ from the effective date if the permit is issued in advance of the authorized activity start date.

attributes.name: issuing_agency

attributes.name: issuing_agency_jurisdiction

attributes.name: next_inspection_date

attributes.name: permit_number

attributes.name: permit_status

attributes.name: permit_tier

attributes.name: permit_type

attributes.name: permitted_activities

attributes.name: regulatory_program

products.name: regulatory_requirement

Covers EPA regulations (RCRA, CERCLA, CAA, CWA), OSHA standards (29 CFR 1910, 1926), DOT hazmat transport rules (49 CFR), state solid waste codes, and ISO 14001/45001 framework clauses. Each record captures the regulation citation, regulatory body, applicability scope (facility type, waste stream, operation type), effective date, and compliance obligation type. Used to map permits, inspections, and corrective actions to specific regulatory drivers.

attributes.name: inspection_number

attributes.name: inspection_result

attributes.name: inspection_scope

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion and closure, including any administrative states.

attributes.name: inspector_badge_number

attributes.name: iso_14001_audit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection was conducted as part of an ISO 14001 Environmental Management System audit or certification process.

attributes.name: iso_45001_audit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection was conducted as part of an ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System audit or certification process.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was last updated in the Enviance EHS system. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as major or medium-severity, requiring corrective action within a defined timeframe. Subset of total findings.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as minor or low-severity, requiring corrective action but not posing immediate risk. Subset of total findings.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next inspection of this type is scheduled for this facility, based on regulatory frequency requirements or internal audit schedule.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, context, or comments recorded by the inspector or audit team during the inspection. May include operational observations, best practices noted, or areas of concern.

attributes.name: number_of_findings
attributes.description: Total count of deficiencies, violations, observations, or non-conformances identified during the inspection. Zero indicates no issues found.

attributes.name: regulatory_program

products.name: inspection_finding

Enables granular tracking of inspection outcomes and drives the corrective action workflow. Child entity of inspection.

attributes.name: closure_date

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the finding must be resolved or corrective action completed. Typically set based on severity and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the actual or potential environmental impact of the condition identified in the finding. None indicates no environmental consequence; low indicates minimal impact; medium indicates localized impact; high indicates significant impact; severe indicates widespread or long-term environmental harm.

attributes.name: facility_area
attributes.description: Specific location, department, or operational area within the facility where the finding was identified (e.g., Landfill Cell 3, MRF Sorting Line, Fleet Maintenance Bay, Leachate Collection System). Enables spatial tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: finding_type

attributes.name: health_safety_impact

None indicates no health/safety consequence; low indicates minimal risk; medium indicates manageable risk; high indicates significant risk; severe indicates imminent danger.

attributes.name: inspection_finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the deficiency, observation, or condition identified during the inspection. Includes context, evidence observed, and specific circumstances. Critical for understanding the nature and scope of the finding.

attributes.name: inspection_finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the finding. Open indicates newly identified and not yet addressed; in progress indicates corrective action underway; pending verification indicates action completed awaiting validation; closed indicates verified resolution; deferred indicates postponed resolution with documented justification.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Name of the inspector or auditor who identified and documented this finding. May be an internal auditor, regulatory agency inspector, or third-party auditor.

attributes.name: inspector_organization
attributes.description: Organization or agency the inspector represents (e.g., EPA Region 5, State DEQ, Internal EHS Team, Third-Party Auditor). Provides context for the findings authority and follow-up requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this finding record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context related to the finding. May include inspector observations, management responses, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: notification_date

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal notification of this finding has been sent to responsible parties, management, or regulatory authorities as required.

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the potential penalty amount. Waste Management primarily operates in USD.

attributes.name: potential_penalty_amount

attributes.name: regulation_category

attributes.name: regulatory_citation

attributes.references: EPA Regulations (40 CFR), OSHA Standards (29 CFR), RCRA, Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act

attributes.name: repeat_finding

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Documented root cause of the finding as determined through root cause analysis. Identifies underlying systemic issues rather than symptoms.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the finding. Critical indicates immediate threat to health, safety, or environment requiring urgent action; major indicates significant regulatory or operational risk; moderate indicates manageable risk with defined timeline; minor indicates low-impact issue; informational indicates no immediate action required.

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: verification_method

attributes.name: verified_by

Distinct from inspection findings in that it represents an official agency-issued enforcement document with legal standing and potential financial liability. Sourced from Enviance EHS and SAP EHS.

attributes.description: Actual date when the regulatory agency (EPA, state air quality agency, or local enforcement agency) was notified of the emission event. Used to verify compliance with notification deadlines.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; State Air Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: air_emission_event_status
attributes.description: Current status of the emission event record in the EHS management system. Open indicates active event; under investigation means root cause analysis in progress; corrective action pending means actions identified but not completed; reported means regulatory notification submitted; closed means all actions complete and event resolved.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the root cause of the emission event. Includes equipment failure details, operational upset conditions, weather events, human error, or other contributing factors. Required for regulatory deviation reports.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V Deviation Reporting; 40 CFR Part 70

attributes.name: community_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emission event resulted in off-site impacts, odor complaints, or community concerns. True if complaints were received or visible plume extended beyond facility boundary.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act; State Nuisance Regulations; Community Relations

attributes.name: complaint_count
attributes.description: Number of community complaints received related to this emission event. Includes odor complaints, visible emission concerns, and health-related inquiries.
attributes.references: State Air Quality Regulations; Community Relations Protocols

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of immediate and long-term corrective actions implemented to stop the emission event and prevent recurrence. Includes equipment repairs, operational adjustments, enhanced monitoring, and preventive maintenance measures.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this emission event record was first created in the Enviance EHS system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SOX Data Governance

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the emission event was first detected or identified. May differ from event start time if detection was delayed.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emission event constitutes a deviation from permit requirements under Clean Air Act Title V. True if permit limits were exceeded or monitoring/recordkeeping requirements were not met.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; 40 CFR Part 70.6(a)(3)(iii)(B)

attributes.name: emission_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the estimated emission quantity. Typically pounds or tons for mass-based pollutants, cubic feet or cubic meters for volumetric measurements.
attributes.references: EPA Emissions Reporting Standards; 40 CFR Part 98 (GHG Reporting)

attributes.name: enforcement_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emission event resulted in regulatory enforcement action such as Notice of Violation (NOV), penalty assessment, consent order, or compliance schedule. True if formal enforcement was initiated.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Section 113; State Air Quality Enforcement

attributes.name: estimated_emission_quantity
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of pollutant released during the event. Calculated using emission factors, continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) data, or engineering estimates. Reported in units specified by emission_quantity_unit.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 75 (CEMS); EPA AP-42 Emission Factors; Clean Air Act Title V

attributes.name: event_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the emission event in hours. Calculated from start and end timestamps. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance assessment.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; State Air Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the air emission event concluded or was brought under control. Used to calculate total event duration and emission quantity.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V Deviation Reporting; 40 CFR Part 70

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the air emission event began. Critical for calculating duration and determining regulatory notification deadlines.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V Deviation Reporting; 40 CFR Part 70

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the air emission event. Excess emission indicates permit limit exceedance; SSM (Startup Shutdown Malfunction) covers operational transitions; fugitive emission refers to uncontrolled releases; emergency release covers unplanned incidents; routine release covers normal operations; opacity exceedance indicates visible emission violations.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; 40 CFR Part 64; State Air Quality Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified this emission event record.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SOX Data Governance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this emission event record was last updated in the Enviance EHS system. Tracks changes to event details, corrective actions, or status updates.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SOX Data Governance

attributes.name: monitoring_method
attributes.description: Method used to detect and quantify the emission event. CEMS (Continuous Emission Monitoring System) for real-time data; parametric monitoring for surrogate parameters; visual observation for opacity; calculation using emission factors; engineering estimate for unmonitored sources.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 75 (CEMS); 40 CFR Part 60 (NSPS); Clean Air Act Title V

attributes.name: notification_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which regulatory notification or deviation report must be submitted to the appropriate agency. Calculated based on event type and applicable regulations (typically 24 hours for emergencies, 30 days for deviations).
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; 40 CFR Part 70.6(a)(3)(iii)(B); State Regulations

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify the regulatory agency of the emission event (phone call, email, written report, electronic submission portal, in-person notification).
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; State Air Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emission event triggered a regulatory notification requirement to EPA, state air quality agency, or local enforcement agency. True if immediate notification (within 24 hours) or deviation reporting is required.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; 40 CFR Part 70; State Air Quality Regulations

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty assessed by regulatory agency for the emission event violation, if applicable. Reported in U.S. dollars.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Section 113; State Air Quality Enforcement

attributes.name: permit_limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the permit limit (e.g., pounds per hour, tons per year, parts per million, percent opacity, grains per dry standard cubic foot).
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V Operating Permit; 40 CFR Part 60 (NSPS)

attributes.name: permit_limit_value
attributes.description: The regulatory permit limit for the pollutant and emission unit that was exceeded or approached during this event. Used to determine if event constitutes a deviation or violation.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V Operating Permit; State Air Quality Permits

attributes.name: pollutant_code
attributes.description: EPA-standardized code for the primary air pollutant involved in the emission event (e.g., PM10, PM2.5, SO2, NOx, VOC, CO, CO2e, CH4, H2S). May reference multiple pollutants for complex events.
attributes.references: EPA National Emissions Inventory (NEI); 40 CFR Part 51; Clean Air Act

attributes.name: pollutant_name
attributes.description: Full name of the air pollutant released during the event (e.g., Particulate Matter 10 micrometers, Sulfur Dioxide, Nitrogen Oxides, Volatile Organic Compounds, Carbon Monoxide, Methane, Hydrogen Sulfide).
attributes.references: EPA National Emissions Inventory (NEI); Clean Air Act Criteria Pollutants

attributes.name: preventive_action_planned
attributes.description: Description of planned preventive measures to avoid similar emission events in the future. May include capital improvements, enhanced training, revised procedures, or increased inspection frequency.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Clean Air Act Title V

attributes.name: report_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or tracking identifier assigned by the regulatory agency or internal EHS system for the deviation report or notification associated with this emission event.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V; Enviance EHS System

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Internal classification of emission event severity based on magnitude of exceedance, duration, community impact, and regulatory significance. Minor events have minimal impact; critical events pose significant environmental or health risks.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Internal EHS Protocols

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions at the time of the emission event. Relevant for fugitive dust events, odor complaints, and dispersion modeling. Includes wind speed, wind direction, temperature, precipitation.
attributes.references: EPA Air Quality Dispersion Modeling; State Air Quality Regulations

attributes.name: wind_direction
attributes.description: Wind direction at the time of the emission event (e.g., N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, or degrees from north). Used to assess potential off-site impacts and community exposure.
attributes.references: EPA Air Quality Dispersion Modeling; 40 CFR Part 51 Appendix W

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.description: Wind speed in miles per hour at the time of the emission event. Critical for fugitive emission events and dispersion analysis.
attributes.references: EPA Air Quality Dispersion Modeling; 40 CFR Part 51 Appendix W

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who created this emission event record in the EHS system.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SOX Data Governance

products.name: spill_release
products.description: Records of chemical, fuel, leachate, and hazardous material spills and environmental releases at Waste Management facilities and during transport operations. Tracks spill ID, release type (leachate, fuel, hazmat, stormwater), location (facility, roadway, transfer station), date and time, material released, estimated quantity, affected environmental media (soil, surface water, groundwater), immediate containment actions, regulatory reportability determination (CERCLA RQ threshold, state spill reporting), agency notification date and confirmation, and cleanup completion status. Supports CERCLA Section 103, EPCRA Section 304, and Clean Water Act spill reporting. Sourced from Enviance EHS.
products.reference: CERCLA Section 103 / EPCRA Section 304 / CWA Spill Reporting

This FK links spill records to the resulting violation notice, enabling enforcement acti

attributes.name: agency_notified

attributes.name: containment_actions

attributes.name: corrective_actions

attributes.name: discovery_date

attributes.name: disposal_facility_epa_number

attributes.description: EPA identification number of the disposal facility where contaminated waste was sent.

attributes.name: quantity_unit

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag

attributes.name: release_type

products.name: scheduled_obligation
products.description: Scheduled compliance obligations and recurring regulatory tasks that Waste Management must fulfill on defined frequencies. Covers permit renewal deadlines, quarterly monitoring report submissions, annual regulatory filings, semi-annual compliance certifications, monthly LFG monitoring rounds, and periodic waste characterization sampling. Tracks obligation ID, obligation type, regulatory driver (permit condition or regulation citation), responsible facility and department, due date, recurrence frequency, assigned responsible party, completion status, and days until due. Acts as the compliance calendar and task management backbone. Sourced from Enviance EHS compliance calendar module.
products.reference: Enviance EHS Compliance Calendar / ISO 14001 Clause 6.1.3

attributes.name: agency_contact_email

attributes.name: completed_by

attributes.name: completion_date

attributes.name: completion_timestamp

attributes.name: confirmation_number

attributes.name: days_until_due

attributes.name: documentation_required

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: escalation_date

products.name: audit_program

attributes.name: quantity_unit

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this chemical inventory record was last modified in the Enviance EHS system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: risk_assessment
products.description: EHS risk assessments conducted for Waste Management operations, facilities, and activities under ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 frameworks. Covers job hazard analyses (JHA), process hazard analyses (PHA), environmental aspect and impact assessments, and operational risk reviews. Tracks assessment ID, assessment type, facility and operation scope, assessment date, identified hazard or environmental aspect, associated risk or impact, likelihood rating, severity rating, risk priority number (RPN), existing controls, residual risk level, and recommended additional controls. Supports ISO 14001 Clause 6.1 and ISO 45001 Clause 6.1 hazard identification and risk assessment obligations.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was conducted or completed. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this assessment record.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the risk assessment, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: assessment_reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who reviewed and approved the risk assessment. Typically a senior EHS manager or facility director.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk assessment. Draft indicates initial preparation, In Review indicates management or EHS review in progress, Approved indicates formal acceptance, Active indicates current operational use, Superseded indicates replaced by newer assessment, Archived indicates historical record retention.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the risk assessment methodology applied. Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) evaluates task-level hazards, Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) evaluates process-level risks, Environmental Aspect and Impact Assessment evaluates environmental consequences, and Operational Risk Review evaluates broader operational risks.

attributes.name: associated_risk_or_impact
attributes.description: Description of the potential consequence or impact if the identified hazard or environmental aspect is realized. For safety, examples include injury, illness, or fatality. For environmental, examples include air quality degradation, water contamination, soil pollution, or contribution to climate change (CO2e emissions).

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment has identified the need for formal corrective action to address unacceptable residual risk. True if corrective action is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
