attributes.name: existing_controls
attributes.description: Description of current control measures, safeguards, or mitigation strategies already in place to manage the identified hazard or environmental aspect. Examples include engineering controls (guards, ventilation), administrative controls (procedures, training, permits), or Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements.

attributes.name: hazard_category
attributes.description: Classification of the identified hazard or environmental aspect. Physical hazards include struck-by, caught-in, fall hazards. Chemical hazards include exposure to hazardous substances. Biological hazards include exposure to pathogens. Ergonomic hazards include repetitive motion or lifting. Environmental aspects include emissions, discharges, waste generation. Operational hazards include equipment failure or process upset. Regulatory hazards include non-compliance risk. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical|chemical|biological|ergonomic|environmental|operational|regulatory — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hazard_identified
attributes.description: Description of the specific hazard, environmental aspect, or risk factor identified during the assessment. For occupational safety, examples include struck-by hazards from moving vehicles, exposure to hazardous waste, ergonomic strain, or confined space entry risks. For environmental aspects, examples include air emissions, wastewater discharge, soil contamination, or greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.

attributes.name: iso_clause_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ISO 14001 or ISO 45001 clause that this risk assessment fulfills. Typically Clause 6.1 (Actions to address risks and opportunities) or Clause 6.1.2 (Hazard identification and assessment of risks and opportunities).

attributes.name: likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Numerical rating representing the probability or frequency that the identified hazard or environmental aspect will occur. Typically scored on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is rare and 5 is almost certain. Used in conjunction with severity rating to calculate risk priority.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 6.1, ISO 45001:2018 Clause 6.1, Risk Assessment Best Practices

attributes.name: management_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk assessment was reviewed by senior management as part of the ISO 14001 or ISO 45001 management review process.

attributes.name: management_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment requires formal management review due to high residual risk level or significant operational impact. True if management review is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or reassessment of this risk assessment. ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 require periodic review of risk assessments to ensure continued relevance and accuracy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context related to this risk assessment. May include stakeholder input, lessons learned, or special considerations.

attributes.name: operation_scope
attributes.description: Description of the specific operation, process, activity, or work area covered by this risk assessment. Examples include residential collection route operations, landfill cell compaction, MRF sorting line operations, hazardous waste handling, fleet maintenance activities, or leachate management.

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Description of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required to manage the identified hazard. Examples include hard hats, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, hearing protection, high-visibility vests, or chemical-resistant suits.

attributes.name: recommended_additional_controls
attributes.description: Description of recommended additional control measures, safeguards, or mitigation strategies to further reduce residual risk to an acceptable level. May include engineering improvements, enhanced training, revised procedures, or additional PPE.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 6.1.4, ISO 45001:2018 Clause 6.1.4, OSHA Hierarchy of Controls

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Reference to applicable regulatory requirement, standard, or permit condition that drives this risk assessment. Examples include EPA regulations, OSHA standards (29 CFR 1910), DOT requirements (49 CFR), RCRA requirements, Clean Air Act provisions, or state environmental regulations.
attributes.references: EPA, OSHA, DOT, RCRA, Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: Classification of the remaining risk level after existing controls are applied. Low indicates acceptable risk with current controls. Medium indicates risk requiring monitoring. High indicates risk requiring additional controls. Very High indicates unacceptable risk requiring immediate action.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was formally reviewed and approved by management or EHS leadership.

attributes.name: risk_priority_number
attributes.description: Calculated risk priority score, typically the product of likelihood rating and severity rating. Used to rank and prioritize risks for control implementation. Higher RPN values indicate higher priority for risk mitigation.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, Risk Assessment Best Practices

attributes.name: safety_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of the occupational health and safety impact associated with the identified hazard. Used for ISO 45001 hazard identification and risk assessments.

attributes.name: severity_rating
attributes.description: Numerical rating representing the magnitude of harm or impact if the identified hazard or environmental aspect is realized. Typically scored on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is negligible and 5 is catastrophic. Used in conjunction with likelihood rating to calculate risk priority.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 6.1, ISO 45001:2018 Clause 6.1, Risk Assessment Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this risk assessment data originated. Typically Enviance EHS or SAP EHS module.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment has identified the need for specific training to manage the identified hazard or environmental aspect. True if training is required, False otherwise. Examples include HAZWOPER training, CDL training, confined space entry training, or equipment-specific training.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

products.reference: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) / RCRA Info / SWIS Facility Record

attributes.name: regulated_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulated facility record. Primary key for compliance tracking and regulatory reporting. [ROLE: MASTER_RESOURCE]

attributes.name: primary_regulated_epa_facility_id
attributes.description: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) identifier. Unique federal identifier assigned by EPA for tracking environmental compliance across all federal programs.

attributes.name: active_violations_count
attributes.description: Current number of unresolved regulatory violations at this facility. Calculated from violation_notice records with status = open or pending. Used for compliance risk assessment.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the regulated facility. Used for regulatory correspondence, inspection scheduling, and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building number, suite, or unit. Optional field for additional location details.

attributes.name: applicable_regulatory_programs
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of federal and state environmental programs applicable to this facility. Examples: RCRA Subtitle D, Title V Air, NPDES Water, SPCC, EPCRA Tier II, SWIS. Determines compliance obligations and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the design capacity value. TPD = Tons Per Day (common for landfills and WTE), cubic yards (transfer stations), tons per hour (MRFs).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the facility is located. Used for local jurisdiction compliance and LEA coordination.

attributes.name: compliance_risk_level
attributes.description: Overall compliance risk assessment for the facility. Low = no violations, good compliance history; Medium = minor violations or aging permits; High = multiple violations or major non-compliance; Critical = enforcement action pending or operations at risk. Used for prioritizing compliance resources.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the facility location. Determines applicable national environmental regulations and international reporting requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulated facility record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: design_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum permitted operational capacity of the facility. Units vary by facility type: TPD (Tons Per Day) for landfills and WTE plants, cubic yards for transfer stations, tons per hour for MRFs. Used for permit compliance and capacity planning.

attributes.name: facility_closure_date
attributes.description: Date the facility permanently ceased operations. Null for active facilities. Used for post-closure monitoring and long-term stewardship tracking.

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Internal business identifier code for the facility. Used for cross-system integration with SAP EHS, Enviance, and operational systems.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the regulated facility as registered with regulatory agencies. Used for permit applications, inspection reports, and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: facility_opened_date
attributes.description: Date the facility first began operations. Used for facility age analysis, permit history tracking, and closure planning.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the facility based on its primary operational function. Determines applicable regulatory programs and compliance requirements. MRF = Materials Recovery Facility, WTE = Waste-to-Energy, TSDF = Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: landfill|mrf|transfer_station|wte_plant|tsdf|hauling_depot|collection_yard|maintenance_facility|administrative_office — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. True = certified, False = not certified. Certification demonstrates commitment to environmental performance improvement.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. True = certified, False = not certified. Certification demonstrates commitment to worker safety.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection conducted at this facility. Used for compliance tracking and inspection frequency analysis.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the facility in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, environmental monitoring zone determination, and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: lea_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the Local Enforcement Agency with jurisdiction over this facility. LEAs conduct inspections and enforce state solid waste regulations at the local level.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the facility in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, environmental monitoring zone determination, and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code classifying the facility's primary business activity. Used for regulatory applicability determination and industry benchmarking. Common codes: 562111 (Solid Waste Collection), 562212 (Solid Waste Landfill), 562213 (Solid Waste Combustors and Incinerators), 562920 (Materials Recovery Facilities).

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of the next regulatory inspection. Based on inspection frequency requirements and agency scheduling. Used for preparation and resource planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory or operational notes about the facility. Used for documenting special conditions, historical context, or unique compliance considerations.

attributes.name: operating_permit_number
attributes.description: Primary operating permit number issued by the state or local regulatory agency. Required for legal operation of the facility. Links to detailed permit records in Enviance EHS.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the facility independent of regulatory status. Operational = actively processing waste, Non-operational = temporarily idle, Seasonal = operates during specific periods, Standby = ready but not active, Decommissioned = permanently shut down.

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the primary operating permit. Critical for compliance tracking and permit renewal planning. Facilities cannot operate beyond this date without renewal.

attributes.name: permitted_waste_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste types the facility is permitted to accept. Examples: MSW (Municipal Solid Waste), C&D (Construction and Demolition), industrial, hazardous, medical, e-waste, universal waste. Determines operational scope and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: post_closure_monitoring_end_date
attributes.description: Date when post-closure monitoring obligations end. Typically 30 years after closure for landfills. Null if monitoring not required or facility still active.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D Post-Closure Care Requirements

attributes.name: post_closure_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility requires post-closure environmental monitoring after operations cease. True = monitoring required (typical for landfills), False = no monitoring required. Determines long-term compliance obligations.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D Post-Closure Care Requirements

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the facility location. Used for geographic analysis and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: primary_regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary regulatory contact. Used for regulatory correspondence, inspection notifications, and compliance alerts.

attributes.name: primary_regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary internal contact responsible for regulatory compliance at this facility. Typically the facility manager, EHS manager, or compliance officer.

attributes.name: primary_regulatory_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary regulatory contact. Used for urgent regulatory communications and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: rcra_generator_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Generator Status
attributes.description: RCRA hazardous waste generator classification. LQG = Large Quantity Generator (≥1000 kg/month), SQG = Small Quantity Generator (100-1000 kg/month), VSQG = Very Small Quantity Generator (<100 kg/month). Determines hazardous waste management requirements.

attributes.name: regional_epa_office
attributes.description: EPA regional office with jurisdiction over this facility. Determines which EPA regional office handles permits, inspections, and enforcement actions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: region_1|region_2|region_3|region_4|region_5|region_6|region_7|region_8|region_9|region_10 — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory compliance status of the facility. Active = operational and compliant, Inactive = temporarily non-operational, Pending closure = in closure process, Closed = permanently closed, Suspended = operations halted due to violations, Under review = regulatory investigation in progress.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code for legacy regulatory reporting. Still required by some state agencies and EPA programs. Common codes: 4953 (Refuse Systems), 4212 (Local Trucking Without Storage).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record that originated this regulated facility data. Enviance EHS = primary compliance system, SAP EHS = enterprise EHS module, Manual entry = data entered directly by compliance staff.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the facility is located. Determines applicable state environmental regulations and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: title_v_designation
attributes.description: Clean Air Act Title V operating permit classification. Major source = emissions exceed threshold limits, Minor source = below thresholds, Synthetic minor = voluntarily limited emissions. Determines air quality monitoring and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act Title V (40 CFR Part 70)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulated facility record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

products.name: facility_audit
products.description: This association product represents the execution of an audit program at a specific regulated facility. It captures the audit event including scheduling, execution, findings, and outcomes. Each record links one audit_program to one regulated_facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit execution.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management EHS compliance operations, audit programs are executed across multiple facilities, and each facility is subject to multiple audit programs (ISO 14001, RCRA, OSHA VPP, operational reviews). Compliance managers actively schedule facility audits by selecting facilities for each program cycle, assign auditors, track execution, and manage findings. The facility audit is a recognized operational entity with substantial relationship data including audit dates, results, findings counts, auditor assignments, and certification outcomes.

attributes.name: facility_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this facility audit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audit_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the audit program under which this facility audit was conducted

attributes.name: regulated_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulated facility that was audited

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the audit was completed and findings were finalized.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the audit was conducted at this facility. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: audit_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the audit report generated from this facility audit.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Overall result or outcome of the facility audit. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of this facility audit execution. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: auditor_assigned
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the auditor assigned to conduct this specific facility audit. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: certification_outcome
attributes.description: Certification status resulting from this facility audit, if applicable to external certification programs. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical or high-severity findings identified during this facility audit. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of findings identified during this facility audit. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next audit of this facility under this audit program. Explicitly identified in detection phase.

products.name: permit_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance mapping between permit and regulatory_requirement. It captures the specific requirements that each permit must satisfy and tracks compliance status, applicability determinations, and requirement-specific monitoring and reporting obligations. Each record links one permit to one regulatory_requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In environmental compliance operations, permits must satisfy multiple regulatory requirements simultaneously (e.g., a landfill permit implements RCRA Subtitle D requirements, state solid waste codes, air quality standards, and stormwater management rules). Conversely, each regulatory requirement applies to multiple permits across different facilities and permit types. Compliance officers actively manage these mappings during permit application, renewal, and ongoing compliance monitoring, tracking status, applicability determinations, and requirement-specific obligations for each permit-requirement combination.

attributes.name: permit_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this permit-requirement mapping record. Primary key.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the permit that must satisfy this regulatory requirement

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory requirement that applies to this permit

attributes.name: applicability_determination
attributes.description: Documented determination of how and why this regulatory requirement applies to this specific permit. Captures the legal and operational reasoning for the mapping.

attributes.name: citation_reference
attributes.description: Specific citation or section reference from the regulatory requirement that applies to this permit. Allows for granular tracking when only portions of a requirement apply.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this permit with respect to this specific regulatory requirement. Tracks whether the permit holder is meeting the obligation.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this permit-requirement mapping was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory requirement became applicable to this specific permit. May differ from the requirement's general effective date based on permit-specific circumstances.

attributes.name: exemption_claimed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an exemption from this regulatory requirement has been claimed for this permit. If true, exemption documentation should be maintained.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory requirement ceases to apply to this specific permit. May be due to permit expiration, requirement sunset, or exemption grant.

attributes.name: last_compliance_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which compliance with this requirement was last verified for this permit through inspection, audit, or self-assessment.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this permit-requirement mapping was last modified.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency_override
attributes.description: Permit-specific monitoring frequency that overrides the default monitoring requirement. Captures permit conditions that impose more or less frequent monitoring than the base requirement.

attributes.name: next_compliance_verification_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance verification activity for this permit-requirement combination.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting compliance activities, issues, or special circumstances related to this permit-requirement mapping.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency_override
attributes.description: Permit-specific reporting frequency that overrides the default reporting requirement. Captures permit conditions that impose different reporting schedules than the base requirement.

attributes.name: responsible_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the compliance officer or facility manager responsible for ensuring this specific permit meets this specific requirement.

products.name: srf_production

attributes.name: chlorine_content_percent

attributes.name: co2e_emissions_avoided_tons
attributes.description: Estimated tons of CO2 equivalent greenhouse gas emissions avoided by using SRF instead of fossil fuels. Critical for carbon offset program reporting and ESG disclosures.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SRF batch has received all required environmental and quality certifications for legal sale and use.

attributes.name: contamination_level
attributes.description: Assessment of non-combustible or hazardous material contamination in the SRF batch. Impacts quality classification and end-user acceptance.

attributes.name: conversion_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of input waste successfully converted to SRF, calculated as (SRF output / input volume) * 100. Key performance indicator for production optimization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SRF production record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: destination_facility_name

attributes.name: input_volume_tons

attributes.name: input_waste_stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the waste stream used as feedstock for SRF production. MSW = Municipal Solid Waste, C&D = Construction and Demolition Waste.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SRF production record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of moisture content in the SRF batch. Lower moisture content improves combustion efficiency and energy output.

attributes.name: particle_size_mm
attributes.description: Average particle size of the SRF material in millimeters. Affects combustion efficiency and handling characteristics at end-use facilities.

attributes.name: production_batch_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique batch identifier assigned to the SRF production run for traceability and quality control purposes.

attributes.name: production_cost_per_ton
attributes.description: Total cost per ton to produce the SRF including labor, energy, and processing costs. Used for margin analysis and EBITDA calculations.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date when the SRF production batch was completed. Used for production tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: production_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SRF production batch processing was completed. Used to calculate production duration and throughput rates.

attributes.name: production_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SRF production batch processing began. Enables production cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: production_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SRF production batch. Tracks progression from production through quality testing to shipment.

attributes.name: quality_certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification identifier issued by the testing laboratory confirming SRF quality parameters meet specified standards.

attributes.name: quality_test_date
attributes.description: Date when laboratory quality testing was completed for the SRF batch. Required for certification and customer acceptance.

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: renewable_energy_credit_eligible_flag

attributes.name: revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from the sale of this SRF batch in USD. Used for financial reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Date when the SRF batch was shipped to the end-use destination. Used for inventory management and revenue recognition timing.

attributes.name: srf_output_tonnage
attributes.description: Total weight in tons of SRF produced from the input waste stream. Used for yield calculations and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location or bin identifier where the SRF batch is stored at the production facility prior to shipment. Used for inventory management.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of sulfur content in the SRF batch. Monitored for EPA emissions compliance and air quality standards.
attributes.references: EN 15289 Sulfur Determination, EPA Air Quality Standards

attributes.name: unit_price_per_ton
attributes.description: Price per ton charged for the SRF batch in USD. Varies based on quality classification and market conditions.
