attributes.description: Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) for employee safety during the reporting period, calculated per OSHA standards as incidents per 100 full-time employees. Key social performance metric.
attributes.references: OSHA Recordkeeping Requirements, GRI 403 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: esg_score
attributes.description: Composite ESG performance score assigned by external rating agencies or internal assessment frameworks. Typically scaled 0-100, with higher scores indicating stronger ESG performance.
attributes.references: MSCI ESG Ratings, Sustainalytics ESG Risk Ratings, CDP Scoring Methodology

attributes.name: framework_type
attributes.description: The ESG disclosure framework or standard to which this submission conforms. GRI = Global Reporting Initiative, TCFD = Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures, CDP = Carbon Disclosure Project, SASB = Sustainability Accounting Standards Board, SEC_CLIMATE = SEC Climate Rule, ISSB = International Sustainability Standards Board.
attributes.references: GRI Standards, TCFD Recommendations, CDP Questionnaire, SASB Standards, SEC Climate Disclosure Rule, ISSB Standards

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_managed_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Waste Managed in Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total volume of hazardous waste managed during the reporting period, measured in metric tons. Includes RCRA-regulated hazardous waste handled, treated, stored, and disposed.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C, GRI 306 Waste, EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ESG disclosure record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: lfg_to_rng_conversion_volume_mmbtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Landfill Gas (LFG) to Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Conversion Volume in Million British Thermal Units (MMBtu)
attributes.description: Total volume of landfill gas converted to renewable natural gas during the reporting period, measured in million British thermal units. Represents circular economy and waste-to-energy performance.
attributes.references: EPA Landfill Methane Outreach Program (LMOP), Clean Air Act, GRI 302 Energy

attributes.name: material_topics_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or summary of the material ESG topics addressed in this disclosure (e.g., GHG emissions, waste diversion, water usage, employee safety, community engagement).
attributes.references: GRI Standards Topic-Specific Disclosures, SASB Materiality Map

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, commentary, or context related to this ESG disclosure submission that do not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: publication_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Disclosure Publication Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: The public URL where this ESG disclosure report or filing is published and accessible to stakeholders.
attributes.references: GRI Standards, SEC EDGAR System, CDP Public Disclosure Platform

attributes.name: renewable_energy_consumption_mwh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Consumption in Megawatt Hours (MWh)
attributes.description: Total renewable energy consumed during the reporting period, measured in megawatt hours. Includes energy from CNG, RNG, solar, wind, and other renewable sources.
attributes.references: GRI 302 Energy, TCFD Recommendations, Clean Air Act

attributes.name: renewable_energy_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Percentage of Total Energy Consumption
attributes.description: Percentage of total energy consumption derived from renewable sources. Key sustainability KPI for tracking progress toward renewable energy adoption goals.

attributes.name: restatement_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this disclosure includes restated data from prior reporting periods due to corrections, methodology changes, or improved data quality.

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for any data restatements included in this disclosure, including methodology changes, data corrections, or scope adjustments.

attributes.name: scope_1_emissions_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 1 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions in Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total Scope 1 direct GHG emissions reported in this disclosure, measured in metric tons of CO2 equivalent. Includes emissions from owned or controlled sources such as fleet vehicles and landfill gas.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule, GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: scope_2_emissions_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 2 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions in Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total Scope 2 indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heating, and cooling reported in this disclosure, measured in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule, GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: scope_3_emissions_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions in Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total Scope 3 indirect GHG emissions from value chain activities reported in this disclosure, measured in metric tons of CO2 equivalent. Includes upstream and downstream emissions outside direct control.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard, TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ESG disclosure was formally submitted to the external framework body or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: SEC Climate Disclosure Rule, CDP Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ESG disclosure submission. Tracks progression from draft through final publication or rejection.

attributes.name: total_waste_diverted_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Waste Diverted from Landfill in Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total volume of waste diverted from landfill disposal through recycling, composting, waste-to-energy, and other recovery methods during the reporting period, measured in metric tons.
attributes.references: GRI 306 Waste, EPA Waste Reduction Model (WARM)

attributes.name: waste_diversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total waste diverted from landfill disposal, calculated as diverted waste divided by total waste managed. Key sustainability KPI.
attributes.references: GRI 306 Waste, EPA Waste Reduction Model (WARM)

attributes.name: water_consumption_cubic_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Water Consumption in Cubic Meters
attributes.description: Total volume of water consumed by operations during the reporting period, measured in cubic meters. Includes water used in facilities, fleet maintenance, and operational processes.
attributes.references: GRI 303 Water and Effluents, Clean Water Act

products.name: emission_factor
products.description: Reference table of GHG emission factors used in CO2e calculations across all emission sources. Captures factor name, GHG type (CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs), source category (mobile combustion, stationary combustion, fugitive, process), fuel or activity type, emission factor value, unit (kg CO2e per unit), global warming potential (GWP) basis (AR4, AR5, AR6), factor source (EPA, IPCC, CARB), effective date, and expiry date. Ensures consistent and auditable emission calculations across all reporting.
products.reference: EPA Emission Factors for GHG Inventories / IPCC AR6 GWP Values

attributes.name: emission_factor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the emission factor record. Primary key.

attributes.name: superseded_by_factor_emission_factor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the emission_factor_id that replaces this factor when status is superseded. Null if not superseded. Maintains version lineage for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the emission factor was approved for use. Null if not yet approved. Supports audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval status for use in corporate GHG accounting: approved (validated and authorized for use), pending_approval (under review by sustainability or compliance team), rejected (not approved for use).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved this emission factor for use in corporate GHG accounting. Null if not yet approved. Supports governance and accountability.

attributes.name: biogenic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emission factor accounts for biogenic carbon (carbon from recently living biomass such as RNG, biofuels, or organic waste). True if biogenic; False if fossil-based. Biogenic emissions are often reported separately under GHG protocols.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology or formula used to derive the emission factor (e.g., mass balance, direct measurement, engineering estimation, IPCC Tier 2 approach). Supports transparency and reproducibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this emission factor record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_quality_tier
attributes.description: IPCC data quality tier classification: Tier 1 (default IPCC factors), Tier 2 (country-specific factors), Tier 3 (facility-specific measurements), Tier 4 (continuous monitoring). Higher tiers indicate greater accuracy and specificity.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this emission factor becomes valid and should be used in CO2e calculations. Supports temporal accuracy in emissions reporting.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: emission_factor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the emission factor: active (currently in use), superseded (replaced by newer version), deprecated (no longer recommended), draft (pending approval), or under_review (being validated).

attributes.name: emission_scope
attributes.description: GHG Protocol emission scope classification: Scope 1 (direct emissions from owned/controlled sources), Scope 2 (indirect emissions from purchased energy), or Scope 3 (other indirect emissions in value chain).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this emission factor is no longer valid and should not be used in new calculations. Null if the factor remains current indefinitely. Supports version control and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: factor_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the emission factor used for system integration and reporting automation.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: factor_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the emission factor (e.g., Diesel Combustion - Mobile Sources, Natural Gas Stationary Combustion, Landfill Gas Fugitive Emissions).
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: factor_source
attributes.description: Authoritative source or organization that published the emission factor (e.g., EPA, IPCC, CARB, EIA, DEFRA, GHG Protocol). Ensures traceability and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: factor_source_document
attributes.description: Specific document, publication, or database from which the emission factor was obtained (e.g., EPA Emission Factors for Greenhouse Gas Inventories 2023, IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 2 Chapter 3). Supports audit trail and version control.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: factor_source_url
attributes.description: Web URL or digital reference to the source document for verification and audit purposes. Null if no digital reference is available.

attributes.name: factor_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the emission factor (e.g., kg CO2e per gallon, kg CO2e per kWh, kg CO2e per ton, kg CO2e per mile, kg CO2e per MMBtu). Defines the denominator for emission calculations.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: factor_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the emission factor used in CO2e calculations. Precision to six decimal places to support accurate scientific calculations.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Specific fuel type or activity associated with the emission factor (e.g., Diesel, Gasoline, CNG, RNG, Natural Gas, Propane, Electricity, Waste-in-Place). Null if not applicable to the source category.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic region or jurisdiction for which the emission factor is applicable (e.g., USA, California, European Union, Global). Some factors vary by region due to grid mix, fuel composition, or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: ghg_type
attributes.description: Type of greenhouse gas covered by this emission factor: Carbon Dioxide (CO2), Methane (CH4), Nitrous Oxide (N2O), Hydrofluorocarbons (HFC), Perfluorocarbons (PFC), or Sulfur Hexafluoride (SF6).

attributes.name: gwp_basis
attributes.description: IPCC Assessment Report used for Global Warming Potential values: Second Assessment Report (SAR), Fourth Assessment Report (AR4), Fifth Assessment Report (AR5), or Sixth Assessment Report (AR6). Determines the conversion factors for non-CO2 gases to CO2 equivalents.

attributes.name: gwp_timeframe_years
attributes.description: Time horizon in years over which the Global Warming Potential is calculated (typically 20, 100, or 500 years). Most regulatory frameworks use 100-year GWP.

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: Industry sector or business activity for which the emission factor is most applicable (e.g., Waste Management, Transportation, Energy, Manufacturing). Null if the factor is universally applicable.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this emission factor record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, context, or special instructions for applying this emission factor. May include assumptions, limitations, or guidance for specific use cases.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or voluntary reporting framework for which this emission factor is approved or recommended (e.g., EPA GHGRP, CARB MRR, EU ETS, GRI, TCFD, CDP, SBTi). Supports multi-framework compliance.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: source_category
attributes.description: Category of emission source: mobile combustion (fleet vehicles), stationary combustion (boilers, generators), fugitive emissions (leaks, venting), process emissions (chemical reactions), waste disposal (landfill decomposition), or purchased electricity (grid consumption).
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: uncertainty_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated uncertainty or margin of error associated with the emission factor, expressed as a percentage. Used for sensitivity analysis and data quality assessment in GHG inventories.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories

products.name: circular_economy_program
products.description: Master record of circular economy programs operated by Waste Management including material take-back programs, industrial symbiosis partnerships, organics composting programs, e-waste recycling programs, and construction material reuse initiatives. Captures program name, program type, target material streams, participating customer segments, geographic scope, diversion volume targets, and alignment to Ellen MacArthur Foundation circular economy principles and GRI 306 waste disclosures.
products.reference: Ellen MacArthur Foundation CE Framework / GRI 306

attributes.name: circular_economy_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the circular economy program record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carbon_initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_initiative. Business justification: Circular economy programs can be part of broader carbon reduction initiatives. One program supports one initiative (1:N). New FK needed to link programs to parent initiatives.

attributes.name: operating_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary Waste Management facility (MRF, composting facility, TSDF, or transfer station) that operates or coordinates this circular economy program.

attributes.name: primary_circular_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the person who created this program record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Circular economy programs (organics composting, advanced recycling, reuse initiatives) require tailored safety programs for new service lines. Real business process: safety protocol development for em

attributes.name: srf_production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.srf_production_line. Business justification: Circular economy programs include SRF production as key waste diversion pathway. Links sustainability programs to operational production assets for tracking diversion targets, GHG avoidance, and circu

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Circular economy programs involve vendor partnerships (recycling processors, material recovery facilities, technology providers). While partner_organization_name exists (denormalized), formal vendor l

attributes.name: annual_diversion_target_tons
attributes.description: The target volume of material to be diverted from landfill annually through this program, measured in tons. Key performance indicator for program success and GRI 306 reporting.

attributes.name: annual_operating_cost_usd
attributes.description: The estimated or actual annual operating cost for the program in US dollars, including labor, equipment, facility, and administrative costs. Used for ROI and EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target_usd
attributes.description: The target annual revenue for the program in US dollars. Used for financial performance tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: certification_standards
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of third-party certifications or standards that the program adheres to (e.g., 'ISO 14001', 'Zero Waste Certified', 'Cradle to Cradle', 'LEED Material Credits'). Supports marketing and customer contract requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001, Zero Waste International Alliance, Cradle to Cradle Certified, USGBC LEED

attributes.name: circular_economy_principle_alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Ellen MacArthur Foundation circular economy principles that this program supports (e.g., 'design out waste and pollution', 'keep products and materials in use', 'regenerate natural systems'). Used for ESG narrative reporting.
attributes.references: Ellen MacArthur Foundation Circular Economy Principles

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this program record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cumulative_diversion_actual_tons
attributes.description: The total volume of material actually diverted from landfill since program inception, measured in tons. Updated periodically based on operational data.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The primary operational system of record that provides data for this program (e.g., 'Enviance EHS', 'SAP EHS', 'AMCS Platform', 'Waste Logics'). Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: esg_reporting_framework_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: ESG (Environmental Social Governance) Reporting Framework Alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ESG reporting frameworks that this program supports (e.g., 'GRI 306', 'TCFD', 'CDP Climate', 'SASB Waste Management Standard'). Ensures data collection meets disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: GRI Standards, TCFD Recommendations, CDP Reporting Framework, SASB Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic coverage area for the program (e.g., 'Northeast Region', 'California Statewide', 'Metro Chicago Area', 'National'). Supports regional sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: ghg_emissions_avoided_co2e_tons_annual
attributes.business_glossary_term: GHG (Greenhouse Gas) Emissions Avoided CO2e (Carbon Dioxide Equivalent) Tons Annual
attributes.description: Estimated annual greenhouse gas emissions avoided through material diversion and circular economy activities, measured in metric tons of CO2 equivalent. Supports EPA GHG reporting and Clean Air Act compliance.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98), Clean Air Act

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this program record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and data freshness assessment.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance review of the program against its targets and KPIs. Used for governance and continuous improvement tracking.

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Customer-facing description of the program used in marketing materials, customer portals, and sustainability reports. Communicates program value proposition and participation instructions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special considerations, or operational notes about the program that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: participating_customer_segments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segments eligible to participate in the program (e.g., 'residential', 'commercial', 'industrial', 'municipal', 'institutional'). Defines program scope and market reach.

attributes.name: participation_eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the requirements for customers or partners to participate in the program (e.g., minimum volume commitments, material quality standards, geographic location, contract terms).

attributes.name: partnership_model
attributes.description: The business and operational structure of the program indicating ownership and partnership arrangements. Critical for financial and legal reporting.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric business identifier for the program used in operational systems and reporting (e.g., 'CE-EWASTE-001', 'CE-ORG-COMP-02').

attributes.name: program_end_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual date when the program concluded or is scheduled to conclude. Null for ongoing programs.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: The official business name of the circular economy program (e.g., 'Electronics Take-Back Initiative', 'Organics Composting Partnership', 'C&D Material Reuse Program').
attributes.references: Ellen MacArthur Foundation Circular Economy Principles

attributes.name: program_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the circular economy program officially commenced operations. Used for program maturity analysis and performance trending.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the circular economy program indicating operational state.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the circular economy program based on its operational model and material focus. Aligns with Ellen MacArthur Foundation circular economy strategies.
attributes.references: Ellen MacArthur Foundation Circular Economy Framework

attributes.name: program_website_url
attributes.description: The public-facing website URL for the program where customers and stakeholders can learn more and access participation information.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program record is currently active in the system, inactive but retained for historical reference, or archived for long-term storage.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory requirements that the program must comply with (e.g., 'RCRA Subtitle D', 'State EPR Law', 'Local Organics Diversion Mandate'). Ensures program design meets legal obligations.
attributes.references: RCRA, State Environmental Quality Regulations, Local Solid Waste Ordinances

attributes.name: revenue_model
attributes.description: The primary revenue generation mechanism for the program. Used for financial planning and program sustainability assessment.

attributes.name: target_material_streams
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of material types targeted by this program (e.g., 'electronics, batteries, appliances' or 'food waste, yard waste, biosolids' or 'concrete, asphalt, wood, metal'). Supports GRI 306 waste disclosure requirements.

products.name: sustainability_program_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of customer or facility enrollments in circular economy and sustainability programs. Captures enrollment date, enrolled entity type (residential customer, commercial account, municipal client, facility), program enrolled, enrollment status, material streams included, estimated annual diversion volume, and program exit date. Enables measurement of program participation rates and customer-level sustainability impact reporting.

attributes.name: sustainability_program_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program enrollment record. Primary key for the program enrollment entity.

attributes.name: circular_economy_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_economy_program. Business justification: Enrollments are for specific circular economy programs. One enrollment is for one program (1:N). New FK needed. Removes redundant program_name and program_type strings that can be retrieved from circu

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract under which this program enrollment is established. Links to commercial or municipal service agreements.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer enrolled in the sustainability program. Links to residential, commercial, or municipal customer accounts.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that created the enrollment record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility enrolled in the sustainability program. Applicable when the enrolled entity is a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF), landfill, or Waste-to-Energy (WTE) facility.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Customer facility incidents during circular economy program participation may affect enrollment status or service delivery. Real business process: incident tracking at enrolled customer sites for liab

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that last modified the enrollment record. Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: primary_sustainability_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee serving as the primary account manager or program coordinator for this enrollment. Responsible for customer relationship and program performance.

attributes.name: sla_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Service Level Agreement (SLA) governing the program enrollment terms, performance commitments, and service standards.

attributes.name: certification_standard
attributes.description: External certification or verification standard applicable to this program enrollment. Examples include ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems, LEED certification, Zero Waste certification, and Carbon Neutral certification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the enrollment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated data quality score for this enrollment record, ranging from 0 to 100. Based on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of enrollment data.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the program participation ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended enrollments without a predetermined end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the program benefits and obligations become effective for the enrolled entity. May differ from enrollment date due to processing or setup requirements.

attributes.name: enrolled_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity enrolled in the sustainability program. Distinguishes between customer types and facility types for program participation tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the entity enrolled in the sustainability program. Supports marketing effectiveness analysis and customer acquisition tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the entity was officially enrolled in the sustainability program. Represents the start of program participation for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique enrollment number assigned to the program enrollment for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which the enrollment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and system integration management.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the program enrollment. Tracks the enrollment from initial application through active participation to program exit.

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment should be included in corporate Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting and sustainability disclosures. Supports Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD), Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP), and Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) reporting requirements.
attributes.references: TCFD Framework, CDP Reporting Standards, GRI Standards

attributes.name: estimated_annual_co2e_reduction_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Annual Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Reduction (Tons)
attributes.description: Projected annual reduction in Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions measured in Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) metric tons resulting from this program enrollment. Supports Clean Air Act compliance and voluntary carbon reporting frameworks.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) GHG Reporting Protocol, Clean Air Act

attributes.name: estimated_annual_diversion_volume_tons
attributes.description: Projected annual volume of waste diverted from landfill through this program enrollment, measured in tons. Used for program planning and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact forecasting.
attributes.references: Solid Waste Association of North America (SWANA) Measurement Standards

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the entity exiting the sustainability program. Supports analysis of program retention and customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: incentive_type
attributes.description: Type of incentive offered to the enrolled entity for program participation. Supports program economics and customer engagement strategies.

attributes.name: incentive_value_usd
attributes.description: Monetary value of the incentive provided to the enrolled entity, expressed in United States Dollars (USD). Used for program cost tracking and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment record is currently active and should be included in operational reporting and program management. Supports soft-delete and historical record retention.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the enrollment record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data currency monitoring.

attributes.name: material_streams_included
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste material streams included in the program enrollment. Examples include paper, cardboard, plastics, metals, glass, organics, Municipal Solid Waste (MSW), Construction and Demolition (C&D) waste, and hazardous materials.
attributes.references: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Material Classification

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the program enrollment. Supports operational coordination and customer service.

attributes.name: participation_tier
attributes.description: Tiered classification of program participation level based on volume, performance, or commitment. Supports differentiated service levels and recognition programs.

attributes.name: program_exit_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the entity exited or withdrew from the sustainability program. Populated when enrollment status transitions to completed or cancelled.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment must be included in mandatory regulatory reporting to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), state environmental agencies, or local enforcement authorities.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Business department or division responsible for managing this program enrollment. Examples include Sustainability Operations, Commercial Services, Municipal Services, and Environmental Compliance.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was verified and approved for program participation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of enrollment verification and validation process. Ensures program eligibility and data accuracy before activation.

products.name: fleet_fuel_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of fuel consumption by fleet vehicle and reporting period, capturing diesel, CNG, RNG, and electric energy consumption. Records vehicle ID, fuel type, quantity consumed (gallons, GGE, kWh), distance traveled (miles), fuel efficiency (MPG or MPGe), associated CO2e emissions calculated, fueling location, and data source (Geotab telematics integration). Serves as the primary source for Scope 1 mobile combustion emissions in the GHG inventory and fleet decarbonization tracking.
products.reference: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart C Mobile Combustion / GHG Protocol Scope 1

attributes.name: fleet_fuel_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet fuel consumption record. Primary key for this transactional record.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver operating the vehicle during the consumption period. Supports driver behavior analysis and fuel efficiency training programs.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility or station where the vehicle was fueled. Links to facility master for geographic emissions allocation.

attributes.name: fuel_card_holder_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Card Holder Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Fleet fuel transactions require linking to fuel card holders for cost allocation, carbon accounting, and fraud prevention. Distinct from driver_id which tracks route assignment.

attributes.name: fuel_purchase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.fuel_purchase. Business justification: Direct linkage between fuel consumption records and procurement transactions enables reconciliation, variance analysis, fraud detection, and cost control. Finance reconciles fuel consumption against f

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Vehicle incidents affect fuel consumption records (accidents, breakdowns, fires). Real business process: incident investigation includes fuel system analysis, emissions impact assessment for carbon ac

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material. Business justification: Fleet fuel is a procured material. Linking fuel_type to material master enables procurement optimization, inventory management, standardized material-level emission factors, and spend analysis. Procur

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.report_period. Business justification: Fleet fuel consumption is tracked within reporting periods. One consumption record belongs to one reporting period (1:N). New FK needed. Removes redundant date and string columns.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection or hauling route the vehicle was servicing during the consumption period. Links fuel consumption to operational activity.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fleet vehicle that consumed the fuel. Links to the vehicle asset master record.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Fuel purchases are made from vendors (fuel suppliers, fueling stations). Linking consumption records to vendor enables vendor performance analysis, contract compliance verification, spend management,

attributes.name: carbon_intensity_score
attributes.description: Carbon intensity of the fuel in grams of CO2 equivalent per megajoule (gCO2e/MJ). Used for Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) compliance and renewable fuel pathway verification.

attributes.name: co2e_emissions_metric_tons
attributes.description: Total greenhouse gas emissions in metric tons of CO2 equivalent calculated from fuel consumption using EPA emission factors. Primary metric for Scope 1 mobile combustion emissions inventory.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98, Subpart C)

attributes.name: consumption_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fuel consumption transaction, typically generated by the telematics system or fuel management system.

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the fuel consumption event occurred or was recorded by the telematics system. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fuel consumption record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the quality and reliability of the consumption record. Used to filter data for regulatory reporting and identify records requiring validation.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: System or method from which the fuel consumption data was captured. Critical for data quality assessment and audit trail.

attributes.name: distance_traveled_miles
attributes.description: Total distance traveled by the vehicle during the consumption period in miles. Captured from GPS telematics for fuel efficiency calculations.

attributes.name: emission_factor_kg_co2e_per_unit
attributes.description: Emission factor applied to calculate CO2e emissions, expressed in kilograms of CO2 equivalent per fuel unit (gallon, GGE, kWh, or MMBtu). Source-specific factor based on fuel type.
attributes.references: EPA Emission Factors for Greenhouse Gas Inventories

attributes.name: energy_quantity_kwh
attributes.description: Electrical energy consumed in kilowatt-hours. Applicable to electric and hybrid electric vehicles.

attributes.name: energy_quantity_mmbtu
attributes.description: Total energy content consumed in Million British Thermal Units. Normalized energy measure across all fuel types for consistent emissions calculations.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumption record is included in external ESG reporting frameworks (GRI, TCFD, CDP). True if included in ESG disclosures.
attributes.references: GRI Standards, TCFD Recommendations, CDP Climate Change Questionnaire

attributes.name: fuel_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost of fuel consumed in US dollars. Used for fleet operating cost analysis and sustainability ROI calculations.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_mpg
attributes.description: Fuel efficiency in miles per gallon for liquid fuels. Calculated as distance traveled divided by fuel quantity in gallons.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_mpge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Efficiency Miles Per Gallon Equivalent (MPGe)
attributes.description: Fuel efficiency in miles per gallon equivalent for gaseous and electric fuels. Enables efficiency comparison across fuel types.

attributes.name: fuel_quantity_gallons
attributes.description: Volume of liquid fuel consumed in gallons. Applicable to diesel, gasoline, and biodiesel. Null for gaseous and electric fuels.

attributes.name: fuel_quantity_gge
attributes.description: Volume of gaseous fuel consumed in Gasoline Gallon Equivalent units. Used for CNG and RNG to normalize energy content comparisons.

attributes.name: fueling_location_city
attributes.description: City where the fueling event occurred. Used for geographic emissions reporting and regional sustainability analysis.

attributes.name: fueling_location_country
attributes.description: Country where the fueling event occurred, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. Supports multinational fleet emissions reporting.

attributes.name: fueling_location_state
attributes.description: State or province where the fueling event occurred. Required for state-level GHG reporting and Clean Air Act compliance.

attributes.name: ghg_inventory_category
attributes.description: GHG Protocol inventory category to which this consumption record is allocated. Primarily Scope 1 mobile combustion for direct vehicle fuel use.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard

attributes.name: idle_time_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the vehicle engine was idling during the consumption period. Key metric for fuel waste reduction and emissions optimization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fuel consumption record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality audits.

attributes.name: lcfs_credits_generated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) Credits Generated
attributes.description: Number of LCFS credits generated from low-carbon fuel consumption. Applicable in California and other jurisdictions with carbon credit programs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, anomalies, or operational notes related to the fuel consumption record. Supports audit trail and data quality investigations.

attributes.name: renewable_fuel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fuel consumed is renewable (RNG, biodiesel, renewable electricity). True for renewable fuels, false for fossil fuels. Critical for tracking renewable energy adoption KPIs.

attributes.name: rin_credits_generated
attributes.description: Number of Renewable Identification Number credits generated from renewable fuel consumption. Applicable to RNG and biodiesel usage under EPA Renewable Fuel Standard.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard (40 CFR Part 80)

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Business service line to which the vehicle is assigned. Enables emissions allocation by business unit for sustainability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential_collection|commercial_collection|recycling|landfill|transfer_station|hauling|support — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle consuming fuel (e.g., ASL, FEL, REL, haul truck, service vehicle). Enables fleet composition analysis for decarbonization planning.

products.name: tracked_site
products.description: Master record of all physical sites and facilities tracked within the sustainability program including landfills, MRFs, WTE plants, transfer stations, LFG-to-RNG facilities, and fleet maintenance yards. Captures site name, site type, geographic coordinates, regulatory facility ID (EPA ID, state permit number), operational status, reporting boundary inclusion flag, and applicable emission source categories. Serves as the geographic and organizational anchor for all sustainability data products in this domain.
products.reference: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) / GHG Protocol Organizational Boundary

attributes.name: tracked_site_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tracked site within the sustainability program. Primary key. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: epa_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique facility identifier assigned by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency for regulatory tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_tracked_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this tracked site record.

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Each tracked sustainability site requires applicable safety programs based on operations (landfill, transfer station, MRF). Real business process: site-level safety program assignment for facilities w

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the site including street number and name. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, building, or unit number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: annual_waste_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum annual waste processing or disposal capacity of the site measured in tons per year. Applicable to landfills, MRFs, WTE plants, and transfer stations.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit or division that owns or operates this site within the corporate organizational structure.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_project_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site participates in carbon offset or carbon credit generation projects (e.g., landfill methane capture for carbon credits).

attributes.name: certification_standards
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of environmental or sustainability certifications held by the site (e.g., 'ISO 14001', 'ISO 45001', 'LEED', 'TRUE Zero Waste').
attributes.references: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, LEED, TRUE Certification Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the site is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code assigned to this site for budgeting, expense tracking, and financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the site is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tracked site record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_waste_capacity_tpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Daily Waste Capacity Tons Per Day (TPD)
attributes.description: Maximum daily waste processing or disposal capacity measured in tons per day. TPD = Tons Per Day, a standard industry metric.

attributes.name: data_quality_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the data quality and measurement methodology used for sustainability metrics at this site, aligned with GHG Protocol data quality tiers.

attributes.name: emission_source_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of applicable emission source categories present at this site (e.g., 'stationary_combustion', 'landfill_gas', 'mobile_combustion', 'fugitive_emissions', 'purchased_electricity'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stationary_combustion|landfill_gas|mobile_combustion|fugitive_emissions|purchased_electricity|wastewater_treatment|refrigerants — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program Subpart Categories

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site is included in corporate ESG reporting frameworks such as GRI, TCFD, or CDP disclosures.
attributes.references: GRI Standards, TCFD Framework, CDP Reporting

attributes.name: ghg_scope_1_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site contains direct GHG emission sources owned or controlled by the organization (e.g., landfill methane, on-site combustion).

attributes.name: ghg_scope_2_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site has indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heating, or cooling.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tracked site record is currently active in the sustainability program (True = active, False = archived or inactive).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tracked site record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the site in decimal degrees format, used for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the site in decimal degrees format, used for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special considerations, or contextual information about the site relevant to sustainability tracking.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the site indicating whether it is actively operating, temporarily suspended, permanently closed, or in another lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the site location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary site contact for sustainability program coordination and reporting.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary site manager or sustainability coordinator responsible for this site.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary site contact. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site generates renewable energy through LFG-to-RNG conversion, WTE operations, or other renewable energy systems.

attributes.name: reporting_boundary_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site is included within the organizational boundary for corporate sustainability and greenhouse gas emissions reporting (True = included, False = excluded).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard

attributes.name: site_activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the site was first activated or commissioned for operations.

attributes.name: site_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the site was permanently closed or decommissioned. Null if the site is still active.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Internal business identifier or code assigned to the site for operational tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the facility or site tracked in the sustainability program (e.g., 'Apex Regional Landfill', 'Metro MRF East').

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the site based on its primary operational function. MRF = Materials Recovery Facility, WTE = Waste-to-Energy, LFG = Landfill Gas, RNG = Renewable Natural Gas, TSDF = Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: landfill|mrf|wte_plant|transfer_station|lfg_to_rng_facility|fleet_maintenance_yard|composting_facility|hazmat_tsdf|administrative_office|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: state_permit_number
attributes.description: State-issued environmental permit or license number authorizing the site to operate under state environmental regulations.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Department Permit Standards

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the site is located (e.g., 'CA', 'TX', 'ON').

attributes.name: sustainability_program_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the site was formally enrolled in the corporate sustainability tracking and reporting program.

products.name: ghg_inventory
products.description: Master record representing a complete annual or periodic GHG inventory compilation for a defined organizational boundary and reporting year. Captures inventory year, organizational boundary approach (operational control, equity share, financial control), total Scope 1 CO2e, total Scope 2 CO2e (location-based and market-based), total Scope 3 CO2e by category, biogenic emissions, data quality assessment, verification status, and verifier identity. Serves as the authoritative GHG inventory record submitted to EPA and disclosed in ESG reports.
products.reference: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 / GHG Protocol Corporate Standard / ISO 14064-1

attributes.name: ghg_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GHG inventory record. Primary key.

attributes.name: epa_facility_id
attributes.description: EPA-assigned facility identifier for the reporting entity under the GHG Reporting Rule, if applicable.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.report_period. Business justification: GHG inventories are compiled for specific reporting periods. One inventory for one reporting period (1:N). New FK needed. Removes redundant date columns that can be retrieved from report_period.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GHG inventory was formally approved by management.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who approved this GHG inventory for submission or publication.

attributes.name: base_year
attributes.description: Historical year against which the organization's GHG emissions are tracked and reduction targets are measured (e.g., 2020).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)

attributes.name: base_year_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base Year Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total GHG emissions in the base year, used as the reference point for tracking emissions reductions over time, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)

attributes.name: biogenic_co2_metric_tons
attributes.description: Total CO2 emissions from combustion or decomposition of biomass (e.g., landfill gas methane oxidation, biofuel combustion), reported separately from fossil-based emissions per GHG Protocol guidance, expressed in metric tons.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GHG inventory record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_assessment
attributes.description: Overall assessment of the quality, completeness, and reliability of the data used to compile this GHG inventory: high (primary data, direct measurement, high confidence), medium (mix of primary and secondary data, some estimation), low (significant use of estimates, proxies, or incomplete data).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Chapter 7, ISO 14064-1

attributes.name: emissions_intensity_ratio
attributes.description: GHG emissions per unit of business activity (e.g., metric tons CO2e per ton of waste processed, per million USD revenue, per employee), used to normalize emissions for comparison across time periods or peer organizations.

attributes.name: epa_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GHG inventory was submitted to the U.S. EPA under the GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98), if applicable.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: esg_framework_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Framework Alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of voluntary ESG reporting frameworks and standards to which this GHG inventory aligns (e.g., GRI 305, TCFD, CDP Climate Change, SASB, ISSB).

attributes.name: intensity_metric
attributes.description: Unit of business activity used to calculate the emissions intensity ratio (e.g., tons_waste_processed, revenue_usd, employee_count, vehicle_miles_traveled).

attributes.name: inventory_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the GHG inventory compilation (e.g., INV-2023-001).

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GHG inventory: draft (under preparation), in_review (undergoing internal or external review), approved (finalized and approved by management), submitted (submitted to regulatory or voluntary reporting body), published (publicly disclosed in ESG report).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GHG inventory record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, assumptions, limitations, or contextual information relevant to this GHG inventory.

attributes.name: organizational_boundary_approach
attributes.description: Method used to define organizational boundaries for GHG accounting: operational control (company has full authority over operations), financial control (company directs financial and operating policies), or equity share (proportional to ownership percentage).

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for compiling and preparing this GHG inventory.

attributes.name: restatement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory includes a restatement of previously reported emissions due to changes in calculation methodology, organizational boundary, data corrections, or other material changes (True if restated, False otherwise).

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the reason for restating previously reported emissions (e.g., methodology change, data correction, organizational boundary change, acquisition or divestiture).

attributes.name: scope_1_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 1 Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total direct GHG emissions from sources owned or controlled by the organization (e.g., fleet fuel combustion, landfill gas emissions, stationary combustion), expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: scope_2_location_based_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 2 Location-Based Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heating, and cooling, calculated using average emission factors for the regional grid, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_2_market_based_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 2 Market-Based Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heating, and cooling, calculated using emission factors from contractual instruments (e.g., renewable energy certificates, power purchase agreements), expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_12_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 12 End-of-Life Treatment of Sold Products CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from waste disposal and treatment of products sold by the organization at the end of their life, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_1_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 1 Purchased Goods and Services CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from extraction, production, and transportation of goods and services purchased by the organization, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_2_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 2 Capital Goods CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from extraction, production, and transportation of capital goods purchased by the organization (e.g., equipment, vehicles, buildings), expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_3_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 3 Fuel and Energy Related Activities CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from extraction, production, and transportation of fuels and energy purchased by the organization, not included in Scope 1 or Scope 2 (e.g., upstream emissions of purchased fuels, transmission and distribution losses), expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_4_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 4 Upstream Transportation and Distribution CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from transportation and distribution of products purchased by the organization between tier 1 suppliers and the organization's facilities, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_5_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 5 Waste Generated in Operations CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from third-party disposal and treatment of waste generated in the organization's owned or controlled operations, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_6_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 6 Business Travel CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from transportation of employees for business-related activities in vehicles not owned or operated by the organization, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_7_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 7 Employee Commuting CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from transportation of employees between their homes and worksites, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_category_9_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Category 9 Downstream Transportation and Distribution CO2e Metric Tons
attributes.description: Scope 3 emissions from transportation and distribution of products sold by the organization between the organization's operations and the end consumer, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: scope_3_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Total indirect GHG emissions from value chain activities not owned or controlled by the organization (e.g., purchased goods and services, business travel, employee commuting, waste disposal, downstream transportation), expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: total_co2e_metric_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Metric Tons
attributes.description: Sum of Scope 1, Scope 2 (location-based or market-based as selected), and Scope 3 emissions, representing the organization's total GHG footprint for the reporting period, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: verification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the third-party verification or assurance process was completed and the verification statement was issued.

attributes.name: verification_statement_reference
attributes.description: Document reference, file path, or URL to the verification statement or assurance report issued by the third-party verifier.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Level of third-party verification or assurance obtained for this GHG inventory: not_verified (no external verification), limited_assurance (moderate level of assurance per ISO 14064-3), reasonable_assurance (high level of assurance per ISO 14064-3).

attributes.name: verifier_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party verification body or assurance provider that verified this GHG inventory (e.g., accredited certification body, independent auditor).

products.name: report_period
products.description: Reference record defining the official sustainability reporting periods used across all data products in this domain. Captures period name, period type (annual, quarterly, monthly), start date, end date, fiscal year alignment, calendar year alignment, reporting framework applicability (EPA GHG, CDP, GRI, TCFD), period status (open, closed, verified), and data freeze date. Ensures consistent temporal alignment across GHG inventory, diversion records, and ESG disclosures.
products.reference: GHG Protocol Reporting Period / EPA Annual GHG Report Calendar

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sustainability reporting period. Primary key for this reference entity.

attributes.name: primary_report_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that created this reporting period record.

attributes.name: actual_submission_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the sustainability report or disclosure was submitted for this period.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule, CDP Disclosure Timeline

attributes.name: assurance_level
attributes.description: Level of third-party assurance obtained for this reporting period: limited (review-level), reasonable (audit-level), or none.

attributes.name: baseline_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period serves as a baseline year for carbon reduction targets or sustainability goals.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Science Based Targets Initiative

attributes.name: calendar_month
attributes.description: The calendar month number (1-12) if this is a monthly reporting period, otherwise null.

attributes.name: calendar_quarter
attributes.description: The calendar quarter number (1-4) if this is a quarterly reporting period, otherwise null.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year to which this reporting period belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: cdp_reporting_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is used for voluntary CDP climate change disclosure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reporting period record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_freeze_date
attributes.description: The date after which no further data changes are allowed for this reporting period. Used to ensure data integrity for regulatory and ESG reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance, EPA GHG Reporting Rule

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the reporting period (inclusive). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: epa_ghg_reporting_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting Applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is used for EPA GHG mandatory reporting under 40 CFR Part 98.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month number (1-12) if this is a monthly reporting period, otherwise null.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number (1-4) if this is a quarterly reporting period, otherwise null.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this reporting period belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: gri_reporting_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is used for GRI sustainability reporting standards.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reporting period is currently active and available for use in sustainability data collection and reporting processes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reporting period record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context about this reporting period, including any special circumstances or data quality considerations.

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code for the reporting period used across systems (e.g., '2024Q1', 'FY24', '202401').

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the reporting period (e.g., 'FY2024 Q1', '2024 Annual Report', 'January 2024').

products.name: initiative_safety_analysis
products.description: This association product represents the safety planning relationship between carbon reduction initiatives and Job Hazard Analyses. It captures which JHAs apply to which initiatives during specific project phases, tracking task frequency, crew assignments, training requirements, and initiative-specific safety controls. Each record links one carbon initiative to one JHA with attributes that exist only in the context of this initiative-safety relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management sustainability initiatives, a single carbon initiative (e.g., RNG facility construction, fleet electrification) requires multiple Job Hazard Analyses covering different tasks (excavation, electrical work, confined space entry, vehicle maintenance), and each JHA can apply to multiple initiatives across the organization. The business actively manages these associations by tracking which JHAs apply during which project phases, monitoring training completion, and documenting initiative-specific safety controls that supplement standard JHA procedures.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this initiative-JHA association record

attributes.name: assigned_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically initiative project manager or safety coordinator) who assigned this JHA to the initiative

attributes.business_glossary_term: Initiative Safety Analysis - Carbon Initiative Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carbon reduction initiative requiring safety analysis

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Job Hazard Analysis applicable to this initiative

attributes.description: Date when this JHA was assigned to the initiative for safety planning purposes

attributes.name: crew_size_assigned
attributes.description: Number of crew members assigned to perform this JHA-covered task for this specific initiative (may differ from standard JHA crew size based on initiative scope)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this JHA is no longer applicable to the initiative (aligned with project phase completion or initiative completion)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this JHA becomes applicable to the initiative (aligned with project phase start)

attributes.name: initiative_specific_controls
attributes.description: Additional safety controls or modifications to standard JHA procedures required for this specific initiative (e.g., enhanced PPE for RNG facility work, additional monitoring for methane capture expansion)

attributes.name: jha_applicability_phase
attributes.description: Project phase during which this JHA applies to the initiative (e.g., construction phase for RNG facility build requires excavation JHA, electrical work JHA; operations phase requires different JHAs)

attributes.name: training_completion_required_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which all crew members must complete JHA-specific training before performing tasks on this initiative

products.name: program_task_safety_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the safety requirements and hazard controls that apply when specific job tasks are performed within the context of circular economy programs. It captures program-specific task execution parameters including frequency, crew sizing, PPE requirements, and training status. Each record links one circular economy program to one JHA with attributes that exist only in the context of this program-task relationship.. Existence Justification: Circular economy programs involve multiple distinct job tasks (organics collection, composting operations, MRF sorting, e-waste disassembly, hazmat handling), each requiring its own Job Hazard Analysis. Conversely, a single JHA (e.g., 'Forklift Operation in Enclosed Spaces') applies across multiple circular economy programs (composting, MRF, transfer station operations). The business actively manages program-specific safety parameters including task frequency within each program, crew sizing based on program scale, program-specific PPE requirements for specialized material streams, and training completion tracking per program-task combination.

products.name: program_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between circular_economy_program and employee. It captures the operational assignment of employees to circular economy programs with specific roles, territories, and performance targets. Each record links one circular_economy_program to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management operations, circular economy programs (e.g., electronics take-back, organics composting, industrial symbiosis) require cross-functional teams with multiple employees in different roles (sales, operations, customer service, compliance). Employees routinely support multiple programs across different territories and customer segments. The business actively manages these assignments with specific roles, territories, performance targets for incentive compensation, and required certifications.
