attributes.references: Internal Compensation Framework, FLSA Compensation Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the employee. Used for emergency contact, scheduling communications, and operational coordination.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Preferred or commonly used name for the employee in day-to-day business operations, communications, and system displays. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: sap_personnel_number
attributes.description: Employee personnel number in SAP S/4HANA system. Used for labor cost allocation, time management, and payroll integration across FI/CO modules.

attributes.name: seniority_date
attributes.description: Date used for calculating seniority for union contracts, layoff protection, vacation accrual, and other seniority-based benefits. May differ from hire date due to breaks in service or transfers.
attributes.references: Collective Bargaining Agreement Standards, NLRA Section 8

attributes.name: social_security_number
attributes.description: U.S. Social Security Number for the employee. Used for tax reporting, payroll processing, benefits administration, and government compliance. Highly sensitive and subject to strict access controls.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15, Social Security Act, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for offboarding, final payroll processing, benefits termination, and workforce turnover analytics.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for employment termination. Used for turnover analysis, unemployment claims, and workforce planning. Null for active employees.
attributes.references: EEOC Recordkeeping Requirements, State Unemployment Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: union_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union. Affects labor relations, collective bargaining agreement applicability, dues deduction, and grievance procedures.
attributes.references: NLRA Section 7, Collective Bargaining Agreement Standards

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Primary work location or facility where the employee is based. May be a landfill, MRF, transfer station, fleet maintenance facility, or administrative office.

attributes.name: workday_employee_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) Employee Identifier
attributes.description: External employee identifier from Workday HCM system. Used for integration and cross-system reconciliation with the system of record for HR, payroll, and talent management.

products.name: job_position
products.description: Defines all authorized job positions within Waste Management including CDL driver roles (ASL, FEL, REL operators), MRF sorter, landfill equipment operator, HAZWOPER technician, environmental compliance engineer, fleet mechanic, dispatcher, and management roles. Captures job code, job family, FLSA classification (exempt/non-exempt), pay grade, required CDL class, required certifications, DOT-regulated flag, and headcount authorization. Sourced from Workday HCM position management.

attributes.name: job_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job position. Primary key for the job position entity.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary facility or work location where this position is based (e.g., MRF, landfill, transfer station, district office).

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department or cost center where this position is budgeted and organizationally aligned.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position that this position reports to in the organizational hierarchy. Null for top-level executive positions.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.union_agreement. Business justification: Job positions covered by union agreements should link to the authoritative CBA to ensure pay grades, job classifications, and seniority rules are consistent with negotiated terms. The union_code strin

attributes.name: background_check_level
attributes.description: Level of pre-employment background screening required for the position. Basic includes criminal history, standard adds employment verification, enhanced adds credit and driving record checks.

attributes.name: cdl_class_required
attributes.description: Specific CDL class required for the position. Class A for combination vehicles over 26,001 lbs; Class B for single vehicles over 26,001 lbs; Class C for vehicles carrying hazardous materials or 16+ passengers.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: cdl_endorsements_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required CDL endorsements (e.g., H for Hazardous Materials, N for Tank Vehicles, P for Passenger, T for Double/Triple Trailers). Empty if no endorsements required.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: cdl_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid Commercial Driver License is required for this position. True for driver roles operating commercial vehicles over 26,001 pounds.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: direct_reports_count
attributes.description: Number of employees who directly report to this position. Zero for individual contributor roles.

attributes.name: dot_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is subject to DOT safety regulations including drug and alcohol testing, medical certification, and hours of service requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) 49 CFR Parts 40, 382, 391, 395

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this position definition was closed or superseded. Null for currently active positions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this position definition became effective and available for hiring. Used for position history tracking and workforce planning.

attributes.name: epa_certification_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required EPA certifications (e.g., EPA Section 608 Refrigerant Handling, EPA Lead-Safe Certified, EPA Asbestos Abatement). Empty if no EPA certifications required.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act determining overtime eligibility. Exempt positions are salaried and not eligible for overtime; non-exempt positions are hourly and eligible for overtime pay.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FLSA Regulations 29 CFR Part 541

attributes.name: hazwoper_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response (HAZWOPER) Certification Required
attributes.description: Level of HAZWOPER training required under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120 for positions handling hazardous waste. 8-hour for refresher, 24-hour for occasional site workers, 40-hour for regular hazardous waste operations.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: headcount_authorization
attributes.description: Number of authorized full-time equivalent (FTE) employees for this position. Used for workforce planning and budget management.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad categorization of the position into functional job families for workforce planning and talent management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operations|maintenance|environmental|administrative|management|safety|customer_service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the position within the organization structure, used for career progression and compensation planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|intermediate|senior|lead|manager|director|executive — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified this position record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization with SAP and other systems.

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification required for the position. Used for recruiting and candidate screening.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for the position. Zero for entry-level positions.

attributes.name: osha_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Certification Required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required OSHA certifications (e.g., OSHA 10-Hour, OSHA 30-Hour, Confined Space Entry, Lockout/Tagout, Fall Protection). Empty if no OSHA certifications required.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade assigned to the position defining the salary range and benefits tier. Used for internal equity and market benchmarking.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical demands of the position including lifting requirements, standing/walking duration, exposure to weather, and other physical capabilities needed (e.g., ability to lift 50 lbs, stand for 8+ hours, work in extreme temperatures).
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Essential Functions

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the position as defined in Workday HCM. Used for external reporting and integration with SAP.

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the position including key responsibilities, essential functions, and performance expectations. Used for job postings and performance management.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the position. Active positions are authorized for hiring; frozen positions are temporarily on hold; closed positions are eliminated; pending approval positions await budget authorization.

attributes.name: position_title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position (e.g., Commercial Driver License (CDL) Driver - Automated Side Loader (ASL), Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) Sorter, Landfill Equipment Operator, Environmental Compliance Engineer).

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required Personal Protective Equipment for the position (e.g., hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, high-visibility vest, gloves, respirator, hearing protection).
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 29 CFR 1910.132-138

attributes.name: rcra_training_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires RCRA hazardous waste management training for Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility (TSDF) operations.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) 40 CFR Part 265

attributes.name: safety_sensitive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is classified as safety-sensitive requiring enhanced drug and alcohol testing under DOT or company policy. Includes all CDL drivers, equipment operators, and hazardous waste handlers.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) 49 CFR Part 40

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Standard shift pattern for the position. Day for regular business hours, night for overnight operations, rotating for positions that alternate shifts, on-call for emergency response roles, flexible for positions with variable schedules.

attributes.name: supervisory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position has direct supervisory responsibility for other employees including hiring, performance management, and disciplinary authority.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of time the position requires travel away from primary work location. 0 for no travel, 100 for full-time travel positions.

attributes.name: union_position_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement with a labor union.

attributes.name: work_environment
attributes.description: Primary work environment for the position. Office for administrative roles, field for route drivers and technicians, facility for MRF and landfill operations, mixed for roles with both office and field responsibilities.

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Organizational hierarchy for Waste Management workforce including business units, regions, districts, facilities (MRF, landfill, transfer station, WTE plant), and cost centers. Supports labor cost allocation to SAP FI/CO cost centers and enables workforce reporting by operational unit. Captures unit type, parent unit, facility type, geographic region, SAP cost center code, and responsible manager.
products.reference: Workday HCM Organization / SAP Cost Center

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit within Waste Management's workforce hierarchy.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who serves as the responsible manager or director for this organizational unit. Used for organizational hierarchy, approval workflows, and accountability reporting.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the hierarchy, enabling multi-level organizational structure representation from corporate down to facility level.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.union_agreement. Business justification: Organizational units with union representation should link to the authoritative collective bargaining agreement that governs labor relations in that unit. This ensures consistent application of wage s

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the organizational unit location. Used for facility identification, employee assignment, and operational logistics.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, building, or floor number for the organizational unit location.

attributes.name: budget_amount_annual
attributes.description: Total annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in USD. Used for financial planning, cost control, and performance management. Includes labor, materials, and overhead costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Budget Management Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the organizational unit is located. Used for local labor market analysis and municipal compliance reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the organizational unit operates. Supports multi-national workforce management and country-specific compliance requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for financial transactions and budget reporting for this organizational unit. Typically USD for U.S. operations.

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Current number of active employees assigned to this organizational unit. Updated based on employee assignments and used for utilization analysis and staffing gap identification.

attributes.name: dot_facility_number
attributes.description: Department of Transportation facility registration number for organizational units operating commercial motor vehicles. Required for fleet operations and CDL driver management. Null for non-fleet units.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 390 Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit ceased operations or when the current configuration ended. Null for currently active units. Used for historical reporting and organizational change tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit became operational or when the current configuration became effective. Used for historical workforce analysis and organizational change tracking.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the organizational unit. Used for official communications and administrative correspondence.

attributes.name: epa_facility_id
attributes.description: EPA-assigned facility identification number for organizational units that are regulated environmental facilities (landfills, MRFs, WTE plants, hazardous waste facilities). Used for environmental compliance reporting and permit tracking. Null for non-regulated units.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Specific facility classification for facility-level organizational units. MRF (Materials Recovery Facility) for recycling operations, landfill for waste disposal sites, transfer station for waste consolidation points, WTE (Waste-to-Energy) plant for energy conversion facilities, maintenance depot for fleet servicing, administrative office for non-operational locations, or not applicable for non-facility units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mrf|landfill|transfer_station|wte_plant|maintenance_depot|administrative_office|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SWANA (Solid Waste Association of North America) Facility Classification Standards

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region where the organizational unit operates. Used for regional workforce planning, labor market analysis, and geographic performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: northeast|southeast|midwest|southwest|west|northwest|central|national — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau Geographic Classification Standards

attributes.name: headcount_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of employees that can be assigned to this organizational unit based on operational requirements, facility capacity, or budget constraints. Used for workforce planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Soft delete indicator. True if this organizational unit record has been logically deleted but retained for historical reference, false for active records. Used for data retention and historical reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: operates_holidays
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates on recognized company holidays. True for essential operations (e.g., landfills, emergency response), false for units that close on holidays.

attributes.name: operates_weekends
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates on Saturdays and Sundays. True for units with weekend operations (e.g., collection routes, 24/7 facilities), false for standard Monday-Friday operations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Standard daily end time for operations at this organizational unit in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used for shift scheduling, time and attendance rules, and operational planning.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Standard daily start time for operations at this organizational unit in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used for shift scheduling, time and attendance rules, and operational planning.

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the organizational unit. Active units are fully operational, inactive units are temporarily non-operational, planned units are approved but not yet operational, closed units are permanently shut down, and suspended units are temporarily halted pending review.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the organizational unit. Used for internal communication and employee contact.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the organizational unit location. Supports geographic analysis and local regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: rcra_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act) Permit Number
attributes.description: RCRA permit number for organizational units handling hazardous waste. Required for TSDF (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility) operations. Null for units not handling hazardous waste.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Parts 260-279 Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: safety_zone_classification
attributes.description: OSHA-based safety risk classification for the organizational unit. Low risk for administrative offices, moderate risk for transfer stations, high risk for MRF and collection operations, hazardous for landfills and hazardous waste facilities. Determines PPE requirements, training protocols, and safety inspection frequency.

attributes.name: sap_cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center code associated with this organizational unit for labor cost allocation, financial reporting, and budget tracking. Enables integration between workforce management and financial systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Accounting Standards

attributes.name: sap_profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO profit center code for revenue and profitability reporting at the organizational unit level. Used for P&L analysis and performance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Profit Center Accounting Standards

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the organizational unit is primarily located. Used for state-level labor law compliance, tax reporting, and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the organizational unit location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago). Used for shift scheduling, time and attendance, and cross-regional coordination.

attributes.name: union_representation
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this organizational unit are represented by a labor union. True for unionized units, false for non-union units. Used for labor relations, collective bargaining, and compliance with union agreements.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) Compliance Standards

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the organizational unit used across operational systems and reporting. Typically aligns with SAP organizational unit codes.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the organizational unit (e.g., 'Northeast Region', 'Chicago MRF', 'Southern District').

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit within the hierarchy structure. Corporate represents headquarters, region covers geographic areas, district represents operational territories, facility includes MRF/landfill/transfer station/WTE plant locations, department covers functional groups, and cost center represents financial reporting units.

attributes.name: workday_org_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this organizational unit in the Workday HCM system. Used for integration between lakehouse and source HCM system for employee assignments, payroll, and workforce planning.

products.name: employee_assignment
products.description: Tracks the active and historical assignment of employees to specific job positions, org units, facilities, routes, and shift schedules. Captures assignment start/end dates, primary facility (landfill, MRF, transfer station, collection district), assigned route or work area, shift pattern (day/swing/night/split with start/end times, rotation type), days of week, reporting manager, on-call flag, and SAP labor cost allocation split. Enables workforce deployment tracking and 24/7 scheduling for landfill operations, MRF processing, collection routes, and WTE continuous operations.

attributes.name: employee_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: The SAP Financial Accounting (FI) cost center code to which labor costs for this assignment are allocated. Used for General Ledger (GL) posting and Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary facility where the employee is assigned to work. May reference a landfill, Materials Recovery Facility (MRF), transfer station, Waste-to-Energy (WTE) plant, collection district office, or administrative office.

attributes.name: job_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job position to which the employee is assigned. Links to position master data.

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.site. Business justification: Employees are assigned to specific landfill sites for operational planning, shift scheduling, and labor cost allocation. Complements existing facility_id (asset domain) by providing landfill-specific

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Employees assigned to specific service offerings: hazmat technician to medical waste service, CDL driver to roll-off service. Drives crew scheduling, service delivery tracking, labor cost allocation b

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit (department, division, or business unit) to which the employee is assigned. Used for reporting hierarchy and cost center allocation.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee being assigned. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collection route assigned to the employee. Applicable for drivers and collection crew members. Null for non-route-based assignments.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.shift_schedule. Business justification: Employee assignments should link to the authoritative shift schedule definition to ensure consistency in shift timing, rotation patterns, and staffing requirements. The shift_pattern, shift_start_time

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or special instructions related to this assignment. May include shift preferences, accommodation requirements, or temporary assignment details.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for creating or modifying this assignment. Used for workforce analytics and organizational change tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_hire|promotion|transfer|demotion|reorganization|temporary_coverage|seasonal_demand|return_from_leave — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee assignment indicating whether it is currently active, inactive, temporarily suspended, pending approval, or completed.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment indicating whether it is the employee's primary role, a secondary assignment, temporary coverage, seasonal work, on-call duty, or relief assignment.

attributes.name: cdl_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a valid Commercial Driver's License is required for this assignment. True for driver positions operating vehicles over 26,001 pounds or carrying hazardous materials.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) CDL Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment relationship for this assignment. Full-time for regular employees, part-time for reduced hours, temporary for fixed-term assignments, seasonal for peak period workers, contractor for non-employee labor.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the employee assignment ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended assignments.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the position is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements. Non-exempt positions are eligible for overtime pay.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FLSA Regulations

attributes.name: fte_equivalent
attributes.description: The Full-Time Equivalent value for this assignment, typically 1.00 for full-time, 0.50 for half-time, etc. Used for workforce planning and headcount reporting.

attributes.name: hazmat_endorsement_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a HAZMAT endorsement on the CDL is required for this assignment. True for drivers transporting hazardous waste or materials requiring placarding.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) HAZMAT Regulations

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: The standardized job classification code for this assignment. Examples include codes for Commercial Driver's License (CDL) drivers, MRF sorters, landfill operators, environmental engineers, technicians, and administrative staff.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The human-readable job title for this assignment. Examples: CDL Driver - Residential, MRF Sorter, Landfill Equipment Operator, Environmental Compliance Engineer, Fleet Maintenance Technician.

attributes.name: labor_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the employee's time allocated to this assignment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for full-time, 50.00 for half-time). Used for split assignments and labor cost allocation to multiple cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Labor Cost Allocation

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this assignment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: on_call_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the employee is designated as on-call for this assignment. True indicates the employee must be available for emergency response outside regular shift hours.

attributes.name: osha_training_required_flag

attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether specific OSHA safety training is required for this assignment. True for positions requiring OSHA 10-hour, 30-hour, or specialized training such as HAZWOPER (Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response).
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Training Requirements

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation grade or band assigned to this position. Used for salary administration and compensation planning. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: ppe_assignment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard Personal Protective Equipment package assigned to this position. Examples include codes for basic PPE (hard hat, safety vest, gloves), respiratory protection, fall protection, or specialized hazmat suits.

attributes.name: rotation_type
attributes.description: Indicates the frequency at which the employee's shift pattern rotates. None for fixed schedules, weekly/biweekly/monthly for standard rotations, custom for non-standard rotation patterns. Common in 24/7 landfill and WTE operations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the system of record from which this assignment data originated. Typically Workday HCM for HR assignments, SAP for cost center allocations, or manual for ad-hoc assignments.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this assignment record in the source system. Used for data reconciliation and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: union_code

attributes.name: work_area_code

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: cdl_license
products.description: Tracks Commercial Driver License (CDL) credentials for all DOT-regulated drivers at Waste Management. Captures CDL class (A, B, C), endorsements (hazmat, tanker, doubles/triples), issuing state, license number, issue date, expiration date, DOT medical certificate expiration, random drug test pool enrollment status, and compliance status. Critical for DOT compliance and FMCSA regulatory requirements. Sourced from Workday HCM and cross-referenced with DOT FMCSA records.

attributes.name: cdl_license_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CDL license record in the Waste Management system.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who holds this CDL license. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: The class of CDL license held by the driver. Class A allows operation of combination vehicles over 26,001 lbs GVWR; Class B allows single vehicles over 26,001 lbs; Class C allows vehicles designed to transport 16+ passengers or hazardous materials.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse Query Date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent query to the FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse for this driver. Employers must query the clearinghouse annually and before hiring to check for drug and alcohol violations.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_status
attributes.description: The driver's status in the FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse. Clear indicates no violations; violation_pending indicates unresolved violation; violation_resolved indicates completed return-to-duty process; prohibited indicates driver is not eligible to operate CMV.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the CDL license. Compliant indicates all requirements are met; non-compliant indicates missing or expired documentation; expiring_soon indicates renewal needed within 30 days; suspended or revoked indicates license is not valid for operation.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 383, Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CDL license record was first created in the Waste Management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dot_medical_certificate_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Medical Certificate Expiration Date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the driver's DOT medical examiner certificate. Drivers must maintain a valid medical certificate to operate commercial vehicles. Typically valid for 12-24 months depending on health conditions.

attributes.name: driver_qualification_file_complete
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the driver's qualification file contains all required documents per FMCSA regulations (application, MVR, medical certificate, road test, etc.). True indicates complete; False indicates missing documentation.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CDL endorsements held by the driver. Common endorsements include H (Hazardous Materials), N (Tank Vehicle), T (Double/Triple Trailers), P (Passenger), S (School Bus). Critical for determining which routes and vehicles the driver is qualified to operate.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the CDL license expires. Drivers must renew before this date to maintain DOT compliance. Typically renewed every 4-8 years depending on state regulations.

attributes.name: fmcsa_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Registration Number
attributes.description: The driver's FMCSA registration number used for tracking in the FMCSA Motor Carrier Management Information System (MCMIS). Used for compliance monitoring and safety performance tracking.

attributes.name: hazmat_endorsement_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the HAZMAT endorsement (H endorsement). HAZMAT endorsements require TSA background checks and must be renewed every 5 years. Critical for drivers transporting hazardous waste.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date the CDL license was originally issued or most recently renewed by the state DMV. Used to calculate license tenure and renewal cycles.

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the state that issued the CDL license (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Required for DOT compliance and interstate commerce verification.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 383, ANSI D20 State Codes

attributes.name: last_alcohol_test_date
attributes.description: The date of the driver's most recent alcohol test (random, post-accident, or reasonable suspicion). Used to track testing frequency and compliance with DOT requirements.

attributes.name: last_alcohol_test_result
attributes.description: The result of the driver's most recent alcohol test. Negative indicates BAC below 0.02; positive indicates BAC at or above 0.02; refused indicates driver declined to test; cancelled indicates test was invalidated.

attributes.name: last_drug_test_date
attributes.description: The date of the driver's most recent drug test (random, pre-employment, post-accident, or reasonable suspicion). Used to track testing frequency and compliance with DOT requirements.

attributes.name: last_drug_test_result
attributes.description: The result of the driver's most recent drug test. Negative indicates no substances detected; positive indicates prohibited substances detected; refused indicates driver declined to test; cancelled indicates test was invalidated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CDL license record was last updated in the Waste Management system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_mvr_check_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check Date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent Motor Vehicle Record check performed for this driver. FMCSA requires annual MVR checks for all CDL holders to monitor driving violations and license status.

attributes.name: last_road_test_date
attributes.description: The date of the driver's most recent road test or skills evaluation. Required for initial CDL qualification and may be repeated for new vehicle types or after extended absence from driving.

attributes.name: last_road_test_result
attributes.description: The result of the driver's most recent road test. Passed indicates successful completion; failed indicates did not meet standards; waived indicates test was waived due to prior experience or equivalent certification.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The unique CDL license number issued by the state Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). This is the primary identifier on the physical license card and is used for DOT compliance verification.

attributes.name: mvr_status
attributes.description: Summary status of the driver's most recent MVR check. Clear indicates no violations; violations_minor indicates minor infractions; violations_major indicates serious violations (DUI, reckless driving); suspended or revoked indicates license is not valid.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or comments about the CDL license, such as pending renewals, special circumstances, or compliance issues requiring follow-up.

attributes.name: random_drug_test_pool_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Random Drug Test Pool Enrollment Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver is currently enrolled in the DOT-mandated random drug and alcohol testing pool. All CDL holders performing safety-sensitive functions must be enrolled.

attributes.name: restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of restrictions on the CDL license (e.g., E - No Manual Transmission, L - No Air Brake Equipped Vehicles, O - No Tractor-Trailer, Z - No Full Air Brake). Defines operational limitations for the driver.

attributes.name: self_certification_type
attributes.description: The type of driving the CDL holder has self-certified to perform. Non-excepted interstate is the most common for waste management drivers operating across state lines and subject to full FMCSA regulations.

attributes.name: serious_violations_count
attributes.description: The number of serious traffic violations (DUI, reckless driving, leaving the scene of an accident, etc.) recorded on the driver's MVR within the past 3 years. Two or more serious violations may result in disqualification.

attributes.name: total_violations_count
attributes.description: The total number of traffic violations recorded on the driver's MVR within the past 3 years. Used for safety performance evaluation and driver qualification decisions.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date the driver completed FMCSA-mandated Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT) from a registered training provider. Required for all CDL applicants as of February 2022.

attributes.name: training_provider_registry_number
attributes.description: The FMCSA registry number of the training provider that delivered the driver's Entry-Level Driver Training. Used to verify training was completed by an approved provider.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date the CDL license information was last verified against state DMV records or FMCSA databases. Regular verification ensures data accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or user ID of the HR or safety staff member who last verified the CDL license information and compliance status. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: certification
products.description: Master catalog of all workforce certifications and licenses required or recognized at Waste Management. Includes OSHA 10/30, HAZWOPER 24/40-hour, DOT Hazmat Handler, EPA RCRAInfo, CDL endorsements, first aid/CPR, confined space entry, forklift operator, landfill operator certification, MRF equipment operator, and environmental engineer PE license. Captures certification name, issuing body, validity period, renewal requirements, and whether it is DOT/OSHA/EPA mandated.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: background_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check or security clearance is required to obtain this certification (true for TSA hazmat endorsement, TWIC card) or not (false).
attributes.references: TSA Security Threat Assessment, DOT Hazmat Security

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: For CDL certifications, specifies the license class (A, B, or C). Null for non-CDL certifications.

attributes.name: cdl_endorsement
attributes.description: For CDL endorsements, specifies the endorsement code (H=Hazmat, N=Tank, P=Passenger, S=School Bus, T=Double/Triple Trailers, X=Hazmat+Tank). Null for non-endorsement certifications.

attributes.name: certification_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the certification type (e.g., OSHA10, HAZWOPER40, CDL-A).

attributes.name: certification_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the certification including its purpose, scope, competencies covered, and business value to Waste Management operations.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the certification (e.g., OSHA 10-Hour General Industry, HAZWOPER 40-Hour Initial Training, Commercial Driver License Class A).
attributes.references: OSHA Training Standards, DOT FMCSA Regulations, EPA Training Requirements

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this certification in the company catalog: active (currently recognized and tracked), inactive (no longer offered but historical records exist), deprecated (being phased out), or pending_approval (under review for addition to catalog).

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Category of the certification distinguishing between licenses, certifications, training completions, endorsements, and permits.

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours
attributes.description: Number of continuing education or refresher training hours required per renewal period to maintain this certification. Null if no continuing education is required.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated cost in USD for an employee to obtain this certification, including training fees, exam fees, and application fees. Used for workforce planning and budgeting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this certification was first recognized and added to the company certification catalog.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this certification was deprecated or removed from the active catalog. Null if still active.

attributes.name: epa_program
attributes.description: For EPA certifications, specifies the relevant EPA program or regulation (e.g., RCRAInfo, Section 608 Refrigerant Handling, Asbestos Abatement). Null for non-EPA certifications.

attributes.name: equipment_authorization
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of equipment types or asset classes that this certification authorizes the holder to operate (e.g., Forklift, Front End Loader, Automated Side Loader, MRF Sorting Line). Null if not equipment-specific.
attributes.references: Internal Equipment Safety Standards, OSHA Powered Industrial Truck Standard

attributes.name: exam_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an examination is required to obtain this certification (true) or if completion of training is sufficient (false).

attributes.name: facility_type_authorization
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of facility types this certification authorizes work at (e.g., Landfill, MRF, Transfer Station, TSDF, WTE Facility). Null if not facility-specific.

attributes.name: hazmat_category
attributes.description: For hazardous materials certifications, specifies the category or class of hazmat covered (e.g., RCRA Hazardous Waste, DOT Hazmat Transportation, EPA Universal Waste). Null for non-hazmat certifications.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, EPA 40 CFR Part 262, RCRA Subtitle C

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is legally or operationally required for specific job roles (true) or is optional/recommended (false).

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or agency that issues and governs this certification (e.g., OSHA, EPA, State DMV, NWRA, SWANA).
attributes.references: OSHA, EPA, DOT, State Licensing Authorities, NWRA, SWANA

attributes.name: issuing_body_type
attributes.description: Classification of the issuing authority level (federal agency, state agency, local authority, industry association, or internal company certification).

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Primary job family or role category for which this certification is relevant (e.g., Driver, Technician, MRF Sorter, Facility Operator, Environmental Engineer, Safety Officer).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: medical_exam_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical examination is required to obtain or maintain this certification (true for DOT medical cards, respirator fit testing) or not (false).
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 391, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134

attributes.name: minimum_passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum score or percentage required to pass the certification exam. Null if no exam is required or no minimum score is specified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special instructions, or exceptions related to this certification (e.g., state-specific variations, grandfathering provisions, reciprocity agreements).

attributes.name: online_training_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification can be obtained through online or remote training (true) or requires in-person attendance (false).

attributes.name: osha_standard
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Standard
attributes.description: For OSHA certifications, specifies the relevant OSHA standard or regulation (e.g., 29 CFR 1910.120 for HAZWOPER, 29 CFR 1910.146 for Confined Space). Null for non-OSHA certifications.

attributes.name: prerequisite_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of certification codes that must be held before this certification can be obtained. Null if no prerequisites exist.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate
attributes.description: Identifies the primary regulatory framework that mandates this certification (DOT for commercial driving, OSHA for safety, EPA/RCRA for environmental, state for local requirements, or none if voluntary).
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Regulations, OSHA 29 CFR, EPA 40 CFR, RCRA Subtitle C

attributes.name: renewal_method
attributes.description: Method required to renew the certification: retraining course, examination, continuing education credits, application submission, or automatic renewal.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification requires periodic renewal (true) or is valid indefinitely once obtained (false).

attributes.name: training_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of training hours required to obtain this certification initially (e.g., 10 for OSHA 10-Hour, 40 for HAZWOPER 40-Hour). Null if no formal training hours are specified.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Standards, EPA Training Requirements

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the typical or preferred training provider or vendor for this certification (e.g., internal training department, external training company, community college). Null if multiple providers exist.

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: Standard duration in months that this certification remains valid from the date of issuance before renewal is required. Null if certification does not expire.

products.name: employee_certification
products.description: Transactional record of each certification earned, maintained, or expired for a Waste Management employee. Captures the employee, certification type, issuing organization, certificate number, issue date, expiration date, renewal date, verification status, and compliance flag. Enables proactive expiration alerts for HAZWOPER, CDL medical cards, and OSHA certifications. Supports regulatory audit trails for EPA, OSHA, and DOT inspections.
products.reference: OSHA 29 CFR / DOT 49 CFR / RCRA HAZWOPER

attributes.name: employee_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.certification. Business justification: employee_certification is the transactional record of certifications earned by employees. It currently has certification_type_code and certification_name as denormalized strings. The certification pro

attributes.name: compliance_training_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_requirement. Business justification: Employee certifications fulfill compliance training requirements. Linking enables automated compliance verification, audit support demonstrating regulatory training completion, and alerts for expiring

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who holds this certification. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or license number assigned by the issuing organization. Used for verification and audit purposes. May be a CDL number, OSHA card number, or training certificate ID.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Level or grade of the certification (e.g., Class A CDL, OSHA 10-Hour vs 30-Hour, HAZWOPER 24-Hour vs 40-Hour, Forklift Operator Level 1). Indicates scope of authorization.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Active indicates valid and compliant; expired requires renewal; suspended or revoked indicates regulatory action; pending or in_progress indicates training underway.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120, DOT 49 CFR Part 391, EPA RCRA 40 CFR 265.16

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the certification is currently in compliance (True) or non-compliant (False). Non-compliance may trigger work restrictions or mandatory training.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120, DOT 49 CFR Part 391, EPA RCRA 40 CFR 265.16

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the certification training, examination, and issuance. Used for workforce development budgeting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: document_attachment_path
attributes.description: File path or URI to the scanned copy of the physical certification document, certificate, or license. Used for audit documentation and regulatory inspections.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Additional endorsements or qualifications associated with the certification (e.g., CDL Hazmat endorsement, Tanker endorsement, Air Brake restriction removal). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: exam_score
attributes.description: Score or percentage achieved on the certification examination, if applicable. Used to document competency and meet regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the certification expires and is no longer valid. Critical for compliance tracking and proactive renewal alerts. Null for certifications with no expiration.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120, DOT 49 CFR Part 391.45, EPA RCRA 40 CFR 265.16

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the instructor or trainer who conducted the certification training program.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the certification was originally issued to the employee.

attributes.name: issuing_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or authority that issued the certification (e.g., State DMV, OSHA Training Institute, National Safety Council, EPA-approved training provider).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120, DOT 49 CFR Part 391, EPA RCRA 40 CFR 265.16

attributes.name: job_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is a mandatory requirement for the employees current job role (True) or optional/supplemental (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, verification, or renewal information.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this certification record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the certification must be renewed to maintain continuous compliance. Used for proactive scheduling of refresher training.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or contextual information about the certification (e.g., renewal pending, awaiting verification, special accommodations granted).

attributes.name: passing_score_required
attributes.description: Minimum score or percentage required to pass the certification examination.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory body or authority governing this certification type (e.g., OSHA, DOT, EPA, State DMV, FMCSA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSHA|DOT|EPA|STATE_DMV|FMCSA|NFPA|ANSI|OTHER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910, DOT 49 CFR, EPA 40 CFR

attributes.name: reimbursement_status
attributes.description: Status of employee reimbursement for certification costs, if applicable. Tracks whether the employee has been reimbursed for out-of-pocket training expenses.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date the certification was last renewed or recertified. Tracks ongoing compliance with periodic renewal requirements.

attributes.name: restrictions
attributes.description: Any restrictions or limitations placed on the certification (e.g., corrective lenses required, automatic transmission only, daylight driving only). Comma-separated list.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 383, DOT 49 CFR Part 391

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record from which this certification data originated (e.g., Workday HCM, SAP HCM, manual entry, external training provider import).

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the employee completed the training course or examination required for this certification.

attributes.name: training_hours
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed to earn this certification (e.g., 40 hours for HAZWOPER, 10 hours for OSHA General Industry). Used for compliance documentation and audit trails.

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training was conducted (e.g., facility name, city, online platform).

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or vendor that delivered the training program leading to this certification.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date the certification was last verified with the issuing organization or regulatory authority.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certification has been independently verified with the issuing authority. Critical for audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 391.23, OSHA Compliance Directive CPL 02-02-079

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that performed the verification check.

products.name: training_course
products.description: Master catalog of all training courses offered or required at Waste Management. Includes safety training (OSHA, HAZWOPER, PPE use), DOT driver training, defensive driving, MRF equipment operation, landfill operations, hazmat handling, environmental compliance, CDL pre-trip inspection, and leadership development. Captures course code, delivery method (classroom, online, on-the-job), duration hours, required frequency (annual, biennial, one-time), and regulatory mandate reference.
products.reference: OSHA Training Requirements / DOT Training Standards

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training course. Primary key.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.certification. Business justification: Training courses that award certifications should link to the authoritative certification definition to ensure consistency in certification names, issuing bodies, validity periods, and regulatory mand

attributes.name: compliance_training_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_requirement. Business justification: Training courses implement compliance training requirements. Linking enables curriculum mapping to regulatory mandates, gap analysis for training program completeness, and audit documentation showing

attributes.name: course_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for maintaining and updating this training course. Typically a subject matter expert, training manager, or department head.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Training courses in waste management are often facility-specific (landfill safety protocols, MRF equipment operation, transfer station procedures). Regulatory compliance (OSHA, EPA, RCRA) requires sit

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_line. Business justification: Training courses map to service line requirements: hazmat training for industrial services, CDL training for commercial collection. Drives compliance training planning, onboarding curriculum design, a

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the department or business unit that owns and manages this training course. Used for cost allocation and organizational reporting.

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Safety training courses (LOTO, confined space, hazmat) are delivered under specific safety programs. Enables compliance reporting by program and ensures training aligns with program requirements per O

attributes.name: assessment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course requires a formal assessment, test, or examination for completion. True if assessment is mandatory; false if attendance or participation is sufficient.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of assessment used to evaluate employee competency upon course completion. Written exam is paper or digital test; practical demonstration is hands-on skills evaluation; online quiz is digital assessment; skills test is field performance evaluation; observation is supervisor evaluation; none if no assessment required.

attributes.name: continuing_education_credits
attributes.description: Number of continuing education units (CEUs) or professional development hours awarded upon course completion. Used for professional license maintenance and career development tracking.

attributes.name: cost_per_employee
attributes.description: Direct cost to train one employee in this course, including instructor fees, materials, facility rental, and external vendor charges. Used for training budget planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the training course type. Safety includes OSHA and HAZWOPER; compliance includes DOT and EPA; technical includes equipment operation; operational includes route management and MRF processes; leadership includes management development; administrative includes software and business processes.

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the training course in the learning management system. Used for registration, scheduling, and transcript tracking.

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the training course content, learning objectives, and outcomes. Used for course selection and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: course_materials_description
attributes.description: Description of training materials, resources, and equipment required for course delivery. Examples: student workbook, safety manual, PPE kit, equipment simulator, online learning platform access.

attributes.name: course_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the training course as displayed in catalogs and employee portals.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course. Active courses are available for enrollment; inactive courses are temporarily unavailable; under development courses are being created; retired courses are no longer offered; suspended courses are on hold pending review.

attributes.name: course_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the course category. Examples: OSHA 10-Hour, HAZWOPER 40-Hour, CDL Class A, Defensive Driving, MRF Equipment Operation, Landfill Cell Management, Environmental Monitoring, Leadership Development.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the training course record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training course is delivered to employees. Classroom is instructor-led in-person; online is eLearning; hybrid combines both; on-the-job is hands-on field training; webinar is live virtual; self-paced is asynchronous digital learning.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total calendar days required to complete the training course. Used for multi-day courses and scheduling employee availability.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total instructional time required to complete the training course, measured in hours. Used for scheduling, labor cost planning, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course was retired or discontinued. Null if the course is still active or available. Used for course lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course became available for employee enrollment and scheduling. Used for course lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: instructor_qualification_required
attributes.description: Qualifications, certifications, or credentials required for instructors who deliver this training course. Examples: Certified Safety Professional, OSHA Authorized Trainer, Subject Matter Expert with 5+ years experience.

attributes.name: language_offered
attributes.description: Languages in which the training course is available. Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes. Examples: EN (English), ES (Spanish), FR (French). Used for multilingual workforce training compliance.

attributes.name: last_content_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course content was last reviewed for accuracy, regulatory compliance, and relevance. Used for quality assurance and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the training course record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: maximum_class_size
attributes.description: Maximum number of employees that can be enrolled in a single session of this training course. Used for scheduling, resource planning, and regulatory compliance (e.g., OSHA trainer-to-student ratios).

attributes.name: minimum_passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum score or percentage required to successfully complete the training course and receive certification. Used for assessment validation and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: next_content_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of training course content. Used for proactive course maintenance and regulatory compliance validation.

attributes.name: online_learning_platform_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Online Learning Platform Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Web address or link to the online learning platform where the course is hosted. Used for online and self-paced courses. Null for classroom-only courses.

attributes.name: ppe_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Personal Protective Equipment is required for employees attending this training course. True if PPE is mandatory; false if not required.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Specific PPE items required for employees attending this training course. Examples: hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, high-visibility vest, gloves, respirator.

attributes.name: prerequisite_courses
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of course codes that must be completed before an employee can enroll in this course. Used for learning path sequencing and compliance validation.

attributes.name: recertification_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required recertification or refresher training. Common values: 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), 36 (triennial). Null if recertification is not required.

attributes.name: recertification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course requires periodic recertification or renewal. True if recertification is mandatory; false if one-time completion is sufficient.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course is mandated by federal, state, or local regulation. True if required by law or regulation; false if voluntary or company policy.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulation, standard, or legal requirement that mandates this training. Examples: 29 CFR 1910.120 (HAZWOPER), 49 CFR Part 383 (CDL), 40 CFR Part 258 (Landfill Operations).
attributes.references: OSHA Regulations, DOT Regulations, EPA Regulations

attributes.name: target_job_roles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job roles or positions for which this training course is designed or required. Examples: CDL Driver, MRF Sorter, Landfill Operator, Environmental Engineer, Facility Manager, Technician.

attributes.name: vendor_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the external training vendor or provider if the course is delivered by a third party. Null if training is delivered internally by Waste Management staff.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the training course content. Incremented when course materials, learning objectives, or regulatory requirements are updated. Format: major.minor (e.g., 2.1).

products.name: workforce_training_record

Captures employee, course, completion date, training delivery method, instructor or platform, pass/fail result, score, hours credited, and next due date for recurring training. Supports OSHA recordkeeping requirements, DOT driver qualification file maintenance, and HAZWOPER annual refresher compliance tracking.

attributes.name: workforce_training_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each training event completion record. Primary key for the workforce training record entity.

attributes.name: compliance_training_requirement_id

Linking is critical for regulatory audits (EPA, OSHA, DOT), automated compliance reporting, and tracking which employees have s

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee who completed the training. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: training_course_id
