attributes.name: annual_employer_contribution
attributes.description: Total annual employer contribution amount for this benefit plan in USD. Calculated based on per-period contribution and frequency. Used for financial reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104, IRS Form 5500, ACA Section 6056

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the primary beneficiary designated by the employee for life insurance or retirement benefits. Required for life insurance and 401(k) plans.

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the designated beneficiary to the employee. Used for life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary designation.

attributes.name: carrier_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or policy number provided by the insurance carrier or benefit provider upon successful enrollment. Used for reconciliation and member services.

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Election Date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee elected COBRA continuation coverage after a qualifying event. Nullable if COBRA was not elected.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this enrollment is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of employment. True if the plan qualifies for COBRA; false otherwise.

attributes.name: cobra_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) End Date
attributes.description: Date on which COBRA continuation coverage ends. Typically 18 or 36 months after the qualifying event, depending on the event type. Nullable if COBRA is ongoing or was not elected.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted or paid. Aligns with the payroll cycle for the employee's position.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee, determining who is covered under the benefit plan (employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, full family, or employee plus domestic partner).
attributes.references: ERISA, ACA (Affordable Care Act) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this benefit enrollment. Applicable for family coverage tiers. Used for premium calculation and ACA reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage becomes active and the employee is eligible to use the benefits. This is the start date of coverage.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount deducted from the employee's paycheck per pay period for this benefit plan. Represents the employee's share of the premium or contribution cost in USD.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount contributed by Waste Management per pay period for this benefit plan on behalf of the employee. Represents the employer's share of the premium or contribution cost in USD.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104, IRS Publication 15-B, ACA Section 6055

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enrollment confirmation communication was sent to the employee. Used for audit trail and compliance with ERISA disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee elected or enrolled in the benefit plan. This is the date the enrollment decision was made, which may differ from the effective date.

attributes.name: enrollment_event_type
attributes.description: The triggering event that allowed or required the benefit enrollment. New hire indicates initial enrollment upon employment; annual open enrollment is the yearly election period; qualifying life event (QLE) includes marriage, birth, adoption, or other IRS-defined events; benefit change indicates mid-year plan modification; rehire indicates re-enrollment after returning to employment; leave of absence indicates enrollment during approved leave.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969, HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the employee completed the benefit enrollment. Online portal indicates self-service through Workday; paper form indicates manual submission; phone indicates telephonic enrollment; HR representative indicates assisted enrollment; automatic indicates system-generated enrollment; default indicates passive enrollment into default plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable enrollment confirmation number generated by Workday HCM for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Active indicates coverage is in force; pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date; terminated indicates coverage has ended; suspended indicates temporary hold; waived indicates employee declined coverage; cancelled indicates enrollment was voided.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee must provide evidence of insurability (medical underwriting) for this enrollment. Typically required for supplemental life insurance above guaranteed issue amounts. True if EOI is required; false otherwise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Portability Rules, Insurance Carrier Requirements

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: Current status of the evidence of insurability review process. Not required if EOI is not needed; pending if submitted and under review; approved if underwriting accepted; denied if underwriting rejected; incomplete if additional information is needed.
attributes.references: HIPAA Portability Rules, Insurance Carrier Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the HR representative or system user who last modified this enrollment record. Used for audit trail and data governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this enrollment record. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for HR representatives to capture additional context, special circumstances, or administrative notes related to this enrollment. Used for case management and audit documentation.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year or fiscal year for which this benefit enrollment is effective. Used for annual reporting, open enrollment tracking, and compliance (e.g., ACA 1095-C reporting).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this enrollment record originated. Typically 'Workday HCM' for benefit enrollments. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage ends. Nullable for active enrollments. Populated when employee terminates employment, changes plans, or reaches plan end date.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104, COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act)

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the union local chapter governing this benefit plan, if applicable. Populated only when union_plan_indicator is true. Used for union reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: union_plan_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this enrollment is for a union-negotiated benefit plan. True if the plan is governed by collective bargaining agreement; false otherwise. Relevant for drivers and facility operators covered by union contracts.
attributes.references: NLRA (National Labor Relations Act), Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee formally waived or declined the benefit coverage. Populated when enrollment_status is 'waived'.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the employee for waiving or declining benefit coverage. Populated when enrollment_status is 'waived'. Used for compliance documentation and audit purposes.

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Records all formal performance and conduct actions for Waste Management employees including annual/mid-year reviews, probationary evaluations, and progressive discipline (verbal warnings, written warnings, suspensions, terminations). Captures review period, action type, overall rating, safety performance score (OSHA recordable incidents, near-miss reporting), productivity metrics (stops per hour for drivers, TPD for MRF sorters), violation type if disciplinary, issuing supervisor, employee acknowledgment, appeal status, and merit/corrective action recommendation. Sourced from Workday HCM talent management.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance review or disciplinary action record.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_area. Business justification: Performance reviews assess employees against service area metrics: diversion rate achievement, customer satisfaction, route efficiency. Drives performance management, bonus calculation, and territory

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center code for labor cost allocation associated with the employee's position.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility or work location where the employee is assigned.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee being reviewed or subject to disciplinary action.

attributes.name: tertiary_performance_hr_representative_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the HR representative who reviewed or approved the performance review or disciplinary action.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Specific action type for disciplinary records: performance review, verbal warning, written warning, final warning, suspension, or termination.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has filed an appeal or grievance regarding the performance review or disciplinary action.

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date the appeal or grievance was resolved.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employee's appeal or grievance: pending, under review, upheld, overturned, withdrawn, or not applicable.

attributes.name: attendance_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting the employee's attendance and punctuality during the review period.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the employee must complete the required corrective actions.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions required of the employee, including training, performance improvement plan, or behavioral changes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review or disciplinary action record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_service_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting the employee's customer service performance, including customer feedback and complaint resolution.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the department or business unit where the employee works.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date the employee acknowledged the performance review or disciplinary action.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has acknowledged receipt and review of the performance review or disciplinary action document.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Comments or feedback provided by the employee in response to the performance review or disciplinary action.

attributes.name: job_classification
attributes.description: Job classification or title of the employee at the time of the review (e.g., Commercial Driver License (CDL) driver, MRF sorter, technician, facility operator).

attributes.name: merit_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Recommended percentage increase for merit-based salary adjustment.

attributes.name: merit_increase_recommended_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a merit-based salary increase is recommended based on the performance review.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review or disciplinary action record was last modified.

attributes.name: near_miss_reports_count
attributes.description: Number of near-miss safety incidents reported by the employee during the review period, demonstrating proactive safety awareness.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the performance review or disciplinary action.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_incidents_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable Incidents Count
attributes.description: Number of OSHA recordable incidents involving the employee during the review period.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Overall performance rating assigned during the review: exceeds expectations, meets expectations, needs improvement, unsatisfactory, or not rated.

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the overall performance rating, typically on a scale (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0).

attributes.name: productivity_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the productivity metric: stops per hour, tons per day, work orders per day, calls per hour, or other role-specific unit.

attributes.name: productivity_metric_value
attributes.description: Quantitative productivity metric for the employee's role: stops per hour for drivers, Tons Per Day (TPD) for Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) sorters, work orders completed for technicians, or other role-specific measures.

attributes.name: promotion_recommended_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a promotion is recommended based on the performance review.

attributes.name: quality_of_work_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting the quality and accuracy of the employee's work output.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date the performance review or disciplinary action was conducted or issued.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance period being evaluated.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance period being evaluated.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the performance review or disciplinary action record: draft, submitted, approved, completed, appealed, or archived.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of performance review or action: annual review, mid-year review, probationary evaluation, project-based review, disciplinary action, or termination review.

attributes.name: safety_performance_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting the employee's safety performance including Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) recordable incidents, near-miss reporting, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) compliance, and adherence to safety protocols.

attributes.name: teamwork_collaboration_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting the employee's ability to work effectively with team members and contribute to a collaborative work environment.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union the employee belongs to, if applicable.

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the violation, incident, or performance deficiency that led to the disciplinary action.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Type of violation or deficiency for disciplinary actions: safety violation, attendance violation, conduct violation, performance deficiency, policy violation, Department of Transportation (DOT) violation, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety_violation|attendance_violation|conduct_violation|performance_deficiency|policy_violation|dot_violation|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: disciplinary_action
products.description: Records formal disciplinary actions taken against Waste Management employees including verbal warnings, written warnings, suspensions, and terminations. Captures incident date, violation type (safety violation, DOT HOS violation, attendance, conduct, substance abuse), action type, action date, issuing supervisor, employee acknowledgment, appeal status, and resolution outcome. Supports progressive discipline tracking and DOT drug/alcohol violation management.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the disciplinary action record. Primary key for the disciplinary action entity.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management facility where the incident occurred or where the employee is assigned. Used for site-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Master, Asset Management System

attributes.name: primary_disciplinary_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who is the subject of the disciplinary action. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Disciplinary actions frequently result from safety incidents (PPE violations, unsafe acts). Links disciplinary outcomes to triggering incidents for progressive discipline tracking and incident follow-

attributes.name: tertiary_disciplinary_approving_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the higher-level manager or HR representative who approved the disciplinary action. Required for suspensions and terminations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Hierarchy, HR Policy Manual

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.union_agreement. Business justification: Disciplinary actions for union employees must follow grievance procedures and due process rights defined in the collective bargaining agreement. Linking to the authoritative union_agreement ensures co

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee signed or electronically acknowledged the disciplinary action. Null if employee refused to acknowledge.

attributes.name: action_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal disciplinary action was issued or taken. May differ from incident date due to investigation period.

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the disciplinary action, formatted as DA-YYYYMMDD followed by sequence. Used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: The type of disciplinary action taken following progressive discipline policy. Escalates from verbal warning through termination based on severity and recurrence.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Progressive Discipline, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee filed the appeal or grievance. Null if no appeal was filed. Starts the appeal resolution timeline.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Grievance Procedure, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has filed a formal appeal or grievance of the disciplinary action through HR or union channels.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Grievance Procedure, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Description of the final outcome of the appeal or grievance, including any modifications to the original disciplinary action. Null if no appeal or appeal still pending.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Grievance Procedure, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal or grievance was resolved. Null if appeal is still pending or no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Grievance Procedure, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the appeal or grievance process. Null if no appeal was filed. Tracks resolution progress through HR and union channels.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Grievance Procedure, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of the corrective actions or performance improvement plan required of the employee to avoid further discipline. May include training, counseling, or behavioral expectations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disciplinary action record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the department or functional area where the employee works (e.g., collection operations, MRF, landfill, fleet maintenance). Used for departmental trend analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Structure, SAP Cost Center Master

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disciplinary action record. Active actions count toward progressive discipline; expired or overturned actions do not.

attributes.name: dot_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation is reportable to DOT under FMCSR regulations (e.g., positive drug/alcohol test, HOS violation, safety-related termination). Triggers DOT clearinghouse reporting.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSR Part 382, DOT Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse

attributes.name: eligible_for_rehire_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminated employee is eligible for future rehire. False for terminations involving serious violations (substance abuse, safety, theft). Checked during applicant screening.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has acknowledged receipt and review of the disciplinary action documentation. Required for progressive discipline documentation.

attributes.name: employee_statement
attributes.description: Written statement or comments provided by the employee regarding the incident or disciplinary action. Captured for due process and appeal documentation.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Employee Rights, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disciplinary action expires and is no longer considered active for progressive discipline purposes. Typically 12-24 months from action date per policy.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Progressive Discipline, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up review of employee performance or behavior following the disciplinary action. Used to track corrective action plan compliance.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The date on which the incident or violation that triggered the disciplinary action occurred. Critical for timeline tracking and progressive discipline sequencing.
attributes.references: OSHA Recordkeeping Requirements, DOT FMCSR Part 382

attributes.name: job_classification
attributes.description: The employees job classification or title at the time of the incident (e.g., CDL Driver, MRF Sorter, Equipment Operator, Environmental Engineer). Relevant for role-specific violation patterns.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog, Union Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disciplinary action record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates, including appeal outcomes and status changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, context, or administrative comments regarding the disciplinary action. May include legal review notes, HR guidance, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident that triggered the disciplinary action is OSHA recordable (injury, illness, or fatality). Links disciplinary action to OSHA 300 log entry.

attributes.name: paid_suspension_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension is paid or unpaid. True for paid suspension (typically during investigation), false for unpaid disciplinary suspension.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Suspension Policy, Fair Labor Standards Act

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the severity of the violation based on safety impact, regulatory implications, and business disruption. Influences the appropriate disciplinary response.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Progressive Discipline Matrix

attributes.name: suspension_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days of suspension. Null for non-suspension actions. Used for progressive discipline tracking and payroll deduction calculation.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of suspension if the action type is suspension. Null for non-suspension actions. Employee is eligible to return to work the following day.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Suspension Policy, Workday Time Tracking

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of suspension if the action type is suspension. Null for non-suspension actions. Used for payroll and attendance system integration.
attributes.references: HR Policy Manual - Suspension Policy, Workday Time Tracking

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The effective date of employment termination if the action type is termination. Null for non-termination actions. Triggers final payroll and benefits processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Processing, COBRA Requirements

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the reason for termination (e.g., safety violation, substance abuse, job abandonment, performance). Used for unemployment claims and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason Catalog, State Unemployment Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the violation that triggered the disciplinary action. Used for trend analysis and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA Standards, DOT FMCSR, HR Policy Manual

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific incident or violation, including circumstances, location, witnesses, and any mitigating or aggravating factors. Critical for legal documentation.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Specific type of violation within the category (e.g., HOS violation, PPE non-compliance, unauthorized absence, insubordination, failed drug test). Provides granular detail for root cause analysis.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSR Part 395, OSHA 1910.132, HR Policy Manual

attributes.name: witness_names
attributes.description: Names of witnesses to the incident, if any. Comma-separated list. Used for investigation documentation and potential corroboration.

products.name: dot_drug_test
products.description: Tracks DOT-mandated drug and alcohol testing events for CDL drivers and safety-sensitive employees at Waste Management. Captures test type (pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, return-to-duty, follow-up), test date, specimen type, laboratory, result (negative, positive, refusal, cancelled), MRO review status, and SAP/Workday reference. Mandatory under DOT 49 CFR Part 382 and FMCSA regulations for all CDL holders.
products.reference: DOT 49 CFR Part 382 / FMCSA Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse

attributes.name: dot_drug_test_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Drug Test ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DOT-mandated drug and alcohol test event. Primary key for the dot_drug_test product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee (CDL driver or safety-sensitive worker) who underwent the drug test. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management facility where the employee was assigned at the time of the test.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the safety incident or accident that triggered a post-accident drug test, if applicable. Null for non-post-accident tests.

attributes.name: cdl_license_number
attributes.description: The CDL license number of the employee at the time of the test. Required for all DOT-regulated drivers.

attributes.name: cdl_state
attributes.description: State or jurisdiction that issued the employee's CDL license.

attributes.name: collection_site_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the collection site facility.

attributes.name: collection_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility or clinic where the specimen was collected.

attributes.name: collector_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified specimen collector who performed the collection procedure.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall compliance status of the test event. Compliant indicates the test was conducted and documented per DOT regulations; non-compliant indicates a violation occurred; pending review indicates the status is under evaluation; exempted indicates the employee was exempt from testing.

attributes.name: concentration_level
attributes.description: Measured concentration of detected substances in the specimen, typically expressed in ng/mL for drugs or BAC percentage for alcohol.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which the test expense is allocated for financial reporting and labor cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drug test record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: follow_up_testing_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is subject to a follow-up testing plan as prescribed by the SAP. True if follow-up plan is active; False otherwise.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The employee's job title or position at the time of the test (e.g., CDL Driver, MRF Sorter, Facility Operator).

attributes.name: laboratory_certification_number
attributes.description: SAMHSA certification number of the laboratory that performed the analysis, ensuring the lab meets federal standards.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the SAMHSA-certified laboratory that analyzed the specimen.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drug test record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: mro_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the MRO for follow-up or verification inquiries.

attributes.name: mro_name
attributes.description: Name of the licensed physician (Medical Review Officer) who reviewed and verified the test result.

attributes.name: mro_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MRO completed the review and verification of the test result.

attributes.name: mro_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the MRO review process. Verified positive confirms a positive result after medical review; verified negative confirms no prohibited substances; verified refusal confirms employee refusal; pending indicates review in progress; cancelled by MRO indicates the MRO invalidated the test.
attributes.value_regex: verified positive|verified negative|verified refusal|pending|cancelled by mro

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or special circumstances related to the drug test event.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee was notified of the requirement to undergo the drug or alcohol test.

attributes.name: random_pool_selection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee was selected from the random testing pool, if the test type is random. Null for non-random tests.

attributes.name: return_to_duty_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee received clearance to return to safety-sensitive duties following a violation and successful completion of SAP requirements. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: safety_sensitive_position_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a DOT-defined safety-sensitive position at the time of the test. True if safety-sensitive; False otherwise.

attributes.name: sap_evaluation_status
attributes.description: Status of the SAP evaluation and treatment process. Not required if no violation occurred; pending if referral made but evaluation not started; in progress if employee is undergoing treatment; completed if SAP has cleared the employee for return-to-duty; not completed if employee has not fulfilled SAP requirements.

attributes.name: sap_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this drug test record to the corresponding HR event or personnel action in SAP S/4HANA for payroll and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: sap_referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee was referred to a Substance Abuse Professional following a violation. Null if no referral was made.

attributes.name: sap_referral_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Substance Abuse Professional (SAP) Referral Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee must be referred to a Substance Abuse Professional (SAP) as a result of the test outcome. True if SAP referral is required; False otherwise.

attributes.name: specimen_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the specimen by the collection site or laboratory to maintain chain of custody and traceability.

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen collected for the test. Urine is standard for drug tests; breath is standard for alcohol tests; blood, saliva, and hair may be used in specific circumstances.

attributes.name: split_specimen_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee requested analysis of the split specimen (Bottle B) after a positive result on the primary specimen (Bottle A). True if requested; False if not requested.

attributes.name: split_specimen_result
attributes.description: Result of the split specimen analysis if requested. Confirmed means the split specimen also tested positive; not confirmed means the split specimen did not confirm the original positive; not tested means no split specimen test was performed; unavailable means the split specimen was not available for testing.

attributes.name: substances_detected
attributes.description: List of specific controlled substances or alcohol detected in the specimen if the test result was positive. May include marijuana, cocaine, opiates, amphetamines, PCP, or alcohol.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug or alcohol test specimen was collected from the employee.

attributes.name: test_reason_code
attributes.description: Internal code representing the specific reason or trigger for the test (e.g., annual random pool selection, post-accident protocol, supervisor observation).

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Final result of the drug or alcohol test. Negative indicates no prohibited substances detected; positive indicates presence of prohibited substances above cutoff levels; refusal indicates employee refused to test; cancelled indicates test was invalidated; invalid indicates specimen could not be tested.

attributes.name: test_time
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the specimen collection occurred, including time zone information.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Type of DOT-mandated drug or alcohol test conducted. Pre-employment tests are required before hiring; random tests are unannounced selections from the pool; post-accident tests follow qualifying incidents; reasonable suspicion tests are based on observed behavior; return-to-duty tests are required before reinstatement after a violation; follow-up tests are part of a monitoring program.

attributes.name: violation_flag

domains.name: asset
domains.description: Fixed asset and infrastructure management including containers (dumpsters, roll-offs, carts identified by CID/RFID), landfill sites, MRF facilities, transfer stations, WTE plants, maintenance shops, stationary equipment (compactors, balers, scales), and administrative buildings. Tracks asset master records, acquisition, depreciation, location, condition, utilization, BOM, RFID/GPS tracking, and lifecycle. Distinct from fleet (rolling stock) which has its own DOT compliance requirements. Integrates with Infor EAM and SAP PM.

Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) and Infor EAM as the authoritative SSOT for all fixed asset master data.

products.description: Reference classification hierarchy for fixed assets aligned with SAP asset class configuration and GAAP/IFRS capitalization policies. Defines asset categories such as containers, compactors, balers, weighing scales, landfill infrastructure, MRF equipment, WTE plant equipment, transfer station equipment, and buildings. Each class carries depreciation method defaults, useful life ranges, capitalization thresholds, GL account assignments, and RCRA/EPA reporting flags. Enables consistent depreciation calculation and regulatory asset reporting across all Waste Management facilities.

products.name: asset_container
products.description: Master record for all waste containers deployed in the field, including front-load dumpsters, rear-load dumpsters, roll-off boxes, residential carts, and compactor units. Each container is identified by a unique CID (Container Identification) and optionally an RFID tag or GPS device. Tracks container type, size (cubic yards), material, color, lid type, ownership (owned/leased/customer-owned), deployment status, current service address, last inspection date, condition grade, tare weight, and AMCS container tracking reference. Distinct from fleet (rolling stock) — containers are stationary assets placed at customer sites.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is owned by Waste Management, leased from a third party, or owned by the customer. attributes.name: retrieval_date

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: The RFID tag identifier embedded in or attached to the container for automated tracking and scanning during collection operations. Used by AMCS Platform and collection vehicles equipped with RFID readers.

attributes.description: The asset number assigned to this container in the SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets (FI-AA) module. Used for financial asset tracking, depreciation runs, and general ledger integration.

attributes.description: The empty weight of the container in pounds. Used to calculate net waste weight by subtracting tare weight from gross weight measured at scales. Critical for accurate tonnage reporting and billing.

MSW is Municipal Solid Waste (general trash); recycling for recyclable materials; organics for compostable waste; C&D for Construction and Demolition debris; hazardous for RCRA-regulated waste; universal waste for batteries, electronics, etc.

products.name: facility

attributes.description: Identifier of the asset (container, equipment, facility) whose location is being tracked. Links to the asset master record in Infor EAM or SAP PM.

attributes.name: placement_driver_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver who placed or delivered the asset to this location. Links to driver master for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: placement_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle used to transport and place the asset at this location. Links to fleet vehicle master.

attributes.name: placement_work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order that authorized or executed the asset placement at this location. Links to field service work order system.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection route that services this asset location. Links to route master for operational planning and optimization.

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer service address where the asset is located. Applicable for containers placed at customer sites. Links to customer service address master.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the asset location. Includes street number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as suite, unit, or building number.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for assigning the asset to this location. Supports root cause analysis for location changes and utilization patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_service|service_change|replacement|maintenance|temporary_placement|customer_request|route_optimization|lost_recovery|seasonal — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bay_or_pad_number
attributes.description: Specific bay, pad, or designated area within a building or facility where the asset is positioned. Used for precise location tracking of stationary equipment like compactors, balers, and scales.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific building or structure within a facility where the asset is located. Used for maintenance shops, administrative buildings, and multi-building facilities.

attributes.name: cid
attributes.description: Container Identification number - unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to containers (dumpsters, roll-offs, carts) for tracking and service management. Industry-standard identifier used across AMCS and Waste Logics platforms.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the asset is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the asset is located. Primary operations in USA and CAN.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this asset location record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was removed from or moved away from this location. Null indicates the asset is currently at this location.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed at or moved to this location. Marks the beginning of the location assignment period.

attributes.name: geofence_zone_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the geofence zone that encompasses this asset location. Used for automated location alerts and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: GPS (Global Positioning System) Accuracy in Meters
attributes.description: Accuracy of the GPS coordinates in meters. Indicates the precision of the location data captured from telemetry systems.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees. Captured from Geotab GPS telemetry or AMCS container tracking.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees. Captured from Geotab GPS telemetry or AMCS container tracking.

attributes.name: is_billable_location
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset placement at this location is billable to a customer. True for customer sites with active service; false for internal facility locations.

attributes.name: is_primary_location
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary or home location for the asset. True for the main assigned location; false for temporary or secondary locations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this asset location record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: last_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset at this location was last serviced (e.g., container emptied, equipment maintained). Used for service frequency analysis.

attributes.name: last_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset location was last verified or confirmed. Updated by RFID scans, GPS pings, or manual audits.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current status of the asset at this location. Indicates whether the asset is actively in service, temporarily placed, awaiting pickup, or lost/missing.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the location where the asset is currently positioned. Distinguishes between customer sites, internal facilities, and transit states. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_site|facility|yard|transfer_station|landfill|mrf|wte_plant|maintenance_shop|in_transit|storage — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_scheduled_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset at this location is next scheduled for service. Supports route planning and customer service level agreement (SLA) compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the asset location, such as access instructions, site conditions, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: placement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the asset was placed at this location. Captured from driver mobile app, RFID scan, or GPS telemetry.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the asset location. US format supports 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP codes.

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier attached to the asset for automated tracking and scanning during collection operations. Hexadecimal format.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System or method that captured or recorded this asset location. Indicates data lineage and reliability of location information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: amcs|geotab|waste_logics|infor_eam|manual_entry|rfid_scan|gps_telemetry — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the asset is located. US state codes follow USPS standard.

attributes.name: utilization_status
attributes.description: Current utilization state of the asset at this location. Indicates whether the asset is actively being used, idle, or available for redeployment.

products.name: acquisition
products.description: Records the procurement and capitalization events for fixed assets, capturing how each asset was acquired (purchase, lease, construction, donation, transfer). Tracks acquisition date, vendor/supplier reference, purchase order number, invoice number, acquisition cost, freight and installation costs, total capitalized cost, funding source, approval authority, and SAP asset acquisition document number. Links to the fixed_asset master upon capitalization. Supports GAAP/IFRS asset capitalization policy compliance and capital expenditure (CapEx) tracking against approved budgets.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Acquisition / GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset acquisition event. Primary key for the acquisition record.

attributes.name: acquisition_fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset master record that was acquired through this acquisition event. Links to the asset master upon capitalization.

attributes.name: acquisition_trade_in_asset_fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the existing asset that was traded in as part of this acquisition. Links to the disposed asset record for gain/loss calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project or CapEx initiative under which this asset was acquired. Links to capital planning and budget tracking systems.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Acquisition has asset_class STRING indicating the class of the asset being acquired, but asset_class table exists with capitalization thresholds, depreciation rules, and GL accounts. Adding asset_clas

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Links to vendor master in SAP MM.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was acquired and placed into service. Used as the start date for depreciation calculation and asset lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_method
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was acquired. Determines capitalization treatment and accounting entries per GAAP/IFRS standards.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the acquisition transaction. Externally-known reference number used in procurement and accounting documentation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the acquisition transaction in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from approval through capitalization or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|in_transit|received|installed|capitalized|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual or committee that approved the asset acquisition. Supports SOX compliance and capital expenditure governance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the asset acquisition was formally approved by the designated authority. Part of the audit trail for capital expenditure controls.

attributes.name: budget_line_item
attributes.description: Specific budget line item or cost center code against which the acquisition was charged. Used for budget variance analysis and financial control.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was capitalized in the general ledger and added to the fixed asset register. May differ from acquisition date for constructed assets.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Base purchase price of the asset before additional costs. Represents the invoice amount paid to the vendor excluding freight, installation, and other capitalizable costs.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the acquisition record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the acquisition transaction. Primarily USD for domestic operations, with CAD and MXN for North American facilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied to the asset for financial reporting. Straight-line is most common for waste management fixed assets per GAAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation and shipping costs incurred to deliver the asset to its installation location. Capitalized as part of total asset cost per GAAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funds used to finance the asset acquisition. Tracks whether the asset was funded through operating budget, capital expenditure budget, grants, or financing arrangements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: installation_cost
attributes.description: Costs incurred to install, configure, and prepare the asset for its intended use. Includes labor, materials, and contractor fees. Capitalized per GAAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the vendor invoice for the asset purchase. Used for payment terms calculation and financial period assignment.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number associated with the asset purchase. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and audit verification.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified the acquisition record. Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the acquisition record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about the acquisition, such as special terms, conditions, or justification for the purchase.

attributes.name: other_capitalizable_costs
attributes.description: Additional costs that are capitalized as part of the asset value, such as site preparation, testing, training, or legal fees directly attributable to the acquisition.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number issued to procure the asset. Links to SAP MM purchasing documents for procurement audit trail.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in depreciation calculation to determine depreciable basis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: sap_asset_document_number
attributes.description: SAP asset acquisition document number generated when the asset was capitalized in SAP FI-AA. Links to SAP fixed asset master and depreciation runs.

attributes.name: total_capitalized_cost
attributes.description: Total cost capitalized for the asset, including acquisition cost, freight, installation, and other capitalizable costs. This is the depreciable basis for the asset.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: trade_in_value
attributes.description: Credit or allowance received for the trade-in asset, reducing the net acquisition cost. Used in gain/loss calculation on asset disposal.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years, used for depreciation calculation. Determined by asset class and company depreciation policy.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: warranty_end_date
attributes.description: Date the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage expires. Triggers transition to internal maintenance or extended warranty consideration.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage begins for the acquired asset. Used for maintenance planning and warranty claim tracking.

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Description of warranty coverage terms, including what is covered, exclusions, and claim procedures. Supports warranty management and cost avoidance.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created the acquisition record. Supports audit trail and accountability for data entry.

products.name: depreciation_run
products.description: Records periodic depreciation calculation runs executed against the fixed asset register, aligned with SAP FI-AA depreciation posting cycles. Captures run date, fiscal period, depreciation area (book, tax, IFRS), total depreciation posted, number of assets processed, run status, and GL posting document reference. Supports monthly close processes, financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS, and SOX-compliant audit trails for asset valuation. Each run produces depreciation postings at the individual asset level captured in depreciation_posting.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Run / GAAP ASC 360-10

attributes.name: depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the depreciation calculation run. Primary key for the depreciation run entity.

attributes.name: reversed_run_depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the original depreciation_run_id that this run reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Provides audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depreciation run results have been reviewed and approved by the accounting team before GL posting. Used in organizations with segregation of duties and SOX controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the accounting manager or controller who approved the depreciation run for GL posting. Required for SOX audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the depreciation run was approved for GL posting. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial close processes.

attributes.name: asset_count
attributes.description: The total number of fixed assets processed and included in this depreciation calculation run. Used for reconciliation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity or business unit for which this depreciation run was executed. Waste Management may operate multiple company codes for different subsidiaries or geographic regions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this depreciation run record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which depreciation amounts are calculated and posted (typically USD for Waste Management).

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: The accounting framework or valuation perspective for which depreciation is calculated (e.g., book depreciation for financial statements, tax depreciation for IRS reporting, IFRS for international standards). SAP FI-AA supports parallel depreciation areas for multi-GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area Configuration, GAAP/IFRS/IRS Standards

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the depreciation calculation run completed (successfully or with errors). Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: The number of errors encountered during the depreciation run, such as assets with incomplete master data, invalid depreciation keys, or calculation failures. Zero indicates a clean run.

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total elapsed time in seconds for the depreciation run to complete, calculated as the difference between start_timestamp and end_timestamp. Used for performance analysis and optimization.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (typically month 1-12) within the fiscal year for which depreciation is calculated. Used for monthly close processes and period-specific financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this depreciation run calculates asset depreciation expense, aligned with the organization's financial reporting calendar.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or system identifier that last modified this depreciation run record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this depreciation run record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for accounting staff to document special circumstances, adjustments, or issues related to this depreciation run. Used for month-end close documentation and audit support.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the depreciation expense was posted to the General Ledger (GL). This may differ from the run_date if posting occurs in a subsequent period due to month-end close timing.

attributes.name: posting_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI General Ledger (GL) document number generated when the depreciation expense is posted to the financial ledger. This provides the audit trail linking the depreciation run to the GL entries for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI-CO General Ledger Posting Standards, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this depreciation run reverses a previous run. True if this is a reversal run (used to correct errors from a prior period), False for normal forward runs.

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the depreciation calculation run was executed. This is the principal business event timestamp for the run.

attributes.name: run_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depreciation run was executed in test mode (for validation and review without GL posting) or production mode (with actual GL posting). Test runs are used during month-end close preparation.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the depreciation run, typically generated by the financial system (SAP FI-AA) to uniquely identify each periodic depreciation calculation cycle.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the depreciation run indicating whether the calculation is scheduled, executing, completed successfully, failed, cancelled, or posted to the General Ledger (GL).

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depreciation run indicating whether it is a standard planned periodic run, an unplanned ad-hoc run, a repeat run to correct errors, an adjustment run for asset changes, or a special year-end closing run.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the depreciation calculation run was initiated. Used for performance monitoring and audit trail.

attributes.name: system_source
attributes.description: The source system that generated or recorded this depreciation run. Typically SAP FI-AA for automated runs, Infor EAM for asset-specific runs, or Manual_Entry for adjustments.

attributes.name: total_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate depreciation expense calculated and posted across all assets processed in this run, expressed in the company's reporting currency (USD). This amount flows to the General Ledger (GL) as a period expense.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: The number of warnings generated during the depreciation run, such as assets nearing full depreciation or assets with unusual depreciation patterns. Warnings do not prevent posting but require review.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or system identifier that created this depreciation run record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: depreciation_posting
products.description: Line-level depreciation posting records for each fixed asset per fiscal period, generated by a depreciation_run. Captures asset number, depreciation area, fiscal year, posting period, planned depreciation amount, posted depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation to date, net book value after posting, and SAP GL document reference. Provides the asset-level audit trail required for financial statement preparation, tax reporting, and SOX compliance. Enables asset-level book value queries and depreciation schedule reporting.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Posting / IFRS 16 / ASC 842

attributes.name: depreciation_posting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the depreciation posting record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Depreciation_posting has asset_class STRING for reporting and GL posting, but asset_class table exists. Adding asset_class_id FK enables asset-class-level depreciation reporting, validates depreciatio

attributes.name: depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depreciation run batch that generated this posting. Multiple postings are created by a single depreciation run execution.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID or service account that executed the depreciation run and created this posting. Required for SOX audit trail.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset for which depreciation is being posted. Links to the asset master record (containers, landfill sites, MRF facilities, transfer stations, WTE plants, maintenance shops, stationary equipment).

attributes.name: reversed_posting_depreciation_posting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original depreciation_posting_id that this posting reverses. Null if this is not a reversal transaction.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The cumulative depreciation posted for the asset from acquisition date through the end of this posting period. Used to calculate net book value.

attributes.name: acquisition_value
attributes.description: The original acquisition or capitalized cost of the asset. Denormalized from asset master for reporting and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the asset. Denormalized from asset master for reporting convenience and audit trail.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The business identifier (asset tag or asset number) of the fixed asset. Denormalized from asset master for reporting convenience and audit trail.

attributes.name: asset_sub_number
attributes.description: Sub-asset identifier for assets with multiple components or sub-assets tracked separately (e.g., landfill cells within a landfill site, or equipment modules within a MRF facility).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area or segment (e.g., Residential Collection, Commercial Collection, Recycling, Landfill, Hazmat) for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code to which the asset and depreciation posting belong. Required for multi-entity financial consolidation and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the depreciation expense is allocated. Used for internal cost accounting and management reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this posting (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: Depreciation area code representing the valuation view (e.g., 01=Book Depreciation, 10=Tax Depreciation, 15=IFRS, 20=Cost Accounting, 30=Consolidated, 40=Investment Support). Allows parallel depreciation calculations for different reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA), GAAP, IFRS, IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: The depreciation method key or code (e.g., straight-line, declining balance, units of production) used to calculate depreciation for this asset. Denormalized for audit and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA), IAS 16, ASC 360, IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the depreciation is posted (e.g., 2024). Part of the fiscal period key.

attributes.name: gl_account_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The GL account number to which the accumulated depreciation is credited (contra-asset account on the balance sheet).
attributes.references: SAP FI, GAAP Chart of Accounts, IFRS

attributes.name: gl_account_depreciation_expense
attributes.description: The GL account number to which the depreciation expense is debited (income statement account).
attributes.references: SAP FI, GAAP Chart of Accounts, IFRS

attributes.name: gl_document_line_item
attributes.description: The line item number within the GL document for this specific depreciation posting entry.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: The GL document number generated by the depreciation posting. Provides the audit trail link to the financial accounting document.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The net book value of the asset after this depreciation posting (acquisition value minus accumulated depreciation). Represents the carrying amount on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA), IAS 16, ASC 360, GAAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this depreciation posting. Used for manual adjustments, exceptions, or audit explanations.

attributes.name: planned_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The planned or calculated depreciation amount for the asset in this period, based on the depreciation key and useful life. Expressed in the company currency.

attributes.name: posted_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The actual depreciation amount posted to the General Ledger (GL) for this period. May differ from planned amount due to manual adjustments, partial period depreciation, or asset retirement.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the depreciation posting was made to the General Ledger (GL). Typically the last day of the posting period.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period (1-12 for monthly, or 1-13 if special period is used) within the fiscal year for which depreciation is posted.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current status of the depreciation posting: posted (successfully posted to GL), reversed (subsequently reversed), cancelled (voided before posting), pending (awaiting approval or posting).

attributes.name: posting_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the depreciation posting was created and posted to the GL. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this posting is a reversal of a previous depreciation posting (True) or an original posting (False).

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the source document or transaction in the originating system. Provides traceability back to the source system for audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, Enterprise Data Architecture Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source ERP system or module that generated this depreciation posting (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI-AA, Infor EAM). Required for multi-system environments and data lineage.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The type of depreciation transaction: planned (normal periodic depreciation), unplanned (extraordinary depreciation), manual_adjustment (manual correction), reversal (correction of prior posting), catch_up (retroactive depreciation for missed periods).

attributes.name: useful_life_periods
attributes.description: The useful life of the asset expressed in posting periods (e.g., months). Used when depreciation is calculated on a period basis rather than annual.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The useful life of the asset in years, as defined in the asset master. Used for depreciation calculation. Denormalized for reporting and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA), IAS 16, ASC 360, IRS Publication 946

products.name: retirement
products.description: Records the retirement, disposal, or write-off of fixed assets from the Waste Management asset register. Captures retirement date, retirement reason (sale, scrapping, theft, damage, end-of-life), proceeds from sale (if any), gain/loss on disposal, retirement document number in SAP FI-AA, approving authority, and environmental disposal certification (for assets containing hazardous materials such as compactors with hydraulic fluid). Ensures complete asset lifecycle closure and supports GAAP/IFRS derecognition accounting and EPA/RCRA disposal compliance.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Retirement / GAAP ASC 360-10-40

attributes.name: retirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset retirement record. Primary key for the asset retirement transaction.

attributes.name: retirement_approving_authority_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the approving authority in Workday HCM. Provides audit trail and segregation of duties verification.

attributes.name: retirement_fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being retired from the asset register. Links to the master asset record in the asset management system.

attributes.name: retirement_initiated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the person who initiated the retirement request in Infor EAM or SAP PM. Used for accountability and process tracking.

attributes.name: retirement_processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the finance or asset management specialist who processed the retirement transaction in SAP FI-AA. Used for audit trail and quality control.

attributes.name: retirement_replacement_asset_fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new asset that replaced the retired asset, if applicable. Used for asset lifecycle planning, capacity management, and capital expenditure tracking.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: The RFID tag identifier assigned to the retired asset for automated tracking and inventory management. Tag should be deactivated or recovered upon retirement.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense recognized on the asset from acquisition date through retirement date. Used to calculate net book value at retirement.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the asset retirement was formally approved by the authorized signatory. Must precede or match the retirement date for control compliance.

attributes.name: approving_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the manager or executive who authorized the asset retirement. Required for governance and internal control compliance.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the retired asset type: CONTAINER (dumpsters, roll-offs, carts), EQUIPMENT (compactors, balers, scales), FACILITY (landfill, MRF, transfer station, WTE plant), VEHICLE (fleet rolling stock), BUILDING (administrative, maintenance shops).

attributes.name: asset_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the asset category (e.g., Front End Loader (FEL) container, stationary compactor, Materials Recovery Facility (MRF), Automated Side Loader (ASL) truck). Provides granular asset type for reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: buyer_contact_information
attributes.description: Contact details (phone, email, address) for the buyer of the retired asset. Used for transaction documentation and warranty transfer. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or organization that purchased the retired asset. Applicable when retirement reason is SALE. Used for Bill of Lading (BOL) and transfer documentation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the retired asset. Used for management accounting, budget tracking, and departmental performance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the asset retirement record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disposal_cost_amount
attributes.description: The cost incurred to dispose of the retired asset, including transportation, environmental remediation, hazardous waste handling fees, and TSDF tipping fees. Reduces net proceeds in gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: disposal_method
