attributes.description: The method used to dispose of the retired asset: AUCTION (public/private auction), TRADE_IN (traded for new equipment), DONATION (donated to charity/municipality), LANDFILL (disposed in company landfill), RECYCLING (sent to MRF for material recovery), HAZMAT_DISPOSAL (sent to TSDF for hazardous waste disposal), SALVAGE (sold for parts/scrap value). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AUCTION|TRADE_IN|DONATION|LANDFILL|RECYCLING|HAZMAT_DISPOSAL|SALVAGE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The official document number generated in SAP FI-AA (Fixed Asset Accounting) module for the asset retirement transaction. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: environmental_disposal_certification_number
attributes.description: The certification or manifest number issued by the EPA, state environmental agency, or TSDF confirming compliant disposal of assets containing hazardous materials (e.g., compactors with hydraulic fluid, equipment with refrigerants). Required for RCRA and CERCLA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA / CERCLA / Clean Air Act

attributes.name: gain_loss_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gain or Loss on Disposal Amount
attributes.description: The financial gain (positive) or loss (negative) recognized on asset retirement, calculated as (sale proceeds - disposal costs - net book value). Posted to the General Ledger (GL) for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP FI where the gain or loss on disposal is posted. Ensures proper financial statement classification and audit trail.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the retired asset contained or was contaminated with hazardous materials requiring special disposal procedures under RCRA or OSHA regulations. True if hazardous, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA / OSHA Hazard Communication Standard

attributes.name: hazardous_material_type
attributes.description: Description of the type of hazardous material contained in the retired asset (e.g., hydraulic fluid, refrigerant, lead-acid battery, PCB-containing transformer). Required for EPA manifest and TSDF acceptance.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: The insurance claim number if the asset retirement was due to theft, damage, or casualty loss covered by insurance. Links to insurance recovery and subrogation processes.

attributes.name: insurance_recovery_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered from insurance for the retired asset. Offsets the loss on disposal in financial reporting and may affect gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the asset retirement record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The carrying value of the asset at retirement date, calculated as original acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the undepreciated balance being removed from the books.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, special circumstances, or operational details related to the asset retirement. Provides context for future reference and audit inquiries.

attributes.name: original_acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The original purchase price or capitalized cost of the asset when it was first acquired and placed in service. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.

attributes.name: physical_location_at_retirement
attributes.description: The physical site, facility, or yard where the asset was located at the time of retirement. Used for asset tracking, inventory reconciliation, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for asset retirement: SALE (sold to third party), SCRAP (scrapped/disposed), THEFT (stolen/lost), DAMAGE (irreparable damage), EOL (end of useful life), OBSOLETE (technologically obsolete).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances and business justification for retiring the asset. Provides context beyond the standardized reason code.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The effective date when the asset was officially retired from service and removed from the active asset register. Used for depreciation calculation cutoff and financial reporting.

attributes.name: retirement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the retirement transaction: PENDING (awaiting approval), APPROVED (authorized but not yet processed), COMPLETED (fully processed and posted to GL), CANCELLED (retirement request withdrawn).

attributes.name: sale_invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number issued to the buyer for the sale of the retired asset. Links to Oracle Revenue Management for Accounts Receivable (AR) tracking and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition / Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: sale_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: The cash or fair market value received from the sale or disposal of the retired asset. Null if asset was scrapped with no salvage value. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer serial number or Container Identification (CID) number of the retired asset. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and disposal documentation.

products.name: transfer
products.description: Records the inter-company, inter-plant, or inter-location transfer of fixed assets within the Waste Management network. Captures transfer date, sending facility, receiving facility, transfer reason (redeployment, consolidation, disposal routing), transfer document number, asset condition at transfer, and approving authority. For containers, tracks redeployment from one customer site or yard to another. Supports asset utilization optimization, intercompany accounting entries in SAP FI-AA, and container inventory balancing across districts.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Transfer / Infor EAM Transfer Order

attributes.name: transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset transfer transaction. Primary key for the asset transfer record.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being transferred. Links to the asset master record in the asset domain.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order created in Infor EAM for post-transfer maintenance or inspection. Links transfer event to maintenance execution.

attributes.name: receiving_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, plant, yard, or customer site to which the asset is being transferred. Destination location in the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier attached to the asset for automated tracking and scanning. Used to capture transfer events and location updates throughout the asset lifecycle.

attributes.name: sending_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, plant, yard, or customer site from which the asset is being transferred. Source location in the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who authorized the asset transfer. Typically a regional director, asset manager, or finance controller depending on transfer type and value.

attributes.name: transfer_requested_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who initiated the asset transfer request. Typically a district manager, operations supervisor, or asset coordinator.

attributes.name: actual_transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the asset physically arrived at the receiving facility and custody was transferred. Captured from RFID scan, GPS telematics, or manual confirmation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset transfer was formally approved by the authorizing employee. Marks transition from pending to approved status.

attributes.name: asset_book_value_at_transfer
attributes.description: Net book value (acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the transfer date. Used for intercompany accounting entries and financial reporting.

attributes.name: asset_condition_at_transfer
attributes.description: Physical and operational condition assessment of the asset at the time of transfer. Used to determine maintenance requirements at receiving location and validate transfer appropriateness.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the transportation company or internal fleet unit responsible for moving the asset. Applicable when shipping method involves a carrier.

attributes.name: container_cid
attributes.description: Container Identification number for waste containers (dumpsters, roll-offs, carts). Applicable when the transferred asset is a container. Links to RFID tracking systems.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to execute the asset transfer, including transportation, labor, inspection, and administrative expenses. Allocated to receiving cost center.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transfer cost amount. Typically USD for Waste Management domestic operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset transfer record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business document number for the asset transfer, generated by SAP FI-AA or Infor EAM. Used for audit trail and intercompany accounting reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the asset transfer occurred. Used for financial reporting period assignment and depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the asset transfer occurred. Used for financial reporting period assignment and depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: gps_latitude_at_transfer
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Latitude at Transfer
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate where the asset transfer was physically executed. Captured from Geotab telematics or AMCS platform for location verification.

attributes.name: gps_longitude_at_transfer
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Longitude at Transfer
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate where the asset transfer was physically executed. Captured from Geotab telematics or AMCS platform for location verification.

attributes.name: intercompany_accounting_document
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA document number for the intercompany accounting entry generated by the asset transfer. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset transfer record was most recently updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, special handling instructions, or observations related to the asset transfer. Used by operations and asset management teams.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business justification for the asset transfer (e.g., utilization optimization, customer contract change, facility closure, equipment upgrade, damage repair routing).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the asset transfer was initiated. Provides business context beyond the standardized reason code.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity assuming asset ownership. Required for intercompany transfers to generate proper accounting entries.

attributes.name: receiving_cost_center
attributes.description: SAP FI-CO cost center code of the receiving organizational unit. Used for intercompany accounting entries and depreciation allocation after transfer.

attributes.name: requires_maintenance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the asset requires preventive maintenance (PM) or repair work order (WO) upon arrival at receiving facility. Triggers work order creation in Infor EAM.

attributes.name: scheduled_transfer_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the physical movement and custody change of the asset. May differ from actual transfer date due to logistics or operational constraints.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity relinquishing asset ownership. Required for intercompany transfers to generate proper accounting entries.

attributes.name: sending_cost_center
attributes.description: SAP FI-CO cost center code of the sending organizational unit. Used for intercompany accounting entries and depreciation allocation prior to transfer.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used to physically move the asset from sending to receiving location. Impacts transit time and cost allocation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated this asset transfer transaction. Identifies data lineage for integration and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Primary key or unique identifier of this asset transfer record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to source.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Shipment tracking identifier provided by carrier or logistics system. Enables real-time visibility of asset location during transit.

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The business date when the asset transfer was executed and ownership/custody changed from sending to receiving facility. Used for financial period assignment and depreciation calculation cutoff in SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset transfer transaction. Tracks workflow progression from initiation through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_transit|completed|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer transaction based on organizational scope and business purpose. Determines accounting treatment and approval workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: intercompany|interplant|interlocation|redeployment|consolidation|disposal_routing|customer_site_swap — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: value_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the asset book value at transfer. Typically USD for Waste Management domestic operations.

products.name: asset_inspection
products.description: Records physical condition inspections performed on fixed assets including containers, compactors, balers, scales, and facility infrastructure. Captures inspection date, inspector ID, inspection type (routine, pre-deployment, post-incident, regulatory), overall condition grade (1-5 scale), specific defect findings (dents, cracks, leaks, graffiti, missing lids), pass/fail determination, corrective action required flag, and next scheduled inspection date. Integrates with Infor EAM inspection management and supports OSHA, DOT, and EPA regulatory inspection documentation requirements.

attributes.name: asset_inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset inspection record. Primary key.

attributes.name: checklist_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the standardized inspection checklist or template used for this inspection, ensuring consistency and completeness of inspection procedures.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fixed asset being inspected (container, compactor, baler, scale, facility infrastructure, etc.).

attributes.name: primary_asset_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor who performed the inspection.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order generated as a result of this inspection, if corrective action was required. Links inspection findings to maintenance execution.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inspection results were reviewed and approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: asset_out_of_service_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether the asset was taken out of service as a result of this inspection due to safety concerns, regulatory non-compliance, or critical defects. Triggers asset status update in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Status Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions recommended or required, including repair scope, parts needed, estimated labor hours, and priority level. Used to generate work orders and allocate maintenance resources.

attributes.name: corrective_action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for corrective action: critical (immediate safety or regulatory risk), high (significant operational impact), medium (scheduled repair), or low (cosmetic or deferred maintenance).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Priority; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether corrective action (repair, replacement, or remediation) is required as a result of this inspection. Triggers work order generation in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for performing the inspection, including labor, materials, equipment, and contractor fees. Used for cost allocation and budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO); Infor EAM Cost Tracking

attributes.name: defect_findings
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of specific defects identified during inspection, such as dents, cracks, leaks, rust, graffiti, missing lids, broken hinges, worn seals, hydraulic leaks, structural damage, or electrical faults. Supports root cause analysis and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Defect Tracking; OSHA Hazard Communication Standard

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes required to complete the inspection, used for labor cost allocation, productivity analysis, and scheduling optimization.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Labor Tracking; Workday HCM Time and Attendance

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the physical inspection was performed.

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: Method or technique used to perform the inspection: visual (walk-around observation), manual (hands-on testing), automated (RFID scan, IoT sensor), sensor_based (remote monitoring), or third_party (external contractor or certification body).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inspection Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique inspection number or code used for tracking and reference in work orders and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection: scheduled (planned but not started), in_progress (underway), completed (finished and recorded), cancelled (not performed), or failed (inspection could not be completed due to access or safety issues).

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the inspection was completed, supporting shift-level and real-time tracking.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Category of inspection performed: routine (scheduled periodic), pre-deployment (before asset is placed in service), post-incident (after damage or accident), regulatory (mandated by EPA, OSHA, DOT), preventive maintenance (PM-driven), safety (OSHA compliance), or quality assurance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: routine|pre_deployment|post_incident|regulatory|preventive_maintenance|safety|quality_assurance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inspection Types; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; EPA RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or license number of the inspector, if required by regulation (e.g., DOT inspector certification, OSHA competent person designation, EPA-certified technician). Validates inspector qualifications.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Inspector Certification; OSHA Competent Person Requirements; EPA Technician Certification

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical location where the inspection was performed, such as facility name, yard, maintenance shop, customer site, or field location. Supports geographic analysis and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next inspection of this asset is scheduled, based on regulatory requirements, preventive maintenance schedules, or asset condition. Supports compliance tracking and proactive maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance Scheduling; EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or observations recorded by the inspector, including context, environmental conditions, access issues, or recommendations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: overall_condition_grade
attributes.description: Numeric condition rating on a 1-5 scale where 1=Excellent (no defects), 2=Good (minor wear), 3=Fair (moderate wear, functional), 4=Poor (significant defects, repair needed), 5=Critical (unsafe, immediate action required). Used for asset lifecycle and replacement planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Condition Assessment; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: pass_fail_determination
attributes.description: Binary or conditional outcome of the inspection: pass (asset meets all criteria), fail (asset does not meet criteria and cannot be used), or conditional_pass (asset can be used with restrictions or minor repairs).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT FMCSA Inspection Standards

attributes.name: photo_documentation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether photographic evidence was captured during the inspection. Photos are typically stored in a separate document management system and linked via inspection_id.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Document Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this inspection was performed to satisfy a regulatory requirement from EPA, OSHA, DOT, or local enforcement agencies. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT FMCSA; Enviance EHS Compliance Tracking

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or citation for the specific regulatory requirement that mandated this inspection, such as EPA permit condition, OSHA standard section, or DOT inspection code. Supports audit documentation.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT FMCSA; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether a safety incident or near-miss occurred during the inspection. Triggers incident reporting workflow in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; Enviance EHS Incident Management

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of inspection (e.g., clear, rain, snow, extreme heat), relevant for outdoor asset inspections where environmental factors may affect inspection quality or asset condition assessment.

products.name: valuation
products.description: Stores point-in-time valuation snapshots for fixed assets beyond standard depreciation, including insurance appraisals, fair market value assessments, impairment testing results, and replacement cost estimates. Captures valuation date, valuation type (insurance, impairment, fair value, replacement cost), appraised value, valuation methodology, appraiser reference, and whether an impairment write-down was triggered. Supports GAAP ASC 360 impairment testing, insurance renewal negotiations, and capital planning for asset replacement programs.

attributes.name: valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset valuation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being valued (container, facility, equipment, building, etc.).

attributes.name: appraised_value
attributes.description: The monetary value assigned to the asset by the appraiser or valuation methodology at the valuation date, expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: appraiser_certification
attributes.description: Professional certification or credential of the appraiser (e.g., ASA, MAI, CPA, internal certification reference).

attributes.name: appraiser_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external appraisal firm or internal department that conducted the valuation.

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or firm that performed the valuation (internal valuation team member or external certified appraiser).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the valuation was formally approved for use in financial reporting or insurance negotiations.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved the valuation (e.g., CFO, Controller, Asset Manager).

attributes.name: carrying_amount
attributes.description: The book value (net book value after accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the valuation date, used for impairment comparison.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the appraised value (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: depreciation_method_used
attributes.description: The depreciation method applied in the valuation calculation: straight line, declining balance, units of production, sum of years digits, or none (for land or non-depreciable assets).

attributes.name: economic_obsolescence_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the asset exhibits economic obsolescence (loss of value due to external market or regulatory factors beyond the assets control).

attributes.name: functional_obsolescence_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the asset exhibits functional obsolescence (outdated design, inefficiency, or inability to meet current operational requirements).

attributes.name: impairment_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this valuation identified an impairment condition (appraised value below carrying amount) requiring a write-down per GAAP ASC 360.

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: The calculated impairment loss amount if an impairment was identified (carrying amount minus fair value). Null if no impairment.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The insurance coverage amount recommended or established based on this valuation, used for property and casualty insurance policy limits.

attributes.name: market_value_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the base valuation to reflect current market conditions, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5% increase, -10.00 for 10% decrease).

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: The technical approach used to determine the appraised value: cost approach (replacement cost less depreciation), market approach (comparable sales), income approach (discounted cash flow), or other industry-standard methodology.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 820 - Fair Value Measurement, IFRS 13

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this valuation record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_valuation_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next valuation of this asset, based on policy requirements (e.g., annual insurance appraisals, quarterly impairment testing).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, assumptions, limitations, or special considerations documented by the appraiser or valuation team.

attributes.name: physical_condition_rating
attributes.description: Appraiser assessment of the physical condition of the asset at the valuation date: excellent (like new), good (minor wear), fair (moderate wear), poor (significant deterioration), critical (near end of life).

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business purpose for this valuation (e.g., annual insurance renewal, quarterly impairment testing, pre-disposal assessment, merger and acquisition due diligence).

attributes.name: replacement_cost_new
attributes.description: The estimated cost to replace the asset with a new equivalent asset at current market prices, used for insurance and capital planning.
attributes.references: Insurance Industry Standards, Capital Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or file path to the detailed valuation report supporting this valuation record.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: The estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used in depreciation and replacement cost calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, Internal Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: useful_life_remaining_years
attributes.description: The estimated remaining useful life of the asset in years at the valuation date, as assessed by the appraiser.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, Internal Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset valuation was performed or effective.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: valuation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the valuation event, often assigned by appraiser or internal valuation team.

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the valuation record: draft (in progress), pending review (submitted for approval), approved (finalized and accepted), rejected (not accepted), superseded (replaced by a newer valuation).

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The purpose or methodology category of the valuation: insurance appraisal for coverage renewal, fair market value for financial reporting, impairment test per ASC 360, replacement cost for capital planning, liquidation value for disposal scenarios, or book value reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, IFRS IAS 36 - Impairment of Assets

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) for complex fixed assets and stationary equipment, defining the component parts and sub-assemblies that make up each asset. Tracks parent asset, component part number, component description, quantity, unit of measure, manufacturer part number, criticality rating, lead time for replacement, and whether the component is a consumable or capital spare. Sourced from Infor EAM BOM management and SAP PM equipment BOM. Enables preventive maintenance planning, spare parts inventory management, and total cost of ownership analysis for compactors, balers, WTE boilers, and MRF sorting equipment.
products.reference: BOM — Infor EAM / SAP PM Equipment BOM

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of materials record.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent fixed asset or stationary equipment that this BOM defines. References the complex asset (compactor, baler, WTE boiler, MRF sorting equipment) that is composed of the component parts listed in this BOM.

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the component within the BOM structure. Level 0 is the parent asset; level 1 is a direct child assembly; level 2 is a sub-assembly of level 1, etc. Supports multi-level BOM explosion.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM line item: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), obsolete (superseded by newer component), or pending approval (engineering change pending).

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the component part, including specifications, model information, and functional purpose within the parent asset.

attributes.name: component_part_number
attributes.description: Internal part number or SKU identifying the component part or sub-assembly within the BOM structure. Used for inventory lookup and procurement.

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the component within the BOM hierarchy: assembly (major sub-system), sub-assembly (grouped parts), part (individual component), consumable (regularly replaced item), fluid (lubricant, hydraulic fluid), or fastener (bolt, nut, washer).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business criticality of the component to asset operation. Critical components cause immediate downtime if failed; low criticality components have minimal operational impact. Drives spare parts stocking strategy.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency procurement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this BOM line item is superseded or retired. Null for currently active BOM lines. Enables historical BOM reconstruction for legacy assets.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM line item is effective. Supports BOM versioning when component specifications change due to engineering updates or supplier changes.

attributes.name: ehs_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing environmental, health, and safety considerations for the component, including PPE requirements, disposal instructions, and regulatory compliance notes.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is classified as hazardous material under RCRA, DOT, or OSHA regulations (e.g., batteries, hydraulic fluids, refrigerants). Requires special handling, storage, and disposal procedures.
attributes.references: RCRA, DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations, OSHA

attributes.name: interchangeable_part_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of alternative or equivalent part numbers that can substitute for this component. Supports flexible sourcing and reduces downtime when primary part is unavailable.

attributes.name: is_capital_spare
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is classified as a capital spare (high-value, long-lead-time item stocked for emergency replacement) versus a consumable or routine spare. Capital spares are capitalized on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: is_consumable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is a consumable item (regularly replaced during preventive maintenance, such as filters, belts, fluids) versus a durable part. Consumables are expensed immediately.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified this BOM record. Tracks engineering change ownership.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last updated in the source system. Tracks engineering changes and BOM revisions.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days required to procure and receive the component from the supplier. Used for preventive maintenance planning and spare parts inventory optimization.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or supplier of the component part.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number for the component. Used for sourcing genuine replacement parts and warranty claims.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures_hours
attributes.description: Average operating hours between failures for this component, based on historical maintenance data. Used for predictive maintenance scheduling and reliability analysis.

attributes.name: parent_component_part_number
attributes.description: Part number of the immediate parent component in a multi-level BOM. Null for level-1 components that report directly to the parent asset. Enables hierarchical BOM navigation.

attributes.name: position_reference
attributes.description: Physical location or position identifier of the component within the parent asset (e.g., 'Front Left Wheel', 'Hydraulic Pump #2', 'Conveyor Belt Section A'). Aids field technicians during maintenance.

attributes.name: quantity_required
attributes.description: Number of units of this component required to assemble or maintain one unit of the parent asset. Supports fractional quantities for consumables.

attributes.name: recommended_replacement_interval_hours
attributes.description: Manufacturer-recommended or company-standard operating hours between scheduled replacements for this component. Drives preventive maintenance (PM) work order generation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this BOM record was sourced: Infor EAM (asset management), SAP PM (plant maintenance), or manual entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this BOM record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of the component in US dollars. Used for total cost of ownership analysis, maintenance budgeting, and spare parts valuation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., each, gallon, kilogram). Aligns with inventory and procurement systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|set|pair|gallon|liter|pound|kilogram|meter|foot|box|roll|sheet — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: warranty_months
attributes.description: Duration of manufacturer warranty coverage for the component in months from date of installation. Used for warranty claim tracking and cost recovery.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who created this BOM record. Supports accountability and audit requirements.

products.name: rfid_tag
products.description: Master record for RFID tags assigned to containers and other trackable assets. Captures RFID tag ID (EPC code), tag type (passive UHF, active), tag manufacturer, tag status (active, damaged, replaced, retired), assignment date, asset it is attached to, and last read timestamp. Enables automated container identification during collection events, yard inventory counts, and customer billing verification. Integrates with AMCS Platform container tracking and Waste Logics customer portal for container-level service confirmation.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the RFID tag record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.container. Business justification: RFID_tag currently has container_id_cid STRING attribute storing the container CID, but container table exists with cid as a unique identifier. This should be a proper FK relationship (rfid_tag.contai

attributes.name: assigned_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the asset (container, equipment, or other trackable item) to which this RFID tag is currently attached. Null if the tag is in inventory and not yet assigned.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Modified By User ID
attributes.description: The system user ID or employee identifier of the person who last modified this RFID tag record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: primary_rfid_installed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who physically installed the RFID tag on the asset. Used for quality control, training assessment, and accountability.

attributes.name: replaced_by_tag_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the new RFID tag that replaced this tag. Creates a chain of custody for container tracking history. Null if the tag is still active or was retired without replacement.

attributes.name: assigned_asset_type
attributes.description: The category of asset to which this RFID tag is attached. Container is most common for waste management operations. Equipment includes compactors, balers, and scales. Vehicle tags are used for non-fleet tracking (fleet has separate DOT-compliant systems).

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date when this RFID tag was assigned to a specific asset (container, equipment, or other trackable item). Marks the beginning of the tag-asset relationship for tracking and billing purposes.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer batch or lot number for this RFID tag. Used for quality control, recall management, and performance analysis by production batch. If a batch shows high failure rates, all tags from that batch can be identified and replaced proactively.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this RFID tag record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: encryption_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RFID tag uses encrypted communication protocols. True for tags with built-in encryption capabilities. Encryption enhances security for sensitive applications and prevents unauthorized tag cloning.

attributes.name: environmental_rating
attributes.description: The IP (Ingress Protection) rating indicating the tags resistance to dust and water. Waste container RFID tags typically require IP67 or higher for outdoor exposure, pressure washing, and harsh environmental conditions.

attributes.name: epc_code
attributes.description: The unique EPC identifier encoded in the RFID tag, typically a 96-bit or 128-bit hexadecimal value conforming to GS1 EPC standards. This is the actual data read from the tag during scanning operations.

attributes.name: expected_lifespan_years
attributes.description: The manufacturer-specified expected operational lifespan of the RFID tag in years under normal operating conditions. Passive tags typically last 10-20 years; active tags with batteries last 3-7 years. Used for replacement forecasting and total cost of ownership calculations.

attributes.name: frequency_band
attributes.description: The radio frequency band on which the tag operates. UHF (860-960 MHz) is standard for waste container tracking due to long read range and fast read rates. Frequency band determines reader compatibility and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: The date when the RFID tag was physically installed or affixed to the asset. May differ from assignment_date if the tag was pre-assigned before physical installation.

attributes.name: installation_location
attributes.description: Describes where on the asset the RFID tag is physically mounted (e.g., front panel, lid interior, side wall, handle). Important for troubleshooting read failures and ensuring consistent tag placement across the fleet.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this RFID tag record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: last_read_location_latitude
attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate where the RFID tag was last successfully read. Captured from GPS-enabled mobile readers on collection vehicles or fixed readers at facilities.

attributes.name: last_read_location_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate where the RFID tag was last successfully read. Used in conjunction with latitude for geospatial analysis and container location tracking.

attributes.name: last_read_reader_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the RFID reader device that performed the last successful read. May be a vehicle-mounted reader, handheld scanner, or fixed portal reader. Used for reader performance analysis and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_read_timestamp
attributes.description: The most recent date and time when this RFID tag was successfully read by an RFID reader during a collection event, yard inventory scan, or other tracking operation. Used to identify potentially damaged or lost tags.

attributes.name: memory_capacity_bytes
attributes.description: The total memory capacity of the RFID tag in bytes. Typical passive UHF tags have 96-512 bits (12-64 bytes). Larger memory allows storage of additional data such as service history, container specifications, or maintenance records directly on the tag.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, observations, or special handling instructions related to this RFID tag. May include installation challenges, special mounting requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum ambient temperature in Celsius at which the RFID tag is rated to operate reliably. Important for tags on containers exposed to direct sunlight, hot climates, or high-temperature waste streams.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum ambient temperature in Celsius at which the RFID tag is rated to operate reliably. Critical for tags deployed in extreme cold climates or refrigerated waste applications.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number under which this RFID tag was procured. Links to procurement records for vendor management, cost tracking, and audit trails.

attributes.name: read_failure_count
attributes.description: The total number of attempted reads that failed for this RFID tag. High failure counts indicate potential tag damage, environmental interference, or reader issues requiring investigation.

attributes.name: read_success_count
attributes.description: The total number of successful reads recorded for this RFID tag since installation. Used to assess tag performance, durability, and expected remaining lifespan.

attributes.name: replacement_date
attributes.description: The date when this RFID tag was replaced with a new tag. Marks the end of the tags active service life. Used in conjunction with installation_date to calculate actual tag lifespan for performance analysis.

attributes.name: replacement_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why the RFID tag was replaced or retired. Common reasons include physical damage, read failures, container disposal, tag upgrade, or end of service life. Used for root cause analysis and tag durability improvement.

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Read Signal Strength in Decibels-Milliwatts (dBm)
attributes.description: The signal strength of the last successful RFID tag read, measured in dBm. Typical values range from -70 dBm (weak) to -30 dBm (strong). Declining signal strength over time may indicate tag degradation or environmental factors affecting readability.

attributes.name: tag_manufacturer
attributes.description: The name of the company that manufactured the RFID tag hardware (e.g., Alien Technology, Impinj, Avery Dennison, Confidex). Important for warranty tracking, performance characteristics, and replacement sourcing.

attributes.name: tag_model
attributes.description: The specific model or part number of the RFID tag. Different models have varying read ranges, durability ratings, and environmental tolerances critical for outdoor waste container applications.

attributes.name: tag_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the RFID tag. Active tags are in service and readable. Damaged tags have been identified as non-functional during read attempts. Replaced tags have been swapped out. Retired tags are decommissioned. Lost tags cannot be located. Quarantined tags are temporarily suspended pending investigation.

attributes.name: tag_type
attributes.description: The technology type of the RFID tag. Passive UHF tags are most common for container tracking in waste management, offering long read ranges (up to 40 feet) without battery power. Active tags include battery for extended range and sensor capabilities.

attributes.name: unit_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tag Unit Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The purchase cost of the individual RFID tag in USD. Used for asset valuation, inventory accounting, and cost-benefit analysis of RFID tracking programs. Passive UHF tags typically cost $0.10-$2.00; active tags cost $10-$50.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the manufacturer warranty for this RFID tag expires. Used for warranty claim processing and replacement planning. Typical RFID tag warranties range from 1-5 years depending on tag type and application.

attributes.name: write_protected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RFID tag memory is write-protected (locked). True means the tag is read-only and cannot be reprogrammed. False means the tag can be rewritten. Write protection prevents accidental or malicious data modification.

products.name: rfid_read_event
products.description: Transactional record of each RFID tag read event captured during container service operations. Records read timestamp, RFID tag ID, reader device ID (mounted on collection truck or at facility gate), GPS coordinates at time of read, read signal strength, associated route and stop reference, and event type (service confirmation, yard scan, gate entry/exit). Provides the raw event stream for container service verification, billing confirmation, and chain-of-custody tracking. High-volume append-only table partitioned by read date.

attributes.name: rfid_read_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Read Event ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each RFID tag read event captured during container service operations or facility gate transactions.

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical container (dumpster, roll-off, cart) associated with the RFID tag at the time of the read event.

attributes.name: collection_stop_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific route stop where the RFID read occurred. Null for non-route events such as facility gate scans.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Route Stop Master Data

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with the container at the time of the read event. Used for billing confirmation and service verification.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver operating the vehicle at the time of the RFID read. Null for stationary facility readers. Used for driver performance tracking and service accountability.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (landfill, MRF, transfer station, maintenance shop) where the RFID read occurred. Null for mobile route-based reads.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier encoded in the RFID tag affixed to the container. Typically a 96-bit or 128-bit EPC (Electronic Product Code) represented as hexadecimal string.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 15963 RFID Unique Identification, EPCglobal Tag Data Standards

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection route being executed when the RFID read occurred. Null for facility gate or yard scan events.

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service address where the container was read. Used to validate that service occurred at the correct location per the service agreement.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection vehicle on which the RFID reader was mounted at the time of the read event. Null for stationary readers at facilities.

attributes.name: antenna_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific antenna on the reader device that captured the tag read. Multi-antenna readers use this to determine read direction and position.

attributes.name: billing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this read event qualifies for billing confirmation based on read quality, location accuracy, and business rules. True if eligible, False if not.

attributes.name: duplicate_read_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this read event is a duplicate of a previous read within a defined time window (typically 60 seconds). True if duplicate, False if unique read.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RFID read event indicating the business context: service confirmation during collection, yard inventory scan, facility gate entry/exit, manual handheld scan, or exception handling scan.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any exception or anomaly detected during the read event. Empty string if no exception. Used for quality control and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the exception or anomaly, if any. Null if no exception occurred. Provides context for operational review and customer service.

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Accuracy in Meters
attributes.description: Estimated accuracy of the GPS coordinates in meters at the time of the read. Lower values indicate higher precision. Used to assess reliability of location data for billing disputes.
attributes.references: GPS Standard Positioning Service Performance Standard

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the raw RFID read event was processed and loaded into the lakehouse silver layer. Used for data lineage and latency monitoring.

attributes.name: read_direction
attributes.description: Direction of vehicle or container movement at the time of read: inbound (entering facility), outbound (exiting facility), stationary (no movement), or unknown (direction not determinable).

attributes.name: read_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees) captured by GPS at the time of the RFID read. Used for service verification and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: read_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees) captured by GPS at the time of the RFID read. Used for service verification and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: read_quality_score
attributes.description: Normalized quality score (0-100) calculated from signal strength, GPS accuracy, and reader diagnostics. Higher scores indicate more reliable reads suitable for billing confirmation.

attributes.name: read_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this read within the route execution or facility session. Used to reconstruct the chronological order of service events and detect duplicate reads.

attributes.name: read_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the RFID tag was read by the reader device. Captured in UTC and converted to local time zone for reporting.

attributes.name: reader_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID reader device that captured the tag read. Typically mounted on collection trucks, facility gates, or yard scanners.

attributes.name: reader_firmware_version
attributes.description: Version number of the firmware running on the RFID reader device at the time of the read. Used for troubleshooting and ensuring device compliance with operational standards.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Business date (local time zone) on which the service event occurred. Used for partitioning, billing cycle alignment, and operational reporting. Derived from read_timestamp.

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency (RF) Signal Strength in Decibels-Milliwatts (dBm)
attributes.description: Received signal strength indicator (RSSI) of the RFID tag read measured in dBm. Higher values (closer to zero) indicate stronger signal. Used for read quality assessment and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the read event record in the source operational system. Used for traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system that originated the RFID read event: AMCS Platform, Geotab Fleet Telematics, Locus Dispatch, or MANUAL for handheld scanner entries.

attributes.name: tag_memory_bank
attributes.description: RFID tag memory bank from which the data was read: EPC (Electronic Product Code), TID (Tag Identifier), USER (user-defined data), or RESERVED (access/kill passwords).
attributes.references: EPCglobal Gen2 RFID Tag Memory Architecture

products.name: gps_telemetry
products.description: Time-series GPS position and telemetry records for GPS-equipped stationary assets and containers with active tracking devices. Captures device ID, asset ID, timestamp, latitude, longitude, altitude, geofence zone, battery level, tamper alert flag, and signal quality. Distinct from fleet telematics (which is owned by the fleet domain via Geotab) — this table covers non-rolling assets such as roll-off containers with GPS trackers, portable compactors, and temporary site equipment. Enables real-time asset location visibility, theft detection, and unauthorized movement alerts.
products.reference: GPS Asset Tracking / Geotab Asset Tracker

attributes.name: gps_telemetry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GPS telemetry record. Primary key for time-series GPS position and telemetry data from GPS-equipped stationary assets and containers.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the asset being tracked. Links to the asset master record for the container, roll-off, portable compactor, or other GPS-equipped stationary asset.

attributes.name: accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated accuracy radius of the GPS position reading in meters. Represents the confidence interval within which the true position lies. Lower values indicate higher precision.

attributes.name: altitude_meters
attributes.description: Elevation above sea level in meters at the time of GPS reading. Used for terrain analysis and asset placement verification in landfill cells or hilly terrain.

attributes.name: battery_level_percent
attributes.description: Remaining battery charge level of the GPS device as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for proactive device maintenance and battery replacement scheduling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this telemetry record was first inserted into the data platform. System-generated audit field in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the GPS tracking device hardware unit. Used to identify the specific GPS tracker installed on the asset, distinct from the asset itself.
attributes.references: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) and GPS Device Registry

attributes.name: device_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the GPS tracking device. Active = functioning normally, Inactive = powered off or not transmitting, Maintenance = undergoing service, Fault = malfunction detected, Decommissioned = removed from service.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GPS position and telemetry data was captured by the device. Represents the real-world observation time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Version number of the GPS device firmware at the time of transmission. Used for device management, compatibility tracking, and firmware update planning.

attributes.name: geofence_status
attributes.description: Current status of the asset relative to its assigned geofence zone. Inside = within authorized zone, Outside = beyond authorized zone, Entering = crossing into zone, Exiting = crossing out of zone.

attributes.name: geofence_zone_code
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the geofence zone the asset is currently within. Null if asset is outside all defined geofences. Used for authorized location verification and breach detection.

attributes.name: hdop
attributes.description: Measure of GPS position accuracy. Lower values indicate better precision. <1 = Ideal, 1-2 = Excellent, 2-5 = Good, 5-10 = Moderate, 10-20 = Fair, >20 = Poor.

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Compass direction of asset movement in degrees (0-360). 0/360 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West. Null if asset is stationary.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the GPS device was installed on the asset. Used for device age tracking, warranty management, and replacement planning.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the GPS device last underwent maintenance, battery replacement, or firmware update. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and device lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the asset position in decimal degrees. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000. Positive values represent North, negative values represent South.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the asset position in decimal degrees. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000. Positive values represent East, negative values represent West.

attributes.name: movement_alert_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether unauthorized movement was detected for a stationary asset. True = unexpected movement detected, False = asset stationary or movement authorized. Used for theft detection.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Communication network used to transmit the telemetry data. Cellular = 3G/4G/5G mobile network, Satellite = satellite communication, WiFi = wireless local area network, LoRa = long-range low-power network.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or context about the telemetry reading. Used for documenting anomalies, investigation findings, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: satellite_count
attributes.description: Number of GPS satellites the device was connected to at the time of reading. Higher count indicates better position accuracy. Minimum 3 required for 2D fix, 4 for 3D fix.

attributes.name: signal_quality
attributes.description: Quality of the GPS satellite signal at the time of reading. Excellent = 4+ satellites with strong signal, Good = 3-4 satellites, Fair = 2-3 satellites, Poor = 1-2 satellites, No Signal = 0 satellites.

attributes.name: speed_kmh
attributes.description: Instantaneous speed of the asset in kilometers per hour. For stationary assets, non-zero values indicate unauthorized movement or theft. Used for tamper detection and movement alerts.

attributes.name: tamper_alert_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the GPS device detected tampering or unauthorized removal attempt. True = tamper detected, False = no tamper. Triggers security alerts and theft investigation.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient temperature reading from the GPS device sensor in degrees Celsius. Used for device health monitoring and environmental condition tracking. Null if device does not have temperature sensor.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Classification of what triggered this telemetry transmission. Scheduled = routine periodic update, Event Triggered = geofence breach or movement alert, On Demand = manual query, Emergency = tamper or critical alert.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this telemetry record was last modified in the data platform. System-generated audit field in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

products.name: lease
products.description: Master record for operating and finance leases on assets used by Waste Management, including leased containers, compactors, balers, and facility equipment. Captures lessor name, lease type (operating/finance per ASC 842/IFRS 16), lease start and end dates, monthly lease payment, right-of-use (ROU) asset value, lease liability balance, implicit interest rate, renewal options, purchase options, and SAP lease contract reference. Supports IFRS 16/ASC 842 lease accounting compliance, lease vs. buy analysis, and lease portfolio management.
products.reference: ASC 842 / IFRS 16 Lease Accounting — SAP RE-FX

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lease contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the business unit or operating division responsible for managing this lease. Supports lease portfolio analysis by business unit.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Lease has leased_asset_category STRING describing the type of leased asset, but this should map to the asset_class hierarchy for consistent classification. Adding asset_class_id FK enables lease accou

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the asset master record in the asset management system (Infor EAM or SAP PM). Links the lease contract to the specific asset instance being leased. May be null if lease covers multiple assets or asset not yet registered.

attributes.name: lessor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Vendor master record identifier for the lessor in the SAP S/4HANA MM module. Links lease contract to vendor master for procurement and accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: classification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease was classified as operating or finance lease per ASC 842/IFRS 16 criteria. Typically the lease commencement date or the date of initial recognition.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that is the lessee under this lease contract. Used for financial consolidation and reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the lease contract as assigned by the lessor or internal procurement system. Referenced in SAP lease contract module and vendor communications.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which lease expenses are allocated for internal management accounting and cost control. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA CO module cost center hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the scanned lease contract document stored in the enterprise document management system. Provides access to the original signed lease agreement for audit and reference purposes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled end date of the lease contract term. May be extended if renewal options are exercised. Null for perpetual or indefinite leases.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for posting lease expense or ROU asset amortization. Aligns with the chart of accounts in SAP S/4HANA FI module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: implicit_interest_rate
attributes.description: Implicit interest rate in the lease contract, if determinable. Used to discount lease payments to present value for ROU asset and lease liability calculation. If not determinable, the lessee's incremental borrowing rate is used instead.

attributes.name: incremental_borrowing_rate
attributes.description: The rate of interest that the lessee would have to pay to borrow funds on a collateralized basis over a similar term to obtain an asset of similar value. Used as the discount rate when the implicit rate is not readily determinable.

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lease contract. Active indicates the lease is in force; terminated indicates early termination; expired indicates natural end of term; renewed indicates transition to a new lease term.

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease as operating lease, finance lease, or capital lease per ASC 842 (US GAAP) and IFRS 16 accounting standards. Determines accounting treatment for right-of-use asset and lease liability recognition.

attributes.name: leased_asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset(s) covered by this lease contract. May include containers (dumpsters, roll-offs, carts), compactors, balers, scales, or other equipment used in waste collection and processing operations.

attributes.name: liability_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding lease liability balance on the balance sheet. Represents the present value of remaining lease payments. Reduced by principal portion of each lease payment and increased by interest accretion.

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent lease modification that changed the scope or consideration of the lease. Lease modifications require remeasurement of the lease liability and ROU asset per ASC 842/IFRS 16.

attributes.name: modification_description
attributes.description: Description of the most recent lease modification, including changes to lease term, payment amounts, or scope of leased assets. Null if no modifications have occurred.

attributes.name: monthly_lease_payment
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount due to the lessor under the lease contract. Excludes variable payments based on usage or performance. Denominated in the currency specified in payment_currency_code.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the lease contract. Used for capturing information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for lease payment amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). All monetary fields in this lease record are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of lease payment obligations. Most leases are monthly; some may be quarterly or annually depending on contract terms.

attributes.name: purchase_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes an option for the lessee to purchase the leased asset at the end of the lease term or during the lease period. True if purchase option exists; False otherwise.

attributes.name: purchase_option_price
attributes.description: Fixed purchase price or formula for calculating the purchase price if the lessee exercises the purchase option. Null if no purchase option exists or price is not predetermined.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes an option for the lessee to renew the lease term beyond the initial end date. True if renewal option exists; False otherwise.

attributes.name: renewal_option_terms
attributes.description: Detailed description of renewal option terms, including renewal period duration, payment adjustments, and conditions for exercising the renewal. Null if no renewal option exists.

attributes.name: rou_asset_value
attributes.description: Initial right-of-use asset value recognized on the balance sheet at lease commencement per ASC 842/IFRS 16. Calculated as the present value of lease payments plus initial direct costs. Amortized over the lease term.

attributes.name: sap_lease_contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document ID for the lease contract in SAP S/4HANA lease accounting module. Used for integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and SAP system of record.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the lease contract. Marks the commencement of the lease term and the beginning of lease payment obligations and right-of-use asset recognition per ASC 842/IFRS 16.

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the lease contract in months from start date to end date. Used for lease accounting calculations and amortization schedules.

attributes.name: termination_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee has the right to terminate the lease before the scheduled end date. True if early termination option exists; False otherwise.

attributes.name: termination_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty or fee payable by the lessee if the lease is terminated early. Null if no termination penalty applies or if termination is not permitted.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

products.name: warranty
products.description: Warranty records for fixed assets and equipment, tracking manufacturer and extended warranty coverage. Captures warranty provider, warranty type (parts, labor, comprehensive), coverage start and end dates, warranty terms and conditions, claim limit, deductible amount, warranty contact information, and number of claims filed. Enables proactive warranty utilization before expiration, warranty claim tracking, and vendor performance assessment. Particularly relevant for high-value MRF sorting equipment, WTE boilers, compactors, and balers.

attributes.name: warranty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset warranty record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset or equipment covered by this warranty. Links to the asset master record in Infor EAM or SAP PM.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warranty provider in the vendor master system. Links to SAP MM vendor master or procurement system.

attributes.name: claim_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total dollar amount that can be claimed under this warranty over its lifetime. Null indicates unlimited coverage. Critical for high-value equipment like MRF sorting systems and WTE boilers.

attributes.name: claim_limit_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the claim limit amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: claims_approved_count
attributes.description: Total number of warranty claims that were approved and paid by the warranty provider. Used to calculate claim approval rate and assess warranty provider responsiveness.

attributes.name: claims_filed_count
attributes.description: Total number of warranty claims filed against this warranty to date. Used for warranty utilization tracking and vendor performance assessment.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for warranty claim submission and service coordination.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the warranty provider for claim submission and service coordination.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for warranty claim submission and service requests. Critical for emergency equipment failures at MRF and WTE facilities.

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the warranty contract document stored in the document management system. May be a file path, document ID, or URL to the warranty certificate and terms.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Total cost paid for the warranty coverage. Zero for manufacturer warranties included with asset purchase; non-zero for extended warranties and service contracts. Used for warranty ROI analysis.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the warranty cost (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: coverage_duration_months
attributes.description: Total duration of warranty coverage expressed in months. Standard manufacturer warranties are typically 12-36 months; extended warranties may range from 12-120 months for high-value equipment.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
