attributes.description: Date when warranty coverage expires. Critical for proactive warranty utilization planning and determining when assets transition to out-of-warranty maintenance.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Date when warranty coverage becomes effective. Typically the asset acquisition date for manufacturer warranties or the purchase date for extended warranties.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warranty record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount that must be paid by Waste Management before warranty coverage applies to each claim. Zero indicates no deductible. Common for extended warranties on high-value equipment.

attributes.name: deductible_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deductible amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Specific items, conditions, or circumstances not covered by the warranty. Common exclusions include consumables, normal wear and tear, misuse, unauthorized modifications, and environmental damage from landfill leachate or corrosive waste.

attributes.name: labor_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty covers labor costs for repairs and service. True means labor is covered; false means labor must be paid separately.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this warranty record. Links to Workday HCM user master for audit purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warranty record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes about the warranty including special conditions, claim history, provider performance issues, or maintenance requirements to maintain warranty validity.

attributes.name: parts_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty covers replacement parts costs. True means parts are covered; false means parts must be purchased separately.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the company or organization providing the warranty coverage. May be the original equipment manufacturer (OEM), third-party warranty provider, or service contractor.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number used to procure the extended warranty or service contract. Links to SAP MM procurement documents. Null for manufacturer warranties included with asset purchase.

attributes.name: renewal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warranty is eligible for renewal upon expiration. True means renewal option is available; false means warranty cannot be renewed.

attributes.name: renewal_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when Waste Management should be notified about warranty renewal options. Typically 60-90 days before coverage end date to allow procurement lead time.

attributes.name: service_response_time_hours
attributes.description: Guaranteed maximum time in hours for warranty provider to respond to a service request. Part of warranty Service Level Agreement (SLA). Critical for high-availability equipment like MRF sorting lines and WTE boilers.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full text or summary of warranty terms, conditions, exclusions, and limitations. Includes coverage scope, maintenance requirements, claim procedures, and exclusions (e.g., misuse, environmental damage, normal wear).

attributes.name: total_claims_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total claims value (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: total_claims_value
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar value of all approved warranty claims paid under this warranty. Used for warranty ROI calculation and vendor performance assessment.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty can be transferred to a new owner if the asset is sold or relocated. True means warranty transfers with the asset; false means warranty is non-transferable.

attributes.name: travel_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty covers technician travel and trip charges for on-site service. Particularly relevant for remote landfill sites, transfer stations, and MRF facilities.

attributes.name: warranty_number
attributes.description: Unique warranty certificate or policy number issued by the warranty provider. Used for warranty claim reference and tracking.

attributes.name: warranty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the warranty. Active indicates coverage is in effect; expired indicates coverage period has ended; cancelled indicates warranty was terminated early; suspended indicates temporary hold; pending activation indicates warranty purchased but not yet effective.

attributes.name: warranty_type
attributes.description: Classification of warranty coverage. Manufacturer warranty is included with asset purchase; extended warranty is purchased separately; comprehensive covers parts and labor; parts-only covers replacement parts; labor-only covers service labor; service contract is ongoing maintenance agreement.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this warranty record. Links to Workday HCM user master for audit purposes.

products.name: capital_project
products.description: Tracks capital expenditure (CapEx) projects for asset construction, major improvements, and infrastructure expansion at Waste Management facilities. Captures project name, project type (new construction, expansion, rehabilitation, technology upgrade), sponsoring facility, approved budget, actual spend to date, project manager, start date, expected completion date, project status, and SAP internal order or WBS element reference. Manages the lifecycle from CapEx approval through asset capitalization, including landfill cell construction, MRF equipment upgrades, and WTE plant expansions.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure project. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Project Definition

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit or division sponsoring and funding the capital project.

attributes.name: carbon_initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_initiative. Business justification: Capital projects implementing carbon reduction initiatives (LFG-to-RNG systems, solar installations, fleet electrification, energy efficiency upgrades) must link to carbon_initiative to track capital

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Capital_project has asset_class STRING attribute indicating the asset class of the asset being constructed/improved, but asset_class table exists with full classification hierarchy and accounting rule

attributes.name: contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Vendor master identifier for the primary contractor executing the capital project.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) - Vendor Master

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary facility or site where the capital project is being executed (landfill, MRF, transfer station, WTE plant, maintenance shop).

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset master record created when the capital project is capitalized and transferred to the asset register.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Asset Master

attributes.name: project_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the project manager assigned to this capital project.

attributes.name: strategic_initiative_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate strategic initiative or program that this capital project supports (e.g., sustainability program, fleet modernization, digital transformation).

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the project was completed and ready for capitalization or operational handover.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Actual Finish Date

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenditure incurred to date on the capital project, including committed and posted costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Actual Costs

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when project execution commenced (first work order issued or first cost posted).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Actual Start Date

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual or committee that approved the capital project budget (e.g., CFO, Board of Directors, Capital Committee).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital project budget and scope were formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure budget approved for the project by the investment committee or board. Represents the authorized spending limit.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the completed project was capitalized and transferred to fixed assets, triggering depreciation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Capitalization Date

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount committed via purchase orders and contracts but not yet invoiced or paid.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Contract or purchase order number governing the terms and conditions of the capital project execution with the contractor.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this project (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: environmental_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital project requires environmental permits from EPA, state, or local authorities (e.g., air quality permit, water discharge permit, solid waste permit).
attributes.references: EPA Permit Requirements, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of capital funding for the project: internal cash (retained earnings), debt financing (bonds/loans), equity (shareholder capital), grant (government/foundation), lease (capital lease arrangement), or public-private partnership.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Funding Source

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified the capital project record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was last modified.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number issued by the regulatory authority for environmental or construction permits required for the project.
attributes.references: EPA Permit System, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current status of required environmental or construction permits: not required, pending (application submitted), approved (permit issued), denied (application rejected), expired (permit lapsed).
attributes.references: EPA Permit Tracking, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for project completion as defined in the approved project schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Basic Finish Date

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for project execution to begin, as defined in the project plan.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Basic Start Date

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the capital project (e.g., 'Landfill Cell 7 Construction', 'MRF Baler Upgrade').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Project Description

attributes.name: project_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing important project milestones, issues, decisions, or other relevant information for audit and knowledge management.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique project number or code assigned to the capital project for external reference and tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Project Definition Number

attributes.name: project_priority
attributes.description: Business priority ranking of the capital project: critical (regulatory/safety), high (strategic), medium (operational improvement), low (discretionary).

attributes.name: project_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the capital project scope, objectives, deliverables, and expected business outcomes.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital project: planning (pre-approval), approved (budget authorized), in_progress (active execution), on_hold (temporarily suspended), completed (construction finished), cancelled (terminated before completion), closed (financially settled and capitalized). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|approved|in_progress|on_hold|completed|cancelled|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - System Status

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by nature of work: new construction (greenfield facility), expansion (capacity increase), rehabilitation (major repair/refurbishment), technology upgrade (system modernization), equipment replacement (asset renewal), or environmental compliance (regulatory-driven improvements).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Project Type

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment of the capital project considering technical complexity, regulatory exposure, schedule constraints, and financial impact.

attributes.name: sap_internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP internal order number used for cost collection and tracking for smaller capital projects not requiring full WBS structure.

attributes.name: sap_wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP WBS element identifier for complex capital projects structured with hierarchical work breakdown for cost and schedule control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - WBS Element

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Schedule variance in days calculated as actual completion date minus planned completion date. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early completion.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Budget variance calculated as actual spend minus approved budget. Positive values indicate over-budget, negative values indicate under-budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Budget Variance

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Budget variance expressed as a percentage of approved budget: (actual spend / approved budget - 1) * 100.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Budget Variance Percentage

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created the capital project record.

products.name: capital_project_expenditure
products.description: Line-level expenditure records posted against capital projects, capturing individual cost transactions that accumulate toward asset capitalization. Records expenditure date, cost element, vendor or internal cost center, amount, purchase order reference, goods receipt reference, and capitalization eligibility flag. Supports project cost tracking, budget variance analysis, and the determination of total capitalized cost when the asset is placed in service. Integrates with SAP FI-CO project accounting and the procurement domain PO/GR process.
products.reference: SAP PS Cost Line Item / CapEx Accounting

attributes.name: capital_project_expenditure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital project expenditure line item. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the capital budget line item against which this expenditure is tracked. Enables budget vs. actual variance analysis and commitment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems Budget Management

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: The business unit or operating division responsible for this capital project expenditure. Enables segment reporting and divisional performance analysis (e.g., Residential Collection, Commercial Hauling, Landfill Operations, Recycling).

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent capital project (WBS element or internal order) against which this expenditure is posted. Links to the capital project master record tracking the overall asset construction or acquisition initiative.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS) - WBS Element

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: The internal cost center code that originated this expenditure for internal labor, overhead, or allocated costs. Used when the expenditure is not vendor-sourced but represents internal resource consumption charged to the capital project.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the facility or site where the capital asset is being constructed or installed. Links expenditure to the physical location (landfill, MRF, transfer station, WTE plant, maintenance shop).

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the vendor or supplier who provided the goods or services for this expenditure. Null for internal cost postings (labor, overhead allocation).

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The asset class or category to which the capitalized expenditure will be assigned upon asset creation. Determines depreciation method, useful life, and general ledger account assignment (e.g., Buildings, Machinery, Vehicles, Landfill Infrastructure, MRF Equipment).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting Asset Class

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance between this expenditure and the budgeted amount for the associated budget line item. Positive values indicate over-budget spending; negative values indicate under-budget. Supports project cost control and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems Budget Variance

attributes.name: capitalization_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this expenditure is eligible for capitalization as part of the fixed asset cost basis. True indicates the cost will be capitalized; False indicates it will be expensed. Drives the asset acquisition cost calculation and financial statement treatment.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Capitalization Rules, SAP Asset Accounting

attributes.name: capitalization_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the capitalization eligibility determination. Values include: direct_material (materials incorporated into the asset), direct_labor (labor directly attributable to asset construction), freight_delivery (transportation costs), installation (installation and commissioning), site_preparation (site work required for asset placement), engineering_design (design and engineering services), permits_fees (regulatory permits and fees), interest_during_construction (financing costs during construction period), overhead_allocation (allocated indirect costs), non_capitalizable_expense (operating expense not eligible for capitalization), maintenance_repair (routine maintenance or repair costs). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_material|direct_labor|freight_delivery|installation|site_preparation|engineering_design|permits_fees|interest_during_construction|overhead_allocation|non_capitalizable_expense|maintenance_repair — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Capitalization Guidance, SAP Asset Accounting Configuration

attributes.name: commitment_document_number
attributes.description: The document number representing the financial commitment (purchase requisition, purchase order, or contract) that reserved budget for this expenditure. Supports commitment accounting and funds reservation tracking.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The company code (legal entity) to which this expenditure is posted. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation and legal entity-level reporting.

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: The cost element or general ledger account code to which this expenditure is classified. Represents the nature of the cost (e.g., materials, labor, equipment rental, professional services, freight). Aligns with the chart of accounts and cost accounting structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element / FI GL Account

attributes.name: cost_element_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the cost element, providing business context for the type of expenditure (e.g., Construction Materials, Engineering Services, Equipment Purchase, Site Preparation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Master Data

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this expenditure record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the expenditure amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency capital projects and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating source document (invoice date, goods receipt date, timesheet date) that triggered this expenditure posting. Used for audit trail and variance analysis between document and posting dates.

attributes.name: expenditure_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of this expenditure line item in the transaction currency. Represents the gross cost posted to the capital project before any adjustments, taxes, or allocations.

attributes.name: expenditure_date
attributes.description: The date on which this expenditure was posted to the capital project in the financial system. Represents the accounting date for cost recognition, distinct from the document date or goods receipt date.

attributes.name: expenditure_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier or line number for this expenditure transaction within the project accounting system. May correspond to a journal entry line, goods receipt line, or invoice line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Document Line Item

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number that confirmed physical receipt of materials or completion of services. Links expenditure to the three-way match process (PO, GR, Invoice) and inventory movements.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on the vendor invoice. Used for payment terms calculation, aging analysis, and variance tracking between invoice date and posting date.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number associated with this expenditure. Supports accounts payable reconciliation and audit trail for payment processing.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this expenditure record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this expenditure record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about this expenditure. May include justification for capitalization decision, variance explanations, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was made to the vendor for this expenditure. Supports cash flow analysis and working capital management for capital projects.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: The financial document number for the payment that settled this expenditure. Links to accounts payable payment run and cash management.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: The current posting status of this expenditure in the financial system. Values: posted (successfully posted to GL and project), pending (awaiting approval or posting), reversed (posting has been reversed), cancelled (transaction cancelled before posting), parked (saved as draft, not yet posted).

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_item
attributes.description: The specific line item number within the purchase order that this expenditure relates to. Provides granular linkage to the ordered material or service specification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM PO Line Item

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number that authorized this expenditure. Links the expenditure to the procurement process and enables traceability to contract terms, pricing, and delivery schedules.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods or services received for this expenditure line item. Used in conjunction with unit_of_measure for materials management and unit cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt Quantity

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this expenditure posting was reversed. Used for period-end reconciliation and financial statement adjustments.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this expenditure posting has been reversed (True) or is active (False). Supports audit trail and correction tracking.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this expenditure has been reversed. Provides audit trail linkage between original and reversal postings.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (sales tax, VAT, GST) associated with this expenditure. Supports tax accounting, compliance reporting, and determination of capitalizable vs. expensed tax costs.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or tax code applied to this expenditure. Determines tax rate, tax type, and tax account assignment.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of measure for this expenditure. Calculated as expenditure_amount divided by quantity. Supports unit cost benchmarking and price variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., EA for each, TON for tons, HR for hours, M3 for cubic meters, FT for feet). Standardizes quantity reporting across diverse materials and services.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Units of Measurement, SAP UOM

attributes.name: work_breakdown_structure_element
attributes.description: The WBS element code within the project hierarchy to which this expenditure is assigned. Provides granular project phase or deliverable-level cost tracking (e.g., Design Phase, Site Preparation, Equipment Installation, Commissioning).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this expenditure record. Supports accountability and audit compliance.

products.name: container_inventory
products.description: Snapshot inventory records of container stock held at Waste Management yards, maintenance shops, and staging areas. Tracks yard location, container type, container size, quantity on hand, quantity reserved for deployment, quantity awaiting repair, quantity condemned, and last physical count date. Enables container inventory management, reorder planning, and deployment scheduling. Supports the AMCS Platform container pool management and Waste Logics container availability queries for customer service representatives.
products.reference: AMCS Container Pool / Waste Logics Inventory

attributes.name: container_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the container inventory snapshot record.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Container_inventory tracks inventory by container_type and container_size, but these should map to asset_class for consistent valuation and accounting. Adding asset_class_id FK enables inventory valua

attributes.name: supplier_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary vendor or supplier for this container type and size.

attributes.name: yard_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the yard, maintenance shop, or staging area where the container inventory is held.

attributes.name: average_daily_deployment
attributes.description: The average number of containers of this type and size deployed per day over the last 30 days.

attributes.name: container_size
attributes.description: The size or capacity of the container (e.g., 2-yard, 4-yard, 6-yard, 8-yard, 10-yard, 20-yard, 30-yard, 40-yard, 64-gallon, 96-gallon).

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: The type of container being inventoried (e.g., front load, rear load, roll-off, cart, compactor, recycling bin).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for inventory valuation (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: The number of days between scheduled cycle counts for this container type and size.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: The number of days the current available inventory can support based on average daily deployment rate.

attributes.name: inventory_date
attributes.description: The date for which this inventory snapshot was recorded.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The current status of this inventory record (active, inactive, frozen, under review).

attributes.name: last_physical_count_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the employee who performed the last physical inventory count.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: The date when the last physical inventory count was performed for this container type and size at this location.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The typical lead time in days from order placement to delivery for this container type and size.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The SAP material master number or SKU for this container type and size.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_count_date
attributes.description: The date when the next physical inventory count is scheduled for this container type and size.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this inventory record.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Number of containers available for immediate deployment to customer sites.

attributes.name: quantity_condemned
attributes.description: Number of containers marked as condemned or awaiting disposal due to irreparable damage or end of useful life.

attributes.name: quantity_in_repair
attributes.description: Number of containers currently undergoing maintenance or repair.

attributes.name: quantity_in_transit
attributes.description: Number of containers in transit between facilities or being relocated.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Total number of containers of this type and size currently in stock at the yard location.

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Number of containers reserved for scheduled deployment or customer orders.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The minimum inventory level that triggers a reorder or procurement action for this container type and size.

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: The standard quantity to order when inventory falls below the reorder point.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: The specific storage location or bin code within the yard facility where containers are stored.

attributes.name: total_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total value of the inventory on hand (quantity_on_hand multiplied by unit_cost).

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The average cost per container unit for this type and size, used for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between the system inventory count and the last physical count (positive or negative).

products.name: condition_history
products.description: Historical log of condition rating changes for fixed assets over their lifecycle, providing a longitudinal view of asset health degradation or improvement. Each record captures the assessment date, previous condition grade, new condition grade, assessment method (inspection, sensor, visual), technician or system that recorded the change, and any associated work order or inspection reference. Enables predictive maintenance modeling, asset replacement prioritization, and lifecycle cost analysis for containers, compactors, and facility equipment.

attributes.name: condition_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each asset condition history record. Primary key for the asset condition history log.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset whose condition is being tracked. Links to the asset master record in SAP PM or Infor EAM.

attributes.name: inspection_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order under which this condition assessment was performed. Links to Infor EAM or SAP PM work order records.

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or technician who performed the condition assessment. Links to Workday HCM employee master data.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: The method or technique used to assess the asset condition. Distinguishes between manual inspections, automated sensor data, and predictive analytics.

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and observations from the condition assessment. Provides detailed context for condition changes and recommended actions.

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the condition assessment was performed or recorded. Principal business event timestamp for this log entry.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment based on its business purpose. Supports compliance tracking and maintenance strategy analysis.

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment was performed to satisfy regulatory compliance requirements (EPA, OSHA, DOT, state environmental agencies).

attributes.name: condition_change_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or root cause for the change in asset condition. Captures factors such as wear and tear, environmental exposure, accident damage, or maintenance improvements.

attributes.name: condition_score
attributes.description: Numeric condition score on a standardized scale (typically 0-100) representing asset health. Enables quantitative trend analysis and predictive maintenance modeling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this condition history record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: critical_defect_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any critical or safety-related defects were identified during this assessment. Triggers immediate corrective action workflows.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated repair cost. Supports multi-currency financial reporting.

attributes.name: current_condition_grade
attributes.description: The new condition rating assigned during this assessment. Used for asset health monitoring and replacement prioritization.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects or issues identified during this condition assessment. Quantifies asset health problems for prioritization and trend analysis.

attributes.name: document_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents (inspection reports, test results, certifications) attached to this condition assessment.

attributes.name: environmental_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of environmental risk posed by the asset in its current condition. Critical for landfill liners, leachate systems, and hazardous waste containers.

attributes.name: estimated_remaining_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated number of years the asset can continue to operate in its current condition before replacement is required. Supports capital planning and budgeting.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost to repair or remediate the identified condition issues. Supports maintenance budgeting and repair-versus-replace analysis.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate where the condition assessment was performed. Supports field inspection verification and mobile workforce tracking.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate where the condition assessment was performed. Supports field inspection verification and mobile workforce tracking.

attributes.name: inspection_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or document identifier for the inspection report or assessment record. Supports traceability to source documentation.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the technician or inspector who recorded the condition change. Provides human-readable reference for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this condition history record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this condition history record was last modified. Tracks updates and corrections to assessment data.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next condition assessment based on inspection frequency requirements and asset criticality. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: operational_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of how the current asset condition affects operational performance and service delivery. Supports asset replacement prioritization.

attributes.name: photo_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of photos or images attached to this condition assessment record. Supports visual documentation of asset condition.

attributes.name: previous_condition_grade
attributes.description: The condition rating of the asset immediately before this assessment. Enables tracking of condition degradation or improvement over time.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: The recommended maintenance or lifecycle action based on this condition assessment. Drives work order generation and capital planning decisions.

attributes.name: recommended_action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for the recommended action. Determines scheduling and resource allocation for corrective maintenance.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency or authority for which this compliance inspection was performed (e.g., EPA, OSHA, state environmental department).

attributes.name: safety_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of safety risk posed by the asset in its current condition. Aligns with OSHA and EPA safety compliance requirements.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the IoT sensor or monitoring device that captured automated condition data. Applicable for sensor-based assessments on compactors, scales, and facility equipment.

attributes.name: system_source
attributes.description: Source system or application that recorded this condition assessment. Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this condition history record. Supports audit trail and data quality accountability.

products.name: utilization
products.description: Periodic utilization measurement records for fixed assets, capturing how intensively each asset is being used relative to its rated capacity. For containers, tracks fill level percentage, service frequency, and idle days. For compactors and balers, tracks operating hours, cycles per day, and throughput (tons). For scales, tracks weighing transactions per day. Captures measurement period, utilization rate, rated capacity, actual throughput, idle time, and data source (sensor, manual entry, AMCS). Supports asset rationalization, redeployment decisions, and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: utilization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset utilization measurement record.

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit that owns or operates the asset. Used for organizational reporting and asset portfolio analysis across divisions.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility where the asset is located during the measurement period. Links to landfill sites, MRF facilities, transfer stations, WTE plants, or maintenance shops.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being measured. Links to the asset master record in SAP PM or Infor EAM.

attributes.name: actual_throughput_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the actual throughput value. Must be compatible with the rated capacity unit for utilization rate calculation.

attributes.name: actual_throughput_value
attributes.description: The actual measured throughput or usage during the measurement period. For containers, this is average fill level. For compactors and balers, this is actual tons processed. For scales, this is actual weighing transactions completed.

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: The category of fixed asset being measured. Determines which utilization metrics are applicable (e.g., containers track fill level, compactors track operating hours and cycles, scales track transaction count). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: container|compactor|baler|scale|transfer_station|landfill_cell|mrf_equipment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: average_fill_level_percent
attributes.description: Average fill level percentage for containers during the measurement period. Calculated from RFID sensor readings or visual inspection data. Used to optimize service frequency and identify oversized or undersized containers.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the asset during the measurement period. Used for financial allocation of asset utilization costs and ROI analysis. Sourced from SAP FI/CO.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this utilization measurement record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: cycles_completed
attributes.description: Total number of operational cycles completed during the measurement period. Applicable to compactors (compaction cycles) and balers (baling cycles). Captured from equipment control systems or manual logs.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The system or method used to capture the utilization measurement. Identifies whether data came from automated sensors (RFID, GPS), manual entry, or integrated systems (AMCS, Infor EAM, SAP PM). Critical for data quality assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rfid_sensor|gps_telematics|manual_entry|amcs_platform|infor_eam|sap_pm|scale_system|equipment_controller — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: idle_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the asset was idle (not used or serviced) during the measurement period. Critical metric for container rationalization and redeployment decisions.

attributes.name: idle_hours
attributes.description: Total idle hours (non-operating time) during the measurement period. For containers, this represents days without service. For equipment, this is available hours minus operating hours. Used to identify underutilized assets for redeployment.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The method used to obtain the utilization measurement. Automated sensor indicates RFID or IoT device readings, manual inspection indicates visual assessment, system calculated indicates derived metrics from operational systems.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the utilization measurement period. Defines the conclusion of the observation window for calculating utilization metrics.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the utilization measurement period. Defines the beginning of the observation window for calculating utilization metrics.

attributes.name: measurement_quality_score
attributes.description: Data quality score for the utilization measurement, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00. Higher scores indicate more reliable data. Factors include data source reliability, completeness, and timeliness. Used to weight measurements in analytics.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the utilization measurement was captured or recorded. For sensor-based measurements, this is the sensor reading timestamp. For manual entries, this is the data entry timestamp.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that last modified this utilization measurement record. Used for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this utilization measurement record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the utilization measurement. May include explanations for anomalies, special circumstances affecting utilization, or operational observations.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Total operating hours recorded for the asset during the measurement period. Applicable to compactors, balers, and other powered equipment. Captured from equipment hour meters or telematics systems.

attributes.name: peak_fill_level_percent
attributes.description: Maximum fill level percentage recorded during the measurement period. Indicates whether the container size is adequate for the customer's waste generation rate.

attributes.name: rate_percent
attributes.description: The calculated utilization rate expressed as a percentage of rated capacity. For containers, this is average fill level percentage. For equipment, this is operating hours divided by available hours. Used for asset rationalization and redeployment decisions.

attributes.name: rated_capacity_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the rated capacity value. Varies by asset type: cubic yards for containers, tons per day for processing equipment, transactions per day for scales, operating hours for machinery.

attributes.name: rated_capacity_value
attributes.description: The maximum rated capacity of the asset during the measurement period. For containers, this is volume in cubic yards. For compactors and balers, this is throughput in tons per day (TPD). For scales, this is maximum weighing transactions per day.

attributes.name: redeployment_candidate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is a candidate for redeployment based on utilization metrics. True if asset is underutilized at current location and could be more effectively deployed elsewhere.

attributes.name: roi_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this utilization measurement has significant impact on asset ROI analysis. True if utilization is outside acceptable thresholds and requires management attention for redeployment or disposal decisions.

attributes.name: service_frequency_count
attributes.description: Number of times the asset was serviced during the measurement period. For containers, this is the number of pickups. For equipment, this is the number of maintenance or operational service events.

attributes.name: total_weight_processed_tons
attributes.description: Total weight in tons processed through the asset during the measurement period. Applicable to compactors, balers, scales, and processing equipment. Sourced from weight tickets and equipment logs.

attributes.name: utilization_status
attributes.description: Categorical assessment of the asset's utilization level. Optimal indicates efficient use, underutilized flags candidates for redeployment, overutilized indicates need for additional capacity, idle indicates no usage, out_of_service indicates asset is unavailable.

attributes.name: weighing_transactions_count
attributes.description: Total number of weighing transactions processed by a scale during the measurement period. Key utilization metric for landfill scales, transfer station scales, and MRF scales.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this utilization measurement record. Used for data lineage and accountability.

products.name: impairment
products.description: Records formal asset impairment assessments and write-downs performed under GAAP ASC 360 or IFRS IAS 36. Captures impairment test date, triggering event (market decline, physical damage, regulatory change, technology obsolescence), carrying amount before impairment, recoverable amount, impairment loss recognized, GL posting reference, approving authority, and whether the impairment is permanent or potentially reversible. Particularly relevant for landfill assets approaching permitted capacity limits and WTE plant equipment subject to regulatory changes.

attributes.name: impairment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset impairment assessment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Asset_impairment has asset_class STRING for reporting impairment losses by asset class (required for financial statement disclosures under ASC 360 / IAS 36). Adding asset_class_id FK enables asset-cla

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility where the impaired asset is located. Particularly relevant for landfill sites approaching capacity limits or WTE plants subject to regulatory changes.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being assessed for impairment. Links to the asset master record in SAP S/4HANA or Infor EAM.

attributes.name: appraisal_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the external appraisal report supporting the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent appraiser or valuation firm that performed the asset valuation, if an external appraisal was obtained.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment assessment was formally approved by the approving authority.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the executive or authority who approved the impairment assessment and write-down. Typically CFO or Controller for material impairments.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation, work papers, and audit trail materials that substantiate the impairment assessment for internal and external audit purposes.

attributes.name: carrying_amount
attributes.description: The net book value of the asset immediately before the impairment loss is recognized, calculated as acquisition cost less accumulated depreciation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA) to which this impairment belongs.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the impaired asset, used for management accounting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this impairment record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this impairment record.

attributes.name: discount_rate_percent
attributes.description: The discount rate applied in calculating the present value of future cash flows for value-in-use calculations, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental incident (e.g., leachate release, air quality violation, groundwater contamination) contributed to the impairment assessment.
attributes.references: EPA, CERCLA, Clean Water Act, Clean Air Act

attributes.name: fair_value_less_costs_to_sell
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Value Less Costs to Sell
attributes.description: The estimated market value of the asset less the costs that would be incurred to dispose of it. Used in determining recoverable amount under IFRS.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the impairment loss is recognized.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the impairment loss is recognized for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the impairment loss was posted to the general ledger for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gl_posting_document_number
attributes.description: The document number in the general ledger system (SAP FI) that records the impairment loss journal entry.

attributes.name: impairment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the impairment assessment, typically generated by the financial system for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: impairment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the impairment assessment in the approval and posting workflow.

attributes.name: impairment_type
attributes.description: Classification of whether the impairment is permanent (not reversible) or potentially reversible under future conditions. GAAP generally prohibits reversal; IFRS allows reversal under certain conditions.

attributes.name: landfill_remaining_capacity_tons
attributes.description: For landfill assets, the remaining permitted capacity in tons at the time of impairment assessment. Approaching capacity limits is a common impairment trigger for landfill infrastructure.
attributes.references: EPA Subtitle D, State Solid Waste Regulations

attributes.name: loss_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the carrying amount exceeds the recoverable amount. This is the write-down amount recognized in the financial statements.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this impairment record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this impairment record was last modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or context regarding the impairment assessment, including management judgment, assumptions, and future considerations.

attributes.name: recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The higher of the asset's fair value less costs to sell or its value in use. This is the amount the asset is expected to recover through use or sale.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to specific regulatory changes, permit modifications, or compliance requirements that triggered or contributed to the impairment (e.g., EPA permit restrictions, RCRA changes, state environmental regulations).

attributes.name: reversal_amount
attributes.description: The amount of impairment loss reversed, if applicable under IFRS. Limited to the amount that would restore the asset to its depreciated historical cost.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment loss was reversed, if applicable under IFRS. Null if no reversal has occurred.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this impairment has been subsequently reversed. Applicable under IFRS IAS 36; not permitted under GAAP ASC 360.

attributes.name: sox_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the impairment loss is material for SOX financial reporting and internal control purposes, requiring enhanced documentation and executive certification.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment assessment was performed. This is the principal business event timestamp for the impairment evaluation.

attributes.name: triggering_event
attributes.description: The business event or condition that triggered the impairment assessment. Common triggers include market decline, physical damage, regulatory changes, technology obsolescence, landfill capacity limits, or environmental incidents. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: market_decline|physical_damage|regulatory_change|technology_obsolescence|capacity_limit|operational_closure|environmental_incident — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: triggering_event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific circumstances that triggered the impairment assessment, including relevant facts, dates, and business context.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the recoverable amount or fair value of the asset for impairment testing purposes.

attributes.name: value_in_use
attributes.description: The present value of future cash flows expected to be derived from the asset through continued use and eventual disposal. Used in determining recoverable amount under IFRS.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this impairment record.

products.name: asset_insurance
products.description: Insurance policy coverage records for fixed assets, tracking which assets are covered under which insurance policies. Captures policy number, insurer name, coverage type (property, equipment breakdown, inland marine), coverage start and end dates, insured value, deductible, premium allocation, and last appraisal date. Enables insurance renewal management, coverage gap analysis, and claims processing support. Particularly important for high-value assets such as WTE boilers, MRF sorting lines, landfill liner systems, and large compactor fleets.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset insurance coverage record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id

attributes.name: additional_insured_parties
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional parties named as insured under this policy. May include lessors, contractors, or municipalities requiring coverage.

attributes.name: appraisal_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the appraisal report. Links to document management system for detailed valuation documentation.

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: The name of the certified appraiser or appraisal firm that conducted the last valuation. Used for audit trail and credibility assessment.

attributes.name: broker_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the insurance broker. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: broker_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the insurance broker. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance broker or agent who arranged this coverage. Used for policy servicing and renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: business_interruption_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy includes business interruption coverage for lost revenue if the asset is damaged and operations are disrupted. Critical for WTE plants, MRF facilities, and landfill operations.

attributes.name: certificate_of_insurance_issued_date
attributes.description: The date when the certificate of insurance was issued. Used to verify current coverage for contract compliance and vendor requirements.

attributes.name: claims_count
attributes.description: The total number of insurance claims filed against this policy for this asset. Used for loss history analysis and premium negotiation.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: The date when insurance coverage expires for this asset. Triggers renewal workflows and coverage gap alerts.

attributes.name: coverage_limit

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: The date when insurance coverage becomes effective for this asset. Used to determine coverage eligibility for claims.

attributes.name: coverage_status

attributes.name: coverage_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this insurance coverage record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: deductible_amount

attributes.name: environmental_coverage_flag

attributes.name: insured_value

attributes.name: insurer_contact_name
attributes.description: Primary contact person at the insurance carrier for policy inquiries and claims.

attributes.name: insurer_email

attributes.name: insurer_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the insurance company providing coverage for this asset.

attributes.name: insurer_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the insurance carrier contact. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: last_appraisal_date
attributes.description: The date when the asset was last appraised to determine insured value. Used to track valuation currency and trigger reappraisal workflows.

attributes.name: loss_payee_name
attributes.description: The name of the entity designated to receive insurance proceeds in the event of a loss. Typically the asset owner or lender with a security interest.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this insurance coverage record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_appraisal_due_date
attributes.description: The date when the next asset appraisal is due. Ensures insured values remain current and aligned with replacement costs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, exclusions, or coverage details not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The unique policy number assigned by the insurance carrier. Used for claims processing and policy lookup.

attributes.name: policy_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date when the insurance policy is scheduled for renewal. Triggers renewal workflows and premium renegotiation processes.

attributes.name: premium_allocation_method

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount paid for this insurance coverage. May be annual, semi-annual, or allocated portion for this specific asset.

attributes.name: premium_frequency

attributes.name: renewal_notice_sent_date

attributes.name: replacement_cost_coverage_flag

attributes.name: risk_assessment_rating

attributes.name: total_claims_paid
attributes.description: The cumulative amount paid by the insurer for all claims on this asset. Used for loss ratio analysis and risk assessment.

products.name: lifecycle_stage
products.description: Reference table defining the standardized lifecycle stages for Waste Management fixed assets, from acquisition through retirement. Stages include: Ordered, In-Transit, Received, In-Service, Idle, Under-Repair, Condemned, Retired. Each stage carries a description, allowed transitions (state machine rules), SLA for stage duration, and whether the asset is billable to customers while in this stage. Enables consistent lifecycle status management across SAP FI-AA, Infor EAM, and AMCS Platform, and supports asset aging and lifecycle reporting.
products.reference: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle / SAP FI-AA Status Management

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset lifecycle stage reference record. Primary key for the asset lifecycle stage table.

attributes.name: allowed_source_stages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lifecycle stage codes from which an asset can transition INTO this stage. Defines valid state machine transitions. Empty for initial stage (Ordered). Used for lifecycle transition validation.

attributes.name: allowed_target_stages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lifecycle stage codes to which an asset can transition FROM this stage. Defines valid state machine transitions. Empty for terminal stage (Retired). Used for lifecycle transition validation.

attributes.name: amcs_deployment_status

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether management approval is required before an asset can transition into this lifecycle stage. True for Condemned and Retired stages due to financial impact; False for routine operational transitions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle stage reference record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display order of lifecycle stages in user interface dropdowns, reports, and dashboards. Lower numbers appear first. Allows custom ordering independent of stage_sequence.

attributes.name: disposal_method_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates the typical disposal method applicable when assets reach this lifecycle stage. Only populated for terminal stages (Condemned, Retired). Used to guide asset disposition process and environmental compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|scrap|donation|landfill|recycle|transfer|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management / EPA Waste Disposal Regulations

attributes.name: eam_status_mapping
attributes.description: Corresponding asset status code in Infor EAM system. Enables synchronization of lifecycle stage between Waste Management's enterprise data model and Infor EAM operational system. Used for bidirectional integration.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this lifecycle stage definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active stage definitions. Supports temporal versioning and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this lifecycle stage definition became active and available for use in asset management systems. Supports temporal versioning of lifecycle stage definitions.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this lifecycle stage are subject to active environmental compliance monitoring and reporting requirements (EPA, RCRA, air/water permits). True for In-Service stage at regulated facilities; False for non-operational stages.

attributes.name: gl_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transitions into or out of this lifecycle stage trigger General Ledger postings in SAP FI. True for capitalization (Received), disposal (Retired), and impairment (Condemned) stages; False for operational transitions.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle stage definition is currently active and available for assignment to assets. False for deprecated or retired stage definitions. Used for reference data filtering.

attributes.name: is_active_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle stage represents an active operational state where the asset is available for use or deployment. True for In-Service and Idle stages; False for all others.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this lifecycle stage can be billed to customers for service. True for In-Service stage when asset is deployed at customer location; False for all other stages including maintenance, transit, and disposal.

attributes.name: is_depreciable
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this lifecycle stage are subject to depreciation calculations. True for capitalized stages (Received, In-Service, Idle, Under-Repair); False for pre-capitalization (Ordered, In-Transit) and post-disposal (Condemned, Retired) stages.
attributes.references: GAAP / IFRS Fixed Asset Accounting Standards

attributes.name: is_insurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this lifecycle stage require active insurance coverage. True for stages where asset has value and risk exposure (In-Transit, Received, In-Service, Idle, Under-Repair); False for pre-acquisition and post-disposal stages.

attributes.name: is_terminal_stage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a terminal lifecycle stage from which no further transitions are allowed. True only for Retired stage; False for all others. Used for lifecycle completion validation.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether preventive maintenance (PM) strategies and work orders should be active for assets in this lifecycle stage. True for In-Service and Idle stages; False for all others. Drives PM scheduling in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management / Infor EAM PM Configuration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or business rules related to this lifecycle stage. Used for documentation and knowledge management.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated notifications should be sent to stakeholders when an asset transitions into this lifecycle stage. True for exception stages (Under-Repair, Condemned) and terminal stages (Retired); False for routine operational transitions.

attributes.name: requires_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this lifecycle stage require periodic safety and compliance inspections. True for In-Service and Idle stages; False for non-operational stages. Drives inspection scheduling in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: OSHA Safety Standards / EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: requires_location_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this lifecycle stage require active GPS or RFID location tracking. True for In-Service, Idle, and In-Transit stages; False for stationary stages (Received, Under-Repair) and disposal stages.

attributes.name: sap_system_status
attributes.description: Corresponding system status code in SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA) module. Maps lifecycle stage to SAP's asset master status field. Used for SAP integration and financial reporting alignment.

attributes.name: sla_duration_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Duration in Days
attributes.description: Target maximum number of days an asset should remain in this lifecycle stage before transitioning to the next stage. Used for lifecycle aging analysis and exception reporting. Null for stages without time constraints (e.g., In-Service).

attributes.name: sla_warning_threshold_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Threshold in Days
attributes.description: Number of days before SLA breach when warning alerts should be triggered for assets remaining in this stage. Typically 70-80% of sla_duration_days. Used for proactive lifecycle management.

attributes.name: stage_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of lifecycle stages into major phases: acquisition (ordered, in-transit, received), operational (in-service, idle), maintenance (under-repair), disposal (condemned, retired). Used for lifecycle analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: stage_code

attributes.name: stage_description

attributes.name: stage_name

attributes.name: stage_owner_role

attributes.name: stage_sequence

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle stage reference record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: utilization_tracking_enabled

products.name: facility_access_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization and preference relationship between customer accounts and waste management facilities. It captures which facilities a customer is authorized to use, their preference ranking, facility-specific pricing overrides, access restrictions, and delivery history. Each record links one customer account to one facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this customer-facility relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, large commercial and industrial customer accounts are authorized to deliver waste to multiple facilities based on waste type, geographic proximity, and facility capacity. Each facility serves thousands of customer accounts. The business actively manages facility access authorizations as operational records, tracking customer-specific preferences, pricing overrides, access restrictions, and delivery history for each customer-facility pair.

attributes.name: account_customer_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Access Authorization - Customer Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account that has been granted facility access

attributes.name: customer_account_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management employee or system user who granted this facility access authorization. Used for audit trail and authorization governance.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to facility. Links this authorization to the specific waste management facility.

attributes.name: access_restrictions
attributes.description: Specific restrictions or conditions on this customer's access to this facility (e.g., 'hazardous waste only', 'weekdays only', 'max 5 tons per delivery', 'requires escort'). Null if no restrictions apply.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer account was granted access authorization to this facility. Establishes the start of the customer-facility relationship.

attributes.name: authorization_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this facility access authorization expires, if applicable. Null for indefinite authorizations. Used for temporary access grants or contract-bound authorizations.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the facility access authorization. Active = customer can currently use facility; Suspended = temporarily blocked; Revoked = permanently removed; Expired = authorization period ended.

attributes.name: last_delivery_date

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about this customer-facility authorization, including special arrangements, historical context, or operational instructions.

attributes.name: preferred_facility_rank
attributes.description: Ranking of this facility in the customer's preference order (1 = most preferred). Used by routing systems to optimize delivery assignments when multiple authorized facilities are available.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_override
attributes.description: Customer-specific tipping fee per ton for deliveries to this facility, overriding the facility's standard rate. Null if standard facility rate applies. Used for negotiated pricing agreements with large commercial/industrial customers.

products.name: facility_safety_program_implementation
products.description: This association product represents the implementation and compliance tracking of safety programs at specific facilities. It captures the operational deployment of OSHA-mandated and internal safety programs (LOTO, confined space, hazmat handling, etc.) at each landfill, MRF, transfer station, or TSDF. Each record links one facility to one safety program with implementation-specific attributes including deployment dates, facility-level coordinators, compliance status, audit results, and certification levels that exist only in the context of this facility-program relationship.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management operations, each facility (landfill, MRF, transfer station, TSDF) must implement multiple safety programs (LOTO, confined space, hazmat handling, respiratory protection, etc.) based on the operations conducted at that site. Conversely, each safety program is deployed across multiple facilities where applicable. The business actively manages facility-specific implementation with deployment dates, facility-level coordinators, compliance status tracking, audit schedules, and certification levels that are unique to each facility-program combination.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the safety program being implemented at the facility

attributes.name: training_completion_percentage
