products.name: safety_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between fixed assets and safety programs. It captures the enrollment of specific assets (containers, compactors, vehicles, facility equipment) into formal OSHA-mandated and internal safety programs, tracking program-specific compliance status, audit history, certifications, and responsible personnel for each asset-program combination. Each record links one fixed asset to one safety program with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In waste management operations, fixed assets (compactors, balers, containers, vehicles, confined space equipment) must be enrolled in multiple OSHA-mandated and internal safety programs simultaneously (LOTO, Confined Space Entry, Fall Protection, Hazmat Handling, Respiratory Protection). Each safety program applies to multiple assets across facilities. The business actively manages compliance status, audit schedules, certifications, and responsible personnel for each asset-program combination as a distinct operational record.

products.name: vendor_certification

Critical for vendor qualification and compliance gating in hazmat and environmental services procurement.
products.reference: EPA TSDF Authorization / DOT Carrier Certification

attributes.name: vendor_certification_id

attributes.description: The name of the entity designated as the certificate holder or additional insured on insurance certificates. Typically Waste Management or a subsidiary. Null for non-insurance certifications.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate or permit number issued by the certifying authority. This is the externally-known identifier for the certification.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Tracking, DOT Carrier Authorization

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: A description of the scope, coverage, or limitations of the certification. For EPA TSDF permits, this includes waste types and treatment methods authorized. For DOT hazmat carriers, this includes hazard classes authorized. For insurance, this includes coverage limits and exclusions. For ISO certifications, this includes the facilities or processes covered.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Conditions, DOT Hazmat Regulations 49 CFR, ISO Certification Scope Statements

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Active certifications are valid and in good standing. Expired certifications have passed their expiration date. Suspended certifications are temporarily invalid due to compliance issues. Pending renewal indicates renewal application submitted but not yet approved. Revoked certifications have been permanently withdrawn by the issuing authority. Pending approval indicates initial application under review.
attributes.references: Vendor Qualification Standard, EPA Enforcement Actions

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The category of certification held by the vendor. Includes regulatory permits (EPA TSDF, DOT hazmat carrier, RCRA compliance, state environmental permits), quality/safety certifications (ISO 14001 environmental management, ISO 45001 occupational health and safety), business designations (MWBE minority/women-owned business enterprise), insurance certificates (general liability, workers compensation, auto liability), and bonding (performance bond, payment bond). attributes.references: EPA RCRA Regulations, DOT FMCSA, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, State Procurement Standards

attributes.name: compliance_gate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is a mandatory compliance gate for vendor qualification. True indicates that the vendor cannot be approved or used for relevant procurement categories without this certification being active and valid. False indicates the certification is supplementary or optional.
attributes.references: Vendor Qualification Policy, Procurement Compliance Standards

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: The monetary coverage limit for insurance certificates or bonding amounts. Expressed in USD. Null for non-financial certifications such as permits or quality certifications.
attributes.references: Insurance Policy Terms, Bonding Requirements, Procurement Contract Standards

attributes.name: coverage_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the coverage amount. Typically USD for U.S. operations.

attributes.name: deductible_amount

attributes.references: Permit Issuance Standards, Insurance Policy Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Nullable for certifications with indefinite validity or one-time designations.
attributes.references: Permit Renewal Requirements, Insurance Policy Terms

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory body, government agency, or standards organization that issued the certification. Examples include U.S. EPA, state environmental quality departments, DOT FMCSA, ISO certification bodies, insurance carriers, and bonding companies.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic or regulatory jurisdiction of the issuing authority. Examples include federal (USA), state (e.g., California, Texas), regional (e.g., EPA Region 5), or international (e.g., ISO global).
attributes.references: EPA Regional Structure, State Boundaries, DOT Jurisdictional Authority

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vendor certification record was most recently updated. Audit trail field.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was most recently renewed. Null for certifications that have never been renewed.
attributes.references: Vendor Certification History, Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next certification renewal. May differ from expiration date if renewal must be initiated before expiration.
attributes.references: Vendor Management Policy, Renewal Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the certification. May include details on restrictions, conditional approvals, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: policy_holder_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the policy holder for insurance certificates. Should match the vendor legal name. Null for non-insurance certifications.
attributes.references: Insurance Certificate Standards, Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: The procurement category or service line for which this certification is required or relevant. attributes.references: SAP MM Material Groups, Procurement Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: renewal_alert_threshold_days
attributes.description: The number of days before expiration when the system should trigger a renewal alert to procurement and vendor management teams. Typical values range from 30 to 90 days depending on certification type and renewal complexity.
attributes.references: Vendor Management Policy, Procurement Compliance Workflow

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified by Waste Management procurement or compliance teams.
attributes.references: Vendor Qualification Procedure, Compliance Audit Standards

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity and validity of the certification. Document upload indicates vendor provided certificate copy. Third-party verification indicates independent verification service used. Registry lookup indicates verification via public regulatory database (e.g., EPA TSDF registry, DOT carrier database). Self-attestation indicates vendor declaration without independent verification. On-site audit indicates physical inspection or audit conducted.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the received item (fleet parts, fuel, containers, chemicals, PPE, equipment, facility supplies). Enables inventory tracking and spend analytics.

attributes.name: po_line_id

attributes.name: purchase_order_id

attributes.name: receiving_employee_id

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: asset_number

attributes.name: batch_number

attributes.name: cost_center

attributes.name: created_by_user

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_note_number

attributes.name: document_date

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the goods receipt was posted. Supports monthly financial close and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods receipt was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing processes.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account

attributes.name: gr_document_number

attributes.name: gr_line_number

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: movement_type

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.name: posting_date

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag

attributes.name: reversal_flag

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: stock_type

attributes.name: valuation_amount

attributes.name: work_order_number

attributes.name: landfill_site_id

attributes.name: primary_service_employee_id

attributes.name: tertiary_service_last_modified_by_user_employee_id

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor who performed the service.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order or maintenance order that the service supports, if applicable.

attributes.name: acceptance_date

attributes.name: approver_name

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service entry sheet record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the service amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the service expense is posted for financial accounting.

attributes.name: invoice_reference_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number that references this service entry sheet for payment verification.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: service_end_date

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_number

attributes.name: service_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: service_unit_price

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the vendor invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt document confirming physical receipt of materials or services. Used in three-way match validation.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment run batch in which this invoice was paid. Links to the payment execution process for cash management and reconciliation.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice is submitted. Used for three-way match validation (PO-GR-Invoice).

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was approved for payment. Used for tracking approval cycle time and compliance with internal controls.

attributes.name: baseline_date

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts, volume discounts, or negotiated rebates.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the vendor, calculated based on invoice date and payment terms. Used for cash flow planning and avoiding late payment penalties.

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice was posted, used for financial period assignment and year-end reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the invoice amount is posted. Determines the expense or asset category for financial statement reporting.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount before any deductions, including all line items, taxes, and surcharges. This is the headline invoice value from the vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. This is the document date from the vendor's perspective and is used for aging and payment term calculations.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or header text from the vendor invoice providing additional context about the invoice purpose or contents.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number assigned by the vendor. This is the externally-known identifier for the invoice document and must be unique per vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the AP workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through approval, posting, and payment. attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_amount

attributes.name: payment_block_flag

attributes.name: payment_block_reason

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment method or instrument used to pay this invoice (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check, credit card, EFT, virtual card).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status indicating whether the invoice has been paid, is awaiting payment, or is overdue. Used for cash management and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

attributes.name: posting_date

attributes.name: receipt_date

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the vendor or related document (e.g., delivery note number, contract number, service entry sheet number) for cross-reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice line is matched. Used for three-way match validation (PO, GR, Invoice).

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service entry sheet confirming completion of services. Used for service-based invoice verification.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor invoice header. Links this line item to the overall invoice document.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Reference date for payment terms calculation. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date, used to determine payment due date.

attributes.name: blocked_for_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice line is blocked from payment due to matching errors, quality issues, or pending approval. True if blocked, false if cleared for payment.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which this expense is allocated. Enables operational cost tracking by department, facility, or business unit for EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Date when the material was delivered or service was completed. Used for accrual accounting and period-end cutoff validation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount applied to this invoice line. May represent volume discounts, early payment discounts, or negotiated rebates.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Discount percentage applied to the line net amount. Used for calculating discount amount when percentage-based discounts are applied.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this invoice line expense is posted. Determines financial statement classification and COGS categorization.

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service units being invoiced on this line. Compared against PO quantity and GR quantity for variance analysis.

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the material or service being invoiced. May include vendor-specific item descriptions, specifications, or service details.

attributes.description: Net amount for this invoice line before taxes and surcharges. Calculated as invoiced quantity multiplied by unit price, minus any line-level discounts.

attributes.name: line_notes

attributes.name: line_tax_amount

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number

attributes.name: match_status

attributes.name: payment_block_reason

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order placement to delivery, as committed by the vendor in the quote.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered to receive the quoted price, as specified by the vendor.

attributes.name: net_quote_amount
attributes.description: Net total amount after applying discounts and adding taxes. Final amount for competitive bid comparison.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms offered by the vendor in the quote (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). References standard payment term codes.

attributes.name: quote_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions provided by the vendor or procurement team regarding the quote.

attributes.name: quote_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique quote number assigned by the vendor or system. Business identifier for the quotation.

attributes.name: quote_ranking
attributes.description: Comparative ranking of this quote among all quotes received for the same RFQ, based on price, lead time, and technical compliance. Used for award decision.

attributes.name: quote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor quote in the procurement workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|accepted|rejected|expired|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quote_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor submitted the quote in response to the RFQ.

attributes.name: quote_valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the quote validity period. The quoted price is effective from this date.

attributes.name: quote_valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the quote validity period. The quoted price expires after this date.

attributes.name: quoted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service that the vendor is offering to supply at the quoted price.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejecting the quote, if applicable. Supports audit trail and vendor feedback for future RFQs.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Estimated tax amount applicable to the quoted goods or services, based on jurisdiction and tax rules.

attributes.name: technical_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quoted material or service meets the technical specifications and requirements defined in the RFQ.

attributes.name: technical_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on technical compliance, deviations, or exceptions to RFQ specifications. Supports award decision documentation.

attributes.name: total_quote_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for the quoted quantity (unit price multiplied by quantity). Gross quote value before taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quoted quantity (e.g., each, ton, gallon, pound, kilogram, liter, cubic meter, hour, day). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|TON|GAL|LB|KG|L|M3|FT3|HR|DAY — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit quoted by the vendor. Used for competitive bid comparison and price benchmarking.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration of the warranty period in months, as offered by the vendor in the quote.

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Warranty terms and conditions offered by the vendor for the quoted material or service.

products.name: info_record
products.description: Purchasing info record establishing the agreed purchasing conditions between Waste Management and a specific vendor for a specific material or service — the vendor-material price relationship master. Captures vendor, material, plant, purchasing organization, standard price, price unit, minimum order quantity, planned delivery time, tolerance levels, and last PO reference. Drives automatic price defaulting in PO creation and supports price variance analysis. Sourced from SAP MM Purchasing Info Record (EINA/EINE).

attributes.name: info_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchasing info record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or service for which this purchasing info record is established.

attributes.name: sourcing_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_contract. Business justification: Purchasing info records are often created from sourcing contract terms, establishing the operational purchasing conditions (price, lead time, MOQ) agreed in the contract. This FK provides traceability

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) for whom this purchasing info record is established.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the person who created this purchasing info record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchasing info record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard price (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this info record is marked for deletion and should not be used for new purchase orders.

attributes.name: gr_processing_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for internal goods receipt processing after delivery. Added to planned delivery time for total lead time.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer (e.g., FOB, CIF, EXW).

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The specific location or point referenced in the Incoterms (e.g., port name, facility address).

attributes.name: info_record_category
attributes.description: Category of the purchasing info record indicating the procurement type (standard purchase, subcontracting, consignment, pipeline).

attributes.name: info_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchasing info record, typically system-generated or manually assigned.

attributes.name: info_record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchasing info record indicating whether it is available for use in purchase order creation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the person who last modified this purchasing info record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchasing info record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent purchase order created using this info record.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The most recent purchase order number created using this info record, used for audit and reference purposes.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number for the material, distinct from the vendor part number.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from this vendor for this material. Used to enforce vendor MOQ requirements in PO creation.

attributes.name: net_price_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard price is a net price (no further discounts apply) or a gross price (subject to discounts and conditions).

attributes.name: order_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the material is ordered from the vendor (e.g., EA, GAL, TON, LB).

attributes.name: overdelivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage by which the vendor is allowed to overdeliver against the purchase order quantity without triggering an exception.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected delivery at the receiving location. Used for MRP and scheduling.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the plant or facility for which this info record applies. May be null for organization-level records.

attributes.name: price_date_category
attributes.description: Indicates how the price is determined: fixed price, variable price based on market conditions, or contract-based pricing.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: The quantity unit to which the standard price applies (e.g., price per 1, per 10, per 100 units).

attributes.name: purchase_order_acknowledgment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is required to send a formal acknowledgment of the purchase order before processing can proceed.

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing group or buyer responsible for managing this vendor-material relationship.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for this vendor-material relationship. Aligns with SAP organizational structure.

attributes.name: quotation_date
attributes.description: Date of the vendor quotation or RFQ response that established the pricing and terms in this info record.

attributes.name: quotation_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the vendor quotation or request for quotation (RFQ) that led to the creation of this info record.

attributes.name: regular_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is designated as the regular or preferred supplier for this material, used for automatic source determination.

attributes.name: reminder_days
attributes.description: Number of days before delivery date when a reminder should be sent to the vendor if no goods receipt has been posted.

attributes.name: standard_order_quantity
attributes.description: The standard or recommended order quantity for this vendor-material combination, often used for lot-sizing.

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: The agreed standard price per unit for the material or service from this vendor. This is the base price before any discounts or surcharges.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code applicable to purchases of this material from this vendor, used for automatic tax calculation in purchase orders and invoices.

attributes.name: underdelivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage by which the vendor is allowed to underdeliver against the purchase order quantity without triggering an exception.

attributes.name: unlimited_overdelivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unlimited overdelivery is allowed for this vendor-material combination, overriding the overdelivery tolerance percentage.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this purchasing info record and its pricing conditions become effective.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this purchasing info record and its pricing conditions remain effective. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: The vendors own part number or material identifier for this item, used for cross-referencing in purchase orders and communications.

products.name: source_list
products.description: Approved source list defining which vendors are authorized to supply specific materials to specific plants during defined validity periods. Captures material, plant, vendor, purchasing organization, validity start/end dates, fixed source indicator, MRP relevance flag, and blocked status. Enforces preferred vendor and sole-source policies for critical materials such as CNG fuel, hazmat disposal services, and OEM fleet parts. Sourced from SAP MM Source List (EORD).

attributes.name: source_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the source list record. Primary key.

attributes.name: info_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.info_record. Business justification: Source lists define approved vendors for materials and should reference the purchasing info record that contains the detailed purchasing conditions (price, lead time, terms). This FK links the approve

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material for which this source list entry defines approved vendors. Links to the material master record.

attributes.name: source_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID of the procurement employee who created this source list entry. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: source_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID of the procurement or vendor management employee who blocked this source list entry. Provides accountability for blocking decisions.

attributes.name: source_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID of the procurement employee who last modified this source list entry. Provides audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: sourcing_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_contract. Business justification: Source lists reference framework sourcing contracts for approved vendor-material combinations. Currently has agreement_number (STRING contract number); need FK to sourcing_contract.sourcing_contract_i

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved vendor authorized to supply the material to the specified plant. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: agreement_item_number
attributes.description: Five-digit line item number within the referenced purchasing agreement that corresponds to this source list entry. Identifies the specific material line in the contract.

attributes.name: blocked_date
attributes.description: The date on which this source list entry was blocked from use. Used for audit trails and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: blocked_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this source list entry is temporarily blocked from use. When true, prevents new purchase orders from being created with this vendor for this material, typically due to quality issues, contract disputes, or vendor performance problems.

attributes.name: blocked_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the reason why this source list entry is blocked, if applicable. Provides context for procurement restrictions and vendor management actions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this source list record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: critical_material_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material is classified as business-critical at this plant, requiring special procurement controls. Examples include CNG fuel for fleet operations, hazmat disposal services, or OEM parts for critical equipment.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_certified_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this vendor holds required environmental certifications such as ISO 14001, EPA permits, or state environmental quality approvals relevant to the material being supplied.

attributes.name: fixed_source_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this vendor is the sole authorized source for the material at this plant. When true, enforces sole-source procurement policy and prevents PO creation with other vendors.

attributes.name: hazmat_approved_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this vendor is approved and certified to supply hazardous materials per RCRA, DOT, and EPA requirements. Required for vendors supplying chemicals, hazardous waste disposal services, or regulated substances.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this source list record was last modified in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent purchase order created against this source list entry. Used for vendor activity tracking and source list maintenance.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The ten-digit purchase order number of the most recent PO created against this source list entry. Provides audit trail and quick reference to recent procurement activity.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from this vendor for this material at this plant. Enforces vendor-specific MOQ requirements in purchase order creation.

attributes.name: mrp_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this source list entry is considered during MRP runs for automatic purchase requisition generation. When true, MRP will propose this vendor for material replenishment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for procurement buyers and vendor managers to document special instructions, restrictions, quality requirements, or other relevant information about this source list entry.

attributes.name: oem_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this vendor is an authorized OEM supplier or distributor for the material. Critical for fleet parts procurement to ensure warranty compliance and genuine parts sourcing.

attributes.name: order_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which orders must be placed with this vendor for this material. Examples include EA (each), GAL (gallon), TON (ton), LB (pound), or CY (cubic yard).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant or facility where this source list entry applies. Represents landfills, MRFs, transfer stations, maintenance depots, or administrative offices.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating vendor preference order when multiple approved sources exist for the same material at the same plant. Lower numbers indicate higher preference. Used for automated vendor selection in procurement workflows.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for procurement activities under this source list entry. Defines procurement authority and contract scope.

attributes.name: quota_arrangement_number
attributes.description: Reference to the quota arrangement that governs order distribution when multiple vendors supply the same material. Defines percentage splits and allocation rules across approved sources.

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit business identifier for the source list entry in the SAP system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: source_determination_rule
attributes.description: Defines how the system should select this vendor during purchase requisition processing. Automatic allows system-driven vendor selection, manual requires buyer intervention, and quota arrangement distributes orders across multiple vendors per defined percentages.

attributes.name: standard_delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to material delivery for this vendor-material-plant combination. Used for MRP planning and delivery date calculation.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this source list entry expires. Vendor authorization to supply the material ends on this date. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this source list entry becomes effective. Vendor is authorized to supply the material starting on this date.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: The vendor's own part number or catalog number for this material. Used for cross-referencing in purchase orders, invoices, and vendor communications.

products.name: spend_category
products.description: Enterprise spend taxonomy classifying all procurement expenditures into a hierarchical category structure aligned with COGS and EBITDA reporting — Level 1 (Direct Operations, Indirect, Capital), Level 2 (Fleet, Fuel, Disposal, Facilities, Safety, Professional Services), Level 3 (granular sub-categories). Supports spend analytics, budget variance reporting, and strategic sourcing prioritization. Maps to GL account ranges and SAP CO cost element groups.
products.reference: UNSPSC / SAP MM Material Group Hierarchy

attributes.name: spend_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spend category. Primary key.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the procurement category manager or owner responsible for strategic sourcing and vendor management for this category.

attributes.name: parent_category_spend_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent spend category in the hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level categories.

attributes.name: primary_spend_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who created this spend category record.

attributes.name: annual_spend_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted annual spend amount for this category in the current fiscal year. Used for budget variance reporting and spend analytics.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category require multi-level approval workflow beyond standard Purchase Order (PO) authorization.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the annual spend budget amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the spend category in the enterprise taxonomy. Used for reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the spend category scope, including examples of goods or services classified under this category.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the spend category (e.g., Fleet Parts, Diesel Fuel, Personal Protective Equipment).

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category applies to goods, services, or both.

attributes.name: cogs_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating how spend in this category impacts Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) reporting.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standard commodity classification code (e.g., UNSPSC, NAICS) used for industry benchmarking and supplier market analysis.

attributes.name: contract_coverage_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of spend in this category covered by active supplier contracts. Higher coverage indicates better cost control and compliance.

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost element group code associated with this spend category. Used for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Element Group Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this spend category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ebitda_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether spend in this category directly impacts EBITDA calculations. True if the category affects EBITDA, False otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this spend category was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active categories.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this spend category became active and available for use in procurement transactions.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether procurement in this category requires environmental compliance documentation or certifications (e.g., ISO 14001, EPA permits).

attributes.name: gl_account_range_end
attributes.description: Ending General Ledger account number in the range mapped to this spend category. Used for financial reporting and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) allocation.

attributes.name: gl_account_range_start
attributes.description: Starting General Ledger account number in the range mapped to this spend category. Used for financial reporting and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) allocation.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spend category includes hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, or disposal per Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) and Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) regulations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this spend category record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this spend category taxonomy and mapping were last reviewed and validated by the procurement team.

attributes.name: level_1_category
attributes.description: Top-level classification in the spend hierarchy. Direct Operations includes operational expenditures directly tied to service delivery. Indirect includes support and administrative costs. Capital includes long-term asset investments.

attributes.name: level_2_category
attributes.description: Second-level classification providing functional grouping within Level 1 (e.g., Fleet, Fuel, Disposal, Facilities, Safety, Professional Services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Fleet|Fuel|Disposal|Facilities|Safety|Professional Services|Equipment|Containers|Chemicals|IT|HR|Marketing — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: level_3_category
attributes.description: Granular sub-category providing detailed classification within Level 2 (e.g., Diesel Fuel, Compressed Natural Gas (CNG), Hydraulic Fluids, Brake Parts, Safety Gloves).

attributes.name: minimum_order_value
attributes.description: Minimum purchase order value threshold for this category. Orders below this threshold may require consolidation or alternative procurement methods.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this spend category definition and GL account mappings.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special instructions, or historical information about this spend category.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_count
attributes.description: Number of preferred or approved vendors for this spend category. Used to track supplier concentration and sourcing strategy execution.

attributes.name: safety_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods or services in this category require Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) or other safety certifications.

attributes.name: spend_category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the spend category. Active categories are available for use in procurement transactions. Inactive or deprecated categories are retained for historical reporting only.

attributes.name: strategic_sourcing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this spend category for strategic sourcing initiatives. Critical and High priority categories receive focused supplier negotiation and contract management.

products.name: approval_workflow
products.description: Procurement approval workflow instances tracking the authorization chain for purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and sourcing contracts above defined spend thresholds. Captures workflow instance ID, document type and reference, approval step sequence, approver role, assigned approver, approval action (approve/reject/delegate), action timestamp, comments, and escalation status. Enforces Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) segregation of duties and spend authority limits. Sourced from SAP workflow (SWWWIHEAD) and procurement approval rules.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approval workflow instance. Primary key for the approval workflow product.

attributes.name: primary_approval_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee assigned as the approver for this workflow step. Links to the workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Approval workflows for purchase orders need a typed FK to the PO being approved. Similar to PR workflows, this provides direct typed relationship from workflow instance to the PO record, enabling work

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who initiated the procurement request. Used for segregation of duties validation and audit trail.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.rfq. Business justification: Approval workflows for RFQs need a typed FK to the RFQ being approved. RFQs above certain thresholds require approval before being issued to vendors. This typed relationship enables tracking of RFQ ap

attributes.name: sourcing_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_contract. Business justification: Approval workflows track authorization chains for sourcing contracts. Need typed FK to sourcing_contract.sourcing_contract_id when document_type='CONTRACT'. No columns to remove as document_reference_

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approver took action on this workflow step. Critical for SLA tracking and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP Workflow Audit Trail, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: approval_action
attributes.description: Action taken by the approver at this workflow step. Indicates whether the approver approved, rejected, delegated to another person, requested additional information, escalated to higher authority, or withdrew the request.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes provided by the approver explaining the rationale for their decision, especially for rejections or requests for additional information.

attributes.name: approval_step_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order of the current approval step within the workflow. Indicates the position in the approval chain (e.g., 1 for first approver, 2 for second approver).

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: Organizational role or position responsible for approval at this step (e.g., Procurement Manager, Finance Director, VP Operations, CFO). Defines the authority level required.

attributes.name: assigned_approver_email
attributes.description: Email address of the assigned approver. Used for workflow notifications and audit trail. Classified as confidential PII.

attributes.name: assigned_approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee assigned as the approver for this workflow step. Denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: budget_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the budget availability check performed during the approval workflow. Indicates whether sufficient budget exists for the procurement spend.

attributes.name: budget_check_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the budget availability check was performed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which the procurement spend will be charged. Used for budget validation and financial reporting. Links to the general ledger (GL) cost center master.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this approval workflow record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the spend amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency procurement operations.

attributes.name: delegated_to_approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee to whom approval authority was delegated. Denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: delegation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the approval was delegated to another person (e.g., out of office, conflict of interest, lack of expertise).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Business document number of the procurement document being approved (e.g., PO number, PR number, contract number). Denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific procurement document (purchase requisition, purchase order, or contract) that is subject to this approval workflow.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of procurement document requiring approval. Indicates whether the workflow is for a purchase requisition (PR), purchase order (PO), sourcing contract, request for quotation (RFQ), service entry sheet, or blanket order.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether this workflow step has been escalated to a higher authority due to timeout, complexity, or policy exception.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the workflow was escalated (e.g., approval timeout, spend threshold exceeded, policy exception required).

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the workflow was escalated to a higher authority. Null if no escalation occurred. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the procurement expense will be posted. Used for financial classification and COGS/EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this approval workflow record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the approval workflow. Urgent priority may trigger expedited routing or shorter SLA targets. Determined by business criticality and spend urgency.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for rejection (e.g., budget_exceeded, vendor_not_approved, insufficient_justification, duplicate_request). Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: requester_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit of the employee who initiated the procurement request. Used for spend analytics and budget tracking.

attributes.name: requester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who initiated the procurement request. Denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: segregation_of_duties_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the segregation of duties validation. Ensures that the requester, approver, and receiver are different individuals to prevent fraud. Critical for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: sla_actual_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of hours taken to complete the approval workflow. Calculated as the difference between workflow_initiated_timestamp and workflow_completed_timestamp. Used for SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether the approval workflow exceeded the SLA target hours. True indicates an SLA breach requiring management attention.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours within which the approval workflow should be completed, as defined by the service level agreement (SLA). Used for performance monitoring and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: sox_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether this workflow instance is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) segregation of duties and spend authority controls. True for workflows above materiality thresholds.

attributes.name: spend_amount

domains.name: safety
domains.description: Occupational health and safety management for field operations including job hazard analyses, safety observations, incident investigations, PPE management, safety meetings, and OSHA recordkeeping for waste collection, landfill, MRF, and hazmat operations

products.name: safety_program

Captures program name, regulatory basis (OSHA standard citation), program owner, applicable operation types, effective date, review cycle, and current status.

attributes.name: primary_safety_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who coordinates day-to-day program activities, training scheduling, and documentation for this safety program.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. This link is fundamental for program design, audit trails, and demonstrating regulatory complia

attributes.name: applicable_facility_types

attributes.name: applicable_operation_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operation types to which this safety program applies (e.g., Residential Collection, Commercial Collection, Landfill, MRF, Hazmat, Fleet Maintenance, WTE Facility). Indicates scope of program applicability.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months

attributes.name: budget_amount

attributes.name: certification_required_flag

attributes.name: document_url

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: program_code

attributes.name: program_description

attributes.name: program_name

attributes.name: program_status

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: jha
products.description: Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) master record defining the formal hazard identification and risk control documentation for a specific job task or work activity performed at Waste Management operations. Captures JHA number, job task description, operation type (collection, landfill, MRF, hazmat, transfer), associated safety program, hazard categories identified, required PPE, engineering controls, administrative controls, and approval status. Serves as the authoritative pre-task safety planning document for field operations.
products.reference: Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) / Job Safety Analysis (JSA)

attributes.name: certification_required_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a work permit is required before performing this job task (e.g., hot work permit, confined space entry permit, excavation permit).

attributes.name: pre_task_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-task safety inspection or checklist must be completed before starting this job task.

attributes.name: required_ppe
attributes.description: List of required Personal Protective Equipment for the job task. May include: hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, steel-toe boots, high-visibility vest, respirator, hearing protection, fall protection harness, chemical suit.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132-138, ANSI Z87.1, ANSI Z89.1

attributes.name: revision_notes
attributes.description: Notes describing changes made in the current revision of the JHA (e.g., updated PPE requirements, added new hazard controls).

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version number of this JHA document. Incremented each time the JHA is updated or revised.

attributes.name: training_requirements

products.name: jha_step
products.description: Individual job step line item within a Job Hazard Analysis (JHA), decomposing the work task into discrete sequential steps. For each step, captures the step sequence number, step description, associated hazards (struck-by, caught-in, fall, chemical exposure, ergonomic, etc.), hazard severity rating, probability rating, risk score, and the specific preventive measures and controls required. Enables granular hazard tracking at the task-step level for field operations.

attributes.name: jha_step_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual job step within a Job Hazard Analysis. Primary key for the JHA step record.

attributes.name: jha_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Job Hazard Analysis document that contains this step. Links the step to the overall JHA assessment.

attributes.name: required_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.certification. Business justification: JHA steps may require specific certifications (confined space, forklift, hazmat). Links step requirements to certification definitions, enabling verification that assigned employees hold required cert

attributes.name: control_hierarchy
attributes.description: Classification of the control measure according to the OSHA hierarchy of controls. Elimination (remove hazard) is most effective; PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) is least effective but often necessary as last line of defense.
attributes.references: OSHA 3071 - Job Hazard Analysis; NIOSH Hierarchy of Controls

attributes.name: control_measure
attributes.description: Specific preventive action, safeguard, or control required to eliminate or reduce the hazard to an acceptable level. Describes the mitigation strategy (e.g., 'Wear high-visibility vest and maintain 10-foot clearance from moving equipment', 'Use chemical-resistant gloves rated for leachate contact').
attributes.references: OSHA 3071 - Job Hazard Analysis; ANSI Z10

attributes.name: emergency_response_procedure
attributes.description: Immediate actions to be taken if an incident occurs during this job step. Describes emergency protocols (e.g., 'If struck by vehicle, call 911 immediately and secure scene', 'If chemical exposure, activate eyewash station and notify supervisor').
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.38 - Emergency Action Plans; OSHA 1910.120 - HAZWOPER Emergency Response

attributes.name: environmental_condition
attributes.description: Relevant environmental or atmospheric conditions that affect hazard exposure during this step. Describes conditions such as temperature extremes, weather exposure, confined atmosphere, noise levels, or presence of hazardous gases (e.g., 'Outdoor work in temperatures exceeding 90°F', 'Potential methane atmosphere in landfill cell').
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.95 - Occupational Noise Exposure; OSHA 1926.62 - Lead; EPA Clean Air Act

attributes.name: equipment_required
attributes.description: Specialized equipment, tools, or machinery required to safely perform this job step. Lists all necessary equipment (e.g., 'Automated Side Loader (ASL) truck with functional safety interlocks', 'Gas detection monitor calibrated within 30 days', 'Fall arrest harness and lanyard').
attributes.references: OSHA 1910 Subpart O - Machinery and Machine Guarding; OSHA 1926 Subpart M - Fall Protection

attributes.name: frequency_per_shift
attributes.description: Number of times this job step is typically performed during a single work shift. Used to calculate cumulative exposure and ergonomic risk factors.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910 Ergonomics Guidelines; NIOSH Lifting Equation

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific hazard or risk present during this job step. Identifies what could cause injury or illness (e.g., 'Worker could be struck by moving vehicle in collection area', 'Exposure to leachate during container handling').

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the hazard associated with this job step. Categories align with OSHA hazard taxonomy for waste operations including struck-by hazards, caught-in/between hazards, fall hazards, exposure hazards, and ergonomic risks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: struck_by|caught_in|fall_same_level|fall_elevation|chemical_exposure|biological_exposure|ergonomic|electrical|thermal|noise|radiation|confined_space|vehicle_collision|equipment_failure|other — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 3071 - Job Hazard Analysis; OSHA 1910 General Industry Standards

attributes.name: incident_history_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether past safety incidents or near-misses have been associated with this job step. True if historical incidents exist; False if no incident history. Used to prioritize high-risk steps for enhanced controls.
attributes.references: OSHA 1904 - Recording and Reporting Occupational Injuries and Illnesses

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this job step hazard analysis. Ensures JHA remains current with operational changes, regulatory updates, and incident learnings. Typically reviewed annually or after incidents.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, observations, or context relevant to this job step hazard analysis. Captures supplementary information such as site-specific considerations, seasonal variations, or lessons learned from incident investigations.

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job step requires a work permit before execution. True if permit is required (e.g., hot work permit, confined space entry permit, excavation permit); False if no permit needed.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.146 - Permit-Required Confined Spaces; OSHA 1910.252 - Hot Work

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Type of work permit required for this job step, if applicable. Specifies the regulatory permit category needed before work can commence.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.146 - Permit-Required Confined Spaces; OSHA 1910.147 - Lockout/Tagout; OSHA 1926 Subpart P - Excavations

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Specific Personal Protective Equipment required for this job step. Lists all PPE items necessary (e.g., 'Safety glasses, steel-toed boots, high-visibility vest, cut-resistant gloves', 'Respirator (half-face with organic vapor cartridge), chemical suit, nitrile gloves').
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.132 - Personal Protective Equipment; OSHA 1910.134 - Respiratory Protection

attributes.name: probability_rating
attributes.description: Likelihood that the hazard will result in an incident during normal operations. Frequent = occurs often; Probable = will occur several times; Occasional = likely to occur sometime; Remote = unlikely but possible; Improbable = so unlikely it can be assumed will not occur.
attributes.references: ANSI Z10 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems; ISO 45001

attributes.name: regulatory_standard
attributes.description: Specific OSHA, EPA, DOT, or other regulatory standard that governs safety requirements for this job step. Provides regulatory traceability (e.g., 'OSHA 1910.178 - Powered Industrial Trucks', 'RCRA 40 CFR 264 - Hazardous Waste Management', 'DOT 49 CFR 383 - Commercial Driver Licensing').
attributes.references: OSHA Standards; RCRA Regulations; DOT FMCSA Regulations

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score after control measures are applied. Represents the remaining risk level after mitigation. Used to verify that controls reduce risk to acceptable levels per company risk tolerance thresholds.
attributes.references: ANSI Z10 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems; ISO 45001

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the safety professional, supervisor, or subject matter expert who reviewed and validated this job step hazard analysis. Provides accountability for hazard assessment quality.

attributes.name: reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this job step hazard analysis was last reviewed and validated. Used to track currency of hazard assessments and trigger periodic re-evaluation.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score derived from severity and probability ratings. Typically uses a risk matrix (e.g., 1-25 scale) to prioritize hazards requiring control measures. Higher scores indicate higher priority for mitigation.
attributes.references: ANSI Z10 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems; ISO 45001

attributes.name: severity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential severity of injury or illness if the hazard results in an incident. Catastrophic = fatality or permanent total disability; Critical = permanent partial disability or temporary total disability; Moderate = medical treatment; Minor = first aid; Negligible = no injury.
attributes.references: ANSI Z10 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems; ISO 45001

attributes.name: step_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific work step or task action being performed. Describes what the worker does at this stage of the job (e.g., 'Approach container and position truck', 'Lift container using automated side loader').

attributes.name: step_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to complete this job step under normal conditions. Used for exposure time calculations and work planning.
attributes.references: ANSI Z10 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: step_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this step within the job task breakdown. Defines the chronological position of the step in the work process (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

attributes.name: step_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this JHA step record. Active = currently in use; Under Review = being evaluated for changes; Revised = updated version exists; Obsolete = no longer applicable.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Specific training or certification required for workers performing this job step. Identifies competency requirements (e.g., 'CDL Class B with air brake endorsement', 'RCRA hazardous waste handler training', 'Confined space entry certification').
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.120 - HAZWOPER; OSHA 1910.146 - Permit-Required Confined Spaces; DOT FMCSA

attributes.name: worker_count
attributes.description: Number of workers typically involved in performing this job step. Identifies crew size requirements and coordination needs (e.g., 1 for solo driver tasks, 2 for two-person lift operations, 3 for confined space entry with attendants).
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.146 - Permit-Required Confined Spaces; OSHA 1926 - Construction Standards

attributes.name: parent_jha_step_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on jha_step (parent_jha_step_id)

products.name: observation
products.description: Transactional record of a field safety observation event conducted by a supervisor, safety manager, or peer observer at a Waste Management operational site. Captures observation date and time, observer identity, observed employee or crew, operation type (collection route, landfill cell, MRF sort line, hazmat handling), observation category (safe behavior, at-risk behavior, near-miss, unsafe condition), specific behavior or condition observed, corrective feedback provided, and closure status. Supports behavior-based safety (BBS) programs.

attributes.name: closure_date

attributes.description: Number of photos or images attached to the observation record for documentation purposes. Zero if no photos were captured.

products.name: incident

Captures incident number, incident date and time, facility or route location, operation type, incident classification (injury, illness, near-miss, property damage, vehicle accident), OSHA recordability determination, body part affected, nature of injury, initial description, and reporting status. The authoritative SSOT for all safety incident events.
