attributes.name: environmental_factors_identified
attributes.description: Environmental conditions that contributed to the incident such as weather, lighting, noise, temperature, or site layout issues.

attributes.name: equipment_factors_identified
attributes.description: Equipment-related factors such as mechanical failure, design deficiency, maintenance issues, or lack of proper guarding that contributed to the incident.

attributes.name: equipment_inspection_conducted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether involved equipment was inspected as part of the investigation to identify mechanical or design deficiencies.

attributes.name: human_factors_identified
attributes.description: Specific human factors contributing to the incident such as fatigue, distraction, inadequate training, communication breakdown, or procedural non-compliance.

attributes.name: immediate_causes
attributes.description: Direct, proximate causes that immediately preceded the incident. Typically unsafe acts or unsafe conditions that triggered the event.

attributes.name: investigation_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when all corrective actions were verified as implemented and the investigation was formally closed.

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective actions were finalized and documented.

attributes.name: investigation_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from investigation start to completion. Used to track investigation cycle time and efficiency.

attributes.name: investigation_findings_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the investigation findings, conclusions, and key takeaways. Used for management reporting and lessons learned.

attributes.name: investigation_method
attributes.description: Specific investigation methodology or framework used such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram, Fault Tree Analysis, or Bow Tie Analysis.

attributes.name: investigation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique investigation tracking number assigned to this formal investigation. Format: INV-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: investigation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the investigation based on incident severity, potential for recurrence, and regulatory implications.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal investigation was initiated. Typically within 24-48 hours of the incident occurrence per OSHA guidelines.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investigation process. Tracks progression from initiation through closure.

attributes.name: investigation_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee names or IDs who participated in the investigation team. Includes subject matter experts, witnesses, and support personnel.

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation depth and methodology. Root Cause Analysis (RCA) is the most comprehensive structured investigation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investigation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_investigator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead investigator assigned to this investigation.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Key lessons learned from the investigation that should be communicated across the organization to prevent similar incidents.

attributes.name: management_system_gaps
attributes.description: Identified deficiencies in management systems, policies, procedures, or oversight that allowed the incident to occur.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Type of waste management operation where the incident occurred. Aligns with core business process areas.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident meets OSHA criteria for recordability on the OSHA 300 Log. True if recordable, False if not.

attributes.name: photographic_evidence_collected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographs or video evidence of the incident scene were collected and documented.

attributes.name: preventive_measures_recommended
attributes.description: Recommended preventive measures to eliminate or control the identified hazards and prevent recurrence of similar incidents.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident was reported to OSHA or other regulatory authorities, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident severity requires notification to OSHA or other regulatory authorities within mandated timeframes.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_operations_manager_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings and corrective actions were reviewed and approved by the operations manager.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_safety_manager_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings and corrective actions were reviewed and approved by the safety manager.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the underlying root cause identified through the investigation. Aligns with standard RCA taxonomy.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified root cause(s) that led to the incident. Documents the fundamental systemic or process failure.

attributes.name: site_inspection_conducted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical site inspection was conducted to assess environmental and situational factors.

attributes.name: witness_statements_collected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether witness statements were collected as part of the investigation process.

attributes.name: supplemental_incident_investigation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on incident_investigation (supplemental_incident_investigation_id)

products.name: corrective_action
products.description: Corrective and preventive action (CAPA) record generated from incident investigations, safety observations, safety audits, or regulatory inspections within the safety domain. Captures action number, source event type and reference, action description, action category (engineering control, administrative control, PPE, training, procedure update), assigned responsible party, target completion date, actual completion date, verification method, and closure status. Distinct from compliance.corrective_action which is driven by regulatory violations — this entity is safety-program-driven.

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the corrective action record. Primary key for the corrective action entity.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: affected_offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Corrective actions may require service offering modifications (adding PPE requirements, changing collection procedures, restricting service hours). Safety and operations teams coordinate on offering-l

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the facility where the corrective action is to be implemented. Links to landfill, MRF, transfer station, or other operational facility.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Corrective actions from safety incidents at permitted facilities must reference the permit for regulatory closure documentation. Agencies require proof that corrective actions address permit condition

attributes.name: primary_corrective_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee or contractor assigned as the owner responsible for implementing and completing this corrective action.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Section 5.3 Organizational Roles and Responsibilities

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Corrective actions requiring capital expenditure (equipment upgrades, PPE purchases, engineering controls) must link to purchase orders for cost tracking, budget justification, audit trail, and verifi

attributes.name: quaternary_corrective_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who last modified the corrective action record. Provides audit trail for changes to action status, completion, or verification.

attributes.name: quinary_corrective_responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quinary Corrective Responsible Party Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Safety corrective actions often stem from specific regulatory requirements (OSHA standards, EPA rules, DOT regulations). This link is essential for compliance audits, demonstrating regulatory adherenc

attributes.name: tertiary_corrective_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who created the corrective action record. Typically a safety manager, supervisor, or incident investigator.

attributes.name: action_category
attributes.description: Classification of the corrective action based on the hierarchy of controls. Categories include engineering control (physical changes to eliminate hazard), administrative control (policy/procedure changes), PPE (personal protective equipment), training, procedure update, or equipment repair.
attributes.references: OSHA Hierarchy of Controls, ANSI Z10 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective or preventive action to be taken. Includes specific steps, controls to be implemented, and expected outcomes to prevent recurrence of the safety issue.

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the corrective action, typically formatted as CA-NNNNNN. Used for tracking and reference in safety meetings and audits.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the corrective action based on risk severity and potential for recurrence. Critical actions address imminent hazards, high priority addresses serious risks, medium for moderate risks, and low for minor improvements.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed and verified. Null if action is still in progress or not yet started.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost in US dollars incurred to implement the corrective action. Captured upon completion for budget tracking and cost-benefit analysis.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was formally closed after verification of effectiveness. Represents final administrative closure of the action.

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the corrective action. Open indicates newly assigned, in progress indicates work has started, completed indicates action finished but not yet verified, verified indicates effectiveness confirmed, closed indicates final closure, overdue indicates past target date, cancelled indicates action no longer required. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_progress|completed|verified|closed|overdue|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the corrective action record was first created in the system. Represents when the action was formally assigned and entered into the safety management system.

attributes.name: effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of how effective the corrective action was in preventing recurrence and improving safety. Populated during effectiveness review after sufficient time has elapsed post-implementation.

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up review to assess long-term effectiveness of the corrective action. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days after closure to ensure sustained improvement.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost in US dollars to implement the corrective action. Includes labor, materials, equipment, and training costs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the corrective action record. Tracks when status changes, completion updates, or verification activities were recorded.

attributes.name: preventive_action_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this action is preventive (true) or corrective (false). Preventive actions address potential hazards before incidents occur, corrective actions address issues after an event.

attributes.name: recurrence_prevention_measures
attributes.description: Detailed description of measures implemented to prevent recurrence of the safety issue across similar operations, facilities, or equipment. Captures systemic improvements beyond the immediate corrective action.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this corrective action is required by OSHA, EPA, DOT, or other regulatory authority. True indicates regulatory mandate, false indicates voluntary safety improvement.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Department or business unit responsible for implementing the corrective action (e.g., Fleet Maintenance, Landfill Operations, MRF Operations, Hazmat Handling, Safety Department).
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Section 5.3 Organizational Roles and Responsibilities

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal root cause analysis was conducted for the source event prior to defining this corrective action. True indicates RCA was performed, false indicates action was defined without formal RCA.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the root cause identified through investigation. Used to identify systemic patterns and prioritize preventive actions across the safety program.

attributes.name: source_event_reference
attributes.description: Business reference number of the originating event (e.g., incident number, observation ID, audit finding number). Provides human-readable traceability to the source event.

attributes.name: source_event_type
attributes.description: Type of safety event that triggered this corrective action. Distinguishes whether the action originated from an incident investigation, safety observation, audit finding, regulatory inspection, near miss, or hazard report.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the corrective action must be completed. Established based on risk priority and resource availability.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was verified as effective. Typically occurs after actual completion date once effectiveness has been confirmed.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the corrective action was implemented effectively and achieved the intended outcome. Options include physical inspection, safety audit, field observation, documentation review, equipment testing, or training completion verification.

attributes.name: verification_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the verification process, findings, and confirmation that the corrective action achieved the intended safety improvement.

attributes.name: originating_corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on corrective_action (originating_corrective_action_id)

products.name: osha_recordable
products.description: OSHA 300 Log recordable case record for each work-related injury or illness that meets OSHA recordability criteria under 29 CFR Part 1904. Captures OSHA case number, linked incident reference, employee job title, date of injury or illness onset, where the event occurred, description of injury or illness, days away from work, days of restricted work or job transfer, OSHA case type (injury, skin disorder, respiratory condition, poisoning, hearing loss, all other illnesses), and privacy case flag. Serves as the authoritative OSHA 300 log data source for annual OSHA 300A summary reporting.
products.reference: OSHA 300 Log — Log of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses

attributes.name: osha_recordable_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OSHA 300 Log recordable case record.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.driver. Business justification: OSHA recordable cases involving drivers require direct driver link for OSHA 300 log reporting, case classification, days away/restricted work tracking, and driver safety performance analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who sustained the work-related injury or illness.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility where the injury or illness occurred.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying safety incident that triggered this OSHA recordable case.

attributes.name: body_part_affected
attributes.description: The specific body part or system affected by the injury or illness (e.g., hand, back, eyes, respiratory system).

attributes.name: case_closure_date
attributes.description: The date when the OSHA recordable case was officially closed after all required documentation and follow-up actions were completed.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OSHA recordable case in the investigation and documentation workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OSHA recordable case record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_away_from_work
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the employee was unable to work as a result of the injury or illness, excluding the day of injury or onset.

attributes.name: days_of_job_transfer_or_restriction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Days of Job Transfer or Restriction
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the employee was on restricted work activity or temporary job transfer due to the injury or illness.

attributes.name: death_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the injury or illness resulted in the death of the employee.

attributes.name: establishment_name
attributes.description: The name of the establishment (facility or site) where the injury or illness occurred, as it appears on OSHA reporting.

attributes.name: event_exposure_type
attributes.description: The event or exposure that directly produced the injury or illness (e.g., struck by object, fall from elevation, overexertion, contact with chemical, repetitive motion).

attributes.name: injury_illness_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Date of Injury or Illness Onset
attributes.description: The date the work-related injury occurred or the date the occupational illness was diagnosed or first manifested.

attributes.name: injury_illness_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the injury or illness, including the part of body affected and the nature of the injury or illness (e.g., laceration to left hand, chemical burn to forearm, lower back strain).

attributes.name: injury_illness_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time of Injury or Illness Onset
attributes.description: The time of day when the injury occurred or illness symptoms first appeared, in 24-hour HH:MM format.

attributes.name: injury_nature
attributes.description: The type or nature of the injury sustained (e.g., laceration, fracture, sprain, burn, contusion, puncture).

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title or occupation of the employee at the time of the injury or illness (e.g., Waste Collection Driver, Landfill Equipment Operator, MRF Sorter).

attributes.name: location_where_event_occurred
attributes.description: Specific location or area within the facility where the injury or illness event took place (e.g., loading dock, landfill cell 5, MRF sorting line 2, vehicle cab).

attributes.name: loss_of_consciousness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee lost consciousness as a result of the work-related injury or illness.

attributes.name: medical_treatment_beyond_first_aid_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Treatment Beyond First Aid Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the injury or illness required medical treatment beyond first aid as defined in 29 CFR 1904.7(b)(5).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or supplementary information related to the OSHA recordable case for internal tracking and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: osha_300a_reporting_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 300A Reporting Year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this case will be included in the annual OSHA 300A summary report.

attributes.name: osha_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Case Number
attributes.description: The official OSHA 300 Log case number assigned to this recordable injury or illness, typically formatted as year-sequence (e.g., 2024-0001).

attributes.name: osha_case_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Case Type
attributes.description: Classification of the recordable case into one of the six OSHA 300 Log categories as defined in 29 CFR 1904.12.

attributes.name: physician_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physician or licensed health care professional recommended days away from work or work restriction/transfer.

attributes.name: ppe_used
attributes.description: Description of the personal protective equipment the employee was wearing or using at the time of the incident.

attributes.name: privacy_case_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this case qualifies as a privacy concern case under 29 CFR 1904.29(b)(6)-(b)(10), requiring the employee name to be withheld from the OSHA 300 Log.

attributes.name: recordable_determination_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the safety professional who made the recordability determination.

attributes.name: recordable_determination_date
attributes.description: The date when the safety team determined that the incident met OSHA recordability criteria under 29 CFR 1904.7.

attributes.name: remained_at_work_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee remained at work and continued their normal duties without any days away or job transfer/restriction.

attributes.name: source_of_injury
attributes.description: The object, substance, or equipment that directly produced or inflicted the injury or illness (e.g., waste container, truck tailgate, chemical substance, machinery).

attributes.name: treating_physician_name
attributes.description: Name of the physician or licensed health care professional who provided treatment for the injury or illness.

attributes.name: treatment_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the medical facility, clinic, or hospital where the employee received treatment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OSHA recordable case record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: work_process_at_time_of_incident
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work Process at Time of Incident
attributes.description: The work activity or process the employee was performing when the injury or illness occurred (e.g., residential route collection, landfill compaction, MRF sorting, vehicle maintenance).

attributes.name: recurrence_osha_recordable_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on osha_recordable (recurrence_osha_recordable_id)

attributes.name: hazard_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the hazard. Format: HAZ- followed by alphanumeric code.

attributes.description: Detailed description of the workplace hazard including specific conditions, locations, and circumstances under which the hazard is present.

attributes.name: hazard_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the hazard for quick identification and reporting.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hazard in the register. Active: hazard present and managed; Mitigated: controls in place, residual risk accepted; Eliminated: hazard removed; Under Investigation: newly identified, assessment in progress; Archived: no longer applicable.

attributes.name: hazard_source
attributes.description: Specific source or origin of the hazard. Examples: collection truck hydraulics, landfill working face, MRF sorting line, leachate handling system, compactor equipment.

attributes.name: hazard_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary or more specific classification within the primary hazard category. Examples: confined space, vehicle collision, needle stick, heat stress, landfill gas exposure.

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazard was first identified and entered into the register.

attributes.name: incident_history_count
attributes.description: Number of recorded safety incidents or near-misses associated with this hazard. Used to validate risk ratings and control effectiveness.

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Likelihood score of the hazard occurring without any controls in place. Typically scored 1-5 where 1=rare, 5=almost certain. Used to calculate inherent risk.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk level derived from inherent risk score. Typically: 1-5=low, 6-12=medium, 13-20=high, 21-25=critical.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated inherent risk score (likelihood × severity) before any control measures are applied. Represents the raw risk level.

attributes.name: inherent_severity_rating
attributes.description: Severity score of potential consequences without any controls in place. Typically scored 1-5 where 1=negligible injury, 5=fatality. Used to calculate inherent risk.

attributes.name: last_incident_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent incident or near-miss related to this hazard. Triggers review of control adequacy.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazard register entry was most recently reviewed and validated for accuracy and control effectiveness.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this hazard and its controls. Ensures living register is kept current.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context about the hazard, its assessment, or control measures. Free-text field for supplementary information.

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Type of waste management operation where the hazard is present. Determines applicable safety protocols and regulatory requirements. attributes.name: ppe_required

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk level derived from residual risk score after controls. Used to determine if additional controls are needed.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated residual risk score (likelihood × severity) after control measures are applied. Represents the remaining risk level.

attributes.name: residual_severity_rating
attributes.description: Severity score after control measures are applied. Scored 1-5. Represents the reduced consequence severity with controls in place.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled reviews of this hazard. Typically 6 or 12 months, or more frequent for high-risk hazards.

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Whether the residual risk level has been formally accepted by management or requires further mitigation.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this hazard register record was most recently updated. Tracks currency of information.

attributes.name: prior_alert_acknowledgment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on alert_acknowledgment (prior_alert_acknowledgment_id)

products.name: medical_case
products.description: Occupational medical case management record for Waste Management employees who receive medical treatment following a work-related injury or illness. Captures case number, linked incident reference, treating medical provider, initial treatment date, treatment type (first aid, medical treatment beyond first aid, emergency room, hospitalization), work restriction type (full duty, light duty, restricted duty, days away from work), return-to-work date, case management status, and total days away and restricted. Supports OSHA 300 log recordkeeping and workers' compensation case coordination.

attributes.name: medical_case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the occupational medical case record. Primary key for the medical case management system.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.driver. Business justification: Work-related injuries to drivers require direct driver link for workers compensation case management, return-to-work coordination, work restriction tracking, and driver availability planning.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating workplace incident that resulted in this medical case. Links to the safety incident record that triggered medical treatment.

attributes.name: medical_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal safety or HR professional assigned to manage this medical case and coordinate return-to-work activities.
attributes.references: Occupational Health Case Management Best Practices

attributes.name: primary_medical_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management employee who received medical treatment for the work-related injury or illness.

attributes.name: treating_provider_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Medical treatment providers must link to vendor master for workers' comp cost allocation, provider network management, payment processing, 1099 reporting, and provider qualification verification. Repl

attributes.name: actual_medical_cost
attributes.description: Total actual medical expenses incurred for treatment of this case, including all provider bills, pharmacy, and rehabilitation costs.

attributes.name: body_part_affected
attributes.description: Specific body part or region injured or affected by the occupational illness. Used for injury trend analysis and prevention program targeting.

attributes.name: case_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the medical case was officially closed after the employee returned to full duty and all medical treatment was completed.

attributes.name: case_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting case management activities, physician communications, accommodation discussions, and return-to-work coordination efforts.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the medical case used for tracking and reference across systems. Externally visible case tracking number used in workers compensation coordination and case management communications.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the medical case indicating whether the case is actively being managed, pending closure, or has been closed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this medical case record was first created in the case management system.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: ICD-10 or other standardized medical diagnosis code assigned by the treating provider describing the injury or illness.

attributes.name: diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Plain language description of the diagnosed injury or illness provided by the medical professional.

attributes.name: estimated_medical_cost
attributes.description: Projected total medical treatment cost for this case based on initial diagnosis and treatment plan. Used for workers compensation reserve setting.

attributes.name: full_duty_return_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee was medically cleared to return to full unrestricted duty without limitations.
attributes.references: Occupational Health Return to Work Standards

attributes.name: hospitalization_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days the employee was hospitalized as an inpatient for treatment of the work-related injury or illness.

attributes.name: hospitalization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the injury or illness required inpatient hospitalization. Triggers additional OSHA reporting requirements for severe injuries.

attributes.name: initial_treatment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee first received medical treatment for the work-related injury or illness. Critical timestamp for OSHA recordkeeping and workers compensation claim initiation.

attributes.name: initial_treatment_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when initial medical treatment was administered, including time of day for emergency response tracking.

attributes.name: injury_nature
attributes.description: Classification of the type of physical harm or illness sustained (e.g., laceration, fracture, strain, chemical exposure, respiratory condition).
attributes.references: OSHA Injury and Illness Classification System

attributes.name: osha_case_classification
attributes.description: OSHA classification category for the medical case used for OSHA 300 log reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medical case meets OSHA criteria for recordability on the OSHA 300 log based on treatment type and work restrictions.

attributes.name: physical_therapy_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ongoing physical therapy or rehabilitation was prescribed as part of the treatment plan.

attributes.name: privacy_case_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this case qualifies as a privacy concern case under OSHA rules, requiring special handling of employee identity information on posted logs.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee returned to any work capacity following the injury or illness. May differ from full duty return date if light duty was assigned.
attributes.references: Workers Compensation Return to Work Programs

attributes.name: surgery_date
attributes.description: Date when surgical procedure was performed to treat the work-related injury or illness.

attributes.name: surgery_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surgical intervention was required to treat the injury or illness. Impacts case severity classification and cost projections.

attributes.name: total_days_away
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the employee was unable to work due to the injury or illness. Used for OSHA 300 log column G reporting.

attributes.name: total_days_restricted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Days of Job Transfer or Restriction
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the employee worked under physician-imposed restrictions or modified duty. Used for OSHA 300 log column H and I reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7 Restricted Work Days Calculation

attributes.name: treating_provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the medical facility or provider type that delivered treatment to the employee.

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the level of medical care provided. Determines OSHA recordability and workers compensation case classification.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this medical case record was last modified, reflecting the most recent case status or information update.

attributes.name: work_restriction_end_date
attributes.description: Date when work restrictions were lifted or the employee returned to full duty. Nullable for ongoing restrictions.

attributes.name: work_restriction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physician-imposed work restrictions or days away from work began. Used to calculate total restricted or away days for OSHA reporting.

attributes.name: work_restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of work limitations imposed by the treating physician. Determines OSHA 300 log column classification and return-to-work planning.

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number assigned by the workers compensation insurance carrier for this medical case. Used for coordinating medical case management with insurance claims.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Claim Filing Requirements

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_status
attributes.description: Current status of the associated workers compensation insurance claim.

attributes.name: related_medical_case_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on medical_case (related_medical_case_id)

products.name: industrial_hygiene_sample
products.description: Transactional record of industrial hygiene sampling and exposure monitoring events conducted at Waste Management facilities and operations. Captures sample ID, sampling date, facility or operation location, operation type (MRF dust, landfill gas, hazmat chemical exposure, noise dosimetry, heat stress), employee or area being sampled, contaminant or hazard being measured, sampling method and equipment, sample duration, measured result value and unit, applicable OSHA PEL or ACGIH TLV threshold, exceedance flag, and recommended controls. Supports OSHA exposure monitoring compliance.

attributes.name: industrial_hygiene_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the industrial hygiene sampling event record.

attributes.name: combustion_operating_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.combustion_operating_log. Business justification: IH samples correlated with combustion operating conditions (furnace temperature, feedstock type, emissions) for exposure-operations analysis. Links worker exposure data to process conditions for root

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Waste Management facility where the sampling event occurred.

attributes.name: job_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_position. Business justification: IH samples assess exposure for specific job positions to hazardous substances. Links sample to position enables "exposure profile by position" for similar exposure group determination and medical surv

attributes.name: laboratory_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Industrial hygiene sampling labs must link to vendor master for payment processing, laboratory accreditation verification, cost allocation to safety programs, and vendor qualification management. Repl

attributes.name: primary_industrial_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee being monitored for exposure, if this is a personal sample. Null for area samples.

attributes.name: tertiary_industrial_reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the certified industrial hygienist (CIH) or EHS manager who reviewed and validated the sampling results.

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: IH sampling at WTE facilities (combustion byproducts, heavy metals, particulates) tracked for facility-specific exposure monitoring, OSHA compliance, and worker health protection. Facility-level expos

attributes.name: acgih_tlv
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Conference of Governmental Industrial Hygienists (ACGIH) Threshold Limit Value (TLV)
attributes.description: The ACGIH Threshold Limit Value for the contaminant, representing recommended exposure guidelines.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The date the laboratory completed the analysis of the sample.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: The unique Chemical Abstracts Service registry number for the chemical substance being sampled, if applicable.

attributes.name: contaminant_name
attributes.description: The specific contaminant, chemical, or hazard being measured (e.g., silica, benzene, hydrogen sulfide, noise, heat index).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this industrial hygiene sample record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The minimum detectable concentration or level for the analytical method used.

attributes.name: equipment_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the sampling equipment used, for calibration traceability.

attributes.name: exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the measured result exceeded the applicable exposure limit (OSHA PEL or ACGIH TLV).

attributes.name: exceedance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the exposure limit that was measured, calculated as (measured_result / exposure_limit) * 100.

attributes.name: exposure_limit_type
attributes.description: The type of exposure limit being evaluated: Time-Weighted Average (TWA), Short-Term Exposure Limit (STEL), ceiling limit, or action level.

attributes.name: flow_rate
attributes.description: The air flow rate in liters per minute (LPM) for air sampling pumps, if applicable.

attributes.name: hazard_category
attributes.description: The broad category of occupational hazard being measured: chemical exposure, dust/particulate, gas/vapor, noise, heat stress, biological agent, or radiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chemical|dust|gas|noise|heat|biological|radiation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_task_description
attributes.description: Description of the work task or activity being performed by the employee during sampling, if this is a personal sample.

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation
attributes.description: The accreditation standard held by the laboratory (e.g., AIHA LAP LLC, ISO/IEC 17025).

attributes.name: measured_result_value
attributes.description: The quantitative result of the exposure measurement (concentration, level, or dose).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or contextual information about the sampling event, conditions, or results.

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: The type of Waste Management operation where the sample was collected: Materials Recovery Facility (MRF), landfill, collection route, hazardous waste (hazmat) handling, transfer station, Waste-to-Energy (WTE) facility, maintenance shop, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MRF|landfill|collection|hazmat|transfer_station|WTE|maintenance|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: osha_pel
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Permissible Exposure Limit (PEL)
attributes.description: The OSHA Permissible Exposure Limit for the contaminant, representing the maximum allowable exposure level.

attributes.name: ppe_worn
attributes.description: Description of personal protective equipment worn by the employee during the sampling period (e.g., respirator type, hearing protection).

attributes.name: quantification_limit
attributes.description: The minimum quantifiable concentration or level for the analytical method used.

attributes.name: recommended_controls
attributes.description: Industrial hygienist recommendations for exposure controls based on the sampling results (e.g., engineering controls, administrative controls, PPE upgrades).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this sampling result must be reported to OSHA or other regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: result_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the measured result (e.g., mg/m3, ppm, dBA, WBGT, fibers/cc).

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date the sampling results were reviewed and validated by the responsible EHS professional.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the industrial hygiene sample, typically assigned by the laboratory or EHS system.

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sample: collected, in transit to lab, received by lab, analyzed, reported, or voided.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sample collection method: personal (breathing zone), area (fixed location), bulk (material sample), wipe (surface contamination), or direct-reading (real-time instrument).

attributes.name: sample_volume_liters
attributes.description: Total volume of air sampled in liters, calculated from flow rate and duration.

attributes.name: sampling_date
attributes.description: The date on which the industrial hygiene sample was collected.

attributes.name: sampling_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the sampling event in minutes, calculated from start to end timestamp.

attributes.name: sampling_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the sampling event concluded.

attributes.name: sampling_equipment
attributes.description: Description of the sampling equipment used (e.g., personal air sampling pump, noise dosimeter, direct-reading gas detector, heat stress monitor).

attributes.name: sampling_location_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific location within the facility or operation where the sample was collected (e.g., tipping floor, sorting line, landfill cell 5, truck cab).

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: The standardized sampling method or protocol used (e.g., NIOSH 0600, OSHA ID-121, dosimetry per NIOSH 0500).

attributes.name: sampling_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the sampling event began.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this industrial hygiene sample record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: follow_up_industrial_hygiene_sample_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Follow Up Industrial Hygiene Sample Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on industrial_hygiene_sample (follow_up_industrial_hygiene_sample_id)

products.name: incentive
products.description: Master record for safety incentive and recognition programs operated by Waste Management to promote safe behaviors and reward safety performance milestones. Captures program ID, program name, incentive type (milestone award, peer recognition, safety bonus, team recognition), eligibility criteria (days without recordable injury, observation participation rate, training completion), award value or description, program period, applicable operation type or district, and program status. Supports safety culture development and employee engagement in safety programs.

attributes.name: incentive_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety incentive program record. Primary key.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational district where this incentive program is applicable. Null if program is company-wide.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific facility where this incentive program is applicable. Null if program applies to multiple facilities or district-wide.

attributes.name: incentive_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the safety incentive program (typically a senior safety leader or executive).

attributes.name: incentive_program_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who coordinates day-to-day administration of the safety incentive program.

attributes.name: incentive_program_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who owns and is accountable for the safety incentive program (typically a safety manager or director).

attributes.name: applicable_facility_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of facility types where this incentive program applies (e.g., transfer station, landfill, MRF, maintenance facility, administrative office).

attributes.name: applicable_operation_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operation types eligible for this incentive program (e.g., residential collection, commercial collection, landfill, MRF, hazmat, fleet maintenance, WTE).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety incentive program was officially approved by management or safety committee.

attributes.name: award_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the award or recognition provided (e.g., gift card, plaque, certificate, paid time off, public recognition).

attributes.name: award_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which awards are distributed under this program (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, milestone-based, continuous).

attributes.name: award_value
attributes.description: Monetary value of the incentive award in US dollars (USD). Null for non-monetary recognition programs.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this safety incentive program in US dollars (USD) for the program period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety incentive program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_without_injury_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of consecutive days without a recordable injury required to qualify for the incentive award.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety incentive program became or will become active and operational.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the criteria employees or teams must meet to qualify for the incentive (e.g., days without recordable injury, observation participation rate, training completion percentage).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety incentive program is scheduled to expire or be reviewed for renewal. Null for ongoing programs.

attributes.name: incentive_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incentive program type indicating the recognition mechanism (milestone award, peer recognition, safety bonus, team recognition, individual achievement, department award).

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety incentive program was last reviewed for effectiveness and compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of the safety incentive program effectiveness and compliance.

attributes.name: observation_participation_rate_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of required safety observations that must be completed to qualify for the incentive (expressed as percentage, e.g., 85.00 for 85%).

attributes.name: osha_vpp_aligned_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA Voluntary Protection Programs (VPP) Aligned Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incentive program is aligned with OSHA Voluntary Protection Programs (VPP) guidelines and best practices.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the safety incentive program used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: program_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official program documentation, guidelines, and terms and conditions.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the safety incentive program (e.g., Zero Injury Milestone Award, Safety Champion Recognition).

attributes.name: program_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the safety incentive program administration or eligibility.

attributes.name: program_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the incentive program period. Null for ongoing programs without a defined end date.

attributes.name: program_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the incentive program period during which performance is measured for award eligibility.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety incentive program indicating whether it is currently operational.

attributes.name: reporting_discouraged_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this program has been reviewed and confirmed NOT to discourage injury or illness reporting, in compliance with OSHA anti-retaliation requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this safety incentive program record originated (e.g., SAP EHS, Enviance, custom safety management system).

attributes.name: total_awards_issued
attributes.description: Cumulative count of awards issued under this program since inception.

attributes.name: total_participants
attributes.description: Total number of employees or teams currently participating in or eligible for this safety incentive program.

attributes.name: training_completion_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of required safety training courses that must be completed to qualify for the incentive (expressed as percentage, e.g., 100.00 for 100%).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety incentive program record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: parent_incentive_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on incentive (parent_incentive_id)

products.name: emergency_action_plan
products.description: Master record for facility-level Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) required under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38 for each Waste Management facility. Captures plan ID, facility reference, plan version, effective date, emergency types covered (fire, chemical spill, medical emergency, severe weather, active threat), evacuation routes and assembly points, emergency contact list, employee roles and responsibilities, alarm system description, last drill date, and plan review date. Provides the authoritative emergency preparedness documentation for each operational site.

attributes.name: emergency_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Emergency Action Plan record. Primary key for the emergency action plan entity.

attributes.name: emergency_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Waste Management facility (landfill, MRF, transfer station, hazmat facility, or administrative office) for which this Emergency Action Plan is established.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Emergency action plans for permitted facilities must incorporate permit-specific emergency procedures (spill response, air emission event protocols, fire suppression). Required by RCRA Part B permits

attributes.name: primary_emergency_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: primary_waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_waste_stream. Business justification: Emergency action plans are tailored to waste streams handled at facility (hazmat spill response for chemical waste, biohazard containment for medical waste). Facility managers develop stream-specific

attributes.name: quaternary_emergency_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically facility manager, safety manager, or regional operations director) who formally approved this Emergency Action Plan version for implementation.

attributes.name: tertiary_emergency_alternate_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee designated as the alternate or backup Emergency Coordinator who assumes responsibility when the primary coordinator is unavailable.

attributes.name: wte_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to energy.wte_facility. Business justification: Facility-specific emergency action plans for WTE operations (fire, explosion, chemical release) required by OSHA 1910.38. Facility-level plans reflect site-specific hazards, evacuation routes, and eme

attributes.name: alarm_system_description
attributes.description: Description of the alarm or notification system used to alert employees of an emergency, including type (audible horn, siren, PA system, text alert), location of alarm devices, and distinctive signals for different emergency types.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this Emergency Action Plan version was formally approved by management and authorized for implementation at the facility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this Emergency Action Plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_operations_shutdown
attributes.description: Procedures for shutting down critical plant operations and equipment before evacuation to prevent additional hazards, such as securing landfill gas collection systems, shutting down MRF conveyors, isolating hazmat storage, or securing waste-to-energy boilers.

attributes.name: drill_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency for conducting emergency drills at this facility, expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 6 for semi-annual, 3 for quarterly). Driven by regulatory requirements and facility risk profile.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this Emergency Action Plan becomes the official, enforceable plan for the facility. All employees must be trained on the plan by this date.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_list
attributes.description: Comprehensive list of emergency contacts including local fire department, police, EMS, hospital, poison control, hazmat response team, EPA regional office, state environmental agency, utility companies, and internal corporate emergency response. Includes names, phone numbers, and addresses.

attributes.name: emergency_types_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of emergency scenarios addressed in this plan, such as fire, chemical spill, medical emergency, severe weather (tornado, hurricane, flood), active threat, hazardous material release, equipment failure, gas leak, explosion, or natural disaster. Defines the scope of preparedness.

attributes.name: employee_roles_responsibilities
attributes.description: Detailed description of roles and responsibilities assigned to employees during an emergency, including floor wardens, evacuation assistants, first aid responders, equipment shutdown personnel, and headcount coordinators. Defines who does what during emergency response.

attributes.name: employee_training_completion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of employees at the facility who have completed required training on the current version of the Emergency Action Plan. Used to track compliance and readiness. Target is 100 percent.

attributes.name: evacuation_procedures
attributes.description: Detailed description of evacuation procedures including routes, exits, assembly points, accountability processes, and special considerations for different facility areas (e.g., landfill cell, MRF processing floor, hazmat storage area).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this Emergency Action Plan expires and must be reviewed, updated, and reissued. Typically set based on regulatory review frequency or facility operational changes.

attributes.name: facility_map_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the facility map showing evacuation routes, exits, assembly points, emergency equipment locations (fire extinguishers, AEDs, eyewash stations), and hazardous material storage areas.

attributes.name: hazmat_specific_procedures
attributes.description: Special emergency procedures for facilities handling hazardous waste, including spill containment, leak isolation, vapor monitoring, decontamination protocols, and coordination with RCRA-certified hazmat response teams.

attributes.name: last_drill_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent emergency evacuation drill or tabletop exercise conducted at the facility to test the Emergency Action Plan and employee preparedness.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Emergency Action Plan was last reviewed and validated for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current facility operations, staffing, and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: medical_emergency_procedures
attributes.description: Procedures for responding to medical emergencies including location of first aid kits, AED devices, eyewash stations, safety showers, and protocols for calling EMS and transporting injured employees to medical facilities.

attributes.name: next_drill_date
attributes.description: Date scheduled for the next emergency evacuation drill or tabletop exercise. OSHA recommends annual drills at minimum; some facilities conduct quarterly drills.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date scheduled for the next comprehensive review and update of the Emergency Action Plan. OSHA requires review whenever the plan is initially developed, whenever employee responsibilities change, and whenever new equipment or hazards are introduced.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this Emergency Action Plan, such as facility-specific hazards, recent updates, lessons learned from drills, or pending revisions.

attributes.name: osha_standard_citation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Standard Citation
attributes.description: Specific OSHA standard citation(s) that this Emergency Action Plan is designed to comply with, typically 29 CFR 1910.38 (Emergency Action Plans) and may include 29 CFR 1910.120 (HAZWOPER) for hazmat facilities.

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the complete Emergency Action Plan document stored in the document management system. Provides access to the full plan including maps, diagrams, contact lists, and detailed procedures.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the Emergency Action Plan, typically formatted as facility code plus version sequence (e.g., LF-001-EAP-2024-V3). Used for external reference and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Emergency Action Plan indicating whether it is in draft, actively in force, under review for updates, expired and requiring renewal, superseded by a newer version, or archived for historical record.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the Emergency Action Plan document, incremented with each revision or update to track plan evolution and ensure current version is in use.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Specification of PPE required for emergency response personnel, including respirators, chemical suits, gloves, boots, and eye protection. Defines what equipment must be available and who is trained to use it.

attributes.name: primary_assembly_point
attributes.description: Designated primary location where all employees must gather after evacuating the facility for headcount and accountability. Typically a safe distance from the facility with clear visibility and access.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority governing emergency preparedness requirements for this facility, such as OSHA for occupational safety, EPA for environmental emergencies, state environmental agencies, local fire marshal, or DOT for transportation facilities.

attributes.name: rescue_non_rescue_duties
attributes.description: Specification of which employees, if any, are assigned rescue or medical duties during emergencies, and which employees are prohibited from rescue activities and must evacuate immediately. Critical for OSHA compliance and employee safety.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency for comprehensive review and update of the Emergency Action Plan, expressed in months. Typically 12 months (annual) but may be more frequent for high-hazard facilities or after significant operational changes.

attributes.name: secondary_assembly_point
attributes.description: Alternate assembly location to be used if the primary assembly point is inaccessible or unsafe due to the nature or location of the emergency (e.g., wind direction for chemical release, fire spread).

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal training on this Emergency Action Plan is required for all employees at the facility. OSHA mandates training for all employees covered by the plan.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this Emergency Action Plan record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: superseded_emergency_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on emergency_action_plan (superseded_emergency_action_plan_id)

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `waste_management_ecm`.`_metrics`.`asset_container`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1

      expr: SUM(CAST(aging_bucket_over_90_days AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "waste_stream_type"
      expr: waste_stream_type
      comment: "Type of waste stream hauled"
    - name: "contamination_flag"
      expr: contamination_flag
      comment: "Whether contamination was detected"
    - name: "load_rejection_flag"
      expr: load_rejection_flag
      comment: "Whether load was rejected at destination"
    - name: "safety_incident_flag"
      expr: safety_incident_flag
      comment: "Whether safety incident occurred during haul"

      expr: rcra_classification
      comment: "RCRA classification of waste"
  measures:
    - name: "total_outbound_hauls"

    - name: "total_actual_tonnage"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_tonnage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tonnage hauled to disposal/processing"
    - name: "avg_tonnage_per_haul"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_tonnage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tonnage per haul"
    - name: "total_estimated_tonnage"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_tonnage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated tonnage"
    - name: "tonnage_variance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CAST(actual_tonnage AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(estimated_tonnage AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(estimated_tonnage AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage variance between actual and estimated tonnage - forecasting accuracy metric"
    - name: "total_tipping_fee_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tipping_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tipping fee costs paid - key disposal cost metric"
    - name: "total_environmental_fee_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(environmental_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total environmental fee costs"
    - name: "avg_tipping_fee_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tipping_fee_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tipping fee rate per ton"
    - name: "effective_tipping_fee_rate"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(tipping_fee_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actual_tonnage AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Effective tipping fee per ton paid - cost efficiency metric"
    - name: "total_route_distance_miles"
      expr: SUM(CAST(route_distance_miles AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total miles traveled for outbound hauls"
    - name: "avg_route_distance_miles"
      expr: AVG(CAST(route_distance_miles AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average haul distance"
    - name: "total_estimated_fuel_gallons"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_fuel_consumption_gallons AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated fuel consumption"
    - name: "fuel_efficiency_tons_per_gallon"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(actual_tonnage AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(estimated_fuel_consumption_gallons AS DOUBLE)), 0), 3)
      comment: "Tons hauled per gallon of fuel - haul efficiency metric"
    - name: "load_rejection_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN load_rejection_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of loads rejected at destination - quality metric"
    - name: "contamination_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN contamination_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of hauls with contamination"
    - name: "safety_incident_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN safety_incident_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of hauls with safety incidents"
    - name: "on_time_arrival_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_arrival_timestamp <= estimated_arrival_timestamp THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_arrival_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND estimated_arrival_timestamp IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of hauls arriving on time - logistics performance metric"
$$
metric_views.description: Outbound haul logistics, cost, and efficiency metrics. Tracks haul tonnage, tipping fees, fuel consumption, and on-time delivery performance.

      expr: AVG(CAST(operational_capacity_tpd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average operational capacity per station"

      comment: "Percentage of permitted capacity currently operational - key capacity planning metric"

      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(measurement_date), '-', YEAR(measurement_date))
      comment: "Quarter of measurement for seasonal capacity planning"
    - name: "measurement_status"
      expr: measurement_status
      comment: "Status of the airspace measurement (e.g., preliminary, final, certified)"
    - name: "survey_method"
      expr: survey_method
      comment: "Method used for airspace survey (e.g., GPS, drone, traditional survey)"
    - name: "regulatory_reporting_period"
      expr: regulatory_reporting_period
      comment: "Regulatory reporting period for compliance tracking"
    - name: "submitted_to_regulator"
      expr: submitted_to_regulator_flag
      comment: "Whether measurement has been submitted to regulatory authority"
    - name: "capacity_utilization_tier"
      expr: CASE WHEN (cumulative_volume_consumed_cubic_yards / NULLIF(total_permitted_capacity_cubic_yards, 0)) >= 0.9 THEN 'Critical (90%+)' WHEN (cumulative_volume_consumed_cubic_yards / NULLIF(total_permitted_capacity_cubic_yards, 0)) >= 0.75 THEN 'High (75-90%)' WHEN (cumulative_volume_consumed_cubic_yards / NULLIF(total_permitted_capacity_cubic_yards, 0)) >= 0.5 THEN 'Moderate (50-75%)' ELSE 'Low (<50%)' END
      comment: "Capacity utilization tier for strategic planning and expansion prioritization"
  measures:
    - name: "total_volume_consumed_cy"
      expr: SUM(CAST(volume_consumed_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total airspace volume consumed in cubic yards during the period"
    - name: "total_waste_tonnage_placed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(waste_tonnage_placed_tons AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total waste tonnage placed in landfill during the period"
    - name: "avg_compaction_ratio"
      expr: AVG(CAST(compaction_ratio AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average compaction ratio achieved, indicating operational efficiency"
    - name: "avg_in_place_density"
      expr: AVG(CAST(in_place_density_lbs_per_cubic_yard AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average in-place density in lbs per cubic yard, key efficiency metric"
    - name: "avg_consumption_rate_cy_per_day"
      expr: AVG(CAST(rate_cubic_yards_per_day AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average daily airspace consumption rate for capacity forecasting"
    - name: "avg_remaining_capacity_cy"
      expr: AVG(CAST(remaining_permitted_airspace_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average remaining permitted airspace capacity in cubic yards"
    - name: "avg_years_remaining_capacity"
      expr: AVG(CAST(years_remaining_capacity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average projected years of remaining capacity, critical for strategic planning"
    - name: "capacity_utilization_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CAST(cumulative_volume_consumed_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(total_permitted_capacity_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE), 0)), 2)
      comment: "Average capacity utilization percentage, key strategic KPI for expansion planning"
    - name: "total_cover_material_volume_cy"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cover_material_volume_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cover material volume used, impacts operational costs"
    - name: "measurement_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of airspace measurements recorded"
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic airspace utilization and capacity metrics for landfill cells, tracking consumption rates, remaining capacity, and projected closure timelines

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `waste_management_ecm`.`_metrics`.`landfill_cell`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Operational metrics for landfill cells tracking capacity, tonnage, status, and gas collection system deployment"
  source: "`waste_management_ecm`.`landfill`.`cell`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "cell_status"
      expr: cell_status
      comment: "Current operational status of the cell (e.g., active, closed, under construction)"
    - name: "phase_number"
      expr: phase_number
      comment: "Phase number for multi-phase landfill development tracking"
    - name: "liner_system_type"
      expr: liner_system_type
      comment: "Type of liner system installed (e.g., single, double, composite)"
    - name: "gas_collection_installed"
      expr: gas_collection_system_installed
      comment: "Whether gas collection system is installed"
    - name: "daily_cover_material_type"
      expr: daily_cover_material_type
      comment: "Type of daily cover material used"
    - name: "opening_year"
      expr: YEAR(opening_date)
      comment: "Year the cell was opened for waste acceptance"
    - name: "closure_year"
      expr: YEAR(closure_date)
      comment: "Year the cell was closed"
    - name: "capacity_utilization_tier"
      expr: CASE WHEN (remaining_capacity_cubic_yards / NULLIF(design_capacity_cubic_yards, 0)) <= 0.1 THEN 'Critical (<10% remaining)' WHEN (remaining_capacity_cubic_yards / NULLIF(design_capacity_cubic_yards, 0)) <= 0.25 THEN 'Low (10-25% remaining)' WHEN (remaining_capacity_cubic_yards / NULLIF(design_capacity_cubic_yards, 0)) <= 0.5 THEN 'Moderate (25-50% remaining)' ELSE 'High (>50% remaining)' END
      comment: "Remaining capacity tier for operational prioritization"
  measures:
    - name: "total_design_capacity_cy"
      expr: SUM(CAST(design_capacity_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total design capacity in cubic yards across all cells"
    - name: "total_design_capacity_tons"
      expr: SUM(CAST(design_capacity_tons AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total design capacity in tons across all cells"
    - name: "total_remaining_capacity_cy"
      expr: SUM(CAST(remaining_capacity_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total remaining capacity in cubic yards, critical for operational planning"
    - name: "total_tonnage_received"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_tonnage_received AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tonnage received across all cells"
    - name: "avg_daily_tonnage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(average_daily_tonnage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average daily tonnage across cells for throughput planning"
    - name: "avg_area_acres"
      expr: AVG(CAST(area_acres AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cell area in acres"
    - name: "capacity_utilization_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 - AVG(CAST(remaining_capacity_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(design_capacity_cubic_yards AS DOUBLE), 0))), 2)
      comment: "Average capacity utilization percentage across cells, key operational KPI"
    - name: "avg_tipping_fee_per_ton"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tipping_fee_per_ton AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tipping fee per ton, key revenue metric"
    - name: "cell_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of landfill cells"
    - name: "active_cell_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN cell_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of active cells currently accepting waste"
    - name: "gas_collection_cell_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN gas_collection_system_installed = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of cells with gas collection systems installed"
$$
metric_views.description: Operational metrics for landfill cells tracking capacity, tonnage, status, and gas collection system deployment
